Original: For a mech of just 35 tons this little turtle sports a lot of long range fire support in the form of 40 LRM tubes, which can scare away even much much larger enemies. For close range, self defense or a last effort push if the ammo bins are empty, the ADR-A carries 2 Small Pulse Lasers and the standard Flamer.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_adder_ADR-A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: For a mech of just 35 tons this little turtle sports a lot of long range fire support in the form of 40 LRM tubes, which can scare away even much much larger enemies. For close range, self defense or a last effort push if the ammo bins are empty, the ADR-A carries 2 Small Pulse Lasers and the standard Flamer.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 区区 35 吨的小乌龟却拥有大量远程火力支援——40 个 LRM 发射管，足以吓退远比它庞大的敌人。近程自卫、或在弹药打空时的最后一搏，ADR-A 携带 2 门小型脉冲激光和标准火焰喷射器。

Original: Every time the Adder-B is spotted you can't stop wondering how the clans fit all that firepower on a tiny 35 ton chassis. With an extremely accurate Large Pulse Laser this mid to long range configuration softens up the armor of an enemy to finish it at medium range with its powerful LB-X AC/5, backed up by a pair of ERMLs. Never underestimate the power of an ADR-B, it might be a mistake you can't recover from.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_adder_ADR-B.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Every time the Adder-B is spotted you can't stop wondering how the clans fit all that firepower on a tiny 35 ton chassis. With an extremely accurate Large Pulse Laser this mid to long range configuration softens up the armor of an enemy to finish it at medium range with its powerful LB-X AC/5, backed up by a pair of ERMLs. Never underestimate the power of an ADR-B, it might be a mistake you can't recover from.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 每次看到 Adder-B，你都会忍不住想知道氏族是怎么把那么多火力塞进区区 35 吨底盘的。凭借一门极其精准的大型脉冲激光，这套中远程配置能软化敌方装甲，然后在中距离以强力 LB-X AC/5 予以了结，另有两门 ER 中型激光支援。永远不要低估一台 ADR-B 的实力，那可能是个你无法挽回的错误。

Original: As a slightly lighter armed long range bombardment variant, the Adder-C 'only' sports two LRM-15 launchers as the main armament... And also an additional launcher for a NARC Homing Beacons. You can't hide anywhere if you have one of those stuck on your hull. For CQC and as a non ammo-dependent backup weapon, a single Medium Pulse Laser can absolutely ruin the day for ambushers who think the LRM support mech might be an easy kill.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_adder_ADR-C.Details

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一款搭载略轻武装的远程轰炸变体，Adder-C"仅仅"以两具 LRM-15 发射器为主武器……另外还多装了一具发射 NARC 自导信标的发射器。只要有那玩意儿粘在你船壳上，你无处可藏。用于近距近战并作为不依赖弹药的备用武器，一门中型脉冲激光足以彻底毁掉那些以为这台 LRM 支援机甲是个软柿子的伏击者的好日子。

The ADR-D will try to keep its distance and open up components from a safe distance before it moves in to finish the job with a set of Streak SRM2s.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_adder_ADR-D.Details

Original: Codenamed Puma by Inner Sphere forces who first engaged it, the Adder is a light Clan OmniMech that serves as a direct or an indirect fire-support unit in most of its configurations. The Primary configuration has a basic but powerful arsenal of two ER PPCs which are linked to an advanced Targeting Computer, allowing the Primary configuration of the Adder to strike at long range with deadly accuracy. It also sports a flamer.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_adder_ADR-Prime.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Codenamed Puma by Inner Sphere forces who first engaged it, the Adder is a light Clan OmniMech that serves as a direct or an indirect fire-support unit in most of its configurations. The Primary configuration has a basic but powerful arsenal of two ER PPCs which are linked to an advanced Targeting Computer, allowing the Primary configuration of the Adder to strike at long range with deadly accuracy. It also sports a flamer.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 被首次交战的内天体部队代号为"美洲狮"，蝰蛇是一款轻型氏族全能机甲，在多数配置中充当直接或间接火力支援单位。主配置装备一套基础但强大的两门 ER PPC 武器，联接一台先进瞄准计算机，使蝰蛇主配置能以致命精度在远距离打击。它还配有一具火焰喷射器。

Original: Khan Marthe Pryde decided to upgrade the 'Mechs her Clan fielded. Rather than waste precious resources designing a new OmniMech from the ground up, she instructed her scientists to improve upon existing designs. The design the scientists chose to modify was the Adder. Though the two 'Mechs are visually similar and share the same weight, the Cougar is slower and better armed.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_adder_ADR-Prime.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Khan Marthe Pryde decided to upgrade the 'Mechs her Clan fielded. Rather than waste precious resources designing a new OmniMech from the ground up, she instructed her scientists to improve upon existing designs. The design the scientists chose to modify was the Adder. Though the two 'Mechs are visually similar and share the same weight, the Cougar is slower and better armed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玛尔特·普莱德可汗决定升级其氏族装备的机甲。为不浪费宝贵资源从头设计新型全能机甲，她指示科学家改良现有设计。科学家选择改造的是蝰蛇。尽管两款机甲外观相似且重量相同，美洲狮更慢但武装更强。

Original: The Albatross was designed by the Free Worlds League in 3053 with an eye toward a possible future conflict with the then advancing Clans. The 'Mech is built using a Hermes 380 XL Engine to minimize weight and maximize free tonnage for its weapon loadout. The Albatross also uses a variety of weapons in an attempt to make the 'Mech effective at any range. The 'Mech has average mobility with a maximum speed of 64.8 kph and also makes use of double heat sinks for their greater heat dissipation capability.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_albatross_ALB-3U.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Albatross was designed by the Free Worlds League in 3053 with an eye toward a possible future conflict with the then advancing Clans. The 'Mech is built using a Hermes 380 XL Engine to minimize weight and maximize free tonnage for its weapon loadout. The Albatross also uses a variety of weapons in an attempt to make the 'Mech effective at any range. The 'Mech has average mobility with a maximum speed of 64.8 kph and also makes use of double heat sinks for their greater heat dissipation capability.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 信天翁由自由世界联盟于 3053 年设计，着眼点是与当时正在推进的氏族可能发生的未来冲突。机甲采用一台赫尔墨斯 380 XL 引擎建造，以最小化重量并为武器载荷最大化可用吨位。信天翁还使用多种武器，力图使机甲在任何距离上都有效。机甲机动性中等，最高速度 64.8 公里/小时，并使用双倍散热器以获得更强的散热能力。

Original: The Albatross does not specialize in one role and is more of a workhorse design than anything else. The 'Mech carries an Irian Weapons Works V7 LRM15 launcher which gives it long range and indirect fire support capabilities. This is backed up by an Oriente Model O LB-X Autocannon/10 and a Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Laser which give the 'Mech a powerful long-range punch. The 'Mech carries a Tronel PPL-20 Large Pulse Laser which allows the 'Mech to engage an enemy at the edge of the medium to long-range envelope. Finally, for close combat, the 'Mech has an Irian Weapons Works 60mm SRM-6 and two Irian Weapons Works Super 6 Medium Lasers.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_albatross_ALB-3U.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Albatross does not specialize in one role and is more of a workhorse design than anything else. The 'Mech carries an Irian Weapons Works V7 LRM-15 launcher which gives it long range and indirect fire support capabilities. This is backed up by an Oriente Model O LB-X Autocannon/10 and a Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Laser which give the 'Mech a powerful long-range punch. The 'Mech carries a Tronel PPL-20 Large Pulse Laser which allows the 'Mech to engage an enemy at the edge of the medium to long-range envelope. Finally, for close combat, the 'Mech has an Irian Weapons Works 60mm SRM-6 and two Irian Weapons Works Super 6 Medium Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 信天翁不专精于某一角色，更像是一款主力设计。机甲携带一具"伊里安兵器工厂 V7"LRM-15 发射器，赋予它远程与间接火力支援能力。它由一门"东方 O 型"LB-X 自动炮/10 和一门"多元光学阳光"ER 大型激光支援，为机甲提供强大的远程打击力。机甲携带一门"特罗内尔 PPL-20"大型脉冲激光，使机甲能在中远程范围边缘交战。最后，近战方面，机甲有一具"伊里安兵器工厂 60 毫米"SRM-6 和两门"伊里安兵器工厂超级 6"中型激光。

Original: Originally developed in the final year of the Amaris Civil War as the ultimate fixed position city defense BattleMech, the Annihilator was built as a sign of the military strength of the Star League in Exile. The -1A was armed with four Autocannon/10s and four Medium Lasers. While less accurate than the original -2A, the 1A was still a highly destructive and dangerous 'Mech that no MechWarrior looked forward to engaging.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_annihilator_ANH-1A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally developed in the final year of the Amaris Civil War as the ultimate fixed position city defense BattleMech, the Annihilator was built as a sign of the military strength of the Star League in Exile. The -1A was armed with four Autocannon/10s and four Medium Lasers. While less accurate than the original -2A, the 1A was still a highly destructive and dangerous 'Mech that no MechWarrior looked forward to engaging.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 歼灭者最初在阿马里斯内战最后一年被开发为终极固定阵地城市防御战斗机甲，作为流亡星盟军事实力的象征而建造。-1A 装备四门自动炮/10 和四门中型激光。虽然精度不如原版-2A，1A 仍是破坏力惊人、危险至极的机甲，没有哪个机甲战士愿意与它交战。

Original: Still a fearsome and powerful design, where the original Annihilator-1A carries a bevy of powerful autocannons, the -1E instead opts for an all-energy weapon loadout. Four Particle Projection Cannons give the Annihilator-1E a brutal and incredibly powerful punch while the Medium Lasers from the -1A are carried over for in-close protection while increasing the armor protection somewhat to mitigate enemy return fire.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_annihilator_ANH-1E.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Still a fearsome and powerful design, where the original Annihilator-1A carries a bevy of powerful autocannons, the -1E instead opts for an all-energy weapon loadout. Four Particle Projection Cannons give the Annihilator-1E a brutal and incredibly powerful punch while the Medium Lasers from the -1A are carried over for in-close protection while increasing the armor protection somewhat to mitigate enemy return fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 歼灭者仍是令人生畏的强大设计，原版歼灭者-1A 携带大量强力自动炮，而-1E 则选择全能量武器配置。四门粒子投射炮赋予歼灭者-1E 残暴而惊人的打击力，而-1A 的中型激光被保留用于近身防护，同时装甲防护略有提升以缓解敌方还击。

Original: The Apollo is designed to be a long range fire support BattleMech. This is accomplished by mounting an engine on the 'Mech that gives it a top speed of only 64.8 kph and eleven and a half tons of armor. The 'Mech was then armed with massive missile launchers which can rain destruction down on an enemy. While the Apollo has less than average speed for a medium 'Mech, if it is employed correctly the Apollo should have nothing to fear from enemy fire; it is fully capable of staying at the edge of the battlefield and laying down suppressive LRM fire.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_apollo_APL-1M.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Apollo is designed to be a long range fire support BattleMech. This is accomplished by mounting an engine on the 'Mech that gives it a top speed of only 64.8 kph and eleven and a half tons of armor. The 'Mech was then armed with massive missile launchers which can rain destruction down on an enemy. Original: The Arctic Fox is a light OmniMech reverse engineered by the Kell Hounds from the Clan Uller OmniMech with assistance in the final stages from Clan Wolf-in-Exile. The resulting OmniMech is a powerful light 'Mech that has a top speed of 97.2 km/h that is provided by a GM 180 XL engine, shaving off valuable weight from the Arctic Fox's base chassis while also making the 'Mech vulnerable to becoming a combat kill through the loss of one of its side torsos. The Arctic Fox has ten double heat sinks which are generally enough to handle the 'Mech's heat load, with the ability to add more if needed. To protect itself from enemy fire, the Arctic Fox has six tons of Royal-7 armor.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_arcticfox_AF1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Arctic Fox is a light OmniMech reverse engineered by the Kell Hounds from the Clan Uller OmniMech with assistance in the final stages from Clan Wolf-in-Exile. The resulting OmniMech is a powerful light 'Mech that has a top speed of 97.2 km/h that is provided by a GM 180 XL engine, shaving off valuable weight from the Arctic Fox's base chassis while also making the 'Mech vulnerable to becoming a combat kill through the loss of one of its side torsos. The Arctic Fox has ten double heat sinks which are generally enough to handle the 'Mech's heat load, with the ability to add more if needed. To protect itself from enemy fire, the Arctic Fox has six tons of Royal-7 armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 极地狐是凯尔猎犬依据氏族乌勒尔全能机甲逆向工程而来的轻型全能机甲，最终阶段得到流亡狼氏族的协助。成品是一款强劲的轻型机甲，由 GM 180 XL 引擎提供 97.2 公里/小时的最高速度，既为极地狐的基础底盘省下宝贵重量，也使它因失去任一侧面躯干而容易被击毁。它装有十台双倍散热器，通常足以应对其热负荷，必要时还可加装。为抵御敌方火力，极地狐拥有六吨 Royal-7 装甲。

Original: The primary configuration of the Arctic Fox is intended to wear an enemy's armor down at long ranges and then close for the kill. To do this, the Arctic Fox carries an ER PPC that can hit a target at up to six hundred and ninety meters. For close combat, two Medium Lasers provide the primary hitting power while two SRM-4 launchers seek out weak points in an enemy's armor.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_arcticfox_AF1.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary configuration of the Arctic Fox is intended to wear an enemy's armor down at long ranges and then close for the kill. To do this, the Arctic Fox carries an ER PPC that can hit a target at up to six hundred and ninety meters. For close combat, two Medium Lasers provide the primary hitting power while two SRM-4 launchers seek out weak points in an enemy's armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 北极狐主配置意在远距离磨掉敌人装甲，然后逼近收尾。为此，北极狐携带一门 ER PPC，能在六百九十米外命中目标。近战方面，两门中型激光构成主要打击力，而两具 SRM-4 发射器搜寻敌人装甲上的弱点。

Original: Keeping the top speed of the ASN-21 as well as its base weapon load of missiles, the ASN-101 is a rare Federated Suns variant that drops two jump jets and a half ton of armor to mount a trio of Small Lasers, giving the ASN-101 a much better close-in punch compared to its progenitor.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_assassin_ASN-101.Details

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: ASN-101 保留了 ASN-21 的最高速度与基础导弹武器配置，是联邦太阳稀有的变体，它削减两个跳跃推进器和半吨装甲，以装载三门小型激光，使 ASN-101 相比其前身具备强得多的近身打击力。

Original: Assassin was designed to complete against the lighter scout mechs like the Wasp and Stinger but is twice as heavy, faster, greater jump range, heavier armor and much more firepower.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_assassin_ASN-21.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Assassin was designed to complete against the lighter scout mechs like the Wasp and Stinger but is twice as heavy, faster, greater jump range, heavier armor and much more firepower.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 刺客的设计目标是抗衡黄蜂与毒刺等轻型侦察机甲，但它的重量翻倍、速度更快、跳跃距离更远、装甲更厚、火力强得多。

Original: Assassins are a rare mech nowadays with good firepower and armor with great speed and jumping range.  Makes are really good scout mech killer if you ask me. Dangerous to get jumped by one of these from behind no matter your size.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_assassin_ASN-21.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Assassins are a rare mech nowadays with good firepower and armor with great speed and jumping range.  Makes are really good scout mech killer if you ask me. Dangerous to get jumped by one of these from behind no matter your size.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 刺客如今是稀有机甲，火力与装甲都不错，速度与跳跃距离出色。要我说，它们是极好的侦察机甲杀手。无论你体型如何，被这东西从背后跳上来都很危险。

Original: The -23 variant of the Assassin is an upgrade of the original model using Lostech; originally seen as a standardized field modification, in 3067 new production began at Hellespont 'Mech Works. The SRM-2 has been removed to upgrade the Medium Laser to a Medium Pulse Laser and an Artemis IV fire control system has been added for the LRM-5 launcher. Within the CCAF, TDF and MAF it is largely used as a cheap way to rebuild shattered forces and sees service mostly in green and reserve formations. The Capellans in particular use the -23 as a fire-support unit for pursuit and strike lances, though shortages of Artemis munitions means many are forced to use mine-delivery missiles.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_assassin_ASN-23.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The -23 variant of the Assassin is an upgrade of the original model using Lostech; originally seen as a standardized field modification, in 3067 new production began at Hellespont 'Mech Works. The SRM-2 has been removed to upgrade the Medium Laser to a Medium Pulse Laser and an Artemis IV fire control system has been added for the LRM-5 launcher. Within the CCAF, TDF and MAF it is largely used as a cheap way to rebuild shattered forces and sees service mostly in green and reserve formations. The Capellans in particular use the -23 as a fire-support unit for pursuit and strike lances, though shortages of Artemis munitions means many are forced to use mine-delivery missiles.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 刺客的-23 变体是使用失落科技的原版升级型；最初被视为标准化的野战改装，3067 年由赫勒斯庞特机甲厂开始新的生产。SRM-2 被移除以把中型激光升级为中型脉冲激光，并为 LRM-5 发射器加装 Artemis IV 火控系统。在 CCAF、TDF 和 MAF 中，它主要被用作重建残破部队的廉价手段，多在生疏与预备编队中服役。卡佩兰人尤其把-23 用作追击与打击小队的火力支援单位，不过 Artemis 弹药短缺意味着许多只能使用布雷导弹。

Original: First fielded in 2765, the Atlas II was designed by the Hegemony Research and Development Department, Weapons Division of the original Star League to maintain the technological edge over the other Great Houses. It was exclusively for the SLDF's Royal Regiments. In 2785, when General Aleksandr Kerensky put out his call for loyal forces to join him in his Exodus, every Atlas II pilot responded and left with him. The Atlas II is armed with an array of weaponry, including an LB-X Autocannon/10, a pair of ER Large Lasers, and a 20-tube Long Range Missile Launcher for long range attacks. For close range combat, the 'Mech is equipped with a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers and a Holly Six Pack. In 2785, when General Aleksandr Kerensky put out his call for loyal forces to join him in his Exodus, every Atlas II pilot responded and left with him. The Atlas II is armed with an array of weaponry, including an LB-X Autocannon/10, a pair of ER Large Lasers, and a 20-tube Long Range Missile Launcher for long range attacks. For close range combat, the 'Mech is equipped with a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers and a Holly Six Pack. In addition, the 'Mech has been given CASEfor both sides of the torso in order to keep an ammunition cook-off from consuming the 'Mech.

Original: I've heard of these older refits and thankfully our Battalion never faced one. Facing a single Pilot in an Atlas is one thing, but going up against two pilots in one of these is something else altogether; an experienced Commander and MechWarrior is a force to be reckoned with. Its no wonder they were targeted so heavily targeted during the Early Succession Wars. The loss of ammo and medium lasers makes this design no less deadly.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_atlas_AS7-D-DC.YangsThoughts

Original: A Combine upgrade of the Atlas that used rediscovered Star League technology, the K model was built with a Vlar 300 XL Engine. Carrying a Shigunga LRM-20 with two tons of ammo in the left torso the 'Mech was rearmed for long range combat with an Imperator Dragon's Fire Gauss Rifle in place of the autocannon, with two tons of gauss rounds carried in the right arm, backed up by a pair of Victory Nickel Alloy ER Large Lasers split between both arms. This armament allowed the AS7-K to keep an enemy at range, though the continued use of twenty single heat sinks caused swift heat buildup if both lasers are fired repeatedly. For close range defense, the K model carried two Victory Heartbeat Medium Pulse Lasers and a Yori Flyswatter Anti-Missile System in the left arm. To round off the AS7-K's defense, CASE was added to the side torsos to protect against an ammunition explosion.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_atlas_AS7-K.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Combine upgrade of the Atlas that used rediscovered Star League technology, the K model was built with a Vlar 300 XL Engine. This armament allowed the AS7-K to keep an enemy at range, though the continued use of twenty single heat sinks caused swift heat buildup if both lasers are fired repeatedly. For close range defense, the K model carried two Victory Heartbeat Medium Pulse Lasers and a Yori Flyswatter Anti-Missile System in the left arm. To round off the AS7-K's defense, CASE was added to the side torsos to protect against an ammunition explosion.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: K 型是联合体利用重新发现的星盟技术对阿特拉斯的升级，采用一台 Vlar 300 XL 引擎建造。左躯干携带一具"紫郡"LRM-20 与两吨弹药，机甲以远程战斗重新武装：用一门"帝皇龙焰"高斯步枪取代自动炮，右臂携带两吨高斯弹，并由分置双肩的两门"胜利镍合金"ER 大型激光支援。这一武器配置使 AS7-K 能让敌人保持在远处，不过继续使用二十台单散热器意味着若两门激光反复开火会迅速积热。近程防御方面，K 型在左臂携带两门"胜利心跳"中型脉冲激光和一套"织部苍蝇拍"反导系统。为完善 AS7-K 的防御，两侧躯干加装了 C.A.S.E. 以防弹药爆炸。

But due to it's twenty -just- single heat sinks, you have to keep an eye your heat buildup.

Original: The D configuration is intended to act as a sniper. The primary weapon is a Light Gauss Rifle. For close to medium range combat, the Avatar D has two MRM-20 launchers and a pair of ER Medium Lasers in addition to the two hard-wired Medium Lasers. Finally, the D Configuration has a C3 Slave unit that allows it to work in C3 lances.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_avatar_AV1-OD.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The D configuration is intended to act as a sniper. The primary weapon is a Light Gauss Rifle. For close to medium range combat, the Avatar D has two MRM-20 launchers and a pair of ER Medium Lasers in addition to the two hard-wired Medium Lasers. Finally, the D Configuration has a C3 Slave unit that allows it to work in C3 lances.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: D 配置意在担任狙击手。主武器是一门轻型高斯步枪。中近距离战斗方面，降世神 D 除两门固定中型激光外，还有两具 MRM-20 发射器和一对 ER 中型激光。最后，D 配置装有一台 C3 从属单元，使它能在 C3 小队中作战。

Original: The 9M is an upgrade of the Awesome that uses Star League technologies. The 'Mech is built around a 320 Hermes XL Fusion engine, giving the 'Mech a top speed of 64.8 km/h. The heat sinks were upgraded to double heat sinks to allow this variant to be rearmed with three Fusigon Longtooth ER PPCs. The ER PPCs are backed up by two Hovertec Streak SRM-2s, split between the left arm and center torso and fed by one ton of reloads in the left leg, a Magna 400P Medium Pulse Laser also in the center torso, and a Diverse Optics Type 10 Small Pulse Laser in place of the head-mounted small laser.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_awesome_AWS-9M.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 9M is an upgrade of the Awesome that uses Star League technologies. The 'Mech is built around a 320 Hermes XL Fusion engine, giving the 'Mech a top speed of 64.8 km/h. The heat sinks were upgraded to double heat sinks to allow this variant to be rearmed with three Fusigon Longtooth ER PPCs. The ER PPCs are backed up by two Hovertec Streak SRM-2s, split between the left arm and center torso and fed by one ton of reloads in the left leg, a Magna 400P Medium Pulse Laser also in the center torso, and a Diverse Optics Type 10 Small Pulse Laser in place of the head-mounted small laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 9M 是使用星盟技术对神奇的升级。机甲围绕一台 320 赫尔墨斯 XL 聚变引擎建造，最高速度 64.8 公里/小时。散热器升级为双倍散热器，使此变体得以重新装备三门"富西贡长牙"ER PPC。这些 ER PPC 由两具"气垫"连续 SRM-2 支援（分置左臂与中央躯干，由左腿一吨再装填供弹）、中央躯干一门玛格纳 400P 中型脉冲激光，以及取代头部小型激光的"多元光学 10 型"小型脉冲激光。
重型狙击手 & 防御者

Original: The 9M is an upgrade of the Awesome that uses Star League technologies. Twenty double Heatsinks keeping it cool while firing the three Fusigon Longtooth ER PPCs constantly, and with it's 320 XL engine it is faster and allows in addition a variety of backup weapons, but makes the 'Mech also more fragile.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_awesome_AWS-9M.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 9M is an upgrade of the Awesome that uses Star League technologies. Twenty double Heatsinks keeping it cool while firing the three Fusigon Longtooth ER PPCs constantly, and with it's 320 XL engine it is faster and allows in addition a variety of backup weapons, but makes the 'Mech also more fragile.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 9M 是使用星盟技术对神奇的升级。二十台双倍散热器让它在持续发射三门"富西贡长牙"ER PPC 时保持低温；凭借 320 XL 引擎它更快，还允许加装多种备用武器，但也使机甲更脆弱。

Original: The Bane is a BattleMech that is based upon a Star League prototype that was never put into production. Tagged the Kraken by Inner Sphere forces who opposed it, the Bane was first built in 2827. It was originally a significant part of many Clan toumans, but was gradually relegated to second-line status following the introduction of the OmniMech. As such, it is still critical to many defensive units.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_Bane.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Bane is a BattleMech that is based upon a Star League prototype that was never put into production. Tagged the Kraken by Inner Sphere forces who opposed it, the Bane was first built in 2827. It was originally a significant part of many Clan toumans, but was gradually relegated to second-line status following the introduction of the OmniMech. As such, it is still critical to many defensive units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 灾祸是一款以星盟从未投产的原型为基础的战斗机甲。它被对抗它的内天体部队冠以"海怪"之名，于 2827 年首次建造。它原本是许多氏族图曼的重要组成部分，但随着全能机甲的引入逐渐退居二线。即便如此，它对许多防御单位仍至关重要。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Banshee 3E was originally designed for close combat, with better speed than most other assault 'Mechs. While it has heavy armor and powerful Melee attack capability, its firepower is severely lacking and it can still be flanked by lighter units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 女妖 3E 最初为近战而设计，速度优于大多数其他突击机甲。虽然它有厚重装甲和强大的近战攻击能力，火力却严重不足，且仍可能被轻型单位包抄。

Original: The Banshee 3E was originally designed for close combat, with better speed than most other assault 'Mechs. While it has heavy armor and powerful Melee attack capability, its firepower is severely lacking and it can still be flanked by lighter units. To address this design flaw, the Magistracy of Canopus exchanged the autocannon with a bigger one, at the expense of heat management in the MC variant.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_banshee_BNC-3MC.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Banshee 3E was originally designed for close combat, with better speed than most other assault 'Mechs. While it has heavy armor and powerful Melee attack capability, its firepower is severely lacking and it can still be flanked by lighter units. To address this design flaw, the Magistracy of Canopus exchanged the autocannon with a bigger one, at the expense of heat management in the MC variant.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 女妖 3E 最初为近战而设计，速度优于大多数其他突击机甲。虽然它有厚重装甲和强大的近战攻击能力，火力却严重不足，且仍可能被轻型单位包抄。为解决这一设计缺陷，卡诺普斯法域在 MC 变体中用一门更大的自动炮替换了原有自动炮，代价是散热管理。

Original: The Banshee 3Q variant lacks the long distance capabilities of its predecessor, replacing its AC10 and PPC with an AC20 and enough ammo to last in a sustained fight.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_banshee_BNC-3Q.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Banshee 3Q variant lacks the long distance capabilities of its predecessor, replacing its AC10 and PPC with an AC20 and enough ammo to last in a sustained fight.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 女妖 3Q 变体缺乏前代的长距离能力，它以一门 AC20 和足以支撑持久战的弹药取代了 AC10 与 PPC。

Original: This is some new Steiner variant, and those techs at Defiance Industries really made it a monster.  While not as fast as the original, this damage output on this 'Mech would make an Atlas jealous.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_banshee_BNC-3S.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is some new Steiner variant, and those techs at Defiance Industries really made it a monster.  While not as fast as the original, this damage output on this 'Mech would make an Atlas jealous.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是某种新的施泰纳变体，迪法恩斯工业的那些技师真把它做成了怪物。虽然不如原版快，但这台机甲的伤害输出会让阿特拉斯嫉妒。

Original: The original production variant of this 'Mech, the BKX-7K, utilizes two massive Donal Particle Projection Cannons, which were relatively new at the time. To support the massive cannons, it also has two Federated-5 Shot LRM-5 launchers with one ton of ammo to split between them and a Harpoon-6 SRM-6, giving it something to hit with at all ranges.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_battleaxe_BKX-7K.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original production variant of this 'Mech, the BKX-7K, utilizes two massive Donal Particle Projection Cannons, which were relatively new at the time. To support the massive cannons, it also has two Federated-5 Shot LRM-5 launchers with one ton of ammo to split between them and a Harpoon-6 SRM-6, giving it something to hit with at all ranges.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台机甲的最初量产变体 BKX-7K 采用两门巨型多纳尔粒子投射炮，它们在当时相对较新。为支援这两门巨炮，它还装有两具联邦 5 发 LRM-5 发射器，共分一吨弹药，以及一具"鱼叉-6"SRM-6，使它在任何距离上都有可用的武器。

Original: A failed prototype but with a hell of a punch.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_battleaxe_BKX-7K.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A failed prototype but with a hell of a punch.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 失败的原型机，但威力惊人。

Original: With the introduction of the BattleAxe’s successor, the Hammerhands, no official variants ever surfaced. However, many MechWarriors, especially those who never quite learned to manage the BattleAxe as it leapt through the air, had technicians remove the temperamental jump jets and install a second LRM 5 in each torso, deeming it the “No Crash” version, or simply 7NC.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_battleaxe_BKX-7NC.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: With the introduction of the BattleAxe’s successor, the Hammerhands, no official variants ever surfaced. However, many MechWarriors, especially those who never quite learned to manage the BattleAxe as it leapt through the air, had technicians remove the temperamental jump jets and install a second LRM 5 in each torso, deeming it the “No Crash” version, or simply 7NC.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 随着战斧的继任者"锤手"问世，再没有官方变体出现过。然而许多机甲战士——尤其是那些始终没学会如何驾驭空中跳跃的战斧的人——让技师拆下反复无常的跳跃推进器，在每侧躯干各装一具 LRM 5，称之为"不摔机"版本，或简称 7NC。

Original: A failed prototype but with a hell of a punch. But be careful with ammo you will run dry fast.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_battleaxe_BKX-7NC.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A failed prototype but with a hell of a punch. But be careful with ammo you will run dry fast.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 失败的原型机，但打击力惊人。不过要小心弹药，你会很快打空。

Original: The Battle Hawk was originally designed and built at a time when Defiance Industries felt threatened by the large amount of equipment being produced by, and imported from, the Free Worlds League. It was built to prove that Defiance Industries was still an industry leader in BattleMechs. This came from a 'Mech that, while slow for its weight class, is a force to be reckoned with on the modern battlefield. The Battle Hawk has a top speed of 86.4 kph, which puts it on par with 'Mechs fifteen to twenty tons heavier than itself, but it also carries a powerful arsenal for its size. Its five and a half tons of armor give it good protection for a light 'Mech. Additionally, to make the Battle Hawk more maneuverable on the battlefield, it can jump up to one hundred and fifty meters.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_battlehawk_BH-K305.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Battle Hawk was originally designed and built at a time when Defiance Industries felt threatened by the large amount of equipment being produced by, and imported from, the Free Worlds League. It was built to prove that Defiance Industries was still an industry leader in BattleMechs. This came from a 'Mech that, while slow for its weight class, is a force to be reckoned with on the modern battlefield. The Battle Hawk has a top speed of 86.4 kph, which puts it on par with 'Mechs fifteen to twenty tons heavier than itself, but it also carries a powerful arsenal for its size. Its five and a half tons of armor give it good protection for a light 'Mech. Additionally, to make the Battle Hawk more maneuverable on the battlefield, it can jump up to one hundred and fifty meters.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战斗鹰设计与建造之时，迪法恩斯工业正感到被自由世界联盟生产与进口的大量装备所威胁。它的诞生是为了证明迪法恩斯工业仍是战斗机甲行业的领导者。成果是一款虽在同重量级中偏慢、但在现代战场上不容小觑的机甲。战斗鹰最高速度 86.4 公里/小时，与其重十五到二十吨的机甲持平，同时也为此尺寸携带了强大的武器库。五吨半装甲为轻型机甲提供了良好防护。此外，为提升战场机动性，战斗鹰可跳跃至一百五十米。

Original: The Battle Hawk is armed with a powerful short-range arsenal. The primary weaponry is a trio of Defiance P5M Medium Pulse Lasers, which provides the Battle Hawk with a blistering short-range laser arsenal. The 'Mech is also armed with a Hovertec Streak SRM-2 which allows the 'Mech to attempt to seek out weak points in an enemy's armor. The 'Mech is also armed with a McArthur Anti-Missile System which provides the Battle Hawk with a degree of protection from missile attacks.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_battlehawk_BH-K305.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Battle Hawk is armed with a powerful short-range arsenal. The primary weaponry is a trio of Defiance P5M Medium Pulse Lasers, which provides the Battle Hawk with a blistering short-range laser arsenal. The 'Mech is also armed with a Hovertec Streak SRM-2 which allows the 'Mech to attempt to seek out weak points in an enemy's armor. The 'Mech is also armed with a McArthur Anti-Missile System which provides the Battle Hawk with a degree of protection from missile attacks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战鹰装备强大的近程武器库。主武器为三门迪法恩斯 P5M 中型脉冲激光，为战鹰提供炽烈的近程激光武器库。机甲还装备一具"气垫"连续 SRM-2，使机甲能尝试搜寻敌方装甲上的弱点。机甲另装有一套麦克阿瑟反导系统，为战鹰提供一定程度的导弹攻击防护。

Original: A upgrade Battlemaster 1DC Command refit, carrying advanced Technologies and Hardened Armour to stay in the fight as long as possible.

Original: Command Console refit built in 2855 - The BattleMaster was one of the Federated Suns' preferred 'Mechs to install Command Consoles. Standard refits usually installed the Command Console on the BLR-1G, removing one heat sink and both rear-mounted Medium Lasers.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_battlemaster_BLR-1G-DC.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Command Console refit built in 2855 - The BattleMaster was one of the Federated Suns' preferred 'Mechs to install Command Consoles. Standard refits usually installed the Command Console on the BLR-1G, removing one heat sink and both rear-mounted Medium Lasers.

Original: Thankfully I never faced one of these during my stint with the Second St. Ives Lancers on Kittery. The Fedrats, after all, preferred installing Command Consoles on the BattleMaster, but from my understanding these were relegated to training duties by the late Third Succession War. The loss of only one heat sink and two Medium Lasers is not too bad for a trade-off.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_battlemaster_BLR-1G-DC.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Thankfully I never faced one of these during my stint with the Second St. Ives Lancers on Kittery. The Fedrats, after all, preferred installing Command Consoles on the BattleMaster, but from my understanding these were relegated to training duties by the late Third Succession War. The loss of only one heat sink and two Medium Lasers is not too bad for a trade-off.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 幸好我在基特里随第二圣艾夫斯枪骑兵服役期间从未遇到过这种机甲。毕竟联邦鼠更喜欢把指挥控制台装在战将上，但据我了解，这些到第三次继承战争后期已被降级用于训练任务。只损失一台散热器和两门中型激光，这样的代价不算太糟。

Original: The Black Hawk-KU is an Inner Sphere version of the Clan Black Hawk OmniMech. In order to make it possible to copy the Black Hawk, the Black Hawk-KU is built ten tons heavier than its Clan counterpart. The Black Hawk-KU is built on a sixty ton chassis and is powered by a Vlar 300 XL Engine which propels it to a top speed of 86.4 kph.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_blackhawk_BHKU-O.Details

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑鹰-KU 是氏族黑鹰全能机甲的内天体版本。为使复制黑鹰成为可能，黑鹰-KU 比其氏族对应型重了十吨。它采用六十吨底盘，由 Vlar 300 XL 引擎驱动，最高速度 86.4 公里/小时。

Original: Well Isnt This Just a Bucket of bolts, Look At These Weapons, If You Can Call Them That,The Lasers Are Out Of Alignment And The 'Rifles' Are Dented, They Even Took The Fusion Core Out! Barbarians.. At Least It's Cheap To Replace, Not Sure Why You'd Want To.. Commander
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_blackjack_BJ-1P.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Well Isnt This Just a Bucket of bolts, Look At These Weapons, If You Can Call Them That,The Lasers Are Out Of Alignment And The 'Rifles' Are Dented, They Even Took The Fusion Core Out! Barbarians.. At Least It's Cheap To Replace, Not Sure Why You'd Want To.. Commander
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好啊，这不就是一堆破铜烂铁吗？看看这些武器，如果还能叫武器的话——激光全都没校准，"步枪"上全是凹痕，他们居然连聚变核心都拆走了！野蛮人……至少替换起来便宜，不过我不确定你为什么会想替换它……指挥官

Original: This early Blackjack prototype started along a completely different path for the 'Mech.  Focusing on close in weapons, the BJ-1X has four Flamers and four Medium Lasers.  The BJ-1X also focused more on speed than jump manueverability, increasing the engine size while removing the Jump Jets.

Original: The BJ-2 was introduced in 3052 by the Federated Suns as the new production model of the Blackjack, based on earlier experimental designs. It upgrades the 'Mech with two Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Lasers in place of the autocannons and removes the medium lasers for four Hovertec Streak SRM-2 launchers, two each in the left and right sides of the torso. One ton of ammo for the launchers is kept in the left torso while the standard heat sinks were upgraded to double heat sinks.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_blackjack_BJ-2.Details

One ton of ammo for the launchers is kept in the left torso while the standard heat sinks were upgraded to double heat sinks.

Original: An upgrade of the Blackjack BattleMech, the Blackjack OmniMech is a powerful and adaptable medium weight workhorse. Much like the Firestarter OmniMech, the genesis of the omni-Blackjack stems from the Combine's technology exchange program during the initial Clan Invasion with Ceres Metals Industries ' St. Ives Compact branch offering Luthien Armor Works specifications and licenses to manufacturer the ill-regarded Blackjack.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_blackjack_BJ2-O.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade of the Blackjack BattleMech, the Blackjack OmniMech is a powerful and adaptable medium weight workhorse. Much like the Firestarter OmniMech, the genesis of the omni-Blackjack stems from the Combine's technology exchange program during the initial Clan Invasion with Ceres Metals Industries ' St. Ives Compact branch offering Luthien Armor Works specifications and licenses to manufacturer the ill-regarded Blackjack.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为黑杰克战斗机甲的升级版，黑杰克全能机甲是一款强劲且适应性强的中量级主力。与火焰使者全能机甲相似，全能版黑杰克的诞生源于氏族入侵初期联合体的技术交换计划——谷神星金属工业的圣艾夫斯契约分部向卢西恩装甲工厂提供了规格与许可，以制造这款评价不佳的黑杰克。

Original: An upgrade of the Blackjack BattleMech, the Blackjack OmniMech is a powerful and adaptable medium weight workhorse. Much like the Firestarter OmniMech, the genesis of the omni-Blackjack stems from the Combine's technology exchange program during the initial Clan Invasion with Ceres Metals Industries ' St. Ives Compact branch offering Luthien Armor Works specifications and licenses to manufacturer the ill-regarded Blackjack. Even though it received the upgraded and more effective BJ-2 version, LAW manufactured only a few examples before reworking and retooling the line to manufacture an OmniMech version.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_blackjack_BJ2-O.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade of the Blackjack BattleMech, the Blackjack OmniMech is a powerful and adaptable medium weight workhorse. Much like the Firestarter OmniMech, the genesis of the omni-Blackjack stems from the Combine's technology exchange program during the initial Clan Invasion with Ceres Metals Industries ' St. Ives Compact branch offering Luthien Armor Works specifications and licenses to manufacturer the ill-regarded Blackjack. Even though it received the upgraded and more effective BJ-2 version, LAW manufactured only a few examples before reworking and retooling the line to manufacture an OmniMech version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑杰克全能机甲是黑杰克战斗机甲的升级版，是一款强大而适应性强的中型主力机。与火焰使者全能机甲很像，全能黑杰克的起源来自联合体在氏族入侵初期的技术交换计划——塞雷斯金属工业的圣艾夫斯共同体分部向鲁西恩装甲工厂提供规格与许可，以生产这款评价不佳的黑杰克。尽管它获得了升级且更有效的 BJ-2 版本，LAW 只制造了少数几台，随后就改造并重新装备生产线以制造全能机甲版本。

It uses an Active Probe to find hidden units, an ECM Suite to counteract enemy electronics, and a TAG spotting laser to designate targets for homing artillery. Offensively, it can call upon an ER PPC and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑猎隼 A 为电子战与侦察而配置。它使用主动探测器寻找隐藏单位、ECM 套件对抗敌方电子设备、TAG 侦察激光为寻的炮弹标记目标。攻击方面，它能依靠一门 ER PPC 和两门中型脉冲激光。

Original: The C is a close-support variant that mounts six ER Medium Lasers and a Streak SRM-6. It also uses three additional double heat sinks to help combat heat levels.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_blacklanner_BKL-C.Details

Original: This close-range brawler mounts pairs of Medium Pulse Lasers, SRM-6s, ER Small Lasers, Flamers, and four Machine Guns. This configuration is devastating to conventional infantry and a serious threat to combat vehicles. An Active Probe ensures that it is rarely surprised.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This close-range brawler mounts pairs of Medium Pulse Lasers, SRM-6s, ER Small Lasers, Flamers, and four Machine Guns. This configuration is devastating to conventional infantry and a serious threat to combat vehicles. An Active Probe ensures that it is rarely surprised.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款近战近战型装备成对的中型脉冲激光、SRM-6、ER 小型激光、火焰喷射器和四挺机枪。此配置对常规步兵极具毁灭性，对战斗车辆也是严重威胁。主动探测器确保它很少被突袭。

Original: The primary configuration of the Black Lanner is effective at all ranges. At long range, it can make use of an ER Large Laser and LRM-10. When it closes in, it can attack with a pair of ER Medium Lasers and an SRM-6 that can exploit holes in its opponent's armor. An ECM Suite protects it from many forms of electronics.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_blacklanner_BKL-PRIME.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary configuration of the Black Lanner is effective at all ranges. At long range, it can make use of an ER Large Laser and LRM-10. When it closes in, it can attack with a pair of ER Medium Lasers and an SRM-6 that can exploit holes in its opponent's armor. An ECM Suite protects it from many forms of electronics.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑猎隼的主配置在各类距离上都很有效。远距离可用一门 ER 大型激光和一具 LRM-10。接近后，它可用两门 ER 中型激光和一具 SRM-6 攻击，后者能利用对手装甲上的破口。ECM 套件保护它免受多种电子手段干扰。

Original: Taking its name from a term meaning 'Lightning War' the Blitzkrieg completely lives up to the name. The Blitzkrieg is built on a lightweight Coventry BTZ-VII Endo Steel chassis and is powered by a Magna 350 XL engine that weighs half as much as a standard fusion engine while giving the 'Mech a top speed of 118.8 km/h.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_blitzkrieg_BTZ-3F.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Taking its name from a term meaning 'Lightning War' the Blitzkrieg completely lives up to the name. The Blitzkrieg is built on a lightweight Coventry BTZ-VII Endo Steel chassis and is powered by a Magna 350 XL engine that weighs half as much as a standard fusion engine while giving the 'Mech a top speed of 118.8 km/h.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 闪电战之名取自意为"闪电战争"的术语，而它完全配得上这个名字。它建立在轻量化的考文垂 BTZ-VII 内骨骼底盘上，由一台玛格纳 350 XL 引擎驱动——重量仅为标准聚变引擎的一半，同时赋予机甲 118.8 公里/小时的最高速度。

Original: The original Bombard mounted a pair of massive Autocannon/20s in place of the Thunderbolt launchers as well as standard Medium Lasers instead of the MBM-013's ER lasers. This version was also equipped with experimental War of 3039-vintage double heat sinks, less bulky than standard double heat sinks, but which utilized corrosive coolant.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_bombard_BMB-010.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Bombard mounted a pair of massive Autocannon/20s in place of the Thunderbolt launchers as well as standard Medium Lasers instead of the MBM-013's ER lasers. This version was also equipped with experimental War of 3039-vintage double heat sinks, less bulky than standard double heat sinks, but which utilized corrosive coolant.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 原版轰击者以一对巨型自动炮/20 取代雷霆发射器，并以标准中型激光取代 MBM-013 的 ER 激光。此版本还装备了 3039 年战争时期的实验性双倍散热器——比标准双倍散热器更不笨重，但使用腐蚀性冷却剂。

Original: The Brigand is a BattleMech that is surrounded by a sea of controversy as it is the first 'Mech to be produced by a pirate band. Manufactured by a company named Vengeance Incorporated, which is run by the pirates of the Haven Star Cluster and 'Lady Death' Trevaline, the Brigand represents an unprecedented threat because in spite of the fact that it is built by pirates, it uses advanced construction techniques and weapons.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_brigand_LDT-1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Brigand is a BattleMech that is surrounded by a sea of controversy as it is the first 'Mech to be produced by a pirate band. Manufactured by a company named Vengeance Incorporated, which is run by the pirates of the Haven Star Cluster and 'Lady Death' Trevaline, the Brigand represents an unprecedented threat because in spite of the fact that it is built by pirates, it uses advanced construction techniques and weapons.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 强盗是一台备受争议的战斗机甲，因为它是首款由海盗团伙生产的机甲。它由一家名为"复仇公司"的企业制造，该企业由避风港星团的海盗与"死亡女士"特雷瓦琳经营。强盗代表着前所未有的威胁，因为尽管它由海盗建造，却使用了先进的建造技术和武器。

Original: The Bushwacker was originally a failed BattleMech designed to have a smaller forward profile to make the 'Mech a harder target to hit. The Bushwacker's unique design caused problems with the engine shielding, the side-effects of which manifested themselves as various gremlins in the 'Mech's on board electronics on the prototypes fielded.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_bushwacker_BSW-S2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Bushwacker was originally a failed BattleMech designed to have a smaller forward profile to make the 'Mech a harder target to hit. The Bushwacker's unique design caused problems with the engine shielding, the side-effects of which manifested themselves as various gremlins in the 'Mech's on board electronics on the prototypes fielded.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 伏击者最初是一款失败的战斗机甲，设计初衷是缩小正面轮廓以使机甲更难被击中。但伏击者独特的设计导致引擎屏蔽出现问题，副作用表现为已部署原型机上各种机载电子设备的莫名故障。

Original: We call the Cataphract a "FrankenMech" because it's got a little bit of everything stitched together on it. The 1X model works well at medium-long to closer range, with good armor and weaponry.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_cataphract_CTF-1X.Details

Original: The CTF-4X is the latest variant of this prototype 'Mech.  The 4X downgrades the Engine, making for a slower ride, but adds more long range firepower with two Autocannon 5s, a Large Laser and LRM5.

Original: Honestly Commander, I've never even heard of this thing.  Have to hand it to the Capellans though, these FrankenMechs are nothing if not interesting.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_cataphract_CTF-4X.YangsThoughts

Original: The Catapult A1 was designed as a true support role model.  The CPLT-A1 removes all 4 Medium Lasers in favor of additional LRM ammunition and armor.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_catapult_CPLT-A1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Catapult A1 was designed as a true support role model.  The CPLT-A1 removes all 4 Medium Lasers in favor of additional LRM ammunition and armor.

Original: The A1 model is going to need that extra armor if another 'Mech gets close in, as it doesn't have any real close in defenses.  On the brighter side, you aren't likely to run out of ammo.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_catapult_CPLT-A1.YangsThoughts

Original: Ah, the Catapult C1. Just like its namesake, it's good at lobbing large numbers of missiles over terrain without fear of return fire. Surprisingly, it's also not too shabby at closer ranges in a pinch.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_catapult_CPLT-C1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ah, the Catapult C1. Just like its namesake, it's good at lobbing large numbers of missiles over terrain without fear of return fire. Surprisingly, it's also not too shabby at closer ranges in a pinch.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 啊，弹射器 C1。正如其名，它擅长越过地形投掷大量导弹而不必担心回击。令人惊讶的是，必要时刻它在较近距离也相当不赖。

Original: The Royal Catapult, the -C1b was designed to fill the same role as the normal -C1 but better. Thanks to Ferro-Fibrous armor it sports better protection, and thanks to double heat sinks it can jump and fire all day long without problems.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 皇家弹射器-C1b 的设计目标是执行与普通-C1 相同的角色，但做得更好。得益于铁纤维装甲，它拥有更好的防护；得益于双倍散热器，它可以整天跳跃开火而毫无问题。

Original: The CPLT-C4 is an explosive addition to any outfit's arsenal.  Trading out the stock LRM-15s, Medium Lasers and extra Heat Sinks for LRM-20s and Small Lasers - along with 2 extra tons of ammo, the C4 gives the Catapult impressive long range firepower.

Original: If you can't find yourself an Archer, this is the next best thing.  While not as potent close in as the standard C1 model, the C4 can still hold its own in a brawl against a lighter opponent.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: If you can't find yourself an Archer, this is the next best thing.  While not as potent close in as the standard C1 model, the C4 can still hold its own in a brawl against a lighter opponent.

Original: The Catapult K2 is an outside-the-box redesign that trades the indirect-fire capability for heavier direct-fire PPCs. It doesn't usually mount Jump Jets, though, so it can be a bit more restricted in its use.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_catapult_CPLT-K2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Catapult K2 is an outside-the-box redesign that trades the indirect-fire capability for heavier direct-fire PPCs. It doesn't usually mount Jump Jets, though, so it can be a bit more restricted in its use.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 弹射器 K2 是一次跳出常规的重新设计，以更强的直射 PPC 取代间接火力能力。不过它通常不装跳跃推进器，因此在运用上稍有局限。

Original: An upgrade of the K2 Catapult, the K2K model changes the engine to an extralight model. The twin PPCs also have been upgraded to ER PPCs. Finally, the K2K model carries thirteen and a half tons of armor. .

Finally, the K2K model carries thirteen and a half tons of armor. .

Original: The D variant of the Centurion, introduced in 3049, is the first of many upgrades using Star League technology. The chassis was re-engineered to use Endo Steel construction techniques. Next the power plant was changed from the standard engine to an GM 300 extralight engine, increasing its maximum speed to 97.2 km/h. Finally, the weapons were upgraded. The Autocannon/10 was swapped for a Mydron Excel LB-X Autocannon/10 and an Artemis IV fire control system was added to the LRM launcher. The two medium lasers were retained.

Original: The Chameleon was designed to help a new MechWarrior master the skills of maneuvering and heat management, with a top speed of 97.2 kph and a jumping distance of one hundred and eighty meters. The 'Mech also had an almost all energy weapons loadout, but cooled only by ten standard heat sinks. This paucity of freezers forces MechWarriors to concentrate on the 'Mech's heat levels. In some instances, the Chameleon had been forced into combat situations, notably during the Dragoon Civil War. Production of the Chameleon halted briefly in 3052 when Defiance Industries decided to switch its production to the Nightsky, but was quickly resumed when J.B. BattleMechs Incorporated purchased the rights to the design. J.B. BattleMechs also introduced two battle-worthy variants of the Chameleon. The Chameleon is a training 'Mech, intended to simulate a variety of opponents by mounting a wide variety of weapon systems. A Chameleon is a medium 'Mech, but it doesn't always look like one. It can be fitted out with extra plates to modify its appearance, and carries special electronics to falsify its signature; these special abilities let it look and scan as something other than what it is, hence the machine's name.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_chameleon_CLN-7V.Details

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 变色龙旨在帮助新手机甲战士掌握机动与散热管理技巧，最高速度 97.2 公里/小时，跳跃距离一百八十米。该机甲还配备几乎全能量的武器配置，但仅由十台标准散热器冷却。散热器的匮乏迫使机甲战士专注于机甲的热量水平。某些情况下，变色龙被迫投入实战，尤其是在龙骑兵内战期间。变色龙的生产曾在 3052 年短暂中断，当时迪法恩斯工业决定将生产转向夜空，但在 J.B. 机甲公司购得该设计权后迅速恢复。J.B. 机甲还推出了两款具备战斗力的变色龙变体。变色龙是一款训练机甲，旨在通过搭载多种武器系统来模拟各类对手。变色龙是中型机甲，但不总是看起来像。它可以加装额外装甲板改变外观，并携带特殊电子设备伪造自身信号；这些特殊能力让它看起来和扫描起来都不像自己，因此得名。

Original: The Chameleon carried a basic arsenal that allowed a MechWarrior-in-training to learn the skill of heat management. The 'Mech's reliable low-tech arsenal had proven effective when forced into combat. The primary weapon was a Cyclops Eye Large Laser. This was backed up by two Intek Medium Lasers and a trio of Defiance B3S Small Lasers. To make the threat of overheating more real to the new MechWarrior, the 'Mech carried two Scatter Gun Light Machine Guns that can be used for anti-infantry training.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_chameleon_CLN-7V.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Chameleon carried a basic arsenal that allowed a MechWarrior-in-training to learn the skill of heat management. The 'Mech's reliable low-tech arsenal had proven effective when forced into combat. The primary weapon was a Cyclops Eye Large Laser. This was backed up by two Intek Medium Lasers and a trio of Defiance B3S Small Lasers. To make the threat of overheating more real to the new MechWarrior, the 'Mech carried two Scatter Gun Light Machine Guns that can be used for anti-infantry training.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 变色龙携带基础武器库，让受训中的机甲战士学习散热管理技巧。机甲可靠的低技术武器库在被拖入战斗时证明有效。主武器是一门"独眼巨人眼"大型激光。它由两门英泰克中型激光和三门"迪法恩斯 B3S"小型激光支援。为使过热威胁对新手机甲战士更真实，机甲携带两挺"散射枪"轻型机枪，可用于反步兵训练。

Original: The 7W variant of the Chameleon looked to use the 'Mech in a full time combat role. The 'Mech had upgraded the Large Laser to an ER Large Laser. Additionally, the Machine Guns and Small Lasers had been removed and replaced with a Medium Pulse Laser and double heat sinks.

Original: The Chameleon was designed to help a new MechWarrior master the skills of maneuvering and heat management, with a top speed of 97.2 kph and a jumping distance of one hundred and eighty meters. The 'Mech also had an almost all energy weapons loadout, but cooled only by ten standard heat sinks. This paucity of freezers forces MechWarriors to concentrate on the 'Mech's heat levels. In some instances, the Chameleon had been forced into combat situations, notably during the Dragoon Civil War. Production of the Chameleon halted briefly in 3052 when Defiance Industries decided to switch its production to the Nightsky, but was quickly resumed when J.B. BattleMechs Incorporated purchased the rights to the design. J.B. BattleMechs also introduced two battle-worthy variants of the Chameleon. Original: Where the CHP-2N is the downgraded Succession Wars variant of the Champion, the -1N is the fully powered Star League variant and is the original one the designers introduced. The high speed for a mech its size remains as does the somewhat anemic armor, the main benefit the mech gets from Star League technology is found in the weaponry: a LB-10X Autocannon, a SRM 6 with an Artemis IV system, and a pair each of Medium and Small Lasers. Otherwise, the -1N is much the same as the -2N and performs the same in many ways.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_champion_CHP-1N.Details

This gave the -1Nb an extremely long range weapon profile and a serious punch while also solving its heat issues.

Original: The Champion debuted in 2602 as a generalist combat 'Mech with a focus on heavy reconnaissance and fast strike capabilities. While definitely faster and more maneuverable than other heavy 'Mechs, it was criticized by many for being too large, underarmed and underarmored. The armament on the Champion is considered by many to be feeble for its size, especially after losing its advanced technology from the Star League. Carrying an AC/10, a SRM 6, and a pair each of Medium and Small Lasers, the Champion is woefully underarmed for its size.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_champion_CHP-2N.Details

The armament on the Champion is considered by many to be feeble for its size, especially after losing its advanced technology from the Star League. Carrying an AC/10, a SRM 6, and a pair each of Medium and Small Lasers, the Champion is woefully underarmed for its size.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 冠军于 2602 年首次亮相，是一款通用战斗机甲，侧重重型侦察与快速打击能力。虽然确实比其他重型机甲更快更灵活，它却被许多人批评体型过大、武装与装甲不足。许多人认为冠军的武器就其尺寸而言过于孱弱，尤其在失去星盟的先进技术之后。它携带一门 AC/10、一具 SRM 6，以及成对的中型与小型激光，就尺寸而言武装弱得可怜。

Original: The Charger is seen as an example of abject failure in BattleMech design. Wells Technologies originally wanted to produce an ultra-heavy scout 'Mech for the Star League Defense Force that was not only fast but could survive contact with the enemy. This was done by building the Charger on an 80-ton frame, making it the heaviest scout 'Mech in existence, and powering it with a massive LTV 400 fusion engine that took up almost sixty percent of the Charger's mass. With a top speed which allowed it to outrun most other 'Mechs the Charger was then given ten tons of Durallex Heavy armor, enough to survive repeated hits from a Class 20 Autocannon. However these features left very little room for offensive capability, an intentional deficiency on the part of the design team as they saw any task other than gathering data a distraction.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_charger_CGR-1A1.Details

With a top speed which allowed it to outrun most other 'Mechs the Charger was then given ten tons of Durallex Heavy armor, enough to survive repeated hits from a Class 20 Autocannon. However these features left very little room for offensive capability, an intentional deficiency on the part of the design team as they saw any task other than gathering data a distraction.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 冲锋者被视为战斗机甲设计中彻底失败的例子。威尔斯科技原本想为星盟防卫军生产一款超重型侦察机甲，不仅快速，还能在与敌接触中存活。为此他们把冲锋者建在 80 吨骨架上，使其成为现存最重的侦察机甲，并以一台占据冲锋者近百分之六十质量的巨大 LTV 400 聚变引擎驱动。凭借使其能跑赢大多数其他机甲的极高速度，冲锋者随后获得十吨杜拉莱克斯重型装甲，足以反复承受 20 级自动炮的命中。然而这些特性几乎没给进攻能力留下空间——这是设计团队有意为之的缺陷，因为他们认为除收集数据之外的任何任务都是干扰。

Original: Because the designers of the Charger wanted to discourage any activities that would put the 'Mech in danger, the engineers at Wells Technologies equipped the Charger with five Magna Mk I Small Lasers, mounted in its arms, torso and head. As these leave the 'Mech dangerously undergunned, arguably its most potent weapons are its fists; if the Charger is able to close the distance and get within hand-to-hand combat, it is more than capable of pounding to pieces other 'Mechs, especially lightweight ones.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_charger_CGR-1A1.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Because the designers of the Charger wanted to discourage any activities that would put the 'Mech in danger, the engineers at Wells Technologies equipped the Charger with five Magna Mk I Small Lasers, mounted in its arms, torso and head. As these leave the 'Mech dangerously undergunned, arguably its most potent weapons are its fists; if the Charger is able to close the distance and get within hand-to-hand combat, it is more than capable of pounding to pieces other 'Mechs, especially lightweight ones.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由于冲锋者的设计者想阻止任何让机甲陷入危险的活动，威尔斯科技的工程师为冲锋者装备了五门玛格纳 Mk I 小型激光，装在臂部、躯干和头部。这让机甲火力严重不足，因此可以说它最有力的武器是拳头；若冲锋者能拉近距离进入肉搏，它完全有能力把其他机甲——尤其是轻型机甲——砸成碎片。

Original: The 1A5 variant of the Charger was one of the first variants of the Charger made to take it from the role of scout to assault 'Mech. A Capellan modification to the CGR-1Ls they received as part of the Kapteyn Accords, the engine was downgraded to a 320 version, which reduced the maximum speed of the 'Mech to 64.8 km/h, and four of the small lasers were removed. In their place was a Tomodzuru Autocannon/20 as its primary weapon, two Bical SRM-6 launchers and an Argra 3L Medium Laser, while the 'Mech's armor was increased by five tons. This made the CGR-1A5 extremely dangerous at close ranges and gave it a speed comparable to most 'Mechs in the heavy weight class, while carrying armor on par with other eighty-ton 'Mechs.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_charger_CGR-1A5.Details

In their place was a Tomodzuru Autocannon/20 as its primary weapon, two Bical SRM-6 launchers and an Argra 3L Medium Laser, while the 'Mech's armor was increased by five tons. This made the CGR-1A5 extremely dangerous at close ranges and gave it a speed comparable to most 'Mechs in the heavy weight class, while carrying armor on par with other eighty-ton 'Mechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 冲锋者 1A5 变体是最早把冲锋者从侦察角色转变为突击机甲的变体之一。它是卡佩兰对作为卡普坦协定一部分所获 CGR-1L 的改装，引擎降级为 320 版本，把机甲最高速度降至 64.8 公里/小时，并移除四门小型激光。取而代之的是作为主武器的"友鹤"自动炮/20、两具比卡尔 SRM-6 发射器和一门阿尔格拉 3L 中型激光，机甲装甲增加五吨。这使 CGR-1A5 在近程极为危险，速度可与多数重型机甲相当，同时装甲与其他八十吨机甲持平。

Original: A Combine-LAW attempt to make the Charger more effective at long ranges, the 1A9 used a reduced 320-rated engine, lowering its top speed to 64.8 km/h, and its arsenal was overhauled. All of the smaller lasers (except for the head mounted one) were replaced with medium lasers and a single LRM-20 launcher was mounted in the right torso, with two tons of reloads carried in the left torso. To make up for the lost mobility, four jump jets were also installed, two in each leg, to allow the Charger to jump up to one hundred and twenty meters. This variant was fielded in time to surprise the Armed Forces of the Federated Suns during the War of 3039, but in years since the design fell into the hands of the Outworlds Alliance thanks to a legal snafu which gave Ravenna Electronics a production license.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_charger_CGR-1A9.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Combine-LAW attempt to make the Charger more effective at long ranges, the 1A9 used a reduced 320-rated engine, lowering its top speed to 64.8 km/h, and its arsenal was overhauled. All of the smaller lasers (except for the head mounted one) were replaced with medium lasers and a single LRM-20 launcher was mounted in the right torso, with two tons of reloads carried in the left torso. To make up for the lost mobility, four jump jets were also installed, two in each leg, to allow the Charger to jump up to one hundred and twenty meters. This variant was fielded in time to surprise the Armed Forces of the Federated Suns during the War of 3039, but in years since the design fell into the hands of the Outworlds Alliance thanks to a legal snafu which gave Ravenna Electronics a production license.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 1A9 是联合体-LAW 为使冲锋者在远程更有效所做的尝试，它采用缩小的 320 级引擎，把最高速度降至 64.8 公里/小时，并全面改造了武器库。所有较小激光（除头部那门）都换成中型激光，右躯干安装一具 LRM-20 发射器，左躯干携带两吨再装填。为弥补丧失的机动性，还安装了四个跳跃推进器（每腿两个），使冲锋者可跳跃至一百二十米。该变体及时投入战场，在 3039 年战争中令联邦太阳系武装部队大为意外，但此后数年因一次法律纠纷授予雷文纳电子生产许可，该设计落入外域联盟之手。

Original: An export model sold to the Capellan Confederation as part of the Kapteyn Accords, the CGR-1L was a simple modification of the Charger in an attempt to make it more effective following their disastrous use on Chara in 3023. In place of four and a half tons of armor and all five Small Lasers, the 1L mounts a Large Laser in its right arm and two medium lasers in either side torso. While more prone to overheating and less protected - mounting armor comparable to that of a traditional scout 'Mech - it was better capable of defending itself against other scout 'Mechs, and at the time that was good enough for the desperate warriors of the Capellan Confederation Armed Forces. Since then, the CGR-1L has remained in Capellan service as a training 'Mech and, according to rumor, punishment assignment for dissident soldiers.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_charger_CGR-1L.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An export model sold to the Capellan Confederation as part of the Kapteyn Accords, the CGR-1L was a simple modification of the Charger in an attempt to make it more effective following their disastrous use on Chara in 3023. In place of four and a half tons of armor and all five Small Lasers, the 1L mounts a Large Laser in its right arm and two medium lasers in either side torso. While more prone to overheating and less protected - mounting armor comparable to that of a traditional scout 'Mech - it was better capable of defending itself against other scout 'Mechs, and at the time that was good enough for the desperate warriors of the Capellan Confederation Armed Forces. Since then, the CGR-1L has remained in Capellan service as a training 'Mech and, according to rumor, punishment assignment for dissident soldiers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: CGR-1L 是作为卡普坦协定一部分出售给卡佩兰邦联的出口型号，是对冲锋者的简单改装，试图在 3023 年查拉星上的灾难性使用之后让它更有效。1L 以四吨半装甲和全部五门小型激光为代价，在右臂装一门大型激光，两侧躯干各两门中型激光。虽然更易过热、防护也更差——装甲水平堪比传统侦察机甲——但它更能抵御其他侦察机甲，而在当时，对卡佩兰邦联武装部队绝望的战士而言已经足够。此后 CGR-1L 一直留在卡佩兰服役，作为训练机甲，据传也是对付异见士兵的惩罚性差事。

Original: This radical modification looks to turn the Charger into a traditional assault 'Mech by reducing the 'Mechs speed to 54 km/h, which allows the use of a smaller engine (incidentally, the commonplace Pitban 240 reactor). The 'Mech is armored with fifteen and a half tons of armor and is armed with four Large Lasers, one in each arm and side torso, and a Medium Laser in its head; twenty-eight heat sinks kept the 'Mech cool.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_charger_CGR-SB.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This radical modification looks to turn the Charger into a traditional assault 'Mech by reducing the 'Mechs speed to 54 km/h, which allows the use of a smaller engine (incidentally, the commonplace Pitban 240 reactor). The 'Mech is armored with fifteen and a half tons of armor and is armed with four Large Lasers, one in each arm and side torso, and a Medium Laser in its head; twenty-eight heat sinks kept the 'Mech cool.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这项激进的改装试图把冲锋者变成传统的突击机甲：将机甲速度降至 54 公里/小时，从而得以使用更小的引擎（顺带一提，是常见的皮特班 240 反应堆）。机甲披挂十五吨半装甲，武装为四门大型激光（每臂与每侧躯干各一）以及头部一门中型激光；二十八台散热器使机甲保持凉爽。

Original: Called Challenger by its designers, the -SB modification is not remarkable because it is not particularly difficult to apply.  Using a common and well-know reactor in the refit and essentially only upgrading the existing lasers to heavier versions, in turn requiring the Targeting-Tracking System to be tampered with.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_charger_CGR-SB.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Called Challenger by its designers, the -SB modification is not remarkable because it is not particularly difficult to apply.  Using a common and well-know reactor in the refit and essentially only upgrading the existing lasers to heavier versions, in turn requiring the Targeting-Tracking System to be tampered with.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -SB 改装被设计者称为"挑战者"，它并不起眼，因为实施起来并不特别困难。改装中使用了常见且知名的反应堆，本质上只是把现有激光升级为更重的版本，相应地需要对瞄准追踪系统进行调整。

Original: In all honesty, Cicadas as a rule are very fragile. The 2A model was designed to be as fast as any light 'Mech, but that massive engine leaves little room for much else. Still, if you use it cautiously, it can be a successful scout and diversion.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_cicada_CDA-2A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In all honesty, Cicadas as a rule are very fragile. The 2A model was designed to be as fast as any light 'Mech, but that massive engine leaves little room for much else. Still, if you use it cautiously, it can be a successful scout and diversion.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 说实话，蝉总体上非常脆弱。2A 型号被设计得与任何轻型机甲一样快，但那台庞大的引擎几乎没给其他东西留下空间。不过只要谨慎使用，它仍能成为成功的侦察与佯动机甲。

Original: In all honesty, Cicadas as a rule are very fragile. The 2A model was designed to be as fast as any light 'Mech, but that massive engine leaves little room for much else. Still, if you use it cautiously, it can be a successful scout and diversion.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_cicada_CDA-2A.YangsThoughts

Original: A swap out of the 2A's Small Laser and half a ton of armor for a Flamer, this 'Mech can be quickly maneuvered in to heat up an opponent that is already having issues.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_cicada_CDA-2B.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A swap out of the 2A's Small Laser and half a ton of armor for a Flamer, this 'Mech can be quickly maneuvered in to heat up an opponent that is already having issues.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 它以一台火焰喷射器换掉 2A 的小型激光和半吨装甲，可以迅速机动上去给本就散热吃紧的对手再加把火。

Original: Not much of an improvement over the 2A model, if anything, the removal of half a ton of armor just makes you a bit more vulnerable.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_cicada_CDA-2B.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Not much of an improvement over the 2A model, if anything, the removal of half a ton of armor just makes you a bit more vulnerable.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 相比 2A 型号没什么改进，反而移除半吨装甲只让你更脆弱一点。

Original: A typical Periphery raider, the Cicada 2P is fast and hard hitting but lacks endurance and cannot survive long once it has delivered it's payload. 4 RL-20's make up the bulk of the mechs firepower, capable of threatening even an Assault mech if used correctly. The secondary weapons are a pair of medium chem lasers with a ton of ammo between them. Achieving almost identical speeds to its Inner Sphere counterparts, the 2P is designed as a heavy scout and head hunter with a nasty alpha strike capable of shredding most opponents regardless of the target. Designed to be easy to maintain and even easier to replace, the 2P is built with parts that can be salvaged from most battlefields or brought in any number of back street bazaars or disreputable arms markets. Indeed, most new 2P’s are often repurposed wrecks hauled off the battlefield and rebuilt as quickly as possible.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_cicada_CDA-2P.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A typical Periphery raider, the Cicada 2P is fast and hard hitting but lacks endurance and cannot survive long once it has delivered it's payload. 4 RL-20's make up the bulk of the mechs firepower, capable of threatening even an Assault mech if used correctly. The secondary weapons are a pair of medium chem lasers with a ton of ammo between them. Achieving almost identical speeds to its Inner Sphere counterparts, the 2P is designed as a heavy scout and head hunter with a nasty alpha strike capable of shredding most opponents regardless of the target. Designed to be easy to maintain and even easier to replace, the 2P is built with parts that can be salvaged from most battlefields or brought in any number of back street bazaars or disreputable arms markets. Indeed, most new 2P’s are often repurposed wrecks hauled off the battlefield and rebuilt as quickly as possible.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蝉 2P 是典型的外围区袭扰型，速度快、打击狠，但缺乏耐久，一旦倾泻完弹药就难以久撑。4 具 RL-20 构成机甲火力的主体，运用得当甚至能威胁突击机甲。次要武器是两门中型化学激光，共一吨弹药。2P 的速度几乎与内天体同类相当，被设计为重型侦察与猎头机甲，具备凶悍的全力齐射，不论目标是谁都能撕碎大多数对手。它易于维护、更易替换，用可从大多数战场回收或在任何后街集市、不名誉军火市场上买到的零件建造。事实上，大多数新的 2P 都是被拖离战场的残骸重新拼装，尽快重建而成。

Original: A typical Periphery raider, the Cicada 2P is fast and hard hitting but lacks endurance and cannot survive long once it has delivered it's payload. 4 RL-20's make up the bulk of the mechs firepower, capable of threatening even an Assualt mech if used correctly. The secondary weapons are a pair of medium chem lasers with a ton of ammo between them. Achieving almost identical speeds to its Inner Sphere counterparts, the 2P is designed as a heavy scout and head hunter with a nasty alpha strike capable of shredding most opponents regardless of the target. Designed to be easy to maintain and even easier to replace, the 2P is built with parts that can be salvaged from most battlefields or brought in any number of back street bazaars or disreputable arms markets. Indeed, most new 2P’s are often repurposed wrecks hauled off the battlefield and rebuilt as quickly as possible.

Original: A somewhat unusual design, this fire support mech is popular among the more advanced periphery states and with many mercenary commands. Refitting a standard 2A with an XL Engine, Gibson Federated stripped the weapons and replaced them with a pair of LRM-15’s and 3 tons of ammunition. Conceived as a relatively cheap support mech, with the speed to keep up with lighter scout elements and enough ammunition to last most engagements, it has maintained steady sales since it’s introduction and convinced Gibson to refit one of their older 2A production lines; to produce this variant. Deployed by everyone from the FWL to the Outworlds Alliance, this mech has been spreading across the IS and is a common sight among defensive garrisons. Critics of the design note it’s lack of armour and CASE whilst proponents praise it’s low cost and tactical flexibility.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_cicada_CDA-3E.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A somewhat unusual design, this fire support mech is popular among the more advanced periphery states and with many mercenary commands. Conceived as a relatively cheap support mech, with the speed to keep up with lighter scout elements and enough ammunition to last most engagements, it has maintained steady sales since it’s introduction and convinced Gibson to refit one of their older 2A production lines; to produce this variant. Deployed by everyone from the FWL to the Outworlds Alliance, this mech has been spreading across the IS and is a common sight among defensive garrisons. Critics of the design note it’s lack of armour and CASE whilst proponents praise it’s low cost and tactical flexibility.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一款略显另类的设计，这款火力支援机甲在较先进的外围区国家和许多佣兵部队中颇受欢迎。吉布森联邦将一个标准 2A 换上 XL 引擎，拆除武器代之以两具 LRM-15 和三吨弹药。它被构想为一款相对廉价的支援机甲，速度足以跟上轻型侦察部队，弹药也足以支撑大多数交战，自推出以来销量稳定，并说服吉布森改装了他们一条较老的 2A 生产线以生产此变体。从自由世界联盟到外域联盟都在部署，这款机甲已遍布内天体，在防御驻军中十分常见。批评者指出它缺乏装甲与 C.A.S.E.，支持者则称赞其低成本与战术灵活性。

Original: The 3F Cicada is one of the most advanced versions of this 'Mech, its upgrades based on combat reports from the front lines of the Clan Invasion, and was introduced in 3052. The chassis has been constructed using Endo Steel construction techniques and the 'Mech is protected with six and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. The 3F is powered by an extralight engine and carries a weapons loadout that appears to be a cross between the 2A and 3C models. The primary weapon is an ER PPC, which is backed up by two medium lasers. What's more the Cicada can now jump up to two hundred and forty meters thanks to the inclusion of eight jump jets.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_cicada_CDA-3F.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3F Cicada is one of the most advanced versions of this 'Mech, its upgrades based on combat reports from the front lines of the Clan Invasion, and was introduced in 3052. The chassis has been constructed using Endo Steel construction techniques and the 'Mech is protected with six and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. The 3F is powered by an extralight engine and carries a weapons loadout that appears to be a cross between the 2A and 3C models. The primary weapon is an ER PPC, which is backed up by two medium lasers. What's more the Cicada can now jump up to two hundred and forty meters thanks to the inclusion of eight jump jets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3F 蝉是该机甲最先进的版本之一，其升级基于氏族入侵前线的战斗报告，于 3052 年推出。底盘采用内骨骼建造技术，机甲由六吨半铁纤维装甲保护。3F 由超轻型引擎驱动，武器配置看起来介于 2A 与 3C 型号之间。主武器是一门 ER PPC，辅以两门中型激光。更重要的是，得益于八个跳跃推进器的加入，蝉如今能跳起至二百四十米。

Original: A Combine rebuild of captured 3E’s, this design swaps the LRM-15’s for a pair of MRM-20’s and 2 tons of ammo, augmented by an Artemis IV system. Assigned to the Ghost Regiments and the Legions of Vega, these Cicadas are typically employed as scout-skirmishers and scout hunters. Unfortunately the limited ammo and lack of serious protection has lead to many mechwarriors petitioning for reassignment to other units or refusing to pilot these mechs. The Procurement Department on the other hand, is thrilled that it can offload these retrofitted Cicadas to units who have no choice in the matter. Nonetheless pilots who can master this design, report satisfaction with it’s performance and many have turned to field conversions to improve it’s endurance. The most commonly one reported is the installation of an Endosteel skeleton allowing another ton of ammo or the installation CASE II.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_cicada_CDA-3K.Details

Nonetheless pilots who can master this design, report satisfaction with it’s performance and many have turned to field conversions to improve it’s endurance. The most commonly one reported is the installation of an Endosteel skeleton allowing another ton of ammo or the installation CASE II.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款设计是联合体对缴获 3E 的重建，把 LRM-15 换成一对 MRM-20 和 2 吨弹药，并加装 Artemis IV 系统。这些蝉被配属给幽灵团与维加军团，通常作为侦察散兵和侦察猎手使用。遗憾的是，有限的弹药和缺乏像样的防护导致许多机甲战士申请调往其他单位或拒绝驾驶这些机甲。另一方面，采购部门却为能把这些改装蝉甩给别无选择的单位而欣喜若狂。尽管如此，能驾驭此设计的飞行员报告对其性能满意，许多人转而进行野战改装以提升其续航力。最常被报告的改装是安装内骨骼骨架以多带一吨弹药，或加装 C.A.S.E. II。

Original: The 3M upgrade of this older BattleMech uses some of the newest technology available at its introduction in 3049. It uses an extralight version of the same Pitban 320 engine, freeing up extra space to upgrade the small laser to a Small Pulse Laser and adding an Ultra Autocannon/5 to the left torso. The new ballistic weapon is fed by one ton of ammunition stored in the right torso and protected by CASE in the event of an ammunition explosion. The Star Slab armor has also been replaced with Durallex Light, although the amount of protection is the same as in the 2A.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_cicada_CDA-3M.Details

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款较老战斗机甲的 3M 升级版使用了 3049 年推出时可获得的部分最新技术。它采用同款皮特班 320 引擎的超轻型版本，腾出额外空间把小型激光升级为小型脉冲激光，并在左躯干加装一门超速自动炮/5。这门新实弹武器由右躯干储存的一吨弹药供弹，并在弹药爆炸时由 C.A.S.E. 保护。"星板"装甲也已换成杜拉莱克斯轻型，尽管防护量与 2A 相同。

It uses an extralight version of the same Pitban 320 engine, freeing up extra space to upgrade the small laser to a Small Pulse Laser and adding an Ultra Autocannon/5 to the left torso. The new ballistic weapon is fed by one ton of ammunition stored in the right torso and protected by CASE in the event of an ammunition explosion. The Star Slab armor has also been replaced with Durallex Light, although the amount of protection is the same as in the 2A.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_cicada_CDA-3M.YangsThoughts

Original: The Clint was primarily designed as a cheap recon unit, with the capabilities of a well-armed, low-end medium weight 'Mech, and in this regard it served well. With a top speed of 97.2 km/h and a jumping capability of one hundred and eighty meters, the Clint can easily keep up with other recon elements and maneuver through mountainous or urban terrain. The 1-2R Clint was the original prototype variant that carried an Armstrong Buster Autocannon/10 with a single Medium Laser as a secondary weapon and no jump jets.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_clint_CLNT-1-2R.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Clint was primarily designed as a cheap recon unit, with the capabilities of a well-armed, low-end medium weight 'Mech, and in this regard it served well. With a top speed of 97.2 km/h and a jumping capability of one hundred and eighty meters, the Clint can easily keep up with other recon elements and maneuver through mountainous or urban terrain. The 1-2R Clint was the original prototype variant that carried an Armstrong Buster Autocannon/10 with a single Medium Laser as a secondary weapon and no jump jets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 克林特主要被设计为廉价的侦察单位，具备武装良好的入门级中量级机甲的能力，在这方面它表现出色。凭借 97.2 公里/小时的最高速度和一百八十米的跳跃能力，克林特能轻松跟上其他侦察单位，并能穿越山地或城市地形。1-2R 克林特是最初的原型变体，携带一门阿姆斯特朗"破坏者"自动炮/10，以一门中型激光为次要武器，且没有跳跃推进器。
