Original: When General Aleksandr Kerensky led most of the Star League Defense Force into exile in 2784, they brought prototypes of the Clint BattleMech with them. After the annihilation of Clan Wolverine, Clan Snow Raven revisited these prototypes and was able to begin mass-production of the 'Mech in 2830 and introduced 2842. They ensured that it kept up with advances in Clan technology, eventually becoming the design that is now known as the Clint IIC. This speedy medium 'Mech is armed with a Type KOV LB-10X Autocannon and a pair of Series 2d ER Medium Lasers. This makes the Clint IIC an effective light 'Mech killer. It is capable of ranging far beyond supply lines thanks to its four tons of ammunition, though it only uses ten standard heat sinks and seven tons of standard armor.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_clint_CLNT-IIC.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: When General Aleksandr Kerensky led most of the Star League Defense Force into exile in 2784, they brought prototypes of the Clint BattleMech with them. After the annihilation of Clan Wolverine, Clan Snow Raven revisited these prototypes and was able to begin mass-production of the 'Mech in 2830 and introduced 2842. They ensured that it kept up with advances in Clan technology, eventually becoming the design that is now known as the Clint IIC. This speedy medium 'Mech is armed with a Type KOV LB-10X Autocannon and a pair of Series 2d ER Medium Lasers. This makes the Clint IIC an effective light 'Mech killer. It is capable of ranging far beyond supply lines thanks to its four tons of ammunition, though it only uses ten standard heat sinks and seven tons of standard armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2784 年亚历山大·克伦斯基将军率领星盟防卫军大部流亡时，带上了克林特战斗机甲的原型机。在狼獾氏族被灭绝后，雪鸦氏族重新审视这些原型，于 2830 年得以开始量产并于 2842 年推出。他们确保其跟上氏族技术的进步，最终演变为如今被称为克林特 IIC 的设计。这款高速中型机甲装备一门 KOV 型 LB-10X 自动炮和两门 2d 系列 ER 中型激光，使其成为高效的轻型机甲杀手。凭借四吨弹药，它能远离补给线长期作战，不过它仅使用十台标准散热器和七吨标准装甲。
氏族狙击手与轻型近战

Original: The predesessor to the 2D, the Commando 1D was meant to give the MechWarrior a little more long range punch with a Large Laser. at the cost of some of its armor.  While the 2D is superior in most aspects, there are still a number of this older design still in service today.

Original: You don't see many of these outside of Lyran space.  While I like the added range, the reduced armor and increased heat profile make this a troublesome 'Mech.  There is a reason they moved on to the 2D.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_commando_COM-1D.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You don't see many of these outside of Lyran space.  While I like the added range, the reduced armor and increased heat profile make this a troublesome 'Mech.  There is a reason they moved on to the 2D.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在莱兰空间之外你见不到多少这种机甲。虽然我喜欢它增加的射程，但减少的装甲和升高的热量曲线使它成为一台麻烦的机甲。他们转向 2D 是有原因的。

Original: When the say Inferno, no one realized they were referring to the temperature inside the cockpit.  I suggest removing some of the lasers and adding a heat sink or two.

Original: In 3055 the Taurian Concordat's Vandenburg Mechanized Industries produced limited runs of this factory refit of the Commando COM-2D using stealth and sensor packages imported from the Cappelan Confederation. While the result was an effective scout, with respectable ambush capabilities, the expense compared to the base model, and the difficulties of multinational production, kept it from widespread adoption.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_commando_COM-2DS.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In 3055 the Taurian Concordat's Vandenburg Mechanized Industries produced limited runs of this factory refit of the Commando COM-2D using stealth and sensor packages imported from the Cappelan Confederation. While the result was an effective scout, with respectable ambush capabilities, the expense compared to the base model, and the difficulties of multinational production, kept it from widespread adoption.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3055 年，陶里安协约的范登堡机械化工业公司限量生产了这款突击队 COM-2D 的工厂改装型，使用从卡佩兰邦联进口的隐形与传感器组件。成果是一款有效的侦察机甲，具备可观的伏击能力，但与基础型号相比的高昂成本以及跨国生产的困难，使其未能被广泛采用。
轻型攻击手 & 侦察兵

Original: Well Commander, as outfitted from the factory it's certainly a superior Commando. At the chassis level it's not much different than it's cheaper cousins. But the custom Null Signature system puts it on another level.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_commando_COM-2DS.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Well Commander, as outfitted from the factory it's certainly a superior Commando. At the chassis level it's not much different than it's cheaper cousins. But the custom Null Signature system puts it on another level.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 嗯，指挥官，按出厂配置它的确是一台更优秀的突击队员。在底盘层面它与其较廉价的表亲区别不大。但定制的"虚无信号"系统让它上升到了另一个层次。

Original: The Commando 2I features modified SRMs with an Inferno payload. This pirate favorite is notorious for its ability to harass and disable, while also packing a punch with its two RL-10s.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_commando_COM-2I.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Commando 2I features modified SRMs with an Inferno payload. This pirate favorite is notorious for its ability to harass and disable, while also packing a punch with its two RL-10s.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 突击队员 2I 采用装有燃烧弹载荷的改装 SRM。这款海盗最爱以骚扰与瘫痪能力而臭名昭著，同时凭借两具 RL-10 也有相当打击力。

Original: A very recent variant, the 3A mounts a pair of SRM-6 racks and supplements its close in firepower with a Flamer.  It is an excellent quick strike 'Mech, but suffers in drawn out fights due to a limited supply of ammunition for the SRMs.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_commando_COM-3A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A very recent variant, the 3A mounts a pair of SRM-6 racks and supplements its close in firepower with a Flamer.  It is an excellent quick strike 'Mech, but suffers in drawn out fights due to a limited supply of ammunition for the SRMs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3A 是极新的变体，装备一对 SRM-6 挂架，并以一具火焰喷射器补充其近距火力。它是出色的快速打击机甲，但由于 SRM 弹药有限，在持久战中会吃亏。
轻型攻击手 & 侦察兵

Original: For a light 'Mech, the COM-3A can dish out a lot of damage in a single volley.  Though it is bound to chew up that ammo faster than my crew would go through a case of Triple-F Burgers.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_commando_COM-3A.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: For a light 'Mech, the COM-3A can dish out a lot of damage in a single volley.  Though it is bound to chew up that ammo faster than my crew would go through a case of Triple-F Burgers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为轻型机甲，COM-3A 单次齐射就能造成大量伤害。不过它肯定会比我手下那帮人吃"三重 F 汉堡"还快地耗光弹药。

Original: The Commando 4H is the Marian Hegemony's primary garrison mech, often sent out against pirates twice the weight with surprising success. 90 Rockets ensure that even out weighed it isn't out gunned.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_commando_COM-4H.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Commando 4H is the Marian Hegemony's primary garrison mech, often sent out against pirates twice the weight with surprising success. 90 Rockets ensure that even out weighed it isn't out gunned.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 突击队员 4H 是马里安霸权的首要驻防机甲，常被派去对抗两倍重量的海盗并取得惊人成功。90 枚火箭确保它即便体重落于下风，火力也不落于下风。
轻型攻击手 & 侦察兵

Original: The Commando 4H is a periphery pilots dream as far as light mechs go. All mechs are equal under such a ridiculous rocket barrage.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_commando_COM-4H.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Commando 4H is a periphery pilots dream as far as light mechs go. All mechs are equal under such a ridiculous rocket barrage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 就轻型机甲而言，突击队员 4H 是外围区飞行员的梦想。在如此荒谬的火箭弹幕之下，所有机甲都是平等的。

Original: The COM-5S was introduced in 3050 and was the first Commando to feature Star League technology. Its new Cyclops MultiTasker 10 Targeting System links an Artemis IV Fire Control System to the Coventry 90 mm SRM-6, which replaces the Shannon Six-Shooter, and exchanges the SRM-4 with a Coventry T4H Streak SRM-2 launcher. Additionally, the chassis has been upgraded with Endo Steel, the armor has been upgraded to Ferro-Fibrous, and CASE has been added to protect the ammunition.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_commando_COM-5S.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The COM-5S was introduced in 3050 and was the first Commando to feature Star League technology. Its new Cyclops MultiTasker 10 Targeting System links an Artemis IV Fire Control System to the Coventry 90 mm SRM-6, which replaces the Shannon Six-Shooter, and exchanges the SRM-4 with a Coventry T4H Streak SRM-2 launcher. Additionally, the chassis has been upgraded with Endo Steel, the armor has been upgraded to Ferro-Fibrous, and CASE has been added to protect the ammunition.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: COM-5S 于 3050 年推出，是首款采用星盟科技的突击队。其新的独眼巨人 MultiTasker 10 瞄准系统将 Artemis IV 火控系统与考文垂 90 毫米 SRM-6（取代香农六发左轮）联动，并将 SRM-4 换成考文垂 T4H 连续 SRM-2 发射器。此外底盘升级为内骨骼，装甲升级为铁纤维，并加装 C.A.S.E. 保护弹药。
轻型攻击手 & 侦察兵

Original: During the Amaris Civil War, several Lyran MechWarriors joined the SLDF in defiance of their government's policy of neutrality. With this came the coup that the Star League Defense Force had attempted to pull off for decades: the acquisition of the Lyran Commando. Long considered one of the better scout 'Mechs in the Inner Sphere, at least one of these Commandos accompanied Kerensky into exile and several of them appeared in the forces assigned to Operation Klondike. As newer weapons and 'Mechs made their way into the Clan arsenal, these Commandos began to show their age, so Clan Goliath Scorpion began a program to upgrade theirs. Dubbed the Commando IIC, this upgrade used newer technologies to outperform its venerable cousin. With the proliferation of OmniMechs, most Commando IICs were relegated to second line status, though the Scorpions still continue to outfit some of their pirate hunters with these 'Mechs.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_commando_COM-IIC.Details

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿马里斯内战期间，数名莱兰机甲战士不顾政府中立政策加入星盟防卫军。随之而来的是星盟防卫军数十年来一直试图实现的目标：获得莱兰突击队。突击队长期被视为内天体最好的侦察机甲之一，至少有一台随克伦斯基流亡，数台出现在"克朗代克行动"的部队中。随着更新式武器与机甲进入氏族武库，这些突击队开始显露老态，于是歌利亚蝎氏族启动了升级计划。命名为突击队 IIC，该升级利用更新技术超越了它古老的表亲。随着全能机甲普及，大多数突击队 IIC 退居二线，但蝎氏族仍继续用它们装备部分猎杀海盗的部队。

Original: First produced in late fall of 3054, the Copperhead is a finely honed arena 'Mech. The design rose to fame when Silver Dragons Stables MechWarrior Brendon Frazer piloted his Copperhead, the Silver Snake, into the Solaris Top Twenty prior to his untimely death. The Silver Dragons commissioned Solaris Arms to develop a new exclusive variant to try and repeat the feat, but the new model's expensive experimental weaponry forced them to allow sales to other interested parties. The Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery snapped up a number of the original CPR-HD-002 models. While not increasing the original model's meager four and half tons of armor coverage, Solaris Arms chose to replace the original Durallex plating with ArcShield Reflective Armor to enhance its endurance against the large volume of energy weapons carried by Arena 'Mechs. Already a relatively speedy design, the addition of a Supercharger enhanced its ground speed. Its extremely short jumping distance was neither improved nor removed; instead it was retained to expand a pilot's options in tight terrain. An extra Double Heat Sink, bringing the total to thirteen, is still not enough to keep up with the increased heat produced by the CPR-HD-003's advanced laser weaponry. Allowing the designers to squeeze in the new systems, a cramped Small Cockpit is used, which is less of a liability in the short duration arena battles than on an actual battlefield.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_copperhead_CPR-HD-002.Details

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 铜斑蛇于 3054 年深秋首次生产，是一台精炼的竞技场机甲。当银龙马疚的机甲战士布伦登·弗雷泽驾驶他的铜斑蛇"银蛇"齐身索拉里斯前二十名后，这一设计声名大噪——随后他不幸身亡。银龙委托索拉里斯兵工厂开发一款新的独家变体以图重现这一壮举，但新型号昂贵的实验性武器迫使他们允许向其他有意方销售。德拉科尼斯联合体征募兵部队迅速抢购了若干原版 CPR-HD-002 型号。索拉里斯兵工厂并未增加原型那可怜的四吨半装甲覆盖，而是选择把原有的杜拉莱克斯装甲板换成"弧盾"反射装甲，以增强其对竞技场机甲所携带大量能量武器的耐久力。这本来就已是相对高速的设计，加装增压器后地面速度进一步提升。它极短的跳跃距离既未改进也未取消，而是保留下来以拓展飞行员在狭窄地形中的选择。增加一台双倍散热器使总数达到十三台，仍不足以应对 CPR-HD-003 先进激光武器产生的更高热量。为让设计者塞进这些新系统，采用了狭窄的小型驾驶舱——在短时的竞技场战斗中，这比在真实战场上危害更小。

Original: The original model lacked the CPR-HD-003's supercharger and small cockpit. Instead of the Reflective armor, it was fitted with Ferro-Fibrous armor and carried only twelve heat sinks. The weapons loadout consisted of four Medium Lasers, a Small Pulse Laser, a standard SRM-4, and a one-shot Streak SRM-2.

Original: While Corsair is supposedly a generic Periphery term referring to heavy and assault class FrankenMechs cobbled together out of desperation as the Succession War era dragged on, with no specific weight or base chassis, the most successful of these are ninety-five ton brutes modeled in a generally similar style, usually marked with a COR designation. Armed with a grab-bag array of weaponry, the Corsair's primary weapons are an AC/10 and LRM-15 mounted in its right torso, supported by a trio of Medium Lasers split between its left and center torsos and a SRM-6 and Large Laser mounted in its vestigial left arm.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_corsair_COR-5R.Details

Original: The Cossack is named after the mercenary unit Khorsakov's Cossacks in honor of their faithful service to the St Ives Compact. The Cossack is a practice in compromise. Originally requested as the fastest 'Mech that Ceres Metals Industries could produce, the emphasis of the design changed throughout its development to a slow moving, heavily armored light 'Mech. The final design that was accepted became the current incarnation of the Cossack. The Cossack is built on a Taijian Series X Endo Steel chassis to save weight. More weight was cut from the design by using a lightweight Hermes 120 XL engine that gives the 'Mech a top speed of 97.2 km/h. Six Pitban LFT-65 jump jets allow the Cossack to jump up to hundred and eighty meters, allowing the 'Mech to easily handle most rough terrain. For protection, the Cossack has three tons of armor and has ten heat sinks to handle the heat produced by the weapons payload carried by the 'Mech. Overall, the compromise that created the Cossack has turned it into a light trooper 'Mech that works well as part of a team but alone excels at no one role.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_cossack_C-SK1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 哥萨克以佣兵部队霍尔萨科夫的哥萨克命名，以表彰他们对圣艾夫斯共同体的忠诚服役。哥萨克是妥协的实践。它最初被要求成为塞雷斯金属工业所能生产的最快机甲，但在开发过程中设计重心转变为一款缓慢、重装甲的轻型机甲。最终被采纳的设计成为哥萨克现在的模样。哥萨克基于"太极 X 系列"内骨骼底盘建造以减轻重量。设计还通过使用轻量化的赫尔墨斯 120 XL 引擎进一步减重，赋予机甲 97.2 公里/小时的最高速度。六个皮特班 LFT-65 跳跃推进器使哥萨克能跳起至一百八十米，使机甲能轻松应对大多数崎岖地形。防护方面，哥萨克有三吨装甲和十台散热器，以处理机甲武器载荷产生的热量。总体而言，造就哥萨克的妥协把它变成了一款轻型通用机甲，作为团队成员表现良好，但单独行动时在任何角色上都不出众。

Original: The primary weapons on the Cossack are a Kajuka Type 2 Bright Blossom Medium Laser and a MilDouglas Duke SRM-6. These are backed up by a pair of Jackson Model 12 Small Lasers. While this is not an impressive arsenal, the Cossack is capable of defending itself from most light 'Mechs and vehicles.

Original: Khan Marthe Pryde decided to upgrade the 'Mechs her Clan fielded. Rather than waste precious resources designing a new OmniMech from the ground up, she instructed her scientists to improve upon existing designs. The design the scientists chose to modify was the Adder. Though the two 'Mechs are visually similar and share the same weight, the Cougar is slower and better armed.

Original: The Cronus was designed by Angus Gilmour to be a cost-effective 'Mech for use by mercenaries and small Periphery units using scrapped military equipment. After retiring from service with the Free Worlds League Military in the 3rd Succession War, Gilmour and many ex-technicians he recruited began working for the family business, Gilmour MilTech, on his home planet Talitha. While Gilmour MilTech would spend much of its time rebuilding/restoring wrecked equipment, technicians with free time constructed small numbers of the Cronus. An inexpensive, hand-built design, the Cronus combines design aspects of many different 55-ton BattleMechs seen on the modern battlefield.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_cronus_CNS-3M.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Cronus was designed by Angus Gilmour to be a cost-effective 'Mech for use by mercenaries and small Periphery units using scrapped military equipment. After retiring from service with the Free Worlds League Military in the 3rd Succession War, Gilmour and many ex-technicians he recruited began working for the family business, Gilmour MilTech, on his home planet Talitha. While Gilmour MilTech would spend much of its time rebuilding/restoring wrecked equipment, technicians with free time constructed small numbers of the Cronus. An inexpensive, hand-built design, the Cronus combines design aspects of many different 55-ton BattleMechs seen on the modern battlefield.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 克洛诺斯由安格斯·吉尔摩设计，旨在为佣兵和小型外围区单位提供一款使用报废军用装备、成本效益高的机甲。第三次继承战争中从自由世界联盟军队退役后，吉尔摩和他招募的许多前技师开始在其母星塔利莎为家族企业吉尔摩军工工作。虽然吉尔摩军工大部分时间用于重建/修复报废装备，有余力的技师们小批量地制造克洛诺斯。作为一款廉价的手工打造设计，克洛诺斯融合了现代战场上多种 55 吨战斗机甲的设计特点。

Original: An older variant of the Cronus, the 3M uses all standard technologies that have been available to the Inner Sphere in 3031. As its primary weapon, the 3M has a Large Laser which is backed up by three Medium Lasers and a SRM-4 launcher. The 3M is slightly slower than the 5M, with a top speed of 86.4 km/h and it carries a price tag of 4,896,656 C-Bills, which is less than the 5M by of 7,754,522.

After retiring from service with the Free Worlds League Military in the 3rd Succession War, Gilmour and many ex-technicians he recruited began working for the family business, Gilmour MilTech, on his home planet Talitha. While Gilmour MilTech would spend much of its time rebuilding/restoring wrecked equipment, technicians with free time constructed small numbers of the Cronus. An inexpensive, hand-built design, the Cronus combines design aspects of many different 55-ton BattleMechs seen on the modern battlefield.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 克洛诺斯由安格斯·吉尔摩设计，旨在为佣兵和小型外围区单位提供一款使用报废军用装备、成本效益高的机甲。第三次继承战争中从自由世界联盟军队退役后，吉尔摩和他招募的许多前技师开始在其母星塔利莎为家族企业吉尔摩军工工作。虽然吉尔摩军工大部分时间用于重建/修复报废装备，有余力的技师们小批量地制造克洛诺斯。作为一款廉价的手工打造设计，克洛诺斯融合了现代战场上多种 55 吨战斗机甲的设计特点。

Original: The upgraded Cronus is built on a lightweight Earthwerk SHD II Endo Steel chassis that carries a VOX 330 XL engine, providing a top speed of 97.2 km/h. The Cronus has enhanced mobility with six Northrup 12000 jump jets that allow the 'Mech to jump up to one hundred and eighty meters. It is protected with ten and a half tons of Maximillian 43 armor, with CASE. The Cronus is able to handle the heat from its weapons with fourteen double heat sinks and is fitted with a C3 slave unit, allowing it to be integrated into a C3 unit. The Cronus has a Magna Sunspot ER PPC as its primary long ranged weapon. The ER PPC is capable of delivering consistent damage at all of its range brackets. For close combat, the Cronus has two Diverse Optics Type ER Medium Lasers and a single Diverse Optics Type ER Small Laser. Finally, to seek out weak points in an enemy's armor, the Cronus carries a Harpoon-4S Streak SRM-4.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_cronus_CNS-5M.YangsThoughts

Original: The Daimyo is named for the title used for warlords from the medieval Japanese empire. The 'Mech, first produced in 3053, attempts to live up to the heritage of its name admirably. It is armed primarily for long range combat but can hold its own if the situation warrants it. The Daimyo's maximum speed of 86.4 kph and its Nissan 200 fusion engine make the Daimyo a rugged 'Mech that can survive an amazing amount of damage, while bringing the fight to the enemy.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_daimyo_DMO-1K.Details

Original: The primary long range weapon on the Daimyo is a Lord's Light 2 ER PPC, which allows the 'Mech to strike at an enemy from extreme ranges. Once the 'Mech closes with its enemy, it is able to bring its close range arsenal to bear. This consists of two Victory 23R Medium Lasers, which are backed up by a Shannon SH-60 SRM-6 missile launcher.

Original: The Dart was built when the Federated Commonwealth was looking for BattleMechs that were not ammunition dependent. The 'Mech, while lightly armed, is an exceptional recon 'Mech and also works well in a guerrilla force where its use of energy weapons allows it to operate independently.

Original: The Dervish carries as its main weapons two Federated 10-Shot LRM launchers. These missile launchers give the Dervish the long-range capability needed to provide fire support to friendly units and are safely embedded in the torso as opposed to the exposed launchers on other 'Mechs. A ton of ammunition per launcher provides sufficient endurance for any but the most prolonged battles. For close combat, the Dervish carries two Federated 2-Shot SRM launchers and two ChisComp 39 Medium Lasers. The SRM launchers are completely self-contained within the forearms, allowing them to be aimed quickly, and fed by a ton of ammunition each. The lasers are placed just above the launchers and ensure the 'Mech is still capable of fighting should it run out of missiles. The Dervish is capable of jumping 150 meters and is protected by seven and a half tons of armor.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_dervish_DV-6M.Details

A ton of ammunition per launcher provides sufficient endurance for any but the most prolonged battles. For close combat, the Dervish carries two Federated 2-Shot SRM launchers and two ChisComp 39 Medium Lasers. The SRM launchers are completely self-contained within the forearms, allowing them to be aimed quickly, and fed by a ton of ammunition each. The lasers are placed just above the launchers and ensure the 'Mech is still capable of fighting should it run out of missiles. The Dervish is capable of jumping 150 meters and is protected by seven and a half tons of armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 苦行僧以两具联邦 10 发 LRM 发射器为主武器。这些导弹发射器为苦行僧提供了向友军提供火力支援所需的远程能力，且安全嵌入躯干内，不像其他机甲那样外露。每具发射器一吨弹药，除最持久的战斗外足以支撑。近战方面，苦行僧携带两具联邦 2 发 SRM 发射器和两门 ChisComp 39 中型激光。SRM 发射器完全内嵌于前臂，可迅速瞄准，各由一吨弹药供弹。激光位于发射器正上方，确保机甲在导弹耗尽后仍能作战。苦行僧能跳 150 米，并由七吨半装甲保护。

Original: The 7D Dervish is a 3047 upgrade of the design using Star League technology. The 'Mech is built with an Endo Steel chassis and also uses eight tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor with CASE for protection against ammunition explosions. With the saved weight, the SRM-2s have been upgraded to Federated SuperStreak SRMs and the 'Mech uses double heat sinks. This variant was first produced by Achernar BattleMechs on New Avalon.

Original: The 7P is a Medium Range Missile Boat, carrying an MRM-20 and MRM-10 in each arm, supported by a Medium Laser in each arm and side torso. Such a heavy loadout while retaining the Dervish's usual seven and half tons of armor and five jump jets is made possible with an 275 rated extralight engine and Endo Steel frame. The 7P is fitted with ten double heat sinks and carries a combined four tons of MRM reloads.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_dervish_DV-7P.Details

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 7P 是一款中程导弹平台，每臂携带一具 MRM-20 和 MRM-10，由每臂及每侧躯干各一门中型激光支援。在保留苦行僧惯常的七吨半装甲和五个跳跃推进器的同时实现如此沉重的载荷，要归功于一台 275 额定超轻型引擎和内骨骼框架。7P 装有十台双倍散热器，并携带共四吨 MRM 再装填。

Original: The Dire Wolf is one of the OmniMechs that became feared throughout the Inner Sphere during the initial Clan Invasion and rightly so. The Dire Wolf weighs in at an impressive one hundred tons and has a relatively slow cruising speed of 54 km/h provided by a 300 XL engine. Its speed and armor protection matches that of an Atlas, but it has superior potential firepower with fifty and a half tons of free pod space for weapons and equipment. It is these traits which saw the 'Mech christened Daishi (pseudo-Japanese for 'Great Death') by the criminal underbelly of the Draconis Combine, a name that would be proven grimly accurate time and time again.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_direwolf_DS-PRIME.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Dire Wolf is one of the OmniMechs that became feared throughout the Inner Sphere during the initial Clan Invasion and rightly so. The Dire Wolf weighs in at an impressive one hundred tons and has a relatively slow cruising speed of 54 km/h provided by a 300 XL engine. Its speed and armor protection matches that of an Atlas, but it has superior potential firepower with fifty and a half tons of free pod space for weapons and equipment. It is these traits which saw the 'Mech christened Daishi (pseudo-Japanese for 'Great Death') by the criminal underbelly of the Draconis Combine, a name that would be proven grimly accurate time and time again.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 恐狼是氏族入侵初期令整个内天体闻之色变的全能机甲之一，实至名归。它重达惊人的一百吨，由 300 XL 引擎驱动，巡航速度相对缓慢，仅 54 公里/小时。它的速度与装甲防护与阿特拉斯相当，但凭借五十吨半的自由吊舱空间搭载武器与装备，拥有更强的火力潜力。正因如此，德拉科尼斯联合体的黑道将其命名为"大师"（伪日语"伟大的死亡"），而这名字一次又一次被证明冷酷地精准。

Original: This Direwolf Commander is a piece of work by a nutcase clanner and I have seen many weird stuff. The madman or whoever designed this, must have been clearly out of his mind. Sacrificing everything for pure firepower this mech mounts 11 clan ERPPCs, that will instantly shut down your mech, if you try to alpha strike as well bringing lot of pain to the target. If the mech doesn't get destroyed while being shutdown it will definitely blow up by all the excess heat by firing all those PPCs.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_direwolf_DS-PRIME.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Direwolf Commander is a piece of work by a nutcase clanner and I have seen many weird stuff. The madman or whoever designed this, must have been clearly out of his mind. Sacrificing everything for pure firepower this mech mounts 11 clan ERPPCs, that will instantly shut down your mech, if you try to alpha strike as well bringing lot of pain to the target. If the mech doesn't get destroyed while being shutdown it will definitely blow up by all the excess heat by firing all those PPCs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台"恐狼指挥官"是某个疯子氏族人的杰作，而我已经见过很多古怪的东西。这个疯子——或不管是谁设计的——显然完全失去了理智。为了纯粹的火力牺牲一切，这台机甲装了 11 门氏族 ER PPC，如果你试图齐射，它会立刻让你的机甲停机，同时给目标带来巨大痛苦。如果机甲在停机状态下没被摧毁，它也会因发射所有这些 PPC 产生的过量热量而爆炸。

Original: The standard against which all battle armor is measured, the Elemental battle armor was first introduced in 2868 by Clan Wolf in a Trial of Possession against the Nova Cats. It was a marvel of Clan engineering that allowed a small group of operators to take down large 'Mechs and survive the encounter. While it is possible for a normal-sized human to use the battle armor, this design is tailored for the Clans' giant Elemental warriors and only they can bring out its fullest potential.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_Elemental.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The standard against which all battle armor is measured, the Elemental battle armor was first introduced in 2868 by Clan Wolf in a Trial of Possession against the Nova Cats. It was a marvel of Clan engineering that allowed a small group of operators to take down large 'Mechs and survive the encounter. While it is possible for a normal-sized human to use the battle armor, this design is tailored for the Clans' giant Elemental warriors and only they can bring out its fullest potential.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 元素战斗装甲是所有战斗装甲的衡量标准，由狼氏族于 2868 年在对抗诺瓦猫的占有试炼中首次推出。它是氏族工程的奇迹，能让一小队操作员击倒大型机甲并幸存下来。虽然普通体型的人也能使用这种战斗装甲，但该设计是为氏族巨人般的元素战士量身打造，唯有他们才能发挥其全部潜力。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 元素战斗装甲是所有战斗装甲的衡量标准，由狼氏族于 2868 年在对抗诺瓦猫的占有试炼中首次推出。它是氏族工程的奇迹，能让一小队操作员击倒大型机甲并幸存下来。虽然普通体型的人也能使用这种战斗装甲，但该设计是为氏族巨人般的元素战士量身打造，唯有他们才能发挥其全部潜力。

Original: The Enfield was originally designed to replace the Wyvern as an urban combat 'Mech, but the design never made it to mass production. The plans for the Enfield were lost during the Succession Wars and were recovered by the Federated Suns on the world of Achernar in 2870. Knowledge of the design was kept hidden until the 3050s, when the NAIS selected the Enfield as a companion 'Mech to the Enforcer. The Enfield began production in 3055 and has seen heavy deployment to the Lyran Alliance because of the constant threat presented by the Clans. The 'Mech carries eleven tons of StarGuard III armor with CASE to protect against ammunition explosions. The Enfield is built on a Blackstone MD2E Endo Steel chassis and uses a Magna 250 XL engine which gives the 'Mech a top speed of 86.4 km/h to save weight, allowing it to carry a heavy arsenal. Due its extra-light engine, however, the 'Mech developed an undeserved reputation for being fragile in heavy combat.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_enfield_END-6J.Details

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 恩菲尔德最初旨在取代双足飞龙成为城市战斗机甲，但从未进入量产。其图纸在继承战争中遗失，2870 年由联邦太阳系在阿克尔纳星上寻回。该设计的知识一直被保密到 3050 年代，NAIS 选定恩菲尔德作为执法者的搭档机甲。恩菲尔德于 3055 年开始生产，因氏族的持续威胁而在莱兰联盟大量部署。机甲携带十一吨星卫 III 装甲并配 C.A.S.E. 以防弹药爆炸。恩菲尔德建立在黑石 MD2E 内骨骼底盘上，使用玛格纳 250 XL 引擎，最高速度 86.4 公里/小时，以节省重量从而搭载重型武器库。然而由于使用超轻型引擎，它在激烈战斗中落下了"脆弱"的冤枉名声。

Original: The 6J variant of the Enfield removes the Small Laser from the 'Mech and exchanges the Large Pulse Laser for a Large Laser. The saved weight is used to add five jump jets, allowing the Enfield to jump up to one hundred and fifty meters. This variant of the Enfield is very reliable, and although it loses some firepower and accuracy in the Large Laser, the addition of the jump jets gives it a high degree of mobility and survivability.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_enfield_END-6J.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 6J variant of the Enfield removes the Small Laser from the 'Mech and exchanges the Large Pulse Laser for a Large Laser. The saved weight is used to add five jump jets, allowing the Enfield to jump up to one hundred and fifty meters. This variant of the Enfield is very reliable, and although it loses some firepower and accuracy in the Large Laser, the addition of the jump jets gives it a high degree of mobility and survivability.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 英菲尔德的 6J 变体移除机甲上的小型激光，并把大型脉冲激光换成大型激光。节省的重量用于加装五个跳跃推进器，使英菲尔德能跳起至一百五十米。英菲尔德此变体非常可靠，虽然大型激光损失了一些火力与精度，但跳跃推进器的加入赋予它高度机动性与生存性。

Original: First walking off the production line in late 3050, the 5D Enforcer is a major upgrade to the standard 'Mech, meeting many of its pilots' desire for something faster, better-protected and with more endurance. The Nissan 200 engine has been removed and replaced with a Magna 250 Extralight Engine, increasing the Enforcer's top speed to 86.4 km/h and the amount of space available for other additions. The armor has been stripped from the 'Mech and replaced with StarGuard CIV Ferro-Fibrous armor with CASE to protect against an ammunition explosion while the weapons payload has also been changed. Retaining the small laser both the Autocannon/10 and the Large Laser were replaced for a new Mydron Excel LB-X Autocannon/10, fed by two tons of ammunition, and a BlazeFire Sweetshot ER Large Laser. Finally, an additional jump jet was added, increasing the jumping distance by thirty meters to keep up with the Enforcer's new speed profile.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_enforcer_ENF-5D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: First walking off the production line in late 3050, the 5D Enforcer is a major upgrade to the standard 'Mech, meeting many of its pilots' desire for something faster, better-protected and with more endurance. The Nissan 200 engine has been removed and replaced with a Magna 250 Extralight Engine, increasing the Enforcer's top speed to 86.4 km/h and the amount of space available for other additions. The armor has been stripped from the 'Mech and replaced with StarGuard CIV Ferro-Fibrous armor with CASE to protect against an ammunition explosion while the weapons payload has also been changed. Retaining the small laser both the Autocannon/10 and the Large Laser were replaced for a new Mydron Excel LB-X Autocannon/10, fed by two tons of ammunition, and a BlazeFire Sweetshot ER Large Laser. Finally, an additional jump jet was added, increasing the jumping distance by thirty meters to keep up with the Enforcer's new speed profile.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5D 执法者于 3050 年末首次下线，是标准机甲的重大升级，满足了许多飞行员对更快、防护更好、续航更久的需求。日产 200 引擎被移除，换成玛格纳 250 超轻型引擎，将执法者最高速度提升至 86.4 公里/小时，并腾出更多空间用于其他加装。装甲被剥离，改为星卫 CIV 铁纤维装甲并配 C.A.S.E. 以防弹药爆炸，武器配置也作了更改。保留小型激光的同时，自动炮/10 和大型激光换成一门迈德龙 Excel LB-X 自动炮/10（由两吨弹药供弹）和一门烈焰"甜射"ER 大型激光。最后加装一个跳跃推进器，使跳跃距离增加三十米，以跟上执法者新的速度曲线。

Original: Fast and powerful, the Executioner, known as the Gladiator in the Inner Sphere, is an assault OmniMech developed by Clan Ghost Bear. As one of the fastest assault mechs available, the Executioner surprises its prey by being able to alter the engagement ranges way quicker than expected from a mech of this weight. The Executioner PRIME uses its speed to stay at distance to make full use of its long range weaponry.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_executioner_PRIME.Details

The Executioner PRIME uses its speed to stay at distance to make full use of its long range weaponry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 行刑者快速而强大，在内天体被称为角斗士，是由鬼熊氏族开发的突击全能机甲。作为可用的最快突击机甲之一，行刑者能比人们对该重量机甲的预期更快地改变交战距离，从而突袭猎物。行刑者主型号利用其速度保持距离，以充分发挥远程武器的威力。

Original: The Inner Sphere Standard was developed following the initial thrust of the Clan invasion, as Inner Sphere powers rushed to duplicate the battle armor technology the Clans fielded. Lacking any battlefield salvage on which to base their development though, engineers were forced to work off of ancient rumors of early power armor suits like the Nighthawk, more akin to armored Exoskeletons than the 'Toads' currently rampaging through known space, and these prototypes fared poorly during testing. It took salvage from the first victories over the Clans to truly kick-start the development of battle armor. The New Avalon Institute of Science was the first to reproduce in part the Clans' Elemental armor as the Inner Sphere Standard.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_battlearmor_IS-STD.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Inner Sphere Standard was developed following the initial thrust of the Clan invasion, as Inner Sphere powers rushed to duplicate the battle armor technology the Clans fielded. Lacking any battlefield salvage on which to base their development though, engineers were forced to work off of ancient rumors of early power armor suits like the Nighthawk, more akin to armored Exoskeletons than the 'Toads' currently rampaging through known space, and these prototypes fared poorly during testing. It took salvage from the first victories over the Clans to truly kick-start the development of battle armor. The New Avalon Institute of Science was the first to reproduce in part the Clans' Elemental armor as the Inner Sphere Standard.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 内天体标准型是在氏族入侵首轮攻势后开发的，当时内天体各势力竞相复制氏族装备的战斗装甲技术。然而由于缺乏战场缴获作为研发基础，工程师们只能依据"夜鹰"等早期动力装甲的古老传闻着手——它们与其说是当前肆虐已知空间的"蟾蜍"式装甲，更像是带装甲的外骨骼。这些原型在测试中表现糟糕。直到从对氏族的首次胜利中获得缴获品，战斗装甲的研发才真正起步。新阿瓦隆科学研究院率先部分复制了氏族的元素战士装甲，即内天体标准型。

Original: The Exterminator is a BattleMech that was designed in 2630 for the most dubious, but necessary, of purposes: Headhunting. Advanced systems allowed it to easily infiltrate enemy lines. Once the Exterminator had breached the enemy's rear, its mission was to find and destroy as much of the enemy's command structure as possible. This mission profile included attacking Mobile Headquarters, field bases and command level officers. Rather than be part of the standard formation, Exterminators were attached to a regimental or higher headquarters unit, often as a fifth member of the command lance itself, before being assigned to individual units.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_exterminator_EXT-4D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Exterminator is a BattleMech that was designed in 2630 for the most dubious, but necessary, of purposes: Headhunting. Advanced systems allowed it to easily infiltrate enemy lines. Once the Exterminator had breached the enemy's rear, its mission was to find and destroy as much of the enemy's command structure as possible. This mission profile included attacking Mobile Headquarters, field bases and command level officers. Rather than be part of the standard formation, Exterminators were attached to a regimental or higher headquarters unit, often as a fifth member of the command lance itself, before being assigned to individual units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 灭绝者在 2630 年设计，用途最可疑却也最必要：猎杀指挥官。先进系统使它易于渗透敌线。一旦突入敌后，灭绝者的任务就是尽可能多地寻找并摧毁敌方指挥体系，包括攻击机动指挥部、野战基地和指挥级军官。灭绝者不编入标准编制，而是配属团级或更高指挥部，往往是指挥连的第五名成员，然后才被分配至具体单位。

Original: Originally developed as an anti-infantry and Bug Hunter 'Mech, the Falcon is a highly popular light recon and skirmisher 'Mech. Initially created for the newly formed Star League Defense Force's use in the Reunification War, the popular design remained in production until the destruction of Stormvanger's Hesperus II Falcon line during the Third Battle of Hesperus II in 2789, becoming all but extinct until the arrival of Wolf's Dragoonsin 3005. Well regarded by the mercenaries, the Dragoons upgraded their dwindling number of Falcons in the early 3050s before eventually commissioning Blackwell Industries to restart production of the design in early 3060 to produce advanced Clan-tech versions for their exclusive use, as well as more mundane and affordable versions for the general mercenary market. While originally sporting a weapons array similar to the Locust, Stinger and Waspit was charged to defeat, the Falcon's six tons of StarGuard Type II armor provided it with vastly superior protection, allowing it to outlast them and remain combat effective longer. When it was originally developed, the 'Mech's top speed of 97.2 kph and a jumping distance of one hundred and fifty meters allowed it to keep up with other light recon 'Mechs. But by the 3060s the Falconwas outclassed by newer and faster designs, only its use of a cheaper standard Fusion Engine rather than a more expensive and fragile Light or XL Engine kept buyers interested.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_falcon_FLC-4N.Details

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎鹰最初是作为反步兵与"猎虫者"机甲开发的，是一款极受欢迎的轻型侦察与游骑机甲。它最初为新成立的星盟防卫军用于统一战争而制造，这款广受欢迎的机型一直生产到 2789 年第三次赫斯佩鲁斯 II 战役中斯托姆万格的赫斯佩鲁斯 II 猎鹰生产线被毁，此后几乎灭绝，直到 3005 年狼之龙骑兵到来。这支佣兵团对它评价甚高，于 3050 年代初升级了日益减少的猎鹰，最终在 3060 年代初委托布莱克威尔工业重启生产，为其独家生产先进的氏族科技版本，也为普通佣兵市场提供更朴素实惠的版本。猎鹰原本的武器配置与其要击败的蝗虫、毒刺和黄蜂相似，但其六吨星卫 II 型装甲提供了远为优越的防护，使其能比对手更持久、更久地保持战斗力。初研制时，它 97.2 公里/小时的最高速度和一百五十米的跳跃距离使其能跟上其他轻型侦察机甲。但到 3060 年代，猎鹰已被更新更快的设计超越，唯有其使用较便宜的标配聚变引擎而非更昂贵脆弱的轻型或 XL 引擎，才让买家保持兴趣。

Original: The original Falcon designed in 2582, the 4N model has a lighter arsenal more akin to 'Mechs 10 tons lighter. The primary weapon is a SunGlow Type 1 Medium Laser with two Omnicron 1000 Small Lasers as secondary weapons. To deter infantry attacks, the 'Mech carries two rear mounted Reginald Mark VI Machine Guns with a shared single ton of ammo. The 4N was equipped with a Garret T20C communications system and a Dynatec 150A targeting and tracking system.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_falcon_FLC-4N.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Falcon designed in 2582, the 4N model has a lighter arsenal more akin to 'Mechs 10 tons lighter. To deter infantry attacks, the 'Mech carries two rear mounted Reginald Mark VI Machine Guns with a shared single ton of ammo. The 4N was equipped with a Garret T20C communications system and a Dynatec 150A targeting and tracking system.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 4N 型号是 2582 年设计的原版猎鹰，武器较轻，更像轻 10 吨的机甲。主武器是一门"阳光 1 型"中型激光，次要武器为两门奥米克戎 1000 小型激光。为威慑步兵攻击，机甲携带两挺后向"雷金纳德 Mark VI"机枪，共用一吨弹药。4N 装备加勒特 T20C 通讯系统和 Dynatec 150A 瞄准追踪系统。

Finally, for protection from missiles, the rear-facing machine guns were dropped for a forward facing Sure Fire 444 Anti-Missile System and a single ton of ammunition.

Original: The Fireball was a quick response BattleMech built as a direct result of the Clans' Elemental infantry. As the Clans swept through the Inner Sphere, members of the Armed Forces of the Federated Commonwealth met with scientists from the New Avalon Institute of Science to discuss, among other things, how to counter their new Battle Armored foes. The result was a 'Mech which on paper met many of the criteria for successfully dealing with Elementals: it had weapons with a high rate-of-fire for taking on swarms of Toads as they were known, had ammunition stores to maintain that rate for extended periods, and an extremely high speed so it could quickly come to the aid of heavier units. These Fireballs were given to units with prior experience fighting the Clans but assigned to rookie pilots, partly because the 'Mech's capabilities fit the personality of many of these new Mechwarriors, partly to more quickly build up their combat experience. The Crucis Lancers, Deneb Light Cavalry and Ceti Hussars were the first regiments to receive these 'Mechs in 3053, employing them immediately on the front lines as raiding along the border between the Inner Sphere and Occupation Zones commenced following the Truce of Tukayyid.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_fireball_ALM-7D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 火球是为直接应对氏族元素步兵而建造的快速反应战斗机甲。当氏族席卷内天体时，联邦联邦武装部队成员与新阿瓦隆科学研究院的科学家会面，讨论如何对抗这些新的战斗装甲敌人等问题。成果是一款在纸面上满足成功应对元素战士多项标准的机甲：它拥有高射速武器以对付成群的"蟾蜍"，有足以长时间维持该射速的弹药储备，以及极高的速度以便迅速支援较重的单位。这些火球被分配给有对抗氏族经验但机师为新手的部队，部分原因是机甲的特性契合许多新机甲战士的性格，部分原因是为了更快积累他们的实战经验。克鲁西斯枪骑兵、德内布轻骑兵和塞提骠骑兵是 3053 年首批接收这些机甲的团，图卡伊德休战协定后内天体与占领区边境的袭扰战开始，它们立即被投入前线。

Original: The Fireball is built around a massive 5-ton DAV 220 extra light fusion engine, which propels the 'Mech to a cruising speed of 119 km/h and top speed of 184 km/h, allowing it to respond to a call from anywhere in the line for immediate support. The high speed of the Fireball comes at a price though, as the 'Mech only has four tons of armor protection and a very light weapons array. A Hovertec Streak SRM-2 serves as its primary weapon, giving it highly accurate short-range firepower. The launcher is mounted over the left shoulder along with one ton of reloads. The 'Mech is also armed with a LFN Lindblad Machine Gun for anti-infantry combat, carried over the right shoulder with one ton of ammunition. Aiming these weapons is the Corean B-Tech Targeting-Tracking System, a proven component chosen because of previous battlefield experience and because it was manufactured on New Avalon as well, cutting down on shipping time.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_fireball_ALM-7D.YangsThoughts

Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_fireball_ALM-8D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Fireball was a quick response BattleMech built as a direct result of the Clans' Elemental infantry. As the Clans swept through the Inner Sphere, members of the Armed Forces of the Federated Commonwealth met with scientists from the New Avalon Institute of Science to discuss, among other things, how to counter their new Battle Armored foes. The result was a 'Mech which on paper met many of the criteria for successfully dealing with Elementals: it had weapons with a high rate-of-fire for taking on swarms of Toads as they were known, had ammunition stores to maintain that rate for extended periods, and an extremely high speed so it could quickly come to the aid of heavier units. These Fireballs were given to units with prior experience fighting the Clans but assigned to rookie pilots, partly because the 'Mech's capabilities fit the personality of many of these new Mechwarriors, partly to more quickly build up their combat experience. The Crucis Lancers, Deneb Light Cavalry and Ceti Hussars were the first regiments to receive these 'Mechs in 3053, employing them immediately on the front lines as raiding along the border between the Inner Sphere and Occupation Zones commenced following the Truce of Tukayyid.

Original: Configured as a close combat and spotting 'Mech, the Firestarter B carries, as its primary weapon, a Large Pulse Laser, which is backed up by a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers and a Small Laser. The centerpiece of the B configuration is its electronics package, which consists of a TAG spotting laser for directing artillery fire and a C3 Slave unit that allows the Firestarter to share targeting data with allied units.

Original: In its primary configuration the Firestarter is built to stay at long ranges when facing an enemy. The primary weapons are a pair of Large Lasers. Finally, to allow the 'Mech to search out hidden units, the Prime carries a Beagle Active Probe.

Original: Entering production in 2519 the FLE-14 Flea was an attempt to create an ultra-light BattleMech. Weighing a mere fifteen tons, it could arguably be regarded as a different 'Mech design than the true Flea. It was capable of a maximum ground speed of nearly 150km/h with a 120 meter jump capability. Its weapons and armor however were very light: Only one ton of armor protected the unit, and the single Medium Laser mounted in the right arm was barely enough to make it a viable battlefield unit.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_flea_FLE-14.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Entering production in 2519 the FLE-14 Flea was an attempt to create an ultra-light BattleMech. It was capable of a maximum ground speed of nearly 150km/h with a 120 meter jump capability. Its weapons and armor however were very light: Only one ton of armor protected the unit, and the single Medium Laser mounted in the right arm was barely enough to make it a viable battlefield unit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: FLE-14 跳蚤于 2519 年投产，是打造超轻型战斗机甲的一次尝试。它仅重十五吨，可以说算得上是与真正的跳蚤不同的一款机甲设计。它能达到近 150 公里/小时的最大地面速度，跳跃能力 120 米。然而其武器与装甲都极轻：只有一吨装甲保护该单位，右臂上那门孤零零的中型激光勉强使它成为可用的战场单位。

Original: Built as part of the Wolf's Dragoons exclusive contract with Earthwerks Incorporated to replenish the Dragoon's losses at the end of the Fourth Succession War, alongside renewed production of original Fleas, the FLE-16 was the first new production model of the extremely rare 'Mech in centuries. The variant remedied the earlier FLE-14's weaknesses by combining incredible speed with additional armor and weaponry on a 20 ton chassis. The engine was upgraded to a GM 180 in order to reach a similar maximum ground speed of nearly 150 km/h. It mounts two Medium Lasers and an Flamer while retaining an armor profile like the earlier FLE-15.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_flea_FLE-16.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Built as part of the Wolf's Dragoons exclusive contract with Earthwerks Incorporated to replenish the Dragoon's losses at the end of the Fourth Succession War, alongside renewed production of original Fleas, the FLE-16 was the first new production model of the extremely rare 'Mech in centuries. The variant remedied the earlier FLE-14's weaknesses by combining incredible speed with additional armor and weaponry on a 20 ton chassis. The engine was upgraded to a GM 180 in order to reach a similar maximum ground speed of nearly 150 km/h. It mounts two Medium Lasers and an Flamer while retaining an armor profile like the earlier FLE-15.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: FLE-16 是作为狼之龙骑兵与地球工厂公司独家合同的一部分而建造的，该合同旨在第四次继承战争结束时补充龙骑兵的损失，与重新生产的原版跳蚤一同问世，是这款极为稀有机甲数世纪以来首个新量产型号。此变体通过在 20 吨底盘上结合惊人的速度与额外的装甲和武器，弥补了早期 FLE-14 的弱点。引擎升级为 GM 180，以达到近 150 公里/小时的相近最高地面速度。它装有两门中型激光和一具火焰喷射器，同时保留与早期 FLE-15 相似的装甲配置。

Original: Originally produced exclusively for the Dragoons until the Capellan Confederation acquired the design's blueprints via a Maskirovka raid during the 3040s, the post-Helm Memory Core FLE-17 variant is based on the older FLE-15 model. Since the Dragoons used the Flea in a recon role more than an antipersonnel 'Mech, Earthwerks conceived a new design by incorporating recovered technology. Retaining the design's maximum speed of 97.2 km/h, the addition of an Endo Steelchassis frees up weight for a MASC system that allows the 'Mech's speed to be pushed up to 129.6 km/h in short bursts. The increase of speed is required to ensure survival on the modern battlefield, as the FLE-17 is only clad in a pitiful three tons of Livingston Ceramics armor plating.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_flea_FLE-17.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally produced exclusively for the Dragoons until the Capellan Confederation acquired the design's blueprints via a Maskirovka raid during the 3040s, the post-Helm Memory Core FLE-17 variant is based on the older FLE-15 model. Since the Dragoons used the Flea in a recon role more than an antipersonnel 'Mech, Earthwerks conceived a new design by incorporating recovered technology. Retaining the design's maximum speed of 97.2 km/h, the addition of an Endo Steelchassis frees up weight for a MASC system that allows the 'Mech's speed to be pushed up to 129.6 km/h in short bursts. The increase of speed is required to ensure survival on the modern battlefield, as the FLE-17 is only clad in a pitiful three tons of Livingston Ceramics armor plating.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该设计最初专为龙骑兵生产，直到卡佩兰邦联在 3040 年代通过一次马斯克罗夫卡突袭获得其图纸。赫尔姆记忆核心之后的 FLE-17 变体以较老的 FLE-15 型号为基础。由于龙骑兵更多将跳蚤用作侦察而非反人员机甲，地球工厂通过融入回收技术构想出新设计。在保持 97.2 公里/小时最高速度的同时，加装内骨骼底盘腾出重量用于 MASC 系统，使机甲速度可在短促爆发中推至 129.6 公里/小时。速度的提升是确保在现代战场生存所必需的，因为 FLE-17 仅披着可怜的三吨利文斯顿陶瓷装甲。

Original: Born from the Terran Hegemony's attempts to create a medium fire-support platform that would be more advanced than the RLN-1N Rifleman, Mitchell Vehicles unveiled the GLH-1D Galahad in 2570. Though it outgunned the earlier design and found significant acceptance within the Hegemony Armed Forces, the Galahad suffered from the same heat issues as the BattleMech it was meant to replace. This variant uses the original 50 ton mech weapon loadout.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_galahad_GLH-1D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Born from the Terran Hegemony's attempts to create a medium fire-support platform that would be more advanced than the RLN-1N Rifleman, Mitchell Vehicles unveiled the GLH-1D Galahad in 2570. Though it outgunned the earlier design and found significant acceptance within the Hegemony Armed Forces, the Galahad suffered from the same heat issues as the BattleMech it was meant to replace. This variant uses the original 50 ton mech weapon loadout.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 源自地球霸权打造比 RLN-1N 步枪手更先进的中型火力支援平台的尝试，米切尔车辆于 2570 年推出 GLH-1D 加拉哈德。虽然它的火力强于先前设计并在霸权武装部队中获得相当认可，但加拉哈德同样受制于它本该取代的那款机甲的热量问题。此变体使用原本 50 吨机甲的武器配置。

Original: Born from the Terran Hegemony's attempts to create a medium fire-support platform that would be more advanced than the RLN-1N Rifleman, Mitchell Vehicles unveiled the GLH-1D Galahad in 2570. Though it outgunned the earlier design and found significant acceptance within the Hegemony Armed Forces, the Galahad suffered from the same heat issues as the BattleMech it was meant to replace. With the development of the new Gauss Rifle, Mitchell Vehicles decided in 2594 to redesign the Galahad around these new weapons. The Galahad utilizes special building materials in the form of eleven tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor and Endo Steel internals. To fit the massive weapons on the Galahad, the engine was dropped to a GM 180, giving it a maximum speed of only 54 km/h, making it difficult for the 'Mech to keep up with its companions in most cases. The GLH-2D carries two massive M-7 Gauss Rifles, with two tons of ammo for each rifle. It was a showing of the powerful new weapons at the time and earned it the nickname of Gausszilla.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_galahad_GLH-2D.Details

Though it outgunned the earlier design and found significant acceptance within the Hegemony Armed Forces, the Galahad suffered from the same heat issues as the BattleMech it was meant to replace. With the development of the new Gauss Rifle, Mitchell Vehicles decided in 2594 to redesign the Galahad around these new weapons. The Galahad utilizes special building materials in the form of eleven tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor and Endo Steel internals. To fit the massive weapons on the Galahad, the engine was dropped to a GM 180, giving it a maximum speed of only 54 km/h, making it difficult for the 'Mech to keep up with its companions in most cases. The GLH-2D carries two massive M-7 Gauss Rifles, with two tons of ammo for each rifle. It was a showing of the powerful new weapons at the time and earned it the nickname of Gausszilla.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 源自地球霸权打造比 RLN-1N 步枪手更先进的中型火力支援平台的尝试，米切尔车辆于 2570 年推出 GLH-1D 加拉哈德。虽然它的火力强于先前设计并在霸权武装部队中获得相当认可，但加拉哈德同样受制于它本该取代的那款机甲的热量问题。随着新型高斯步枪的发展，米切尔车辆于 2594 年决定围绕这些新武器重新设计加拉哈德。它采用特殊建造材料：十一吨铁纤维装甲与内骨骼内部结构。为在加拉哈德上装下这些巨型武器，引擎降至 GM 180，最高速度仅 54 公里/小时，使机甲在多数情况下难以跟上同伴。GLH-2D 携带两门巨型 M-7 高斯步枪，每门配两吨弹药。它在当时展示了这种强大的新武器，并为它赢得"高斯斯拉"的绰号。

Original: Configured almost exclusively for long range combat, the B configuration of the Gargoyle carries a powerful Gauss Rifle backed up by an LRM-10 launcher linked to an Artemis IV FCS, allowing it to keep its distance from enemy units. For self defense at short ranges, the 'Mech has an SRM-4 launcher which is also enhanced with an Artemis IV FCS. The main drawback to this configuration is its over reliance on ammunition based weaponry, making it effective only so long as it has sufficient ammunition for its weapons.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_gargoyle_GAR-B.Details

Original: This variant makes use of Clan technology developed in the 3060s. An ATM 12 in the right arm has enough ammunition bins to make use of all of the types available to an Advanced Tactical Missile Launcher. Four Heavy Medium Lasers provide a powerful punch as short range, while a Streak SRM-6 can exploit those holes. A pair of ER Micro Lasers round out the offensive armament. A Targeting Computer makes the lasers more accurate.

Four Heavy Medium Lasers provide a powerful punch as short range, while a Streak SRM-6 can exploit those holes. A pair of ER Micro Lasers round out the offensive armament. A Targeting Computer makes the lasers more accurate.

Original: The Primary Gargoyle configuration is capable of engaging enemies at a variety of ranges. For long range encounters, the Gargoyle has two LB 5-X Autocannon that are capable of firing both solid rounds and cluster ammunition, making the 'Mech effective against aircraft and vehicles. For short ranges, the 'Mech has two SRM-6 launchers and a single ER Small Laser which provide adequate close in protection.

Original: The first homegrown BattleMech produced by the Draconis Combine was the Gladiator. The 55-ton 'Mech took seven years to design, as Coordinator Kozo Von Rohrs refused to open up the process to anybody but a select group at New Samarkand Armor Works (the predecessor of Luthien Armor Works) who were under constant surveillance by DEST. 2468 finally saw the GLD-1R Gladiator hit mass-production. Following the Battle of Nox in 2475, the dishonored 'Mech was retired from official production, with NSAW closing down the production lines by 2488. Merryweather Industries was the first private company to attempt BattleMech production without governmental support. Despite their location in the Terran Hegemony, they acquired the plans to the Gladiator and produced a new run in 2490. They were unable to raise the capital to finish their second run, the 4R, and nearly went bankrupt before moving into IndustrialMechs. The GLD-4R production lines were closed down in 2495. A few salvaged Gladiator -1Rs were still in service with militaries across the Inner Sphere and Periphery, though these relics were finally pushed to extinction during the Reunification War. The 55-ton Gladiator has a top speed of 86 km/h, comparable to many other 'Mechs of the same weight. Nine and a half tons of armor provides a respectable amount of protection. Five jump jets enables the 'Mech to jump up to 150 meters at a time.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_gladiator_GLD-1R.Details

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 联合体自主生产的第一款战斗机甲是角斗士。这款 55 吨机甲耗时七年设计，因为协调官科佐·冯·罗尔斯拒绝将此过程向除新萨马尔坎德装甲工厂（卢西恩装甲工厂的前身）一小批人之外的任何人开放，这批人还处于 DEST 的持续监视之下。2468 年 GLD-1R 角斗士终于进入量产。在 2475 年诺克斯战役后，这款蒙羞的机甲被正式停产，NSAW 于 2488 年关闭生产线。梅里韦瑟工业是第一家在没有政府支持下尝试生产战斗机甲的私营公司。尽管位于地球霸权境内，他们仍取得了角斗士的图纸，并于 2490 年生产了新一轮机型。他们无力筹集资金完成第二轮生产（4R 型），几乎破产，随后转向工业机甲。GLD-4R 生产线于 2495 年关闭。少数回收的角斗士-1R 仍在内外天体的军队中服役，但这些老古董最终在统一战争中彻底消亡。55 吨的角斗士最高速度达 86 公里/小时，与同重量的许多机甲相当。九吨半装甲提供了可观的防护。五个跳跃推进器使机甲一次可跳跃至 150 米。

Original: The original Gladiator used primitive technologies, so it only had a Large Laser and two Medium Lasers. In addition, it could only manage a top speed around 64 km/h. It was protected by sixteen and a half tons of Primitive Armor. The GLD-1R went out of production by 2488. During the Jihad, several companies began producing this primitive design of Gladiator as a part of the appearance of RetroTech on the battlefield, driven by the need for war materiel; companies which produced the primitive Gladiator during this era included Rastaban Agricultural Products, Metals of the Earth and Sword of the Prophet Enterprises although many of these manufacturing lines had closed down by 3079.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_gladiator_GLD-1R.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Gladiator used primitive technologies, so it only had a Large Laser and two Medium Lasers. In addition, it could only manage a top speed around 64 km/h. During the Jihad, several companies began producing this primitive design of Gladiator as a part of the appearance of RetroTech on the battlefield, driven by the need for war materiel; companies which produced the primitive Gladiator during this era included Rastaban Agricultural Products, Metals of the Earth and Sword of the Prophet Enterprises although many of these manufacturing lines had closed down by 3079.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 原版角斗士使用原始技术，因此只有一门大型激光和两门中型激光。此外它最高速度仅约 64 公里/小时。它由十六吨半原始装甲保护。GLD-1R 于 2488 年停产。圣战期间，随着"复古技术"在战场上出现，若干公司出于战争物资需求开始生产这一原始设计的角斗士；此时期生产原始角斗士的公司包括拉斯塔班农产品、大地金属和先知之剑企业，不过其中许多生产线到 3079 年已关闭。

Original: A basic modification of the 5J model introduced by the Combine in 3052, the Grasshopper-C carries a C3 slave unit to allow it to be integrated into a C3 lance. These models often served as the point 'Mech in a C3 lance, where its speed and armor allowed it to get close enough to the enemy and share this targeting data with friendly units. To make room for the addition of the C3 unit, ammunition for the Streak SRM-2 launcher was reduced by one ton, though since the Streak launcher was already an ammo-efficient design this resulted in no drop in performance
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_grasshopper_GHR-C.Details

Original: The 3M Griffin was an upgraded version of the design built for House Marik by Earthwerks and Brigadier Corps starting in 3049. With production lines on Keystone and Oliver this variant sought to enhance the original's long-range capabilities. The engine was exchanged for a Hermes 275 extralight model and carried fourteen double heat sinks to improve heat management. The normal PPC was replaced by a Fusigon Longtooth ER PPC, for longer reach at the expense of more heat, and the LRM launcher had been upgraded to a Doombud LRM-20 launcher, for more indirect fire support capabilities. Finally a ChrisComp Small Laser was mounted in the head and the two tons of LRM reloads in the left torso were protected by CASE. While intended for the Free Worlds League Military the capture of Oliver by FedCom forces meant the 3M also appeared in large numbers in the Armed Forces of the Federated Commonwealth.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_griffin_GRF-3M.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3M Griffin was an upgraded version of the design built for House Marik by Earthwerks and Brigadier Corps starting in 3049. With production lines on Keystone and Oliver this variant sought to enhance the original's long-range capabilities. The engine was exchanged for a Hermes 275 extralight model and carried fourteen double heat sinks to improve heat management. The normal PPC was replaced by a Fusigon Longtooth ER PPC, for longer reach at the expense of more heat, and the LRM launcher had been upgraded to a Doombud LRM-20 launcher, for more indirect fire support capabilities. Finally a ChrisComp Small Laser was mounted in the head and the two tons of LRM reloads in the left torso were protected by CASE. While intended for the Free Worlds League Military the capture of Oliver by FedCom forces meant the 3M also appeared in large numbers in the Armed Forces of the Federated Commonwealth.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3M 狮鹫是为马里克家族打造的升级版，由地球工厂与准将兵团自 3049 年起生产。借助基斯通与奥利弗的生产线，该变体力图强化原版的远程能力。引擎换成赫尔墨斯 275 超轻型，并携带十四台双倍散热器以改善散热管理。标准 PPC 换成"富西贡长牙"ER PPC，以更多热量换取更远射程；LRM 发射器升级为末日芽 LRM-20，以增强间接火力支援能力。最后，头部安装一门克里斯康小型激光，左躯干的两吨 LRM 再装填由 C.A.S.E. 保护。虽然原为自由世界联盟军队设计，但联邦联邦部队夺取奥利弗意味着 3M 也大量出现在联邦联邦武装部队中。

Original: Created by a pilot who lost the LRM rack off his Griffin, the -6CV replaces the long-range payload with a mid-range weapon system: a MRM 30. Backing up the MRM rack is an ER PPC with a PPC Capacitor for extra punch. To keep the heat under control, the -6CV mounts double heat sinks and is powered by a Light Fusion Engine for speed. It also has gained a little armor for extra survivability
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_griffin_GRF-6CV.Details

Backing up the MRM rack is an ER PPC with a PPC Capacitor for extra punch. To keep the heat under control, the -6CV mounts double heat sinks and is powered by a Light Fusion Engine for speed. It also has gained a little armor for extra survivability

It also has gained a little armor for extra survivability

Original: The Grim Reaper was a 'Mech designed by ComStar to help replenish the heavy material losses suffered by the Com Guards during the Battle of Tukayyid, with the Word of Blake maintaining production after it captured Terra to help rebuild and expand the Word of Blake Militia. Thus the Grim Reaper is seen in moderate numbers in both secular and fanatical militaries. Designed to be a generic trooper 'Mech, the Grim Reaper carries a varied and non specialized weapons payload.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_grimreaper_GRM-R-PR29.Details

Thus the Grim Reaper is seen in moderate numbers in both secular and fanatical militaries. Original: The Grizzly is a BattleMech that was developed by Clan Ghost Bear scientists in the 30th century. Unfortunately, the design excels at no one thing, so it never carved a niche in the Clan's touman.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_grizzly.Details

Original: The Grizzly actually packs a solid long-range punch with a Omega 12-coil Gauss Rifle and a Type X Short Bow LRM-10 Launcher.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_grizzly.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 灰熊实际上拥有扎实的远程打击力：一具"欧米茄 12 线圈"高斯步枪和一具"X 型短弓"LRM-10 发射器。

Original: The Hammer is a 'Mech that was built to provide fire support for light 'Mechs. The 'Mech is built around a long-range arsenal that can provide both direct and indirect fire support. It is also often paired with the Anvil, using its missiles to soften up the enemy at a distance until the Anvil can bring its lasers to bear. The Hammer has a maximum speed of 86.4 kph, which is enough for a 'Mech intended to stay at the edges of a battlefield acting in a fire support role. Additionally, the 'Mech has a respectable six tons of armor protection. With its average speed and good armor protection combined with its long-range weapons, the Hammer is a good overall light fire support 'Mech.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_hammer_HMR-3C.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hammer is a 'Mech that was built to provide fire support for light 'Mechs. The 'Mech is built around a long-range arsenal that can provide both direct and indirect fire support. It is also often paired with the Anvil, using its missiles to soften up the enemy at a distance until the Anvil can bring its lasers to bear. The Hammer has a maximum speed of 86.4 kph, which is enough for a 'Mech intended to stay at the edges of a battlefield acting in a fire support role. Additionally, the 'Mech has a respectable six tons of armor protection. With its average speed and good armor protection combined with its long-range weapons, the Hammer is a good overall light fire support 'Mech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战锤是为轻型机甲提供火力支援而制造的机甲。它以远程武器库为核心，可提供直射与间接火力支援。它常与铁砧搭档，在远距离用导弹削弱敌人，直到铁砧能以激光发起攻击。战锤最高速度 86.4 公里/小时，对于一款意在战场边缘执行火力支援角色的机甲而言已足够。此外，它还拥有可观的六吨装甲防护。凭借平均速度、良好装甲与远程武器的组合，战锤是一款整体出色的轻型火力支援机甲。

Original: Called the Claw-Hammer, the 3C is built to make the Hammer capable of better defending itself when an enemy closes on the battlefield. This is done by removing one of the LRM launchers and replacing it with four additional Medium Lasers, which gives the Hammer the ability to attack the enemy with an overwhelming laser barrage at close ranges. This variant also works well as a bodyguard 'Mech in a lance of Hammer 'Mechs.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_hammer_HMR-3C.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Called the Claw-Hammer, the 3C is built to make the Hammer capable of better defending itself when an enemy closes on the battlefield. This variant also works well as a bodyguard 'Mech in a lance of Hammer 'Mechs.

Original: The original version produced during 3039. Though lacking the LosTech of the HTM-27, the single production run of the original field-test Hatamoto-Chi completed on the verge of the War of 3039 came as a total shock to the attacking Lyran and Davion Forces. Since it was built on a standard chassis, the 26T had less armor, one less heat sink, and single ton of SRM ammunition in a standard ammo bin.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_hatamotochi_HTM-26T.Details

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初版本于 3039 年生产。尽管缺少 HTM-27 的失落科技，原版野战测试型旗本-血的唯一一次量产恰在 3039 年战争前夕完成，令进攻的莱兰与达维昂部队大为震惊。由于建立在标准底盘上，26T 装甲较少、少一台散热器，SRM 弹药也仅有一吨存于标准弹药箱中。

Original: Constructed with an Earthwerks VOL Endo Steel chassis, fitted with CASE protected ammo bins and clad in fifteen and a half tons of Mitchell Argon armor, the Hatamoto-Chi shared the features which made its parent design a nearly indestructible zombie 'Mech. The main area that Combine was unable to replicate the Thug was the older design's advanced Double Heat Sinks, eighteen standard Heat Sinks giving the Hatamoto-Chi a high heat curve in heavy combat.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_hatamotochi_HTM-27T.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Constructed with an Earthwerks VOL Endo Steel chassis, fitted with CASE protected ammo bins and clad in fifteen and a half tons of Mitchell Argon armor, the Hatamoto-Chi shared the features which made its parent design a nearly indestructible zombie 'Mech. 重型狙击手 & 防御者

Original: The first OmniMech both designed and built by the Lyran Alliance. The inspiration for the Hauptmann is drawn from the Daishi OmniMech used by the Clans. Using information from captured Daishis and data gleaned from the construction of the Firestarter OmniMech, which was shared by the Draconis Combine, the end result is a powerful OmniMech capable of defending itself in most combat situations. The Hauptmann is built on a standard chassis and powered by a 285 fusion engine, adding to the 'Mech's durability as it cannot be killed by a side torso loss. The Hauptmann has eleven double heat sinks fixed on the chassis and can add more if needed in its various configurations. For protection, the Hauptmann carries eighteen and a half tons of armor and has CASE fixed in the right torso to protect against an ammunition explosion.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_hauptmann_HA1-O.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The first OmniMech both designed and built by the Lyran Alliance. The inspiration for the Hauptmann is drawn from the Daishi OmniMech used by the Clans. Using information from captured Daishis and data gleaned from the construction of the Firestarter OmniMech, which was shared by the Draconis Combine, the end result is a powerful OmniMech capable of defending itself in most combat situations. The Hauptmann is built on a standard chassis and powered by a 285 fusion engine, adding to the 'Mech's durability as it cannot be killed by a side torso loss. The Hauptmann has eleven double heat sinks fixed on the chassis and can add more if needed in its various configurations. For protection, the Hauptmann carries eighteen and a half tons of armor and has CASE fixed in the right torso to protect against an ammunition explosion.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 首款由莱兰联盟自行设计并制造的全能机甲。上尉的灵感源自氏族使用的"大师"全能机甲。利用缴获的"大师"资料以及由德拉科尼斯联合体分享的火焰使者全能机甲建造数据，最终成果是一款强大的全能机甲，能在大多数战斗情形下自保。上尉采用标准底盘，由 285 聚变引擎驱动，这增强了它的耐久性，使其不会因失去侧面躯干而被击毁。它底盘上固定有十一台双倍散热器，必要时可在各配置中加装更多。防护方面，上尉携带十八吨半装甲，并在右侧躯干固定 C.A.S.E. 以防弹药爆炸。

Original: The primary configuration carries a varied and powerful arsenal. For long range combat, the Hauptmann carries two ER Large Lasers as its primary long range weapons. These give the Hauptmann Prime a good long range damage capability. For close combat, the 'Mech has an LB-X Autocannon/20 for devastating close range firepower backed up by two Medium Pulse Lasers, an ER Small Laser, and a pair of Streak SRM-2 launchers. Finally, to protect the 'Mech against enemy electronic warfare systems, the Hauptmann Prime has a Guardian ECM Suite.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_hauptmann_HA1-O.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary configuration carries a varied and powerful arsenal. For long range combat, the Hauptmann carries two ER Large Lasers as its primary long range weapons. These give the Hauptmann Prime a good long range damage capability. For close combat, the 'Mech has an LB-X Autocannon/20 for devastating close range firepower backed up by two Medium Pulse Lasers, an ER Small Laser, and a pair of Streak SRM-2 launchers. Finally, to protect the 'Mech against enemy electronic warfare systems, the Hauptmann Prime has a Guardian ECM Suite.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主配置携带多样而强大的武器库。远程战斗方面，上尉以两门 ER 大型激光为主要远程武器。这赋予上尉主型号良好的远程伤害能力。近战方面，机甲有一门 LB-X 自动炮/20 提供毁灭性近程火力，辅以两门中型脉冲激光、一门 ER 小型激光和一对连续 SRM-2 发射器。最后，为保护机甲免受敌方电子战系统干扰，上尉主型号装有守护者 ECM 套件。

Original: Intended for close combat, the Hauptmann A is armed with four ER Medium Lasers as its primary short-ranged weapons with a pair of SRM-6 launchers linked to an Artemis IV fire control system for increased missile accuracy. Original: Despite its initial success, the combat service of the Hellfire has not be flaw free. Aside from the sensor interference caused by firing its signature Heavy Lasers, a number of battlefield reports indicate the heavy laser tubes can violently rupture in the heat of battle. The 'Mech also experiences a fifteen percent higher rate of MASC failure than usual, though technicians have yet to determine whether this is due to the age of the Lupus chassis or if this is something caused by the Heavy Lasers.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_hellfire_HLF-1.Details

Aside from the sensor interference caused by firing its signature Heavy Lasers, a number of battlefield reports indicate the heavy laser tubes can violently rupture in the heat of battle. The 'Mech also experiences a fifteen percent higher rate of MASC failure than usual, though technicians have yet to determine whether this is due to the age of the Lupus chassis or if this is something caused by the Heavy Lasers.

Original: One of the most popular Star League BattleMechs, many a Highlander accompanied General Aleksandr Kerensky into exile. Some were mothballed, but many found their way into the toumans of the Clans. As technology advanced, the weapons systems were upgraded until the design known as the Highlander IIC finally emerged. With the use of newer, lighter weapons, the damage potential of the Highlander has roughly doubled. The IIC also contains enough ammunition that it rarely needs to conserve any during Trials. Clan scientists were forced to rearrange the placement of some weapons within the 'Mech to allow it proper ammo feeds, but the design is largely unchanged. It carries the maximum amount of Ferro-Fibrous armor that can be crammed on the frame, fourteen and a half tons. As with the original, the IIC carries enough jump jets to move up to ninety meters at a time, allowing MechWarriors to execute the Highlander Burial.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_highlander_HGN-IIC-1.Details

With the use of newer, lighter weapons, the damage potential of the Highlander has roughly doubled. The IIC also contains enough ammunition that it rarely needs to conserve any during Trials. Clan scientists were forced to rearrange the placement of some weapons within the 'Mech to allow it proper ammo feeds, but the design is largely unchanged. It carries the maximum amount of Ferro-Fibrous armor that can be crammed on the frame, fourteen and a half tons. As with the original, the IIC carries enough jump jets to move up to ninety meters at a time, allowing MechWarriors to execute the Highlander Burial.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 高地人是星盟最受欢迎的战斗机甲之一，许多随亚历山大·克伦斯基将军流亡。有些被封存，但许多进入了氏族的图曼。随着技术进步，武器系统不断升级，最终诞生了被称为高地人 IIC 的设计。凭借更新更轻的武器，高地人的伤害潜力几乎翻倍。IIC 还携带充足弹药，在试炼中几乎无需节省。氏族科学家被迫重新安排机内部分武器的位置以使其供弹顺畅，但设计大体未变。它携带了框架所能容纳的最大量铁纤维装甲——十四吨半。与原版一样，IIC 携带足以一次移动九十米的跳跃推进器，使机甲战士能施展"高地人埋葬"。

Original: One of the most popular Star League BattleMechs, many a Highlander accompanied General Aleksandr Kerensky into exile. Some were mothballed, but many found their way into the toumans of the Clans. As technology advanced, the weapons systems were upgraded until the design known as the Highlander IIC finally emerged. With the use of newer, lighter weapons, the damage potential of the Highlander has roughly doubled. The IIC also contains enough ammunition that it rarely needs to conserve any during Trials. Clan scientists were forced to rearrange the placement of some weapons within the 'Mech to allow it proper ammo feeds, but the design is largely unchanged. It carries the maximum amount of Ferro-Fibrous armor that can be crammed on the frame, fourteen and a half tons. As with the original, the IIC carries enough jump jets to move up to ninety meters at a time, allowing MechWarriors to execute the Highlander Burial. Like the original Highlander IIC, the B retains the Gauss Rifle and twin Streak SRM-6 racks, but replaces the single LRM-20 with twin LRM-15 racks in the right torso, removing one of the Medium Pulse Lasers to help free up the weight needed.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_highlander_HGN-IIC-B.Details

Original: The Hitman was designed to work as a spotter 'Mech for advanced Arrow IV missile artillery rounds. In order to do this, the 'Mech is built to be able to close to effective range for its Forward-1 Target Acquisition Gear spotting gear rapidly with a Kagushima 210 XL propelling it up to 118.8 kph and a MASC system pushing the 'Mech up to 151.2 kph in short bursts. The 'Mech also carries an Apple Churchill Guardian ECM Suite to foul any enemy electronics warfare equipment and a Wunderland Beagle Active Probe to detect any hidden enemy units. With the recent invention of semi-guided LRMs the Hitman can also guide LRM fire to a unit targeted with its TAG unit. The Hitman carries five tons of armor protection to protect it against any attacks that may hit it.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_hitman_HM-1.Details

The 'Mech also carries an Apple Churchill Guardian ECM Suite to foul any enemy electronics warfare equipment and a Wunderland Beagle Active Probe to detect any hidden enemy units. With the recent invention of semi-guided LRMs the Hitman can also guide LRM fire to a unit targeted with its TAG unit. The Hitman carries five tons of armor protection to protect it against any attacks that may hit it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 杀手被设计为先进箭矢 IV 导弹炮弹的侦察机甲。为此，机甲能迅速接近其 Forward-1 目标捕获指示器的有效距离：管岛 210 XL 引擎推动它达到 118.8 公里/小时，MASC 系统则在短促爆发中推至 151.2 公里/小时。机甲还携带苹果·丘吉尔守护者 ECM 套件以干扰敌方电子战设备，以及旺德兰比格犬主动探测器以侦测隐藏的敌方单位。随着半制导 LRM 的问世，杀手还能将其 TAG 标记的目标引导给 LRM 火力。杀手携带五吨装甲防护，以抵御可能命中它的攻击。

Original: The Hitman carries an arsenal that is capable of striking an enemy regardless of the ranges they are at. For long range engagements while closing with an enemy the Hitman is armed with a Thunderstroke-L LRM-5 with Artemis IV fire control system for increased missile accuracy. When the Hitman closes to the effective range for its TAG it is able to use its three Argra 3L Medium Lasers to defend itself.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_hitman_HM-1.YangsThoughts

Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_hollanderii_BZK-F7.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The F7, debuting in 3061 is a modification of the F5 that takes advantage of the Hollander II's larger weapons payload to mount the Lyran Alliance's new Heavy Gauss Rifle, which is capable of causing a great deal of damage at short to medium ranges. While improving upon the firepower of the variant, the removal of backup weaponry to fit these massive weapon leaves it with the same problems as the original Hollander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: F7 于 3061 年亮相，是 F5 的改型，利用荷兰人 II 更大的武器负载能力搭载莱兰联盟新型重型高斯步枪，能在中近距离造成大量伤害。虽然火力优于前型，但为容纳这些巨型武器而移除备用武器，使它仍带有原版荷兰人的同样问题。

Original: The Hollander was introduced in 3054 specifically to carry a Gauss Rifle into combat and act as a sniper. The Federated Commonwealth was in dire need of a response to the fast-moving, long-range firepower of the Clan Invaders at the time, and looked at a number of light 'Mech designs featuring PPCs or LRMs as a potential answer. It was Coventry's unorthodox decision to mount such a large weapon, one that had neither the overheating or ammunition explosion drawbacks of the other designs, which won them the contract. With its single massive cannon and use of rediscovered technology, the Hollander can destroy another light 'Mech in a single hit at extreme range and threaten heavier targets easily.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_hollander_BZK-F3.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hollander was introduced in 3054 specifically to carry a Gauss Rifle into combat and act as a sniper. It was Coventry's unorthodox decision to mount such a large weapon, one that had neither the overheating or ammunition explosion drawbacks of the other designs, which won them the contract. With its single massive cannon and use of rediscovered technology, the Hollander can destroy another light 'Mech in a single hit at extreme range and threaten heavier targets easily.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 荷兰人于 3054 年推出，专门为了把高斯步枪带上战场并担任狙击手。当时联邦联邦急需应对氏族入侵者快速机动的远程火力，考察了多款装备 PPC 或 LRM 的轻型机甲设计方案。考文垂大胆决定装上如此巨大的武器——既没有其他设计那样的过热或弹药爆炸缺陷——从而赢得了合同。凭借其单门巨型火炮和对重新发现技术的运用，荷兰人能在极远距离一炮摧毁另一台轻型机甲，并轻易威胁更重的目标。

Original: The G1 variant of the Hollander is built to address concerns about the Hollander's lack of back up weapons. First debuting in 3056 the 'Mech replaces the heavy Gauss Cannon with an LB-X Autocannon/10 as its primary weapon, freeing up weight to mount two Defiance B3M Medium Lasers in its arms as backup weapons and add two tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. The G1 is an excellent 'Mech for vehicle hunting as well as anti-aircraft use with its LB-X cluster rounds.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_hollander_BZK-G1.Details

Original: Conceived by Martinson Armaments of Terra in 2578 as an infantry support 'Mech, the Hoplite first saw service with the newly formed Star League Defense Force during the Reunification War before being relegated to Terran Hegemony militia units in the twenty-seventh century. Intended for infantry support, the Hoplite is slow for a medium 'Mech with a top speed of only 64.8 km/h. However its eleven and a half tons of armor and heavy arsenal, both impressive for a 'Mech of its size, makes the Hoplite a rugged machine able to fight its way out of most situations using superior firepower. The original Reunification War era model, save for using an older Dalban Sniper targeting and tracking system, was all but identical to the 4C.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_hoplite_HOP-4A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Conceived by Martinson Armaments of Terra in 2578 as an infantry support 'Mech, the Hoplite first saw service with the newly formed Star League Defense Force during the Reunification War before being relegated to Terran Hegemony militia units in the twenty-seventh century. Intended for infantry support, the Hoplite is slow for a medium 'Mech with a top speed of only 64.8 km/h. However its eleven and a half tons of armor and heavy arsenal, both impressive for a 'Mech of its size, makes the Hoplite a rugged machine able to fight its way out of most situations using superior firepower. The original Reunification War era model, save for using an older Dalban Sniper targeting and tracking system, was all but identical to the 4C.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重装步兵由泰拉的马丁森军械于 2578 年构想为步兵支援机甲，在统一战争中首次随新成立的星盟防卫军服役，后在二十七世纪被降级至地球霸权民兵单位。作为步兵支援机甲，重装步兵对中型机甲而言偏慢，最高速度仅 64.8 公里/小时。然而其十一吨半装甲与重型武器库对如此尺寸的机甲都堪称出色，使重装步兵成为一台凭借优势火力就能从大多数困境中杀出重围的坚固机器。统一战争时代的原始型号除了使用较老的达尔班狙击瞄准追踪系统外，与 4C 几乎完全相同。
