Original: Essentially a Royal variant in everything but name, the Double B Hoplite was put into production at Strana Mechty MechWorks and Eden Weaponry Consolidated just before the death of Aleksandr Kerensky and found its way both into the forces of the Pentagon Powers and the infant toumans of the Clans. Keeping the LRM rack of the 4B, the Double B upgrades the Holly LRM-15 launcher with an Artemis IV system, swaps the PPC for an Kinslaughter H-Class ER PPC, and increases the 'Mech's survivability with a Guardian ECM system, CASE in both torsos, double heat sinks, and an anti-missile system. However, the design's speed and armor were not upgraded, enforcing the need to deploy the 4Bb as a fire-support unit.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_hoplite_HOP-4Bb.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Essentially a Royal variant in everything but name, the Double B Hoplite was put into production at Strana Mechty MechWorks and Eden Weaponry Consolidated just before the death of Aleksandr Kerensky and found its way both into the forces of the Pentagon Powers and the infant toumans of the Clans. Keeping the LRM rack of the 4B, the Double B upgrades the Holly LRM-15 launcher with an Artemis IV system, swaps the PPC for an Kinslaughter H-Class ER PPC, and increases the 'Mech's survivability with a Guardian ECM system, CASE in both torsos, double heat sinks, and an anti-missile system. However, the design's speed and armor were not upgraded, enforcing the need to deploy the 4Bb as a fire-support unit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 双 B 重装步兵实质上除名字之外一切皆为皇家变体，在亚历山大·克伦斯基去世前夕于斯特拉纳·麦赫蒂机甲工厂与伊甸兵器联合体投产，既进入五角势力部队，也进入氏族初生的图曼。双 B 保留 4B 的 LRM 挂架，把"冬青"LRM-15 发射器升级加装 Artemis IV 系统，把 PPC 换成"族杀 H 级"ER PPC，并通过守护者 ECM 系统、两侧躯干的 C.A.S.E.、双倍散热器和一套反导系统提升机甲生存力。然而该设计的速度与装甲并未升级，因此 4Bb 必须作为火力支援单位使用。

Original: The Hornet debuted in 2760 as an urban recon 'Mech, but lack of interest forced the design to be shelved two years later. In 2990, Kallon Industriesrediscovered the blueprints and resumed production. The upgraded HNT-171 started production in 3051. The production line was destroyed by the Capellans in 3069. The 'Mech is designed around the concept of being able to swiftly move through an urban environment with relatively heavy armor. Overall, because of its eclectic mix of weapons and relatively slow speed, the Hornet is only somewhat effective when inside of a city. When caught outside an urban environment the 'Mech is hard pressed to defend itself.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_hornet_HNT-151.Details

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 大黄蜂于 2760 年作为城市侦察机甲首次亮相，但因缺乏兴趣，两年后该设计被搁置。2990 年，卡隆工业重新发现了图纸并恢复生产。升级版 HNT-171 于 3051 年开始生产。生产线于 3069 年被卡佩兰人摧毁。此机甲的设计理念是能以相对厚重的装甲在城市环境中快速机动。总体而言，由于武器配置杂糅且速度相对缓慢，大黄蜂仅在城内表现尚可。一旦身陷城外环境，它便难以自保。

As a secondary weapon the Hornet carries a Martell Medium Laser, and finally the 'Mech is armed with a MainFire Point Defense Anti-Missile System to defend against missile attacks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 大黄蜂以"冬青"LRM-5 发射器为主要远程武器。这使大黄蜂能在六百多米外打击敌人。在城市环境中，LRM 发射器更像是负担而非资产。作为次要武器，大黄蜂携带一门马特尔中型激光，最后机甲还装备一套"主火点防御"反导系统以抵御导弹攻击。

Original: Originally a refit line converted to full production, the -5S is a complete overhaul of the Hunchback design developed by Norse-Storm BattleMechs in 3058. The structure has been modified to use Endo Steel construction techniques, the engine has been upgraded to a Light Fusion Engine, and four Jump Jets were added for increased mobility. The 'Mech carries, as its primary weapon, an LB-X Autocannon/20 with CASE-protected ammunition supported by two medium pulse lasers and a single small laser.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_hunchback_HBK-5S.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally a refit line converted to full production, the -5S is a complete overhaul of the Hunchback design developed by Norse-Storm BattleMechs in 3058. The structure has been modified to use Endo Steel construction techniques, the engine has been upgraded to a Light Fusion Engine, and four Jump Jets were added for increased mobility. The 'Mech carries, as its primary weapon, an LB-X Autocannon/20 with CASE-protected ammunition supported by two medium pulse lasers and a single small laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -5S 最初是一条改装线，后转为全面量产，是诺斯-风暴战斗机甲公司于 3058 年开发的驼背设计全面翻新。结构已改用内骨骼建造技术，引擎升级为轻型聚变引擎，并加装四个跳跃推进器以提升机动性。机甲的主武器为一门 LB-X 自动炮/20，弹药由 C.A.S.E. 保护，辅以两门中型脉冲激光和一门小型激光。

Original: The Hunchback IIC is a ClanTech refit of the venerable Hunchback. Its meager armor, coupled with paltry ammunition and lack of long-range weapons, led Inner Sphere observers to conclude that this 'Mech was a last-ditch effort for failed warriors to die with glory. In truth, the assignment of a Hunchback IIC was essentially a death sentence. Warriors given this machine were not expected to survive their next battle.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_hunchback_HBK-IIC-2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hunchback IIC is a ClanTech refit of the venerable Hunchback. Its meager armor, coupled with paltry ammunition and lack of long-range weapons, led Inner Sphere observers to conclude that this 'Mech was a last-ditch effort for failed warriors to die with glory. In truth, the assignment of a Hunchback IIC was essentially a death sentence. Warriors given this machine were not expected to survive their next battle.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 驼背 IIC 是古老的驼背的氏族科技改装版。它可怜的装甲，加上稀少的弹药和缺乏远程武器，让内天体观察家断定这款机甲是失败战士求取荣耀战死的最后一搏。事实上，被分配驼背 IIC 基本等于死刑。获得此机的战士不被指望能活过下一场战斗。

Original: The primary configuration of the Huntsman sports a myriad of weapons. An Ultra Autocannon/2 and Artemis IV-linked LRM-10 provide long-range capability, while four ER Medium Lasers and a Streak SRM-6 make it a vicious close range 'Mech. A pair of Anti-Personnel Pods and a Flamer protect it from conventional infantry, and an Anti-Missile System provides it with some defense against incoming missiles. An Active Probe finds hidden units, and a TAG spotting laser can designate targets for homing artillery strikes.

A pair of Anti-Personnel Pods and a Flamer protect it from conventional infantry, and an Anti-Missile System provides it with some defense against incoming missiles. An Active Probe finds hidden units, and a TAG spotting laser can designate targets for homing artillery strikes.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎人的主配置武器种类繁多。一门超速自动炮/2 和 Artemis IV 联接的 LRM-10 提供远程能力，而四门 ER 中型激光和一具连续 SRM-6 使它成为凶悍的近战机甲。一对反人员荚舱和一具火焰喷射器保护它免受常规步兵攻击，反导系统则为它提供对来袭导弹的防御。主动探测器可发现隐藏单位，TAG 指示激光能为制导炮击标记目标。

Original: The primary weapon that the Huron Warrior carries is a Grizzard Gauss Rifle (Modified 210 Version) that is capable of stripping off a ton of armor with each shot at extremely long ranges. The Gauss Rifle is backed up by a Martell ER Large Laser that provides good supplemental firepower at long ranges. Finally, it is armed with a Martell Medium Pulse Laser, which gives the Huron Warrior the ability to protect itself at short ranges.

Original: The Initiate started production after the Word of Blake retook Terra. This medium 'Mech has been produced in record numbers by the Word of Blake with no shortage of pilots. It is built on a Geometric 1000 Endo Steel chassis to save weight and is powered by a LTV 160 fusion engine that gives it a top speed of 64.8 km/h. For protection from enemy fire, the Initiate carries eight and a half tons of armor that allows the 'Mech to stand up to fire from most other 'Mechs of the same weight class or lower, and enjoys increased durability because of its CASE system that protects against ammunition explosions. Overall, the Initiate is a reliable trooper 'Mech that is capable of filling a variety of roles on the modern battlefield.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_initiate_INI-02.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Initiate started production after the Word of Blake retook Terra. This medium 'Mech has been produced in record numbers by the Word of Blake with no shortage of pilots. It is built on a Geometric 1000 Endo Steel chassis to save weight and is powered by a LTV 160 fusion engine that gives it a top speed of 64.8 km/h. For protection from enemy fire, the Initiate carries eight and a half tons of armor that allows the 'Mech to stand up to fire from most other 'Mechs of the same weight class or lower, and enjoys increased durability because of its CASE system that protects against ammunition explosions. Overall, the Initiate is a reliable trooper 'Mech that is capable of filling a variety of roles on the modern battlefield.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 启蒙者在布雷克之言重夺泰拉后开始生产。这款中型机甲被布雷克之言以创纪录的数量生产，飞行员从不短缺。它基于"几何 1000"内骨骼底盘建造以减重，由 LTV 160 聚变引擎驱动，最高速度 64.8 公里/小时。为抵御敌方火力，启蒙者携带八吨半装甲，使机甲能承受同重量级或更低级别大多数机甲的射击，并因其 C.A.S.E. 系统防护弹药爆炸而拥有更高耐久度。总体而言，启蒙者是一台可靠的通用机甲，能在现代战场上胜任多种角色。

Original: The Initiate has a diverse weapons mix that allows it to engage an enemy at a variety of ranges. For long-range combat, the Initiate has an Irian Weapons Works V7 LRM-15 launcher that gives the Initiate the ability to strike at an enemy at long ranges as well as giving an indirect fire capability to the 'Mech. For medium range combat, the Initiate has two Irian Weapons Works Super 6 Medium Lasers and an Irian Weapons Works 60mm SRM-6 launcher. For close ranges, the 'Mech has three Diverse Optics Type ER Small Lasers. Finally, to protect against missile attacks, the 'Mech has a McArthur Anti-Missile System.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_initiate_INI-02.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Initiate has a diverse weapons mix that allows it to engage an enemy at a variety of ranges. For long-range combat, the Initiate has an Irian Weapons Works V7 LRM-15 launcher that gives the Initiate the ability to strike at an enemy at long ranges as well as giving an indirect fire capability to the 'Mech. For medium range combat, the Initiate has two Irian Weapons Works Super 6 Medium Lasers and an Irian Weapons Works 60mm SRM-6 launcher. For close ranges, the 'Mech has three Diverse Optics Type ER Small Lasers. Finally, to protect against missile attacks, the 'Mech has a McArthur Anti-Missile System.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 启蒙者的武器搭配多样，能在多种距离上交战。远程战斗方面，启蒙者有一具"伊里安兵器工厂 V7"LRM-15 发射器，使启蒙者能在远距离打击敌人，并为机甲提供间接火力能力。中程战斗方面，启蒙者有两门"伊里安兵器工厂超级 6"中型激光和一具"伊里安兵器工厂 60 毫米"SRM-6 发射器。近程方面，机甲有三门"多元光学 ER 型"小型激光。最后，为防御导弹攻击，机甲装有一套麦克阿瑟反导系统。

Original: The JagerMech A model attempts to provide an indirect-fire support platform that can dish out damage without ever being seen. It has lower overall focused damage capability, but it usually mounts decent armor.

Original: A recent variant to the JagerMech, the JM6-B removes most of the ammunition dependencies of the original model by swapping out the AutoCannons for Lasers.  To make up for the loss in range, a pair of LRM-15 launchers have been added.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_jagermech_JM6-B.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A recent variant to the JagerMech, the JM6-B removes most of the ammunition dependencies of the original model by swapping out the AutoCannons for Lasers.  To make up for the loss in range, a pair of LRM-15 launchers have been added.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为猎手机甲的新近变体，JM6-B 把自动炮换成激光，从而消除了原型号大部分的弹药依赖。为弥补射程损失，加装了一对 LRM-15 发射器。

Original: While I like the overall lack of ammunition dependence, this beast runs HOT.  I'd suggest we swap out the LRM-15s for LRM-10s and add in another 4 Heat Sinks to help cool her down to a manageable level.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_jagermech_JM6-B.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: While I like the overall lack of ammunition dependence, this beast runs HOT.  I'd suggest we swap out the LRM-15s for LRM-10s and add in another 4 Heat Sinks to help cool her down to a manageable level.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 虽然我喜欢它整体上不依赖弹药，但这头猛兽太热了。我建议我们把 LRM-15 换成 LRM-10，再加 4 台散热器，把它降到可控水平。

Original: I like the idea of mounting the Large Laser - those old Drac techs had the right idea, but they executed it poorly.  We should yank out the extra Medium Lasers and replace them with Heat Sinks.

Original: The JR7-C was a basic upgrade of the JR7-K, removing one of the Medium Lasers and replacing it with a C3 Slave Unit. Combined with its speed this made the Jenner an ideal spotter for a C3 company.

Original: A lumbering mountain of armor and weaponry, Solaris Arms' massive assault 'Mech definitely lives up to the name of Juggernaut in the Solaris Games. While not a flashy design, Solaris Arms kept up steady production of the design since the early 3050s. Sixteen and half tons of Valiant Chainmail armor protect a GM 270 Fusion Engine, propelling the 'Mech at fairly standard assault 'Mech speed of 54 kph.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_juggernaut_JG-R9T1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A lumbering mountain of armor and weaponry, Solaris Arms' massive assault 'Mech definitely lives up to the name of Juggernaut in the Solaris Games. While not a flashy design, Solaris Arms kept up steady production of the design since the early 3050s. Sixteen and half tons of Valiant Chainmail armor protect a GM 270 Fusion Engine, propelling the 'Mech at fairly standard assault 'Mech speed of 54 kph.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一座笨重的装甲与武器之山，索拉里斯兵工厂的巨型突击机甲在索拉里斯竞技场上绝对配得上"主宰者"之名。虽然设计并不炫目，索拉里斯兵工厂自 3050 年代初以来一直稳定生产该设计。十六吨半的"勇武锁子甲"装甲保护着一台 GM 270 聚变引擎，推动机甲以相当标准的突击机甲速度——54 公里/小时——行进。

Original: The Juggernaut's main armament is a trio of Large X-Pulse Lasers, one in each arm with one in its center torso, backed up by three Sutel Precision Line Medium X-Pulse Lasers divided between each arm and the head. Due to the 'Mech's lack of hand actuators, at knife-fighting range the Juggernaut is protected by a staggering twelve Machine Guns fed from two tons of reloads.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_juggernaut_JG-R9T2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Juggernaut's main armament is a trio of Large X-Pulse Lasers, one in each arm with one in its center torso, backed up by three Sutel Precision Line Medium X-Pulse Lasers divided between each arm and the head. Due to the 'Mech's lack of hand actuators, at knife-fighting range the Juggernaut is protected by a staggering twelve Machine Guns fed from two tons of reloads.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重装的主要武装是三门大型 X 脉冲激光，每臂各一，中央躯干一门，辅以三门苏特尔精准线中型 X 脉冲激光，分列每臂与头部。由于机甲没有手部驱动器，在贴身距离上重装靠十二挺机枪（由两吨再装填供弹）提供惊人的防护。

Original: One of the so-called Clanbuster variants developed in 3052 during the lead-up to the Battle of Tukayyid, ComStar's techs replaced the twin autocannons with two M-7 Gauss Rifles and four tons of ammo in the arms, trading a minor reduction in destructive capacity for greatly increased range. While retaining the LRM launcher the large laser was upgraded to a Tronel XIII Large Pulse Laser and two Hovertec Streak SRM-2s, split between the side torsos with a single ton of reloads each, were added. These changes were accomplished by using an extralight engine in place of the standard model.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_kingcrab_KGC-0001.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the so-called Clanbuster variants developed in 3052 during the lead-up to the Battle of Tukayyid, ComStar's techs replaced the twin autocannons with two M-7 Gauss Rifles and four tons of ammo in the arms, trading a minor reduction in destructive capacity for greatly increased range. While retaining the LRM launcher the large laser was upgraded to a Tronel XIII Large Pulse Laser and two Hovertec Streak SRM-2s, split between the side torsos with a single ton of reloads each, were added. These changes were accomplished by using an extralight engine in place of the standard model.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是 3052 年图卡伊德战役前夕开发的所谓"破氏族"变体之一。康星技师将双联自动炮换成两门 M-7 高斯步枪，臂部携带四吨弹药，以略微降低的破坏力换取大幅提升的射程。保留 LRM 发射器的同时，大型激光升级为特罗内尔 XIII 大型脉冲激光，并加装两具霍弗泰克连续 SRM-2，分列两侧躯干、各配一吨再装填。这些改动通过以超轻型引擎取代标准引擎实现。

Original: This version of the King Crab was created by the Star League to be a command 'Mech and introduced alongside the original 000 model in 2743. Conceived in secret between Cosara and the Terran Hegemony, it was an attempt to produce a deadly command 'Mech by mounting a pair of newly-developed Hellstar Magna PPCs in either side torso backed by bya pair of SRM-6's. A pair of newly developed LBX/10's replaced the standard autocannon. The 010 model was more than capable of taking down an Atlas, but the entire line left with Kerensky during the Exodus and even knowledge of the design's existence became lost during the Succession Wars.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_kingcrab_KGC-010.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This version of the King Crab was created by the Star League to be a command 'Mech and introduced alongside the original 000 model in 2743. Conceived in secret between Cosara and the Terran Hegemony, it was an attempt to produce a deadly command 'Mech by mounting a pair of newly-developed Hellstar Magna PPCs in either side torso backed by bya pair of SRM-6's. A pair of newly developed LBX/10's replaced the standard autocannon. The 010 model was more than capable of taking down an Atlas, but the entire line left with Kerensky during the Exodus and even knowledge of the design's existence became lost during the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此版帝王蟹由星盟打造为指挥机甲，与原始 000 型于 2743 年一同推出。它由科萨拉与地球霸权秘密构想，试图通过在两肋各装一对新研制的"地狱星"大型 PPC 并辅以两具 SRM-6，打造一款致命的指挥机甲。一对新研制的 LBX/10 取代了标准自动炮。010 型完全有能力击杀一台阿特拉斯，但整条生产线随克伦斯基一同出走，连该设计存在的知识也在继承战争中失传。

Original: The KTO-20, used to good effect in the War of 3039, was the slightly downgraded version of the KTO-19 given to the Draconis Combine by ComStar as part of Operation Rosebud. Original: Developed by both ComStar and the Word of Blake, the KTO-21 was the first 'Mech to utilize both the new Improved Narc Missile Beacon (iNarc for short) and the improved C3 computer system. In order to utilize these new systems, the KTO-21 was refitted with an Endo Steel chassis and carried half a ton less armor than the KTO-19. Original: The Komodo was designed in 3053 to hunt and kill Clan Elemental Battle Armor. The 'Mech is built to be able to catch up to and destroy them with exceptional speed and maneuverability. The 'Mech is powered by a VOX 225 XL Engine that propels the 'Mech to a maximum speed of 86.4 kph. The Komodo can jump up to one hundred and fifty meters allowing it to traverse just about any terrain with ease, and is armored with seven and a half tons of armor. The 'Mech is also equipped with a Matabushi Guardian ECM Suite to defend against any enemy electronic warfare systems and also a Forward-1 TAG allowing the Komodo to designate a target for an Arrow IV artillery strike.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_komodo_KIM-2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Komodo was designed in 3053 to hunt and kill Clan Elemental Battle Armor. The 'Mech is built to be able to catch up to and destroy them with exceptional speed and maneuverability. The 'Mech is powered by a VOX 225 XL Engine that propels the 'Mech to a maximum speed of 86.4 kph. The Komodo can jump up to one hundred and fifty meters allowing it to traverse just about any terrain with ease, and is armored with seven and a half tons of armor. The 'Mech is also equipped with a Matabushi Guardian ECM Suite to defend against any enemy electronic warfare systems and also a Forward-1 TAG allowing the Komodo to designate a target for an Arrow IV artillery strike.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 科莫多于 3053 年设计，专为猎杀氏族元素战斗装甲。机甲能以卓越的速度与机动性追上并消灭它们。它由 VOX 225 XL 引擎驱动，最高速度 86.4 公里/小时。科莫多可跳跃至一百五十米，轻松跨越几乎任何地形，并有七吨半装甲。它还配备马塔布希守护者 ECM 套件以防御敌方电子战系统，以及 Forward-1 TAG 使科莫多能为箭矢 IV 炮击标记目标。

Original: The Komodo is armed with ten Victory 23R Medium Lasers as its primary weapons. While these have a range of only 270 meters, the 'Mech has enough firepower to annihilate an entire point of Elementals. The 'Mech is also armed with two Yori Flyswatter Anti-Missile Systems to defend against missile attacks.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_komodo_KIM-2.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Komodo is armed with ten Victory 23R Medium Lasers as its primary weapons. While these have a range of only 270 meters, the 'Mech has enough firepower to annihilate an entire point of Elementals. Original: The Lineholder was the first BattleMech design to come from Kressly Warworks. The Lineholder is designed around a set of Common Sense Rules for 'Mech design. This approach has produced a 'Mech with a good ground speed and respectable amount of armor and firepower. The 'Mech has a top speed of 86.4 km/h, allowing it to keep up with all but the fastest light and medium 'Mechs. The Lineholder also carries ten tons of armor protection and has fourteen heat sinks. Its mix of off-the-shelf weapons and equipment makes the Lineholder a reliable 'Mech that is easy to repair and is dependable in battle. However, the ultimate selling point for the Lineholder, especially to its target audience of small units and minor nobles, is value and price. In the first year of sales, the Lineholder was historically successful compared with other 55-ton BattleMechs. For minor factions able to afford brand new BattleMechs, the Lineholder has become the garrison machine of choice.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_lineholder_KW1-LH2.Details

Its mix of off-the-shelf weapons and equipment makes the Lineholder a reliable 'Mech that is easy to repair and is dependable in battle. However, the ultimate selling point for the Lineholder, especially to its target audience of small units and minor nobles, is value and price. In the first year of sales, the Lineholder was historically successful compared with other 55-ton BattleMechs. For minor factions able to afford brand new BattleMechs, the Lineholder has become the garrison machine of choice.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战线守护者是克雷斯利兵工厂出品的第一款战斗机甲设计。它围绕一套"机甲设计常识规则"构建。这一思路造就了一台地面速度良好、装甲与火力都相当可观的机甲。它最高速度 86.4 公里/小时，除最快的轻中型机甲外都能跟上。战线守护者还携带十吨装甲防护并有十四台散热器。它采用的现货武器与装备组合使其成为易于修理、作战可靠的机甲。然而其终极卖点——尤其对小型单位与末等贵族这类目标客户——是性价比。在销售第一年，战线守护者的业绩与其他 55 吨战斗机甲相比堪称历史性成功。对买得起全新战斗机甲的小势力而言，它已成为驻防机型的首选。

Original: The primary weapons on the Lineholder are a pair of LongFire V LRM-5 launchers. These allow the Lineholder to keep an enemy at long range and enable the 'Mech to provide limited indirect fire support. The LRMs are backed up by a BlazeFire Systems Large Laser. Finally, the Lineholder carries four Intek Medium Lasers to protect itself in close combat.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_lineholder_KW1-LH2.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary weapons on the Lineholder are a pair of LongFire V LRM-5 launchers. Finally, the Lineholder carries four Intek Medium Lasers to protect itself in close combat.

Original: The Loader King is one of the few IndustrialMechs still being manufactured in the Inner Sphere. This is due in large part to the fact that Achernar BattleMechs, the parent company of Achernar Heavy Industries, chose to maintain their IndustrialMech output rather than retool the lines for BattleMech production. Achernar BattleMechs already produces the Locust, Wasp, Phoenix Hawk and the Enforcer at their headquarters on New Avalon.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_loaderking_LDK-5C.Details

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 装载之王是内天体仍在制造的少数工业机甲之一。这在很大程度上是因为阿克尔纳战斗机甲的母公司阿克尔纳重工选择维持其工业机甲产量，而非将生产线改装用于战斗机甲生产。阿克尔纳战斗机甲已在其新阿瓦隆总部生产蝗虫、黄蜂、凤凰鹰和执法者。

Original: One of the best known BattleMechs in the Inner Sphere for its low production and operation costs, the Locust is also well known in the Clans. In 2832, Clan Mongoose unleashed an upgraded version of the venerable 'Mech on the Clans, known as the Locust IIC. The speedy design complemented Mongoose tactics, enabling them to win many Trials.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_locustiic_LCT-IIC.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the best known BattleMechs in the Inner Sphere for its low production and operation costs, the Locust is also well known in the Clans. In 2832, Clan Mongoose unleashed an upgraded version of the venerable 'Mech on the Clans, known as the Locust IIC. The speedy design complemented Mongoose tactics, enabling them to win many Trials.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蝗虫因其低廉的生产与运营成本成为内天体最知名的战斗机甲之一，在氏族中同样广为人知。2832 年，猫鼬氏族向氏族推出这款古老机甲的升级版，称为蝗虫 IIC。该高速设计与猫鼬战术相得益彰，使他们赢下许多试炼。

Original: The 2S variant was designed by Majesty Metals of the Magistracy of Canopus as a fast raider and tank hunter suitable for export throughout the periphery. Armed with twin SRM6s, loaded with 2 tons of munitions and fitted with MASC; the 2S is a fearsome knife fighter that can quickly close in and cripple it’s opponents. To make room for the missiles, the standard engine was substituted for an XL engine and paired with an endo steel chassis. Unfortunately the low armour and lack of CASE protected magazines has lead to a high mortality rate among it’s pilots; earning it the nickname dead woman's coffin. As the pilot often goes down with their mech – usually in a fiery explosion as the ammunition magazines detonate. Considered an expensive failure by the Magistracy, the design is nonetheless in high demand throughout the periphery with back orders sufficient to keep Magistracy Metals supplying the design for years to come.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_locust_LCT-2S.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 2S variant was designed by Majesty Metals of the Magistracy of Canopus as a fast raider and tank hunter suitable for export throughout the periphery. Armed with twin SRM6s, loaded with 2 tons of munitions and fitted with MASC; the 2S is a fearsome knife fighter that can quickly close in and cripple it’s opponents. To make room for the missiles, the standard engine was substituted for an XL engine and paired with an endo steel chassis. Unfortunately the low armour and lack of CASE protected magazines has lead to a high mortality rate among it’s pilots; earning it the nickname dead woman's coffin. As the pilot often goes down with their mech – usually in a fiery explosion as the ammunition magazines detonate. Considered an expensive failure by the Magistracy, the design is nonetheless in high demand throughout the periphery with back orders sufficient to keep Magistracy Metals supplying the design for years to come.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2S 变体由卡诺普斯法域的 Majesty Metals 设计，作为适合向外围区各地出口的快速劫掠者与坦克猎手。它装备双联 SRM6，装填 2 吨弹药并配备 MASC；2S 是一名令人生畏的短兵相接者，能迅速逼近并瘫痪对手。为给导弹腾出空间，标准引擎被换成 XL 引擎，并搭配内骨骼底盘。遗憾的是，薄弱的装甲和缺乏 C.A.S.E. 保护的弹仓导致其飞行员死亡率很高；为它赢得了"死人棺材"的绰号——飞行员常常随座机一同陨落，通常是弹药库殉爆时的猛烈爆炸。法域认为这是一次昂贵的失败，但该设计在外围区仍需求旺盛，积压订单足以让 Majesty Metals 在未来数年继续供应这一设计。

Original: The LCT-0S, or Dead Woman's Coffin, is designed to unleash a withering fusillade of SRMs, and then it will likely be destroyed. Since the only SRMs its armed with are unguided, it's unlikely to score any hits. Carrying subsequent salvos is only wasted tonnage
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_locust_LCT-2S.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The LCT-0S, or Dead Woman's Coffin, is designed to unleash a withering fusillade of SRMs, and then it will likely be destroyed. Since the only SRMs its armed with are unguided, it's unlikely to score any hits. Carrying subsequent salvos is only wasted tonnage
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: LCT-0S，又称"死人棺材"，其设计目的是倾泻一阵猛烈的 SRM 弹雨，然后它很可能会被摧毁。由于它装备的 SRM 都是无制导的，很可能一发都打不中。携带后续齐射只是浪费吨位

Original: The 3D Locust introduced in 3049 used Star League technology to take the concept of the 1M further. Although it carried only two Magna Longbow-5 launchers, the engineers at Achernar BattleMechs on New Avalon upgraded the armor to Ferro-Fibrous and the structure to Endo Steel. Completely lacking in close-range weaponry this variant was suitable for harassing the enemy at long range then fleeing before they could get too close.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_locust_LCT-3D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3D Locust introduced in 3049 used Star League technology to take the concept of the 1M further. Although it carried only two Magna Longbow-5 launchers, the engineers at Achernar BattleMechs on New Avalon upgraded the armor to Ferro-Fibrous and the structure to Endo Steel. Completely lacking in close-range weaponry this variant was suitable for harassing the enemy at long range then fleeing before they could get too close.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3D 蝗虫于 3049 年推出，使用星盟科技把 1M 的理念推进得更远。虽然它只携带两具玛格纳长弓-5 发射器，但新阿瓦隆阿克尔纳战斗机甲的工程师把装甲升级为铁纤维、结构升级为内骨骼。该变体完全没有近程武器，适合在远距离骚扰敌人，然后在对方逼近前逃离。

Original: The 3M Locust was built for the Free Worlds League in 3050, with production carried out at both Corean Enterprises on Stewart and Free Worlds Defense Industries on Gibson. It retained the Martell medium laser but replaced the machine guns with four Magna Small Lasers and added a Voelkers Parasol Anti-Missile System in the left arm for missile defense. The armor was upgraded to Kallon FWL Special Ferro-Fibrous with CASE in the left torso to protect the one ton of AMS ammo and utilized a Corean-II Delux Endo Steel chassis. The electronics were also updated to a Garrett T10 B communications system and a Corean CalcMaster targeting-tracking system.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_locust_LCT-3M.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3M Locust was built for the Free Worlds League in 3050, with production carried out at both Corean Enterprises on Stewart and Free Worlds Defense Industries on Gibson. It retained the Martell medium laser but replaced the machine guns with four Magna Small Lasers and added a Voelkers Parasol Anti-Missile System in the left arm for missile defense. The armor was upgraded to Kallon FWL Special Ferro-Fibrous with CASE in the left torso to protect the one ton of AMS ammo and utilized a Corean-II Delux Endo Steel chassis. The electronics were also updated to a Garrett T10 B communications system and a Corean CalcMaster targeting-tracking system.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3M 蝗虫于 3050 年为自由世界联盟建造，在斯图尔特上的科里安企业与吉布森上的自由世界防务工业同时生产。它保留马特尔中型激光，但把机枪换成四门玛格纳小型激光，并在左臂加装一套"沃克斯阳伞"反导系统用于导弹防御。装甲升级为卡隆 FWL 特种铁纤维，左躯干的 C.A.S.E. 保护一吨 AMS 弹药，底盘则采用科里安-II 豪华内骨骼。电子设备也更新为加勒特 T10 B 通讯系统和科里安 CalcMaster 瞄准追踪系统。

Original: The Longbow, introduced in 2480, has seen service in the armies of the Inner Sphere since the days of the Star League and is one of the most well-known fire support 'Mechs in existence. As a fire-support 'Mech though, the Longbow is a trusted and reliable machine that can be counted on to carry out the mission it is designed for. The primary weapons on the Longbow are its LRM launchers, four in all, a pair of 20s and a pair of 5s, letting the Longbow put out 50 LRMs into any target it can see.

Original: A favorite tool of planetary governments through out the Periphery, the Louse is designed for riot suppression. Capable of dispersing riots with lethal and non lethal options, it works well against civilians and lightly armed vehicles while posing no significant threat to actual battlemechs or military grade vehicles. Dual grenade launchers and a mixed laser package provide the bulk of the firepower, whilst a pair of flare launchers provides additional deterrent and can be used defensively in combat. Spall lined armour provides additional protection against infantry grade weapons and a set of sensors designed specifically for peering through cluttered urban environments round out the package. Often deployed as scouts and support forces; this mech is a common sight amongst the pirate bands who find themselves facing it across the battlefield. Not designed for battle, it is nonetheless pressed into service by desperate militias and governments that lack real battlemechs.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_louse_FLE-RS.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A favorite tool of planetary governments through out the Periphery, the Louse is designed for riot suppression. Capable of dispersing riots with lethal and non lethal options, it works well against civilians and lightly armed vehicles while posing no significant threat to actual battlemechs or military grade vehicles. Dual grenade launchers and a mixed laser package provide the bulk of the firepower, whilst a pair of flare launchers provides additional deterrent and can be used defensively in combat. Spall lined armour provides additional protection against infantry grade weapons and a set of sensors designed specifically for peering through cluttered urban environments round out the package. Often deployed as scouts and support forces; this mech is a common sight amongst the pirate bands who find themselves facing it across the battlefield. Not designed for battle, it is nonetheless pressed into service by desperate militias and governments that lack real battlemechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为外围区各行星政府钟爱的工具，虱子专为镇压暴乱而设计。它能以致命与非致命手段驱散暴乱，对付平民和轻武装车辆效果良好，而对真正的战斗机甲或军用级车辆不构成显著威胁。双联榴弹发射器和混合激光组提供主要火力，另有一对照明弹发射器提供额外威慑，也可在战斗中用于防御。防崩落内衬装甲提供对步兵级武器的额外防护，一套专为穿透杂乱城市环境而设计的传感器补全了整套配置。它常作为侦察与支援部队部署；在那些与它战场相见的强盗团伙中也很常见。它并非为战斗设计，却仍被缺乏真正战斗机甲的绝望民兵与政府强行投入使用。

Original: The primary configuration of the Lupus replaces the Archer and Bombardier 'Mechs. A pair of LRM-20 launchers with improved Artemis IV guidance systems allows the warrior to destroy a foe before they can reach close range. The Lupus Prime also carries a set of jump jets which allowed a smart warrior the opportunity to hold the range open, bombarding the enemy with heavy missile barrages. The only drawback is the limited ammunition supply: A mere three tons of ammunition allows for only a brief engagement. Should the enemy close with the Lupus all is not lost. The ER Medium Laser in each arm allow the Lupus to slice off armor, and the ECM Suite makes the Lupus Prime more difficult to target.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_lupus_PRIME.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary configuration of the Lupus replaces the Archer and Bombardier 'Mechs. A pair of LRM-20 launchers with improved Artemis IV guidance systems allows the warrior to destroy a foe before they can reach close range. The Lupus Prime also carries a set of jump jets which allowed a smart warrior the opportunity to hold the range open, bombarding the enemy with heavy missile barrages. The only drawback is the limited ammunition supply: A mere three tons of ammunition allows for only a brief engagement. Should the enemy close with the Lupus all is not lost. The ER Medium Laser in each arm allow the Lupus to slice off armor, and the ECM Suite makes the Lupus Prime more difficult to target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狼人的主配置取代了弓箭手与轰炸机两款机甲。两具配改进型 Artemis IV 制导系统的 LRM-20 发射器，让战士能在敌人接近前将其摧毁。狼人主型号还携带一套跳跃推进器，让聪明的战士有机会保持距离，用重型导弹弹幕轰炸敌人。唯一缺点是弹药有限：仅三吨弹药只够短暂交战。若敌人逼近狼人，也并非无计可施。每臂的 ER 中型激光让狼人能削切装甲，而 ECM 套件使狼人主型号更难被锁定。

Original: The initial prototype Mackie was designated the MSK-5S, and carried a slightly different weapons load than the production model MSK-6S. Using an Autocannon/5 in the right arm instead of the AC/10, the MSK-5S also mounted a Large Laser in the center torso, rather than the twin Medium Lasers, and had two more heat sinks. Twenty tons of Primitive Armor protected the first generation Mackie. This armor, though heavier, provided less protection than later models. The MSK-5S was used by Colonel Kincaid in his now-famous combat trial versus the Merkava tanks.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_mackie_MSK-5S.Details

Twenty tons of Primitive Armor protected the first generation Mackie. This armor, though heavier, provided less protection than later models. The MSK-5S was used by Colonel Kincaid in his now-famous combat trial versus the Merkava tanks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初的麦基原型被定名为 MSK-5S，武器载荷与量产型号 MSK-6S 略有不同。它在右臂使用一门自动炮/5 而非 AC/10，中央躯干也装一门大型激光而非双联中型激光，并多两台散热器。二十吨原始装甲保护着第一代麦基。这种装甲虽然更重，提供的防护却少于后来的型号。MSK-5S 被金凯德上校用于他如今著名的对抗梅卡瓦坦克的战斗试验。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 麦基由地球霸权在二十五世纪开发，是首款真正的战斗机甲。基于霸权武装部队在总监雅各布·卡梅隆治下数十年研发的先进技术，麦基是霸权军事力量的终极体现。

Original: This catchall series of Mackies was used to designate -6S's retrofitted with a wide variety of more modern components.

Original: Though most nations got rid of their cloned Mackies in favor of their own 'Mechs, the Hegemony was proud of their achievement. Moreover, many Hegemony militia units made extensive use of the first BattleMech, resulting in a continuous production of the first BattleMech right up until the Amaris Coup. Many of the various militia upgrades coalesced into the -9H, helped by the fact that Skobel continued to produce small quantities of this design. It mounts two Donal PPCs and an Imperator Autocannon/20, backed up by the pair of Starflash Medium Lasers. Nineteen tons of armor gave it full protection, allowing the 9Hs longevity.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_mackie_MSK-9H.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Though most nations got rid of their cloned Mackies in favor of their own 'Mechs, the Hegemony was proud of their achievement. Moreover, many Hegemony militia units made extensive use of the first BattleMech, resulting in a continuous production of the first BattleMech right up until the Amaris Coup. Many of the various militia upgrades coalesced into the -9H, helped by the fact that Skobel continued to produce small quantities of this design. It mounts two Donal PPCs and an Imperator Autocannon/20, backed up by the pair of Starflash Medium Lasers. Nineteen tons of armor gave it full protection, allowing the 9Hs longevity.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 尽管多数国家放弃克隆的麦基转而使用自家机甲，霸权仍为这一成就自豪。此外，许多霸权民兵单位大量使用首款战斗机甲，导致这款初代战斗机甲一直持续生产至阿马里斯政变。诸多民兵升级方案最终汇聚成-9H，这也得益于斯科贝尔持续小批量生产该设计。它装备两门多纳尔 PPC 和一门帝皇自动炮/20，辅以一对"星闪"中型激光。十九吨装甲给予它全面防护，使 9H 得以长盛不衰。

Original: A modern Clan take on the classic Succession Wars era MAR-3R Marauder, the A variant retains the arm-mounted weaponry of the standard Marauder IIC, removing the torso-mounted ER PPC and ER Small Lasers in exchange for a LB 5-X AC in its right torso supplied with single ton of ammo.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_marauderiic_MAD-IIC-A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是氏族对经典继承战争时代 MAR-3R 掠夺者的现代演绎。A 变体保留标准掠夺者 IIC 的臂载武器，去掉躯干搭载的 ER PPC 与 ER 小型激光，换取右侧躯干一具 LB 5-X AC，配一吨弹药。

Original: Built around the Extended Range Particle Projector Cannon, one of the most powerful weapons in the Clan arsenal, the Marauder IIC's weapon layout is typical of the standard Marauder, each pod-like forearm carrying an ER PPC paired with Medium Pulse Lasers. Where the Marauder IIC differs is with its torso weaponry, replacing the top-mounted autocannon and its vulnerable ammunition-feed linkage with another ER PPC, and adding a set of four ER Small Lasers. Twenty-one double heat sinks keep heat levels manageable, with an enterprising MechWarrior able to use volley fire to keep up a steady barrage of fire.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_marauderiic_MAD-IIC.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Built around the Extended Range Particle Projector Cannon, one of the most powerful weapons in the Clan arsenal, the Marauder IIC's weapon layout is typical of the standard Marauder, each pod-like forearm carrying an ER PPC paired with Medium Pulse Lasers. Where the Marauder IIC differs is with its torso weaponry, replacing the top-mounted autocannon and its vulnerable ammunition-feed linkage with another ER PPC, and adding a set of four ER Small Lasers. Twenty-one double heat sinks keep heat levels manageable, with an enterprising MechWarrior able to use volley fire to keep up a steady barrage of fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 掠夺者 IIC 以 ER 粒子投射炮——氏族武库中最强大的武器之一——为核心，其武器布局与标准掠夺者一致：每只吊舱式前臂各载一门 ER PPC 并配以中型脉冲激光。不同之处在于躯干武器：以另一门 ER PPC 取代顶部自动炮及其脆弱的供弹连接，并加装一组四门 ER 小型激光。二十一台双倍散热器将热量维持在可控水平，有进取心的机甲战士可用齐射维持稳定的火力倾泻。

Original: The Marauder II was first built in 3012 in an attempt to take the firepower of the Marauder and combine it with the reliability and ruggedness of an assault chassis. This Variant was captured and rebuilt by Kurita to carry 2 Heavy and 2 Light PPC.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_marauderII_MAD-2K.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Marauder II was first built in 3012 in an attempt to take the firepower of the Marauder and combine it with the reliability and ruggedness of an assault chassis. This Variant was captured and rebuilt by Kurita to carry 2 Heavy and 2 Light PPC.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 掠夺者 II 于 3012 年首次建造，旨在将掠夺者的火力与突击底盘的可靠性和坚固性相结合。此变体被库瑞塔缴获并重建，携带 2 门重型与 2 门轻型 PPC。

Original: The Marauder II was first built in 3012 in an attempt to take the firepower of the Marauder and combine it with the reliability and ruggedness of an assault chassis. This was achieved by generally upgrading the entire 'Mech's chassis to allow it to carry a much heavier armor and weapons load. The 'Mech was then armored with nineteen tons of armor, giving it protection that rivals that of the Atlas. Finally, to make up for the reduced mobility of the Marauder II, the 'Mech was outfitted with jump jets that give it a jumping capability of up to ninety meters. Blackwell Heavy Industries produced the design exclusively for Wolf's Dragoons until the end of the Fourth Succession War, when Jaime Wolf allowed them to sell to others.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_marauderII_MAD-4A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Marauder II was first built in 3012 in an attempt to take the firepower of the Marauder and combine it with the reliability and ruggedness of an assault chassis. This was achieved by generally upgrading the entire 'Mech's chassis to allow it to carry a much heavier armor and weapons load. The 'Mech was then armored with nineteen tons of armor, giving it protection that rivals that of the Atlas. Finally, to make up for the reduced mobility of the Marauder II, the 'Mech was outfitted with jump jets that give it a jumping capability of up to ninety meters. Blackwell Heavy Industries produced the design exclusively for Wolf's Dragoons until the end of the Fourth Succession War, when Jaime Wolf allowed them to sell to others.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 掠夺者 II 于 3012 年首次建造，旨在将掠夺者的火力与突击底盘的可靠性和坚固性相结合。为此整机底盘全面升级，以承载重得多的装甲与武器。机甲配备了十九吨装甲，防护水平可与阿特拉斯匹敌。最后，为弥补掠夺者 II 机动性的下降，它装上了跳跃推进器，可跳跃至九十米。布莱克威尔重工一直为狼之龙骑兵独家生产该设计，直到第四次继承战争结束，海梅·沃尔夫才允许他们对外销售。

Blackwell Heavy Industries produced the design exclusively for Wolf's Dragoons until the end of the Fourth Succession War, when Jaime Wolf allowed them to sell to others.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_marauderII_MAD-4A.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Marauder II was first built in 3012 in an attempt to take the firepower of the Marauder and combine it with the reliability and ruggedness of an assault chassis. This was achieved by generally upgrading the entire 'Mech's chassis to allow it to carry a much heavier armor and weapons load. The 'Mech was then armored with nineteen tons of armor, giving it protection that rivals that of the Atlas. Finally, to make up for the reduced mobility of the Marauder II, the 'Mech was outfitted with jump jets that give it a jumping capability of up to ninety meters. Blackwell Heavy Industries produced the design exclusively for Wolf's Dragoons until the end of the Fourth Succession War, when Jaime Wolf allowed them to sell to others.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 掠夺者 II 于 3012 年首次建造，旨在将掠夺者的火力与突击底盘的可靠性和坚固性相结合。为此整机底盘全面升级，以承载重得多的装甲与武器。机甲配备了十九吨装甲，防护水平可与阿特拉斯匹敌。最后，为弥补掠夺者 II 机动性的下降，它装上了跳跃推进器，可跳跃至九十米。布莱克威尔重工一直为狼之龙骑兵独家生产该设计，直到第四次继承战争结束，海梅·沃尔夫才允许他们对外销售。

Original: The Marauder II was first built in 3012 in an attempt to take the firepower of the Marauder and combine it with the reliability and ruggedness of an assault chassis. This variant of the Marauder II, the -4B, is a rare introtech variant that carries a ballistic-heavy loadout while maintaining the -4A's armor and speed profile. The -4B carries a pair of AC/10s for its main firepower with 4 tons of ammo while a Large Laser and a pair of Medium Lasers back the autocannons up.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_marauderII_MAD-4B.Details

Original: Take your average Marauder.  Pump it up, and make it even more maddening.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_marauderII_MAD-4B.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 拿一台普通的掠夺者。强化它，让它更加疯狂。

Original: While the standard Marauder II, the MAD-5A, was built to spec for the Wolf's Dragoons to be a line combat unit and a traditional assault mech, the MAD-4HB is only one step removed from being a pirate design. Constructed by pirates after stealing a shipment of Marauder IIs meant for someone else, they removed the fancy equipment they couldn't maintain and filled in the holes with a frankly ungodly number of rockets, allowing the -4HB a punch that can instantly delete lesser mechs and even seriously damage mechs of its own caliber. After the rockets though, the -4HB has little firepower for an assault mech.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_marauderII_MAD-4HB.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: While the standard Marauder II, the MAD-5A, was built to spec for the Wolf's Dragoons to be a line combat unit and a traditional assault mech, the MAD-4HB is only one step removed from being a pirate design. Constructed by pirates after stealing a shipment of Marauder IIs meant for someone else, they removed the fancy equipment they couldn't maintain and filled in the holes with a frankly ungodly number of rockets, allowing the -4HB a punch that can instantly delete lesser mechs and even seriously damage mechs of its own caliber. After the rockets though, the -4HB has little firepower for an assault mech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 标准的掠夺者 II（MAD-5A）是按狼之龙骑兵的规格打造的战线作战单位与传统的突击机甲，而 MAD-4HB 离海盗设计只差一步。海盗们截获了一批本应交给他人的掠夺者 II 后自行建造，拆掉了他们无力维护的精良装备，用简直骇人的火箭数量填补空缺，使-4HB 拥有一击秒杀较弱机甲、甚至重创同级机甲的打击力。不过打完火箭之后，作为突击机甲它的火力就很有限了。

Original: Boss, I've got no words. Those damn Marian pirates are absolutely nuts. It's a miracle this thing doesn't blow itself in half when it fires all those rockets but at least it usually blows its target in half instead.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 老大，我无话可说。那些该死的马里安海盗简直疯了。这东西在发射那一堆火箭时居然没把自己炸成两半，简直是奇迹，不过至少它通常会把目标炸成两半。

Original: The Marauder is among the most classic of all Mech designs, venerable, powerful, respected. However, the original Marauder, the -1R, is mostly forgotten today. Clad in Ferro-Fibroous armor, it is otherwise the same as the downgraded -3R and is just as formidable.

Original: The 3D Marauder was a modification of the 'Mech introduced for House Davion in 2834 which removed its ammunition dependency. In order to do this, the 3D replaced the Autocannon/5 and with a Large Laser. The saved weight was used to add four more heat sinks to the 'Mech to handle the added heat burden from the large laser.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_marauder_MAD-3D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3D Marauder was a modification of the 'Mech introduced for House Davion in 2834 which removed its ammunition dependency. In order to do this, the 3D replaced the Autocannon/5 and with a Large Laser. The saved weight was used to add four more heat sinks to the 'Mech to handle the added heat burden from the large laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3D 掠夺者是 2834 年为达维昂家族推出的改装型，它消除了机甲对弹药的依赖。为此，3D 以一门大型激光取代自动炮/5。节省的重量用于为机甲增加四台散热器，以处理大型激光带来的额外热负担。

Original: Built for House Liao in 2905, the 3L attempted to make the Marauder more heat efficient (and make up for a shortage in reliable PPCs) by replacing one of the arm-mounted particle cannons with a large laser. Additionally, two more heat sinks were added to further increase the Marauder's heat efficiency.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_marauder_MAD-3L.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Built for House Liao in 2905, the 3L attempted to make the Marauder more heat efficient (and make up for a shortage in reliable PPCs) by replacing one of the arm-mounted particle cannons with a large laser. Additionally, two more heat sinks were added to further increase the Marauder's heat efficiency.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3L 于 2905 年为廖家族建造，它试图通过把一门臂载粒子炮换成大型激光来提升掠夺者的散热效率（并弥补可靠 PPC 的短缺）。此外还增加两台散热器，进一步提升掠夺者的散热效率。

Original: The 3M was introduced in 2873 specially for the Free Worlds League. Because of the abundance of large lasers built by that realm, the 3M model carried two large lasers in place of the PPCs. While running cooler than the weapons they replaced, the large lasers also caused slightly less damage. Additionally, the 3M added four heat sinks to the design, making the 'Mech much more manageable for pilots who have trouble with overheating their 'Mechs.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_marauder_MAD-3M.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3M was introduced in 2873 specially for the Free Worlds League. Because of the abundance of large lasers built by that realm, the 3M model carried two large lasers in place of the PPCs. While running cooler than the weapons they replaced, the large lasers also caused slightly less damage. Additionally, the 3M added four heat sinks to the design, making the 'Mech much more manageable for pilots who have trouble with overheating their 'Mechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3M 于 2873 年专为自由世界联盟推出。由于该势力生产的大型激光数量充裕，3M 型号以两门大型激光取代 PPC。虽然比被替换的武器更凉，大型激光造成的伤害也略低。此外，3M 为设计增加了四台散热器，使这台机甲对那些容易让机甲过热的飞行员而言好驾驭得多。

Original: The Marauder was first built by General Motors in 2612 for use as an attack and direct fire support BattleMech. The first 'Mech to diverge from the traditional humanoid shape of previous machines, the Marauder was one of the most well-known 'Mechs in existence and originally meant to usher in a new generation of 'Mechs. Unfortunately, with the fall of the Star League, this new generation never quite materialized. On its own merits though, the Marauder was a devastatingly powerful 'Mech, outclassed only by larger machines like the Stalker and BattleMaster.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_marauder_MAD-3R.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Marauder was first built by General Motors in 2612 for use as an attack and direct fire support BattleMech. The first 'Mech to diverge from the traditional humanoid shape of previous machines, the Marauder was one of the most well-known 'Mechs in existence and originally meant to usher in a new generation of 'Mechs. Unfortunately, with the fall of the Star League, this new generation never quite materialized. On its own merits though, the Marauder was a devastatingly powerful 'Mech, outclassed only by larger machines like the Stalker and BattleMaster.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 掠夺者最初由通用汽车于 2612 年建造，用作攻击与直射火力支援战斗机甲。作为首款偏离以往机种传统人形外形的机甲，掠夺者是现存最知名的机甲之一，原本意在开启新一代机甲。遗憾的是，随着星盟的陨落，这一代新机从未真正成为现实。不过就自身而言，掠夺者是一台破坏力惊人的强大机甲，只有潜行者和战将之类更大的机种能压过它。

Original: Built for the budget conscious mercenary, the 3S is designed for prolonged operations and utilises an all energy loadout that is cheaper to maintain than the standard 3R; whilst using widely available components cuts down on repair costs. The maintenance intensive Autocannon and it’s infamously bad ammunition feed are replaced with an extra trio of Medium Lasers and 6 heat sinks, dramatically increases the amount of time the mech can go without resupply. The extra heat sinking helps offset the increased heat profile added by the lasers, whilst the increased number of medium lasers act as a strong deterrent to any lighter mechs seeking to get inside the PPC’s firing arc. Debuting in 2955, production has remained steady; with two dozen of these machines being built a year at the General Motors Kathil facility. Sold exclusively to the mercenary market, the 3S is a common site on worlds like Outreach and Galatia and remains a favorite of mercenaries everywhere despite it's age.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_marauder_MAD-3S.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Built for the budget conscious mercenary, the 3S is designed for prolonged operations and utilises an all energy loadout that is cheaper to maintain than the standard 3R; whilst using widely available components cuts down on repair costs. The maintenance intensive Autocannon and it’s infamously bad ammunition feed are replaced with an extra trio of Medium Lasers and 6 heat sinks, dramatically increases the amount of time the mech can go without resupply. The extra heat sinking helps offset the increased heat profile added by the lasers, whilst the increased number of medium lasers act as a strong deterrent to any lighter mechs seeking to get inside the PPC’s firing arc. Debuting in 2955, production has remained steady; with two dozen of these machines being built a year at the General Motors Kathil facility. Sold exclusively to the mercenary market, the 3S is a common site on worlds like Outreach and Galatia and remains a favorite of mercenaries everywhere despite it's age.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3S 为预算有限的佣兵打造，专为长期作战设计，采用全能量武器配置，维护成本低于标准 3R；使用随处可得的组件也降低了修理费用。维护密集的自动炮及其臭名昭著的糟糕供弹系统被另外三门中型激光和 6 台散热器取代，大幅延长了机甲无需补给即可作战的时间。额外的散热能力有助于抵消激光带来的更高热负荷，而更多数量的中型激光则对任何试图钻进 PPC 射界的轻型机甲构成强力威慑。3S 于 2955 年首次亮相，生产一直稳定；通用汽车卡西尔工厂每年建造两打这样的机器。它专供佣兵市场，在"外联"和"加拉提亚"等世界随处可见，尽管年代久远，仍是各地佣兵的最爱。

Original: This experimental variant was made at Ronin Incorporated's facility on Wallis in 3039. Techs removed the standard weaponry from a Marauder and replaced the arm mounted weapons with a Binary Laser Cannon in each arm, while the torso mounted autocannon was replaced by twin SRM-6 launchers backed by one ton of ammunition. The Marauder-4X was also noteworthy because it used a Prototype Endo Steel chassis. To keep the heat under control, technicians installed twelve single heat sinks and six prototype Double Heat Sinks.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_marauder_MAD-4X.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This experimental variant was made at Ronin Incorporated's facility on Wallis in 3039. The Marauder-4X was also noteworthy because it used a Prototype Endo Steel chassis. To keep the heat under control, technicians installed twelve single heat sinks and six prototype Double Heat Sinks.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此实验变体于 3039 年在浪人公司位于沃利斯的工厂制造。技师从一台掠夺者上拆除标准武器，把臂载武器换成每臂一门双联激光炮，躯干自动炮则换成双联 SRM-6 发射器（配一吨弹药）。掠夺者-4X 还以使用原型内骨骼底盘而著称。为控制热量，技师安装了十二台单散热器和六台原型双倍散热器。

Original: Built for Solaris by Barrymore Munitions, this Marauder replaces the usual Autocannon with a unique Mech mortar capable of launching 10 Shells per Salvo.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_marauder_MAD-8A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Built for Solaris by Barrymore Munitions, this Marauder replaces the usual Autocannon with a unique Mech mortar capable of launching 10 Shells per Salvo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款掠夺者由巴里摩尔弹药公司为索拉里斯建造，以一门独特的机甲迫击炮取代通常的自动炮，每次齐射可发射 10 发炮弹。

Original: A Clan-tech retrofit of the classic MAD-3R Marauder, designed for use by second-line garrison and solahma forces, the Marauder C replaced some of the Inner Spheroid weaponry with Clan equivalents. The Marauder C swapped the PPCs for a pair of Clan-tech Large Pulse Lasers and the standard autocannon for a Ultra AC/5 model, but retained the IS medium lasers. The munitions for the autocannon were also protected with CASE.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_marauder_MAD-C.Details

Original: This is a Sherrifs mech, It brings a peice of mind to folk, but is not heavy on technology.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_marshal-MHL-X1.YangsThoughts

Original: The MAL-1P utilizes just about the same weapons as stock maulers, except this version carries a PPC in each arm. It retains both LRMs, downgrading these from the LRM-15s to LRM-10s, and keeps the MAL-1R's four Autocannon/2s. A extra-light 270 engine keeps it moving and eleven Double Heat Sinks keep the heat at bay.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_mauler_MAL-1P.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The MAL-1P utilizes just about the same weapons as stock maulers, except this version carries a PPC in each arm. It retains both LRMs, downgrading these from the LRM-15s to LRM-10s, and keeps the MAL-1R's four Autocannon/2s. A extra-light 270 engine keeps it moving and eleven Double Heat Sinks keep the heat at bay.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: MAL-1P 使用的武器与原装重击者几乎相同，只是此版本每臂携带一门 PPC。它保留两具 LRM（从 LRM-15 降级为 LRM-10），并保留 MAL-1R 的四门自动炮/2。一台 270 超轻型引擎让它保持机动，十一台双倍散热器则将热量挡在外面。

Original: The Mauler is armed with four Imperator Smoothie-2 Autocannon/2s as its longest ranged primary weapons. Individually, the damage the AC/2s deal is insignificant, but together they can steadily whittle away armor at extreme range. The 'Mech also carries two Shigunga LRM-15 launchers, adding much needed punch to the extreme reach of its four autocannons. The 'Mech also carries two Victory Nickel Alloy ER Large Lasers for added long range punch.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_mauler_MAL-1R.Details

Individually, the damage the AC/2s deal is insignificant, but together they can steadily whittle away armor at extreme range. The 'Mech also carries two Shigunga LRM-15 launchers, adding much needed punch to the extreme reach of its four autocannons. The 'Mech also carries two Victory Nickel Alloy ER Large Lasers for added long range punch.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重击者装备四门"帝皇奶昔-2"自动炮/2 作为最远程的主武器。单门 AC/2 的伤害微不足道，但合在一起便能在极远距离持续削弱敌方装甲。它还携带两具"紫郡"LRM-15 发射器，为四门自动炮的极远射程增添急需的打击力。机甲还携带两门"胜利镍合金"ER 大型激光以增加远程打击力。

Original: The Mauler MAL-2P should be considered a prototype. Unlike the -1P or MX90, the -2P carries a pair of Lasers in each arm; it's rumored that more than two can affixed if need be. Its twin LRM-10s allow it to send missiles at a greater distance and two Ultra Autocannon/5s give it long to close range support. Both the LRMs and UAC/5s have two tons of ammunition a piece, and like the -1P and MX90, the 2P has Cellular Ammunition Storage Equipment to help protect it from ammo explosions. Eleven Double Heat Sinks and a 270 Standard Engine round out the rest of it load out.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_mauler_MAL-2P.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Mauler MAL-2P should be considered a prototype. Unlike the -1P or MX90, the -2P carries a pair of Lasers in each arm; it's rumored that more than two can affixed if need be. Its twin LRM-10s allow it to send missiles at a greater distance and two Ultra Autocannon/5s give it long to close range support. Both the LRMs and UAC/5s have two tons of ammunition a piece, and like the -1P and MX90, the 2P has Cellular Ammunition Storage Equipment to help protect it from ammo explosions. Eleven Double Heat Sinks and a 270 Standard Engine round out the rest of it load out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重击者 MAL-2P 应被视为原型机。与-1P 或 MX90 不同，-2P 每臂携带两门激光；据传必要时可加装两门以上。其双联 LRM-10 使其能将导弹投送到更远距离，两门超速自动炮/5 提供远至近程支援。LRM 与 UAC/5 各配两吨弹药，且与-1P 和 MX90 一样，2P 拥有蜂窝式弹药储存设备以防弹药爆炸。十一台双倍散热器与 270 标准引擎构成其配置的其余部分。

Original: The -2R variant of the Mauler uses relatively new weapons. The standard AC/2s are replaced with Ultra versions, doubling their potential damage. Paired ER Medium Lasers are fitted in arms formerly housing the ER Large Lasers. The missile launchers are reduced to smaller LRM-10s. A heavier standard fusion engine is utilized instead of the expensive XL.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_mauler_MAL-2R.Details

Paired ER Medium Lasers are fitted in arms formerly housing the ER Large Lasers. The missile launchers are reduced to smaller LRM-10s. A heavier standard fusion engine is utilized instead of the expensive XL.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重击者-2R 变体使用相对较新的武器。标准 AC/2 换成超速版本，潜在伤害翻倍。原本安装 ER 大型激光的臂部改装成对的 ER 中型激光。导弹发射器缩减为较小的 LRM-10。它采用较重的标准聚变引擎，而非昂贵的 XL。

Original: The -C variant of the Mauler is a modification that was made to the -1R model to allow it to carry a C3 Slave unit into battle. This is achieved by removing one ton of autocannon ammunition. This small modification allows the Mauler to share targeting data with friendly units and makes the 'Mech a highly effective sniper.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_mauler_MAL-C.Details

Original: Named for the door guards who serve to ward off evil spirits from a home, the Men Shen is the first OmniMech to come from the Capellan Confederation, it borrows heavily from the Raven BattleMech for its basic design concept. The 'Mech is built on a lightweight Endo Steel chassis and is powered by a vulnerable but light VOX 330 XL Engine that gives it a top speed of 97.2 km/h that is augmented by MASC system allowing the 'Mech to be pushed up to 129.6 km/h in short bursts. The Men Shen comes with eleven tons of armor, giving it a respectable amount of protection. The Men Shen carries on its base chassis a Beagle Active Probe allowing it to serve in a recon role regardless of its configuration. For weapons and equipment the Men Shen has seventeen tons of free pod space.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_menshen_MS1-O.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Named for the door guards who serve to ward off evil spirits from a home, the Men Shen is the first OmniMech to come from the Capellan Confederation, it borrows heavily from the Raven BattleMech for its basic design concept. The 'Mech is built on a lightweight Endo Steel chassis and is powered by a vulnerable but light VOX 330 XL Engine that gives it a top speed of 97.2 km/h that is augmented by MASC system allowing the 'Mech to be pushed up to 129.6 km/h in short bursts. The Men Shen comes with eleven tons of armor, giving it a respectable amount of protection. The Men Shen carries on its base chassis a Beagle Active Probe allowing it to serve in a recon role regardless of its configuration. For weapons and equipment the Men Shen has seventeen tons of free pod space.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 门神之名取自守护家宅驱除邪灵的门卫，它是卡佩兰邦联的首款全能机甲，基本设计概念大量借鉴渡鸦战斗机甲。该机甲建立在轻量化内骨骼底盘上，由脆弱但轻便的 VOX 330 XL 引擎驱动，最高速度 97.2 公里/小时，并可由 MASC 系统在短促爆发中推至 129.6 公里/小时。门神配有十一吨装甲，防护相当可观。其基础底盘搭载比格犬主动探测器，使其无论何种配置都能胜任侦察任务。武器与装备方面，门神拥有十七吨自由吊舱空间。

Original: In its primary configuration the Men Shen is a powerful close combat 'Mech and is capable of providing indirect fire support to friendly units. For close-range combat, the primary configuration has four highly accurate Medium Pulse Lasers. To provide both direct and indirect long range fire support, the primary configuration of the Men Shen has an LRM-15 launcher with an Artemis IV fire control system for increased missile accuracy.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_menshen_MS1-O.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In its primary configuration the Men Shen is a powerful close combat 'Mech and is capable of providing indirect fire support to friendly units. For close-range combat, the primary configuration has four highly accurate Medium Pulse Lasers. To provide both direct and indirect long range fire support, the primary configuration of the Men Shen has an LRM-15 launcher with an Artemis IV fire control system for increased missile accuracy.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主配置中，门神是一台强大的近战机甲，并能向友军单位提供间接火力支援。近程战斗方面，主配置有四门极为精准的中型脉冲激光。为提供直接与间接的远程火力支援，门神主配置装有一具带 Artemis IV 火控系统以提升导弹精度的 LRM-15 发射器。

Original: Named for the door guards who serve to ward off evil spirits from a home, the Men Shen is the first OmniMech to come from the Capellan Confederation, it borrows heavily from the Raven BattleMech for its basic design concept. The 'Mech is built on a lightweight Endo Steel chassis and is powered by a vulnerable but light VOX 330 XL Engine that gives it a top speed of 97.2 km/h that is augmented by MASC system allowing the 'Mech to be pushed up to 129.6 km/h in short bursts. The Men Shen comes with eleven tons of armor, giving it a respectable amount of protection. The Men Shen carries on its base chassis a Beagle Active Probe allowing it to serve in a recon role regardless of its configuration. For weapons and equipment the Men Shen has seventeen tons of free pod space.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_menshen_MS1-OB.Details

Original: Built by Krupp Armament Works under contract for the ComGuard, the 66C was intended for deployment on Tukayyid. Unfortunately the design was unable to be finished in time and Krupp was left with a finished mech that had no prospective buyers. In a deal brokered by Comstar, the company agreed to sell it's finished production to the reformed SLDF and provide them with additional production runs as requested. Built as a fast interdiction unit, the design was designed to chase down and annihilate elemental formations. Armed with 4 small pulse lasers, a medium pulse laser and a Streak SRM-2; the variant performed with distinction throughout the post Tukayyid years and then through Operations Bulldog and Serpent. The Word of Blake invasion choked off the flow of new mechs, as Krupp’s production shifted to the newer designs demanded by the Word.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_mongoose_MON-66CG.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Built by Krupp Armament Works under contract for the ComGuard, the 66C was intended for deployment on Tukayyid. Unfortunately the design was unable to be finished in time and Krupp was left with a finished mech that had no prospective buyers. In a deal brokered by Comstar, the company agreed to sell it's finished production to the reformed SLDF and provide them with additional production runs as requested. Built as a fast interdiction unit, the design was designed to chase down and annihilate elemental formations. Armed with 4 small pulse lasers, a medium pulse laser and a Streak SRM-2; the variant performed with distinction throughout the post Tukayyid years and then through Operations Bulldog and Serpent. The Word of Blake invasion choked off the flow of new mechs, as Krupp’s production shifted to the newer designs demanded by the Word.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 66C 由克虏伯兵工厂按康卫合同建造，原计划部署于图卡伊德。遗憾的是设计未能按时完成，克虏伯手上留下一台没有潜在买家的成品机甲。在康星撮合的交易中，公司同意把已完成的产量卖给重组的星盟防卫军，并按需提供额外生产批次。它被打造为快速拦截单位，旨在追击并歼灭元素编队。装备 4 门小型脉冲激光、一门中型脉冲激光和一具连续 SRM-2；该变体在图卡伊德之后的岁月中表现出色，此后又历经"斗牛犬"与"蛇"行动。布雷克之言的入侵切断了新机甲的供给，因为克虏伯的生产转向了布雷克派要求的新设计。

Original: An upgrade to the Mongoose 67, the 67L is a locally produced model used by the Outworlds Alliance. Assigned to the First and Second Long Road Legions, every part of the mech is manufactured in the Alliance, save for the imported TAG system. The Alliance Military Corps provides the Mongoose chassis from their reserve stocks of Mon-67 models. The original medium lasers are swapped for 3 of the Alliances new ER Medium lasers and the small laser is removed altogether. The addition of locally produced Ferro-Fibrous armour allows for a minor gain in protection and the addition of the TAG system. Developed as a fast harasser and spotter, designed to work in concert with the Alliance Air Wings and Planetary garrisons; the design has proven popular among Mongoose pilots as much for it's improved capabilities as it's locally made parts.

Original: An upgrade to the ageing 68 model, this Mongoose was one of the first models to trial the Combines new C3 Slave unit. Featuring a characteristically minimalist upgrade package, this Mongoose variant served with distinction during Operation Bulldog. An ER Large Laser servers as the sole weapons system, augmented by a new fire control system and the C3 unit. A cheap upgrade, this is a favorite of pilots who were previously assigned a 68; with many praising the enhanced range and accuracy of the Laser. Paired into demi lances, and assigned a C3 Master equipped mech to coordinate, these Mongoose's are deployed as head hunters and long range harassers; both roles that make use of their high ground speed and manoeuvrability. Fast and deadly, they have already made a name for themselves, with one Mongoose formation accounting for 5 kills, including a Star Colonel in a Timberwolf during the Great Refusal.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_mongoose_MON-68B.Details

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款猫鼬是对老旧的 68 型的升级，也是首批试用联合体新型 C3 从属单元的型号之一。它以典型的极简升级方案为特色，在"斗牛犬"行动中表现出色。一门 ER 大型激光是唯一的武器系统，辅以新的火控系统和 C3 单元。作为廉价的升级方案，它深受此前配属 68 型的飞行员喜爱；许多人称赞其激光提升后的射程与精度。它们成对编入半小队，并配属一台装 C3 主控的机甲进行协调，作为猎头者与远程骚扰者部署——这两个角色都能发挥其高地面速度与机动性。快速而致命，它们已经闯出名号：在大拒绝期间，一支猫鼬编队拿下了 5 个战果，其中包括一名驾驶木材狼的星上校。

Original: Originating from the short lived Concord of Kapteyn, this design was designed to showcase each realms newly rediscovered technology in one show-piece design. Unfortunately the Concord fell apart before the design could be put into production. The Clan Invasion left the Free Worlds League scrambling for new designs that could be used in the fight against the Clans. Among the designs pushed into production was the 69K, redesigned to use modern technologies from across the Inner Sphere. The chassis is sourced from the Combine, whilst the engine is of Lyran make; paired with a FWL built Streak SRM-2 and one of the Capellan Confederation’s newly rediscovered Beagle Probes. Produced at Irian technologies Shiro III facility until the early 3060’s, the mech was sold at cost to buyers; with the FWL subsidising production as part of their contributions to the war.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_mongoose_MON-69K.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originating from the short lived Concord of Kapteyn, this design was designed to showcase each realms newly rediscovered technology in one show-piece design. Unfortunately the Concord fell apart before the design could be put into production. The Clan Invasion left the Free Worlds League scrambling for new designs that could be used in the fight against the Clans. Among the designs pushed into production was the 69K, redesigned to use modern technologies from across the Inner Sphere. The chassis is sourced from the Combine, whilst the engine is of Lyran make; paired with a FWL built Streak SRM-2 and one of the Capellan Confederation’s newly rediscovered Beagle Probes. Produced at Irian technologies Shiro III facility until the early 3060’s, the mech was sold at cost to buyers; with the FWL subsidising production as part of their contributions to the war.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此设计源自短暂的卡普坦协约，旨在用一款展示型设计展现各势力新近重新发现的技术。遗憾的是协约在该设计投产前便瓦解。氏族入侵使自由世界联盟急于寻找可用于对抗氏族的新设计。被推入量产的方案中包括 69K，它经过重新设计以使用来自内天体各地的现代技术。底盘取自联合体，引擎为莱兰制造；搭配 FWL 制造的连续 SRM-2 和卡佩兰邦联新近重新发现的比格犬探测器。该机甲在伊里安科技的白三工厂生产至 3060 年代初，以成本价卖给买家；FWL 将其生产补贴作为对战争的贡献。

Original: In the aftermath of the Amaris Civil War and the chaos of the Succession Wars, the Nightstar which was already rare and prized began to be unable to be repaired with its advanced components. Thus, the -7J downgrade was created to make use of damaged Nightstars that lacked the proper components. Without the delicate XL engine, the -7J could no longer carry its massive Gauss Rifles, instead carrying a pair of AC/10s. The remaining weaponry was downgraded, as well as the heat sinks being replaced with the weaker standard versions of the day. The two things that stayed the same however was the mech's ponderous speed and tremendous armor capability.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_nightstar_NSR-7J.Details

Original: The genesis of the Nightstar lies in the Amaris Civil War. The 'Mech itself was only produced until the the First Succession War, when both of the factories and engineers capable of producing the Nightstar were destroyed or killed. The Nightstar is armed to keep an enemy at standoff ranges. The primary weapons carried are a pair of Gauss Rifles, each of which can strip almost a ton of armor off an enemy unit. These are backed up by a ER PPC that is capable of hitting a target at six hundred and ninety meters. For defense at short ranges, the 'Mech has two Medium Pulse Lasers and an Small Laser.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_nightstar_NSR-9J.Details

Original: In the late 3050's the Federated Commonwealth developed this offshoot of the standard NSR-9J in response to the proliferation of stealth technology. High end senors, targeting systems and actuators enable the NSR-9JC to deliver devastatingly accurate gauss rounds to even the most challenging targets. The XL engine of it's parent has been replaced with a standard model, greatly increasing survivability, which is further enhanced with spall liner and hardened arms. A C3 Master computer aids tactical coordination. For close range defense a pair of Medium X-Pulse lasers is mounted in each arm and an ER Small laser sits below the cockpit.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_nightstar_NSR-9JC.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In the late 3050's the Federated Commonwealth developed this offshoot of the standard NSR-9J in response to the proliferation of stealth technology. High end senors, targeting systems and actuators enable the NSR-9JC to deliver devastatingly accurate gauss rounds to even the most challenging targets. The XL engine of it's parent has been replaced with a standard model, greatly increasing survivability, which is further enhanced with spall liner and hardened arms. A C3 Master computer aids tactical coordination. For close range defense a pair of Medium X-Pulse lasers is mounted in each arm and an ER Small laser sits below the cockpit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在 3050 年代后期，联邦联邦针对隐身技术的扩散开发了标准 NSR-9J 的这一分支。高端传感器、瞄准系统与驱动器使 NSR-9JC 能向即使最棘手的目标投送精准得惊人的高斯弹。它母型的 XL 引擎已换成标准型号，大幅提升生存性，并进一步以防崩落内衬和加固臂部加以强化。一台 C3 主控计算机辅助战术协调。近程防御方面，每臂各装一对中型 X 脉冲激光，驾驶舱下方还有一门 ER 小型激光。

Original: Since it was the chosen BattleMech of the Great Father, the venerable Orion has always held a special place in the mystique of the Clans. Out of respect for General Kerensky's legacy, all the Clans maintained the design for several decades even as the development of newer and more advanced technologies increasingly left it less effective on the battlefield. Not a radical reworking of the design, as some Clan upgrades are, the Orion IIC replaces much of the innards and weapons of the original, while preserving its mass and aesthetics. This IIC upgrade utilizes an Endo Steel chassis and twelve tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, while also making use of twelve double heat sinks, freeing up weight for heavier weapons loadout. This variant switches the Gauss Rifle to an Ultra Autocannon/5.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_orion_ON1-IIC-A.Details

Original: The Orion is already a challenging opponent, but I heard these late Third Succession War refits from the Free Worlds League were especially dangerous to encounter. It appears they fit a Command Console by removing one ton of each ammo type. However, unless you have the ability to resupply in the field, I would advise conserving ammunition if possible.

Original: The Ostroc carries as its primary weapons two Fuersturm-C Large Lasers in the left and right torsos. These give the Ostroc good medium to long range damage capabilities. The Ostrocs secondary weapons are two Fuersturm-b Medium Lasers also mounted in the side torsos and a Totschlagen SRM-4 launcher in the right torso for close-range combat, with one ton of reloads carried in the center torso. While the Ostroc's laser-heavy weapons payload allows it to operate well as a guerrilla fighter since it has limited dependency on supply lines, its short arms are a handicap in close combat, and the shocks of hand-to-hand fighting can easily damage the Fuersturm systems.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_ostroc_OSR-2C.Details

Original: An experimental model produced by Kong Interstellar for the Free Worlds League in 2793, the 2M variant of the Ostroc focuses on the 'Mech's maneuverability. Five jump jets, two in each leg and one in the rear torso, have been added to the design, giving it a maximum jumping distance of one hundred and fifty meters. In order to make this change, the medium lasers and the SRM-4 launcher were removed. Relatively few of these were built between the League's annexation of Connaught and the factory's destruction.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_ostroc_OSR-2M.Details

Original: The Ostscout was designed as a pure recon BattleMech by Ostmann Industries. To that end, it was built entirely around gathering data and getting out of trouble, tasks for which it is exceptional. The Ostscout is quick enough to escape most traps, and very few other designs can match it in terms of speed and maneuverability. However its ability to run and leap out of danger came at the expense of offensive capability. In fact were it not for aggressive lobbying on the part of its test pilots the final production model would have been completely weaponless. As it is, the Ostcout would be hard-pressed to win a fight against all but the lightest 'Mechs. A poor combatant, the 'Mech excels at operating deep behind enemy lines, gathering as much information as possible about the terrain and the disposition of enemy forces. Besides the Great Houses, ComStar also utilized the Ostscout, and in the aftermath of the Clan Invasion and ComStar Schism began developing a new Ostscout variant for their Com Guards. This new model would maintain the same maneuverability and intelligence-gathering capabilities of the original while improving its offensive and defensive capabilities. Debuting with success in 3064, within the next three years nearly half of all Com Guard Ostscouts had been upgraded to the new variant; however it was soon discovered that both the Lyran Alliance and Word of Blake were fielding their own updated Ostscouts identical to ComStar's. The intelligence leak would be confirmed and traced back to Dag Kesselring, former Precentor of the 66th Division, who passed on information about the program to both the Lyrans and Blakists.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_ostscout_OTT-7J.Details

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 奥斯特侦察由奥斯特曼工业设计为纯侦察战斗机甲。为此它完全围绕收集数据与脱离险境而构建，而它在这两项任务上表现卓越。奥斯特侦察速度快到足以逃出大多数陷阱，几乎没有其他设计能在速度与机动性上与之匹敌。然而它跑得快、跳得远的能力是以攻击力为代价换来的。事实上，若不是测试飞行员积极游说，最终量产型本会完全没有武器。即便如此，奥斯特侦察除了对抗最轻的机甲外，很难赢下任何战斗。作为战斗者它很差，但在敌后深处行动、尽可能收集地形与敌军部署情报方面却极为出色。除各大议院外，康星也使用奥斯特侦察，在氏族入侵与康星分裂之后，他们开始为其康卫开发新的奥斯特侦察变体。新机型将保持原版同样的机动性与情报收集能力，同时提升攻防能力。该型于 3064 年成功亮相，此后三年内近半数康卫奥斯特侦察都升级到了新型号；然而很快发现莱兰联盟与布雷克之言都在装备与康星型号完全相同的自家更新版奥斯特侦察。泄密最终被确认并可追溯到达格·凯塞尔林——第 66 师的前任主祭——他将该计划的信息同时传给了莱兰人与布雷克派。

Original: The Ostscout carries a single Tronel II Medium Laser mounted in its center torso. This weapon, while not extremely powerful, is enough to dissuade most light scout assets from attempting to pursue. The ten heat sinks the 'Mech carries is more than enough to handle the heat output of this single laser - indeed the Ostscout can jump 210 meters and fire laser at the same time without overheating at all. While it is protected by four and a half tons of armor, the real protection for the 'Mech is its speed and maneuverability. A massive sixteen-ton fusion engine more commonly seen in 'Mechs twice its size propels the Ostscout to a cruising speed of 86.4 km/h. Eight jump jets built into the left and right legs give it a maximum jumping distance of 240 meters, rivaling that of the Spider.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_ostscout_OTT-7J.YangsThoughts

While it is protected by four and a half tons of armor, the real protection for the 'Mech is its speed and maneuverability. A massive sixteen-ton fusion engine more commonly seen in 'Mechs twice its size propels the Ostscout to a cruising speed of 86.4 km/h. Eight jump jets built into the left and right legs give it a maximum jumping distance of 240 meters, rivaling that of the Spider.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 东探在中央躯干装有一门"特罗内尔 II"中型激光。这门武器虽不特别强大，却足以劝阻大多数轻型侦察资产不要追击。机甲携带的十台散热器远超处理这单门激光热量所需——事实上东探能一边跳 210 米一边发射激光而完全不过热。虽然它由四吨半装甲保护，但机甲真正的防护是其速度与机动性。一台通常见于两倍体型机甲的巨型十六吨聚变引擎推动东探达到 86.4 公里/小时的巡航速度。装在左右腿的八个跳跃推进器赋予它 240 米的最大跳跃距离，可与蜘蛛相匹敌。
