Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 奥斯特侦察由奥斯特曼工业设计为纯侦察战斗机甲。为此它完全围绕收集数据与脱离险境而构建，而它在这两项任务上表现卓越。奥斯特侦察速度快到足以逃出大多数陷阱，几乎没有其他设计能在速度与机动性上与之匹敌。然而它跑得快、跳得远的能力是以攻击力为代价换来的。事实上，若不是测试飞行员积极游说，最终量产型本会完全没有武器。即便如此，奥斯特侦察除了对抗最轻的机甲外，很难赢下任何战斗。作为战斗者它很差，但在敌后深处行动、尽可能收集地形与敌军部署情报方面却极为出色。除各大议院外，康星也使用奥斯特侦察，在氏族入侵与康星分裂之后，他们开始为其康卫开发新的奥斯特侦察变体。新机型将保持原版同样的机动性与情报收集能力，同时提升攻防能力。该型于 3064 年成功亮相，此后三年内近半数康卫奥斯特侦察都升级到了新型号；然而很快发现莱兰联盟与布雷克之言都在装备与康星型号完全相同的自家更新版奥斯特侦察。泄密最终被确认并可追溯到达格·凯塞尔林——第 66 师的前任主祭——他将该计划的信息同时传给了莱兰人与布雷克派。

Original: The 7K Ostscout was introduced in 3050 and replaces the medium laser with a Garret Mole TAG laser designator, sacrificing its limited offensive capability to allow it to designate targets for Arrow IV artillery missiles. Otherwise, the 7K Ostscout is identical to the 7J model, and while utterly defenseless is still swift enough to escape from most danger.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_ostscout_OTT-7K.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 7K Ostscout was introduced in 3050 and replaces the medium laser with a Garret Mole TAG laser designator, sacrificing its limited offensive capability to allow it to designate targets for Arrow IV artillery missiles. Otherwise, the 7K Ostscout is identical to the 7J model, and while utterly defenseless is still swift enough to escape from most danger.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 7K 东探于 3050 年推出，以"加勒特偃鼠"TAG 激光指示器取代中型激光，牺牲其有限的进攻能力，以换取为箭矢 IV 火炮导弹指示目标的能力。除此之外，7K 东探与 7J 型号完全相同，虽然完全无防御能力，速度却仍足以逃开大多数危险。

Original: Nine tons of armoring is considered decent for a heavy 'Mech, while its fast cruising speed of 54 km/h is thanks to a nineteen-ton Vlar 300 fusion engine. Besides speed though it's the 'Mech's highly-sensitive TRSS.2L3 targeting-tracking system, able to detect enemies over several kilometers in even the most difficult terrain, which makes it a good command platform for scouting missions. Sixteen heat sinks also help manage the heat output of its all-energy weapons payload.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_ostsol_OTL-4D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Nine tons of armoring is considered decent for a heavy 'Mech, while its fast cruising speed of 54 km/h is thanks to a nineteen-ton Vlar 300 fusion engine. Besides speed though it's the 'Mech's highly-sensitive TRSS.2L3 targeting-tracking system, able to detect enemies over several kilometers in even the most difficult terrain, which makes it a good command platform for scouting missions. Sixteen heat sinks also help manage the heat output of its all-energy weapons payload.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对重型机甲而言九吨装甲称得上不错，而 54 公里/小时的快速巡航速度要归功于一台十九吨的 Vlar 300 聚变引擎。不过除速度之外，真正亮点是机甲高度灵敏的 TRSS.2L3 瞄准追踪系统——即便在最困难的地形中也能探测数公里外的敌人，这使它成为侦察任务的优良指挥平台。十六台散热器也有助于管理其全能量武器载荷的热量输出。

Original: The 4F Ostsol introduced in 2871 was the only common variant of the 'Mech pre-Clan Invasion, completely removing the laser weapons and replacing them with two Dominion-V PPCs in the side torsos. The 'Mech is seen as, in some ways at least, a poor man's Marauder or Warhammer, and the PPC array can quickly overload the sixteen heat sinks. Though, on its own merits, the variant is a good long-range direct fire support 'Mech which uses its top speed of 86.4 kph to dictate combat ranges against most heavier 'Mechs.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_ostsol_OTL-4F.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 4F Ostsol introduced in 2871 was the only common variant of the 'Mech pre-Clan Invasion, completely removing the laser weapons and replacing them with two Dominion-V PPCs in the side torsos. The 'Mech is seen as, in some ways at least, a poor man's Marauder or Warhammer, and the PPC array can quickly overload the sixteen heat sinks. Though, on its own merits, the variant is a good long-range direct fire support 'Mech which uses its top speed of 86.4 kph to dictate combat ranges against most heavier 'Mechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 4F 奥斯特索尔于 2871 年推出，是氏族入侵前该机甲唯一常见的变体，它完全移除激光武器，在两侧躯干换成两门"自治领-V"PPC。该机甲在某种程度上被视为穷人版的掠夺者或战锤，而 PPC 阵列会迅速让十六台散热器过载。不过就自身而言，该变体是一款优秀的远程直射支援机甲，能利用 86.4 公里/小时的最高速度对抗大多数更重的机甲来决定交战距离。

Original: The 5M variant of the Ostsol is an upgrade of the design using Star League technology and is built for close-range combat with production starting in 3050. The original engine, heat sinks, and weapons have been stripped from the chassis and replaced with a Hermes 300 XL engine and sixteen double heat sinks. Taking the place of its standard weapons, the 5M Ostsol carries two Tronel XIII Large Pulse Lasers and four Tronel XII Medium Pulse Lasers, two of which remain rear-mounted to discourage attacks against the 'Mech's weak rear armor. Finally, for added protection against missile attacks, the 5M carries a Lindblad Shotgun Anti-Missile System in its right torso with one ton of ammo in the left.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_ostsol_OTL-5M.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5M variant of the Ostsol is an upgrade of the design using Star League technology and is built for close-range combat with production starting in 3050. The original engine, heat sinks, and weapons have been stripped from the chassis and replaced with a Hermes 300 XL engine and sixteen double heat sinks. Taking the place of its standard weapons, the 5M Ostsol carries two Tronel XIII Large Pulse Lasers and four Tronel XII Medium Pulse Lasers, two of which remain rear-mounted to discourage attacks against the 'Mech's weak rear armor. Finally, for added protection against missile attacks, the 5M carries a Lindblad Shotgun Anti-Missile System in its right torso with one ton of ammo in the left.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 奥斯特索尔 5M 变体是使用星盟技术对该设计的升级，专为近程战斗而造，自 3050 年起生产。原有引擎、散热器和武器已从底盘上拆除，换成赫尔墨斯 300 XL 引擎和十六台双倍散热器。5M 奥斯特索尔以两门"特罗内尔 XIII"大型脉冲激光和四门"特罗内尔 XII"中型脉冲激光取代标准武器，其中两门仍为后向安装，以遏制对机甲薄弱后方装甲的攻击。最后，为加强对导弹攻击的防护，5M 在右躯干装一套林德布拉德霰弹反导系统，左躯干配一吨弹药。

Original: An updated version of the primitive Ostwar developed in 2620, this variant carries 12 tons of standard BattleMech armor and a modern cockpit. The chassis has been upgraded to use Endo Steel, while an XL Engine increases the Ostwar's ground speed to 84 kmh. Eighteen double heat sinks dissipate the heat from three ER Large Lasers and twin SRM-6 launchers.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_ostwar_OWR-2MB.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An updated version of the primitive Ostwar developed in 2620, this variant carries 12 tons of standard BattleMech armor and a modern cockpit. The chassis has been upgraded to use Endo Steel, while an XL Engine increases the Ostwar's ground speed to 84 kmh. Eighteen double heat sinks dissipate the heat from three ER Large Lasers and twin SRM-6 launchers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此变体是 2620 年开发的原始奥斯特战争的更新版，携带 12 吨标准战斗机甲装甲和现代驾驶舱。底盘升级为内骨骼，XL 引擎把奥斯特战争的地面速度提升至 84 公里/小时。十八台双倍散热器散发三门 ER 大型激光和双联 SRM-6 发射器的热量。

Original: The Owens is intended to be an OmniMech upgrade of the Jenner BattleMech. The intended role for the Owens is as a cavalry 'Mech that can move along the enemy lines and designate targets for bombardment with Arrow IV artillery attacks. The Owens is a strong spotting unit as well as a point 'Mech for C3 lances with its permanently mounted TAG laser designator, Beagle Probe and C3 Slave unit.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_owens_OW-1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Owens is intended to be an OmniMech upgrade of the Jenner BattleMech. The intended role for the Owens is as a cavalry 'Mech that can move along the enemy lines and designate targets for bombardment with Arrow IV artillery attacks. The Owens is a strong spotting unit as well as a point 'Mech for C3 lances with its permanently mounted TAG laser designator, Beagle Probe and C3 Slave unit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 欧文斯旨在作为詹纳战斗机甲的全能机甲升级型。其定位是骑兵机甲，可沿敌方战线机动并为我方箭矢 IV 炮击标记目标。凭借固定安装的 TAG 激光指示器、比格犬探测器与 C3 从属单元，欧文斯既是优秀的侦察单位，也是 C3 小队的先锋机甲。

Original: The 10K Panther is a high tech upgrade of the 9R model introduced by Wakazashi Enterprises. The chassis has been rebuilt using Endo Steel construction techniques and the saved weight used to add an Artemis IV fire control system to the missile launcher, as well as upgrading the PPC to a Lord's Light 2 ER PPC. Since its introduction the 10K has gone on to replace the 9R as the most common model employed by the DCMS.

Original: The Perseus is the product of a program begun by the League Central Coordination and Command to create an OmniMech completely indigenous to the Free Worlds League from concept to production. The Perseus shares much with the venerable Orion, a staple of Free Worlds League Military, both broadly resembling the older design visually and using a number of the same components. This similarity prompted more than a few FWLM technicians to nickname the new design the Omni-Orion and the deployment of Perseus has largely been to front-line units that fielded large concentrations of its progenitor, replacing older Orions on a one-for-one basis. Built on a lightweight Endo Steel chassis, the Perseus is powered by a Hermes 300 XL engine helping save even more weight and giving the 'Mech a top speed of 64.8 km/h. The advanced structure and engine save a great deal of weight for weapons and equipment. The Perseus is protected by fourteen tons of Valiant Lamellor armor, giving it around average armor protection for a 'Mech of its size. It also has twelve double heat sinks that are fixed on the chassis.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_perseus_P1-A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Perseus is the product of a program begun by the League Central Coordination and Command to create an OmniMech completely indigenous to the Free Worlds League from concept to production. The advanced structure and engine save a great deal of weight for weapons and equipment. The Perseus is protected by fourteen tons of Valiant Lamellor armor, giving it around average armor protection for a 'Mech of its size. It also has twelve double heat sinks that are fixed on the chassis.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 珀尔修斯是联盟中央协调与指挥部发起的一项计划的产物，旨在从概念到生产打造一款完全属于自由世界联盟的全能机甲。珀尔修斯与备受尊崇的猎户座共享诸多特征——后者是自由世界联盟军队的中坚，两者不仅外观上大体相似，还使用了若干相同部件。这种相似让不少联盟军技师将新设计戏称为"全能猎户座"，而珀尔修斯的部署也主要面向那些大量装备其前身的精锐部队，一对一替换老旧猎户座。珀尔修斯采用轻量化内骨骼底盘，由赫尔墨斯 300 XL 引擎驱动，进一步节省重量，最高速度 64.8 公里/小时。先进的结构与引擎为武器和装备腾出大量重量。它以十四吨英勇拉梅洛装甲防护，装甲水平约为此尺寸机甲的平均值。它还固定配备十二台双倍散热器。

Original: Configured for long range fire support, the A configuration carries a pair of LRM-20 launchers in its arm, both of which are linked to an Artemis IV FCS for increased accuracy. For close range defense, the 'Mech carries two Medium Pulse Lasers and has an SRM-6 launcher linked to an Artemis IV FCS. The 'Mech also has a leg-mounted TAG laser designator, allowing it to call in Semi-Guided LRM and Arrow IV attacks from friendly units and has an ECM Suite to defend itself from enemy electronic warfare systems.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_perseus_P1-A.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Configured for long range fire support, the A configuration carries a pair of LRM-20 launchers in its arm, both of which are linked to an Artemis IV FCS for increased accuracy. For close range defense, the 'Mech carries two Medium Pulse Lasers and has an SRM-6 launcher linked to an Artemis IV FCS. The 'Mech also has a leg-mounted TAG laser designator, allowing it to call in Semi-Guided LRM and Arrow IV attacks from friendly units and has an ECM Suite to defend itself from enemy electronic warfare systems.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: A 配置为远程火力支援而设，臂部装一对 LRM-20 发射器，均联接 Artemis IV 火控系统以提升精度。近程防御方面，机甲携带两门中型脉冲激光和一具联接 Artemis IV 火控系统的 SRM-6 发射器。机甲还有一具装在腿部的 TAG 激光指示器，使其能召唤友军单位的半制导 LRM 和箭矢 IV 攻击，并有一套 ECM 套件防御敌方电子战系统。

Original: The Perseus is the product of a program begun by the League Central Coordination and Command to create an OmniMech completely indigenous to the Free Worlds League from concept to production. The Perseus shares much with the venerable Orion, a staple of Free Worlds League Military, both broadly resembling the older design visually and using a number of the same components. This similarity prompted more than a few FWLM technicians to nickname the new design the Omni-Orion and the deployment of Perseus has largely been to front-line units that fielded large concentrations of its progenitor, replacing older Orions on a one-for-one basis. Built on a lightweight Endo Steel chassis, the Perseus is powered by a Hermes 300 XL engine helping save even more weight and giving the 'Mech a top speed of 64.8 km/h. The advanced structure and engine save a great deal of weight for weapons and equipment. The Perseus is protected by fourteen tons of Valiant Lamellor armor, giving it around average armor protection for a 'Mech of its size. It also has twelve double heat sinks that are fixed on the chassis.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_perseus_P1-B.Details

Original: The Phoenix Hawk LAM was the largest Land-Air 'Mech produced during the Star League. Allied Aerospace reworked their designs for conversion equipment and the size of the LAM, learning from their mistake with the Shadow Hawk LAM and the success of the Stinger LAM. The resulting LAM was the largest LAM ever constructed capable of remaining in AirMech mode. Unfortunately, large Land-Air 'Mech conversion technology was not fully researched before the fall of the Star League, and the Phoenix Hawk LAM frequently met its end due to the occasional glitch. The end of the Star League and destruction of the Allied Aerospace facilities at the beginning of the First Succession War prevented further development and refinement.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_phoenixhawklam_PXH-HK2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Phoenix Hawk LAM was the largest Land-Air 'Mech produced during the Star League. Allied Aerospace reworked their designs for conversion equipment and the size of the LAM, learning from their mistake with the Shadow Hawk LAM and the success of the Stinger LAM. Unfortunately, large Land-Air 'Mech conversion technology was not fully researched before the fall of the Star League, and the Phoenix Hawk LAM frequently met its end due to the occasional glitch. The end of the Star League and destruction of the Allied Aerospace facilities at the beginning of the First Succession War prevented further development and refinement.

Original: First introduced by the Terran Hegemony in 2568, the Phoenix Hawk is one of the most well known BattleMechs in the Inner Sphere. The 'Mech began life when Orguss Industries realized that it could reinforce the Stinger chassis to create a larger version, one with the same speed and maneuverability as the Stinger but with superior armor, firepower and electronics. Though not without its own drawbacks, the Phoenix Hawk is still the standard by which all other reconnaissance 'Mechs are measured.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_phoenixhawk_PXH-1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凤凰鹰由地球霸权于 2568 年首次推出，是内天体最知名的战斗机甲之一。这台机甲的诞生始于奥古斯工业意识到它可以强化毒刺底盘造出更大版本——一个与毒刺速度与机动性相同，但拥有更优装甲、火力与电子设备的型号。尽管并非毫无缺点，凤凰鹰至今仍是衡量所有其他侦察机甲的标准。

Original: After the destruction of their main production line in 2928, Solaris 7 based Blue Shot Weapons looked for other means of income. They took the idea behind the STR-3G Stinger variant and created a similar variant of the Phoenix Hawk by adding a second Large Laser in the left arm. To free up the necessary weight the PXH-1GS removes the Medium Lasers and Machine Guns and sacrifices some speed & maneuverability, but also adds 3 Heat Sinks and two Small Lasers. Both the primary lasers are mounted in gunpods giving the variant its "Gunslinger" nickname.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_phoenixhawk_PXH-1GS.Details

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在 2928 年主生产线被毁后，驻扎索拉里斯 7 的蓝射武器公司寻找其他收入来源。他们借鉴 STR-3G 毒刺变体的思路，通过在左臂加装第二门大型激光，为凤凰鹰打造了类似变体。为腾出所需重量，PXH-1GS 移除中型激光和机枪，并牺牲部分速度与机动性，但也增加 3 台散热器和两门小型激光。两门主激光都装在枪袋中，为该变体赢得了"枪手"的绰号。

Original: Sacrificing speed on the battlefield is usually a bad idea.  The Gunslinger is still plenty fast for the confines of the Solaris arenas, and can dish out a good amount of damage with its two large lasers.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在战场上牺牲速度通常是个坏主意。"枪手"对索拉里斯竞技场的封闭空间而言仍然足够快，并可用两门大型激光造成可观的伤害。

The machine guns and ammunition have also been removed from the design and replaced with a single Small Laser carried in the center torso.

Original: The Phoenix Hawk 2L is compete overhaul designed to be compatible with the myriad PXH-1 variants found throughout the Periphery, upgrading them to a standard beyond the PXH-2. An endo-steel chassis means that an ER large laser and heat sinks can be mounted whilst the machineguns are sacrificed in favour of Guardian ECM. Available for export throughout the Periphery, the only constraint to production is the lack of a production facility for the PXH chassis, though Alliance Mech Works has plans to build a dedicated PHX line should the design prove popular. Until then the current output is limited to in-situ conversions of existing mechs and the restoration of battlefield salvage.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_phoenixhawk_PXH-2L.Details

Original: Like all PXH-3 models, the 3D is an upgraded Phoenix Hawk using rediscovered technology. By upgrading Davion's favorite 1D variant with an Endo-Steel chassis and XL engine, Davion scouts can cram quite a lot of firepower into their scout 'Mechs. To sustain the extra laser firepower the design replaces all single heat sinks with doubles, further improving upon the cooling upgrades from its parent variant. Whilst it lacks the Ferro-Fibrous armor of its Kuritan counterpart, the design does make room for an AMS system, allowing it to dive behind cover without having to worry about indirect fire.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_phoenixhawk_PXH-3D.Details

To sustain the extra laser firepower the design replaces all single heat sinks with doubles, further improving upon the cooling upgrades from its parent variant. Whilst it lacks the Ferro-Fibrous armor of its Kuritan counterpart, the design does make room for an AMS system, allowing it to dive behind cover without having to worry about indirect fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 与所有 PXH-3 型号一样，3D 是使用重新发现技术的凤凰鹰升级版。通过给达维昂最爱的 1D 变体升级内骨骼底盘和 XL 引擎，达维昂侦察兵能在侦察机甲中塞进相当多的火力。为支撑额外的激光火力，该设计把所有单散热器换成双倍散热器，在母变体的散热升级基础上更进一步。虽然缺少其库瑞塔对应型的铁纤维装甲，该设计却腾出空间装了一套 AMS 系统，使它能躲到掩体后而不必担心间接火力。

Original: The 3K Phoenix Hawk is another upgrade of the design that uses rediscovered technologies. Inspired by the 1K variant, the 3K uses an XL engine to upgrade the firepower to Medium Pulse and ER Large Lasers as well as reintroducing House Kurita to jump jets. Taking the 1K's additional heat sinks and upgrading those to doubles alongisde an Ferro-Fibrous armor upgrade means that the 'Mech can stay in the fight for longer, though it remains a scout at heart. It is notably the only PXH-3 variant that does not include AMS.

Taking the 1K's additional heat sinks and upgrading those to doubles alongisde an Ferro-Fibrous armor upgrade means that the 'Mech can stay in the fight for longer, though it remains a scout at heart. It is notably the only PXH-3 variant that does not include AMS.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3K 凤凰鹰是该设计又一次使用重新发现技术的升级。受 1K 变体启发，3K 用 XL 引擎把火力升级为中型脉冲激光和 ER 大型激光，也把跳跃推进器重新带回库瑞塔家族。它继承 1K 的额外散热器并升级为双倍，同时升级铁纤维装甲，意味着机甲能在战斗中坚持更久——尽管它本质上仍是侦察机甲。值得注意的是，它是唯一不含 AMS 的 PXH-3 变体。

Original: The 3M variant of the Phoenix Hawk was introduced in 3048 alongside everyone else's attempt to upgrade the 'Mech with LosTech, built by Earthwerks Incorporated from their Keystone factory. Endo-Steel, double heat sinks and an XL engine allow the design to carry ER Large Lasers and Medium Pulse Lasers. The 'Mech retains a machinegun from the original design, whilst the other is replaced with an Anti Missile System. This gives it slightly more firepower then its Kuritan and Davion brethren, at the cost of fewer heat sinks and slightly worse armor.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_phoenixhawk_PXH-3M.Details

The 'Mech retains a machinegun from the original design, whilst the other is replaced with an Anti Missile System. Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凤凰鹰 3M 变体于 3048 年推出，与各方用失传技术升级该机甲的尝试同期，由地球工厂公司在其基斯通工厂生产。内骨骼、双倍散热器和 XL 引擎使该设计得以携带 ER 大型激光与中型脉冲激光。机甲保留原设计的一挺机枪，另一挺换成反导系统。这使它的火力略强于库瑞塔与达维昂的同门，代价是散热器更少、装甲略差。

Original: The 3S model of this 'Mech, first deployed in 3042, is another upgrade using rediscovered technology that attempts to make the Phoenix Hawk even more effective for reconnaissance. The engine is upgraded to an ExtraLight version and double heat sinks improve heat management. The armor has both been strengthened and replaced with the lighter Ferro Fibrous armor. A large pulse laser adds extra firepower, though it still retains the two medium lasers and machine guns of the original. Additionally an anti-missile system is mounted on the right arm, with CASE protection for its ammo. Its primary difference from other variants is the addition of a MASC system, which allows the 'Mech to reach higher speeds in short bursts.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_phoenixhawk_PXH-3S.Details

Original: The PXH-1b, or Phoenix Hawk 'Special' is a Star League model that manages to be far scarier then even the PHX-3 variants that were introduced not so long ago. Beyond the Endo-Steel chassis and ExtraLight engine that is now more commonly found across the Inner Sphere, the 1b sports a Guardian ECM system and IFF jammer. Its large laser has been upgraded to an ER variant, but on top of its original weaponry the SLDF somehow managed to get an ER PPC in there as well.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_phoenix_hawk_PXH-1b.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The PXH-1b, or Phoenix Hawk 'Special' is a Star League model that manages to be far scarier then even the PHX-3 variants that were introduced not so long ago. Beyond the Endo-Steel chassis and ExtraLight engine that is now more commonly found across the Inner Sphere, the 1b sports a Guardian ECM system and IFF jammer. Its large laser has been upgraded to an ER variant, but on top of its original weaponry the SLDF somehow managed to get an ER PPC in there as well.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: PXH-1b，即凤凰鹰"特种"，是一款星盟型号，比不久前推出的 PHX-3 变体还要可怕得多。除内骨骼底盘和如今在内天体更常见的超轻型引擎之外，1b 还装有守护者 ECM 系统和 IFF 干扰器。它的大型激光已升级为 ER 版本，而在原有武器之上，星盟防卫军不知怎的还设法塞进了一门 ER PPC。

Original: A classic for a reason. Very mobile with good punch for it's tonnage. New pilots need to be careful not to overheat though.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_phoenix_hawk_PXH-1b.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A classic for a reason! Very mobile with good punch for it's tonnage. New pilots need to be careful not to overheat though.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 经典自有其道理！机动性极佳，就其吨位而言打击力也不错。不过新手飞行员要小心别过热。

Original: The Phoenix Hawk Special! This upgraded model of the scout 'Mech represents the peak of Star League technology, still being tested when the Exodus happened. Contrasted to the already spectacular 1b, this variant uses an experimental snub nose PPC to bring the weight down for additional armour, making it the most heavily armoured variant of the Phoenix Hawk that I know of. Just like the 1b it carries a full ECM suite.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_phoenix_hawk_PXH-1c.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Phoenix Hawk Special! This upgraded model of the scout 'Mech represents the peak of Star League technology, still being tested when the Exodus happened. Contrasted to the already spectacular 1b, this variant uses an experimental snub nose PPC to bring the weight down for additional armour, making it the most heavily armoured variant of the Phoenix Hawk that I know of. Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凤凰鹰"特种"！这款侦察机甲的升级型号代表星盟技术的巅峰，在出埃及发生时仍在测试中。与已经出色的 1b 相比，此变体使用一门实验性短管 PPC 以降低重量换取额外装甲，使其成为我所知装甲最厚重的凤凰鹰变体。与 1b 一样，它携带全套 ECM 套件。

Original: A classic for a reason. Very mobile with good punch for it's tonnage. New pilots need to be careful not to overheat though.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_phoenix_hawk_PXH-1c.YangsThoughts

Original: The Piranha was developed by Clan Diamond Shark to combat conventional infantry and light vehicles. The sheer speed that the BattleMech is capable of has also made it something of a scout, though it lacks sophisticated electronic equipment. The Piranha is protected mostly by its speed.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_Piranha.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Piranha was developed by Clan Diamond Shark to combat conventional infantry and light vehicles. The sheer speed that the BattleMech is capable of has also made it something of a scout, though it lacks sophisticated electronic equipment. The Piranha is protected mostly by its speed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 食人鱼由钻石鲨氏族开发，用于对抗常规步兵和轻型车辆。这台战斗机甲所能达到的纯粹速度也使它多少充当侦察兵，尽管它缺乏精密电子设备。食人鱼主要靠速度自保。

Original: The Piranha's main threat is its twelve Series XII Rotary Machine Guns. These are a serious threat to any foe on such a speedy 'Mech, especially if a Star of Piranhas operate in a pack, and such a large array allows the 'Mech to chew through an opponent's rear armor almost instantly. They are most deadly, however, to unarmored infantry, capable of wiping out an entire company in seconds. For work against hardened targets, the Piranha mounts a pair of Mk. 3 ER Medium Lasers and a single Series 1 ER Small Laser. Since the design only uses ten single heat sinks, the MechWarrior must still manage heat levels. The ammunition dependency of the Machine Guns ensure that Piranhas must stay close to supply lines, so most have been relegated to solahma or garrison roles.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_piranha_PIR-1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Piranha's main threat is its twelve Series XII Rotary Machine Guns. These are a serious threat to any foe on such a speedy 'Mech, especially if a Star of Piranhas operate in a pack, and such a large array allows the 'Mech to chew through an opponent's rear armor almost instantly. They are most deadly, however, to unarmored infantry, capable of wiping out an entire company in seconds. For work against hardened targets, the Piranha mounts a pair of Mk. 3 ER Medium Lasers and a single Series 1 ER Small Laser. Since the design only uses ten single heat sinks, the MechWarrior must still manage heat levels. The ammunition dependency of the Machine Guns ensure that Piranhas must stay close to supply lines, so most have been relegated to solahma or garrison roles.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 食人鱼的主要威胁是它的十二挺 XII 系列旋转机枪。在一台如此快速的机甲上，这对任何敌人都是严重威胁，尤其当一个"星"的食人鱼成群作战时；如此庞大的阵列让机甲几乎瞬间啃穿对手的背部装甲。不过它们对无装甲步兵最为致命，能在数秒内歼灭一整连。对付硬化目标时，食人鱼装有双联 Mk. 3 ER 中型激光和一门 1 系列 ER 小型激光。由于该设计仅使用十台单散热器，机甲战士仍须管理热量水平。机枪对弹药的依赖使食人鱼必须靠近补给线，因此大多数被降级到索拉马或驻防任务。

Original: Quickdraw 4Gs are among the fastest and most maneuverable of heavy 'Mechs, with decent weaponry. They suffer from problematic heat buildup when using all their features at once, so some caution is needed.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_quickdraw_QKD-4G.Details

Original: The 5K Quickdraw is an upgraded variant using Star League technology produced by Luthien Armor Works in 3049. Carrying the same weaponry as the 5A model, its use of seventeen double heat sinks solves the problem of excessive waste heat. It also uses Ferro-Fibrous armor, giving the 5K superior armor protection to the 5A model, with no added weight.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_quickdraw_QKD-5K.Details

Original: The Rakshasa was designed by engineers at the New Avalon Institute of Science in an attempt to copy the Mad Cat. The finished product, while not as powerful as the OmniMech it emulates, is a powerful 'Mech with an undeserved bad reputation. The Rakshasa is powered by a GM 375 XL engine and built on a GM Marauder Special MD Endo Steel chassis to save weight and allow the 'Mech to carry as similar a weapons payload as possible to the Mad Cat.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_rakshasa_MDG-1A.Details

Original: Loaded with advanced electronic equipment, the D configuration carries a TAG laser designator, a Beagle Active Probe, and a C3 Slave unit. The Raptor D is armed with a short-range arsenal of three Streak SRM-2 launchers and two Small Lasers. To deter infantry attacks, the D configuration has two Machine Guns. The combination of a Beagle Active Probe with TAG and a C3 slave make the Raptor D an excellent point 'Mech for light C3 lances, since it is able to share targeting information with allied units and also find hidden units and designate them for highly accurate artillery fire.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_raptor_RTX1-OD.Details

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: D 配置装载先进电子设备，携带 TAG 激光指示器、比格犬主动探测器和一台 C3 从属单元。猛禽 D 以三具连续 SRM-2 发射器和两门小型激光构成近程武器库。为威慑步兵攻击，D 配置有两挺机枪。比格犬主动探测器加 TAG 与 C3 从属单元的组合，使猛禽 D 成为轻型 C3 小队的优秀先锋机甲，因为它能与友军共享瞄准信息，也能发现隐藏单位并为高精度炮火标记它们。

Original: The Rifleman II was an upgrade fielded by the SLDF Royals in 2720, adding twenty tons to its overall mass. The Rifleman II used an Endo Steel structure and an XL Engine, and carried a pair of LB-X Autocannon/10s and Large Pulse Lasers, one in each arm, as well as a pair of Medium Lasers, a Beagle Active Probe, and fourteen Double Heat Sinks.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 步枪手 II 是星盟防卫军皇家部队于 2720 年装备的升级型，整体质量增加二十吨。步枪手 II 采用内骨骼结构和 XL 引擎，每臂各携带一门 LB-X 自动炮/10 和一门大型脉冲激光，另有两门中型激光、一具比格犬主动探测器和十四台双倍散热器。

It replaced the autocannon/5s with PPCs and removed the medium lasers, using the freed-up weight to mount an five extra heat sinks. In spite of the extra heat sinks, this model suffered from significant overheat problems.

Original: A modern Clan take on the classic Succession Wars era RFL-3N Rifleman, the A variant carries a Large Pulse Laser and Ultra Autocannon/5 in each arm, supported by an ER Medium Laser in each side torso. Built around a 260-rated XL Engine, Endo Steel frame, and ten tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, the A is fitted with sixteen Double Heat Sinks and four tons of UAC ammo.

Original: A militarized BattleMech version of Achernar's Loader King IndustrialMech, the Roughneck is a low-cost heavy 'Mech intended for price conscious buyers such as planetary militias and down-on-their-luck mercenary units. Featuring a mixed if short ranged weapons loadout, the Roughneck's primary weapons are an AC/10 and SRM-4 in its torsos, supported by a trio of Machine Guns and a head-mounted Small Laser. While tying it to supply lines, two tons of SRM and autocannon rounds provide adequate field endurance, only a ton and a half of rounds supporting three machine guns run dry quickly.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_roughneck_RGH-1A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A militarized BattleMech version of Achernar's Loader King IndustrialMech, the Roughneck is a low-cost heavy 'Mech intended for price conscious buyers such as planetary militias and down-on-their-luck mercenary units. Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 粗汉是阿克尔纳装载之王工业机甲的军用战斗机甲版本，是一款低成本重型机甲，面向精打细算的买家，如行星民兵和落魄的佣兵部队。它的武器配置杂糅而偏近程，主武器是躯干上的 AC/10 和 SRM-4，辅以三挺机枪和头部一门小型激光。虽然这让它依赖补给线，但两吨 SRM 与自动炮弹药提供了足够的野战续航，仅有一吨半弹药支撑三挺机枪，很快就打光。

Original: The Sentry was developed under pressure from the Draconis and Capellan marches for a more advanced 'Mech to defend the borders of the Federated Suns. The 'Mech is built on a light weight Dorwinion hyperactive 3 Endo Steel chassis. This chassis saves weight, allowing the 'Mech to carry heavier weapons and equipment. The Sentry is powered by a Nissan 200 fusion engine that gives it a top speed of 86.4 km/h that is augmented by five HildCo Model 12 jump jets that make it possible for the Sentry to jump up to one hundred and fifty meters. To compensate for its less than average mobility, the Sentry has an impressive eight and a half tons of Starshield A armor that has been fitted with CASE to protect the 'Mech from an ammunition explosion.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_sentry_SNT-04.Details

To compensate for its less than average mobility, the Sentry has an impressive eight and a half tons of Starshield A armor that has been fitted with CASE to protect the 'Mech from an ammunition explosion.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 哨兵是在德拉科尼斯与卡佩兰边疆区压力下开发的，旨在为保卫联邦太阳系边境提供一款更先进的机甲。机甲基于轻量化的"多温尼恩亢奋 3"内骨骼底盘建造。这一底盘节省重量，使机甲能携带更重的武器和装备。哨兵由一台日产 200 聚变引擎驱动，最高速度 86.4 公里/小时，并由五个希尔德科 12 型跳跃推进器增强，使哨兵能跳起至一百五十米。为弥补其低于平均的机动性，哨兵拥有令人印象深刻的八吨半"星盾 A"装甲，并加装 C.A.S.E. 以保护机甲免受弹药爆炸。

Original: The Sentry has a diverse mix of weapons that allow it to carry out a wide variety of missions. For anti-'Mech and vehicle combat the Sentry carries a Parti-Kill PPC and a pair of Magna 200P Small Pulse Lasers which can double as anti-infantry weapons. For anti-infantry and crowd control missions, the Sentry has a quartet of Sperry Browning Machine Guns and a Zippo Flamer.

Original: The original and considerably flawed prototypes were completed in 2680. Based on the Shadow Hawk SHD-2H, the 'Mech carried a Class 2 Autocannon in place of the Class 5. The SHD-X1 carried only 6.5 tons of armor for protection. Only one chassis survived multiple crashes caused by its faulty schematics. It had a top ground speed of 86.4 km/h like its progenitor, the SHD-2H, and used ten single heat sinks.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_shadowhawklam_SHD-X1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original and considerably flawed prototypes were completed in 2680. Based on the Shadow Hawk SHD-2H, the 'Mech carried a Class 2 Autocannon in place of the Class 5. The SHD-X1 carried only 6.5 tons of armor for protection. Only one chassis survived multiple crashes caused by its faulty schematics. It had a top ground speed of 86.4 km/h like its progenitor, the SHD-2H, and used ten single heat sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初且缺陷颇多的原型机于 2680 年完成。以影鹰 SHD-2H 为基础，该机甲以一门 2 级自动炮取代 5 级。SHD-X1 仅有 6.5 吨装甲用于防护。因其图纸错误导致多次坠机，仅有一台机体幸存。它的最高地面速度与前辈 SHD-2H 相同，为 86.4 公里/小时，并使用十台单散热器。

Original: Allied Aerospace won the SLDF's contract to produce a series of Land-Air mechs with a design based on the venerable Shadow HawkBattleMech. Allied gave their new Land-Air 'Mech the ability to convert directly into an Aerospace Fighter. While construction was completed in 2680, thanks to the chassis' numerous flaws, lackluster performance and a number of ill-fated and publicly witnessed test-flights disasters during SLDF reviews in 2682, Allied Aerospace was forced to go back to the drawing board. The more refined X2 variant faced considerable scrutiny by SLDF evaluators in 2684, successfully meeting the SLDF's requirements but still rejected thanks to its high fuel consumption and the bad press generated by the earlier X1. Twenty SHD-X2 were built for trials with potential customers, but failed to attract any interest. Ultimately Allied scrapped the Shadow Hawk LAM program in favor of what became the considerably more successful Phoenix Hawk LAM.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_shadowhawklam_SHD-X2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Allied Aerospace won the SLDF's contract to produce a series of Land-Air mechs with a design based on the venerable Shadow HawkBattleMech. Allied gave their new Land-Air 'Mech the ability to convert directly into an Aerospace Fighter. While construction was completed in 2680, thanks to the chassis' numerous flaws, lackluster performance and a number of ill-fated and publicly witnessed test-flights disasters during SLDF reviews in 2682, Allied Aerospace was forced to go back to the drawing board. The more refined X2 variant faced considerable scrutiny by SLDF evaluators in 2684, successfully meeting the SLDF's requirements but still rejected thanks to its high fuel consumption and the bad press generated by the earlier X1. Twenty SHD-X2 were built for trials with potential customers, but failed to attract any interest. Ultimately Allied scrapped the Shadow Hawk LAM program in favor of what became the considerably more successful Phoenix Hawk LAM.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 联合航空赢得星盟防卫军生产一系列陆空机甲的合同，设计以古老的影鹰战斗机甲为基础。联合航空让新型陆空机甲能直接变身为航空战斗机。虽然制造于 2680 年完成，但由于底盘缺陷众多、性能不佳，加上 2682 年星盟防卫军评审期间一系列不幸且公开可见的试飞灾难，联合航空被迫重头再来。更精细的 X2 变体于 2684 年接受了星盟评审员的严格审查，虽然成功满足星盟要求，却仍因高燃料消耗和早期 X1 造成的负面报道而被否决。二十台 SHD-X2 被造出来供潜在客户试用，却未能引起任何兴趣。最终联合航空放弃了影鹰 LAM 项目，转而投向后来相当成功的凤凰鹰 LAM。

Original: First introduced in 2467, this first generation of the Shadow Hawk employs early BattleMech technology in its weaponry, equipment and its armor. This design was first produced by Lang Industries on Caph, where it was designed as part of the Hegemony's efforts to keep ahead of the Inner Sphere's newly stolen BattleMech technology.

Original: The 5M Shadow Hawk is the first complete overhaul and upgrade of the design, unveiled in 3048 by Earthwerks for the Free Worlds League. The chassis has been upgraded to an Earthwerks SHD II Endo Steel frame, an additional ton of armor was added, two additional jump jets were fitted for a total jumping distance of 150 meters, the engine replaced with an extralight version of the Hermes 275, and the weapons load has undergone an almost complete renovation. The original autocannon has been updated to an Imperator Ultra Autocannon/5, the LRM launcher to a Doombud LRM-20, and the head-mounted SRM launcher to a Hovertec Streak SRM-2. The amount of ammunition carried and the left-arm medium laser are maintained, and while the number of heat sinks was reduced to ten these were upgrade to double-strength models.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_shadowhawk_SHD-5M.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5M Shadow Hawk is the first complete overhaul and upgrade of the design, unveiled in 3048 by Earthwerks for the Free Worlds League. The chassis has been upgraded to an Earthwerks SHD II Endo Steel frame, an additional ton of armor was added, two additional jump jets were fitted for a total jumping distance of 150 meters, the engine replaced with an extralight version of the Hermes 275, and the weapons load has undergone an almost complete renovation. The original autocannon has been updated to an Imperator Ultra Autocannon/5, the LRM launcher to a Doombud LRM-20, and the head-mounted SRM launcher to a Hovertec Streak SRM-2. The amount of ammunition carried and the left-arm medium laser are maintained, and while the number of heat sinks was reduced to ten these were upgrade to double-strength models.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5M 影鹰是该设计的首次彻底翻修与升级，由地球工厂于 3048 年为自由世界联盟推出。底盘升级为地球工厂 SHD II 内骨骼框架，增加一吨装甲，加装两个跳跃推进器使总跳跃距离达 150 米，引擎换成赫尔墨斯 275 的超轻型版本，武器配置几乎全面翻新。原始自动炮升级为帝皇超速自动炮/5，LRM 发射器换为末日芽 LRM-20，头部 SRM 发射器换为霍弗泰克连续 SRM-2。弹药携带量与左臂中型激光保持不变，散热器数量虽减至十台但升级为双倍强度型号。

Original: Created by Maverick Industries, the 5MI is a redesign of House Marik’s 5M model. Designed to compete with the Griffin 1DS and other new designs, the 5MI was Mavericks attempt to win over the recalcitrant FedCom military. Focusing on improving survivability and battlefield endurance, the 5MI used new technology like DHS and an Artemis IV FSC to give it an edge. Unfortunately the design was deemed to expensive too produce and as a result the military declined to purchase any of the initial production run. Such poor performance led to the second manufacturing run being cancelled and resources diverted to more promising lines. The surviving models were sold off to various mercenary groups, though the Maverick Industries scion would use one during her time in the 10th Lyran Guards; netting the company the occasional conversion or custom order from fellow members of the regiment.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_shadowhawk_SHD-5MI.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Created by Maverick Industries, the 5MI is a redesign of House Marik’s 5M model. Designed to compete with the Griffin 1DS and other new designs, the 5MI was Mavericks attempt to win over the recalcitrant FedCom military. Focusing on improving survivability and battlefield endurance, the 5MI used new technology like DHS and an Artemis IV FSC to give it an edge. Unfortunately the design was deemed to expensive too produce and as a result the military declined to purchase any of the initial production run. Such poor performance led to the second manufacturing run being cancelled and resources diverted to more promising lines. The surviving models were sold off to various mercenary groups, though the Maverick Industries scion would use one during her time in the 10th Lyran Guards; netting the company the occasional conversion or custom order from fellow members of the regiment.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5MI 由马弗里克工业打造，是马里克家族 5M 型号的重新设计。为与狮鹫 1DS 及其他新设计竞争，马弗里克试图借此赢得固执的联邦联邦军方青睐。5MI 聚焦于提升生存性与战场续航，采用 DHS 与 Artemis IV 火控系统等新技术以获得优势。遗憾的是该设计被认为生产成本过高，军方因此拒绝采购首批量产的任何一台。如此糟糕的表现导致第二轮生产被取消，资源被转投更有前途的生产线。幸存的型号被卖给各佣兵团，不过马弗里克工业的继承人在第 10 莱兰卫队服役期间使用过一台，为公司从团队袍泽那里赢得了零星的改装或定制订单。

Original: The Shootist first saw service in 2621 as a heavily armored, electronic warfare-capable command 'Mech for SLDF Royal BattleMech Regiments. However, the Shootist's upgraded electronic suites proved no match for the cutting edge of electronic warfare of its own time. When the BattleMaster eclipsed the Shootist in its intended role as a command vehicle merely ten years after its introduction, the SLDF changed the Shootist's mission parameters. The Shootist's balanced mix of weapons and speed, and its heavy armor allowed it a new role: juggernaut for close-combat heavy lances, and later, a bodyguard unit for command lances. This role never proved favorable to the longevity of the Shootist; since the Succession Wars, this BattleMech is rarely seen outside of the ComGuards, Word of Blake Militia, and ancient Clan Brian Caches.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_shootist_ST-8A.Details

This role never proved favorable to the longevity of the Shootist; since the Succession Wars, this BattleMech is rarely seen outside of the ComGuards, Word of Blake Militia, and ancient Clan Brian Caches.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 射击手于 2621 年首次服役，作为星盟防卫军皇家战斗机甲团的重视装甲、具备电子战能力的指挥机甲。然而射击手升级后的电子套件被证明敌不过同代最前沿的电子战。当战将在射击手推出仅十年后就在其预定的指挥车辆角色上超越它时，星盟防卫军改变了射击手的任务参数。射击手均衡的武器与速度搭配以及厚重装甲让它获得了新角色：近战重型小队的主宰者，后来又成为指挥小队的护卫单位。这一角色从未有利于射击手的长久存续；自继承战争以来，这台战斗机甲在康卫、布雷克之言民兵和古老的氏族布莱恩仓库之外已很少见到。

Original: The Shootist has a top speed of 64.8 km/h, giving it an average level of mobility for a heavy 'Mech. The 'Mech has thirteen double heat sinks that allow the Shootist to dissipate the waste heat that is produced by its heavy weapons payload. The Shootist carries twelve tons of MV Ferro-Fibrous armor with CASE to protect the 'Mech in the event of an ammunition explosion. The Shootist is armed to engage an enemy at various ranges. The only long-range weapon on the 'Mech is a Blankenburg ER Large Laser that has an effective range of five hundred and seventy meters. For medium to close range combat, the Shootist carries a devastating Deathgiver Autocannon/20 which is capable of downing most light and even some medium 'Mechs in a single salvo. Finally, for point blank defense, the 'Mech has two Blankenburg Medium Pulse Lasers and a Dinatech Mark III Small Laser.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_shootist_ST-8A.YangsThoughts

The only long-range weapon on the 'Mech is a Blankenburg ER Large Laser that has an effective range of five hundred and seventy meters. For medium to close range combat, the Shootist carries a devastating Deathgiver Autocannon/20 which is capable of downing most light and even some medium 'Mechs in a single salvo. Finally, for point blank defense, the 'Mech has two Blankenburg Medium Pulse Lasers and a Dinatech Mark III Small Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 射击手最高速度 64.8 公里/小时，对重型机甲而言机动性属中等水平。机甲有十三台双倍散热器，使射击手能散发其沉重武器载荷产生的废热。射击手携带十二吨 MV 铁纤维装甲并配 C.A.S.E.，在弹药爆炸时保护机甲。射击手武装到能在多种距离交战。机甲上唯一的远程武器是一门"布兰肯堡"ER 大型激光，有效射程五百七十米。中近程战斗方面，射击手携带一门毁灭性的"死亡赐予者"自动炮/20，单次齐射就能击倒大多数轻型甚至某些中型机甲。最后，抵近防御方面，机甲有两门"布兰肯堡"中型脉冲激光和一门"迪纳科技 Mark III"小型激光。

Original: Apparently based on the Timber Wolf, the Sidewinder OmniMech was developed by Clan Cloud Cobra in preparation for the Clan Invasion of the Inner Sphere. When it turned out that the Cloud Cobras would likely not be among the invader clans they became increasingly desperate and eventually fielded a Sidewinder against Clan Jade Falcon in a trial on Babylon that they lost. The Jade Falcons salvaged the heavily damaged 'Mech and all available information is based on their investigation of the design.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_sidewinder_SW-PRIME.Details

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 响尾蛇全能机甲显然以森林狼为基础，由云眼镜蛇氏族为准备氏族入侵内天体而开发。当发现云眼镜蛇很可能不在入侵氏族之列时，他们日益绝望，最终在巴比伦的一场试炼中派出响尾蛇对抗翡翠猎鹰氏族，但败北。翡翠猎鹰回收了严重受损的机甲，所有已知信息都基于他们对该设计的调查。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Apparently based on the Timber Wolf, the Sidewinder OmniMech was developed by Clan Cloud Cobra in preparation for the Clan Invasion of the Inner Sphere. When it turned out that the Cloud Cobras would likely not be among the invader clans they became increasingly desperate and eventually fielded a Sidewinder against Clan Jade Falcon in a trial on Babylon that they lost. The Jade Falcons salvaged the heavily damaged 'Mech and all available information is based on their investigation of the design.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 响尾蛇全能机甲显然以森林狼为基础，由云眼镜蛇氏族为准备氏族入侵内天体而开发。当发现云眼镜蛇很可能不在入侵氏族之列时，他们日益绝望，最终在巴比伦的一场试炼中派出响尾蛇对抗翡翠猎鹰氏族，但败北。翡翠猎鹰回收了严重受损的机甲，所有已知信息都基于他们对该设计的调查。

Original: Meant mostly as a high-speed fire support unit, the minimally-armored Sling was meant to remain out of the way of enemy fire, saturating the target area with its fifteen long-range missile tubes.

Original: The Snake is a 'Mech that was built under the aegis of an Elemental hunter. With the power of hindsight though the Snake is clearly designed to hunt Inner Sphere Battle Armor suits. The 'Mech is built using a Vox 225 XL Engine to move at a top speed of 86.4 kph. The Snake also has a jumping capability of one hundred and fifty meters making it capable of outmaneuvering any battle armor suit and also keeping it on par with most medium 'Mechs. The Snake is also armored with seven tons of armor and uses double heat sinks to cool the 'Mech's excess heat.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_snake_SNK-1V.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Snake is a 'Mech that was built under the aegis of an Elemental hunter. With the power of hindsight though the Snake is clearly designed to hunt Inner Sphere Battle Armor suits. The 'Mech is built using a Vox 225 XL Engine to move at a top speed of 86.4 kph. The Snake also has a jumping capability of one hundred and fifty meters making it capable of outmaneuvering any battle armor suit and also keeping it on par with most medium 'Mechs. The Snake is also armored with seven tons of armor and uses double heat sinks to cool the 'Mech's excess heat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蛇是一台在"元素猎手"名义下建造的机甲。不过事后看来，蛇显然是为猎杀内天体战斗装甲服而设计的。机甲采用 VOX 225 XL 引擎，最高速度 86.4 公里/小时。蛇还具备一百五十米的跳跃能力，使其能胜过任何战斗装甲服，也能与大多数中型机甲并驾齐驱。蛇还披挂七吨装甲，并使用双倍散热器散发机甲的多余热量。

Original: The Snake's primary weapon is a Mydron Excel LB-X Autocannon/10 which can fire both standard rounds as well as firing cluster rounds which act like 'Mech sized shotgun shells. The 'Mech is also armed with three Hovertec Streak SRM-2s which are highly effective in finding weak spots in an enemy's armor or against Inner Sphere battle armor.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_snake_SNK-1V.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Snake's primary weapon is a Mydron Excel LB-X Autocannon/10 which can fire both standard rounds as well as firing cluster rounds which act like 'Mech sized shotgun shells. The 'Mech is also armed with three Hovertec Streak SRM-2s which are highly effective in finding weak spots in an enemy's armor or against Inner Sphere battle armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蛇的主武器是一门迈德龙 Excel LB-X 自动炮/10，可发射标准弹，也能发射类似机甲级霰弹的集束弹。机甲还装备三门"气垫"连续 SRM-2，在寻找敌方装甲弱点或对付内天体战斗装甲时极为有效。

Original: The Spector was originally designed by Norse-Storm BattleMechs to be a lighter version of the Exterminator BattleMech, made to hunt down light command 'Mechs. The first Spector rolled off the assembly line on 6 June, 2639, and following extensive testing the SLDF ordered 600. The Star League's enthusiasm for the Spector is due to the BattleMechs stealth capabilities, a Chameleon Light Polarization Shield

Original: The 7M was Nimakachi's upgrade of the venerable Spider with recovered Star League technology. Released in 3051 it uses a Crucis-II Delux Endo Steel chassis and three tons of Kallon FWL Special Ferro-Fibrous armor, freeing up weight to replace the two medium lasers with two Tronel XII medium pulse lasers. Many of the components were also replaced with proprietary technology, including Rawlings 75 jump jets, an Omicron 4002 Networking Channel, and a TRSS Eagle Eye targeting system. One thing they could not do however was include an ejection system for the pilot.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_spider_SDR-7M.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 7M was Nimakachi's upgrade of the venerable Spider with recovered Star League technology. Released in 3051 it uses a Crucis-II Delux Endo Steel chassis and three tons of Kallon FWL Special Ferro-Fibrous armor, freeing up weight to replace the two medium lasers with two Tronel XII medium pulse lasers. Many of the components were also replaced with proprietary technology, including Rawlings 75 jump jets, an Omicron 4002 Networking Channel, and a TRSS Eagle Eye targeting system. One thing they could not do however was include an ejection system for the pilot.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 7M 是尼玛卡奇用回收的星盟科技对古老蜘蛛的升级。它于 3051 年发布，使用十字-II 豪华内骨骼底盘和三吨卡隆 FWL 特制铁纤维装甲，腾出重量把两门中型激光换成两门特罗内尔 XII 中型脉冲激光。许多部件也换成自有技术，包括罗林斯 75 跳跃推进器、奥米克戎 4002 网络通道和 TRSS 鹰眼瞄准系统。然而有一件事他们做不到：为飞行员加装弹射系统。

Original: The Stealth is a heavy scout 'Mech that is in use by the Federated Suns and the Lyran Alliance. The 'Mech has a GM 315 XL Engine that allows the Stealth to move at speeds of 118.8 kph and the MASC system on board can push the 'Mech to 151.2 kph in short bursts. This amazing mobility is augmented by jump jets which the Stealth can use to jump up to two hundred and ten meters. The Stealth is also outfitted with a Cyclops-Beagle Sensory Active Probe that the Stealth can use to find hidden enemy units.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐形是联邦太阳系与莱兰联盟使用的重型侦察机甲。它采用 GM 315 XL 引擎，速度可达 118.8 公里/小时，机上的 MASC 系统可在短促爆发中推至 151.2 公里/小时。这一惊人机动性由跳跃推进器进一步增强，隐形可跳跃至二百一十米。它还配备了独眼巨人-比格犬主动探测器，可用于寻找隐藏的敌方单位。

Original: In 2680, the Star League requested designers to develop 'Mechs which could fly as well as function as standard 'Mechs. The first Land-Air 'Mech off the drawing board, the Shadow Hawk LAM, proved so fatally flawed, the concept was almost shelved. However, LexaTech Industries reworked the conversion equipment and unveiled the first viable LAM, the Stinger LAM in 2688, based on the old Stinger design. LexaTech's reworking of the concept proved so successful, the Land-Air 'Mech became highly sought after, especially for space combat operations. In fact, the Stinger LAM first saw combat destroying a nuclear weapons facility in the Oort Cloud orbiting Sol, Terra's star. Found in the Draconis Combine, this variant uses two pairs of Martell Small Lasers on the arms instead of a single Medium Laser.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_stingerlam_STG-A10.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In 2680, the Star League requested designers to develop 'Mechs which could fly as well as function as standard 'Mechs. The first Land-Air 'Mech off the drawing board, the Shadow Hawk LAM, proved so fatally flawed, the concept was almost shelved. However, LexaTech Industries reworked the conversion equipment and unveiled the first viable LAM, the Stinger LAM in 2688, based on the old Stinger design. LexaTech's reworking of the concept proved so successful, the Land-Air 'Mech became highly sought after, especially for space combat operations. In fact, the Stinger LAM first saw combat destroying a nuclear weapons facility in the Oort Cloud orbiting Sol, Terra's star. Found in the Draconis Combine, this variant uses two pairs of Martell Small Lasers on the arms instead of a single Medium Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2680 年，星盟要求设计师开发既能飞行又能作为标准机甲运作的机甲。首款走下绘图板的陆空机甲——影鹰 LAM——被证明缺陷致命，该概念几乎被搁置。然而莱克萨科技工业重做了变身设备，于 2688 年推出首款可用的 LAM——毒刺 LAM，以老式毒刺设计为基础。莱克萨对概念的改造极为成功，陆空机甲变得极受追捧，尤其是在太空作战中。事实上，毒刺 LAM 首次参战就是摧毁太阳系恒星泰拉轨道上奥尔特云中的一处核武器设施。此变体见于德拉科尼斯联合体，臂部使用两对马特尔小型激光取代单门中型激光。

Designed as a fast, jump-capable reconnaissance platform, the Stinger has served capably in that role for well over half a millennium, a testament to the utility of the original design.

Original: This upgraded version of the Stinger produced by Earthwerks Incorporated on Keystone and Calloway VI took advantage of several technologies that were rediscovered, thanks in part to the Helm Memory Core. The chassis was upgraded to an Earthwerks STG II Endo Steel model, allowing it to carry an additional half-ton of armor. The 'Mech retained the Omicron medium laser but swapped the machine guns for a Lindblad Shotgun Anti-Missile System on its right arm and a Flame Tech Flamer on its left. One ton of AMS ammo was carried in the right torso, while the Datacom 26 and Dynatec 990 electronic systems remain unchanged.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_stinger_STG-5M.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This upgraded version of the Stinger produced by Earthwerks Incorporated on Keystone and Calloway VI took advantage of several technologies that were rediscovered, thanks in part to the Helm Memory Core. The chassis was upgraded to an Earthwerks STG II Endo Steel model, allowing it to carry an additional half-ton of armor. The 'Mech retained the Omicron medium laser but swapped the machine guns for a Lindblad Shotgun Anti-Missile System on its right arm and a Flame Tech Flamer on its left. One ton of AMS ammo was carried in the right torso, while the Datacom 26 and Dynatec 990 electronic systems remain unchanged.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款毒刺升级版由地球工厂公司在基斯通与卡洛威 VI 生产，得益于多项重新发现的技术，其中部分要归功于赫尔姆记忆核心。底盘升级为地球工厂 STG II 内骨骼型号，使其能多携带半吨装甲。机甲保留奥米克戎中型激光，但把机枪换成右臂的林德布拉德霰弹反导系统和左臂的火焰科技火焰喷射器。右躯干携带一吨 AMS 弹药，而 Datacom 26 与 Dynatec 990 电子系统保持不变。

Original: The design featured Large Pulse Lasers in each arm, twin Gauss Rifles mounted behind flip-open circular firing ports on each side torso, and an almost superfluous Small Pulse Laser located above the cockpit. The Stone Rhino also sported an interesting feature; each arm contained a retractable, shock-absorbing cowl covering the weapon barrels. This allowed MechWarriors to use the arms as battering rams without damaging the weaponry.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_stonerhino_STR-1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The design featured Large Pulse Lasers in each arm, twin Gauss Rifles mounted behind flip-open circular firing ports on each side torso, and an almost superfluous Small Pulse Laser located above the cockpit. The Stone Rhino also sported an interesting feature; each arm contained a retractable, shock-absorbing cowl covering the weapon barrels. This allowed MechWarriors to use the arms as battering rams without damaging the weaponry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该设计在每臂装备大型脉冲激光，两侧躯干各在翻开式圆形射击口后安装两门高斯步枪，驾驶舱上方还有一门近乎多余的轻型脉冲激光。石犀牛还有一个有趣特征：每臂都包含一个可伸缩的减震罩盖住炮管，使机甲战士能把手臂当攻城锤使用而不损坏武器。

Original: In order to plug holes in their touman, Clan Goliath Scorpion scientists revisited the Behemoth. Like Clan Smoke Jaguar before them, they upgraded and improved upon the design. This version used an Extra-light Engine to mount a pair of Thunderstroke Series 2b Gauss Rifles along the top of the 'Mech. Each arm carried a Series 4D-2 Heavy Large Laser, a Series 22a Heavy Medium Laser, and a General Systems Heavy Small Laser. It retained the shock-absorbing cowls of the original. Another pair of Heavy Mediums protected the rear of the 'Mech. A head-mounted Shield-3 Anti-Missile System defended against missiles, while an Anti-Personnel Pod in each leg discouraged unarmored infantry. This design had jump jets, nineteen tons of armor, and a meager sixteen double heat sinks.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_stonerhino_STR-2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In order to plug holes in their touman, Clan Goliath Scorpion scientists revisited the Behemoth. Like Clan Smoke Jaguar before them, they upgraded and improved upon the design. This version used an Extra-light Engine to mount a pair of Thunderstroke Series 2b Gauss Rifles along the top of the 'Mech. Each arm carried a Series 4D-2 Heavy Large Laser, a Series 22a Heavy Medium Laser, and a General Systems Heavy Small Laser. It retained the shock-absorbing cowls of the original. Another pair of Heavy Mediums protected the rear of the 'Mech. A head-mounted Shield-3 Anti-Missile System defended against missiles, while an Anti-Personnel Pod in each leg discouraged unarmored infantry. This design had jump jets, nineteen tons of armor, and a meager sixteen double heat sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 为填补图曼的缺口，歌利亚蝎氏族科学家重新审视了巨兽。如烟虎氏族先前所做，他们升级改进了该设计。此版本使用超轻型引擎，在机甲顶部安装两门雷霆系列 2b 高斯步枪。每臂携带一门 4D-2 系列重型大型激光、一门 22a 系列重型中型激光和一门通用系统重型小型激光。它保留了原版的减震罩盖。另外两门重型中型激光保护机甲后方。头部安装的盾-3 反导系统防御导弹，每条腿上的反人员荚舱则用于威慑无装甲步兵。该设计配有跳跃推进器、十九吨装甲和仅十六台双倍散热器。

Original: A variable range variant, the Stone Rhino 4 uses an XL Engine to provide weight savings for four LRM 10s to lay down impressive long range fire. Backing these up are a pair of Ultra AC-10s for mid-range engagements. From there, four ER Medium Lasers provide a solid short range punch. Lastly, four Machine Guns provide anti-infantry support. These combine to make a solid and well rounded configuration.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_stonerhino_STR-4.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A variable range variant, the Stone Rhino 4 uses an XL Engine to provide weight savings for four LRM 10s to lay down impressive long range fire. Backing these up are a pair of Ultra AC-10s for mid-range engagements. From there, four ER Medium Lasers provide a solid short range punch. Lastly, four Machine Guns provide anti-infantry support. These combine to make a solid and well rounded configuration.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 石犀牛 4 是一款全能射程变体，它使用 XL 引擎节省重量以搭载四具 LRM 10，倾泻可观远程火力。中距离交战由两门超速 AC-10 支援，四门 ER 中型激光提供扎实的近距离打击，最后四挺机枪提供反步兵支援。这些组合成一套扎实而均衡的配置。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 石犀牛 5 基于"阿马里斯之愚"的早期规格设计，使用 400XL 引擎达到最高 64.8 公里/小时的速度。它在躯干安装四门 LB-5X 自动炮，并以臂部六门 ER 中型激光作为补充。

Original: The Strider OmniMech is based on the older Cicada BattleMech. The Strider is built on an Alshain Type KR240 Endo Steel chassis to help save on weight. Built with the rugged GM 240 fusion engine, the Strider has a top speed of 97.2 km/h. Outfitted with CASE, built around the durable GM 240, and protected with seven and a half tons of armor, the Strider is a durable 'Mech for its weight class; capable of suffering considerable damage before being disabled or destroyed.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_strider_SR1-O.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Strider OmniMech is based on the older Cicada BattleMech. The Strider is built on an Alshain Type KR240 Endo Steel chassis to help save on weight. Built with the rugged GM 240 fusion engine, the Strider has a top speed of 97.2 km/h. Outfitted with CASE, built around the durable GM 240, and protected with seven and a half tons of armor, the Strider is a durable 'Mech for its weight class; capable of suffering considerable damage before being disabled or destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 疾行者全能机甲以较老的蝉战斗机甲为基础。它采用 Alshain KR240 型内骨骼底盘以减轻重量。配备坚固的 GM 240 聚变引擎，疾行者最高速度达 97.2 公里/小时。它装有 C.A.S.E.、以耐用的 GM 240 为核心，并有七吨半装甲防护，在同重量级中属耐久型机甲；在瘫痪或被摧毁前能承受相当可观的损伤。

This is backed up by a highly accurate Streak SRM-6 launcher to seek out weak points in an enemy's armor and an ER Small Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 召唤者 C 是一款近战近战型，装备一门 ER 大型激光用于对敌方目标的远程狙击，但真正发挥威力是在近距离。机甲依靠一门强劲的超速自动炮/20 在近距离快速击杀。它辅以一具极为精准的连续 SRM-6 发射器以寻找敌方装甲弱点，以及一门 ER 小型激光。

Original: In its primary configuration the Summoner has a basic yet effective arsenal. The primary direct fire weapon is an ER PPC backed up by an LB 10-X Autocannon that can fire both standard and cluster ammunition. For fire support and bombardment, the Summoner has an LRM-15 launcher.

Lacking in ranged weapons, an ECM Suite is fitted in the left torso to try and assist in closing with its foes so it can make full use of the four tons of Ultra ammunition and single ton HMG bin.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_sunspider_SNS-F.Details

Original: The F model of the Sun Spider can lay down some significant fire at long range, but watch out for enemies closing the distance, it has no backup or close combat weapons.

Original: Almost a direct counter-point to the Prime, the A Config mounts twin Ultra AC/2s in each side torso, supported by an ER Large Laser in each arm if the two tons of Ultra reloads run dry. The config is rounded out by an extra Double Heat Sink.

Original: A mixed-range combatant, the Sun Spider B is built around a right-torso mounted Gauss Rifle, supported by a left-torso ER Large Laser and matched Streak SRM-6 and ER Medium Lasers in each arm. An Anti-Missile System and a Light Active Probe in the left torso prevent the B from being caught unaware, carrying two tons of Gauss and Streak reloads along with a single ton of AMS ammo and an extra double heat sink.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_sunspider_SNS_B.Details

Original: Apparently based on the Supernova-2, the Supernova-A retains only a single ER Large Laser in each arm, mounting an Artemis IV FCS-equipped LRM-20 and Streak SRM-6 launcher in each torso. With a targeting computer linked to the large lasers, three tons of LRM missiles and four tons of Streak reloads give the A variant good endurance. Keeping the classic jump jets and boosting armor over primary variant, an Endo Steel frame and fitting only seventeen double heat sinks are used to free up the extra weight required for the missile launchers.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_supernova_SNV-A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Apparently based on the Supernova-2, the Supernova-A retains only a single ER Large Laser in each arm, mounting an Artemis IV FCS-equipped LRM-20 and Streak SRM-6 launcher in each torso. Keeping the classic jump jets and boosting armor over primary variant, an Endo Steel frame and fitting only seventeen double heat sinks are used to free up the extra weight required for the missile launchers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 超新星-A 显然以超新星-2 为基础，每臂只保留一门 ER 大型激光，每个躯干装备一具配 Artemis IV 火控系统的 LRM-20 和连续 SRM-6 发射器。大型激光联动的瞄准计算机、三吨 LRM 导弹和四吨连续导弹再装填赋予 A 变体良好的续航。保留经典的跳跃推进器并在主变体基础上加强装甲，使用内骨骼框架并只装十七台双倍散热器，以腾出导弹发射器所需的额外重量。

Original: While an exceptionally early design, the Talos by Vandenberg MilTech was a financial success and a long-standing general mech for the Taurian Defense Forces from its production in the 2530's well into the Succession Wars. An Autocannon/10, two LRM-5s, and an SRM-6 give the Talos weapons effective at multiple range bands while its 8.5 tons of armor give it some longevity on the battlefield.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_talos_TLS-1B.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: While an exceptionally early design, the Talos by Vandenberg MilTech was a financial success and a long-standing general mech for the Taurian Defense Forces from its production in the 2530's well into the Succession Wars. An Autocannon/10, two LRM-5s, and an SRM-6 give the Talos weapons effective at multiple range bands while its 8.5 tons of armor give it some longevity on the battlefield.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 虽然设计极早，但范登堡军工的塔洛斯取得了商业成功，自 2530 年代投产直到继承战争，一直是陶里安防卫军长期使用的通用机甲。一门自动炮/10、两具 LRM-5 和一具 SRM-6 使塔洛斯的武器在多个射程段都有效，而其 8.5 吨装甲赋予它在战场上一定的持久力。

Original: The Talos is extremely old but reliable Taurian design. I'm pretty sure they stopped making these things before the Succession Wars but here we are, one in the flesh. Complete with an AC10, two LRM-5s, and a SRM-6, the Talos was a go-to mech for the Taurians for a good reason.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_talos_TLS-1B.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Talos is extremely old but reliable Taurian design. I'm pretty sure they stopped making these things before the Succession Wars but here we are, one in the flesh. Complete with an AC10, two LRM-5s, and a SRM-6, the Talos was a go-to mech for the Taurians for a good reason.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 塔洛斯是极为古老但可靠的陶里安设计。我很确定他们在继承战争之前就停产了，但现在我们眼前就有一台。配有一门 AC10、两具 LRM-5 和一具 SRM-6，塔洛斯成为陶里安人的首选机甲是有充分理由的。

Original: A relic of an earlier age, it’s a minor miracle this antique is still functional. Occasionally found through the frontier, surviving Taloses are a strange mix of new and old technology, bodged together by generations of different mectechs. Rarely seen and even more rarely fielded in battle, very few of these 500 year old designs still grace the modern battlefield, but those that do are treated with the respect and reverence, due to a centuries old design. The 1P is the ‘‘modern’’ adaption of the older 1B design and has proliferated in recent years, leading some to speculate that a cache of Talos or Talos parts has been found. Armed with a variety of local tech and a knock-off ecm suite, the 1P is a versatile design outfitted as a mid range brawler.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_talos_TLS-1P.Details

The 1P is the ‘‘modern’’ adaption of the older 1B design and has proliferated in recent years, leading some to speculate that a cache of Talos or Talos parts has been found. Armed with a variety of local tech and a knock-off ecm suite, the 1P is a versatile design outfitted as a mid range brawler.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为更早时代的遗物，这台古董还能运转已是小小奇迹。偶尔能在边疆见到，幸存的塔洛斯是新旧技术奇异的混合体，由一代代不同的机甲技师拼凑而成。它们很少见，更罕见于战场，这些五百年前的设计几乎已不再现身现代战场，但少数仍在服役者因这数世纪之久的设计而备受敬重。1P 是较老 1B 设计的"现代"改型，近年数量激增，让一些人猜测有人发现了塔洛斯或其部件的储藏库。1P 装备多种本地技术与一套仿制 ECM 套件，是一款多用途设计，定位为中距离缠斗者。

Original: Armed with a mixed ba of weapons, the LRM-10 provides suppressive fire at range; whilst the Rifle and the Chemical Lasers make up the bulk of the mech’s heavy firepower. A pair of Rocket Launchers can deliver a coup de grâce against damaged opponents or serve as a backup weapon if the mech is engaged at close range.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_talos_TLS-1P.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Armed with a mixed ba of weapons, the LRM-10 provides suppressive fire at range; whilst the Rifle and the Chemical Lasers make up the bulk of the mech’s heavy firepower. A pair of Rocket Launchers can deliver a coup de grâce against damaged opponents or serve as a backup weapon if the mech is engaged at close range.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 混合武器配置下，LRM-10 提供远程压制火力；而步枪与化学激光构成机甲重型火力的主体。一对火箭发射器能对受损对手施以致命一击，或在机甲陷入近距交战时充当备用武器。

Original: With the reintroduction of Helm Core LosTech, the Taurian Defense Force found themselves lagging behind their neighbours. Just as they did during the Age of War, the Taurians turned to the home grown Talos. With a reputation as an easy to maintain and easy to manufacture mech, the design was just what the TDF needed. Lacking the resources to turn the newly redesigned Talos into a viable production model, the Taurians enlisted the aid of their neighbours, in exchange for joining the ongoing Trinity Alliance negotiations. Aided by the expertise of Capellan engineers and financial investment from the Magistracy of Canopus, Vandenburg started limited manufacturing of the Talos; at their New Vandenburg plant: in late 3059. The formal signing of the Trinity Alliance, in 3062; awarded production licenses to both Majesty Metals and Detroit Consolidated Mech Works. Both companies swiftly opened their own lines, producing multiple variants of the Talos for their own use and for export further afield.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_talos_TLS-4A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: With the reintroduction of Helm Core LosTech, the Taurian Defense Force found themselves lagging behind their neighbours. Just as they did during the Age of War, the Taurians turned to the home grown Talos. With a reputation as an easy to maintain and easy to manufacture mech, the design was just what the TDF needed. Lacking the resources to turn the newly redesigned Talos into a viable production model, the Taurians enlisted the aid of their neighbours, in exchange for joining the ongoing Trinity Alliance negotiations. Aided by the expertise of Capellan engineers and financial investment from the Magistracy of Canopus, Vandenburg started limited manufacturing of the Talos; at their New Vandenburg plant: in late 3059. The formal signing of the Trinity Alliance, in 3062; awarded production licenses to both Majesty Metals and Detroit Consolidated Mech Works. Both companies swiftly opened their own lines, producing multiple variants of the Talos for their own use and for export further afield.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 随着赫尔姆核心失落科技的重现，陶里安防卫军发现自己落后于邻国。正如战争时代一样，陶里安人转向了本土成长的塔洛斯。这款机甲以易于维护和易于制造著称，正是陶里安防卫军所需。由于缺乏资源将新设计的塔洛斯转为可行的量产型号，陶里安人以加入正在进行的"三位一体同盟"谈判为交换，寻求邻国援助。在卡佩兰工程师的专业知识与卡诺普斯女权国的资金投入协助下，范登堡于 3059 年末在其新范登堡工厂开始了塔洛斯的限量生产。3062 年三位一体同盟正式签署，授予陛下金属公司与底特律联合机工厂生产许可。两家公司迅速开设了自己的生产线，为自用与远销生产了塔洛斯的多种变体。

Original: The original TDF redesign, the 4A is almost identical to the 1B. The AC/10 is swapped for a newer UAC/10, whilst an Artemis IV FCS enhances the accuracy of the missile launchers. Endo Steel is used to free up the weight needed.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_talos_TLS-4A.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original TDF redesign, the 4A is almost identical to the 1B. The AC/10 is swapped for a newer UAC/10, whilst an Artemis IV FCS enhances the accuracy of the missile launchers. Endo Steel is used to free up the weight needed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为 TDF 最初的重新设计，4A 与 1B 几乎相同。AC/10 换成了更新的 UAC/10，而 Artemis IV 火控系统提升了导弹发射器的精度。内骨骼用于腾出所需重量。

Original: Developed for export to the Magistracy of Canopus, the 4B swaps the 4A’s weapons for a pair of LBX/2’s and a pair of LRM-10’s. Designed as a long range sniper and anti aircraft mech, the 4B was initially limited in manufacture; as resources were devoted to the TDF ordered 4A model. The signing of the Trinity Alliance enabled the MOC to start production themselves and the design proved successful.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_talos_TLS-4B.YangsThoughts

Original: Intended to emulate the Thor OmniMech used by the Clans, the Thanatos is an incredibly sturdy and hard-hitting design. Copying both the looks and the capabilities of the Clan Thor, the Thanatos is a fast all-range design, though it skimps on armor a bit for a mech its size. Carrying an ER Large Laser for long range and a brace of advanced medium lasers and a MRM-20 for medium to close range, the Thanatos has a weapon for any situation. Combined with a fast 86.4 km/h top speed and five jump jets, the Thanatos can often catch what it cannot out-range.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_thanatos_TNS-4S.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Intended to emulate the Thor OmniMech used by the Clans, the Thanatos is an incredibly sturdy and hard-hitting design. Copying both the looks and the capabilities of the Clan Thor, the Thanatos is a fast all-range design, though it skimps on armor a bit for a mech its size. Carrying an ER Large Laser for long range and a brace of advanced medium lasers and a MRM-20 for medium to close range, the Thanatos has a weapon for any situation. Combined with a fast 86.4 km/h top speed and five jump jets, the Thanatos can often catch what it cannot out-range.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 塔纳托斯旨在模仿氏族使用的雷神全能机甲，是一款极其坚固、打击力极强的设计。它同时复制了氏族雷神的外观与能力，是一款快速的全射程机甲，尽管就其尺寸而言装甲略显单薄。远程携带一门 ER 大型激光，中近程则有一批先进中型激光和一具 MRM-20，塔纳托斯拥有应对任何情况的武器。加上 86.4 公里/小时的快速最高速度和五个跳跃推进器，塔纳托斯常常能追上它无法在射程上压制的对手。

Original: The so-called "Lost Thunderbolt", the 5L was a downgraded version of the Royal 5Sb Thunderbolt developed by Earthwerks Tikonov in 2823. Built on a more basic standard chassis, the now LosTech ER PPC was swapped for a Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Laser but most of the 5Sb's systems were preserved with only the loss of one double heat sink and the head-mounted Small Laser. Production of the design only lasted a mere twenty-seven years before further technology decline resulted in the 5LS.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_thunderbolt_TDR-5L.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The so-called "Lost Thunderbolt", the 5L was a downgraded version of the Royal 5Sb Thunderbolt developed by Earthwerks Tikonov in 2823. Built on a more basic standard chassis, the now LosTech ER PPC was swapped for a Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Laser but most of the 5Sb's systems were preserved with only the loss of one double heat sink and the head-mounted Small Laser. Production of the design only lasted a mere twenty-seven years before further technology decline resulted in the 5LS.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5L 即所谓的"失落雷霆"，是地球工厂提科诺夫于 2823 年为皇家 5Sb 雷霆开发的降级版。它建立在更基础的标准底盘上，如今已成失落科技的 ER PPC 被换成多元光学"日光束"ER 大型激光，但 5Sb 的大部分系统得以保留，仅损失一台双倍散热器和头部小型激光。该设计仅生产了短短二十七年，技术进一步衰退便催生了 5LS。

Original: Developed in 2850 as the Second Succession War saw more and more technologies disappear, the 5LS was a downgraded field refit and a factory model of the now impossible to build 5L. While the ER Large Laser and Starfish Small Pulse Lasers were retained, the standard LRM-15 and Bical SRM-2 rack were noticeably less accurate than the 5L's more advanced launchers, but nothing compared to the replacement of the 5L's double heat sinks with fifteen standard models and the heat management issues that resulted. Production of even the "primitive" 5LS would end during the Third Succession War.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_thunderbolt_TDR-5LS.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed in 2850 as the Second Succession War saw more and more technologies disappear, the 5LS was a downgraded field refit and a factory model of the now impossible to build 5L. While the ER Large Laser and Starfish Small Pulse Lasers were retained, the standard LRM-15 and Bical SRM-2 rack were noticeably less accurate than the 5L's more advanced launchers, but nothing compared to the replacement of the 5L's double heat sinks with fifteen standard models and the heat management issues that resulted. Production of even the "primitive" 5LS would end during the Third Succession War.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5LS 于 2850 年开发，当时第二次继承战争让越来越多的技术消失，它是对如今已无法建造的 5L 的降级野战改装与工厂型号。虽然保留了 ER 大型激光和"海星"小型脉冲激光，标准 LRM-15 和比卡尔 SRM-2 挂架的精度明显不如 5L 更先进的发射器，但这与把 5L 的双倍散热器换成十五台标准型号、以及由此产生的散热问题相比，根本不算什么。即便是"原始"的 5LS 也在第三次继承战争期间停产。

Original: The Timber Wolf is a fast, heavy OmniMech. A signature design of the Clans' military might, it was arguably the first Clan OmniMech encountered by Inner Sphere forces on The Rock by Phelan Kell. Vaguely resembling a cross-over between the MAD (Marauder) and CAT (Catapult) series, the Timber Wolf was tagged with the Inner Sphere reporting name Mad Cat on first contact.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_timberwolf_TW-A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Timber Wolf is a fast, heavy OmniMech. A signature design of the Clans' military might, it was arguably the first Clan OmniMech encountered by Inner Sphere forces on The Rock by Phelan Kell. Vaguely resembling a cross-over between the MAD (Marauder) and CAT (Catapult) series, the Timber Wolf was tagged with the Inner Sphere reporting name Mad Cat on first contact.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 森林狼是一款高速重型全能机甲。作为氏族军事力量的标志性设计，它可以说是内天体部队在"岩石"星上由菲兰·凯尔首次遭遇的氏族全能机甲。因其隐约呈现出 MAD（掠夺者）与 CAT（投石机）系列的杂交特征，森林狼在首次接触时被内天体冠以"疯猫"的报告代号。

Original: Built due to an awkward exchange of technology between the Free Worlds League and the Word of Blake, the Toyama was designed by Dr. Thaddeus Anable and then given to the Word of Blake through an agreement made by Captain-General Thomas Marik. The Toyama is intended to be a multi-role BattleMech that can operate somewhat independently of supply lines. The 'Mech is built on a lightweight Endo Steel chassis which supports a Vlar 300 XL engine. The Toyama has a top speed of 64.8 km/h, making it capable of keeping pace with most heavy 'Mechs. The Toyama has an impressive twelve tons of Durallex Heavy armor. To dissipate heat, the Toyama carries fourteen double heat sinks. The 'Mech also carries a Garret/Guardian Interface Guardian ECM Suite to protect the 'Mech from advanced enemy electronic warfare systems.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_toyama_TYM-1A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Built due to an awkward exchange of technology between the Free Worlds League and the Word of Blake, the Toyama was designed by Dr. Thaddeus Anable and then given to the Word of Blake through an agreement made by Captain-General Thomas Marik. The Toyama is intended to be a multi-role BattleMech that can operate somewhat independently of supply lines. The 'Mech is built on a lightweight Endo Steel chassis which supports a Vlar 300 XL engine. The Toyama has a top speed of 64.8 km/h, making it capable of keeping pace with most heavy 'Mechs. The Toyama has an impressive twelve tons of Durallex Heavy armor. To dissipate heat, the Toyama carries fourteen double heat sinks. The 'Mech also carries a Garret/Guardian Interface Guardian ECM Suite to protect the 'Mech from advanced enemy electronic warfare systems.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由于自由世界联盟与布雷克之言之间一次尴尬的技术交换，丰山由撒迪厄斯·阿纳布尔博士设计，然后通过总队长托马斯·马里克达成的协议交给了布雷克之言。丰山意图成为一款能在一定程度上独立于补给线作战的多用途战斗机甲。机甲基于轻量化内骨骼底盘建造，搭载一台 Vlar 300 XL 引擎。丰山最高速度 64.8 公里/小时，使其能与大多数重型机甲并驾齐驱。丰山拥有令人印象深刻的十二吨杜拉莱克斯重型装甲。为散发热量，丰山携带十四台双倍散热器。机甲还装有一套加勒特/守护者接口 ECM 套件，以保护机甲免受敌方先进电子战系统干扰。

Original: The Toyama has a Doombud LRM-20 launcher for long range direct and indirect bombardment capabilities. The Toyama also has two Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Lasers and an Imperator Code Red LB-X Autocannon/10, which can fire both standard ammunition and cluster rounds, for long range combat. For close range engagements, the Toyama has three Magna Mk II Medium Lasers.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_toyama_TYM-1A.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Toyama has a Doombud LRM-20 launcher for long range direct and indirect bombardment capabilities. The Toyama also has two Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Lasers and an Imperator Code Red LB-X Autocannon/10, which can fire both standard ammunition and cluster rounds, for long range combat. For close range engagements, the Toyama has three Magna Mk II Medium Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 丰山有一具"末日芽"LRM-20 发射器，具备远程直接与间接轰炸能力。丰山还有两门"多元光学阳光"ER 大型激光和一门"帝皇红色代码"LB-X 自动炮/10（可发射标准弹与集束弹）用于远程战斗。近程交战方面，丰山有三门"玛格纳 Mk II"中型激光。

Original: The original Trebuchet as produced for the SLDF, it consisted of two Artemis IV-equipped LRM-15s with CASE, four medium lasers, double heat sinks, an Endo-Steel chassis and a 300-rated Extra Light Fusion Engine. Original: Rebuilt from the salvaged remains of a Trebuchet 5S, this low tech refit is a common sight throughout the battlefields of the Deep Periphery. Mounting between 2 and 4 Rocket pods and backed up by a pair of Large Chem Lasers; makes the 5SP into a fearsome short range brawler. Some designs include scavenged or salvaged Endo Steel or Ferro Fibrous, either for increased protection or to mount additional rocket pods. Limited by the 4 tons of Chemical Laser ammunition and the single salvos of the rocket pod, the SP lacks the endurance for protracted engagements. Fortunately these are rarely a concern in the Deep Periphery and this design is commonally seen during raids and border skirmishes, where its heavy fire power can give it an edge over less durable opponents.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_trebuchet_TBT-5SP.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Rebuilt from the salvaged remains of a Trebuchet 5S, this low tech refit is a common sight throughout the battlefields of the Deep Periphery. Mounting between 2 and 4 Rocket pods and backed up by a pair of Large Chem Lasers; makes the 5SP into a fearsome short range brawler. Some designs include scavenged or salvaged Endo Steel or Ferro Fibrous, either for increased protection or to mount additional rocket pods. Limited by the 4 tons of Chemical Laser ammunition and the single salvos of the rocket pod, the SP lacks the endurance for protracted engagements. Fortunately these are rarely a concern in the Deep Periphery and this design is commonally seen during raids and border skirmishes, where its heavy fire power can give it an edge over less durable opponents.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款低技术改装型由一台 5S 投石机的回收残骸重建而成，在深外围区战场上随处可见。装备 2 至 4 个火箭吊舱，辅以两门大型化学激光，使 5SP 成为令人生畏的近距缠斗者。部分设计包含收集或回收的内骨骼或铁纤维，用于提升防护或加装更多火箭吊舱。受限于 4 吨化学激光弹药和火箭吊舱的一次性齐射，SP 缺乏持久交战所需的续航力。所幸在深外围区这很少成为问题，此设计常见于劫掠与边境冲突中，其沉重火力能让它在对抗耐久性较差的对手时占得先机。
