Original: Upgraded with Star League technology, the 7M variant is built with on an Endo Steel chassis and uses a 250 Magna XL engine, giving it the same performance but allowing the design to mount ten double heat sinks and five Rawlings 50 jump jets for a jumping distance of one hundred and fifty meters. It also allows for the Zeus LRM-15s' ammo to be protected by CASE and for a Narc Missile Beacon with two tons of ammo, improving not only the Trebuchet's accuracy but allowing it to share targeting information with other similarly-equipped 'Mechs.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_trebuchet_TBT-7M.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Upgraded with Star League technology, the 7M variant is built with on an Endo Steel chassis and uses a 250 Magna XL engine, giving it the same performance but allowing the design to mount ten double heat sinks and five Rawlings 50 jump jets for a jumping distance of one hundred and fifty meters. It also allows for the Zeus LRM-15s' ammo to be protected by CASE and for a Narc Missile Beacon with two tons of ammo, improving not only the Trebuchet's accuracy but allowing it to share targeting information with other similarly-equipped 'Mechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 7M 变体以星盟技术升级，基于内骨骼底盘建造，并使用玛格纳 250 XL 引擎，性能相同，但允许该设计安装十台双倍散热器和五个罗林斯 50 跳跃推进器，跳跃距离达一百五十米。它还使宙斯 LRM-15 的弹药得以由 C.A.S.E. 保护，并加装一具 NARC 导弹信标与两吨弹药，不仅提升投石机的精度，还使它可与其他同样装备的机甲共享瞄准信息。

Original: The 9K variant of the Trebuchet is a field refit of the 7M with a distinctive Kurita feel to it. Built on an Endo Steel chassis and powered by an XL engine, the 9K replaced the LRMs for two MRM-20launchers with three tons of ammo total. The medium lasers in the right arm are replaced with two Medium Pulse Lasers while the left arm-mounted medium laser is kept, and a C3 slave unit in the left torso allows it to share targeting telemetry with other units. The jump jets are also kept, giving it a jumping distance of one hundred and fifty meters.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_trebuchet_TBT-9K.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 9K variant of the Trebuchet is a field refit of the 7M with a distinctive Kurita feel to it. Built on an Endo Steel chassis and powered by an XL engine, the 9K replaced the LRMs for two MRM-20launchers with three tons of ammo total. The medium lasers in the right arm are replaced with two Medium Pulse Lasers while the left arm-mounted medium laser is kept, and a C3 slave unit in the left torso allows it to share targeting telemetry with other units. The jump jets are also kept, giving it a jumping distance of one hundred and fifty meters.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 投石机 9K 变体是 7M 的野战改装，带有鲜明的库瑞塔风格。它基于内骨骼底盘建造，由 XL 引擎驱动，以两具 MRM-20 发射器（共三吨弹药）取代 LRM。右臂的中型激光换成两门中型脉冲激光，左臂中型激光则保留，左躯干的 C3 从属单元使它可与其他单位共享瞄准遥测数据。跳跃推进器也得以保留，使其跳跃距离达一百五十米。

Original: The UrbanMech IIC is a Clan IIC-style upgrade of the original UrbanMech. Around the same time as the development of the OmniMech during the Golden Century, Clan Coyote technicians reworked this venerable design. They studied battle data from as far back as the Amaris Civil War and used this research as the basis for their upgrades.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_urbanmech_UM-IIC.Details

Around the same time as the development of the OmniMech during the Golden Century, Clan Coyote technicians reworked this venerable design. They studied battle data from as far back as the Amaris Civil War and used this research as the basis for their upgrades.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 城市机甲 IIC 是原版城市机甲的氏族 IIC 式升级版。在黄金世纪全能机甲发展的同期，郊狼氏族技师重制了这款古老的设计。他们研究了可追溯至阿马里斯内战的作战数据，并以此为基础进行升级。

Original: The product of an aborted series of experiments into LAM technology, the Urbanmech LAM is not surprisingly; poorly suited for either role. Designed by the self proclaimed professor of Cluffs Stand, Mencius Horvat; using a mixture of stolen Urbanmech parts and Lostech recovered from throughout the Periphery. Slow by LAM standards and drastically under gunned by Urbanmech standards, this mech struggles to fill either role. That said, the shock factor of an Urbanmech LAM deployed against uninformed opponents, has allowed it a measure of success when used as a raider. Dual ER Mediums and a bevy of rockets provide a nasty punch at close quarters, but prove mediocre at longer ranges. The only known examples of this mech were were recovered by the DMI and were turned over to the NAIS, though their current status is unknown.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_urbanmech_UM-LAMA.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The product of an aborted series of experiments into LAM technology, the Urbanmech LAM is not surprisingly; poorly suited for either role. Designed by the self proclaimed professor of Cluffs Stand, Mencius Horvat; using a mixture of stolen Urbanmech parts and Lostech recovered from throughout the Periphery. Slow by LAM standards and drastically under gunned by Urbanmech standards, this mech struggles to fill either role. That said, the shock factor of an Urbanmech LAM deployed against uninformed opponents, has allowed it a measure of success when used as a raider. Dual ER Mediums and a bevy of rockets provide a nasty punch at close quarters, but prove mediocre at longer ranges. The only known examples of this mech were were recovered by the DMI and were turned over to the NAIS, though their current status is unknown.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一系列夭折的 LAM 技术实验的产物，都市机甲 LAM 不出意外地对两种角色都不擅长。它由克拉夫斯站自封教授的孟修斯·霍瓦特设计，混用了偷来的都市机甲部件与从外围区各地找回的失传技术。按 LAM 标准它很慢，按都市机甲标准它火力严重不足，这台机甲难以胜任任一角色。话虽如此，都市机甲 LAM 面对不知情的对手时带来的震撼效果，使它在作为劫掠者使用时取得了一定成功。双联 ER 中型激光和一批火箭在近距能造成凶狠打击，但在较远距离上表现平庸。已知仅有的几台此类机甲被 DMI 收回并移交 NAIS，不过它们目前的状况不明。

Original: The Urbie LAM does something no UrbanMech should ever do. Fly.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_urbanmech_UM-LAMA.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Urbie LAM does something no UrbanMech should ever do. Fly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 城市 LAM 做了任何城市机甲都不该做的事。飞行。

Original: Don't let the stubby 'Urbie' fool you, it may look like a walking trash can, but it can mount heavy armor and a grown-up-sized Autocannon. R60s aren't known for their speed, but they are very useful if you can draw the enemy into their firing range.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_urbanmech_UM-R60.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Don't let the stubby 'Urbie' fool you, it may look like a walking trash can, but it can mount heavy armor and a grown-up-sized Autocannon. R60s aren't known for their speed, but they are very useful if you can draw the enemy into their firing range.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 别被矮胖的"都市"骗了，它也许看起来像个会走路的垃圾桶，却能装备厚重装甲和成人尺寸的自动炮。R60 不以速度著称，但如果你能把敌人引到它的射程内，它们就非常有用。

Original: This thing barely qualifies as a variant - hell, give me that spare Machine Gun and any standard Urbie and I'll make you a 'C'.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_urbanmech_UM-R60C.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This thing barely qualifies as a variant - hell, give me that spare Machine Gun and any standard Urbie and I'll make you a 'C'.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这东西勉强算是变体——得了，给我那挺备用机枪和任何一台标准"都市"，我就给你造一台"C"。

Original: Meant for close in city fighting, the R60L variant sacrifices armor to upscale its Autocannon 10 to an Autocannon 20.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_urbanmech_UM-R60L.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Meant for close in city fighting, the R60L variant sacrifices armor to upscale its Autocannon 10 to an Autocannon 20.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: R60L 变体为近距离城市战而设，它牺牲装甲把自动炮 10 升级为自动炮 20。

Original: While this is the lightest 'Mech to carry an AC-20 in a stock variant, it isn't geared toward long range or extended engagements.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_urbanmech_UM-R60L.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: While this is the lightest 'Mech to carry an AC-20 in a stock variant, it isn't geared toward long range or extended engagements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 虽然这是标准变体中携带 AC-20 的最轻机甲，它并不适合远程或持久交战。

Original: Meant for close in city fighting, the R60LL replaces its Autocannon 20 with a Ultra version.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_urbanmech_UM-R60LLA.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Meant for close in city fighting, the R60LL replaces its Autocannon 20 with a Ultra version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: R60LL 为城市近战而设，将自动炮 20 换成超速版本。

Original: This UrbanMech has been extensively modified by an apparently madman for reasons unknown. In place of its usual weaponry are a pair of gauss weapons: the Silver Bullet Gauss Rifle providing the main punch and a lone Magshot Gauss Rifle providing quiet backup. To make these weapons possible on the chassis, this Urbie has been made with an Endo-Steel structure and Ferro-Fibrous armor. Truly, the mind that created this was quite unhinged.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_urbanmech_UM-R60SB.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This UrbanMech has been extensively modified by an apparently madman for reasons unknown. In place of its usual weaponry are a pair of gauss weapons: the Silver Bullet Gauss Rifle providing the main punch and a lone Magshot Gauss Rifle providing quiet backup. To make these weapons possible on the chassis, this Urbie has been made with an Endo-Steel structure and Ferro-Fibrous armor. Truly, the mind that created this was quite unhinged.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台城市机甲被某个显然是疯子的人出于不明原因大幅改装。原本的武器被替换为一对高斯武器：银弹高斯步枪提供主要打击，一门单独的磁射高斯步枪提供安静的备用。为在底盘上装下这些武器，这台"城佬"采用了内骨骼结构与铁纤维装甲。创造出它的那个人，心智实在相当不正常。

Original: A Capellan experimental 'variant' that was created when engineers removed the largely superfluous 11th heat sink and installed a Machine Gun with half a ton of ammunition in its place.  While it has no official designation, it is typically referred to as the R60X.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_urbanmech_UM-R60X.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Capellan experimental 'variant' that was created when engineers removed the largely superfluous 11th heat sink and installed a Machine Gun with half a ton of ammunition in its place.  While it has no official designation, it is typically referred to as the R60X.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是卡佩兰的实验性"变体"：工程师移除基本多余的第十一台散热器，并在原位装上一挺机枪和半吨弹药。它没有官方编号，通常被称为 R60X。

Original: Not a bad improvement on the design, but, if it were me, I would have added an extra ton of AC ammo instead to give the trashcan some longevity in the field.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_urbanmech_UM-R60X.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Not a bad improvement on the design, but, if it were me, I would have added an extra ton of AC ammo instead to give the trashcan some longevity in the field.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 设计改进得不错，但要是我的话，我会多装一吨自动炮弹药，让这个垃圾桶在战场上更有持久力。

Original: Meant for close in city fighting the R61L got upgraded with Stealth Equipment alongside its less expensive R60L cousins AC20.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_urbanmech_UM-R61LA.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Meant for close in city fighting the R61L got upgraded with Stealth Equipment alongside its less expensive R60L cousins AC20.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: R61L 为城市近战而设，在较廉价的 R60L 表亲的 AC20 之外，还加装了隐形装备。

Original: Designed by Cataclysm, a former freeborn Clan Wolf MechWarrior turned Mercenary, and infamous UrbanMech fanatic, this refit is designed to be a cost-effective and logistically reliable way to garrison cities. For the price of a single Awesome, one could afford to refit an entire lance of UrbanMechs to the R8Q standard.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_urbanmech_UM-R8QA.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed by Cataclysm, a former freeborn Clan Wolf MechWarrior turned Mercenary, and infamous UrbanMech fanatic, this refit is designed to be a cost-effective and logistically reliable way to garrison cities. For the price of a single Awesome, one could afford to refit an entire lance of UrbanMechs to the R8Q standard.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此改装型由"灾变"设计——一位前自由出身氏族狼机甲战士转行的佣兵，也是臭名昭著的城市机甲狂热分子——旨在提供一种成本效益高、后勤可靠的城池驻防方案。一台卓越的价钱，就足以把整整一个小队的城市机甲改装到 R8Q 标准。

Original: The UM-R90 'SuburbanMech' adapts the traditional UrbanMech R60 into an energy weapon platform for higher performance. Because its weapons aren't limited by ammunition concerns, the R90 is better-suited to longer engagements.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_urbanmech_UM-R90.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The UM-R90 'SuburbanMech' adapts the traditional UrbanMech R60 into an energy weapon platform for higher performance. Because its weapons aren't limited by ammunition concerns, the R90 is better-suited to longer engagements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: UM-R90"郊区机甲"把传统的都市机甲 R60 改造为性能更高的能量武器平台。由于武器不受弹药限制，R90 更适合长时间交战。

Original: This is an UrbanMech variant I've never even heard of before. It's got the same armor as a standard R60, but this R90 is armed entirely with energy weapons, including a PPC for long-range power. I'm not sure why nobody thought of this sooner.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_urbanmech_UM-R90.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is an UrbanMech variant I've never even heard of before. It's got the same armor as a standard R60, but this R90 is armed entirely with energy weapons, including a PPC for long-range power. I'm not sure why nobody thought of this sooner.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是我从未听说过的城市机甲变体。它的装甲与标准 R60 相同，但这台 R90 完全以能量武器武装，包括一门用于远程威力的 PPC。我不明白为什么以前没人想到这个。

Original: A uniquely Lyran take on the VLK-QD, this refit transforms the fire support mech into a light scout hunter with the firepower to engage much heavier prey. The standard LRM is swapped for a streak-6 and a second pulse laser, providing a heavy punch, at the expense of range. Produced by Corean Enterprises at their New Avalon facility exclusively for the Arcturan Guards, the design never saw wide spread deployment. Designed to complement the QD, standard tactics called for mixed lances of QD and QE’s; with the E’s flushing units out for the D’s LRMs and then finishing off damaged opponents. A cheap upgrade, the design had many detractors; most of whom criticised the lack of long range fire power or the over heating issues that stemmed from the refusal to upgrade to DHS. The design ceased production during the FedCom Civil War, with the Guards choosing to invest in newer Lyran made variants following the war.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_valkyrie_VLK-QE.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A uniquely Lyran take on the VLK-QD, this refit transforms the fire support mech into a light scout hunter with the firepower to engage much heavier prey. The standard LRM is swapped for a streak-6 and a second pulse laser, providing a heavy punch, at the expense of range. Produced by Corean Enterprises at their New Avalon facility exclusively for the Arcturan Guards, the design never saw wide spread deployment. Designed to complement the QD, standard tactics called for mixed lances of QD and QE’s; with the E’s flushing units out for the D’s LRMs and then finishing off damaged opponents. A cheap upgrade, the design had many detractors; most of whom criticised the lack of long range fire power or the over heating issues that stemmed from the refusal to upgrade to DHS. The design ceased production during the FedCom Civil War, with the Guards choosing to invest in newer Lyran made variants following the war.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是莱兰对 VLK-QD 的独特演绎，此改装把火力支援机甲变成轻型侦察猎手，具备与远为重型的猎物交战的火力。标准 LRM 换成连续 6 与第二门脉冲激光，提供沉重打击，代价是射程。该设计由科里安企业在其新阿瓦隆工厂为小熊卫队独家生产，从未广泛部署。为与 QD 互补，标准战术要求 QD 与 QE 混编小队；由 E 型把单位逼出来供 D 型的 LRM 打击，然后收拾受损对手。作为一项廉价升级，该设计招致众多批评者；多数人批评其缺乏远程火力，或拒绝升级 DHS 导致的过热问题。该设计在联邦联邦内战期间停产，战后卫队选择投资更新的莱兰制造变体。

Original: The Vapor Eagle features an eclectic and close-ranged weapons load-out, mounting a Large Pulse Laser in its right arm, supported by a single Machine Gun, two Streak SRM-2s and three Medium Pulse Lasers split between its side torsos and rounded out by a trio of Machine Guns in a handgun shaped housing in the left arm. The addition of a Targeting Computer makes its firepower even more deadly as long as it can get its weapons into range. Eleven Double Heat Sinks, half a ton of machine gun ammunition and one Streak missiles are more than adequate for the average Clan trial.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_vaporeagle_VGL-1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Vapor Eagle features an eclectic and close-ranged weapons load-out, mounting a Large Pulse Laser in its right arm, supported by a single Machine Gun, two Streak SRM-2s and three Medium Pulse Lasers split between its side torsos and rounded out by a trio of Machine Guns in a handgun shaped housing in the left arm. The addition of a Targeting Computer makes its firepower even more deadly as long as it can get its weapons into range. Eleven Double Heat Sinks, half a ton of machine gun ammunition and one Streak missiles are more than adequate for the average Clan trial.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蒸汽鹰拥有杂糅而偏近程的武器配置：右臂一门大型脉冲激光，辅以一挺机枪、两具连续 SRM-2 和三门中型脉冲激光分列两侧躯干，左臂手枪形护罩内还有三挺机枪收尾。加装瞄准计算机后，只要武器能进入射程，其火力更为致命。十一台双倍散热器、半吨机枪弹药和一吨连续导弹弹药，对一般的氏族试炼而言绰绰有余。

Original: This variant of the Vapor Eagle removes two of the Medium Pulse Lasers, both Streak Missile pods, and the Large Pulse Laser as well as one of the 'Mechs double heat sinks in exchange for an Ultra Autocannon/10. Mounted in an over the shoulder arrangement like the venerable Shadow Hawk, the weapon fires at twice the rate of a standard Autocannon/10 and carries enough ammunition to continuously fire at its maximum rate of fire for over a minute and a half.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_vaporeagle_VGL-2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant of the Vapor Eagle removes two of the Medium Pulse Lasers, both Streak Missile pods, and the Large Pulse Laser as well as one of the 'Mechs double heat sinks in exchange for an Ultra Autocannon/10. Mounted in an over the shoulder arrangement like the venerable Shadow Hawk, the weapon fires at twice the rate of a standard Autocannon/10 and carries enough ammunition to continuously fire at its maximum rate of fire for over a minute and a half.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 维克多 9S 以其本就不佳的装甲换取更多武器。看到这台机甲从山丘上疾冲而出倾泻可观火力，对敌军而言极为可怕，但它也必须认真地担心任何回击。
重型骑兵 & 近程突击

Original: The Viking began production shortly after the Beowulf in a joint effort by the Free Rasalhague Republic and ComStar. The 'Mech is intended to take over in the role that has been traditionally filled by the Bombardier.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_viking_VKG-2F.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Viking began production shortly after the Beowulf in a joint effort by the Free Rasalhague Republic and ComStar. The 'Mech is intended to take over in the role that has been traditionally filled by the Bombardier.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 维京在贝奥武夫之后不久由自由拉萨尔哈格共和国与康星联合投产。这台机甲意在接替传统上由轰炸机担任的角色。

Original: The Viking has a singular mission of long-range missile fire support. To do this, the Viking carries two Shigunga LRM-15 launchers and two Shigunga LRM-20 launchers, all of which are linked to an Artemis IV fire control system.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_viking_VKG-2F.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Viking has a singular mission of long-range missile fire support. To do this, the Viking carries two Shigunga LRM-15 launchers and two Shigunga LRM-20 launchers, all of which are linked to an Artemis IV fire control system.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 维京有一个明确的任务：远程导弹火力支援。为此，维京携带两具"紫郡"LRM-15 发射器和两具"紫郡"LRM-20 发射器，全部联接一套 Artemis IV 火控系统。

Original: Known as the 'Avenging Angel', the VND-1AA was an attempt to increase the Vindicator's mobility - which succeeded.  However, the cost was to reduce its armor to that of a Light 'Mech.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_vindicator_VND-1AA.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Known as the 'Avenging Angel', the VND-1AA was an attempt to increase the Vindicator's mobility - which succeeded.  However, the cost was to reduce its armor to that of a Light 'Mech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 号称"复仇天使"的 VND-1AA 试图提升维护者的机动性——这一点成功了。然而代价是把它的装甲削减到轻型机甲的水平。

Original: The 3L variant is a basic upgrade using recovered Star League technology.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_vindicator_VND-3L.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3L variant is a basic upgrade using recovered Star League technology.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3L 型号是使用回收的星盟科技的基础升级版。

Original: The 3L variant is a basic upgrade using recovered Star League technology introduced in 3051. The PPC was upgraded to a Ceres Arms Warrior ER PPC and the medium and small lasers have been removed in favor of a single Ceres Arms Model W Medium Pulse Laser. To handle the extra heat from the new ER PPC double heat sinks were added while CASE was installed to protect the LRM's ammunition.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_vindicator_VND-3L.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3L variant is a basic upgrade using recovered Star League technology introduced in 3051. The PPC was upgraded to a Ceres Arms Warrior ER PPC and the medium and small lasers have been removed in favor of a single Ceres Arms Model W Medium Pulse Laser. To handle the extra heat from the new ER PPC double heat sinks were added while CASE was installed to protect the LRM's ammunition.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3L 变体是使用找回的星盟技术的基础升级，于 3051 年推出。PPC 升级为"塞雷斯兵器武士"ER PPC，中型与小型激光被移除，换成一门"塞雷斯兵器 W 型"中型脉冲激光。为处理新 ER PPC 带来的额外热量加装了双倍散热器，并安装 C.A.S.E. 以保护 LRM 的弹药。

Original: The Vulcan is lightly armored at only five tons, though this is typically sufficient when facing infantry forces and its narrow profile makes it a harder target to hit. A cruising speed of 64.8 km/h is enhanced with by six jump jets mounted in the rear of the Vulcan's torso, specially vented to reduce heat build-up in the rear, giving it a jumping range of 180 meters.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_vulcan_VL-2T.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Vulcan is lightly armored at only five tons, though this is typically sufficient when facing infantry forces and its narrow profile makes it a harder target to hit. A cruising speed of 64.8 km/h is enhanced with by six jump jets mounted in the rear of the Vulcan's torso, specially vented to reduce heat build-up in the rear, giving it a jumping range of 180 meters.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 火神装甲轻薄，仅五吨，不过面对步兵部队时通常够用，其狭窄轮廓也使它更难被击中。64.8 公里/小时的巡航速度由六具装在火神躯干后部的跳跃推进器增强，这些喷射器经特殊排气设计以减少后部积热，赋予它 180 米的跳跃距离。

Original: One of the most common of the Vulcan's early variants, the 5T was introduced a year after the original model debuted. It removes the Autocannon/2 and replaces it with three Maxum medium lasers, using the mass saved to add two additional tons of armor. The majority of the Federated Suns' Vulcans were 5T models.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_vulcan_VL-5T.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the most common of the Vulcan's early variants, the 5T was introduced a year after the original model debuted. It removes the Autocannon/2 and replaces it with three Maxum medium lasers, using the mass saved to add two additional tons of armor. The majority of the Federated Suns' Vulcans were 5T models.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5T 是火神早期变体中最常见者之一，在原型号首次亮相一年后推出。它移除自动炮/2，换上三门"马克西姆"中型激光，并用节省的质量增加两吨装甲。联邦太阳系的大多数火神都是 5T 型号。

Original: The 5M Vulcan is an upgrade of the 2T version used by House Marik that makes the 'Mech far more effective in close range combat. The 'Mech uses a Crucis-II Delux Endo Steel chassis and removes the autocannon for a Tronel PPL-20 Large Pulse Laser and also upgrades the Medium Laser to a Tronel XII Medium Pulse Laser. Eleven double heat sinks were also incorporated. This version of the Vulcan began production in 3052 and ceased only with the destruction of Nimakachi's Tematagi plant in 3069.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_vulcan_VT-5M.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5M Vulcan is an upgrade of the 2T version used by House Marik that makes the 'Mech far more effective in close range combat. The 'Mech uses a Crucis-II Delux Endo Steel chassis and removes the autocannon for a Tronel PPL-20 Large Pulse Laser and also upgrades the Medium Laser to a Tronel XII Medium Pulse Laser. Eleven double heat sinks were also incorporated. This version of the Vulcan began production in 3052 and ceased only with the destruction of Nimakachi's Tematagi plant in 3069.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5M 火神是马里克家族所使用 2T 版本的升级，使机甲在近程战斗中有效得多。机甲采用"十字-II 豪华"内骨骼底盘，移除自动炮换成"特罗内尔 PPL-20"大型脉冲激光，并把中型激光升级为"特罗内尔 XII"中型脉冲激光。还加入了十一台双倍散热器。这款火神于 3052 年开始生产，直到 3069 年尼玛卡奇的特马塔吉工厂被毁才停止。

Original: The 5S Vulcan is a 3050 upgrade of the 2T version used by House Steiner which replaces the standard fusion engine with an extralight engine and also upgrades the armor to Lexington Ltd. High Grade Ferro-Fibrous with CASE to protect itself from ammunition explosions. The inclusion of MASC enables the 5S to move up to 129 km/h in short bursts. Additionally, the Autocannon/2 has been replaced with an Imperator Ultra Autocannon/5.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_vulcan_VT-5S.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5S Vulcan is a 3050 upgrade of the 2T version used by House Steiner which replaces the standard fusion engine with an extralight engine and also upgrades the armor to Lexington Ltd. High Grade Ferro-Fibrous with CASE to protect itself from ammunition explosions. The inclusion of MASC enables the 5S to move up to 129 km/h in short bursts. Additionally, the Autocannon/2 has been replaced with an Imperator Ultra Autocannon/5.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5S 火神是施泰纳家族所使用 2T 版本的 3050 升级，它把标准聚变引擎换成超轻型引擎，并将装甲升级为列克星敦公司高等级铁纤维，配 C.A.S.E. 以防弹药爆炸。加装 MASC 使 5S 能在短促爆发中移动至 129 公里/小时。此外，自动炮/2 已换成帝皇超速自动炮/5。

Original: The 5S Vulcan is a 3050 upgrade of the 2T version used by House Steiner which replaces the standard fusion engine with an extralight engine and also upgrades the armor to Lexington Ltd. High Grade Ferro-Fibrous with CASE to protect itself from ammunition explosions. The inclusion of MASC enables the 5S to move up to 129 km/h in short bursts. Additionally, the Autocannon/2 has been replaced with an Imperator Ultra Autocannon/5.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_vulcan_VT-5S.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5S Vulcan is a 3050 upgrade of the 2T version used by House Steiner which replaces the standard fusion engine with an extralight engine and also upgrades the armor to Lexington Ltd. High Grade Ferro-Fibrous with CASE to protect itself from ammunition explosions. The inclusion of MASC enables the 5S to move up to 129 km/h in short bursts. Additionally, the Autocannon/2 has been replaced with an Imperator Ultra Autocannon/5.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5S 火神是施泰纳家族所使用 2T 版本的 3050 升级，它把标准聚变引擎换成超轻型引擎，并将装甲升级为列克星敦公司高等级铁纤维，配 C.A.S.E. 以防弹药爆炸。加装 MASC 使 5S 能在短促爆发中移动至 129 公里/小时。此外，自动炮/2 已换成帝皇超速自动炮/5。

Original: An alteration of the 6R model introduced in 2835, the 6D removed the machine guns and the SRM-6 launcher to add an additional four tons of armor to the design, increasing its leg protection, as well as two more heat sinks. The 6D was particularly favored by the Federated Suns.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_warhammer_WHM-6D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An alteration of the 6R model introduced in 2835, the 6D removed the machine guns and the SRM-6 launcher to add an additional four tons of armor to the design, increasing its leg protection, as well as two more heat sinks. The 6D was particularly favored by the Federated Suns.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 6D 是 2835 年推出的 6R 型号改动版，它移除机枪和 SRM-6 发射器，为设计增加四吨装甲（提升腿部防护）以及两台额外散热器。6D 尤其受联邦太阳系青睐。

Original: One of the mainstays of the heavy 'Mechs.  Solid, dependable, and heavy hitting.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_warhammer_WHM-6D.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the mainstays of the heavy 'Mechs.  Solid, dependable, and heavy hitting.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重型机甲的中坚之一。坚固、可靠、打击力强。

Original: Another basic modification to the Warhammer, the 6K was favored by the Draconis Combine after its introduction in 2830. The 6K removed the machine guns and their volatile ammunition to make room for two heat sinks, allowing it to more easily dissipate waste heat from its PPCs.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_warhammer_WHM-6K.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another basic modification to the Warhammer, the 6K was favored by the Draconis Combine after its introduction in 2830. The 6K removed the machine guns and their volatile ammunition to make room for two heat sinks, allowing it to more easily dissipate waste heat from its PPCs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为战锤的另一项基础改装，6K 在 2830 年推出后受到德拉科尼斯联合体的青睐。6K 移除机枪及其易爆弹药以腾出空间安装两台散热器，使它能更轻易地散发 PPC 产生的废热。

Original: One of the mainstays of the heavy 'Mechs.  Solid, dependable, and heavy hitting.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_warhammer_WHM-6K.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the mainstays of the heavy 'Mechs.  Solid, dependable, and heavy hitting.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重型机甲的中坚之一。坚固、可靠、打击力强。

Original: The 6L was a very basic weapons swap of the 6R model used by Capellan armed forces. Known as the "Hot Hammer" and debuting in 2825, the two machine guns and their ammunition were removed in order to mount two Flamers added for anti-infantry use.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_warhammer_WHM-6L.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 6L was a very basic weapons swap of the 6R model used by Capellan armed forces. Known as the "Hot Hammer" and debuting in 2825, the two machine guns and their ammunition were removed in order to mount two Flamers added for anti-infantry use.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 6L 是卡佩兰武装部队所使用 6R 型号的极基础武器替换。它被称为"热火锤"，于 2825 年首次亮相，移除两挺机枪及其弹药，以安装两具用于反步兵的火焰喷射器。

Original: One of the mainstays of the heavy 'Mechs.  Solid, dependable, and heavy hitting.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_warhammer_WHM-6L.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the mainstays of the heavy 'Mechs.  Solid, dependable, and heavy hitting.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重型机甲的中坚之一。坚固、可靠、打击力强。

Original: The Warhammer BattleMech was introduced by StarCorps Industries in 2515 to be "a mobile 'Mech with enough firepower to destroy or severely damage any 'Mech of the same weight class or lower." In the mission it was designed for, the Warhammer proved to be a very capable 'Mech, and for centuries practically defined the entire class of heavy 'Mechs. Boasting incredible firepower and respectable armoring, the Warhammer served prominently in the Star League Defense Force and was one of the premier 'Mechs in the Gunslinger Program. Indeed, many of the greatest MechWarriors in history were Warhammer pilots.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_warhammer_WHM-6R.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Warhammer BattleMech was introduced by StarCorps Industries in 2515 to be "a mobile 'Mech with enough firepower to destroy or severely damage any 'Mech of the same weight class or lower." In the mission it was designed for, the Warhammer proved to be a very capable 'Mech, and for centuries practically defined the entire class of heavy 'Mechs. Boasting incredible firepower and respectable armoring, the Warhammer served prominently in the Star League Defense Force and was one of the premier 'Mechs in the Gunslinger Program. Indeed, many of the greatest MechWarriors in history were Warhammer pilots.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战锤战斗机甲由星团公司于 2515 年推出，定位为"一台具备足够火力摧毁或重创任何同重量级或更低级机甲的机动型机甲"。在其设计所针对的任务中，战锤被证明是一台极为出色的机甲，并在数世纪里几乎定义了整个重型机甲类别。凭借惊人的火力与可观的装甲，战锤在星盟防卫军中表现突出，也是"枪手计划"中的首要机甲之一。事实上，历史上许多最伟大的机甲战士都是战锤飞行员。

Original: One of the mainstays of the heavy 'Mechs.  Solid, dependable, and heavy hitting.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_warhammer_WHM-6R.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the mainstays of the heavy 'Mechs.  Solid, dependable, and heavy hitting.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重型机甲的中坚之一。坚固、可靠、打击力强。

Original: The Warhammer-6Rb is a variant made for the Star League's Royal regiments. Highly similar to the Warhammer-6R, the -6Rb's differences lie in the armor and heat dissipation systems that have been upgraded to the Star League standard with Ferro-Fibrous and double heat sinks respectively.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_warhammer_WHM-6Rb.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Warhammer-6Rb is a variant made for the Star League's Royal regiments. Highly similar to the Warhammer-6R, the -6Rb's differences lie in the armor and heat dissipation systems that have been upgraded to the Star League standard with Ferro-Fibrous and double heat sinks respectively.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战锤-6Rb 是为星盟皇家团打造的变体。它与战锤-6R 高度相似，-6Rb 的差异在于装甲与散热系统分别升级为星盟标准的铁纤维和双倍散热器。

Original: The Warhammer-6Rb was the first Royal Warhammer but the -7A takes the mech to its logical conclusion. With advanced weapons and construction materials, combined with double heat sinks, the Warhammer-7A is a walking death machine for mechs and vehicles alike.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_warhammer_WHM-7A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Warhammer-6Rb was the first Royal Warhammer but the -7A takes the mech to its logical conclusion. With advanced weapons and construction materials, combined with double heat sinks, the Warhammer-7A is a walking death machine for mechs and vehicles alike.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战锤-6Rb 是首款皇家战锤，但-7A 把这款机甲推向其逻辑终点。凭借先进武器与建造材料，加上双倍散热器，战锤-7A 是行走的死亡机器，对机甲与车辆一视同仁。

Original: The original Warhammer was designed as an assault BattleMech. However, it had been superseded by later and heavier 'Mech designs, though it remained a powerful weapons platform. The Clans wisely maintained and built on this solid frame a real assault 'Mech, the Warhammer IIC. This variant turns the Warhammer IIC into a fire support 'Mech. Clan scientists replaced the Medium Pulse Lasers with a pair of LRM-15s and four tons of ammunition.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_warhammer_WHM-IIC-2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Warhammer was designed as an assault BattleMech. However, it had been superseded by later and heavier 'Mech designs, though it remained a powerful weapons platform. The Clans wisely maintained and built on this solid frame a real assault 'Mech, the Warhammer IIC. This variant turns the Warhammer IIC into a fire support 'Mech. Clan scientists replaced the Medium Pulse Lasers with a pair of LRM-15s and four tons of ammunition.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初的战锤被设计为突击战斗机甲。尽管后来被更重的机甲设计取代，它仍是一个强大的武器平台。氏族明智地在这一坚固框架上维护并建造出真正的突击机甲——战锤 IIC。此变体将战锤 IIC 改造为火力支援机甲。氏族科学家将中型脉冲激光换成两具 LRM-15 和四吨弹药。

Original: The original Warhammer was designed as an assault BattleMech. However, it had been superseded by later and heavier 'Mech designs, though it remained a powerful weapons platform. The Clans wisely maintained and built on this solid frame a real assault 'Mech, the Warhammer IIC. Designed by Clan Diamond Shark, this variant replaces the PPCs and missile launcher of the original design with a pair of arm-mounted Heavy Large Lasers, two additional heat sinks, and a half ton of armor. An advanced Targeting Computer was also added to help ensure that the hard-to-use heavy lasers hit.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_warhammer_WHM-IIC-3.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Warhammer was designed as an assault BattleMech. However, it had been superseded by later and heavier 'Mech designs, though it remained a powerful weapons platform. The Clans wisely maintained and built on this solid frame a real assault 'Mech, the Warhammer IIC. Designed by Clan Diamond Shark, this variant replaces the PPCs and missile launcher of the original design with a pair of arm-mounted Heavy Large Lasers, two additional heat sinks, and a half ton of armor. An advanced Targeting Computer was also added to help ensure that the hard-to-use heavy lasers hit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初的战锤被设计为突击战斗机甲。尽管后来被更重的机甲设计取代，它仍是一个强大的武器平台。氏族明智地在这一坚固框架上维护并建造出真正的突击机甲——战锤 IIC。此变体由钻石鲨氏族设计，将原设计中的 PPC 与导弹发射器换成一对臂载重型大型激光、两台额外散热器和半吨装甲。还加装了先进瞄准计算机以确保难以驾驭的重型激光能够命中。

Original: This variant, used by the SLDF, has a LTV 150 engine, slightly lower maximum ground speed (84km/h), a 120 meter jump capability, and replaces the SRM-2 with a rear-facing One-Shot version. Original: Developed by General Mechanics on Mars in 2464 as the first generation Wasp, this version used several primitive components. The primitive engine reduced the top speed to 85 km/h and meant that only a single medium laser was carried. The prototype jump jets could only cover 150 meters in a jump. The primitive armor provided much less protection than the later Succession Wars-era Wasps, even though it carried three and a half tons of armor.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_wasp_WSP-1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed by General Mechanics on Mars in 2464 as the first generation Wasp, this version used several primitive components. The primitive engine reduced the top speed to 85 km/h and meant that only a single medium laser was carried. The prototype jump jets could only cover 150 meters in a jump. The primitive armor provided much less protection than the later Succession Wars-era Wasps, even though it carried three and a half tons of armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此版本由通用机械于 2464 年在火星开发，是第一代黄蜂，使用了若干原始组件。原始引擎把最高速度降至 85 公里/小时，且只能携带一门中型激光。原型跳跃推进器一次只能跳 150 米。尽管携带三吨半装甲，原始装甲提供的保护远不如后来的继承战争时代黄蜂。

Original: Designed as a fast, jump-capable reconnaissance platform, the Wasp has served capably in that role for well over half a millennium, a testament to the utility of the original design.

Original: A common Periphery rebuild, this mech is a mix of different weapons systems. A primitive medium laser copied from the original Wasp model provides subpar fire power, backed up by the one shot punch of an RL15. A small calibre rifle makes for a semi effective sniper weapon whilst its ammo lasts. The rest of the mech is almost standard spec, rebuilt by a succession of engineers to specs nearly identical to Inner Sphere counterparts. Surprisingly enough, this rebuild offers somewhat superior capabilities compared to most Inner Sphere models. Produced in any number of Periphery junk yards and back alley chop shops, this mech is incredibly common amongst periphery factions;  who field the mech in vast quantities, praising its cheap firepower and easily repaired chassis.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_wasp_WSP-1P.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A common Periphery rebuild, this mech is a mix of different weapons systems. A primitive medium laser copied from the original Wasp model provides subpar fire power, backed up by the one shot punch of an RL15. A small calibre rifle makes for a semi effective sniper weapon whilst its ammo lasts. The rest of the mech is almost standard spec, rebuilt by a succession of engineers to specs nearly identical to Inner Sphere counterparts. Surprisingly enough, this rebuild offers somewhat superior capabilities compared to most Inner Sphere models. Produced in any number of Periphery junk yards and back alley chop shops, this mech is incredibly common amongst periphery factions;  who field the mech in vast quantities, praising its cheap firepower and easily repaired chassis.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一款常见的外围区重建型，混合了不同的武器系统。仿自原版黄蜂的原始中型激光提供欠佳的火力，辅以 RL15 的一次性打击。小口径步枪在弹药耗尽前算是半有效的狙击武器。机甲其余部分几乎是标准规格，由历任工程师重建至与内天体同类几乎相同的规格。相当令人惊讶的是，这款重建型的能力比大多数内天体型号略胜一筹。它在外围区无数废品场和后巷改装铺中生产，在外围势力中极为普遍；这些势力大量列装该机甲，称赞其廉价的火力与易于修理的底盘。

Original: An improved 1-P, this upgrade package uses scavenged tech to improve the 1-Ps scouting ability.  Using minimal upgrades, all purchased or acquired at great cost, this refit package is available for anyone with the contacts or cash to afford it. The new active probe is capable of spotting most threats long before they can see the Wasp, whilst the removal of the RL-15 takes away most of it’s offence punch, it allows for the addition of a knock-off AMS system to better protect the mech. Endo Steel is used to provide the weight savings for the probe, though it’s limited availability and high cost limit the number of these conversions produced. Popular among pilots and the chop shop owners refitting them, this upgrade is expected to spread through the Periphery in the near future, as the technology required becomes easier to acquire.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_wasp_WSP-1P2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An improved 1-P, this upgrade package uses scavenged tech to improve the 1-Ps scouting ability.  Using minimal upgrades, all purchased or acquired at great cost, this refit package is available for anyone with the contacts or cash to afford it. The new active probe is capable of spotting most threats long before they can see the Wasp, whilst the removal of the RL-15 takes away most of it’s offence punch, it allows for the addition of a knock-off AMS system to better protect the mech. Endo Steel is used to provide the weight savings for the probe, though it’s limited availability and high cost limit the number of these conversions produced. Popular among pilots and the chop shop owners refitting them, this upgrade is expected to spread through the Periphery in the near future, as the technology required becomes easier to acquire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为改进型 1-P，这套升级套件使用收集来的技术提升 1-P 的侦察能力。它只做最小幅度的升级，所有部件都以高价购得或获取，这套改装套件可供任何有门路或有钱的人使用。新的主动探测器能在大多数威胁看到黄蜂之前很久就发现它们；移除 RL-15 虽然带走了大部分进攻打击力，却允许加装一套仿制 AMS 系统以更好地保护机甲。内骨骼用于为探测器腾出重量，尽管其有限的可得性与高成本限制了此类改装的产量。它在飞行员和改装它们的改装铺老板中都很受欢迎，预计随着所需技术更易获取，这套升级将在不久的将来传遍外围区。

Original: Standing at ten meters tall, the Watchman is a 'Mech that was born of necessity. The idea for the design came when the bulk of the AFFS was moved to the Clan front. Because this seriously undermined the ability of the Federated Suns to keep its borders secure, the Watchman was designed to be distributed to militia units within the border marches to bulk up their strength. In its own right the Watchman is a durable and reliable 'Mech that is built with off the shelf components and is very easy to repair. The 'Mech is armored with eight and a half tons of standard armor, has a top speed of 86.4 km/h, and can jump up to one hundred and fifty meters. This, combined with the Watchman's varied arsenal, makes it an excellent trooper or trainer.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_watchman_WTC-4M.Details

Original: The Whitworth is something of an ugly duckling, known among both critics and fans as the Tin Woodsman. It was originally produced in 2610 as a BattleMech that was meant to fill the weight gap between the lighter Wasp and the heavier Phoenix Hawk 'Mechs. The Whitworth, though, is slower than either of these designs by over 30 km/h and plagued with a faulty actuator system in its hips and legs which could cause the legs to tear loose during strenuous maneuvers. Replacing the actuators would require a complete reworking of the lower half of the torso and leg assembly. However, the Whitworth carried eight tons of armor, utilized four reliable Whitworth Jetlift jump jets split between both legs for improved mobility, and featured excellent long-range firepower. The result was a 'Mech which could stand up in combat to another 'Mech of its equivalent mass and less. The original WTH-1S Whitworth model saw combat in the Age of War, however since it was armed with SRMs, many were lost when their pilots rushed into close-range combat to effectively use them. The Whitworth's lack of hand actuators, low speed curve, poor armor distribution and less-than-effective weapon loadout doomed them to the scrap pile. At the insistence of the Star League, the Whitworth Company replaced these weapons with LRMs in 2689 and the WTH-1 would serve in the Star League Defense Force as an able if mediocre scout and light strike platform. Whitworths often took part in reconnaissance-in-force missions and raids against well-defended areas, often alongside Wolverines and Phoenix Hawks, or provided fire support for heavy attack forces with Riflemans and Warhammers.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_whitworth_WTH-0.Details

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 惠特沃斯有点像丑小鸭，被批评者和爱好者共同称为"铁皮伐木工"。它最初于 2610 年生产，旨在填补较轻的黄蜂与较重的凤凰鹰机甲之间的重量空缺。然而惠特沃斯比这两款设计都慢 30 多公里/小时，且髋部与腿部的驱动器系统存在故障，在剧烈机动时可能导致腿部脱落。要更换驱动器，必须彻底重做躯干下半部与腿组。不过惠特沃斯携带八吨装甲，使用四个可靠的惠特沃斯 Jetlift 跳跃推进器（分列双腿）以提升机动性，并具备出色的远程火力。结果是一款能在战斗中与同级乃至更轻的机甲抗衡的机体。最初的 WTH-1S 型惠特沃斯曾在战争时代参战，但由于装备 SRM，许多在飞行员冲入近距离以有效使用时被击毁。惠特沃斯缺乏手部驱动器、速度曲线低、装甲分布不佳以及武器配置不够有效，都注定它被丢进废料堆。在星盟的坚持下，惠特沃斯公司于 2689 年将这些武器换为 LRM，WTH-1 遂作为称职但平庸的侦察与轻型打击平台在星盟防卫军服役。惠特沃斯常参与武力侦察任务和对防御严密地区的突袭，常与狼獾和凤凰鹰同行，或以步枪手和战锤为重装突击部队提供火力支援。

Original: This incredibly rare version of the Whitworth was made exclusively for the Amaris Dragoons in 2754 as a terror weapon. Only twenty-four of these variants were ever built by Whitworth's Republic branch, carrying two SRM-6 racks in place of the LRM-10 launchers along with fourteen heat sinks and replacing the left arm laser with a Flamer. These Whitworths were painted matte black and became infamous for razing entire cities with their inferno-loaded SRMs and flamers.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_whitworth_WTH-0.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款极其罕见的惠特沃斯版本于 2754 年专为阿马里斯龙骑兵作为恐怖武器制造。惠特沃斯的共和国分厂仅建造了二十四台此类变体，以两具 SRM-6 挂架取代 LRM-10 发射器，配十四台散热器，并把左臂激光换成火焰喷射器。这些惠特沃斯涂成哑光黑，因其燃烧弹头 SRM 和火焰喷射器夷平整座城市而臭名昭著。

Original: The Whitworth carries as its primary weapons two Longbow LRM-10 launchers with one ton of ammo each in both right and left torsos. These missile launchers allow the Whitworth to strike an enemy at long ranges with a moderate amount of missiles. While against heavier units it is somewhat effective, when used to provide LRM support to a recon lance, the Whitworth's LRMs can deter pursuit by other light units. For secondary weapons, the Whitworth has three Intek Medium Lasers, one mounted in the head and in either arm, that allow it to effectively defend itself from units of the same weight class and lighter at short ranges.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_whitworth_WTH-1.YangsThoughts

However since this loadout encourages a close combat approach for which the 'Mech is grossly ill-equipped, these were phased out and the variant remains extremely rare.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是惠特沃斯在星盟军中服役之前的原始量产型号。两具 LRM-10 导弹发射器被换成两具 SRM-6 发射器和四台额外散热器，让机甲战士拥有更好的散热管理能力。然而，由于这种载荷鼓励近战，而机甲在这方面严重不足，这些型号被逐步淘汰，该变体如今极为罕见。

Original: The Whitworth is something of an ugly duckling, known among both critics and fans as the Tin Woodsman. It was originally produced in 2610 as a BattleMech that was meant to fill the weight gap between the lighter Wasp and the heavier Phoenix Hawk 'Mechs. The Whitworth, though, is slower than either of these designs by over 30 km/h and plagued with a faulty actuator system in its hips and legs which could cause the legs to tear loose during strenuous maneuvers. Replacing the actuators would require a complete reworking of the lower half of the torso and leg assembly. However, the Whitworth carried eight tons of armor, utilized four reliable Whitworth Jetlift jump jets split between both legs for improved mobility, and featured excellent long-range firepower. The result was a 'Mech which could stand up in combat to another 'Mech of its equivalent mass and less. The original WTH-1S Whitworth model saw combat in the Age of War, however since it was armed with SRMs, many were lost when their pilots rushed into close-range combat to effectively use them. The Whitworth's lack of hand actuators, low speed curve, poor armor distribution and less-than-effective weapon loadout doomed them to the scrap pile. At the insistence of the Star League, the Whitworth Company replaced these weapons with LRMs in 2689 and the WTH-1 would serve in the Star League Defense Force as an able if mediocre scout and light strike platform. Whitworths often took part in reconnaissance-in-force missions and raids against well-defended areas, often alongside Wolverines and Phoenix Hawks, or provided fire support for heavy attack forces with Riflemans and Warhammers.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_whitworth_WTH-2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 惠特沃斯有点像丑小鸭，被批评者和爱好者共同称为"铁皮伐木工"。它最初于 2610 年生产，旨在填补较轻的黄蜂与较重的凤凰鹰机甲之间的重量空缺。然而惠特沃斯比这两款设计都慢 30 多公里/小时，且髋部与腿部的驱动器系统存在故障，在剧烈机动时可能导致腿部脱落。要更换驱动器，必须彻底重做躯干下半部与腿组。不过惠特沃斯携带八吨装甲，使用四个可靠的惠特沃斯 Jetlift 跳跃推进器（分列双腿）以提升机动性，并具备出色的远程火力。结果是一款能在战斗中与同级乃至更轻的机甲抗衡的机体。最初的 WTH-1S 型惠特沃斯曾在战争时代参战，但由于装备 SRM，许多在飞行员冲入近距离以有效使用时被击毁。惠特沃斯缺乏手部驱动器、速度曲线低、装甲分布不佳以及武器配置不够有效，都注定它被丢进废料堆。在星盟的坚持下，惠特沃斯公司于 2689 年将这些武器换为 LRM，WTH-1 遂作为称职但平庸的侦察与轻型打击平台在星盟防卫军服役。惠特沃斯常参与武力侦察任务和对防御严密地区的突袭，常与狼獾和凤凰鹰同行，或以步枪手和战锤为重装突击部队提供火力支援。

The 6T was also meant to act as anti-pirate garrison 'Mech, utilizing its long range AC/5 and LRM-5 combo to engage raiders at range.  While the swap out of the Medium Laser for a Small Laser and the addition of two Machine Guns allow this Wolverine variant to better engage with the light vehicles and infantry common to raiding forces.

Original: The 7D variant of the Wolverine is a major upgrade to the design introduced in 3050 by the Federated Suns' new Nanking factory. The standard engine on the 'Mech was replaced with a Nissan 275 XLversion and the armor has been upgraded to Kallon Unity Weave Ferro-Fibrous material with an extra half-ton added. To increase the Wolverine's speed, MASC has been added, allowing it to move up to 108 km/h in bursts. Finally, the weapons payload has been upgraded as well. The autocannon has been upgraded to a General Motors Nova-5 Ultra Autocannon/5 and the medium laser is now a Sutel Precision Line Medium Pulse Laser. The design retains its jumping capability, as well as the SRM-6, although CASE now protects the SRM reloads

Original: The Wraith marked Curtiss Militech's entry into BattleMech production. When the design was announced, many felt that the design would be little more than a walking water cooler. What the critics got was a shock. The Wraith is a 'Mech that, when properly employed, can wreak havoc on an enemy with its astounding speed and maneuverability. It is built around a massive LTV 385 XL Engine that allows it to reach speeds of just under 119 kph. The Wraith has a simple, yet effective, pulse weapons payload. Pulse laser weaponry allows the Mech to negate most of the side effects on accuracy that are introduced by the Wraith's heavy use of jump jets, making it incredibly accurate and powerful for such a lightly armed Mech.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_wraith_TR-1.Details

It is built around a massive LTV 385 XL Engine that allows it to reach speeds of just under 119 kph. The Wraith has a simple, yet effective, pulse weapons payload. Pulse laser weaponry allows the Mech to negate most of the side effects on accuracy that are introduced by the Wraith's heavy use of jump jets, making it incredibly accurate and powerful for such a lightly armed Mech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 幽灵标志着柯蒂斯军工进军战斗机甲生产。该设计公布时，许多人以为它不过是台会走路的水冷器。批评者得到的却是震惊。若运用得当，幽灵能凭借惊人的速度与机动性在敌阵中肆虐。它以庞大的 LTV 385 XL 引擎为核心，速度可达略低于 119 公里/小时。幽灵配有简单却有效的脉冲武器配置。脉冲激光武器能让机甲抵消跳跃推进器大量使用所带来的大部分精度副作用，使这款轻武装机甲变得异常精准而强大。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A relatively new development, the Zeus 6TS removes the Autocannon and replaces it with a PPC.  To help mitigate the additional heat, 2 Heat Sinks were also added.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 宙斯 6TS 是相对较新的发展，它移除自动炮，换成一门 PPC。为帮助缓解额外热量，还加装了 2 台散热器。

Original: An experiment in logistical support, the Zeus 6Y retains the AC5, but downgrades the LRM15 to a LRM10.  This allowed for the Large Laser to be 'upgraded' to a Binary Laser Cannon.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_zeus_ZEU-6Y.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An experiment in logistical support, the Zeus 6Y retains the AC5, but downgrades the LRM15 to a LRM10.  This allowed for the Large Laser to be 'upgraded' to a Binary Laser Cannon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为后勤支援的一次实验，宙斯 6Y 保留 AC5，但把 LRM15 降级为 LRM10。这使得大型激光得以"升级"为一门双联激光炮。
火力支援 & 远距离突击

Original: 'Upgraded' my ass.  For the weight and heat, I'd suggest we rip out that Binary Laser Cannon and let me slap two Large Lasers in there.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_zeus_ZEU-6Y.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: 'Upgraded' my ass.  For the weight and heat, I'd suggest we rip out that Binary Laser Cannon and let me slap two Large Lasers in there.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: "升级"个屁。就这重量和热量，我建议我们把那门双联激光炮拆掉，让我塞两门大型激光进去。

Original: The Zeus IS moves faster than many other assault 'Mech, but mounts mostly low tech, cheap industrial weapons. Still, it's well armoured, and a common sight among the more broke and disgraced units in the Periphery.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_zeus_ZEU-IS.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Zeus IS moves faster than many other assault 'Mech, but mounts mostly low tech, cheap industrial weapons. Still, it's well armoured, and a common sight among the more broke and disgraced units in the Periphery.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 宙斯 IS 比许多其他突击机甲都快，但主要装备低技术、廉价的工业武器。不过它装甲良好，在外围区较穷困落魄的部队中很常见。
火力支援 & 远距离突击

Original: The Zeus IS moves faster than many other assault 'Mech, but mounts mostly low tech, cheap industrial weapons. Still, it's well armoured, and a common sight among the more broke and disgraced units in the Periphery.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_zeus_ZEU-IS.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Zeus IS moves faster than many other assault 'Mech, but mounts mostly low tech, cheap industrial weapons. Still, it's well armoured, and a common sight among the more broke and disgraced units in the Periphery.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 宙斯 IS 比许多其他突击机甲都快，但主要装备低技术、廉价的工业武器。不过它装甲良好，在外围区较穷困落魄的部队中很常见。

Original: For a mech of just 35 tons this little turtle sports a lot of long range fire support in the form of FORTY LRM tubes, which can scare away even much much larger enemies. For close range, self defense or a last effort push if the ammo bins are empty, the ADR-A carries 2 Small Pulse Lasers and the standard Flamer.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_adder_ADR-A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: For a mech of just 35 tons this little turtle sports a lot of long range fire support in the form of FORTY LRM tubes, which can scare away even much much larger enemies. For close range, self defense or a last effort push if the ammo bins are empty, the ADR-A carries 2 Small Pulse Lasers and the standard Flamer.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 区区 35 吨的小乌龟却拥有大量远程火力支援——四十个 LRM 发射管，足以吓退远比它庞大的敌人。近程自卫、或在弹药打空时的最后一搏，ADR-A 携带 2 门小型脉冲激光和标准火焰喷射器。

Original: Every time the Adder-B is spotted you can't stop wondering how the clans fit all that firepower on a tiny 35 ton chassis. With an extremely accurate Large Pulse Laser this mid to long range configuration softens up the armor of an enemy to finish it at medium range with its powerful LB-X AC/5, backed up by a pair of ERML's. Never underestimate the power of an ADR-B, it might be a mistake you can't recover from..
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_adder_ADR-B.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Every time the Adder-B is spotted you can't stop wondering how the clans fit all that firepower on a tiny 35 ton chassis. With an extremely accurate Large Pulse Laser this mid to long range configuration softens up the armor of an enemy to finish it at medium range with its powerful LB-X AC/5, backed up by a pair of ERML's. Never underestimate the power of an ADR-B, it might be a mistake you can't recover from..
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 每次看到 Adder-B，你都会忍不住想知道氏族是怎么把那么多火力塞进区区 35 吨底盘的。凭借一门极其精准的大型脉冲激光，这套中远程配置能软化敌方装甲，然后在中距离以强力 LB-X AC/5 予以了结，另有两门 ER 中型激光支援。永远不要低估一台 ADR-B 的实力，那可能是个你无法挽回的错误。

Original: As a slightly lighter armed long range bombardment variant, the Adder-C 'only' sports two LRM-15 launchers as the main armament...but also has an additional launcher for a NARC Homing Beacons. You can't hide anywhere if you have one of those stuck on your hull. For CQC and as a non ammo-dependent backup weapon, a single Medium Pulse Laser can absolutely ruin the day for ambushers who think the LRM support mech might be an easy kill.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_adder_ADR-C.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As a slightly lighter armed long range bombardment variant, the Adder-C 'only' sports two LRM-15 launchers as the main armament...but also has an additional launcher for a NARC Homing Beacons. You can't hide anywhere if you have one of those stuck on your hull. For CQC and as a non ammo-dependent backup weapon, a single Medium Pulse Laser can absolutely ruin the day for ambushers who think the LRM support mech might be an easy kill.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一款搭载略轻武装的远程轰炸变体，Adder-C"仅仅"以两具 LRM-15 发射器为主武器……不过还多装了一具发射 NARC 自导信标的发射器。只要有那玩意儿粘在你船壳上，你无处可藏。用于近距近战并作为不依赖弹药的备用武器，一门中型脉冲激光足以彻底毁掉那些以为这台 LRM 支援机甲是软柿子的伏击者的好日子。

Original: Sticking to the general theme for this rather slow 35 tonner, the Adder-D fields a mid to long range setup in form of an ER Large Laser and an Ultra Autocannon/5. The ADR-D will try to keep its distance and open up components from a safe distance before it moves in to finish the job with a set of Streak SRM-2's.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_adder_ADR-D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sticking to the general theme for this rather slow 35 tonner, the Adder-D fields a mid to long range setup in form of an ER Large Laser and an Ultra Autocannon/5. The ADR-D will try to keep its distance and open up components from a safe distance before it moves in to finish the job with a set of Streak SRM-2's.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 秉持这款相当缓慢的 35 吨机体的总体主题，Adder-D 以一门 ER 大型激光和一门超速自动炮/5 构成中远程配置。ADR-D 会尽量保持距离，在安全距离上打开对手的部件孔洞，然后推进以一组连续 SRM-2 收尾。

Original: Codenamed Puma by Inner Sphere forces who first engaged it, the Adder is a light Clan OmniMech that serves as a direct or an indirect fire-support unit in most of its configurations.The Primary configuration has a basic but powerful arsenal of two ER PPCs which are linked to an advanced Targeting Computer, allowing the Primary configuration of the Adder to strike at long range with deadly accuracy, this is alongside the standard flamer.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_adder_ADR-Prime.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Codenamed Puma by Inner Sphere forces who first engaged it, the Adder is a light Clan OmniMech that serves as a direct or an indirect fire-support unit in most of its configurations.The Primary configuration has a basic but powerful arsenal of two ER PPCs which are linked to an advanced Targeting Computer, allowing the Primary configuration of the Adder to strike at long range with deadly accuracy, this is alongside the standard flamer.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 被首次交战的内天体部队代号为"美洲狮"，蝰蛇是一款轻型氏族全能机甲，在多数配置中充当直接或间接火力支援单位。主配置装备一套基础但强大的两门 ER PPC，联接一台先进瞄准计算机，使蝰蛇主配置能以致命精度在远距离打击，此外还配有标准火焰喷射器。

Original: The Albatross was designed by the Free Worlds League in 3053 with an eye toward a possible future conflict with the then advancing Clans. The 'Mech is built using a Hermes 380 XL Engine to minimize weight and maximize free tonnage for its weapon loadout. The Albatross also uses a variety of weapons in an attempt to make the 'Mech effective at any range. The 'Mech has average mobility with a maximum speed of 64.8 kph and also makes use of double heat sinks for their greater heat dissipation capability.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_albatross_ALB-3U.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Albatross was designed by the Free Worlds League in 3053 with an eye toward a possible future conflict with the then advancing Clans. The 'Mech is built using a Hermes 380 XL Engine to minimize weight and maximize free tonnage for its weapon loadout. The Albatross also uses a variety of weapons in an attempt to make the 'Mech effective at any range. The 'Mech has average mobility with a maximum speed of 64.8 kph and also makes use of double heat sinks for their greater heat dissipation capability.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 信天翁由自由世界联盟于 3053 年设计，着眼点是与当时正在推进的氏族可能发生的未来冲突。机甲采用一台赫尔墨斯 380 XL 引擎建造，以最小化重量并为武器载荷最大化可用吨位。信天翁还使用多种武器，力图使机甲在任何距离上都有效。机甲机动性中等，最高速度 64.8 公里/小时，并使用双倍散热器以获得更强的散热能力。

Original: Originally developed in the final year of the Amaris Civil War as the ultimate fixed position city defense BattleMech, the Annihilator was built as a sign of the military strength of the Star League in Exile. The -1A was armed with four Autocannon/10s and four Medium Lasers. While less accurate than the original -2A, the 1A was still a highly destructive and dangerous 'Mech that no MechWarrior looked forward to engaging.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_annihilator_ANH-1A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally developed in the final year of the Amaris Civil War as the ultimate fixed position city defense BattleMech, the Annihilator was built as a sign of the military strength of the Star League in Exile. The -1A was armed with four Autocannon/10s and four Medium Lasers. While less accurate than the original -2A, the 1A was still a highly destructive and dangerous 'Mech that no MechWarrior looked forward to engaging.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 歼灭者最初在阿马里斯内战最后一年被开发为终极固定阵地城市防御战斗机甲，作为流亡星盟军事实力的象征而建造。-1A 装备四门自动炮/10 和四门中型激光。虽然精度不如原版-2A，1A 仍是破坏力惊人、危险至极的机甲，没有哪个机甲战士愿意与它交战。

Original: Still a fearsome and powerful design, where the original Annihilator-1A carries a bevy of powerful autocannons, the -1E instead opts for an all-energy weapon loadout. Four Particle Projection Cannons give the Annihilator-1E a brutal and incredibly powerful punch while the Medium Lasers from the -1A are carried over for in-close protection while increasing the armor protection somewhat to mitigate enemy return fire.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_annihilator_ANH-1E.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Still a fearsome and powerful design, where the original Annihilator-1A carries a bevy of powerful autocannons, the -1E instead opts for an all-energy weapon loadout. Four Particle Projection Cannons give the Annihilator-1E a brutal and incredibly powerful punch while the Medium Lasers from the -1A are carried over for in-close protection while increasing the armor protection somewhat to mitigate enemy return fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 歼灭者仍是令人生畏的强大设计，原版歼灭者-1A 携带大量强力自动炮，而-1E 则选择全能量武器配置。四门粒子投射炮赋予歼灭者-1E 残暴而惊人的打击力，而-1A 的中型激光被保留用于近身防护，同时装甲防护略有提升以缓解敌方还击。

Original: Originally developed in the final year of the Amaris Civil War as the ultimate fixed position city defense BattleMech, the Annihilator was built as a sign of the military strength of both the Star League in Exile and the newly created Clans.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_annihilator_ANH-2A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally developed in the final year of the Amaris Civil War as the ultimate fixed position city defense BattleMech, the Annihilator was built as a sign of the military strength of both the Star League in Exile and the newly created Clans.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 歼灭者最初在阿马里斯内战最后一年开发，作为终极固定阵地城市防御战斗机甲，它的建造是流亡星盟与新生的氏族双方军事实力的象征。

Original: Originally developed in the final year of the Amaris Civil War as the ultimate fixed position city defense BattleMech, the Annihilator was built as a sign of the military strength of both the Star League in Exile and the newly created Clans.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_annihilator_clan.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally developed in the final year of the Amaris Civil War as the ultimate fixed position city defense BattleMech, the Annihilator was built as a sign of the military strength of both the Star League in Exile and the newly created Clans.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 歼灭者最初在阿马里斯内战最后一年开发，作为终极固定阵地城市防御战斗机甲，它的建造是流亡星盟与新生的氏族双方军事实力的象征。

Original: The Apollo is designed to be a long range fire support BattleMech. This is accomplished by mounting an engine on the 'Mech that gives it a top speed of only 64.8 kph and eleven and a half tons of armor. The 'Mech was then armed with massive missile launchers which can rain destruction down on an enemy. While the Apollo has less than average speed for a medium 'Mech, if it is employed correctly the Apollo should have nothing to fear from enemy fire; it is fully capable of staying at the edge of the battlefield and laying down suppressive LRM fire.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_apollo_APL-1M.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Apollo is designed to be a long range fire support BattleMech. This is accomplished by mounting an engine on the 'Mech that gives it a top speed of only 64.8 kph and eleven and a half tons of armor. The 'Mech was then armed with massive missile launchers which can rain destruction down on an enemy. While the Apollo has less than average speed for a medium 'Mech, if it is employed correctly the Apollo should have nothing to fear from enemy fire; it is fully capable of staying at the edge of the battlefield and laying down suppressive LRM fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿波罗被设计为远程火力支援战斗机甲。为此它搭载的引擎仅能提供 64.8 公里/小时的最高速度和十一吨半装甲。随后它装备了巨型导弹发射器，可将毁灭倾泻到敌人头上。虽然阿波罗的速度低于中型机甲平均水平，但只要运用得当，它便无需惧怕敌方火力；它完全能停留在战场边缘，倾泻压制性 LRM 火力。

Original: The 2K Archer was a modification built for House Kurita in 2856, designed to increase its direct firepower capability and give it more staying power on the battlefield once it had run out of ammunition
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_archer_ARC-2K.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 2K Archer was a modification built for House Kurita in 2856, designed to increase its direct firepower capability and give it more staying power on the battlefield once it had run out of ammunition
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2K 弓箭手是 2856 年为库瑞塔家族建造的改装型，旨在提升其直射火力，并在弹药耗尽后仍能在战场上坚持更久

Original: A contemporary of 'Mechs such as the Thunderbolt and the Banshee, the Archer's primary role was fire support
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_archer_ARC-2R.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A contemporary of 'Mechs such as the Thunderbolt and the Banshee, the Archer's primary role was fire support
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为雷霆和女妖等机甲的同时代产物，弓箭手的主要角色是火力支援

Original: The 2Rb variant of the Archer was built for SLDF Royal units starting in 2752. A contemporary of 'Mechs such as the Thunderbolt and the Banshee, the Archer's primary role was fire support.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_archer_ARC-2Rb.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 2Rb variant of the Archer was built for SLDF Royal units starting in 2752. A contemporary of 'Mechs such as the Thunderbolt and the Banshee, the Archer's primary role was fire support.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 弓箭手 2Rb 变体自 2752 年起为星盟防卫军皇家单位建造。作为雷霆和女妖等机甲的同时代产物，弓箭手的主要角色是火力支援。

Original: A another modification made to allow the Archer to defend itself more easily against an enemy that managed to close range with it. Built for House Steiner in 2915
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_archer_ARC-2S.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A another modification made to allow the Archer to defend itself more easily against an enemy that managed to close range with it. Built for House Steiner in 2915
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是另一项改装，使弓箭手能更轻易地抵御设法逼近的敌人。2915 年为施泰纳家族建造

Original: Carrying a pair of SRM-4s in place of two medium lasers, this was the trademark variant used by the Wolf's Dragoons, which they produced in the assembly plant aboard their space station Hephaestos until its destruction in 3028. It was once stated by Jaime Wolf that all of the Dragoons' Archers were of this variant.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_archer_ARC-2W.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Carrying a pair of SRM-4s in place of two medium lasers, this was the trademark variant used by the Wolf's Dragoons, which they produced in the assembly plant aboard their space station Hephaestos until its destruction in 3028. It was once stated by Jaime Wolf that all of the Dragoons' Archers were of this variant.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此变体以两具 SRM-4 取代两门中型激光，是狼之龙骑兵的标志性变体，他们在空间站"赫菲斯托斯"上的装配厂生产，直到 3028 年该站被毁。海梅·沃尔夫曾表示，龙骑兵所有的弓箭手都是这一变体。

Original: The Arctic Fox is a light OmniMech reverse engineered by the Kell Hounds from the Clan Uller OmniMech with assistance in the final stages from Clan Wolf-in-Exile. The resulting OmniMech is a powerful light 'Mech that has a top speed of 97.2 km/h that is provided by a GM 180 XL engine, shaving off valuable weight from the Arctic Fox's base chassis while also making the 'Mech vulnerable to becoming a combat kill through the loss of one of its side torsos. The Arctic Fox has ten double heat sinks which are generally enough to handle the 'Mech's heat load, with the ability to add more if needed. To protect itself from enemy fire, the Arctic Fox has six tons of Royal-7 armor.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_arcticfox_AF1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Arctic Fox is a light OmniMech reverse engineered by the Kell Hounds from the Clan Uller OmniMech with assistance in the final stages from Clan Wolf-in-Exile. The resulting OmniMech is a powerful light 'Mech that has a top speed of 97.2 km/h that is provided by a GM 180 XL engine, shaving off valuable weight from the Arctic Fox's base chassis while also making the 'Mech vulnerable to becoming a combat kill through the loss of one of its side torsos. The Arctic Fox has ten double heat sinks which are generally enough to handle the 'Mech's heat load, with the ability to add more if needed. To protect itself from enemy fire, the Arctic Fox has six tons of Royal-7 armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 极地狐是凯尔猎犬依据氏族乌勒尔全能机甲逆向工程而来的轻型全能机甲，最终阶段得到流亡狼氏族的协助。成品是一款强劲的轻型机甲，由 GM 180 XL 引擎提供 97.2 公里/小时的最高速度，既为极地狐的基础底盘省下宝贵重量，也使它因失去任一侧面躯干而容易被击毁。它装有十台双倍散热器，通常足以应对其热负荷，必要时还可加装。为抵御敌方火力，极地狐拥有六吨 Royal-7 装甲。

Original: Keeping the top speed of the ASN-21 as well as its base weapon load of missiles, the ASN-101 is a rare Federated Suns variant that drops two jump jets and a half ton of armor to mount a trio of Small Lasers, giving the ASN-101 a much better close-in punch compared to its progenitor.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_assassin_ASN-101.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Keeping the top speed of the ASN-21 as well as its base weapon load of missiles, the ASN-101 is a rare Federated Suns variant that drops two jump jets and a half ton of armor to mount a trio of Small Lasers, giving the ASN-101 a much better close-in punch compared to its progenitor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: ASN-101 保留了 ASN-21 的最高速度与基础导弹武器配置，是联邦太阳稀有的变体，它削减两个跳跃推进器和半吨装甲，以装载三门小型激光，使 ASN-101 相比其前身具备强得多的近身打击力。

Original: Assassin was designed to complete against the lighter scout mechs like the Wasp and Stinger but is twice as heavy, faster, greater jump range, heavier armor and much more firepower.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_assassin_ASN-21.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Assassin was designed to complete against the lighter scout mechs like the Wasp and Stinger but is twice as heavy, faster, greater jump range, heavier armor and much more firepower.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 刺客的设计目标是抗衡黄蜂与毒刺等轻型侦察机甲，但它的重量翻倍、速度更快、跳跃距离更远、装甲更厚、火力强得多。

Original: The -23 variant of the Assassin is an upgrade of the original model using Lostech; originally seen as a standardized field modification, in 3067 new production began at Hellespont 'Mech Works. The SRM-2 has been removed to upgrade the Medium Laser to a Medium Pulse Laser and an Artemis IV fire control system has been added for the LRM-5 launcher. Within the CCAF, TDF and MAF it is largely used as a cheap way to rebuild shattered forces and sees service mostly in green and reserve formations. The Capellans in particular use the -23 as a fire-support unit for pursuit and strike lances, though shortages of Artemis munitions means many are forced to use mine-delivery missiles.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_assassin_ASN-23.Details

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 刺客的-23 变体是使用失落科技的原版升级型；最初被视为标准化的野战改装，3067 年由赫勒斯庞特机甲厂开始新的生产。SRM-2 被移除以把中型激光升级为中型脉冲激光，并为 LRM-5 发射器加装 Artemis IV 火控系统。在 CCAF、TDF 和 MAF 中，它主要被用作重建残破部队的廉价手段，多在生疏与预备编队中服役。卡佩兰人尤其把-23 用作追击与打击小队的火力支援单位，不过 Artemis 弹药短缺意味着许多只能使用布雷导弹。

Name: Base_3061.mechdef_assassin_ASN-30.Details

Original: First fielded in 2765, the Atlas II was designed by the Hegemony Research and Development Department, Weapons Division of the original Star League to maintain the technological edge over the other Great Houses. It was exclusively for the SLDF's Royal Regiments. In 2785, when General Aleksandr Kerensky put out his call for loyal forces to join him in his Exodus, every Atlas II pilot responded and left with him. The Atlas II is armed with an array of weaponry, including an LB-X Autocannon/10, a pair of ER Large Lasers, and a 20-tube Long Range Missile Launcher for long range attacks. For close range combat, the 'Mech is equipped with a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers and a Holly Six Pack. In addition, the 'Mech has been given CASEfor both sides of the torso in order to keep an ammunition cook-off from consuming the 'Mech.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_atlasii_AS7-D-H.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: First fielded in 2765, the Atlas II was designed by the Hegemony Research and Development Department, Weapons Division of the original Star League to maintain the technological edge over the other Great Houses. It was exclusively for the SLDF's Royal Regiments. In 2785, when General Aleksandr Kerensky put out his call for loyal forces to join him in his Exodus, every Atlas II pilot responded and left with him. The Atlas II is armed with an array of weaponry, including an LB-X Autocannon/10, a pair of ER Large Lasers, and a 20-tube Long Range Missile Launcher for long range attacks. For close range combat, the 'Mech is equipped with a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers and a Holly Six Pack. In addition, the 'Mech has been given CASEfor both sides of the torso in order to keep an ammunition cook-off from consuming the 'Mech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿特拉斯 II 于 2765 年首次投入战场，由原星盟的霸权研发部武器司设计，以维持对各大议院的技术优势。它专供星盟防卫军皇家团使用。2785 年亚历山大·克伦斯基将军号召忠诚部队随他出埃及时，每一位阿特拉斯 II 飞行员都响应并随他离开。阿特拉斯 II 装备一系列武器，包括一门 LB-X 自动炮/10、两门 ER 大型激光和一具 20 管远程导弹发射器用于远程攻击。近距离战斗则配备两门中型脉冲激光和一具冬青六联装。此外，机甲两侧躯干都装有 C.A.S.E.，以防弹药殉爆吞噬整机。

Original: This variant of the Atlas II exchanges both ER Large Lasers and its LB 10-X for a Kinslaughter ER PPC and a Gauss Rifle while removing only one double heat sink
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_atlasii_AS7-D-H2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant of the Atlas II exchanges both ER Large Lasers and its LB 10-X for a Kinslaughter ER PPC and a Gauss Rifle while removing only one double heat sink
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此阿特拉斯 II 变体将两门 ER 大型激光和 LB 10-X 换成一门"屠亲"ER PPC 和一门高斯步枪，仅移除一台双倍散热器

Original: The Atlas A is the first try to be the king of the battlefield, capable of bringing a dizzying array of weapons to bear on targets at any range. It is also noteworthy for normally mounting the maximum amount of armor possible. Few opponents can survive even brief contact with this monster.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_atlas_AS7-A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Atlas A is the first try to be the king of the battlefield, capable of bringing a dizzying array of weapons to bear on targets at any range. It is also noteworthy for normally mounting the maximum amount of armor possible. Few opponents can survive even brief contact with this monster.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿特拉斯 A 是成为战场之王的最初尝试，能在任何距离上向目标倾泻令人目眩的各类武器。它还以通常装备可容纳的最大装甲量而著称。很少有对手能在与这头怪物短暂接触后幸存。

Original: Built in 2776, this Atlas variant is the largest 'Mech equipped with a Command Console. To free up the weight required to fit this device, the AS7-D-DC removes one ton of LRM ammunition and the paired rear firing lasers. Effective at Close and Long Range Fire Support. Recommended for use by Experienced Tactical Commanders. Extremely Rare and largely Extinct.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_atlas_AS7-D-DC.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Built in 2776, this Atlas variant is the largest 'Mech equipped with a Command Console. To free up the weight required to fit this device, the AS7-D-DC removes one ton of LRM ammunition and the paired rear firing lasers. Effective at Close and Long Range Fire Support. Recommended for use by Experienced Tactical Commanders. Extremely Rare and largely Extinct.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款阿特拉斯变体于 2776 年建造，是装备指挥控制台的最大机甲。为腾出安装该装置所需的重量，AS7-D-DC 移除一吨 LRM 弹药和成对的后向激光。在近程与远程火力支援上都很有效。推荐由经验丰富的战术指挥官使用。极为稀有且基本绝迹。

Original: Known as the 'Atlas II,' the D-HT model carries more Energy weaponry and usually a lighter, more flexible Autocannon. It still has unbelievable protection and the same crushing Melee ability as other Atlas models.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_atlas_AS7-D-HT.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Known as the 'Atlas II,' the D-HT model carries more Energy weaponry and usually a lighter, more flexible Autocannon. It still has unbelievable protection and the same crushing Melee ability as other Atlas models.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: D-HT 型号被称为"阿特拉斯 II"，携带更多能量武器，通常配一门更轻便灵活点的自动炮。它仍拥有难以置信的防护，以及其他阿特拉斯型号同样摧枯拉朽的近战能力。
