Name: Base_3061.mechdef_atlas_AS7-D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Atlas D is the king of the battlefield, capable of bringing a dizzying array of weapons to bear on targets at any range. It is also noteworthy for normally mounting the maximum amount of armor possible. Few opponents can survive even brief contact with this monster.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿特拉斯 D 是战场之王，能在任何距离向目标施加令人眼花缭乱的武器阵列。它还以通常装备最大可能的装甲量而著称。很少有对手能在与这头巨兽的短暂接触中幸存。

Original: A Combine upgrade of the Atlas that used rediscovered Star League technology, the K model was built with a Vlar 300 XL Engine. Carrying a Shigunga LRM-20 with two tons of ammo in the left torso the 'Mech was rearmed for long range combat with an Imperator Dragon's Fire Gauss Rifle in place of the autocannon, with two tons of gauss rounds carried in the right arm, backed up by a pair of Victory Nickel Alloy ER Large Lasers split between both arms. This armament allowed the AS7-K to keep an enemy at range, though the continued use of twenty single heat sinks caused swift heat buildup if both lasers are fired repeatedly. For close range defense, the K model carried two Victory Heartbeat Medium Pulse Lasers and a Yori Flyswatter Anti-Missile System in the left arm. To round off the AS7-K's defense, CASE was added to the side torsos to protect against an ammunition explosion.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_atlas_AS7-K.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Combine upgrade of the Atlas that used rediscovered Star League technology, the K model was built with a Vlar 300 XL Engine. Carrying a Shigunga LRM-20 with two tons of ammo in the left torso the 'Mech was rearmed for long range combat with an Imperator Dragon's Fire Gauss Rifle in place of the autocannon, with two tons of gauss rounds carried in the right arm, backed up by a pair of Victory Nickel Alloy ER Large Lasers split between both arms. This armament allowed the AS7-K to keep an enemy at range, though the continued use of twenty single heat sinks caused swift heat buildup if both lasers are fired repeatedly. For close range defense, the K model carried two Victory Heartbeat Medium Pulse Lasers and a Yori Flyswatter Anti-Missile System in the left arm. To round off the AS7-K's defense, CASE was added to the side torsos to protect against an ammunition explosion.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: K 型是联合体利用重新发现的星盟技术对阿特拉斯的升级，采用一台 Vlar 300 XL 引擎建造。左躯干携带一具"紫郡"LRM-20 与两吨弹药，机甲以远程战斗重新武装：用一门"帝皇龙焰"高斯步枪取代自动炮，右臂携带两吨高斯弹，并由分置双肩的两门"胜利镍合金"ER 大型激光支援。这一武器配置使 AS7-K 能让敌人保持在远处，不过继续使用二十台单散热器意味着若两门激光反复开火会迅速积热。近程防御方面，K 型在左臂携带两门"胜利心跳"中型脉冲激光和一套"织部苍蝇拍"反导系统。为完善 AS7-K 的防御，两侧躯干加装了 C.A.S.E. 以防弹药爆炸。

Original: A Succession Wars era attempt at recreating the Atlas II's loadout, the AS7-RS downgrades the AutoCannon, LRMs and SRMs while trading out the Medium Lasers for a pair of arm mounted Large Lasers.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_atlas_AS7-RS.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Succession Wars era attempt at recreating the Atlas II's loadout, the AS7-RS downgrades the AutoCannon, LRMs and SRMs while trading out the Medium Lasers for a pair of arm mounted Large Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: AS7-RS 是继承战争时代重现阿特拉斯 II 配置的尝试，它降级了自动炮、LRM 和 SRM，并把中型激光换成两门臂载大型激光。

Original: The first of the Inner Sphere OmniMechs to be conceptualized and one of the last to reach production by the Draconis Combine, the Avatar's design is based on captured Vulture OmniMechs.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_avatar_AV1-O.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The first of the Inner Sphere OmniMechs to be conceptualized and one of the last to reach production by the Draconis Combine, the Avatar's design is based on captured Vulture OmniMechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 化身是内天体最早被构想、也是联合体最后投产的全能机甲之一，其设计基于缴获的秃鹫全能机甲。

Original: Focused on close combat, the A configuration carries an ER Large Laser as its only long range weapon. Mounting a pair of SRM-6 launchers, an Autocannon/20 and the two Medium Lasers mounted on the base chassis, the Avatar A is a fearsome opponent with devastating close range punch.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_avatar_AV1-OA.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Focused on close combat, the A configuration carries an ER Large Laser as its only long range weapon. Mounting a pair of SRM-6 launchers, an Autocannon/20 and the two Medium Lasers mounted on the base chassis, the Avatar A is a fearsome opponent with devastating close range punch.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: A 配置聚焦近战，以一门 ER 大型激光作为唯一的远程武器。它装有一对 SRM-6 发射器、一门自动炮/20，以及基础底盘上的两门中型激光，降世神 A 是个可怕的对手，拥有毁灭性的近程打击力。

Original: A fire support variant, the B configuration carries two LRM-15 racks and two LRM-10 racks. These are all mated to an Artemis IV Fire Control System. The only short range weaponry on the B configuration consists wholly of the two Medium Lasers mounted on the base chassis.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_avatar_AV1-OB.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A fire support variant, the B configuration carries two LRM-15 racks and two LRM-10 racks. These are all mated to an Artemis IV Fire Control System. The only short range weaponry on the B configuration consists wholly of the two Medium Lasers mounted on the base chassis.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: B 配置是一款火力支援变体，携带两具 LRM-15 挂架和两具 LRM-10 挂架，全部配以 Artemis IV 火控系统。B 配置唯一的近程武器完全由底盘上安装的两门中型激光构成。

Original: As a command configuration, the C configuration carries a C3 Master Computer into battle. The C configuration attempts to keep enemies at arms length with a PPC and Ultra Autocannon/5 supported by a pair of LRM-10 launchers.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_avatar_AV1-OC.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As a command configuration, the C configuration carries a C3 Master Computer into battle. The C configuration attempts to keep enemies at arms length with a PPC and Ultra Autocannon/5 supported by a pair of LRM-10 launchers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为指挥配置，C 配置把 C3 主控计算机带入战斗。C 配置以一门 PPC 和一门超速自动炮/5 搭配两具 LRM-10 发射器，力求把敌人拒于臂长之外。

Original: The D configuration is intended to act as a sniper. The primary weapon is a Light Gauss Rifle. For close to medium range combat, the Avatar D has two MRM-20 launchers and a pair of ER Medium Lasers in addition to the two hard-wired Medium Lasers. Finally, the D Configuration has a C3 Slave unit that allows it to work in C3 lances.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_avatar_AV1-OD.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The D configuration is intended to act as a sniper. The primary weapon is a Light Gauss Rifle. For close to medium range combat, the Avatar D has two MRM-20 launchers and a pair of ER Medium Lasers in addition to the two hard-wired Medium Lasers. Finally, the D Configuration has a C3 Slave unit that allows it to work in C3 lances.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: D 配置意在担任狙击手。主武器是一门轻型高斯步枪。中近距离战斗方面，降世神 D 除两门固定中型激光外，还有两具 MRM-20 发射器和一对 ER 中型激光。最后，D 配置装有一台 C3 从属单元，使它能在 C3 小队中作战。

Original: A dedicated 'Mech killer, the Avatar G carries a Gauss Rifle with two tons of ammunition in each arm.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_avatar_AV1-OG.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A dedicated 'Mech killer, the Avatar G carries a Gauss Rifle with two tons of ammunition in each arm.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 降世神 G 是专职机甲杀手，每臂各携带一门高斯步枪，配两吨弹药。

Original: A field upgrade developed in the midst of Operation Bulldog, this configuration utilized captured Clan Smoke Jaguar weapons to help bolster the SLDF forces in later waves. Mounting a mix of Combine and Clan-tech, this config carries an MRM-40 supported by a Clan Gauss Rifle, ER Large Laser and Streak SRM-4.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_avatar_AV1-OR.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A field upgrade developed in the midst of Operation Bulldog, this configuration utilized captured Clan Smoke Jaguar weapons to help bolster the SLDF forces in later waves. Mounting a mix of Combine and Clan-tech, this config carries an MRM-40 supported by a Clan Gauss Rifle, ER Large Laser and Streak SRM-4.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此配置是"斗牛犬"行动期间开发的野战升级，利用缴获的烟虎氏族武器帮助增强后期波次的星盟防卫军部队。它混装联合体与氏族科技，携带一具 MRM-40，辅以一门氏族高斯步枪、一门 ER 大型激光和一具连续 SRM-4。

Original: A 'Mech that truly lives up to its name! The Awesome 8Q mounts a frightening trio of PPCs that can destroy, knock down, or debilitate any target in no time. It's ungainly, but it can shrug off huge amounts of incoming fire.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_awesome_AWS-8Q.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A 'Mech that truly lives up to its name! The Awesome 8Q mounts a frightening trio of PPCs that can destroy, knock down, or debilitate any target in no time. It's ungainly, but it can shrug off huge amounts of incoming fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一台真正配得上名字的机甲！神奇 8Q 装备三门的可怕 PPC，能在极短时间内摧毁、击倒或瘫痪任何目标。它笨拙不灵，却也能轻易扛下大量来袭火力。

Original: The AWS-8R replaces the more expensive PPCs with a Large Laser and paired LRM-15s.  While this variant can still dish out a similar amount of damage, it suffers from its dependency on a limited supply of ammunition.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_awesome_AWS-8R.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The AWS-8R replaces the more expensive PPCs with a Large Laser and paired LRM-15s.  While this variant can still dish out a similar amount of damage, it suffers from its dependency on a limited supply of ammunition.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: AWS-8R 以一门大型激光和成对的 LRM-15 取代更昂贵的 PPC。虽然此变体仍能造成相近的伤害，却因依赖有限的弹药储备而吃亏。

Original: The Awesome 8T is a superb fire support 'Mech, though its heavy armor is a bit wasted in that role. It can still put up a good fight at medium ranges, and it can crush smaller units outright with Melee attacks.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_awesome_AWS-8T.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Awesome 8T is a superb fire support 'Mech, though its heavy armor is a bit wasted in that role. It can still put up a good fight at medium ranges, and it can crush smaller units outright with Melee attacks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 卓越 8T 是一款出色的火力支援机甲，尽管其厚重装甲在这个角色上略显浪费。它在中距离仍能打出漂亮的一仗，也能用近战攻击直接碾碎较小单位。

Original: Seeking to address the issues with the 8R model, the AWS-8V is a blend of the 8R and 8Q.  This allows a pilot to provide indirect fire support, while still being a potent combatant with its PPC and Large Laser.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_awesome_AWS-8V.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Seeking to address the issues with the 8R model, the AWS-8V is a blend of the 8R and 8Q.  This allows a pilot to provide indirect fire support, while still being a potent combatant with its PPC and Large Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 为解决 8R 型号存在的问题，AWS-8V 融合了 8R 与 8Q。这使飞行员既能提供间接火力支援，又能凭借其 PPC 和大型激光成为强悍的战斗者。

Original: The 9M is an upgrade of the Awesome that uses Star League technologies. The 'Mech is built around a 320 Hermes XL Fusion engine, giving the 'Mech a top speed of 64.8 km/h. The heat sinks were upgraded to double heat sinks to allow this variant to be rearmed with three Fusigon Longtooth ER PPCs. The ER PPCs are backed up by two Hovertec Streak SRM-2s, split between the left arm and center torso and fed by one ton of reloads in the left leg, a Magna 400P Medium Pulse Laser also in the center torso, and a Diverse Optics Type 10 Small Pulse Laser in place of the head-mounted small laser.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_awesome_AWS-9M.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 9M is an upgrade of the Awesome that uses Star League technologies. The 'Mech is built around a 320 Hermes XL Fusion engine, giving the 'Mech a top speed of 64.8 km/h. The heat sinks were upgraded to double heat sinks to allow this variant to be rearmed with three Fusigon Longtooth ER PPCs. The ER PPCs are backed up by two Hovertec Streak SRM-2s, split between the left arm and center torso and fed by one ton of reloads in the left leg, a Magna 400P Medium Pulse Laser also in the center torso, and a Diverse Optics Type 10 Small Pulse Laser in place of the head-mounted small laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 9M 是使用星盟技术对神奇的升级。机甲围绕一台 320 赫尔墨斯 XL 聚变引擎建造，最高速度 64.8 公里/小时。散热器升级为双倍散热器，使此变体得以重新装备三门"富西贡长牙"ER PPC。这些 ER PPC 由两具"气垫"连续 SRM-2 支援（分置左臂与中央躯干，由左腿一吨再装填供弹）、中央躯干一门玛格纳 400P 中型脉冲激光，以及取代头部小型激光的"多元光学 10 型"小型脉冲激光。

Original: The Bane is a BattleMech that is based upon a Star League prototype that was never put into production. Tagged the Kraken by Inner Sphere forces who opposed it, the Bane was first built in 2827. It was originally a significant part of many Clan toumans, but was gradually relegated to second-line status following the introduction of the OmniMech. As such, it is still critical to many defensive units.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_Bane.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Bane is a BattleMech that is based upon a Star League prototype that was never put into production. Tagged the Kraken by Inner Sphere forces who opposed it, the Bane was first built in 2827. It was originally a significant part of many Clan toumans, but was gradually relegated to second-line status following the introduction of the OmniMech. As such, it is still critical to many defensive units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 灾祸是一款以星盟从未投产的原型为基础的战斗机甲。它被对抗它的内天体部队冠以"海怪"之名，于 2827 年首次建造。它原本是许多氏族图曼的重要组成部分，但随着全能机甲的引入逐渐退居二线。即便如此，它对许多防御单位仍至关重要。

Original: The original design first produced in 2445, this Banshee variant carries the PPC, Autocannon/5, and Small Laser of the later 3E, as well as a pair of Medium Lasers.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_banshee_BNC-1E.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original design first produced in 2445, this Banshee variant carries the PPC, Autocannon/5, and Small Laser of the later 3E, as well as a pair of Medium Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此女妖变体源于 2445 年首次生产的原始设计，携带后来 3E 型的 PPC、自动炮/5 和小型激光，以及两门中型激光。

Original: The Banshee 3E was originally designed for close combat, with better speed than most other assault 'Mechs. While it has heavy armor and powerful Melee attack capability, its firepower is severely lacking and it can still be flanked by lighter units.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_banshee_BNC-3E.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Banshee 3E was originally designed for close combat, with better speed than most other assault 'Mechs. While it has heavy armor and powerful Melee attack capability, its firepower is severely lacking and it can still be flanked by lighter units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 女妖 3E 最初为近战而设计，速度优于大多数其他突击机甲。虽然它有厚重装甲和强大的近战攻击能力，火力却严重不足，且仍可能被轻型单位包抄。

Original: The Banshee 3M mounts respectable weaponry with better-than-average speed and armor. This comes at the cost of very poor heat management. It's good at hunting lighter units, especially if it can close to Melee range.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_banshee_BNC-3M.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Banshee 3M mounts respectable weaponry with better-than-average speed and armor. This comes at the cost of very poor heat management. It's good at hunting lighter units, especially if it can close to Melee range.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 女妖 3M 装备可观的武器，速度与装甲优于平均。代价是散热管理极差。它擅长猎杀轻型单位，尤其当它能逼近至近战距离时。

Original: The Banshee 3MC was a special design of the Magistracy of Canopus. It replaced the autocannon with a bigger one. To make room for it, most of the original heatsinks had to go.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_banshee_BNC-3MC.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Banshee 3MC was a special design of the Magistracy of Canopus. It replaced the autocannon with a bigger one. To make room for it, most of the original heatsinks had to go.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 女妖 3MC 是卡诺普斯法域的特殊设计。它用一门更大的自动炮替换原有自动炮。为腾出空间，大部分原有散热器不得不被舍弃。

Original: The Banshee 3Q variant lacks the long distance capabilities of its predecessor, replacing its AC10 and PPC with an AC20 and enough ammo to last in a sustained fight.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_banshee_BNC-3Q.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Banshee 3Q variant lacks the long distance capabilities of its predecessor, replacing its AC10 and PPC with an AC20 and enough ammo to last in a sustained fight.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 女妖 3Q 变体缺乏前代的长距离能力，它以一门 AC20 和足以支撑持久战的弹药取代了 AC10 与 PPC。

Original: A very recent variant, the 3S downgrades the engine size making the Banshee slower, but more than makes up for this by more than doubling its firepower.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_banshee_BNC-3S.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A very recent variant, the 3S downgrades the engine size making the Banshee slower, but more than makes up for this by more than doubling its firepower.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3S 是极新的变体，它降级引擎尺寸使女妖更慢，但以超过两倍的火力远远弥补了这一点。

Original: The original production variant of this 'Mech, the BKX-7K, utilizes two massive Donal Particle Projection Cannons, which were relatively new at the time. To support the massive cannons, it also has two Federated-5 Shot LRM-5 launchers with one ton of ammo to split between them and a Harpoon-6 SRM-6, giving it something to hit with at all ranges.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_battleaxe_BKX-7K.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original production variant of this 'Mech, the BKX-7K, utilizes two massive Donal Particle Projection Cannons, which were relatively new at the time. To support the massive cannons, it also has two Federated-5 Shot LRM-5 launchers with one ton of ammo to split between them and a Harpoon-6 SRM-6, giving it something to hit with at all ranges.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台机甲的最初量产变体 BKX-7K 采用两门巨型多纳尔粒子投射炮，它们在当时相对较新。为支援这两门巨炮，它还装有两具联邦 5 发 LRM-5 发射器，共分一吨弹药，以及一具"鱼叉-6"SRM-6，使它在任何距离上都有可用的武器。

Original: With the introduction of the BattleAxe’s successor, the Hammerhands, no official variants ever surfaced. However, many MechWarriors, especially those who never quite learned to manage the BattleAxe as it leapt through the air, had technicians remove the temperamental jump jets and install a second LRM 5 in each torso, deeming it the “No Crash” version, or simply 7NC.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_battleaxe_BKX-7NC.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: With the introduction of the BattleAxe’s successor, the Hammerhands, no official variants ever surfaced. However, many MechWarriors, especially those who never quite learned to manage the BattleAxe as it leapt through the air, had technicians remove the temperamental jump jets and install a second LRM 5 in each torso, deeming it the “No Crash” version, or simply 7NC.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 随着战斧的继任者"锤手"问世，再没有官方变体出现过。然而许多机甲战士——尤其是那些始终没学会如何驾驭空中跳跃的战斧的人——让技师拆下反复无常的跳跃推进器，在每侧躯干各装一具 LRM 5，称之为"不摔机"版本，或简称 7NC。

Original: The Battle Hawk was originally designed and built at a time when Defiance Industries felt threatened by the large amount of equipment being produced by, and imported from, the Free Worlds League. It was built to prove that Defiance Industries was still an industry leader in BattleMechs. This came from a 'Mech that, while slow for its weight class, is a force to be reckoned with on the modern battlefield. The Battle Hawk has a top speed of 86.4 kph, which puts it on par with 'Mechs fifteen to twenty tons heavier than itself, but it also carries a powerful arsenal for its size. Its five and a half tons of armor give it good protection for a light 'Mech. Additionally, to make the Battle Hawk more maneuverable on the battlefield, it can jump up to one hundred and fifty meters.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_battlehawk_BH-K305.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Battle Hawk was originally designed and built at a time when Defiance Industries felt threatened by the large amount of equipment being produced by, and imported from, the Free Worlds League. It was built to prove that Defiance Industries was still an industry leader in BattleMechs. This came from a 'Mech that, while slow for its weight class, is a force to be reckoned with on the modern battlefield. The Battle Hawk has a top speed of 86.4 kph, which puts it on par with 'Mechs fifteen to twenty tons heavier than itself, but it also carries a powerful arsenal for its size. Its five and a half tons of armor give it good protection for a light 'Mech. Additionally, to make the Battle Hawk more maneuverable on the battlefield, it can jump up to one hundred and fifty meters.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战斗鹰设计与建造之时，迪法恩斯工业正感到被自由世界联盟生产与进口的大量装备所威胁。它的诞生是为了证明迪法恩斯工业仍是战斗机甲行业的领导者。成果是一款虽在同重量级中偏慢、但在现代战场上不容小觑的机甲。战斗鹰最高速度 86.4 公里/小时，与其重十五到二十吨的机甲持平，同时也为此尺寸携带了强大的武器库。五吨半装甲为轻型机甲提供了良好防护。此外，为提升战场机动性，战斗鹰可跳跃至一百五十米。

Original: A upgrade Battlemaster 1DC Command refit, carrying advanced Technologies and Hardened Armour to stay in the fight as long as possible.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_battlemaster_BLR-1CX.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A upgrade Battlemaster 1DC Command refit, carrying advanced Technologies and Hardened Armour to stay in the fight as long as possible.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是战斗大师 1DC 指挥型的升级改装，携带先进技术与硬化装甲，以尽可能长时间留在战斗中。

Original: More of a refit than a production variant, the SRM-6 and two Medium Lasers are removed so that six Heat Sinks and an extra ton of armor could be added.  Making the BLR-1D a formitable opponent.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_battlemaster_BLR-1D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: More of a refit than a production variant, the SRM-6 and two Medium Lasers are removed so that six Heat Sinks and an extra ton of armor could be added.  Making the BLR-1D a formitable opponent.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 它更像是一次改装而非量产变体：SRM-6 与两门中型激光被移除，以便加装六台散热器和一吨额外装甲，使 BLR-1D 成为令人敬畏的对手。

Original: Command Console refit built in 2855 - The BattleMaster was one of the Federated Suns' preferred 'Mechs to install Command Consoles. Standard refits usually installed the Command Console on the BLR-1G, removing one heat sink and both rear-mounted Medium Lasers.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_battlemaster_BLR-1G-DC.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Command Console refit built in 2855 - The BattleMaster was one of the Federated Suns' preferred 'Mechs to install Command Consoles. Standard refits usually installed the Command Console on the BLR-1G, removing one heat sink and both rear-mounted Medium Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2855 年建造的指挥控制台改装型——战将是联邦太阳系首选安装指挥控制台的机甲之一。标准改装通常在 BLR-1G 上安装指挥控制台，移除一台散热器和两门后向中型激光。

Original: Versatile and powerful, the BattleMaster 1G is one of the best known BattleMechs in existence. Normally mounting a varied array of Energy weapons, the BattleMaster can engage enemies at any range and packs a powerful punch.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_battlemaster_BLR-1G.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Versatile and powerful, the BattleMaster 1G is one of the best known BattleMechs in existence. Normally mounting a varied array of Energy weapons, the BattleMaster can engage enemies at any range and packs a powerful punch.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战斗大师 1G 多才多艺而强大，是现存最知名的战斗机甲之一。它通常装备多样化的能量武器阵列，能在任何距离接敌，打击力很强。

Original: A new variant produced for the Lyran Commonwealth by Red Devil industries which changes its mission profile to be more of a support 'Mech, removing its PPC and SRM-6 and replacing them with an LRM-15, LRM-5 and a pair of SRM-2s.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_battlemaster_BLR-1S.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A new variant produced for the Lyran Commonwealth by Red Devil industries which changes its mission profile to be more of a support 'Mech, removing its PPC and SRM-6 and replacing them with an LRM-15, LRM-5 and a pair of SRM-2s.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是红魔工业为莱兰联邦生产的新变体，其任务定位更偏支援机甲，移除 PPC 和 SRM-6，换成一套 LRM-15、LRM-5 和两具 SRM-2。

Original: The Black Hawk-KU is an Inner Sphere version of the Clan Black Hawk OmniMech. In order to make it possible to copy the Black Hawk, the Black Hawk-KU is built ten tons heavier than its Clan counterpart. The Black Hawk-KU is built on a sixty ton chassis and is powered by a Vlar 300 XL Engine which propels it to a top speed of 86.4 kph.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_blackhawk_BHKU-O.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Black Hawk-KU is an Inner Sphere version of the Clan Black Hawk OmniMech. In order to make it possible to copy the Black Hawk, the Black Hawk-KU is built ten tons heavier than its Clan counterpart. The Black Hawk-KU is built on a sixty ton chassis and is powered by a Vlar 300 XL Engine which propels it to a top speed of 86.4 kph.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑鹰-KU 是氏族黑鹰全能机甲的内天体版本。为使复制黑鹰成为可能，黑鹰-KU 比其氏族对应型重了十吨。它采用六十吨底盘，由 Vlar 300 XL 引擎驱动，最高速度 86.4 公里/小时。

Original: Blackjack 0s are Primitive downgrades of the BJ-1, replacing both AC's with Medium Rifles, and maximizing armour as best as it can.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_blackjack_BJ-0.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Blackjack 0s are Primitive downgrades of the BJ-1, replacing both AC's with Medium Rifles, and maximizing armour as best as it can.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑杰克 0 是 BJ-1 的原始降级版，将两门 AC 换成中型步枪，并尽可能最大化装甲。

Original: Blackjack 1s are solid, well-rounded 'Mechs for their tonnage. They typically mount Jump Jets, which give them an extra edge by repositioning quickly to keep a direct line of fire for their Autocannons.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_blackjack_BJ-1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Blackjack 1s are solid, well-rounded 'Mechs for their tonnage. They typically mount Jump Jets, which give them an extra edge by repositioning quickly to keep a direct line of fire for their Autocannons.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑杰克 1 就其吨位而言是扎实而全面的机甲。它们通常装备跳跃推进器，能迅速重新定位以保持自动炮的直射视野，从而获得额外优势。

Original: A recent Federated Suns variant, the BJ-1DB replaces the AutoCannon with Large Lasers.  In order to assist with the added heat, it also drops some armor and the torso mounted lasers to make room for more Heat Sinks.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_blackjack_BJ-1DB.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A recent Federated Suns variant, the BJ-1DB replaces the AutoCannon with Large Lasers.  In order to assist with the added heat, it also drops some armor and the torso mounted lasers to make room for more Heat Sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: BJ-1DB 是联邦太阳系新近变体，将自动炮换成大型激光。为帮助应对增加的热量，它还削减了一些装甲和躯干激光，为更多散热器腾出空间。

Original: Sacrificing the Jump Jets, the BJ-1DC adds a Small Laser in each side torso and a Heat Sink to help ease the extra burden.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_blackjack_BJ-1DC.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sacrificing the Jump Jets, the BJ-1DC adds a Small Laser in each side torso and a Heat Sink to help ease the extra burden.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: BJ-1DC 牺牲跳跃推进器，在两侧躯干各加一门小型激光，并加一台散热器以缓解额外负担。

Original: In The Periphery Maintaining Mechs Tends To Be A Problem, As A Result The 1P Was Designed Generally As A Downgrade From The Os, But Much Cheaper To Maintain And Repair, Pilots Often Complain About The Structure 'Making Strange Noises', These Remarks Were Usually Ignored.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_blackjack_BJ-1P.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In The Periphery Maintaining Mechs Tends To Be A Problem, As A Result The 1P Was Designed Generally As A Downgrade From The Os, But Much Cheaper To Maintain And Repair, Pilots Often Complain About The Structure 'Making Strange Noises', These Remarks Were Usually Ignored.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在外围区，维护机甲往往是个难题。因此 1P 大体上是 O 型的降级版，但维护和修理便宜得多。飞行员常抱怨其结构"发出奇怪的响声"，这些说法通常被无视。

Original: This early Blackjack prototype started along a completely different path for the 'Mech.  Focusing on close in weapons, the BJ-1X has four Flamers and four Medium Lasers.  The BJ-1X also focused more on speed than jump manueverability, increasing the engine size while removing the Jump Jets.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_blackjack_BJ-1X.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This early Blackjack prototype started along a completely different path for the 'Mech.  Focusing on close in weapons, the BJ-1X has four Flamers and four Medium Lasers.  The BJ-1X also focused more on speed than jump manueverability, increasing the engine size while removing the Jump Jets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款早期黑杰克原型为该机甲开辟了一条完全不同的道路。BJ-1X 聚焦近程武器，配备四具火焰喷射器和四门中型激光。它还更注重速度而非跳跃机动，增大引擎尺寸并移除跳跃推进器。

Original: The BJ-2 was introduced in 3052 by the Federated Suns as the new production model of the Blackjack, based on earlier experimental designs. It upgrades the 'Mech with two Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Lasers in place of the autocannons and removes the medium lasers for four Hovertec Streak SRM-2 launchers, two each in the left and right sides of the torso. One ton of ammo for the launchers is kept in the left torso while the standard heat sinks were upgraded to double heat sinks.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_blackjack_BJ-2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The BJ-2 was introduced in 3052 by the Federated Suns as the new production model of the Blackjack, based on earlier experimental designs. It upgrades the 'Mech with two Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Lasers in place of the autocannons and removes the medium lasers for four Hovertec Streak SRM-2 launchers, two each in the left and right sides of the torso. One ton of ammo for the launchers is kept in the left torso while the standard heat sinks were upgraded to double heat sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: BJ-2 由联邦太阳系于 3052 年推出，是黑杰克的新量产型号，基于早期实验设计。它将自动炮换成两门多元光学"日光束"ER 大型激光，并移除中型激光，换成四具霍弗泰克连续 SRM-2 发射器，左右躯干各两具。发射器的一吨弹药存于左侧躯干，标准散热器则升级为双倍散热器。

Original: In the 3030s, the St. Ives Compact experimented with recovered technology on some of their Blackjacks. One prototype that showed great promise replace the autocannon and one heat sink with a pair of Ceres Arms Smasher PPCs. Three of the remaining heat sinks were replaced with experimental “freezer” double efficiency units.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_blackjack_BJ-3.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In the 3030s, the St. Ives Compact experimented with recovered technology on some of their Blackjacks. One prototype that showed great promise replace the autocannon and one heat sink with a pair of Ceres Arms Smasher PPCs. Three of the remaining heat sinks were replaced with experimental “freezer” double efficiency units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在 3030 年代，圣艾夫斯共同体在他们的一些黑杰克上试验了找回的技术。一个前景看好的原型以一对"塞雷斯兵器粉碎者"PPC 取代自动炮和一台散热器。剩余散热器中有三台被换成实验性的"冷冻机"双倍效率装置。

Original: The Blackjack 3T replaces the standard AC/2s with Large Laser, providing greater punch at the cost of some Heat and carries a large collection of Machine guns and 2 Small Lasers.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_blackjack_BJ-3T.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Blackjack 3T replaces the standard AC/2s with Large Laser, providing greater punch at the cost of some Heat and carries a large collection of Machine guns and 2 Small Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑杰克 3T 以大型激光取代标准 AC/2，以一些热量为代价换取更强的打击力，并携带一大批机枪和 2 门小型激光。

Original: The Blackjack 5 is a rather unusual refit, replacing the Autocannons with a pair of Mortars to allow indirect firing support and giving AMS coverage.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_blackjack_BJ-5.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Blackjack 5 is a rather unusual refit, replacing the Autocannons with a pair of Mortars to allow indirect firing support and giving AMS coverage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑杰克 5 是一款颇为不寻常的改装型，以两门迫击炮取代自动炮，以提供间接火力支援并配备 AMS 防护。

Original: The Blackjack G, unlike the average variant, carries twin Ultra AC/10s. This variant also features an advanced targeting computer, an ultra-light gyro, and a supercharger.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_blackjack_BJ-G.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Blackjack G, unlike the average variant, carries twin Ultra AC/10s. This variant also features an advanced targeting computer, an ultra-light gyro, and a supercharger.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑杰克 G 与一般变体不同，携带双联超速 AC/10。此变体还配备先进瞄准计算机、超轻型陀螺仪和增压器。

Original: An upgrade of the Blackjack BattleMech, the Blackjack OmniMech is a powerful and adaptable medium weight workhorse. Much like the Firestarter OmniMech, the genesis of the omni-Blackjack stems from the Combine's technology exchange program during the initial Clan Invasion with Ceres Metals Industries ' St. Ives Compact branch offering Luthien Armor Works specifications and licenses to manufacturer the ill-regarded Blackjack.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_blackjack_BJ2-O.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade of the Blackjack BattleMech, the Blackjack OmniMech is a powerful and adaptable medium weight workhorse. Much like the Firestarter OmniMech, the genesis of the omni-Blackjack stems from the Combine's technology exchange program during the initial Clan Invasion with Ceres Metals Industries ' St. Ives Compact branch offering Luthien Armor Works specifications and licenses to manufacturer the ill-regarded Blackjack.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为黑杰克战斗机甲的升级版，黑杰克全能机甲是一款强劲且适应性强的中量级主力。与火焰使者全能机甲相似，全能版黑杰克的诞生源于氏族入侵初期联合体的技术交换计划——谷神星金属工业的圣艾夫斯契约分部向卢西恩装甲工厂提供了规格与许可，以制造这款评价不佳的黑杰克。

Much like the Firestarter OmniMech, the genesis of the omni-Blackjack stems from the Combine's technology exchange program during the initial Clan Invasion with Ceres Metals Industries ' St. Ives Compact branch offering Luthien Armor Works specifications and licenses to manufacturer the ill-regarded Blackjack.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_blackjack_BJ2-OD.Details

Original: The Black Knight 6-KNT is a dedicated Energy weapon platform. It can shell out hellish damage with its beams and shrug off a lot of damage… just gotta make sure to keep its heat in check.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_blackknight_BL-6-KNT.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Black Knight 6-KNT is a dedicated Energy weapon platform. It can shell out hellish damage with its beams and shrug off a lot of damage… just gotta make sure to keep its heat in check.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑骑士 6-KNT 是专职能量武器平台。它能以光束倾泻地狱般的伤害，并轻易承受大量打击……只要确保把热量控制住。

Original: The Black Knight 6B was the harder-hitting, cooler-running Star League ancestor to the standard BL-6-KNT we have today. It did everything the 6 does, but better—mostly thanks to its Double Heat Sinks.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_blackknight_BL-6b-KNT.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Black Knight 6B was the harder-hitting, cooler-running Star League ancestor to the standard BL-6-KNT we have today. It did everything the 6 does, but better—mostly thanks to its Double Heat Sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑骑士 6B 是我们今天所熟知的标准 BL-6-KNT 的星盟祖先，打击更狠、散热更好。6 型能做到的一切，它都做得更好——主要归功于它的双倍散热器。

Original: A Free Worlds League variant, the BL-7-KNT-L replaces the rarer PPC with a 3rd Large Laser and 2 additional Heat Sinks.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_blackknight_BL-7-KNT-L.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Free Worlds League variant, the BL-7-KNT-L replaces the rarer PPC with a 3rd Large Laser and 2 additional Heat Sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是自由世界联盟的变体，BL-7-KNT-L 将较稀有的 PPC 换成第三门大型激光和 2 台额外散热器。

Original: The Black Knight 7-KNT is a dedicated Energy weapon platform. It can shell out hellish damage with its beams and shrug off a lot of damage… just gotta make sure to keep its heat in check.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_blackknight_BL-7-KNT.Details

Original: The Black Knight 7B is a refit made for and sold to Mercenary Commanders deeply in favour with the Federated Commonwealth, sporting advanced technologies and Prototype X-Pulse Laser.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_blackknight_BL-7b-KNT.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Black Knight 7B is a refit made for and sold to Mercenary Commanders deeply in favour with the Federated Commonwealth, sporting advanced technologies and Prototype X-Pulse Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑骑士 7B 是为深得联邦联邦青睐的佣兵指挥官制造并出售的改装型，配备先进技术和原型 X 脉冲激光。

Original: The Black Knight 9-KNT is essentially a LosTech upgrade to the 6 variant, replacing most of its standard lasers with pulse versions, and the standard PPC with an ER version. This variant also carries double heat sinks to manage the extra heat generated by these weapons.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_blackknight_BL-9-KNT.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Black Knight 9-KNT is essentially a LosTech upgrade to the 6 variant, replacing most of its standard lasers with pulse versions, and the standard PPC with an ER version. This variant also carries double heat sinks to manage the extra heat generated by these weapons.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑骑士 9-KNT 实质上是 6 型的失落科技升级版，将其大部分标准激光换成脉冲版本，标准 PPC 换成 ER 版本。该变体还配备双倍散热器以应对这些武器产生的额外热量。

Original: The Black Lanner A is configured for electronic warfare and scouting. It uses an Active Probe to find hidden units, an ECM Suite to counteract enemy electronics, and a TAG spotting laser to designate targets for homing artillery. Offensively, it can call upon an ER PPC and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_blacklanner_BKL-A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Black Lanner A is configured for electronic warfare and scouting. It uses an Active Probe to find hidden units, an ECM Suite to counteract enemy electronics, and a TAG spotting laser to designate targets for homing artillery. Offensively, it can call upon an ER PPC and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑猎隼 A 配置为电子战与侦察。它使用主动探测器寻找隐藏单位，ECM 套件反制敌方电子设备，TAG 指示激光为制导炮击标记目标。进攻方面，它可调用一门 ER PPC 和一对中型脉冲激光。

Original: The C is a close-support variant that mounts six ER Medium Lasers and a Streak SRM-6. It also uses three additional double heat sinks to help combat heat levels.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_blacklanner_BKL-C.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The C is a close-support variant that mounts six ER Medium Lasers and a Streak SRM-6. It also uses three additional double heat sinks to help combat heat levels.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: C 型是近距支援变体，装备六门 ER 中型激光和一具连续 SRM-6。它还使用三台额外双倍散热器以帮助控制热量水平。

Original: This close-range brawler mounts pairs of Medium Pulse Lasers, SRM-6s, ER Small Lasers, Flamers, and four Machine Guns. This configuration is devastating to conventional infantry and a serious threat to combat vehicles. An Active Probe ensures that it is rarely surprised.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_blacklanner_BKL-D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This close-range brawler mounts pairs of Medium Pulse Lasers, SRM-6s, ER Small Lasers, Flamers, and four Machine Guns. This configuration is devastating to conventional infantry and a serious threat to combat vehicles. An Active Probe ensures that it is rarely surprised.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款近战近战型装备成对的中型脉冲激光、SRM-6、ER 小型激光、火焰喷射器和四挺机枪。此配置对常规步兵极具毁灭性，对战斗车辆也是严重威胁。主动探测器确保它很少被突袭。

Original: The primary configuration of the Black Lanner is effective at all ranges. At long range, it can make use of an ER Large Laser and LRM-10. When it closes in, it can attack with a pair of ER Medium Lasers and an SRM-6 that can exploit holes in its opponent's armor. An ECM Suite protects it from many forms of electronics.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_blacklanner_BKL-PRIME.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary configuration of the Black Lanner is effective at all ranges. At long range, it can make use of an ER Large Laser and LRM-10. When it closes in, it can attack with a pair of ER Medium Lasers and an SRM-6 that can exploit holes in its opponent's armor. An ECM Suite protects it from many forms of electronics.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑猎隼的主配置在各类距离上都很有效。远距离可用一门 ER 大型激光和一具 LRM-10。接近后，它可用两门 ER 中型激光和一具 SRM-6 攻击，后者能利用对手装甲上的破口。ECM 套件保护它免受多种电子手段干扰。

Original: Taking its name from a term meaning 'Lightning War' the Blitzkrieg completely lives up to the name. The Blitzkrieg is built on a lightweight Coventry BTZ-VII Endo Steel chassis and is powered by a Magna 350 XL engine that weighs half as much as a standard fusion engine while giving the 'Mech a top speed of 118.8 km/h.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_blitzkrieg_BTZ-3F.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Taking its name from a term meaning 'Lightning War' the Blitzkrieg completely lives up to the name. The Blitzkrieg is built on a lightweight Coventry BTZ-VII Endo Steel chassis and is powered by a Magna 350 XL engine that weighs half as much as a standard fusion engine while giving the 'Mech a top speed of 118.8 km/h.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 闪电战之名取自意为"闪电战争"的术语，而它完全配得上这个名字。它建立在轻量化的考文垂 BTZ-VII 内骨骼底盘上，由一台玛格纳 350 XL 引擎驱动——重量仅为标准聚变引擎的一半，同时赋予机甲 118.8 公里/小时的最高速度。

Original: Though bearing a remarkable outward resemblance to the Timberwolf, this BattleMech is a new and powerful creation. Carrying thirteen tons of ferro-fibrous armor, the Mad Cat MK II is an incredibly resilient design. A pair of arm mounted Gaussrifles supported by torso mounted LRM racks give it complete command over the battlefield.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_bloodasp_A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Though bearing a remarkable outward resemblance to the Timberwolf, this BattleMech is a new and powerful creation. Carrying thirteen tons of ferro-fibrous armor, the Mad Cat MK II is an incredibly resilient design. A pair of arm mounted Gaussrifles supported by torso mounted LRM racks give it complete command over the battlefield.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 虽然外观与森林狼极为相似，这款战斗机甲却是全新而强大的创造。疯猫 MK II 携带十三吨铁纤维装甲，是极为坚固的设计。臂载的双高斯步枪配以躯干搭载的 LRM 挂架，使其能完全掌控战场。

Original: The original Bombard mounted a pair of massive Autocannon/20s in place of the Thunderbolt launchers as well as standard Medium Lasers instead of the MBM-013's ER lasers. This version was also equipped with experimental War of 3039-vintage double heat sinks, less bulky than standard double heat sinks, but which utilized corrosive coolant.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_bombard_BMB-010.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Bombard mounted a pair of massive Autocannon/20s in place of the Thunderbolt launchers as well as standard Medium Lasers instead of the MBM-013's ER lasers. This version was also equipped with experimental War of 3039-vintage double heat sinks, less bulky than standard double heat sinks, but which utilized corrosive coolant.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 原版轰击者以一对巨型自动炮/20 取代雷霆发射器，并以标准中型激光取代 MBM-013 的 ER 激光。此版本还装备了 3039 年战争时期的实验性双倍散热器——比标准双倍散热器更不笨重，但使用腐蚀性冷却剂。

Original: The Brigand is a BattleMech that is surrounded by a sea of controversy as it is the first 'Mech to be produced by a pirate band. Manufactured by a company named Vengeance Incorporated, which is run by the pirates of the Haven Star Cluster and 'Lady Death' Trevaline, the Brigand represents an unprecedented threat because in spite of the fact that it is built by pirates, it uses advanced construction techniques and weapons.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_brigand_LDT-1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Brigand is a BattleMech that is surrounded by a sea of controversy as it is the first 'Mech to be produced by a pirate band. Manufactured by a company named Vengeance Incorporated, which is run by the pirates of the Haven Star Cluster and 'Lady Death' Trevaline, the Brigand represents an unprecedented threat because in spite of the fact that it is built by pirates, it uses advanced construction techniques and weapons.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 强盗是一台备受争议的战斗机甲，因为它是首款由海盗团伙生产的机甲。它由一家名为"复仇公司"的企业制造，该企业由避风港星团的海盗与"死亡女士"特雷瓦琳经营。强盗代表着前所未有的威胁，因为尽管它由海盗建造，却使用了先进的建造技术和武器。

Original: The Bushwacker was originally a failed BattleMech designed to have a smaller forward profile to make the 'Mech a harder target to hit. The Bushwacker's unique design caused problems with the engine shielding, the side-effects of which manifested themselves as various gremlins in the 'Mech's on board electronics on the prototypes fielded.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_bushwacker_BSW-S2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Bushwacker was originally a failed BattleMech designed to have a smaller forward profile to make the 'Mech a harder target to hit. The Bushwacker's unique design caused problems with the engine shielding, the side-effects of which manifested themselves as various gremlins in the 'Mech's on board electronics on the prototypes fielded.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 伏击者最初是一款失败的战斗机甲，设计初衷是缩小正面轮廓以使机甲更难被击中。但伏击者独特的设计导致引擎屏蔽出现问题，副作用表现为已部署原型机上各种机载电子设备的莫名故障。

The Bushwacker's unique design caused problems with the engine shielding, the side-effects of which manifested themselves as various gremlins in the 'Mech's on board electronics on the prototypes fielded.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 伏击者最初是一款失败的战斗机甲，设计初衷是缩小正面轮廓以使机甲更难被击中。但伏击者独特的设计导致引擎屏蔽出现问题，副作用表现为已部署原型机上各种机载电子设备的莫名故障。

Original: Originally a reverse-engineered version Cataphract the finished design surprisingly enough proving to be a high quality design itself.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_caesar_CES-3R.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally a reverse-engineered version Cataphract the finished design surprisingly enough proving to be a high quality design itself.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 它最初是铁甲舰的逆向工程版本，而最终的成品令人惊讶地被证明本身就是一个高质量设计。

Original: We call the Cataphract a "FrankenMech" because it's got a little bit of everything stitched together on it. The 1X model works well at medium-long to closer range, with good armor and weaponry.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_cataphract_CTF-1X.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We call the Cataphract a "FrankenMech" because it's got a little bit of everything stitched together on it. The 1X model works well at medium-long to closer range, with good armor and weaponry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们称铁甲舰为"拼装机甲"，因为它把五花八门的东西缝在了一起。1X 型号在中远到较近距离都表现出色，装甲与武器俱佳。

Original: The 2X replaces the PPC with a heavy laser, while the arm-mounted medium lasers are removed in favor of a SRM-4.  This reduction in heat load also allows for the removal of 2 heat sinks and adding armor in their stead.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_cataphract_CTF-2X.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 2X replaces the PPC with a heavy laser, while the arm-mounted medium lasers are removed in favor of a SRM-4.  This reduction in heat load also allows for the removal of 2 heat sinks and adding armor in their stead.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2X 将 PPC 换成重型激光，同时移除臂载中型激光，改为一具 SRM-4。热负荷的降低还允许移除 2 台散热器，并以装甲取而代之。

Original: The CTF-4X is the latest variant of this prototype 'Mech.  The 4X downgrades the Engine, making for a slower ride, but adds more long range firepower with two Autocannon 5s, a Large Laser and LRM5.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_cataphract_CTF-4X.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The CTF-4X is the latest variant of this prototype 'Mech.  The 4X downgrades the Engine, making for a slower ride, but adds more long range firepower with two Autocannon 5s, a Large Laser and LRM5.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: CTF-4X 是这款原型机甲的最新变体。4X 降级了引擎，使它跑得更慢，但以两门自动炮 5、一门大型激光和一具 LRM5 增加了更多远程火力。

Original: The Catapult A1 was designed as a true support role model.  The CPLT-A1 removes all 4 Medium Lasers in favor of additional LRM ammunition and armor.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_catapult_CPLT-A1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Catapult A1 was designed as a true support role model.  The CPLT-A1 removes all 4 Medium Lasers in favor of additional LRM ammunition and armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 弹射器 A1 被设计为真正的支援型型号。CPLT-A1 移除全部 4 门中型激光，换成额外的 LRM 弹药和装甲。

Original: Ah, the Catapult C1. Just like its namesake, it's good at lobbing large numbers of missiles over terrain without fear of return fire. Surprisingly, it's also not too shabby at closer ranges in a pinch.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_catapult_CPLT-C1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ah, the Catapult C1. Just like its namesake, it's good at lobbing large numbers of missiles over terrain without fear of return fire. Surprisingly, it's also not too shabby at closer ranges in a pinch.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 啊，弹射器 C1。正如其名，它擅长越过地形投掷大量导弹而不必担心回击。令人惊讶的是，必要时刻它在较近距离也相当不赖。

Original: The Royal Catapult, the -C1b was designed to fill the same role as the normal -C1 but better. Thanks to Ferro-Fibrous armor it sports better protection, and thanks to double heat sinks it can jump and fire all day long without problems.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_catapult_CPLT-C1b.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Royal Catapult, the -C1b was designed to fill the same role as the normal -C1 but better. Thanks to Ferro-Fibrous armor it sports better protection, and thanks to double heat sinks it can jump and fire all day long without problems.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 皇家弹射器-C1b 的设计目标是执行与普通-C1 相同的角色，但做得更好。得益于铁纤维装甲，它拥有更好的防护；得益于双倍散热器，它可以整天跳跃开火而毫无问题。

Original: The CPLT-C4 is an explosive addition to any outfit's arsenal.  Trading out the stock LRM-15s, Medium Lasers and extra Heat Sinks for LRM-20s and Small Lasers - along with 2 extra tons of ammo, the C4 gives the Catapult impressive long range firepower.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_catapult_CPLT-C4.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The CPLT-C4 is an explosive addition to any outfit's arsenal.  Trading out the stock LRM-15s, Medium Lasers and extra Heat Sinks for LRM-20s and Small Lasers - along with 2 extra tons of ammo, the C4 gives the Catapult impressive long range firepower.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: CPLT-C4 是任何部队武器库中的爆炸性补充。它把标准 LRM-15、中型激光和额外散热器换成 LRM-20 与小型激光——外加 2 吨额外弹药，C4 赋予弹射器令人印象深刻的远程火力。

Original: The Catapult K2 is an outside-the-box redesign that trades the indirect-fire capability for heavier direct-fire PPCs. It doesn't usually mount Jump Jets, though, so it can be a bit more restricted in its use.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_catapult_CPLT-K2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Catapult K2 is an outside-the-box redesign that trades the indirect-fire capability for heavier direct-fire PPCs. It doesn't usually mount Jump Jets, though, so it can be a bit more restricted in its use.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 弹射器 K2 是一次跳出常规的重新设计，以更强的直射 PPC 取代间接火力能力。不过它通常不装跳跃推进器，因此在运用上稍有局限。

Original: An upgrade of the K2 Catapult, the K2K model changes the engine to an extralight model. The twin PPCs also have been upgraded to ER PPCs. The 'Mech carries two ER Medium Lasers for close range firepower. To handle the added heat from the upgrades, the 'Mech uses 20 double heat sinks. Finally, the K2K model carries thirteen and a half tons of armor. .
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_catapult_CPLT-K2K.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade of the K2 Catapult, the K2K model changes the engine to an extralight model. The twin PPCs also have been upgraded to ER PPCs. The 'Mech carries two ER Medium Lasers for close range firepower. To handle the added heat from the upgrades, the 'Mech uses 20 double heat sinks. Finally, the K2K model carries thirteen and a half tons of armor. .
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: K2K 型号是 K2 弹射器的升级，把引擎换成超轻型。双联 PPC 也升级为 ER PPC。机甲携带两门 ER 中型激光用于近程火力。为处理升级带来的额外热量，机甲使用 20 台双倍散热器。最后，K2K 型号携带十三吨半装甲。

Original: Though this design never reached full production, it was prototyped during the War of 3039. It upgrades the PPCs of the K2 to ER PPCs.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_catapult_CPLT-K3.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Though this design never reached full production, it was prototyped during the War of 3039. It upgrades the PPCs of the K2 to ER PPCs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该设计从未进入量产，但在 3039 年战争期间被作成原型。它将 K2 的 PPC 升级为 ER PPC。

Original: Another Kuritan variant, the -K5 goes back to its roots by carrying two MRM-30 launchers as its primary weapon.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_catapult_CPLT-K5.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another Kuritan variant, the -K5 goes back to its roots by carrying two MRM-30 launchers as its primary weapon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又一款库瑞塔变体，-K5 回归本源，以两具 MRM-30 发射器为主武器。

Original: The CattleMaster was created at the turn of the thirty-first century as an IndustrialMech to handle large herd animals. The concept for the Rancher 'Mech dates back to the twenty-fourth century. The 'Mech is noted for its durability and flexible Internal Combustion Engine.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_cattlemaster-CM-3R2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The CattleMaster was created at the turn of the thirty-first century as an IndustrialMech to handle large herd animals. The concept for the Rancher 'Mech dates back to the twenty-fourth century. The 'Mech is noted for its durability and flexible Internal Combustion Engine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 牧牛人于三十一世纪之交被制造为工业机甲，用于处置大型畜群。这类"牧场主"机甲的概念可追溯至二十四世纪。此机甲以其耐用性和灵活的内燃引擎著称。

Original: The CattleMaster was created at the turn of the thirty-first century as an IndustrialMech to handle large herd animals. The concept for the Rancher 'Mech dates back to the twenty-fourth century. The 'Mech is noted for its durability and flexible Internal Combustion Engine.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_cattlemaster-CM-3R2H.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The CattleMaster was created at the turn of the thirty-first century as an IndustrialMech to handle large herd animals. The concept for the Rancher 'Mech dates back to the twenty-fourth century. The 'Mech is noted for its durability and flexible Internal Combustion Engine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 牧牛人于三十一世纪之交被制造为工业机甲，用于处置大型畜群。这类"牧场主"机甲的概念可追溯至二十四世纪。此机甲以其耐用性和灵活的内燃引擎著称。

Original: The CattleMaster was created at the turn of the thirty-first century as an IndustrialMech to handle large herd animals. Being fed up by local Troublemakers and Pirates trying to steal his livestock, one farmer went and upgraded his Cattlemaster.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_cattlemaster-CM-X.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The CattleMaster was created at the turn of the thirty-first century as an IndustrialMech to handle large herd animals. Being fed up by local Troublemakers and Pirates trying to steal his livestock, one farmer went and upgraded his Cattlemaster.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 牧牛人于三十一世纪之交被制造为工业机甲，用于处置大型畜群。由于受够了当地捣蛋鬼和海盗试图偷窃他的牲畜，一位农场主升级了自己的牧牛人。

Original: A primitive downgrade of the Centurion-9A commonly found among LowTech States and Bandits.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_centurion_CN3-A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A primitive downgrade of the Centurion-9A commonly found among LowTech States and Bandits.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是百夫长-9A 的原始降级版，在低技术国家和匪帮中很常见。

Original: A sturdy and reliable 'Mech, the Centurion is good at both taking and giving a beating. CN9-A models are able to engage at any range, but their damage curve increases as they approach a target.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_centurion_CN9-A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A sturdy and reliable 'Mech, the Centurion is good at both taking and giving a beating. CN9-A models are able to engage at any range, but their damage curve increases as they approach a target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 百夫长是一款坚固可靠的机甲，既能挨打也能打人。CN9-A 型号能在任何距离交战，其伤害曲线随接近目标而上升。

Original: A sturdy and reliable 'Mech, the Centurion is good at both taking and giving a beating. CN9-A2 models come with a UAC/10 and usually carry Hotloaded LRMs.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_centurion_CN9-A2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A sturdy and reliable 'Mech, the Centurion is good at both taking and giving a beating. CN9-A2 models come with a UAC/10 and usually carry Hotloaded LRMs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 百夫长是一款坚固可靠的机甲，既能挨打也能打人。CN9-A2 型号配备一门 UAC/10，通常携带热装 LRM。

Original: A somewhat radical departure from the stock Centurion, the CN9-AH Variant trades out the stock AC10 and Medium Lasers for a single AC20.  While this amounts to the same degree of firepower, it has the benefit of concentrating the damage to a single location.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_centurion_CN9-AH.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A somewhat radical departure from the stock Centurion, the CN9-AH Variant trades out the stock AC10 and Medium Lasers for a single AC20.  While this amounts to the same degree of firepower, it has the benefit of concentrating the damage to a single location.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: CN9-AH 变体是对标准百夫长的较大偏离，它把标准 AC10 和中型激光换成一门 AC20。虽然火力总量相当，但它有利于把伤害集中在单一部位。

Original: The AL variant of the Centurion tends to trade the larger burst damage of an Autocannon for more Energy weaponry and heavier armor. ALs can take an incredible amount of damage for their size but still pack a good punch.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_centurion_CN9-AL.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The AL variant of the Centurion tends to trade the larger burst damage of an Autocannon for more Energy weaponry and heavier armor. ALs can take an incredible amount of damage for their size but still pack a good punch.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 百夫长的 AL 变体倾向于以自动炮较大的爆发伤害换取更多能量武器和更厚的装甲。AL 就其尺寸而言能承受惊人的伤害，同时打击力依然不错。

Original: A sturdy and reliable 'Mech, the Centurion is good at both taking and giving a beating. CN9-B1 models are able to engage at extreme range thanks to a Light Gauss Rifle and stay in the field with their AMS and Medium Shield.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_centurion_CN9-B1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A sturdy and reliable 'Mech, the Centurion is good at both taking and giving a beating. CN9-B1 models are able to engage at extreme range thanks to a Light Gauss Rifle and stay in the field with their AMS and Medium Shield.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 百夫长是一款坚固可靠的机甲，既能挨打也能打人。CN9-B1 型号凭借一门轻型高斯步枪能在极远距离交战，并靠其 AMS 与中型盾牌留在战场。

Original: The D variant of the Centurion, introduced in 3049, is the first of many upgrades using Star League technology. The chassis was re-engineered to use Endo Steel construction techniques. Next the power plant was changed from the standard engine to an GM 300 extralight engine, increasing its maximum speed to 97.2 km/h. Finally, the weapons were upgraded. The Autocannon/10 was swapped for a Mydron Excel LB-X Autocannon/10 and an Artemis IV fire control system was added to the LRM launcher. The two medium lasers were retained.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_centurion_CN9-D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The D variant of the Centurion, introduced in 3049, is the first of many upgrades using Star League technology. The chassis was re-engineered to use Endo Steel construction techniques. Next the power plant was changed from the standard engine to an GM 300 extralight engine, increasing its maximum speed to 97.2 km/h. Finally, the weapons were upgraded. The Autocannon/10 was swapped for a Mydron Excel LB-X Autocannon/10 and an Artemis IV fire control system was added to the LRM launcher. The two medium lasers were retained.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 百夫长的 D 变体于 3049 年推出，是众多星盟科技升级中的首个。底盘经重新设计以采用内骨骼构造工艺。随后动力装置从标准引擎改为 GM 300 超轻型引擎，最高速度提升至 97.2 公里/小时。最后武器也获升级：自动炮/10 换成迈德龙 Excel LB-X 自动炮/10，LRM 发射器加装 Artemis IV 火控系统，两门中型激光予以保留。

Original: The CN9-D3 variant introduced in 3052 is identical to the CN9-D Centurion with one exceptional difference. The D3 uses Triple Strength Myomer to increase its top speed up to 118.8 kph while it is running hot.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_centurion_CN9-D3.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The CN9-D3 variant introduced in 3052 is identical to the CN9-D Centurion with one exceptional difference. The D3 uses Triple Strength Myomer to increase its top speed up to 118.8 kph while it is running hot.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3052 年推出的 CN9-D3 变体与 CN9-D 百夫长完全相同，只有一个特殊差异。D3 使用三倍强度人造肌，在过热运转时把最高速度提升至 118.8 公里/小时。

Original: The D3D variant of this 'Mech is a potent long-range sniper, first built in 3060. It uses the same chassis and engine combination as the D3 variant but uses MASC to augment its movement to give it a maximum speed of 129.6 kph. The primary weapon on the D3D is a Light Gauss Rifle. For added long range assistance, the 'Mech carries an LRM-10 launcher and for close range combat it carries an ER Medium Laser. This is all protected with eight tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_centurion_CN9-D3D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The D3D variant of this 'Mech is a potent long-range sniper, first built in 3060. It uses the same chassis and engine combination as the D3 variant but uses MASC to augment its movement to give it a maximum speed of 129.6 kph. The primary weapon on the D3D is a Light Gauss Rifle. For added long range assistance, the 'Mech carries an LRM-10 launcher and for close range combat it carries an ER Medium Laser. This is all protected with eight tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该机甲的 D3D 变体是威力强大的远程狙击型，于 3060 年首次建造。它使用与 D3 变体相同的底盘与引擎组合，但用 MASC 增强其移动，最高速度达 129.6 公里/小时。D3D 的主武器是一门轻型高斯步枪。为增强远程支援，机甲携带一具 LRM-10 发射器，近战则一门 ER 中型激光。这一切由八吨铁纤维装甲保护。

Original: A sturdy and reliable 'Mech, the Centurion is good at both taking and giving a beating. CN9-D models are upgraded for a LB-X AC and Artemis supported MML.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_centurion_CN9-DA.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A sturdy and reliable 'Mech, the Centurion is good at both taking and giving a beating. CN9-D models are upgraded for a LB-X AC and Artemis supported MML.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 百夫长是一款坚固可靠的机甲，既能挨打也能打人。CN9-D 型号升级为 LB-X AC 和 Artemis 支援的 MML。

Original: The first purely Marian mech to come from hegemony Factories. It keeps costs down with both primitive armour and engine but counteracts this with a masive alpha from it's 40 Rockets.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_centurion_CN9-H.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The first purely Marian mech to come from hegemony Factories. It keeps costs down with both primitive armour and engine but counteracts this with a masive alpha from it's 40 Rockets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是首款完全由霸权工厂出品的马里安机甲。它以原始装甲和引擎压低成本，但用 40 枚火箭构成的巨型齐射来抵消这一劣势。

Original: A sturdy and reliable 'Mech, the Centurion is good at both taking and giving a beating. CN9-A models are able to engage at any range, but their damage curve increases as they approach a target.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_centurion_TARGETDUMMY.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A sturdy and reliable 'Mech, the Centurion is good at both taking and giving a beating. CN9-A models are able to engage at any range, but their damage curve increases as they approach a target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 百夫长是一款坚固可靠的机甲，既能挨打也能打人。CN9-A 型号能在任何距离交战，其伤害曲线随接近目标而上升。

Original: The Chameleon was designed to help a new MechWarrior master the skills of maneuvering and heat management, with a top speed of 97.2 kph and a jumping distance of one hundred and eighty meters. The 'Mech also had an almost all energy weapons loadout, but cooled only by ten standard heat sinks. This paucity of freezers forces MechWarriors to concentrate on the 'Mech's heat levels. In some instances, the Chameleon had been forced into combat situations, notably during the Dragoon Civil War. Production of the Chameleon halted briefly in 3052 when Defiance Industries decided to switch its production to the Nightsky, but was quickly resumed when J.B. BattleMechs Incorporated purchased the rights to the design. J.B. BattleMechs also introduced two battle-worthy variants of the Chameleon. The Chameleon is a training 'Mech, intended to simulate a variety of opponents by mounting a wide variety of weapon systems. A Chameleon is a medium 'Mech, but it doesn't always look like one. It can be fitted out with extra plates to modify its appearance, and carries special electronics to falsify its signature; these special abilities let it look and scan as something other than what it is, hence the machine's name.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_chameleon_CLN-7V.Details

Production of the Chameleon halted briefly in 3052 when Defiance Industries decided to switch its production to the Nightsky, but was quickly resumed when J.B. BattleMechs Incorporated purchased the rights to the design. J.B. BattleMechs also introduced two battle-worthy variants of the Chameleon. The Chameleon is a training 'Mech, intended to simulate a variety of opponents by mounting a wide variety of weapon systems. A Chameleon is a medium 'Mech, but it doesn't always look like one. It can be fitted out with extra plates to modify its appearance, and carries special electronics to falsify its signature; these special abilities let it look and scan as something other than what it is, hence the machine's name.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 变色龙旨在帮助新手机甲战士掌握机动与散热管理技巧，最高速度 97.2 公里/小时，跳跃距离一百八十米。该机甲还配备几乎全能量的武器配置，但仅由十台标准散热器冷却。散热器的匮乏迫使机甲战士专注于机甲的热量水平。某些情况下，变色龙被迫投入实战，尤其是在龙骑兵内战期间。变色龙的生产曾在 3052 年短暂中断，当时迪法恩斯工业决定将生产转向夜空，但在 J.B. 机甲公司购得该设计权后迅速恢复。J.B. 机甲还推出了两款具备战斗力的变色龙变体。变色龙是一款训练机甲，旨在通过搭载多种武器系统来模拟各类对手。变色龙是中型机甲，但不总是看起来像。它可以加装额外装甲板改变外观，并携带特殊电子设备伪造自身信号；这些特殊能力让它看起来和扫描起来都不像自己，因此得名。

Original: The Chameleon was designed to help a new MechWarrior master the skills of maneuvering and heat management, with a top speed of 97.2 kph and a jumping distance of one hundred and eighty meters. The 'Mech also had an almost all energy weapons loadout, but cooled only by ten standard heat sinks. This paucity of freezers forces MechWarriors to concentrate on the 'Mech's heat levels. In some instances, the Chameleon had been forced into combat situations, notably during the Dragoon Civil War. Production of the Chameleon halted briefly in 3052 when Defiance Industries decided to switch its production to the Nightsky, but was quickly resumed when J.B. BattleMechs Incorporated purchased the rights to the design. J.B. BattleMechs also introduced two battle-worthy variants of the Chameleon. Original: Where the CHP-2N is the downgraded Succession Wars variant of the Champion, the -1N is the fully powered Star League variant and is the original one the designers introduced. The high speed for a mech its size remains as does the somewhat anemic armor, the main benefit the mech gets from Star League technology is found in the weaponry: a LB-10X Autocannon, a SRM 6 with an Artemis IV system, and a pair each of Medium and Small Lasers. Otherwise, the -1N is much the same as the -2N and performs the same in many ways.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_champion_CHP-1N.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Where the CHP-2N is the downgraded Succession Wars variant of the Champion, the -1N is the fully powered Star League variant and is the original one the designers introduced. The high speed for a mech its size remains as does the somewhat anemic armor, the main benefit the mech gets from Star League technology is found in the weaponry: a LB-10X Autocannon, a SRM 6 with an Artemis IV system, and a pair each of Medium and Small Lasers. Otherwise, the -1N is much the same as the -2N and performs the same in many ways.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: CHP-2N 是冠军在继承战争中的降级版，而-1N 则是完整的星盟版本，也是设计师最初推出的原始型号。对如此尺寸的机甲而言速度依旧很高，装甲依然略显单薄，机甲从星盟科技中获得的主要好处体现在武器上：一门 LB-10X 自动炮、一具配 Artemis IV 系统的 SRM 6，以及成对的中型与小型激光。除此之外，-1N 与-2N 大体相同，表现也多有相似。

Original: During the Star League when the Champion-1N was in full production, there was a frequent pilot modification that turned into a production variant. This mech, the -1N2, is exactly the same as the -1N with the exception of the heat sinks, which have been upgraded to doubles. In all other respects, the -1N2 is the same as the -1N.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_champion_CHP-1N2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: During the Star League when the Champion-1N was in full production, there was a frequent pilot modification that turned into a production variant. This mech, the -1N2, is exactly the same as the -1N with the exception of the heat sinks, which have been upgraded to doubles. In all other respects, the -1N2 is the same as the -1N.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 星盟时期，冠军-1N 全速生产时，有一种常见的飞行员改装后来变成了量产变体。这台机甲就是-1N2，除散热器升级为双倍外，与-1N 完全相同。其他方面-1N2 与-1N 一致。

Original: A variant reserved for SLDF Royal units, this Champion was introduced in 2751 and replaces all the standard weaponry with a Gauss Rifle and ER PPC. It also uses double heat sinks. This gave the -1Nb an extremely long range weapon profile and a serious punch while also solving its heat issues.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_champion_CHP-1Nb.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A variant reserved for SLDF Royal units, this Champion was introduced in 2751 and replaces all the standard weaponry with a Gauss Rifle and ER PPC. It also uses double heat sinks. This gave the -1Nb an extremely long range weapon profile and a serious punch while also solving its heat issues.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是为星盟防卫军皇家部队保留的变体，2751 年推出，将所有标准武器换成一门高斯步枪和一门 ER PPC。它还使用双倍散热器。这使-1Nb 拥有极远射程的武器配置和强悍打击力，同时解决了散热问题。

Original: The Champion debuted in 2602 as a generalist combat 'Mech with a focus on heavy reconnaissance and fast strike capabilities. While definitely faster and more maneuverable than other heavy 'Mechs, it was criticized by many for being too large, underarmed and underarmored. The armament on the Champion is considered by many to be feeble for its size, especially after losing its advanced technology from the Star League. Carrying an AC/10, a SRM 6, and a pair each of Medium and Small Lasers, the Champion is woefully underarmed for its size.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_champion_CHP-2N.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Champion debuted in 2602 as a generalist combat 'Mech with a focus on heavy reconnaissance and fast strike capabilities. While definitely faster and more maneuverable than other heavy 'Mechs, it was criticized by many for being too large, underarmed and underarmored. The armament on the Champion is considered by many to be feeble for its size, especially after losing its advanced technology from the Star League. Carrying an AC/10, a SRM 6, and a pair each of Medium and Small Lasers, the Champion is woefully underarmed for its size.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 冠军于 2602 年首次亮相，是一款通用战斗机甲，侧重重型侦察与快速打击能力。虽然确实比其他重型机甲更快更灵活，它却被许多人批评体型过大、武装与装甲不足。许多人认为冠军的武器就其尺寸而言过于孱弱，尤其在失去星盟的先进技术之后。它携带一门 AC/10、一具 SRM 6，以及成对的中型与小型激光，就尺寸而言武装弱得可怜。

Original: The Charger is seen as an example of abject failure in BattleMech design. Wells Technologies originally wanted to produce an ultra-heavy scout 'Mech for the Star League Defense Force that was not only fast but could survive contact with the enemy. This was done by building the Charger on an 80-ton frame, making it the heaviest scout 'Mech in existence, and powering it with a massive LTV 400 fusion engine that took up almost sixty percent of the Charger's mass. With a top speed which allowed it to outrun most other 'Mechs the Charger was then given ten tons of Durallex Heavy armor, enough to survive repeated hits from a Class 20 Autocannon. However these features left very little room for offensive capability, an intentional deficiency on the part of the design team as they saw any task other than gathering data a distraction.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_charger_CGR-1A1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Charger is seen as an example of abject failure in BattleMech design. Wells Technologies originally wanted to produce an ultra-heavy scout 'Mech for the Star League Defense Force that was not only fast but could survive contact with the enemy.
