With a top speed which allowed it to outrun most other 'Mechs the Charger was then given ten tons of Durallex Heavy armor, enough to survive repeated hits from a Class 20 Autocannon. However these features left very little room for offensive capability, an intentional deficiency on the part of the design team as they saw any task other than gathering data a distraction.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 冲锋者被视为战斗机甲设计中彻底失败的例子。威尔斯科技原本想为星盟防卫军生产一款超重型侦察机甲，不仅快速，还能在与敌接触中存活。为此他们把冲锋者建在 80 吨骨架上，使其成为现存最重的侦察机甲，并以一台占据冲锋者近百分之六十质量的巨大 LTV 400 聚变引擎驱动。凭借使其能跑赢大多数其他机甲的极高速度，冲锋者随后获得十吨杜拉莱克斯重型装甲，足以反复承受 20 级自动炮的命中。然而这些特性几乎没给进攻能力留下空间——这是设计团队有意为之的缺陷，因为他们认为除收集数据之外的任何任务都是干扰。

Original: The 1A5 variant of the Charger was one of the first variants of the Charger made to take it from the role of scout to assault 'Mech. A Capellan modification to the CGR-1Ls they received as part of the Kapteyn Accords, the engine was downgraded to a 320 version, which reduced the maximum speed of the 'Mech to 64.8 km/h, and four of the small lasers were removed. In their place was a Tomodzuru Autocannon/20 as its primary weapon, two Bical SRM-6 launchers and an Argra 3L Medium Laser, while the 'Mech's armor was increased by five tons. This made the CGR-1A5 extremely dangerous at close ranges and gave it a speed comparable to most 'Mechs in the heavy weight class, while carrying armor on par with other eighty-ton 'Mechs.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_charger_CGR-1A5.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 1A5 variant of the Charger was one of the first variants of the Charger made to take it from the role of scout to assault 'Mech. A Capellan modification to the CGR-1Ls they received as part of the Kapteyn Accords, the engine was downgraded to a 320 version, which reduced the maximum speed of the 'Mech to 64.8 km/h, and four of the small lasers were removed. In their place was a Tomodzuru Autocannon/20 as its primary weapon, two Bical SRM-6 launchers and an Argra 3L Medium Laser, while the 'Mech's armor was increased by five tons. This made the CGR-1A5 extremely dangerous at close ranges and gave it a speed comparable to most 'Mechs in the heavy weight class, while carrying armor on par with other eighty-ton 'Mechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 冲锋者 1A5 变体是最早把冲锋者从侦察角色转变为突击机甲的变体之一。它是卡佩兰对作为卡普坦协定一部分所获 CGR-1L 的改装，引擎降级为 320 版本，把机甲最高速度降至 64.8 公里/小时，并移除四门小型激光。取而代之的是作为主武器的"友鹤"自动炮/20、两具比卡尔 SRM-6 发射器和一门阿尔格拉 3L 中型激光，机甲装甲增加五吨。这使 CGR-1A5 在近程极为危险，速度可与多数重型机甲相当，同时装甲与其他八十吨机甲持平。

Original: A Combine-LAW attempt to make the Charger more effective at long ranges, the 1A9 used a reduced 320-rated engine, lowering its top speed to 64.8 km/h, and its arsenal was overhauled. All of the smaller lasers (except for the head mounted one) were replaced with medium lasers and a single LRM-20 launcher was mounted in the right torso, with two tons of reloads carried in the left torso. To make up for the lost mobility, four jump jets were also installed, two in each leg, to allow the Charger to jump up to one hundred and twenty meters. This variant was fielded in time to surprise the Armed Forces of the Federated Suns during the War of 3039, but in years since the design fell into the hands of the Outworlds Alliance thanks to a legal snafu which gave Ravenna Electronics a production license.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_charger_CGR-1A9.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Combine-LAW attempt to make the Charger more effective at long ranges, the 1A9 used a reduced 320-rated engine, lowering its top speed to 64.8 km/h, and its arsenal was overhauled. All of the smaller lasers (except for the head mounted one) were replaced with medium lasers and a single LRM-20 launcher was mounted in the right torso, with two tons of reloads carried in the left torso. To make up for the lost mobility, four jump jets were also installed, two in each leg, to allow the Charger to jump up to one hundred and twenty meters. This variant was fielded in time to surprise the Armed Forces of the Federated Suns during the War of 3039, but in years since the design fell into the hands of the Outworlds Alliance thanks to a legal snafu which gave Ravenna Electronics a production license.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 1A9 是联合体-LAW 为使冲锋者在远程更有效所做的尝试，它采用缩小的 320 级引擎，把最高速度降至 64.8 公里/小时，并全面改造了武器库。所有较小激光（除头部那门）都换成中型激光，右躯干安装一具 LRM-20 发射器，左躯干携带两吨再装填。为弥补丧失的机动性，还安装了四个跳跃推进器（每腿两个），使冲锋者可跳跃至一百二十米。该变体及时投入战场，在 3039 年战争中令联邦太阳系武装部队大为意外，但此后数年因一次法律纠纷授予雷文纳电子生产许可，该设计落入外域联盟之手。

Original: An export model sold to the Capellan Confederation as part of the Kapteyn Accords, the CGR-1L was a simple modification of the Charger in an attempt to make it more effective following their disastrous use on Chara in 3023. In place of four and a half tons of armor and all five Small Lasers, the 1L mounts a Large Laser in its right arm and two medium lasers in either side torso. While more prone to overheating and less protected - mounting armor comparable to that of a traditional scout 'Mech - it was better capable of defending itself against other scout 'Mechs, and at the time that was good enough for the desperate warriors of the Capellan Confederation Armed Forces. Since then, the CGR-1L has remained in Capellan service as a training 'Mech and, according to rumor, punishment assignment for dissident soldiers.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_charger_CGR-1L.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An export model sold to the Capellan Confederation as part of the Kapteyn Accords, the CGR-1L was a simple modification of the Charger in an attempt to make it more effective following their disastrous use on Chara in 3023. In place of four and a half tons of armor and all five Small Lasers, the 1L mounts a Large Laser in its right arm and two medium lasers in either side torso. While more prone to overheating and less protected - mounting armor comparable to that of a traditional scout 'Mech - it was better capable of defending itself against other scout 'Mechs, and at the time that was good enough for the desperate warriors of the Capellan Confederation Armed Forces. Since then, the CGR-1L has remained in Capellan service as a training 'Mech and, according to rumor, punishment assignment for dissident soldiers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: CGR-1L 是作为卡普坦协定一部分出售给卡佩兰邦联的出口型号，是对冲锋者的简单改装，试图在 3023 年查拉星上的灾难性使用之后让它更有效。1L 以四吨半装甲和全部五门小型激光为代价，在右臂装一门大型激光，两侧躯干各两门中型激光。虽然更易过热、防护也更差——装甲水平堪比传统侦察机甲——但它更能抵御其他侦察机甲，而在当时，对卡佩兰邦联武装部队绝望的战士而言已经足够。此后 CGR-1L 一直留在卡佩兰服役，作为训练机甲，据传也是对付异见士兵的惩罚性差事。

Original: This radical modification looks to turn the Charger into a traditional assault 'Mech by reducing the 'Mechs speed to 54 km/h, which allows the use of a smaller engine (incidentally, the commonplace Pitban 240 reactor). The 'Mech is armored with fifteen and a half tons of armor and is armed with four Large Lasers, one in each arm and side torso, and a Medium Laser in its head; twenty-eight heat sinks kept the 'Mech cool.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_charger_CGR-SB.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This radical modification looks to turn the Charger into a traditional assault 'Mech by reducing the 'Mechs speed to 54 km/h, which allows the use of a smaller engine (incidentally, the commonplace Pitban 240 reactor). The 'Mech is armored with fifteen and a half tons of armor and is armed with four Large Lasers, one in each arm and side torso, and a Medium Laser in its head; twenty-eight heat sinks kept the 'Mech cool.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这项激进的改装试图把冲锋者变成传统的突击机甲：将机甲速度降至 54 公里/小时，从而得以使用更小的引擎（顺带一提，是常见的皮特班 240 反应堆）。机甲披挂十五吨半装甲，武装为四门大型激光（每臂与每侧躯干各一）以及头部一门中型激光；二十八台散热器使机甲保持凉爽。

Original: In all honesty, Cicadas as a rule are very fragile. The 2A model was designed to be as fast as any light 'Mech, but that massive engine leaves little room for much else. Still, if you use it cautiously, it can be a successful scout and diversion.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_cicada_CDA-2A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In all honesty, Cicadas as a rule are very fragile. The 2A model was designed to be as fast as any light 'Mech, but that massive engine leaves little room for much else. Still, if you use it cautiously, it can be a successful scout and diversion.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 说实话，蝉总体上非常脆弱。2A 型号被设计得与任何轻型机甲一样快，但那台庞大的引擎几乎没给其他东西留下空间。不过只要谨慎使用，它仍能成为成功的侦察与佯动机甲。

Original: A swap out of the 2A's Small Laser and half a ton of armor for a Flamer, this 'Mech can be quickly maneuvered in to heat up an opponent that is already having issues.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_cicada_CDA-2B.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A swap out of the 2A's Small Laser and half a ton of armor for a Flamer, this 'Mech can be quickly maneuvered in to heat up an opponent that is already having issues.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 它以一台火焰喷射器换掉 2A 的小型激光和半吨装甲，可以迅速机动上去给本就散热吃紧的对手再加把火。

Original: A typical Periphery raider, the Cicada 2P is fast and hard hitting but lacks endurance and cannot survive long once it has delivered it's payload. 4 RL-20's make up the bulk of the mechs firepower, capable of threatening even an Assault mech if used correctly. The secondary weapons are a pair of medium chem lasers with a ton of ammo between them. Achieving almost identical speeds to its Inner Sphere counterparts, the 2P is designed as a heavy scout and head hunter with a nasty alpha strike capable of shredding most opponents regardless of the target. Designed to be easy to maintain and even easier to replace, the 2P is built with parts that can be salvaged from most battlefields or brought in any number of back street bazaars or disreputable arms markets. Indeed, most new 2P’s are often repurposed wrecks hauled off the battlefield and rebuilt as quickly as possible.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_cicada_CDA-2P.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A typical Periphery raider, the Cicada 2P is fast and hard hitting but lacks endurance and cannot survive long once it has delivered it's payload. 4 RL-20's make up the bulk of the mechs firepower, capable of threatening even an Assault mech if used correctly. The secondary weapons are a pair of medium chem lasers with a ton of ammo between them. Achieving almost identical speeds to its Inner Sphere counterparts, the 2P is designed as a heavy scout and head hunter with a nasty alpha strike capable of shredding most opponents regardless of the target. Designed to be easy to maintain and even easier to replace, the 2P is built with parts that can be salvaged from most battlefields or brought in any number of back street bazaars or disreputable arms markets. Indeed, most new 2P’s are often repurposed wrecks hauled off the battlefield and rebuilt as quickly as possible.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蝉 2P 是典型的外围区袭扰型，速度快、打击狠，但缺乏耐久，一旦倾泻完弹药就难以久撑。4 具 RL-20 构成机甲火力的主体，运用得当甚至能威胁突击机甲。次要武器是两门中型化学激光，共一吨弹药。2P 的速度几乎与内天体同类相当，被设计为重型侦察与猎头机甲，具备凶悍的全力齐射，不论目标是谁都能撕碎大多数对手。它易于维护、更易替换，用可从大多数战场回收或在任何后街集市、不名誉军火市场上买到的零件建造。事实上，大多数新的 2P 都是被拖离战场的残骸重新拼装，尽快重建而成。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蝉 2P 是典型的外围区劫掠者，快速且打击凶狠，但缺乏耐力，一旦投出载荷便无法长久生存。4 具 RL-20 构成机甲的主要火力，若运用得当甚至能威胁突击机甲。次要武器是两门中型化学激光，共配一吨弹药。2P 的速度几乎与内天体同类相当，被设计为重型侦察兵与猎头者，其凶猛的齐射足以撕裂大多数对手，无论目标为何。2P 为易于维护、更易于替换而设计，其部件可从大多数战场回收，或从任意后巷集市和不入流的军火市场弄到。事实上，多数新的 2P 往往是从战场拖回的报废机体被尽快重建而成。

Original: The Cicada 3C is slightly slower than the 2A but has more room for weaponry and armor. It still generally underperforms in most areas except speed, but it can put up more of a fight, with better survival rates.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_cicada_CDA-3C.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Cicada 3C is slightly slower than the 2A but has more room for weaponry and armor. It still generally underperforms in most areas except speed, but it can put up more of a fight, with better survival rates.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蝉 3C 比 2A 略慢，但有更多空间容纳武器和装甲。除速度外它在多数方面仍普遍表现不佳，但它更能一战，生存率也更高。

Original: A somewhat unusual design, this fire support mech is popular among the more advanced periphery states and with many mercenary commands. Refitting a standard 2A with an XL Engine, Gibson Federated stripped the weapons and replaced them with a pair of LRM-15’s and 3 tons of ammunition. Conceived as a relatively cheap support mech, with the speed to keep up with lighter scout elements and enough ammunition to last most engagements, it has maintained steady sales since it’s introduction and convinced Gibson to refit one of their older 2A production lines; to produce this variant. Deployed by everyone from the FWL to the Outworlds Alliance, this mech has been spreading across the IS and is a common sight among defensive garrisons. Critics of the design note it’s lack of armour and CASE whilst proponents praise it’s low cost and tactical flexibility.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_cicada_CDA-3E.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A somewhat unusual design, this fire support mech is popular among the more advanced periphery states and with many mercenary commands. Refitting a standard 2A with an XL Engine, Gibson Federated stripped the weapons and replaced them with a pair of LRM-15’s and 3 tons of ammunition. Conceived as a relatively cheap support mech, with the speed to keep up with lighter scout elements and enough ammunition to last most engagements, it has maintained steady sales since it’s introduction and convinced Gibson to refit one of their older 2A production lines; to produce this variant. Deployed by everyone from the FWL to the Outworlds Alliance, this mech has been spreading across the IS and is a common sight among defensive garrisons. Critics of the design note it’s lack of armour and CASE whilst proponents praise it’s low cost and tactical flexibility.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一款略显另类的设计，这款火力支援机甲在较先进的外围区国家和许多佣兵部队中颇受欢迎。吉布森联邦将一个标准 2A 换上 XL 引擎，拆除武器代之以两具 LRM-15 和三吨弹药。它被构想为一款相对廉价的支援机甲，速度足以跟上轻型侦察部队，弹药也足以支撑大多数交战，自推出以来销量稳定，并说服吉布森改装了他们一条较老的 2A 生产线以生产此变体。从自由世界联盟到外域联盟都在部署，这款机甲已遍布内天体，在防御驻军中十分常见。批评者指出它缺乏装甲与 C.A.S.E.，支持者则称赞其低成本与战术灵活性。

Original: The 3F Cicada is one of the most advanced versions of this 'Mech, its upgrades based on combat reports from the front lines of the Clan Invasion, and was introduced in 3052. The chassis has been constructed using Endo Steel construction techniques and the 'Mech is protected with six and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. The 3F is powered by an extralight engine and carries a weapons loadout that appears to be a cross between the 2A and 3C models. The primary weapon is an ER PPC, which is backed up by two medium lasers. What's more the Cicada can now jump up to two hundred and forty meters thanks to the inclusion of eight jump jets.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_cicada_CDA-3F.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3F Cicada is one of the most advanced versions of this 'Mech, its upgrades based on combat reports from the front lines of the Clan Invasion, and was introduced in 3052. The chassis has been constructed using Endo Steel construction techniques and the 'Mech is protected with six and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. The 3F is powered by an extralight engine and carries a weapons loadout that appears to be a cross between the 2A and 3C models. The primary weapon is an ER PPC, which is backed up by two medium lasers. What's more the Cicada can now jump up to two hundred and forty meters thanks to the inclusion of eight jump jets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3F 蝉是该机甲最先进的版本之一，其升级基于氏族入侵前线的战斗报告，于 3052 年推出。底盘采用内骨骼建造技术，机甲由六吨半铁纤维装甲保护。3F 由超轻型引擎驱动，武器配置看起来介于 2A 与 3C 型号之间。主武器是一门 ER PPC，辅以两门中型激光。更重要的是，得益于八个跳跃推进器的加入，蝉如今能跳起至二百四十米。

Original: Based off of the same chassis as the 3F, the 3G was introduced in 3056 to transform the chassis into a more dedicated recon platform. It trades in the PPC for an ER Large Laser, a Beagle Active Probe, and additional armor.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_cicada_CDA-3G.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Based off of the same chassis as the 3F, the 3G was introduced in 3056 to transform the chassis into a more dedicated recon platform. It trades in the PPC for an ER Large Laser, a Beagle Active Probe, and additional armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3G 与 3F 使用相同底盘，于 3056 年推出，旨在把底盘改造为更专注的侦察平台。它把 PPC 换成 ER 大型激光、比格犬主动探测器和额外装甲。

Original: A Combine rebuild of captured 3E’s, this design swaps the LRM-15’s for a pair of MRM-20’s and 2 tons of ammo, augmented by an Artemis IV system. Assigned to the Ghost Regiments and the Legions of Vega, these Cicadas are typically employed as scout-skirmishers and scout hunters. Unfortunately the limited ammo and lack of serious protection has lead to many mechwarriors petitioning for reassignment to other units or refusing to pilot these mechs. The Procurement Department on the other hand, is thrilled that it can offload these retrofitted Cicadas to units who have no choice in the matter. Nonetheless pilots who can master this design, report satisfaction with it’s performance and many have turned to field conversions to improve it’s endurance. The most commonly one reported is the installation of an Endosteel skeleton allowing another ton of ammo or the installation CASE II.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_cicada_CDA-3K.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Combine rebuild of captured 3E’s, this design swaps the LRM-15’s for a pair of MRM-20’s and 2 tons of ammo, augmented by an Artemis IV system. Assigned to the Ghost Regiments and the Legions of Vega, these Cicadas are typically employed as scout-skirmishers and scout hunters. Unfortunately the limited ammo and lack of serious protection has lead to many mechwarriors petitioning for reassignment to other units or refusing to pilot these mechs. The Procurement Department on the other hand, is thrilled that it can offload these retrofitted Cicadas to units who have no choice in the matter. Nonetheless pilots who can master this design, report satisfaction with it’s performance and many have turned to field conversions to improve it’s endurance. The most commonly one reported is the installation of an Endosteel skeleton allowing another ton of ammo or the installation CASE II.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款设计是联合体对缴获 3E 的重建，把 LRM-15 换成一对 MRM-20 和 2 吨弹药，并加装 Artemis IV 系统。这些蝉被配属给幽灵团与维加军团，通常作为侦察散兵和侦察猎手使用。遗憾的是，有限的弹药和缺乏像样的防护导致许多机甲战士申请调往其他单位或拒绝驾驶这些机甲。另一方面，采购部门却为能把这些改装蝉甩给别无选择的单位而欣喜若狂。尽管如此，能驾驭此设计的飞行员报告对其性能满意，许多人转而进行野战改装以提升其续航力。最常被报告的改装是安装内骨骼骨架以多带一吨弹药，或加装 C.A.S.E. II。

Original: The Cicada 3L is a succession war refit turning it into a fire support platform.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_cicada_CDA-3L.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Cicada 3L is a succession war refit turning it into a fire support platform.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蝉 3L 是继承战争时期的改装型，将其改造为火力支援平台。

Original: The 3M upgrade of this older BattleMech uses some of the newest technology available at its introduction in 3049. It uses an extralight version of the same Pitban 320 engine, freeing up extra space to upgrade the small laser to a Small Pulse Laser and adding an Ultra Autocannon/5 to the left torso. The new ballistic weapon is fed by one ton of ammunition stored in the right torso and protected by CASE in the event of an ammunition explosion. The Star Slab armor has also been replaced with Durallex Light, although the amount of protection is the same as in the 2A.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_cicada_CDA-3M.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3M upgrade of this older BattleMech uses some of the newest technology available at its introduction in 3049. It uses an extralight version of the same Pitban 320 engine, freeing up extra space to upgrade the small laser to a Small Pulse Laser and adding an Ultra Autocannon/5 to the left torso. The new ballistic weapon is fed by one ton of ammunition stored in the right torso and protected by CASE in the event of an ammunition explosion. The Star Slab armor has also been replaced with Durallex Light, although the amount of protection is the same as in the 2A.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款较老战斗机甲的 3M 升级版使用了 3049 年推出时可获得的部分最新技术。它采用同款皮特班 320 引擎的超轻型版本，腾出额外空间把小型激光升级为小型脉冲激光，并在左躯干加装一门超速自动炮/5。这门新实弹武器由右躯干储存的一吨弹药供弹，并在弹药爆炸时由 C.A.S.E. 保护。"星板"装甲也已换成杜拉莱克斯轻型，尽管防护量与 2A 相同。

Original: The Cicada 4L is yet another refit born from a shortage of proper parts. It carries two Light Rifles with two tons of ammo.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_cicada_CDA-4L.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Cicada 4L is yet another refit born from a shortage of proper parts. It carries two Light Rifles with two tons of ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蝉 4L 又是一个因缺乏合适零件而生的改装型。它携带两门轻型步枪和两吨弹药。

Original: This was once a Clint mech, but now it has spikes all over and it's current weapons, that either fire or blow up in your face.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_clint_CLNT-1-2R-P.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This was once a Clint mech, but now it has spikes all over and it's current weapons, that either fire or blow up in your face.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这曾经是一台克林特机甲，但现在浑身是尖刺，武器不是开火就是炸你一脸。

Original: This was once a Clint mech, but now it has spikes all over and it's current weapons, that either fire or blow up in your face.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_clint_CLNT-1-2R-P2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This was once a Clint mech, but now it has spikes all over and it's current weapons, that either fire or blow up in your face.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这曾经是一台克林特机甲，但现在浑身是尖刺，武器不是开火就是炸你一脸。

Original: The Clint was primarily designed as a cheap recon unit, with the capabilities of a well-armed, low-end medium weight 'Mech, and in this regard it served well. With a top speed of 97.2 km/h and a jumping capability of one hundred and eighty meters, the Clint can easily keep up with other recon elements and maneuver through mountainous or urban terrain. The 1-2R Clint was the original prototype variant that carried an Armstrong Buster Autocannon/10 with a single Medium Laser as a secondary weapon and no jump jets.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_clint_CLNT-1-2R.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Clint was primarily designed as a cheap recon unit, with the capabilities of a well-armed, low-end medium weight 'Mech, and in this regard it served well. With a top speed of 97.2 km/h and a jumping capability of one hundred and eighty meters, the Clint can easily keep up with other recon elements and maneuver through mountainous or urban terrain. The 1-2R Clint was the original prototype variant that carried an Armstrong Buster Autocannon/10 with a single Medium Laser as a secondary weapon and no jump jets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 克林特主要被设计为廉价的侦察单位，具备武装良好的入门级中量级机甲的能力，在这方面它表现出色。凭借 97.2 公里/小时的最高速度和一百八十米的跳跃能力，克林特能轻松跟上其他侦察单位，并能穿越山地或城市地形。1-2R 克林特是最初的原型变体，携带一门阿姆斯特朗"破坏者"自动炮/10，以一门中型激光为次要武器，且没有跳跃推进器。

Original: The Clint was primarily designed as a cheap recon unit, with the capabilities of a well-armed, low-end medium weight 'Mech, and in this regard it served well. With a top speed of 97.2 km/h and a jumping capability of one hundred and eighty meters, the Clint can easily keep up with other recon elements and maneuver through mountainous or urban terrain. The 2-2R Clint is an even more cheap refit of the original variant, equipping primitive, cheaper weaponry, that periphery states can afford.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_clint_CLNT-2-2R.Details

Original: The Clint was primarily designed as a cheap recon unit, with the capabilities of a well-armed, low-end medium weight 'Mech, and in this regard it served well. With a top speed of 97.2 km/h and a jumping capability of one hundred and eighty meters, the Clint can easily keep up with other recon elements and maneuver through mountainous or urban terrain. This well-balanced mix of weapons when combined with the Clint's above-average maneuverability for its size make the Clint a highly effective multi-role BattleMech.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_clint_CLNT-2-3T.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Clint was primarily designed as a cheap recon unit, with the capabilities of a well-armed, low-end medium weight 'Mech, and in this regard it served well. With a top speed of 97.2 km/h and a jumping capability of one hundred and eighty meters, the Clint can easily keep up with other recon elements and maneuver through mountainous or urban terrain. The Clint 2-3T equipped with one Autocannon/5 with one ton of ammunition. As secondary weapons, the Clint carries two Martell Medium Lasers. This well-balanced mix of weapons when combined with the Clint's above-average maneuverability for its size make the Clint a highly effective multi-role BattleMech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 克林特主要被设计为廉价的侦察单位，具备武装良好的入门级中量级机甲的能力，在这方面它表现出色。凭借 97.2 公里/小时的最高速度和一百八十米的跳跃能力，克林特能轻松跟上其他侦察单位，并能穿越山地或城市地形。克林特 2-3T 装备一门自动炮/5，配一吨弹药。作为次要武器，克林特携带两门马特尔中型激光。这种均衡的武器搭配结合克林特同尺寸中高于平均的机动性，使克林特成为极为高效的多用途战斗机甲。

Original: The Clint was primarily designed as a cheap recon unit, with the capabilities of a well-armed, low-end medium weight 'Mech, and in this regard it served well. With a top speed of 97.2 km/h and a jumping capability of one hundred and eighty meters, the Clint can easily keep up with other recon elements and maneuver through mountainous or urban terrain. The Clint 2-3U is a Capellan field upgrade of the Clint that strips all of the armaments from the chassis and replaces them with more potent and enduring weaponry, the most radical of which is the primary weapon. The AC/5 has been replaced with an ER PPC while both the Medium Lasers were replaced with Medium Pulse Lasers; as a result, it runs much hotter than the original. The 3U also packs double heat sinks in place of single models and is more deadly in combat.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_clint_CLNT-2-3U.Details

Original: When General Aleksandr Kerensky led most of the Star League Defense Force into exile in 2784, they brought prototypes of the Clint BattleMech with them. After the annihilation of Clan Wolverine, Clan Snow Raven revisited these prototypes and was able to begin mass-production of the 'Mech in 2830 and introduced 2842. They ensured that it kept up with advances in Clan technology, eventually becoming the design that is now known as the Clint IIC. This speedy medium 'Mech is armed with a Type KOV LB-10X Autocannon and a pair of Series 2d ER Medium Lasers. This makes the Clint IIC an effective light 'Mech killer. It is capable of ranging far beyond supply lines thanks to its four tons of ammunition, though it only uses ten standard heat sinks and seven tons of standard armor.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_clint_CLNT-IIC.Details

Original: The COM-5S was introduced in 3050 and was the first Commando to feature Star League technology. Additionally, the chassis has been upgraded with Endo Steel, the armor has been upgraded to Ferro-Fibrous, and CASE has been added to protect the ammunition.

Original: During the Amaris Civil War, several Lyran MechWarriors joined the SLDF in defiance of their government's policy of neutrality. With this came the coup that the Star League Defense Force had attempted to pull off for decades: the acquisition of the Lyran Commando. Long considered one of the better scout 'Mechs in the Inner Sphere, at least one of these Commandos accompanied Kerensky into exile and several of them appeared in the forces assigned to Operation Klondike. As newer weapons and 'Mechs made their way into the Clan arsenal, these Commandos began to show their age, so Clan Goliath Scorpion began a program to upgrade theirs. Dubbed the Commando IIC, this upgrade used newer technologies to outperform its venerable cousin. With the proliferation of OmniMechs, most Commando IICs were relegated to second line status, though the Scorpions still continue to outfit some of their pirate hunters with these 'Mechs.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_commando_COM-IIC.Details

Dubbed the Commando IIC, this upgrade used newer technologies to outperform its venerable cousin. With the proliferation of OmniMechs, most Commando IICs were relegated to second line status, though the Scorpions still continue to outfit some of their pirate hunters with these 'Mechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿马里斯内战期间，数名莱兰机甲战士不顾政府中立政策加入星盟防卫军。随之而来的是星盟防卫军数十年来一直试图实现的目标：获得莱兰突击队。突击队长期被视为内天体最好的侦察机甲之一，至少有一台随克伦斯基流亡，数台出现在"克朗代克行动"的部队中。随着更新式武器与机甲进入氏族武库，这些突击队开始显露老态，于是歌利亚蝎氏族启动了升级计划。命名为突击队 IIC，该升级利用更新技术超越了它古老的表亲。随着全能机甲普及，大多数突击队 IIC 退居二线，但蝎氏族仍继续用它们装备部分猎杀海盗的部队。

Original: First produced in late fall of 3054, the Copperhead is a finely honed arena 'Mech. The design rose to fame when Silver Dragons Stables MechWarrior Brendon Frazer piloted his Copperhead, the Silver Snake, into the Solaris Top Twenty prior to his untimely death. The Silver Dragons commissioned Solaris Arms to develop a new exclusive variant to try and repeat the feat, but the new model's expensive experimental weaponry forced them to allow sales to other interested parties. The Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery snapped up a number of the original CPR-HD-002 models. While not increasing the original model's meager four and half tons of armor coverage, Solaris Arms chose to replace the original Durallex plating with ArcShield Reflective Armor to enhance its endurance against the large volume of energy weapons carried by Arena 'Mechs. Already a relatively speedy design, the addition of a Supercharger enhanced its ground speed. Its extremely short jumping distance was neither improved nor removed; instead it was retained to expand a pilot's options in tight terrain. An extra Double Heat Sink, bringing the total to thirteen, is still not enough to keep up with the increased heat produced by the CPR-HD-003's advanced laser weaponry. Allowing the designers to squeeze in the new systems, a cramped Small Cockpit is used, which is less of a liability in the short duration arena battles than on an actual battlefield.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_copperhead_CPR-HD-002.Details

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 铜斑蛇于 3054 年深秋首次生产，是一台精炼的竞技场机甲。当银龙马疚的机甲战士布伦登·弗雷泽驾驶他的铜斑蛇"银蛇"齐身索拉里斯前二十名后，这一设计声名大噪——随后他不幸身亡。银龙委托索拉里斯兵工厂开发一款新的独家变体以图重现这一壮举，但新型号昂贵的实验性武器迫使他们允许向其他有意方销售。德拉科尼斯联合体征募兵部队迅速抢购了若干原版 CPR-HD-002 型号。索拉里斯兵工厂并未增加原型那可怜的四吨半装甲覆盖，而是选择把原有的杜拉莱克斯装甲板换成"弧盾"反射装甲，以增强其对竞技场机甲所携带大量能量武器的耐久力。这本来就已是相对高速的设计，加装增压器后地面速度进一步提升。它极短的跳跃距离既未改进也未取消，而是保留下来以拓展飞行员在狭窄地形中的选择。增加一台双倍散热器使总数达到十三台，仍不足以应对 CPR-HD-003 先进激光武器产生的更高热量。为让设计者塞进这些新系统，采用了狭窄的小型驾驶舱——在短时的竞技场战斗中，这比在真实战场上危害更小。

Original: While Corsair is supposedly a generic Periphery term referring to heavy and assault class FrankenMechs cobbled together out of desperation as the Succession War era dragged on, with no specific weight or base chassis, the most successful of these are ninety-five ton brutes modeled in a generally similar style, usually marked with a COR designation. Armed with a grab-bag array of weaponry, the Corsair's primary weapons are an AC/10 and LRM-15 mounted in its right torso, supported by a trio of Medium Lasers split between its left and center torsos and a SRM-6 and Large Laser mounted in its vestigial left arm.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_corsair_COR-5R.Details

Original: At its core this is still a typical Periphery FrankenMech, but it received a lot of care from 'Her' owner, named after a infamous Terran Pirate Queen, does this specific design sport a Thumper Artillery Piece and munitions from the Barrymore Munitions manufacturers, granting superior Tactical Flexibility.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_corsair_COR-S7.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: At its core this is still a typical Periphery FrankenMech, but it received a lot of care from 'Her' owner, named after a infamous Terran Pirate Queen, does this specific design sport a Thumper Artillery Piece and munitions from the Barrymore Munitions manufacturers, granting superior Tactical Flexibility.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 本质上它仍是典型的外围区拼装机甲，但它得到了"她"的主人——以一位臭名昭著的泰拉海盗女王命名——的精心照料。这款特定设计装备一门重锤火炮与巴里摩尔弹药公司的弹药，赋予其卓越的战术灵活性。

Original: The Cossack is named after the mercenary unit Khorsakov's Cossacks in honor of their faithful service to the St Ives Compact. The Cossack is a practice in compromise. Originally requested as the fastest 'Mech that Ceres Metals Industries could produce, the emphasis of the design changed throughout its development to a slow moving, heavily armored light 'Mech. The final design that was accepted became the current incarnation of the Cossack. The Cossack is built on a Taijian Series X Endo Steel chassis to save weight. More weight was cut from the design by using a lightweight Hermes 120 XL engine that gives the 'Mech a top speed of 97.2 km/h. Six Pitban LFT-65 jump jets allow the Cossack to jump up to hundred and eighty meters, allowing the 'Mech to easily handle most rough terrain. For protection, the Cossack has three tons of armor and has ten heat sinks to handle the heat produced by the weapons payload carried by the 'Mech. Overall, the compromise that created the Cossack has turned it into a light trooper 'Mech that works well as part of a team but alone excels at no one role.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_cossack_C-SK1.Details

For protection, the Cossack has three tons of armor and has ten heat sinks to handle the heat produced by the weapons payload carried by the 'Mech. Overall, the compromise that created the Cossack has turned it into a light trooper 'Mech that works well as part of a team but alone excels at no one role.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 哥萨克以佣兵部队霍尔萨科夫的哥萨克命名，以表彰他们对圣艾夫斯共同体的忠诚服役。哥萨克是妥协的实践。它最初被要求成为塞雷斯金属工业所能生产的最快机甲，但在开发过程中设计重心转变为一款缓慢、重装甲的轻型机甲。最终被采纳的设计成为哥萨克现在的模样。哥萨克基于"太极 X 系列"内骨骼底盘建造以减轻重量。设计还通过使用轻量化的赫尔墨斯 120 XL 引擎进一步减重，赋予机甲 97.2 公里/小时的最高速度。六个皮特班 LFT-65 跳跃推进器使哥萨克能跳起至一百八十米，使机甲能轻松应对大多数崎岖地形。防护方面，哥萨克有三吨装甲和十台散热器，以处理机甲武器载荷产生的热量。总体而言，造就哥萨克的妥协把它变成了一款轻型通用机甲，作为团队成员表现良好，但单独行动时在任何角色上都不出众。

Original: With a focus on indirect fire support, the COU-A fields a pair of Artemis IV guided LRM-20s. If the pilot finds itself in a position with direct line of sight he or she can also rely on a pair of ERML's and a single backup Small Pulse Laser. In total this makes for a lot of firepower in a very small package.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_cougar_CGR-A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: With a focus on indirect fire support, the COU-A fields a pair of Artemis IV guided LRM-20s. If the pilot finds itself in a position with direct line of sight he or she can also rely on a pair of ERML's and a single backup Small Pulse Laser. In total this makes for a lot of firepower in a very small package.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: COU-A 聚焦间接火力支援，装备一对 Artemis IV 制导的 LRM-20。若飞行员处于有直射视野的位置，还可依靠两门 ER 中型激光和一门备用小型脉冲激光。总而言之，这在极小的机体中汇聚了极其可观的火力。

Original: The Cougar-B is a classic clan direct fire support / sniper build. Dual ERPPCs and a backup ERML make for a formidable punch. With a set of six additional Double Heatsinks the COU-B runs reasonably cool and is able to keep its barrage up for quite a while.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_cougar_CGR-B.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Cougar-B is a classic clan direct fire support / sniper build. Dual ERPPCs and a backup ERML make for a formidable punch. With a set of six additional Double Heatsinks the COU-B runs reasonably cool and is able to keep its barrage up for quite a while.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 美洲狮-B 是经典的氏族直射火力支援/狙击配置。双 ER PPC 加一门备用 ER 中型激光构成强大的打击力。凭借六台额外双倍散热器，COU-B 散热相当理想，能长时间维持火力倾泻。

Original: A mix of long and medium range weaponry is what makes the Cougar-C variant quite unique. A Gauss Rifle is an absolutely scary main weapon system for a mech of just 35 tons and even the backup weapons are more than enough to strike fear in its enemies heart: 5 ERML will allow the COU-C to stay active and dangerous even after the ammo for the Gauss is depleted.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_cougar_CGR-C.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A mix of long and medium range weaponry is what makes the Cougar-C variant quite unique. A Gauss Rifle is an absolutely scary main weapon system for a mech of just 35 tons and even the backup weapons are more than enough to strike fear in its enemies heart: 5 ERML will allow the COU-C to stay active and dangerous even after the ammo for the Gauss is depleted.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 长中程武器的混合让美洲狮-C 变体相当独特。对一台仅 35 吨的机甲而言，一门高斯步枪绝对是令人恐惧的主武器系统，而备用武器也足以让敌人心中生畏：5 门 ER 中型激光使 COU-C 在高斯弹药耗尽的仍能保持活跃与危险。

Original: Conceptualized to be a sniper with a good near field defense the Cougar-D variant relies on a single ERLL and an Ultra Autocannon/10 for long range and dual SRM4 launchers for close range fire. The COU-D might not be quick, but if he closes in after ripping the armor open, these Short Range Missiles have great finishing potential.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_cougar_CGR-D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Conceptualized to be a sniper with a good near field defense the Cougar-D variant relies on a single ERLL and an Ultra Autocannon/10 for long range and dual SRM4 launchers for close range fire. The COU-D might not be quick, but if he closes in after ripping the armor open, these Short Range Missiles have great finishing potential.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 美洲狮-D 变体的构想是具备良好近场防御的狙击手，它依靠一门 ER 大型激光和一门超速自动炮/10 负责远程，双联 SRM4 发射器负责近程。COU-D 也许不算迅速，但如果它撕开装甲后贴近，这些短程火箭有很强的收尾能力。

Original: The Huntress configuration of the Cougar is a rare sight, designed to be a scout hunter and Heavy Hitter is most of its capability shifted to advanced electronics and the ability to detect and effectively kill even stealthed units in a single devastating Blow.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_cougar_CGR-HR.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Huntress configuration of the Cougar is a rare sight, designed to be a scout hunter and Heavy Hitter is most of its capability shifted to advanced electronics and the ability to detect and effectively kill even stealthed units in a single devastating Blow.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 美洲狮的"女猎手"配置十分罕见，旨在作为侦察猎手与重击手，其大部分能力都转向先进电子设备以及侦测并一击致命地干掉即使处于隐形状态的单位。

Original: Khan Marthe Pryde decided to upgrade the 'Mechs her Clan fielded. Rather than waste precious resources designing a new OmniMech from the ground up, she instructed her scientists to improve upon existing designs. The design the scientists chose to modify was the Adder. Though the two 'Mechs are visually similar and share the same weight, the Cougar is slower and better armed.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_cougar_CGR-Prime.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Khan Marthe Pryde decided to upgrade the 'Mechs her Clan fielded. Rather than waste precious resources designing a new OmniMech from the ground up, she instructed her scientists to improve upon existing designs. The design the scientists chose to modify was the Adder. Though the two 'Mechs are visually similar and share the same weight, the Cougar is slower and better armed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玛尔特·普莱德可汗决定升级其氏族装备的机甲。为不浪费宝贵资源从头设计新型全能机甲，她指示科学家改良现有设计。科学家选择改造的是蝰蛇。尽管两款机甲外观相似且重量相同，美洲狮更慢但武装更强。

Original: The Cronus was designed by Angus Gilmour to be a cost-effective 'Mech for use by mercenaries and small Periphery units using scrapped military equipment. After retiring from service with the Free Worlds League Military in the 3rd Succession War, Gilmour and many ex-technicians he recruited began working for the family business, Gilmour MilTech, on his home planet Talitha. While Gilmour MilTech would spend much of its time rebuilding/restoring wrecked equipment, technicians with free time constructed small numbers of the Cronus. An inexpensive, hand-built design, the Cronus combines design aspects of many different 55-ton BattleMechs seen on the modern battlefield.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_cronus_CNS-3M.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Cronus was designed by Angus Gilmour to be a cost-effective 'Mech for use by mercenaries and small Periphery units using scrapped military equipment. After retiring from service with the Free Worlds League Military in the 3rd Succession War, Gilmour and many ex-technicians he recruited began working for the family business, Gilmour MilTech, on his home planet Talitha. While Gilmour MilTech would spend much of its time rebuilding/restoring wrecked equipment, technicians with free time constructed small numbers of the Cronus. An inexpensive, hand-built design, the Cronus combines design aspects of many different 55-ton BattleMechs seen on the modern battlefield.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 克洛诺斯由安格斯·吉尔摩设计，旨在为佣兵和小型外围区单位提供一款使用报废军用装备、成本效益高的机甲。第三次继承战争中从自由世界联盟军队退役后，吉尔摩和他招募的许多前技师开始在其母星塔利莎为家族企业吉尔摩军工工作。虽然吉尔摩军工大部分时间用于重建/修复报废装备，有余力的技师们小批量地制造克洛诺斯。作为一款廉价的手工打造设计，克洛诺斯融合了现代战场上多种 55 吨战斗机甲的设计特点。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 克洛诺斯由安格斯·吉尔摩设计，旨在为佣兵和小型外围区单位提供一款使用报废军用装备、成本效益高的机甲。第三次继承战争中从自由世界联盟军队退役后，吉尔摩和他招募的许多前技师开始在其母星塔利莎为家族企业吉尔摩军工工作。虽然吉尔摩军工大部分时间用于重建/修复报废装备，有余力的技师们小批量地制造克洛诺斯。作为一款廉价的手工打造设计，克洛诺斯融合了现代战场上多种 55 吨战斗机甲的设计特点。

Original: Introduced in 2596, this variant was originally produced for the SLDF during the Reunification War. It upgraded the heat sinks to double heat sinks and utilized an Endo Steel internal structure to save mass All of the ammunition is located in the side torsos and protected by CASE.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_crusader_CRD-1R.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced in 2596, this variant was originally produced for the SLDF during the Reunification War. It upgraded the heat sinks to double heat sinks and utilized an Endo Steel internal structure to save mass All of the ammunition is located in the side torsos and protected by CASE.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此变体于 2596 年推出，最初在统一战争期间为星盟防卫军生产。它把散热器升级为双倍散热器，并采用内骨骼内部结构以节省质量。全部弹药都位于两侧躯干并由 C.A.S.E. 保护。

Original: The Crusader was initially designed as a close combat BattleMech for the Star League Defense Force, but soon proved itself to be a very adaptable, multi-role design.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_crusader_CRD-2R.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Crusader was initially designed as a close combat BattleMech for the Star League Defense Force, but soon proved itself to be a very adaptable, multi-role design.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 十字军最初为星盟防卫军设计为近战战斗机甲，但很快证明自己是一款适应性极强的多用途设计。

Original: The 3D variant of the Crusader is a simple modification to make the 'Mech's heat load more manageable. Introduced in 2756 and used mostly by House Davion, the two SRM-6 launchers were replaced with two SRM-4 launchers and the machine guns were removed so that the number of heat sinks could be increased by four.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_crusader_CRD-3D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3D variant of the Crusader is a simple modification to make the 'Mech's heat load more manageable. Introduced in 2756 and used mostly by House Davion, the two SRM-6 launchers were replaced with two SRM-4 launchers and the machine guns were removed so that the number of heat sinks could be increased by four.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 十字军 3D 变体是一次简单改装，旨在让机甲的热负荷更易管理。它于 2756 年推出，主要供达维昂家族使用，将两具 SRM-6 发射器换成两具 SRM-4，并移除机枪，以便把散热器数量增加四台。

Original: The Crusader was initially designed as a close combat BattleMech for the Star League Defense Force, but soon proved itself to be a very adaptable, multi-role design.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_crusader_CRD-3R.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Crusader was initially designed as a close combat BattleMech for the Star League Defense Force, but soon proved itself to be a very adaptable, multi-role design.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 十字军最初为星盟防卫军设计为近战战斗机甲，但很快证明自己是一款适应性极强的多用途设计。

Original: The 4D variant of the Crusader was a common field modification kit, utilizing Star League technology recovered from the Helm Memory Core, used by both Davion and Liao forces starting in 3049. This variant has had the medium lasers and the SRM-6 launchers removed and in their place has two Streak SRM-2 launchers and two Medium Pulse Lasers mounted.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_crusader_CRD-4D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 4D variant of the Crusader was a common field modification kit, utilizing Star League technology recovered from the Helm Memory Core, used by both Davion and Liao forces starting in 3049. This variant has had the medium lasers and the SRM-6 launchers removed and in their place has two Streak SRM-2 launchers and two Medium Pulse Lasers mounted.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 十字军 4D 变体是常见的野战改装套件，采用从赫尔姆记忆核心找回的星盟技术，自 3049 年起为达维昂与廖势力双方使用。此变体移除了中型激光和 SRM-6 发射器，在原位安装了两具连续 SRM-2 发射器和两门中型脉冲激光。

Original: The 5M was the official production-model upgraded variant of the Crusader for the Free Worlds League, introduced in 3049 and using recovered Star League technology. Though using the same Crucis-B chassis as before the 'Mech was powered by a Hermes 260 XL Engine and carried thirteen double heat sinks to vent its heat more efficiently.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_crusader_CRD-5M.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5M was the official production-model upgraded variant of the Crusader for the Free Worlds League, introduced in 3049 and using recovered Star League technology. Though using the same Crucis-B chassis as before the 'Mech was powered by a Hermes 260 XL Engine and carried thirteen double heat sinks to vent its heat more efficiently.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5M 是自由世界联盟十字军的官方量产升级变体，于 3049 年推出，采用重新找回的星盟技术。虽然仍使用与先前相同的"十字-B"底盘，机甲改由赫尔墨斯 260 XL 引擎驱动，并携带十三台双倍散热器以更高效地排热。

Original: Equiped with 4 Imperator Smoothie AC/2s, 2 Holly LRM-10 Launchers and 2 Large Lasers this 'Mech was nothing more than a laughingstock when it was first released. It served as the basis for the more successful Mauler
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_daboku_DCMS-MX90-D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Equiped with 4 Imperator Smoothie AC/2s, 2 Holly LRM-10 Launchers and 2 Large Lasers this 'Mech was nothing more than a laughingstock when it was first released. It served as the basis for the more successful Mauler
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 装备 4 门"帝皇奶昔"AC/2、2 具"冬青"LRM-10 发射器和 2 门大型激光，这台机甲首次发布时不过是个笑柄。它成为后来更成功的重击者的基础

Original: The Daimyo is named for the title used for warlords from the medieval Japanese empire. The 'Mech, first produced in 3053, attempts to live up to the heritage of its name admirably. It is armed primarily for long range combat but can hold its own if the situation warrants it. The Daimyo's maximum speed of 86.4 kph and its Nissan 200 fusion engine make the Daimyo a rugged 'Mech that can survive an amazing amount of damage, while bringing the fight to the enemy.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_daimyo_DMO-1K.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Daimyo is named for the title used for warlords from the medieval Japanese empire. The 'Mech, first produced in 3053, attempts to live up to the heritage of its name admirably. It is armed primarily for long range combat but can hold its own if the situation warrants it. The Daimyo's maximum speed of 86.4 kph and its Nissan 200 fusion engine make the Daimyo a rugged 'Mech that can survive an amazing amount of damage, while bringing the fight to the enemy.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 大名之名取自中世纪日本帝国对军阀的称号。该机甲于 3053 年首次生产，竭力不负其名的传承。它以远程战斗为主要武装，但必要时也能自保。大名 86.4 公里/小时的最高速度与日产 200 聚变引擎，使它成为一款坚固的机甲，能承受惊人的损伤并将战斗带到敌人面前。

Original: The Dart was built when the Federated Commonwealth was looking for BattleMechs that were not ammunition dependent. The 'Mech was built with an all energy weapon arsenal on an extremely high-speed chassis. The 'Mech is capable of speeds of up to 151 kph and is armored with three and a half tons of armor. The 'Mech, while lightly armed, is an exceptional recon 'Mech and also works well in a guerrilla force where its use of energy weapons allows it to operate independently.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_dart_DRT-3S.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Dart was built when the Federated Commonwealth was looking for BattleMechs that were not ammunition dependent. The 'Mech was built with an all energy weapon arsenal on an extremely high-speed chassis. The 'Mech is capable of speeds of up to 151 kph and is armored with three and a half tons of armor. The 'Mech, while lightly armed, is an exceptional recon 'Mech and also works well in a guerrilla force where its use of energy weapons allows it to operate independently.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 飞镖诞生于联邦联邦寻找不依赖弹药的机甲之时。它以全能量武器配置建立在极高速底盘上。机甲速度可达 151 公里/小时，并有三吨半装甲。虽然武器轻，飞镖却是出色的侦察机甲，在游击队中也很管用——能量武器让它能独立作战。

Original: The Dervish carries as its main weapons two Federated 10-Shot LRM launchers. These missile launchers give the Dervish the long-range capability needed to provide fire support to friendly units and are safely embedded in the torso as opposed to the exposed launchers on other 'Mechs. A ton of ammunition per launcher provides sufficient endurance for any but the most prolonged battles. For close combat, the Dervish carries two Federated 2-Shot SRM launchers and two ChisComp 39 Medium Lasers. The SRM launchers are completely self-contained within the forearms, allowing them to be aimed quickly, and fed by a ton of ammunition each. The lasers are placed just above the launchers and ensure the 'Mech is still capable of fighting should it run out of missiles. The Dervish is capable of jumping 150 meters and is protected by seven and a half tons of armor.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_dervish_DV-6M.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Dervish carries as its main weapons two Federated 10-Shot LRM launchers. These missile launchers give the Dervish the long-range capability needed to provide fire support to friendly units and are safely embedded in the torso as opposed to the exposed launchers on other 'Mechs. A ton of ammunition per launcher provides sufficient endurance for any but the most prolonged battles. For close combat, the Dervish carries two Federated 2-Shot SRM launchers and two ChisComp 39 Medium Lasers. The SRM launchers are completely self-contained within the forearms, allowing them to be aimed quickly, and fed by a ton of ammunition each. The lasers are placed just above the launchers and ensure the 'Mech is still capable of fighting should it run out of missiles. The Dervish is capable of jumping 150 meters and is protected by seven and a half tons of armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 苦行僧以两具联邦 10 发 LRM 发射器为主武器。这些导弹发射器为苦行僧提供了向友军提供火力支援所需的远程能力，且安全嵌入躯干内，不像其他机甲那样外露。每具发射器一吨弹药，除最持久的战斗外足以支撑。近战方面，苦行僧携带两具联邦 2 发 SRM 发射器和两门 ChisComp 39 中型激光。SRM 发射器完全内嵌于前臂，可迅速瞄准，各由一吨弹药供弹。激光位于发射器正上方，确保机甲在导弹耗尽后仍能作战。苦行僧能跳 150 米，并由七吨半装甲保护。

Original: This Star League era variant uses an XL Engine, twelve single heat sinks, and upgrades the LRM-10s to LRM-15s. Three tons of ammunition are in a CASE protected torso bin.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_dervish_DV-6MD.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Star League era variant uses an XL Engine, twelve single heat sinks, and upgrades the LRM-10s to LRM-15s. Three tons of ammunition are in a CASE protected torso bin.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此星盟时代变体使用 XL 引擎、十二台单散热器，并将 LRM-10 升级为 LRM-15。三吨弹药存于有 C.A.S.E. 保护的躯干弹药箱中。

Original: The 7D Dervish is a 3047 upgrade of the design using Star League technology. The 'Mech is built with an Endo Steel chassis and also uses eight tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor with CASE for protection against ammunition explosions. With the saved weight, the SRM-2s have been upgraded to Federated SuperStreak SRMs and the 'Mech uses double heat sinks. This variant was first produced by Achernar BattleMechs on New Avalon.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_dervish_DV-7D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 7D Dervish is a 3047 upgrade of the design using Star League technology. The 'Mech is built with an Endo Steel chassis and also uses eight tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor with CASE for protection against ammunition explosions. With the saved weight, the SRM-2s have been upgraded to Federated SuperStreak SRMs and the 'Mech uses double heat sinks. This variant was first produced by Achernar BattleMechs on New Avalon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 7D 苦行僧是 3047 年使用星盟技术对该设计的升级。机甲采用内骨骼底盘建造，并使用八吨铁纤维装甲及 C.A.S.E. 以防弹药爆炸。凭借节省的重量，SRM-2 升级为联邦超级连续 SRM，机甲也改用双倍散热器。此变体最初由新阿瓦隆上的阿克尔纳战斗机甲公司生产。

Original: The 7P is a Medium Range Missile Boat, carrying an MRM-20 and MRM-10 in each arm, supported by a Medium Laser in each arm and side torso. Such a heavy loadout while retaining the Dervish's usual seven and half tons of armor and five jump jets is made possible with an 275 rated extralight engine and Endo Steel frame. The 7P is fitted with ten double heat sinks and carries a combined four tons of MRM reloads.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_dervish_DV-7P.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 7P is a Medium Range Missile Boat, carrying an MRM-20 and MRM-10 in each arm, supported by a Medium Laser in each arm and side torso. Such a heavy loadout while retaining the Dervish's usual seven and half tons of armor and five jump jets is made possible with an 275 rated extralight engine and Endo Steel frame. The 7P is fitted with ten double heat sinks and carries a combined four tons of MRM reloads.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 7P 是一款中程导弹平台，每臂携带一具 MRM-20 和 MRM-10，由每臂及每侧躯干各一门中型激光支援。在保留苦行僧惯常的七吨半装甲和五个跳跃推进器的同时实现如此沉重的载荷，要归功于一台 275 额定超轻型引擎和内骨骼框架。7P 装有十台双倍散热器，并携带共四吨 MRM 再装填。

Original: The Dervish IIC, a 55-ton Clan refit of the Star-League-era Dervish, was first seen in 3058 along the Smoke Jaguar front bordering the Draconis Combine. It has similar movement and jump capabilities to the original Dervish, but carries significantly more firepower.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_dervish_DV-IIC.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Dervish IIC, a 55-ton Clan refit of the Star-League-era Dervish, was first seen in 3058 along the Smoke Jaguar front bordering the Draconis Combine. It has similar movement and jump capabilities to the original Dervish, but carries significantly more firepower.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 苦行僧 IIC 是星盟时代苦行僧的 55 吨氏族改装版，于 3058 年首次出现在烟虎氏族与德拉科尼斯联合体接壤的前线。它的移动与跳跃能力与原版苦行僧相似，但火力显著更强。

Original: The Dire Wolf is one of the OmniMechs that became feared throughout the Inner Sphere during the initial Clan Invasion and rightly so. The Dire Wolf weighs in at an impressive one hundred tons and has a relatively slow cruising speed of 54 km/h provided by a 300 XL engine. Its speed and armor protection matches that of an Atlas, but it has superior potential firepower with fifty and a half tons of free pod space for weapons and equipment. It is these traits which saw the 'Mech christened Daishi (pseudo-Japanese for 'Great Death') by the criminal underbelly of the Draconis Combine, a name that would be proven grimly accurate time and time again.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_direwolf_DS-PRIME.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Dire Wolf is one of the OmniMechs that became feared throughout the Inner Sphere during the initial Clan Invasion and rightly so. The Dire Wolf weighs in at an impressive one hundred tons and has a relatively slow cruising speed of 54 km/h provided by a 300 XL engine. Its speed and armor protection matches that of an Atlas, but it has superior potential firepower with fifty and a half tons of free pod space for weapons and equipment. It is these traits which saw the 'Mech christened Daishi (pseudo-Japanese for 'Great Death') by the criminal underbelly of the Draconis Combine, a name that would be proven grimly accurate time and time again.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 恐狼是氏族入侵初期令整个内天体闻之色变的全能机甲之一，实至名归。它重达惊人的一百吨，由 300 XL 引擎驱动，巡航速度相对缓慢，仅 54 公里/小时。它的速度与装甲防护与阿特拉斯相当，但凭借五十吨半的自由吊舱空间搭载武器与装备，拥有更强的火力潜力。正因如此，德拉科尼斯联合体的黑道将其命名为"大师"（伪日语"伟大的死亡"），而这名字一次又一次被证明冷酷地精准。

Original: The DRG-1C uses an AC2 instead of the more standard AC5.  This allows it to have extreme reach across the battlefield, but at a reduced damage rate.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_dragon_DRG-1C.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The DRG-1C uses an AC2 instead of the more standard AC5.  This allows it to have extreme reach across the battlefield, but at a reduced damage rate.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: DRG-1C 使用一门 AC2 取代更标准的 AC5。这使它能在战场上拥有极远射程，但伤害率降低。

Original: The Dragon 1N is a beefy machine that can take a serious beating but tends to be a bit light on weaponry. It moves fast for a heavy 'Mech, though, which makes it well suited to closing for Melee attacks against slower targets.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_dragon_DRG-1N.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Dragon 1N is a beefy machine that can take a serious beating but tends to be a bit light on weaponry. It moves fast for a heavy 'Mech, though, which makes it well suited to closing for Melee attacks against slower targets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 大龙 1N 是一台结实的机器，能承受重击，但武器略显单薄。不过它作为重型机甲移动很快，这使它非常适合逼近较慢的目标进行近战。

Original: The Dragon 1R is a beefy machine that can take a serious beating, mounting twin Inferno SRMs to complement its CQC capabilities.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_dragon_DRG-1R.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Dragon 1R is a beefy machine that can take a serious beating, mounting twin Inferno SRMs to complement its CQC capabilities.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 大龙 1R 是一台结实的机器，能承受重击，装备双联燃烧弹 SRM 以补充其近距近战能力。

Original: Once fielded in great numbers by the Smoke Jaguars, the Ebon Jaguar has proliferated to many of Kerensky's Clans, though some, like the Wolves, Jade Falcons and Coyotes, continue to field Hellbringers instead.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_ebonjaguar_B.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Once fielded in great numbers by the Smoke Jaguars, the Ebon Jaguar has proliferated to many of Kerensky's Clans, though some, like the Wolves, Jade Falcons and Coyotes, continue to field Hellbringers instead.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑玉美洲豹曾由烟虎氏族大量装备，如今已扩散至克伦斯基的众多氏族，不过狼、翡翠猎鹰与郊狼等氏族仍继续装备地狱使者。

Original: The standard against which all battle armor is measured, the Elemental battle armor was first introduced in 2868 by Clan Wolf in a Trial of Possession against the Nova Cats. It was a marvel of Clan engineering that allowed a small group of operators to take down large 'Mechs and survive the encounter. While it is possible for a normal-sized human to use the battle armor, this design is tailored for the Clans' giant Elemental warriors and only they can bring out its fullest potential.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_Elemental.Details

While it is possible for a normal-sized human to use the battle armor, this design is tailored for the Clans' giant Elemental warriors and only they can bring out its fullest potential.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 元素战斗装甲是所有战斗装甲的衡量标准，由狼氏族于 2868 年在对抗诺瓦猫的占有试炼中首次推出。它是氏族工程的奇迹，能让一小队操作员击倒大型机甲并幸存下来。虽然普通体型的人也能使用这种战斗装甲，但该设计是为氏族巨人般的元素战士量身打造，唯有他们才能发挥其全部潜力。

Original: The Emperor is one of the earliest assault BattleMechs, dating back to 2502. The Emperor also bears the distinction of being the first 90+ ton BattleMech to mount jump jets (the famed Highlander began production in 2592).
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_emperor-EMP-1A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Emperor is one of the earliest assault BattleMechs, dating back to 2502. The Emperor also bears the distinction of being the first 90+ ton BattleMech to mount jump jets (the famed Highlander began production in 2592).
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 皇帝是最早的突击战斗机甲之一，可追溯至 2502 年。它还享有另一项殊荣：首款装备跳跃推进器的 90 吨以上战斗机甲（著名的高地人于 2592 年开始生产）。

Original: The Enfield was originally designed to replace the Wyvern as an urban combat 'Mech, but the design never made it to mass production. The plans for the Enfield were lost during the Succession Wars and were recovered by the Federated Suns on the world of Achernar in 2870. Knowledge of the design was kept hidden until the 3050s, when the NAIS selected the Enfield as a companion 'Mech to the Enforcer. The Enfield began production in 3055 and has seen heavy deployment to the Lyran Alliance because of the constant threat presented by the Clans. The 'Mech carries eleven tons of StarGuard III armor with CASE to protect against ammunition explosions. The Enfield is built on a Blackstone MD2E Endo Steel chassis and uses a Magna 250 XL engine which gives the 'Mech a top speed of 86.4 km/h to save weight, allowing it to carry a heavy arsenal. Due its extra-light engine, however, the 'Mech developed an undeserved reputation for being fragile in heavy combat.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_enfield_END-6J.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Enfield was originally designed to replace the Wyvern as an urban combat 'Mech, but the design never made it to mass production. Knowledge of the design was kept hidden until the 3050s, when the NAIS selected the Enfield as a companion 'Mech to the Enforcer. The Enfield began production in 3055 and has seen heavy deployment to the Lyran Alliance because of the constant threat presented by the Clans. The 'Mech carries eleven tons of StarGuard III armor with CASE to protect against ammunition explosions. The Enfield is built on a Blackstone MD2E Endo Steel chassis and uses a Magna 250 XL engine which gives the 'Mech a top speed of 86.4 km/h to save weight, allowing it to carry a heavy arsenal. Due its extra-light engine, however, the 'Mech developed an undeserved reputation for being fragile in heavy combat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 恩菲尔德最初旨在取代双足飞龙成为城市战斗机甲，但从未进入量产。其图纸在继承战争中遗失，2870 年由联邦太阳系在阿克尔纳星上寻回。该设计的知识一直被保密到 3050 年代，NAIS 选定恩菲尔德作为执法者的搭档机甲。恩菲尔德于 3055 年开始生产，因氏族的持续威胁而在莱兰联盟大量部署。机甲携带十一吨星卫 III 装甲并配 C.A.S.E. 以防弹药爆炸。恩菲尔德建立在黑石 MD2E 内骨骼底盘上，使用玛格纳 250 XL 引擎，最高速度 86.4 公里/小时，以节省重量从而搭载重型武器库。然而由于使用超轻型引擎，它在激烈战斗中落下了"脆弱"的冤枉名声。

Original: The precursor to the Enforcer 4R, the 3R models originally mounted twin Medium Lasers in the left arm along with 2 extra Heat Sinks to help the 'Mech dissipate heat.  It was also slightly better protected, as it had an additional ton of armor.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_enforcer_ENF-3R.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The precursor to the Enforcer 4R, the 3R models originally mounted twin Medium Lasers in the left arm along with 2 extra Heat Sinks to help the 'Mech dissipate heat.  It was also slightly better protected, as it had an additional ton of armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为执法者 4R 的前身，3R 型号最初在左臂装双联中型激光，并配 2 台额外散热器帮助机甲散热。它的防护也略好，因为多了一吨装甲。

Original: Enforcer 4R models combine the hefty power of an Autocannon and massive Laser with the mobility of Jump Jets—a deadly combination. Able to engage at medium-long all the way to point-blank range, these 'Mechs are flexible and surprising in combat.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_enforcer_ENF-4R.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Enforcer 4R models combine the hefty power of an Autocannon and massive Laser with the mobility of Jump Jets—a deadly combination. Able to engage at medium-long all the way to point-blank range, these 'Mechs are flexible and surprising in combat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 执法者 4R 型号把自动炮与巨型激光的沉重威力与跳跃推进器的机动性结合起来——这是致命的组合。它能在中远距离一直到抵近射击的交战，这些机甲在战斗中灵活而令人意外。

Original: First walking off the production line in late 3050, the 5D Enforcer is a major upgrade to the standard 'Mech, meeting many of its pilots' desire for something faster, better-protected and with more endurance. The Nissan 200 engine has been removed and replaced with a Magna 250 Extralight Engine, increasing the Enforcer's top speed to 86.4 km/h and the amount of space available for other additions. The armor has been stripped from the 'Mech and replaced with StarGuard CIV Ferro-Fibrous armor with CASE to protect against an ammunition explosion while the weapons payload has also been changed. Retaining the small laser both the Autocannon/10 and the Large Laser were replaced for a new Mydron Excel LB-X Autocannon/10, fed by two tons of ammunition, and a BlazeFire Sweetshot ER Large Laser. Finally, an additional jump jet was added, increasing the jumping distance by thirty meters to keep up with the Enforcer's new speed profile.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_enforcer_ENF-5D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: First walking off the production line in late 3050, the 5D Enforcer is a major upgrade to the standard 'Mech, meeting many of its pilots' desire for something faster, better-protected and with more endurance. The Nissan 200 engine has been removed and replaced with a Magna 250 Extralight Engine, increasing the Enforcer's top speed to 86.4 km/h and the amount of space available for other additions. The armor has been stripped from the 'Mech and replaced with StarGuard CIV Ferro-Fibrous armor with CASE to protect against an ammunition explosion while the weapons payload has also been changed. Retaining the small laser both the Autocannon/10 and the Large Laser were replaced for a new Mydron Excel LB-X Autocannon/10, fed by two tons of ammunition, and a BlazeFire Sweetshot ER Large Laser. Finally, an additional jump jet was added, increasing the jumping distance by thirty meters to keep up with the Enforcer's new speed profile.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5D 执法者于 3050 年末首次下线，是标准机甲的重大升级，满足了许多飞行员对更快、防护更好、续航更久的需求。日产 200 引擎被移除，换成玛格纳 250 超轻型引擎，将执法者最高速度提升至 86.4 公里/小时，并腾出更多空间用于其他加装。装甲被剥离，改为星卫 CIV 铁纤维装甲并配 C.A.S.E. 以防弹药爆炸，武器配置也作了更改。保留小型激光的同时，自动炮/10 和大型激光换成一门迈德龙 Excel LB-X 自动炮/10（由两吨弹药供弹）和一门烈焰"甜射"ER 大型激光。最后加装一个跳跃推进器，使跳跃距离增加三十米，以跟上执法者新的速度曲线。

Original: The Executioner A reduces the overall engagement ranges compared to its PRIME variant by dropping the Gauss Rifle and replacing it with a massive collection of Large Pulse Lasers, backed up by four ERML's. This variant is the nightmare for every light mech out there.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_executioner_A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Executioner A reduces the overall engagement ranges compared to its PRIME variant by dropping the Gauss Rifle and replacing it with a massive collection of Large Pulse Lasers, backed up by four ERML's. This variant is the nightmare for every light mech out there.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 与主型号相比，行刑者 A 缩短了总体交战距离：它去掉高斯步枪，换成一大批大型脉冲激光，辅以四门 ER 中型激光。此变体是外面所有轻型机甲的噩梦。

Original: The Jack-of-all-trades variant. The Executioner B is set up to be effective in all ranges the battlefield can offer. With an ERPPC for extreme and long ranges and an absolutely devastating UAC/20 for closer range brackets, the B just executes its foes by brute force. Advanced targeting systems will make sure that there is nowhere to run...nowhere to hide.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_executioner_B.Details

With an ERPPC for extreme and long ranges and an absolutely devastating UAC/20 for closer range brackets, the B just executes its foes by brute force. Advanced targeting systems will make sure that there is nowhere to run...nowhere to hide.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 样样通吃的变体。行刑者 B 被设定为在战场能提供的所有射程上都有效。极端与远程有 ER PPC，较近射程则有绝对毁灭性的 UAC/20，B 以蛮力处决它的敌人。先进瞄准系统确保无处可逃……无处可藏。

Original: Sometimes you just need to lob some missiles at them. The Executioner C trades direct hit firepower of its sister variants for a set of Artemis IV guided Long Range Missiles. But for everyone who believes to be able to sneak up on this monster: be warned it still fields the massive close range punch in form of an UAC/20.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_executioner_C.Details

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 有时你就是需要朝他们甩几发导弹。行刑者 C 以一套 Artemis IV 制导远程导弹取代其姊妹变体的直击火力。但要提醒所有以为能偷偷接近这头怪物的人：它仍然以 UAC/20 的形式保留着庞大的近距离打击力。

Original: Fast, precise, deadly. The Executioner D(isco) makes use of its phenomenal agility to close in on its enemies...just to unleash a hell of fire on them in form of pulse lasers in all colors and sizes. LPL, MPL, SPL ... you name it, the EXE-D has it. Pilots be warned though, you better bring som chilled drinks as this one is running HOT!
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_executioner_D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fast, precise, deadly. Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 快速、精准、致命。行刑者 D(isco) 利用其惊人的敏捷逼近敌人……只为以各种颜色和尺寸的脉冲激光向它们倾泻地狱之火。LPL、MPL、SPL……你点得出来的，EXE-D 都有。不过警告飞行员们：最好带上冰镇饮料，因为这玩意儿热得发烫！

Original: In a logical step up from other, earlier variants the Executioner E sticks with the idea of being effective and deadly at all ranges. ERLLs and ATMs will grant massive firepower at long and medium ranges while a bunch of Heavy Medium and Heavy Small Lasers will grant close perimeter defense...or the bit of extra damage to finish an already damaged oponent.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_executioner_E.Details

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 行刑者 E 是对其他早期变体的合理升级，坚持在所有距离上都有效而致命。ER 大型激光和 ATM 将在远距离与中距离提供巨量火力，而一批重型中型激光和重型小型激光将提供近距离环形防御…或者用于给已受损对手补上那一点额外伤害。

Original: Fast and powerful, the Executioner, known as the Gladiator in the Inner Sphere, is an assault OmniMech developed by Clan Ghost Bear. As one of the fastest assault mechs available, the Executioner surprises its prey by being able to alter the engagement ranges way quicker than expected from a mech of this weight. The Executioner PRIME uses its speed to stay at distance to make full use of its long range weaponry.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_executioner_PRIME.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fast and powerful, the Executioner, known as the Gladiator in the Inner Sphere, is an assault OmniMech developed by Clan Ghost Bear. As one of the fastest assault mechs available, the Executioner surprises its prey by being able to alter the engagement ranges way quicker than expected from a mech of this weight. The Executioner PRIME uses its speed to stay at distance to make full use of its long range weaponry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 行刑者快速而强大，在内天体被称为角斗士，是由鬼熊氏族开发的突击全能机甲。作为可用的最快突击机甲之一，行刑者能比人们对该重量机甲的预期更快地改变交战距离，从而突袭猎物。行刑者主型号利用其速度保持距离，以充分发挥远程武器的威力。

Original: The Inner Sphere Standard was developed following the initial thrust of the Clan invasion, as Inner Sphere powers rushed to duplicate the battle armor technology the Clans fielded. Lacking any battlefield salvage on which to base their development though, engineers were forced to work off of ancient rumors of early power armor suits like the Nighthawk, more akin to armored Exoskeletons than the 'Toads' currently rampaging through known space, and these prototypes fared poorly during testing. It took salvage from the first victories over the Clans to truly kick-start the development of battle armor. The New Avalon Institute of Science was the first to reproduce in part the Clans' Elemental armor as the Inner Sphere Standard.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_battlearmor_IS-STD.Details

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 内天体标准型是在氏族入侵首轮攻势后开发的，当时内天体各势力竞相复制氏族装备的战斗装甲技术。然而由于缺乏战场缴获作为研发基础，工程师们只能依据"夜鹰"等早期动力装甲的古老传闻着手——它们与其说是当前肆虐已知空间的"蟾蜍"式装甲，更像是带装甲的外骨骼。这些原型在测试中表现糟糕。直到从对氏族的首次胜利中获得缴获品，战斗装甲的研发才真正起步。新阿瓦隆科学研究院率先部分复制了氏族的元素战士装甲，即内天体标准型。

Original: The Exterminator is a BattleMech that was designed in 2630 for the most dubious, but necessary, of purposes: Headhunting. Advanced systems allowed it to easily infiltrate enemy lines. Once the Exterminator had breached the enemy's rear, its mission was to find and destroy as much of the enemy's command structure as possible. This mission profile included attacking Mobile Headquarters, field bases and command level officers. Rather than be part of the standard formation, Exterminators were attached to a regimental or higher headquarters unit, often as a fifth member of the command lance itself, before being assigned to individual units.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_exterminator_EXT-4D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Exterminator is a BattleMech that was designed in 2630 for the most dubious, but necessary, of purposes: Headhunting. This mission profile included attacking Mobile Headquarters, field bases and command level officers. Rather than be part of the standard formation, Exterminators were attached to a regimental or higher headquarters unit, often as a fifth member of the command lance itself, before being assigned to individual units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 灭绝者在 2630 年设计，用途最可疑却也最必要：猎杀指挥官。先进系统使它易于渗透敌线。一旦突入敌后，灭绝者的任务就是尽可能多地寻找并摧毁敌方指挥体系，包括攻击机动指挥部、野战基地和指挥级军官。灭绝者不编入标准编制，而是配属团级或更高指挥部，往往是指挥连的第五名成员，然后才被分配至具体单位。

Original: Originally developed as an anti-infantry and Bug Hunter 'Mech, the Falcon is a highly popular light recon and skirmisher 'Mech. Initially created for the newly formed Star League Defense Force's use in the Reunification War, the popular design remained in production until the destruction of Stormvanger's Hesperus II Falcon line during the Third Battle of Hesperus II in 2789, becoming all but extinct until the arrival of Wolf's Dragoonsin 3005. Well regarded by the mercenaries, the Dragoons upgraded their dwindling number of Falcons in the early 3050s before eventually commissioning Blackwell Industries to restart production of the design in early 3060 to produce advanced Clan-tech versions for their exclusive use, as well as more mundane and affordable versions for the general mercenary market. While originally sporting a weapons array similar to the Locust, Stinger and Waspit was charged to defeat, the Falcon's six tons of StarGuard Type II armor provided it with vastly superior protection, allowing it to outlast them and remain combat effective longer. When it was originally developed, the 'Mech's top speed of 97.2 kph and a jumping distance of one hundred and fifty meters allowed it to keep up with other light recon 'Mechs. But by the 3060s the Falconwas outclassed by newer and faster designs, only its use of a cheaper standard Fusion Engine rather than a more expensive and fragile Light or XL Engine kept buyers interested.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_falcon_FLC-4N.Details

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎鹰最初是作为反步兵与"猎虫者"机甲开发的，是一款极受欢迎的轻型侦察与游骑机甲。它最初为新成立的星盟防卫军用于统一战争而制造，这款广受欢迎的机型一直生产到 2789 年第三次赫斯佩鲁斯 II 战役中斯托姆万格的赫斯佩鲁斯 II 猎鹰生产线被毁，此后几乎灭绝，直到 3005 年狼之龙骑兵到来。这支佣兵团对它评价甚高，于 3050 年代初升级了日益减少的猎鹰，最终在 3060 年代初委托布莱克威尔工业重启生产，为其独家生产先进的氏族科技版本，也为普通佣兵市场提供更朴素实惠的版本。猎鹰原本的武器配置与其要击败的蝗虫、毒刺和黄蜂相似，但其六吨星卫 II 型装甲提供了远为优越的防护，使其能比对手更持久、更久地保持战斗力。初研制时，它 97.2 公里/小时的最高速度和一百五十米的跳跃距离使其能跟上其他轻型侦察机甲。但到 3060 年代，猎鹰已被更新更快的设计超越，唯有其使用较便宜的标配聚变引擎而非更昂贵脆弱的轻型或 XL 引擎，才让买家保持兴趣。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎鹰最初是作为反步兵与"猎虫者"机甲开发的，是一款极受欢迎的轻型侦察与游骑机甲。它最初为新成立的星盟防卫军用于统一战争而制造，这款广受欢迎的机型一直生产到 2789 年第三次赫斯佩鲁斯 II 战役中斯托姆万格的赫斯佩鲁斯 II 猎鹰生产线被毁，此后几乎灭绝，直到 3005 年狼之龙骑兵到来。这支佣兵团对它评价甚高，于 3050 年代初升级了日益减少的猎鹰，最终在 3060 年代初委托布莱克威尔工业重启生产，为其独家生产先进的氏族科技版本，也为普通佣兵市场提供更朴素实惠的版本。猎鹰原本的武器配置与其要击败的蝗虫、毒刺和黄蜂相似，但其六吨星卫 II 型装甲提供了远为优越的防护，使其能比对手更持久、更久地保持战斗力。初研制时，它 97.2 公里/小时的最高速度和一百五十米的跳跃距离使其能跟上其他轻型侦察机甲。但到 3060 年代，猎鹰已被更新更快的设计超越，唯有其使用较便宜的标配聚变引擎而非更昂贵脆弱的轻型或 XL 引擎，才让买家保持兴趣。

Original: Originally developed as an anti-infantry and Bug Hunter 'Mech, the Falcon is a highly popular light recon and skirmisher 'Mech. Initially created for the newly formed Star League Defense Force's use in the Reunification War, the popular design remained in production until the destruction of Stormvanger's Hesperus II Falcon line during the Third Battle of Hesperus II in 2789, becoming all but extinct until the arrival of Wolf's Dragoonsin 3005. Well regarded by the mercenaries, the Dragoons upgraded their dwindling number of Falcons in the early 3050s before eventually commissioning Blackwell Industries to restart production of the design in early 3060 to produce advanced Clan-tech versions for their exclusive use, as well as more mundane and affordable versions for the general mercenary market. While originally sporting a weapons array similar to the Locust, Stinger and Waspit was charged to defeat, the Falcon's six tons of StarGuard Type II armor provided it with vastly superior protection, allowing it to outlast them and remain combat effective longer. When it was originally developed, the 'Mech's top speed of 97.2 kph and a jumping distance of one hundred and fifty meters allowed it to keep up with other light recon 'Mechs. But by the 3060s the Falconwas outclassed by newer and faster designs, only its use of a cheaper standard Fusion Engine rather than a more expensive and fragile Light or XL Engine kept buyers interested.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_falcon_FLC-4P.Details

Original: The Fireball was a quick response BattleMech built as a direct result of the Clans' Elemental infantry. As the Clans swept through the Inner Sphere, members of the Armed Forces of the Federated Commonwealth met with scientists from the New Avalon Institute of Science to discuss, among other things, how to counter their new Battle Armored foes. The result was a 'Mech which on paper met many of the criteria for successfully dealing with Elementals: it had weapons with a high rate-of-fire for taking on swarms of Toads as they were known, had ammunition stores to maintain that rate for extended periods, and an extremely high speed so it could quickly come to the aid of heavier units. These Fireballs were given to units with prior experience fighting the Clans but assigned to rookie pilots, partly because the 'Mech's capabilities fit the personality of many of these new Mechwarriors, partly to more quickly build up their combat experience. The Crucis Lancers, Deneb Light Cavalry and Ceti Hussars were the first regiments to receive these 'Mechs in 3053, employing them immediately on the front lines as raiding along the border between the Inner Sphere and Occupation Zones commenced following the Truce of Tukayyid.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_fireball_ALM-7D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 火球是为直接应对氏族元素步兵而建造的快速反应战斗机甲。当氏族席卷内天体时，联邦联邦武装部队成员与新阿瓦隆科学研究院的科学家会面，讨论如何对抗这些新的战斗装甲敌人等问题。成果是一款在纸面上满足成功应对元素战士多项标准的机甲：它拥有高射速武器以对付成群的"蟾蜍"，有足以长时间维持该射速的弹药储备，以及极高的速度以便迅速支援较重的单位。这些火球被分配给有对抗氏族经验但机师为新手的部队，部分原因是机甲的特性契合许多新机甲战士的性格，部分原因是为了更快积累他们的实战经验。克鲁西斯枪骑兵、德内布轻骑兵和塞提骠骑兵是 3053 年首批接收这些机甲的团，图卡伊德休战协定后内天体与占领区边境的袭扰战开始，它们立即被投入前线。

Original: The FS9-S is an overhaul of the FS9-H introduced in 3049. The structure has been upgraded to use an Endo Steel chassis. The weapons carried are four flamers, two medium lasers, and a single small laser. An Anti-Missile System with one ton of ammo has been added to protect against missile attacks, and a Beagle Active Probe has been installed to enhance the Firestarter's scouting role.
