Original: Entering production in 2519 the FLE-14 Flea was an attempt to create an ultra-light BattleMech. Weighing a mere fifteen tons, it could arguably be regarded as a different 'Mech design than the true Flea. It was capable of a maximum ground speed of nearly 150km/h with a 120 meter jump capability. Its weapons and armor however were very light: Only one ton of armor protected the unit, and the single Medium Laser mounted in the right arm was barely enough to make it a viable battlefield unit.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_flea_FLE-14.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Entering production in 2519 the FLE-14 Flea was an attempt to create an ultra-light BattleMech. Weighing a mere fifteen tons, it could arguably be regarded as a different 'Mech design than the true Flea. It was capable of a maximum ground speed of nearly 150km/h with a 120 meter jump capability. Its weapons and armor however were very light: Only one ton of armor protected the unit, and the single Medium Laser mounted in the right arm was barely enough to make it a viable battlefield unit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: FLE-14 跳蚤于 2519 年投产，是打造超轻型战斗机甲的一次尝试。它仅重十五吨，可以说算得上是与真正的跳蚤不同的一款机甲设计。它能达到近 150 公里/小时的最大地面速度，跳跃能力 120 米。然而其武器与装甲都极轻：只有一吨装甲保护该单位，右臂上那门孤零零的中型激光勉强使它成为可用的战场单位。

Original: An expensive mech that is good against other 20 ton mechs and infantry but not able to stand up to any major threat from larger mechs.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_flea_FLE-15.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An expensive mech that is good against other 20 ton mechs and infantry but not able to stand up to any major threat from larger mechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一台昂贵的机甲，对付其他 20 吨机甲和步兵不错，但无力抵御更大机甲的任何重大威胁。

Original: Built as part of the Wolf's Dragoons exclusive contract with Earthwerks Incorporated to replenish the Dragoon's losses at the end of the Fourth Succession War, alongside renewed production of original Fleas, the FLE-16 was the first new production model of the extremely rare 'Mech in centuries. The variant remedied the earlier FLE-14's weaknesses by combining incredible speed with additional armor and weaponry on a 20 ton chassis. The engine was upgraded to a GM 180 in order to reach a similar maximum ground speed of nearly 150 km/h. It mounts two Medium Lasers and an Flamer while retaining an armor profile like the earlier FLE-15.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_flea_FLE-16.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Built as part of the Wolf's Dragoons exclusive contract with Earthwerks Incorporated to replenish the Dragoon's losses at the end of the Fourth Succession War, alongside renewed production of original Fleas, the FLE-16 was the first new production model of the extremely rare 'Mech in centuries. The variant remedied the earlier FLE-14's weaknesses by combining incredible speed with additional armor and weaponry on a 20 ton chassis. The engine was upgraded to a GM 180 in order to reach a similar maximum ground speed of nearly 150 km/h. It mounts two Medium Lasers and an Flamer while retaining an armor profile like the earlier FLE-15.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: FLE-16 是作为狼之龙骑兵与地球工厂公司独家合同的一部分而建造的，该合同旨在第四次继承战争结束时补充龙骑兵的损失，与重新生产的原版跳蚤一同问世，是这款极为稀有机甲数世纪以来首个新量产型号。此变体通过在 20 吨底盘上结合惊人的速度与额外的装甲和武器，弥补了早期 FLE-14 的弱点。引擎升级为 GM 180，以达到近 150 公里/小时的相近最高地面速度。它装有两门中型激光和一具火焰喷射器，同时保留与早期 FLE-15 相似的装甲配置。

Original: Originally produced exclusively for the Dragoons until the Capellan Confederation acquired the design's blueprints via a Maskirovka raid during the 3040s, the post-Helm Memory Core FLE-17 variant is based on the older FLE-15 model. Since the Dragoons used the Flea in a recon role more than an antipersonnel 'Mech, Earthwerks conceived a new design by incorporating recovered technology. Retaining the design's maximum speed of 97.2 km/h, the addition of an Endo Steelchassis frees up weight for a MASC system that allows the 'Mech's speed to be pushed up to 129.6 km/h in short bursts. The increase of speed is required to ensure survival on the modern battlefield, as the FLE-17 is only clad in a pitiful three tons of Livingston Ceramics armor plating.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_flea_FLE-17.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally produced exclusively for the Dragoons until the Capellan Confederation acquired the design's blueprints via a Maskirovka raid during the 3040s, the post-Helm Memory Core FLE-17 variant is based on the older FLE-15 model. Since the Dragoons used the Flea in a recon role more than an antipersonnel 'Mech, Earthwerks conceived a new design by incorporating recovered technology. Retaining the design's maximum speed of 97.2 km/h, the addition of an Endo Steelchassis frees up weight for a MASC system that allows the 'Mech's speed to be pushed up to 129.6 km/h in short bursts. The increase of speed is required to ensure survival on the modern battlefield, as the FLE-17 is only clad in a pitiful three tons of Livingston Ceramics armor plating.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该设计最初专为龙骑兵生产，直到卡佩兰邦联在 3040 年代通过一次马斯克罗夫卡突袭获得其图纸。赫尔姆记忆核心之后的 FLE-17 变体以较老的 FLE-15 型号为基础。由于龙骑兵更多将跳蚤用作侦察而非反人员机甲，地球工厂通过融入回收技术构想出新设计。在保持 97.2 公里/小时最高速度的同时，加装内骨骼底盘腾出重量用于 MASC 系统，使机甲速度可在短促爆发中推至 129.6 公里/小时。速度的提升是确保在现代战场生存所必需的，因为 FLE-17 仅披着可怜的三吨利文斯顿陶瓷装甲。

Original: A very light sniper mech with a very big laser but cannot take a hit.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_flea_FLE-4.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A very light sniper mech with a very big laser but cannot take a hit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 极轻型狙击机甲，装备超大型激光但不堪一击。

Name: Base_3061.mechdef_franky_MU-TT7.Details

Original: Born from the Terran Hegemony's attempts to create a medium fire-support platform that would be more advanced than the RLN-1N Rifleman, Mitchell Vehicles unveiled the GLH-1D Galahad in 2570. Though it outgunned the earlier design and found significant acceptance within the Hegemony Armed Forces, the Galahad suffered from the same heat issues as the BattleMech it was meant to replace. This variant uses the original 50 ton mech weapon loadout.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_galahad_GLH-1D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Born from the Terran Hegemony's attempts to create a medium fire-support platform that would be more advanced than the RLN-1N Rifleman, Mitchell Vehicles unveiled the GLH-1D Galahad in 2570. Though it outgunned the earlier design and found significant acceptance within the Hegemony Armed Forces, the Galahad suffered from the same heat issues as the BattleMech it was meant to replace. This variant uses the original 50 ton mech weapon loadout.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 源自地球霸权打造比 RLN-1N 步枪手更先进的中型火力支援平台的尝试，米切尔车辆于 2570 年推出 GLH-1D 加拉哈德。虽然它的火力强于先前设计并在霸权武装部队中获得相当认可，但加拉哈德同样受制于它本该取代的那款机甲的热量问题。此变体使用原本 50 吨机甲的武器配置。

Original: Born from the Terran Hegemony's attempts to create a medium fire-support platform that would be more advanced than the RLN-1N Rifleman, Mitchell Vehicles unveiled the GLH-1D Galahad in 2570. Though it outgunned the earlier design and found significant acceptance within the Hegemony Armed Forces, the Galahad suffered from the same heat issues as the BattleMech it was meant to replace. With the development of the new Gauss Rifle, Mitchell Vehicles decided in 2594 to redesign the Galahad around these new weapons. The Galahad utilizes special building materials in the form of eleven tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor and Endo Steel internals. To fit the massive weapons on the Galahad, the engine was dropped to a GM 180, giving it a maximum speed of only 54 km/h, making it difficult for the 'Mech to keep up with its companions in most cases. The GLH-2D carries two massive M-7 Gauss Rifles, with two tons of ammo for each rifle. It was a showing of the powerful new weapons at the time and earned it the nickname of Gausszilla.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_galahad_GLH-2D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Born from the Terran Hegemony's attempts to create a medium fire-support platform that would be more advanced than the RLN-1N Rifleman, Mitchell Vehicles unveiled the GLH-1D Galahad in 2570. Though it outgunned the earlier design and found significant acceptance within the Hegemony Armed Forces, the Galahad suffered from the same heat issues as the BattleMech it was meant to replace. With the development of the new Gauss Rifle, Mitchell Vehicles decided in 2594 to redesign the Galahad around these new weapons. The Galahad utilizes special building materials in the form of eleven tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor and Endo Steel internals. To fit the massive weapons on the Galahad, the engine was dropped to a GM 180, giving it a maximum speed of only 54 km/h, making it difficult for the 'Mech to keep up with its companions in most cases. The GLH-2D carries two massive M-7 Gauss Rifles, with two tons of ammo for each rifle. It was a showing of the powerful new weapons at the time and earned it the nickname of Gausszilla.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 源自地球霸权打造比 RLN-1N 步枪手更先进的中型火力支援平台的尝试，米切尔车辆于 2570 年推出 GLH-1D 加拉哈德。虽然它的火力强于先前设计并在霸权武装部队中获得相当认可，但加拉哈德同样受制于它本该取代的那款机甲的热量问题。随着新型高斯步枪的发展，米切尔车辆于 2594 年决定围绕这些新武器重新设计加拉哈德。它采用特殊建造材料：十一吨铁纤维装甲与内骨骼内部结构。为在加拉哈德上装下这些巨型武器，引擎降至 GM 180，最高速度仅 54 公里/小时，使机甲在多数情况下难以跟上同伴。GLH-2D 携带两门巨型 M-7 高斯步枪，每门配两吨弹药。它在当时展示了这种强大的新武器，并为它赢得"高斯斯拉"的绰号。

Original: Also an effective all around 'Mech, the A configuration ups the firepower with two ER PPCs as its primary long-range weapons. These are supported by a Large Pulse Laser for intermediate range engagements and a Medium Pulse Laser, ER Medium Laser, and ER Small Laser for close combat.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_gargoyle_GAR-A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Also an effective all around 'Mech, the A configuration ups the firepower with two ER PPCs as its primary long-range weapons. These are supported by a Large Pulse Laser for intermediate range engagements and a Medium Pulse Laser, ER Medium Laser, and ER Small Laser for close combat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: A 配置同样是全能有效的机甲，以两门 ER PPC 为远程主武器提升火力。中距离交战由一门大型脉冲激光支援，近战则由一门中型脉冲激光、一门 ER 中型激光和一门 ER 小型激光负责。

Original: Configured almost exclusively for long range combat, the B configuration of the Gargoyle carries a powerful Gauss Rifle backed up by an LRM-10 launcher linked to an Artemis IV FCS, allowing it to keep its distance from enemy units. For self defense at short ranges, the 'Mech has an SRM-4 launcher which is also enhanced with an Artemis IV FCS. The main drawback to this configuration is its over reliance on ammunition based weaponry, making it effective only so long as it has sufficient ammunition for its weapons.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_gargoyle_GAR-B.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Configured almost exclusively for long range combat, the B configuration of the Gargoyle carries a powerful Gauss Rifle backed up by an LRM-10 launcher linked to an Artemis IV FCS, allowing it to keep its distance from enemy units. For self defense at short ranges, the 'Mech has an SRM-4 launcher which is also enhanced with an Artemis IV FCS. The main drawback to this configuration is its over reliance on ammunition based weaponry, making it effective only so long as it has sufficient ammunition for its weapons.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 石像鬼 B 配置几乎专为远程战斗而设，携带一门强力高斯步枪，辅以一具联接 Artemis IV 火控系统的 LRM-10 发射器，使其能与敌方单位保持距离。近程自卫方面，机甲有一具同样加装 Artemis IV 火控系统的 SRM-4 发射器。此配置的主要缺点是过度依赖弹药类武器，使它只在弹药充足时有效。

Original: A dedicated close combat configuration, the Gargoyle C carries as its primary weapon a powerful Ultra Autocannon/20 that has twice the rate of fire as a standard Autocannon. This is supported by a brace of six ER Medium Lasers that make the 'Mech a highly effective brawler.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_gargoyle_GAR-C.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A dedicated close combat configuration, the Gargoyle C carries as its primary weapon a powerful Ultra Autocannon/20 that has twice the rate of fire as a standard Autocannon. This is supported by a brace of six ER Medium Lasers that make the 'Mech a highly effective brawler.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 石像鬼 C 是专职近战配置，主武器为一门强力超速自动炮/20，射速是标准自动炮的两倍。它由六门 ER 中型激光支援，使机甲成为极为高效的缠斗者。

Original: This variant makes use of Clan technology developed in the 3060s. An ATM 12 in the right arm has enough ammunition bins to make use of all of the types available to an Advanced Tactical Missile Launcher. Four Heavy Medium Lasers provide a powerful punch as short range, while a Streak SRM-6 can exploit those holes. A pair of ER Micro Lasers round out the offensive armament. A Targeting Computer makes the lasers more accurate.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_gargoyle_GAR-E.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant makes use of Clan technology developed in the 3060s. An ATM 12 in the right arm has enough ammunition bins to make use of all of the types available to an Advanced Tactical Missile Launcher. Four Heavy Medium Lasers provide a powerful punch as short range, while a Streak SRM-6 can exploit those holes. A pair of ER Micro Lasers round out the offensive armament. A Targeting Computer makes the lasers more accurate.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此变体使用 3060 年代开发的氏族技术。右臂的一具 ATM 12 拥有足够的弹药箱以使用高级战术导弹发射器可用的全部弹种。四门重型中型激光在近距离提供强大打击，而一具连续 SRM-6 可利用这些破口。两门 ER 微型激光为攻击武器收尾。一台瞄准计算机让激光更为精准。

Original: The Primary Gargoyle configuration is capable of engaging enemies at a variety of ranges. For long range encounters, the Gargoyle has two LB 5-X Autocannon that are capable of firing both solid rounds and cluster ammunition, making the 'Mech effective against aircraft and vehicles. For short ranges, the 'Mech has two SRM-6 launchers and a single ER Small Laser which provide adequate close in protection.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_gargoyle_GAR-PRIME.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Primary Gargoyle configuration is capable of engaging enemies at a variety of ranges. For long range encounters, the Gargoyle has two LB 5-X Autocannon that are capable of firing both solid rounds and cluster ammunition, making the 'Mech effective against aircraft and vehicles. For short ranges, the 'Mech has two SRM-6 launchers and a single ER Small Laser which provide adequate close in protection.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 石像鬼的主配置能在多种距离上接敌。远程交战时，它有两门 LB 5-X 自动炮，可发射实心弹与集束弹，对飞行器与车辆都很有效。近距离则有两具 SRM-6 发射器和一门 ER 小型激光，提供足够的近身防护。

Original: The first homegrown BattleMech produced by the Draconis Combine was the Gladiator. The 55-ton 'Mech took seven years to design, as Coordinator Kozo Von Rohrs refused to open up the process to anybody but a select group at New Samarkand Armor Works (the predecessor of Luthien Armor Works) who were under constant surveillance by DEST. 2468 finally saw the GLD-1R Gladiator hit mass-production. Following the Battle of Nox in 2475, the dishonored 'Mech was retired from official production, with NSAW closing down the production lines by 2488. Merryweather Industries was the first private company to attempt BattleMech production without governmental support. Despite their location in the Terran Hegemony, they acquired the plans to the Gladiator and produced a new run in 2490. They were unable to raise the capital to finish their second run, the 4R, and nearly went bankrupt before moving into IndustrialMechs. The GLD-4R production lines were closed down in 2495. A few salvaged Gladiator -1Rs were still in service with militaries across the Inner Sphere and Periphery, though these relics were finally pushed to extinction during the Reunification War. The 55-ton Gladiator has a top speed of 86 km/h, comparable to many other 'Mechs of the same weight. Nine and a half tons of armor provides a respectable amount of protection. Five jump jets enables the 'Mech to jump up to 150 meters at a time.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_gladiator_GLD-1R.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The first homegrown BattleMech produced by the Draconis Combine was the Gladiator. The 55-ton 'Mech took seven years to design, as Coordinator Kozo Von Rohrs refused to open up the process to anybody but a select group at New Samarkand Armor Works (the predecessor of Luthien Armor Works) who were under constant surveillance by DEST. 2468 finally saw the GLD-1R Gladiator hit mass-production. Following the Battle of Nox in 2475, the dishonored 'Mech was retired from official production, with NSAW closing down the production lines by 2488. Merryweather Industries was the first private company to attempt BattleMech production without governmental support. Despite their location in the Terran Hegemony, they acquired the plans to the Gladiator and produced a new run in 2490. They were unable to raise the capital to finish their second run, the 4R, and nearly went bankrupt before moving into IndustrialMechs. The GLD-4R production lines were closed down in 2495. A few salvaged Gladiator -1Rs were still in service with militaries across the Inner Sphere and Periphery, though these relics were finally pushed to extinction during the Reunification War. The 55-ton Gladiator has a top speed of 86 km/h, comparable to many other 'Mechs of the same weight. Nine and a half tons of armor provides a respectable amount of protection. Five jump jets enables the 'Mech to jump up to 150 meters at a time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 联合体自主生产的第一款战斗机甲是角斗士。这款 55 吨机甲耗时七年设计，因为协调官科佐·冯·罗尔斯拒绝将此过程向除新萨马尔坎德装甲工厂（卢西恩装甲工厂的前身）一小批人之外的任何人开放，这批人还处于 DEST 的持续监视之下。2468 年 GLD-1R 角斗士终于进入量产。在 2475 年诺克斯战役后，这款蒙羞的机甲被正式停产，NSAW 于 2488 年关闭生产线。梅里韦瑟工业是第一家在没有政府支持下尝试生产战斗机甲的私营公司。尽管位于地球霸权境内，他们仍取得了角斗士的图纸，并于 2490 年生产了新一轮机型。他们无力筹集资金完成第二轮生产（4R 型），几乎破产，随后转向工业机甲。GLD-4R 生产线于 2495 年关闭。少数回收的角斗士-1R 仍在内外天体的军队中服役，但这些老古董最终在统一战争中彻底消亡。55 吨的角斗士最高速度达 86 公里/小时，与同重量的许多机甲相当。九吨半装甲提供了可观的防护。五个跳跃推进器使机甲一次可跳跃至 150 米。

Original: Affectionately known as the 'Grand Dragon', the DRG-1G replaces the AC5 with a PPC, Medium Laser and 2 extra Heat Sinks.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_granddragon_DRG-1G.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Affectionately known as the 'Grand Dragon', the DRG-1G replaces the AC5 with a PPC, Medium Laser and 2 extra Heat Sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: DRG-1G 被亲切地称为"大龙"，它将 AC5 换成一门 PPC、一门中型激光和 2 台额外散热器。

Original: The Grand Dragon 3K is a beefy machine that can take a serious beating and carries heavier weaponry than its smaller cousin. Equipped with a heavy-duty gyro, a PPC and Gauss rifle, this variant is a formidable heavy weapons platform.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_granddragon_DRG-3K.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Grand Dragon 3K is a beefy machine that can take a serious beating and carries heavier weaponry than its smaller cousin. Equipped with a heavy-duty gyro, a PPC and Gauss rifle, this variant is a formidable heavy weapons platform.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 大龙 3K 是一台强壮的机器，能承受严重打击，并携带比其小型表亲更重的武器。它配备重型陀螺仪、一门 PPC 和一门高斯步枪，是令人敬畏的重型武器平台。

Original: Don't be fooled by its whimsical name—the Grasshopper is a killer that specializes in hunting down light and medium 'Mechs. Its superb jump ability and good armor allow it to get behind foes easily to bring its all-Energy weapons to bear.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_grasshopper_GHR-5H.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Don't be fooled by its whimsical name—the Grasshopper is a killer that specializes in hunting down light and medium 'Mechs. Its superb jump ability and good armor allow it to get behind foes easily to bring its all-Energy weapons to bear.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 别被它古怪的名字骗了——蚱猛是个专精猎杀轻中型机甲的杀手。其卓越的跳跃能力与良好的装甲使它轻易绕到敌后，倾泻全能量武器。

Original: An upgrade of the Grasshopper using Star League technology, the 5J replaces the Diplan large laser with a Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Laser, replaces the Conan/S launcher with a Hovertech Streak SRM-2 model, and removes the two torso-mounted medium lasers for a SureFire 444 Anti-Missile System.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_grasshopper_GHR-5J.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade of the Grasshopper using Star League technology, the 5J replaces the Diplan large laser with a Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Laser, replaces the Conan/S launcher with a Hovertech Streak SRM-2 model, and removes the two torso-mounted medium lasers for a SureFire 444 Anti-Missile System.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5J 是使用星盟科技的蚱猛升级版，将迪普兰大型激光换成多元光学"日光束"ER 大型激光，将柯南/S 发射器换成霍弗泰克连续 SRM-2，并移除两门躯干中型激光，改为一套必火 444 反导系统。

Original: The 5N is a very basic field upgrade of the Grasshopper introduced around 3040. The large laser and missile launcher have both been removed and in their place was added a PPC and a fifth medium laser respectively. Though the change increases the design's firepower, it also comes at a greater risk of overheating the 'Mech, especially if the pilot is careless.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_grasshopper_GHR-5N.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5N is a very basic field upgrade of the Grasshopper introduced around 3040. The large laser and missile launcher have both been removed and in their place was added a PPC and a fifth medium laser respectively. Though the change increases the design's firepower, it also comes at a greater risk of overheating the 'Mech, especially if the pilot is careless.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5N 是约 3040 年推出的蚱猛非常基础的野战升级。大型激光和导弹发射器均被移除，分别换成一门 PPC 和第五门中型激光。虽然这一改动提升了设计的火力，但也带来了更高的过热风险，尤其当飞行员粗心大意时。

Original: A basic modification of the 5J model introduced by the Combine in 3052, the Grasshopper-C carries a C3 slave unit to allow it to be integrated into a C3 lance. These models often served as the point 'Mech in a C3 lance, where its speed and armor allowed it to get close enough to the enemy and share this targeting data with friendly units. To make room for the addition of the C3 unit, ammunition for the Streak SRM-2 launcher was reduced by one ton, though since the Streak launcher was already an ammo-efficient design this resulted in no drop in performance
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_grasshopper_GHR-C.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A basic modification of the 5J model introduced by the Combine in 3052, the Grasshopper-C carries a C3 slave unit to allow it to be integrated into a C3 lance. These models often served as the point 'Mech in a C3 lance, where its speed and armor allowed it to get close enough to the enemy and share this targeting data with friendly units. To make room for the addition of the C3 unit, ammunition for the Streak SRM-2 launcher was reduced by one ton, though since the Streak launcher was already an ammo-efficient design this resulted in no drop in performance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为联合体 3052 年推出的 5J 型号的基础改装，蚱猛-C 携带一台 C3 从属单元以便编入 C3 小队。这些型号常作为 C3 小队中的尖兵机甲，其速度与装甲使它能够逼近敌人并把瞄准数据共享给友军单位。为腾出空间加装 C3 单元，连续 SRM-2 发射器的弹药减少了一吨，不过由于连续发射器本就是弹药效率很高的设计，这并未导致性能下降

Original: Griffin 1Ns use their Jump Jets to stay at range and pelt their opponents from relative safety. 1Ns can run hot if they spend all their time bounding around the battlefield taking potshots, though.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_griffin_GRF-1N.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Griffin 1Ns use their Jump Jets to stay at range and pelt their opponents from relative safety. 1Ns can run hot if they spend all their time bounding around the battlefield taking potshots, though.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狮鹫 1N 利用跳跃推进器保持距离，在相对安全处向对手投掷火力。不过，如果它们整场都在战场上蹦跳打冷枪，也可能过热。

Original: Griffin 1Ss mount closer-range weaponry than their 1N cousins, allowing them to jump in for closer attacks and then move away to disengage or flank. They're generally better at dealing with heat buildup, too.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_griffin_GRF-1S.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Griffin 1Ss mount closer-range weaponry than their 1N cousins, allowing them to jump in for closer attacks and then move away to disengage or flank. They're generally better at dealing with heat buildup, too.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狮鹫 1S 比其 1N 表亲装备更偏近程的武器，使它们能跳入发动近距离攻击，再后撤脱离或包抄。它们在处理热量积累方面通常也更好。

Original: The GRF-2N-X Super Griffin is an evolution of the classic Griffin, a re-design that essentially produced a new BattleMech with even a different tonnage. Using a sixty ton frame, engineers fitted Prototype Improved Jump Jets to the 'Mech to compensate for its reduced speed.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_griffin_GRF-2N-X.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The GRF-2N-X Super Griffin is an evolution of the classic Griffin, a re-design that essentially produced a new BattleMech with even a different tonnage. Using a sixty ton frame, engineers fitted Prototype Improved Jump Jets to the 'Mech to compensate for its reduced speed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: GRF-2N-X 超级狮鹫是经典狮鹫的演进，这次重新设计实质上造就了一款连吨位都不同的新机甲。工程师以六十吨框架为基础，为机甲装上原型改进型跳跃推进器，以弥补其降低的速度。

Original: The Griffin 2N is an old Star League model that was among the most versatile 'Mechs in its heyday. Its weapons generated a lot of heat, but the old Double Heat Sinks were put in to handle it.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_griffin_GRF-2N.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Griffin 2N is an old Star League model that was among the most versatile 'Mechs in its heyday. Its weapons generated a lot of heat, but the old Double Heat Sinks were put in to handle it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狮鹫 2N 是一款老式星盟型号，在其全盛时期是最多才多艺的机甲之一。它的武器产生大量热量，但装设的老式双倍散热器足以应对。

Original: The Griffin 2N is an old Star League model that was among the most versatile 'Mechs in its heyday. The rare B variant was specifically made for Covert Ops and carried advanced surveillance and stealth equipment.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_griffin_GRF-2Nb.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Griffin 2N is an old Star League model that was among the most versatile 'Mechs in its heyday. The rare B variant was specifically made for Covert Ops and carried advanced surveillance and stealth equipment.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狮鹫 2N 是一款老式星盟型号，在其全盛时期是最多才多艺的机甲之一。罕见的 B 变体专为秘密行动而制，携带先进的监视与隐形设备。

Original: The 3M Griffin was an upgraded version of the design built for House Marik by Earthwerks and Brigadier Corps starting in 3049. With production lines on Keystone and Oliver this variant sought to enhance the original's long-range capabilities. The engine was exchanged for a Hermes 275 extralight model and carried fourteen double heat sinks to improve heat management. The normal PPC was replaced by a Fusigon Longtooth ER PPC, for longer reach at the expense of more heat, and the LRM launcher had been upgraded to a Doombud LRM-20 launcher, for more indirect fire support capabilities. Finally a ChrisComp Small Laser was mounted in the head and the two tons of LRM reloads in the left torso were protected by CASE. While intended for the Free Worlds League Military the capture of Oliver by FedCom forces meant the 3M also appeared in large numbers in the Armed Forces of the Federated Commonwealth.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_griffin_GRF-3M.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3M Griffin was an upgraded version of the design built for House Marik by Earthwerks and Brigadier Corps starting in 3049. With production lines on Keystone and Oliver this variant sought to enhance the original's long-range capabilities. The engine was exchanged for a Hermes 275 extralight model and carried fourteen double heat sinks to improve heat management. The normal PPC was replaced by a Fusigon Longtooth ER PPC, for longer reach at the expense of more heat, and the LRM launcher had been upgraded to a Doombud LRM-20 launcher, for more indirect fire support capabilities. Finally a ChrisComp Small Laser was mounted in the head and the two tons of LRM reloads in the left torso were protected by CASE. While intended for the Free Worlds League Military the capture of Oliver by FedCom forces meant the 3M also appeared in large numbers in the Armed Forces of the Federated Commonwealth.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3M 狮鹫是为马里克家族打造的升级版，由地球工厂与准将兵团自 3049 年起生产。借助基斯通与奥利弗的生产线，该变体力图强化原版的远程能力。引擎换成赫尔墨斯 275 超轻型，并携带十四台双倍散热器以改善散热管理。标准 PPC 换成"富西贡长牙"ER PPC，以更多热量换取更远射程；LRM 发射器升级为末日芽 LRM-20，以增强间接火力支援能力。最后，头部安装一门克里斯康小型激光，左躯干的两吨 LRM 再装填由 C.A.S.E. 保护。虽然原为自由世界联盟军队设计，但联邦联邦部队夺取奥利弗意味着 3M 也大量出现在联邦联邦武装部队中。

Original: Created by a pilot who lost the LRM rack of his Griffin, the -6CV replaces the long-range payload with a mid-range weapon system: a MRM 30. Backing up the MRM rack is an ER PPC with a PPC Capacitor for extra punch. To keep the heat under control, the -6CV mounts double heat sinks and is powered by a Light Fusion Engine for speed. It also has gained a little armor for extra survivability.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_griffin_GRF-6CV.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Created by a pilot who lost the LRM rack of his Griffin, the -6CV replaces the long-range payload with a mid-range weapon system: a MRM 30. Backing up the MRM rack is an ER PPC with a PPC Capacitor for extra punch. To keep the heat under control, the -6CV mounts double heat sinks and is powered by a Light Fusion Engine for speed. It also has gained a little armor for extra survivability.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -6CV 由一位失去了格里芬 LRM 挂架的飞行员创造，它以一套中程武器系统取代远程载荷：一具 MRM 30。支援 MRM 挂架的是一门带 PPC 电容器的 ER PPC，以提供额外打击力。为控制热量，-6CV 装双倍散热器，并由一台轻型聚变引擎提供速度。它还增加了一点装甲以提升生存性。
装备氏族科技升级的狮鹫。

Original: The Grim Reaper was a 'Mech designed by ComStar to help replenish the heavy material losses suffered by the Com Guards during the Battle of Tukayyid, with the Word of Blake maintaining production after it captured Terra to help rebuild and expand the Word of Blake Militia. Thus the Grim Reaper is seen in moderate numbers in both secular and fanatical militaries. Designed to be a generic trooper 'Mech, the Grim Reaper carries a varied and non specialized weapons payload.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_grimreaper_GRM-R-PR29.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Grim Reaper was a 'Mech designed by ComStar to help replenish the heavy material losses suffered by the Com Guards during the Battle of Tukayyid, with the Word of Blake maintaining production after it captured Terra to help rebuild and expand the Word of Blake Militia. Thus the Grim Reaper is seen in moderate numbers in both secular and fanatical militaries. Designed to be a generic trooper 'Mech, the Grim Reaper carries a varied and non specialized weapons payload.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 死神是康星设计的机甲，用于补充康卫在图卡伊德战役中遭受的严重物资损失，布雷克之言在夺取地球后维持生产，以协助重建和扩充布雷克之言民兵。因此死神在世俗与狂热两方的军队中都有中等数量的装备。作为一款通用士兵机甲，死神携带多样而非专精的武器配置。

Original: The Grizzly is a BattleMech that was developed by Clan Ghost Bear scientists in the 30th century. Unfortunately, the design excels at no one thing, so it never carved a niche in the Clan's touman.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_grizzly.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Grizzly is a BattleMech that was developed by Clan Ghost Bear scientists in the 30th century. Unfortunately, the design excels at no one thing, so it never carved a niche in the Clan's touman.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 灰熊是鬼熊氏族科学家在三十世纪开发的战斗机甲。遗憾的是，该设计在任何方面都不出众，因此从未在氏族的图曼中占据一席之地。

Original: The Hammer is a 'Mech that was built to provide fire support for light 'Mechs. The 'Mech is built around a long-range arsenal that can provide both direct and indirect fire support. It is also often paired with the Anvil, using its missiles to soften up the enemy at a distance until the Anvil can bring its lasers to bear. The Hammer has a maximum speed of 86.4 kph, which is enough for a 'Mech intended to stay at the edges of a battlefield acting in a fire support role. Additionally, the 'Mech has a respectable six tons of armor protection. With its average speed and good armor protection combined with its long-range weapons, the Hammer is a good overall light fire support 'Mech.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hammer_HMR-3C.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hammer is a 'Mech that was built to provide fire support for light 'Mechs. The 'Mech is built around a long-range arsenal that can provide both direct and indirect fire support. It is also often paired with the Anvil, using its missiles to soften up the enemy at a distance until the Anvil can bring its lasers to bear. The Hammer has a maximum speed of 86.4 kph, which is enough for a 'Mech intended to stay at the edges of a battlefield acting in a fire support role. Additionally, the 'Mech has a respectable six tons of armor protection. With its average speed and good armor protection combined with its long-range weapons, the Hammer is a good overall light fire support 'Mech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战锤是为轻型机甲提供火力支援而制造的机甲。它以远程武器库为核心，可提供直射与间接火力支援。它常与铁砧搭档，在远距离用导弹削弱敌人，直到铁砧能以激光发起攻击。战锤最高速度 86.4 公里/小时，对于一款意在战场边缘执行火力支援角色的机甲而言已足够。此外，它还拥有可观的六吨装甲防护。凭借平均速度、良好装甲与远程武器的组合，战锤是一款整体出色的轻型火力支援机甲。

Original: The original version produced during 3039. Though lacking the LosTech of the HTM-27, the single production run of the original field-test Hatamoto-Chi completed on the verge of the War of 3039 came as a total shock to the attacking Lyran and Davion Forces. Since it was built on a standard chassis, the 26T had less armor, one less heat sink, and single ton of SRM ammunition in a standard ammo bin.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hatamotochi_HTM-26T.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original version produced during 3039. Though lacking the LosTech of the HTM-27, the single production run of the original field-test Hatamoto-Chi completed on the verge of the War of 3039 came as a total shock to the attacking Lyran and Davion Forces. Since it was built on a standard chassis, the 26T had less armor, one less heat sink, and single ton of SRM ammunition in a standard ammo bin.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初版本于 3039 年生产。尽管缺少 HTM-27 的失落科技，原版野战测试型旗本-血的唯一一次量产恰在 3039 年战争前夕完成，令进攻的莱兰与达维昂部队大为震惊。由于建立在标准底盘上，26T 装甲较少、少一台散热器，SRM 弹药也仅有一吨存于标准弹药箱中。

Original: Constructed with an Earthwerks VOL Endo Steel chassis, fitted with CASE protected ammo bins and clad in fifteen and a half tons of Mitchell Argon armor, the Hatamoto-Chi shared the features which made its parent design a nearly indestructible zombie 'Mech. The main area that Combine was unable to replicate the Thug was the older design's advanced Double Heat Sinks, eighteen standard Heat Sinks giving the Hatamoto-Chi a high heat curve in heavy combat.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hatamotochi_HTM-27T.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Constructed with an Earthwerks VOL Endo Steel chassis, fitted with CASE protected ammo bins and clad in fifteen and a half tons of Mitchell Argon armor, the Hatamoto-Chi shared the features which made its parent design a nearly indestructible zombie 'Mech. The main area that Combine was unable to replicate the Thug was the older design's advanced Double Heat Sinks, eighteen standard Heat Sinks giving the Hatamoto-Chi a high heat curve in heavy combat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 旗本-血采用地球工厂 VOL 内骨骼底盘建造，装有 C.A.S.E. 保护的弹药箱，披挂十五吨半米切尔氢装甲，共享了使其母设计成为近乎不可摧毁的"僵尸"机甲的特征。联合体唯一无法复制"暴徒"的地方是那款老设计的先进双倍散热器，十八台标准散热器使旗本-血在激烈战斗中热量曲线偏高。

Original: The 27V, known within the Combine as the Hatamoto-Kaze, is a variant focused on long range combat. The 'Mech removes both of the SRM-6 launchers and replaces them with a pair of LRM-5 launchers, giving the Hatamoto-Kaze the ability to stay back from the battlefield and provide indirect fire.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hatamotochi_HTM-27V.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 27V, known within the Combine as the Hatamoto-Kaze, is a variant focused on long range combat. The 'Mech removes both of the SRM-6 launchers and replaces them with a pair of LRM-5 launchers, giving the Hatamoto-Kaze the ability to stay back from the battlefield and provide indirect fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 27V 在联合体内部被称为旗本-风，是一款专注远程战斗的变体。它移除两具 SRM-6 发射器，换成两具 LRM-5，使旗本-风能远离战场提供间接火力。

Original: The 27W, also known as the Hatamoto-Ku, removes both of the SRM-6 launchers and replaces them with an Autocannon5. The 'Mech has a powerful direct fire capability.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hatamotochi_HTM-27W.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 27W, also known as the Hatamoto-Ku, removes both of the SRM-6 launchers and replaces them with an Autocannon5. The 'Mech has a powerful direct fire capability.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 27W 又称旗本-空，移除两具 SRM-6 发射器，换成一门自动炮5。该机甲具备强大的直射火力。

Original: The first OmniMech both designed and built by the Lyran Alliance. The inspiration for the Hauptmann is drawn from the Daishi OmniMech used by the Clans. Using information from captured Daishis and data gleaned from the construction of the Firestarter OmniMech, which was shared by the Draconis Combine, the end result is a powerful OmniMech capable of defending itself in most combat situations. The Hauptmann is built on a standard chassis and powered by a 285 fusion engine, adding to the 'Mech's durability as it cannot be killed by a side torso loss. The Hauptmann has eleven double heat sinks fixed on the chassis and can add more if needed in its various configurations. For protection, the Hauptmann carries eighteen and a half tons of armor and has CASE fixed in the right torso to protect against an ammunition explosion.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hauptmann_HA1-O.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The first OmniMech both designed and built by the Lyran Alliance. The inspiration for the Hauptmann is drawn from the Daishi OmniMech used by the Clans. Using information from captured Daishis and data gleaned from the construction of the Firestarter OmniMech, which was shared by the Draconis Combine, the end result is a powerful OmniMech capable of defending itself in most combat situations. The Hauptmann is built on a standard chassis and powered by a 285 fusion engine, adding to the 'Mech's durability as it cannot be killed by a side torso loss. The Hauptmann has eleven double heat sinks fixed on the chassis and can add more if needed in its various configurations. For protection, the Hauptmann carries eighteen and a half tons of armor and has CASE fixed in the right torso to protect against an ammunition explosion.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 首款由莱兰联盟自行设计并制造的全能机甲。上尉的灵感源自氏族使用的"大师"全能机甲。利用缴获的"大师"资料以及由德拉科尼斯联合体分享的火焰使者全能机甲建造数据，最终成果是一款强大的全能机甲，能在大多数战斗情形下自保。上尉采用标准底盘，由 285 聚变引擎驱动，这增强了它的耐久性，使其不会因失去侧面躯干而被击毁。它底盘上固定有十一台双倍散热器，必要时可在各配置中加装更多。防护方面，上尉携带十八吨半装甲，并在右侧躯干固定 C.A.S.E. 以防弹药爆炸。

Original: The first OmniMech both designed and built by the Lyran Alliance. The inspiration for the Hauptmann is drawn from the Daishi OmniMech used by the Clans. The Hauptmann has eleven double heat sinks fixed on the chassis and can add more if needed in its various configurations. Original: Despite its initial success, the combat service of the Hellfire has not be flaw free. Aside from the sensor interference caused by firing its signature Heavy Lasers, a number of battlefield reports indicate the heavy laser tubes can violently rupture in the heat of battle. The 'Mech also experiences a fifteen percent higher rate of MASC failure than usual, though technicians have yet to determine whether this is due to the age of the Lupus chassis or if this is something caused by the Heavy Lasers.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A sleek, mobile, and versatile design, the Clan hellhound was long suspected to be one of the first OmniMechs produced by the Clans.

Original: The Highlander 732B is an ancient model from the Star League days! Its Gauss Rifle was a terrifying weapon that gave it a huge punch at almost any range—but you can't find those anymore. And of course, it still has the jump capability it's always been known for.

Original: One of the most popular Star League BattleMechs, many a Highlander accompanied General Aleksandr Kerensky into exile. Some were mothballed, but many found their way into the toumans of the Clans. As technology advanced, the weapons systems were upgraded until the design known as the Highlander IIC finally emerged. With the use of newer, lighter weapons, the damage potential of the Highlander has roughly doubled. The IIC also contains enough ammunition that it rarely needs to conserve any during Trials. Clan scientists were forced to rearrange the placement of some weapons within the 'Mech to allow it proper ammo feeds, but the design is largely unchanged. It carries the maximum amount of Ferro-Fibrous armor that can be crammed on the frame, fourteen and a half tons. As with the original, the IIC carries enough jump jets to move up to ninety meters at a time, allowing MechWarriors to execute the Highlander Burial.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_highlander_HGN-IIC-1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 高地人是星盟最受欢迎的战斗机甲之一，许多随亚历山大·克伦斯基将军流亡。有些被封存，但许多进入了氏族的图曼。随着技术进步，武器系统不断升级，最终诞生了被称为高地人 IIC 的设计。凭借更新更轻的武器，高地人的伤害潜力几乎翻倍。IIC 还携带充足弹药，在试炼中几乎无需节省。氏族科学家被迫重新安排机内部分武器的位置以使其供弹顺畅，但设计大体未变。它携带了框架所能容纳的最大量铁纤维装甲——十四吨半。与原版一样，IIC 携带足以一次移动九十米的跳跃推进器，使机甲战士能施展"高地人埋葬"。高地人 IIC C 将标准型的高斯步枪换成两门超速自动炮/10，保留三门中型脉冲激光，同时移除 LRM-20 的 Artemis 模块和一门左臂连续 SRM-6 发射器。

Original: The Hitman was designed to work as a spotter 'Mech for advanced Arrow IV missile artillery rounds. In order to do this, the 'Mech is built to be able to close to effective range for its Forward-1 Target Acquisition Gear spotting gear rapidly with a Kagushima 210 XL propelling it up to 118.8 kph and a MASC system pushing the 'Mech up to 151.2 kph in short bursts. The 'Mech also carries an Apple Churchill Guardian ECM Suite to foul any enemy electronics warfare equipment and a Wunderland Beagle Active Probe to detect any hidden enemy units. With the recent invention of semi-guided LRMs the Hitman can also guide LRM fire to a unit targeted with its TAG unit. The Hitman carries five tons of armor protection to protect it against any attacks that may hit it.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hitman_HM-1.Details

Original: The F5 variant, called the Hollander II, is a variant of the Hollander that looks to alleviate the 'Mech's problems by building it on a chassis ten tons heavier than the original, pushing it into the medium weight class. First built in 3058 the 'Mech still carries a Gauss Rifle as its primary weapon, but is backed up by a single Medium Laser and a Streak SRM-2 launcher.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hollanderii_BZK-F5.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The F5 variant, called the Hollander II, is a variant of the Hollander that looks to alleviate the 'Mech's problems by building it on a chassis ten tons heavier than the original, pushing it into the medium weight class. First built in 3058 the 'Mech still carries a Gauss Rifle as its primary weapon, but is backed up by a single Medium Laser and a Streak SRM-2 launcher.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 名为荷兰人 II 的 F5 变体是荷兰人的改型，试图通过把底盘加重十吨、跨入中量级来解决机甲的问题。它于 3058 年首次建造，仍以高斯步枪为主武器，但辅以一门中型激光和一具连续 SRM-2 发射器。

Original: The F7, debuting in 3061 is a modification of the F5 that takes advantage of the Hollander II's larger weapons payload to mount the Lyran Alliance's new Heavy Gauss Rifle, which is capable of causing a great deal of damage at short to medium ranges. While improving upon the firepower of the variant, the removal of backup weaponry to fit these massive weapon leaves it with the same problems as the original Hollander.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hollanderii_BZK-F7.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The F7, debuting in 3061 is a modification of the F5 that takes advantage of the Hollander II's larger weapons payload to mount the Lyran Alliance's new Heavy Gauss Rifle, which is capable of causing a great deal of damage at short to medium ranges. While improving upon the firepower of the variant, the removal of backup weaponry to fit these massive weapon leaves it with the same problems as the original Hollander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: F7 于 3061 年亮相，是 F5 的改型，利用荷兰人 II 更大的武器负载能力搭载莱兰联盟新型重型高斯步枪，能在中近距离造成大量伤害。虽然火力优于前型，但为容纳这些巨型武器而移除备用武器，使它仍带有原版荷兰人的同样问题。

Original: The Hollander was introduced in 3054 specifically to carry a Gauss Rifle into combat and act as a sniper. The Federated Commonwealth was in dire need of a response to the fast-moving, long-range firepower of the Clan Invaders at the time, and looked at a number of light 'Mech designs featuring PPCs or LRMs as a potential answer. It was Coventry's unorthodox decision to mount such a large weapon, one that had neither the overheating or ammunition explosion drawbacks of the other designs, which won them the contract. With its single massive cannon and use of rediscovered technology, the Hollander can destroy another light 'Mech in a single hit at extreme range and threaten heavier targets easily.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hollander_BZK-F3.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hollander was introduced in 3054 specifically to carry a Gauss Rifle into combat and act as a sniper. It was Coventry's unorthodox decision to mount such a large weapon, one that had neither the overheating or ammunition explosion drawbacks of the other designs, which won them the contract. With its single massive cannon and use of rediscovered technology, the Hollander can destroy another light 'Mech in a single hit at extreme range and threaten heavier targets easily.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 荷兰人于 3054 年推出，专门为了把高斯步枪带上战场并担任狙击手。当时联邦联邦急需应对氏族入侵者快速机动的远程火力，考察了多款装备 PPC 或 LRM 的轻型机甲设计方案。考文垂大胆决定装上如此巨大的武器——既没有其他设计那样的过热或弹药爆炸缺陷——从而赢得了合同。凭借其单门巨型火炮和对重新发现技术的运用，荷兰人能在极远距离一炮摧毁另一台轻型机甲，并轻易威胁更重的目标。

Original: The G1 variant of the Hollander is built to address concerns about the Hollander's lack of back up weapons. First debuting in 3056 the 'Mech replaces the heavy Gauss Cannon with an LB-X Autocannon/10 as its primary weapon, freeing up weight to mount two Defiance B3M Medium Lasers in its arms as backup weapons and add two tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. The G1 is an excellent 'Mech for vehicle hunting as well as anti-aircraft use with its LB-X cluster rounds.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hollander_BZK-G1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The G1 variant of the Hollander is built to address concerns about the Hollander's lack of back up weapons. The G1 is an excellent 'Mech for vehicle hunting as well as anti-aircraft use with its LB-X cluster rounds.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 荷兰人的 G1 变体旨在解决人们对荷兰人缺乏备用武器的担忧。它于 3056 年首次亮相，将重型高斯炮换成 LB-X 自动炮/10 作为主武器，腾出重量在双臂装两门迪法恩斯 B3M 中型激光作为备用，并加两吨铁纤维装甲。凭借 LB-X 集束弹，G1 是出色的反车辆兼防空机甲。

Original: Conceived by Martinson Armaments of Terra in 2578 as an infantry support 'Mech, the Hoplite first saw service with the newly formed Star League Defense Force during the Reunification War before being relegated to Terran Hegemony militia units in the twenty-seventh century. Intended for infantry support, the Hoplite is slow for a medium 'Mech with a top speed of only 64.8 km/h. However its eleven and a half tons of armor and heavy arsenal, both impressive for a 'Mech of its size, makes the Hoplite a rugged machine able to fight its way out of most situations using superior firepower. The original Reunification War era model, save for using an older Dalban Sniper targeting and tracking system, was all but identical to the 4C.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hoplite_HOP-4A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Conceived by Martinson Armaments of Terra in 2578 as an infantry support 'Mech, the Hoplite first saw service with the newly formed Star League Defense Force during the Reunification War before being relegated to Terran Hegemony militia units in the twenty-seventh century. Intended for infantry support, the Hoplite is slow for a medium 'Mech with a top speed of only 64.8 km/h. However its eleven and a half tons of armor and heavy arsenal, both impressive for a 'Mech of its size, makes the Hoplite a rugged machine able to fight its way out of most situations using superior firepower. The original Reunification War era model, save for using an older Dalban Sniper targeting and tracking system, was all but identical to the 4C.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重装步兵由泰拉的马丁森军械于 2578 年构想为步兵支援机甲，在统一战争中首次随新成立的星盟防卫军服役，后在二十七世纪被降级至地球霸权民兵单位。作为步兵支援机甲，重装步兵对中型机甲而言偏慢，最高速度仅 64.8 公里/小时。然而其十一吨半装甲与重型武器库对如此尺寸的机甲都堪称出色，使重装步兵成为一台凭借优势火力就能从大多数困境中杀出重围的坚固机器。统一战争时代的原始型号除了使用较老的达尔班狙击瞄准追踪系统外，与 4C 几乎完全相同。

Original: Conceived by Martinson Armaments of Terra in 2578 as an infantry support 'Mech, the Hoplite first saw service with the newly formed Star League Defense Force during the Reunification War before being relegated to Terran Hegemony militia units in the twenty-seventh century. Intended for infantry support, the Hoplite is slow for a medium 'Mech with a top speed of only 64.8 km/h. However its eleven and a half tons of armor and heavy arsenal, both impressive for a 'Mech of its size, makes the Hoplite a rugged machine able to fight its way out of most situations using superior firepower. The 4B variant of the Hoplite is an early variant of the 'Mech that attempts to both alleviate the ammunition dependence of its primary weapon and increase its long-range damage potential. This is done by mounting a Magna Hellstar PPC as the primary weapon that is backed up by a massive Mitchell Systems LRM-15 launcher with two tons of reloads, giving it excellent long-range and indirect fire support capabilities.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hoplite_HOP-4B.Details

Original: Essentially a Royal variant in everything but name, the Double B Hoplite was put into production at Strana Mechty MechWorks and Eden Weaponry Consolidated just before the death of Aleksandr Kerensky and found its way both into the forces of the Pentagon Powers and the infant toumans of the Clans. Keeping the LRM rack of the 4B, the Double B upgrades the Holly LRM-15 launcher with an Artemis IV system, swaps the PPC for an Kinslaughter H-Class ER PPC, and increases the 'Mech's survivability with a Guardian ECM system, CASE in both torsos, double heat sinks, and an anti-missile system. However, the design's speed and armor were not upgraded, enforcing the need to deploy the 4Bb as a fire-support unit.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hoplite_HOP-4Bb.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Essentially a Royal variant in everything but name, the Double B Hoplite was put into production at Strana Mechty MechWorks and Eden Weaponry Consolidated just before the death of Aleksandr Kerensky and found its way both into the forces of the Pentagon Powers and the infant toumans of the Clans. However, the design's speed and armor were not upgraded, enforcing the need to deploy the 4Bb as a fire-support unit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 双 B 重装步兵实质上除名字之外一切皆为皇家变体，在亚历山大·克伦斯基去世前夕于斯特拉纳·麦赫蒂机甲工厂与伊甸兵器联合体投产，既进入五角势力部队，也进入氏族初生的图曼。双 B 保留 4B 的 LRM 挂架，把"冬青"LRM-15 发射器升级加装 Artemis IV 系统，把 PPC 换成"族杀 H 级"ER PPC，并通过守护者 ECM 系统、两侧躯干的 C.A.S.E.、双倍散热器和一套反导系统提升机甲生存力。然而该设计的速度与装甲并未升级，因此 4Bb 必须作为火力支援单位使用。

Original: Conceived by Martinson Armaments of Terra in 2578 as an infantry support 'Mech, the Hoplite first saw service with the newly formed Star League Defense Force during the Reunification War before being relegated to Terran Hegemony militia units in the twenty-seventh century. Intended for infantry support, the Hoplite is slow for a medium 'Mech with a top speed of only 64.8 km/h. However its eleven and a half tons of armor and heavy arsenal, both impressive for a 'Mech of its size, makes the Hoplite a rugged machine able to fight its way out of most situations using superior firepower. Effectively identical to the original Hoplite, the 4C carries as its primary weapon a Luxor HV Autocannon/10, which allows it to put a good amount of damage on a target, with a low amount of heat. The 'Mech is also armed with a Conan/5 LRM-5 launcher. Arriving with the Wolf's Dragoons, these were the first Hoplites seen in the Inner Sphere since their extinction during the Succession Wars.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hoplite_HOP-4C.Details

Original: A Hell's Horses field refit from Operation KLONDIKE, the 4Cb removes the weapons, electronics suite, and a heat sink in favor of a Gauss rifle, SRM-6, and Ferro-Fibrous armor.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hoplite_HOP-4Cb.Details

Original: Conceived by Martinson Armaments of Terra in 2578 as an infantry support 'Mech, the Hoplite first saw service with the newly formed Star League Defense Force during the Reunification War before being relegated to Terran Hegemony militia units in the twenty-seventh century. Intended for infantry support, the Hoplite is slow for a medium 'Mech with a top speed of only 64.8 km/h. However its eleven and a half tons of armor and heavy arsenal, both impressive for a 'Mech of its size, makes the Hoplite a rugged machine able to fight its way out of most situations using superior firepower. Refitted by the Dragoons after the Inner Sphere's recovery of the Helm Memory Core, the HOP-4D Hoplite is armed with an impressive Mydron Excel LB-X Autocannon/10, which allows it to fire either standard rounds or cluster rounds, which are similar to the blast from a shotgun, only on a 'Mech scale. As a secondary weapon, the Hoplite carries a Conan/5 LRM-5 launcher, which also allows it to keep the enemy at long ranges.

Refitted by the Dragoons after the Inner Sphere's recovery of the Helm Memory Core, the HOP-4D Hoplite is armed with an impressive Mydron Excel LB-X Autocannon/10, which allows it to fire either standard rounds or cluster rounds, which are similar to the blast from a shotgun, only on a 'Mech scale. As a secondary weapon, the Hoplite carries a Conan/5 LRM-5 launcher, which also allows it to keep the enemy at long ranges.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重装步兵由泰拉的马丁森军械于 2578 年构想为步兵支援机甲，在统一战争中首次随新成立的星盟防卫军服役，后在二十七世纪被降级至地球霸权民兵单位。作为步兵支援机甲，重装步兵对中型机甲而言偏慢，最高速度仅 64.8 公里/小时。然而其十一吨半装甲与重型武器库对如此尺寸的机甲都堪称出色，使重装步兵成为一台凭借优势火力就能从大多数困境中杀出重围的坚固机器。内天体找回赫尔姆记忆核心后，龙骑兵改装了 HOP-4D 重装步兵，装备一门令人印象深刻的迈德龙 Excel LB-X 自动炮/10，可发射标准弹或集束弹——后者类似霰弹枪的散射，只是机甲级别。作为次要武器，重装步兵携带一具柯南/5 LRM-5 发射器，同样能迫使敌人远距离交战。

Original: Developed after the Battle of Luthien, the Hoplite C is a variant exclusively used by the Wolf's Dragoons that uses all Clan technology. Clad in 10 tons of Ferro-Fibrous and fitted with double heat sinks, the 'Mech carries as its primary weapon an Ultra Autocannon/10. This is supported for long-range engagements by an LRM-15 launcher and for close range combat the 'Mech carries two Medium Pulse Lasers and an ER Medium Laser.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hoplite_HOP-C.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed after the Battle of Luthien, the Hoplite C is a variant exclusively used by the Wolf's Dragoons that uses all Clan technology. Clad in 10 tons of Ferro-Fibrous and fitted with double heat sinks, the 'Mech carries as its primary weapon an Ultra Autocannon/10. This is supported for long-range engagements by an LRM-15 launcher and for close range combat the 'Mech carries two Medium Pulse Lasers and an ER Medium Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重装步兵 C 在卢西恩战役后开发，是狼之龙骑兵独家使用的变体，全部采用氏族科技。它披挂 10 吨铁纤维装甲并配双倍散热器，主武器为一门超速自动炮/10。远程交战由一具 LRM-15 发射器支援，近战则有两门中型脉冲激光和一门 ER 中型激光。

Original: The Hornet debuted in 2760 as an urban recon 'Mech, but lack of interest forced the design to be shelved two years later. In 2990, Kallon Industriesrediscovered the blueprints and resumed production. The upgraded HNT-171 started production in 3051. The production line was destroyed by the Capellans in 3069. The 'Mech is designed around the concept of being able to swiftly move through an urban environment with relatively heavy armor. Overall, because of its eclectic mix of weapons and relatively slow speed, the Hornet is only somewhat effective when inside of a city. When caught outside an urban environment the 'Mech is hard pressed to defend itself.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hornet_HNT-151.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hornet debuted in 2760 as an urban recon 'Mech, but lack of interest forced the design to be shelved two years later. In 2990, Kallon Industriesrediscovered the blueprints and resumed production. The upgraded HNT-171 started production in 3051. The production line was destroyed by the Capellans in 3069. The 'Mech is designed around the concept of being able to swiftly move through an urban environment with relatively heavy armor. Overall, because of its eclectic mix of weapons and relatively slow speed, the Hornet is only somewhat effective when inside of a city. When caught outside an urban environment the 'Mech is hard pressed to defend itself.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 大黄蜂于 2760 年作为城市侦察机甲首次亮相，但因缺乏兴趣，两年后该设计被搁置。2990 年，卡隆工业重新发现了图纸并恢复生产。升级版 HNT-171 于 3051 年开始生产。生产线于 3069 年被卡佩兰人摧毁。此机甲的设计理念是能以相对厚重的装甲在城市环境中快速机动。总体而言，由于武器配置杂糅且速度相对缓慢，大黄蜂仅在城内表现尚可。一旦身陷城外环境，它便难以自保。

Original: The Hunchback 1G is a primitive refit trying to retain the 4G's impressive firepower by replacing the weapons with a Medium and Heavy Rifle inplace of the AC/20.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hunchback_HBK-1G.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hunchback 1G is a primitive refit trying to retain the 4G's impressive firepower by replacing the weapons with a Medium and Heavy Rifle inplace of the AC/20.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 驼背 1G 是原始改装型，试图以一门中型和一门重型步枪取代 AC/20，从而保留 4G 令人印象深刻的火力。

Original: The Hunchback 4G is a tried and tested juggernaut on the field. One of the lightest 'Mechs to mount such a massive Autocannon, it is capable of destroying some lighter units in a single volley. It tends to mount heavy armor to boot.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hunchback_HBK-4G.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hunchback 4G is a tried and tested juggernaut on the field. One of the lightest 'Mechs to mount such a massive Autocannon, it is capable of destroying some lighter units in a single volley. It tends to mount heavy armor to boot.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 驼背 4G 是战场上久经考验的巨兽。它是最轻的、装备如此巨型自动炮的机甲之一，能一轮齐射摧毁一些较轻单位。它还倾向于配备厚重装甲。

Original: During the War of 3039, the 9th Ghost regiment was engaged by the Screaming Eagles mercenary company during the Elidere IV campaign, when they decided to modify two of their Hunchbacks to carry prototype Gauss Rifles. Thus, the HBK-4GG was born, able to cause tremendous damage at ranges beyond anyone's expectations.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hunchback_HBK-4GG.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: During the War of 3039, the 9th Ghost regiment was engaged by the Screaming Eagles mercenary company during the Elidere IV campaign, when they decided to modify two of their Hunchbacks to carry prototype Gauss Rifles. Thus, the HBK-4GG was born, able to cause tremendous damage at ranges beyond anyone's expectations.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3039 年战争中，第 9 幽灵团在埃利代尔 IV 战役期间与"尖叫之鹰"佣兵团交战，当时他们决定改装两台驼背以搭载原型高斯步枪。HBK-4GG 由此诞生，能在超出所有人预期的距离上造成巨大伤害。

Original: A 'Swayback' variant, the 4H replaces the AC20 with the lighter AC10 and two Medium Lasers.  While this reduces its overall raw firepower, it gives the Hunchback some much needed ranged capabilities.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hunchback_HBK-4H.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A 'Swayback' variant, the 4H replaces the AC20 with the lighter AC10 and two Medium Lasers.  While this reduces its overall raw firepower, it gives the Hunchback some much needed ranged capabilities.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为"摇摆背"变体，4H 以更轻的 AC10 和两门中型激光取代 AC20。虽然这降低了整体原始火力，却赋予驼背急需的远程能力。

Original: Modified to aid with indirect fire support as well as being able to act as a guardian for fire support lances, the HBK-4J succeeds at both roles.  With its twin LRM-10s it can contribute to the barrage, witlst its five Medium Lasers allow it to fend off the Light 'Mechs that tend to harass fire support teams.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hunchback_HBK-4J.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Modified to aid with indirect fire support as well as being able to act as a guardian for fire support lances, the HBK-4J succeeds at both roles.  With its twin LRM-10s it can contribute to the barrage, witlst its five Medium Lasers allow it to fend off the Light 'Mechs that tend to harass fire support teams.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: HBK-4J 经改装既能协助间接火力支援，又能充当火力支援小队的护卫，两个角色都胜任。凭借双联 LRM-10 它能加入弹幕，而五门中型激光使它能击退惯于骚扰火力支援组的轻型机甲。

Original: Another Swayback 'Mech, this variant was first employed in 2856, and changed the Hunchback's focus from short range combat to fire support by removing the AC/20 and replacing it with an LRM-20 launcher.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hunchback_HBK-4Jb.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another Swayback 'Mech, this variant was first employed in 2856, and changed the Hunchback's focus from short range combat to fire support by removing the AC/20 and replacing it with an LRM-20 launcher.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又是一款"驼背佬"机甲，此变体于 2856 年首次使用，它移除 AC/20 代之以一具 LRM-20 发射器，把驼背的重心从近战转向火力支援。

Original: A Kurita Refit of the Swayback J Hunchback that replaces the LRM with a MRM40 and vastly upgrades the chassis.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hunchback_HBK-4K.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Kurita Refit of the Swayback J Hunchback that replaces the LRM with a MRM40 and vastly upgrades the chassis.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是库瑞塔对"驼背佬 J"驼背的改装，把 LRM 换成 MRM40，并大幅升级底盘。

Original: Combining elements of the 4H and 4J 'Swaybacks', the HBK-4N uses an AC5 and two LRM-5s to give it range, while the four Medium Lasers give it punch up close.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hunchback_HBK-4N.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Combining elements of the 4H and 4J 'Swaybacks', the HBK-4N uses an AC5 and two LRM-5s to give it range, while the four Medium Lasers give it punch up close.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: HBK-4N 融合了 4H 与 4J"驼背佬"的元素，用一门 AC5 和两具 LRM-5 提供射程，四门中型激光则负责近身打击。

Original: The 4P version of the Hunchback trades the singular impact of a massive Autocannon for a frightening array of lighter Energy weaponry that is actually capable of dealing more damage overall. This all comes at the cost of greatly increased heat buildup, of course.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hunchback_HBK-4P.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 4P version of the Hunchback trades the singular impact of a massive Autocannon for a frightening array of lighter Energy weaponry that is actually capable of dealing more damage overall. This all comes at the cost of greatly increased heat buildup, of course.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 驼背 4P 版本以一批令人生畏的轻型能量武器取代巨型自动炮的单点冲击，实际上整体伤害更高。当然，代价是热量积累大幅增加。

Original: TThe 4SP variant of the Hunchback replaces the Autocannon with two SRM6 launchers. This has the potential of doing more damage than the standard model, though the damage is more spread out.  This firepower is supplemented by two Medium Lasers in each arm.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hunchback_HBK-4SP.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: TThe 4SP variant of the Hunchback replaces the Autocannon with two SRM6 launchers. This has the potential of doing more damage than the standard model, though the damage is more spread out.  This firepower is supplemented by two Medium Lasers in each arm.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 驼背 4SP 变体以两具 SRM6 发射器取代自动炮。这有可能造成比标准型号更多的伤害，虽然伤害更分散。这一火力由每臂两门中型激光补充。

Original: Originally a refit line converted to full production, the -5S is a complete overhaul of the Hunchback design developed by Norse-Storm BattleMechs in 3058. The structure has been modified to use Endo Steel construction techniques, the engine has been upgraded to a Light Fusion Engine, and four Jump Jets were added for increased mobility. The 'Mech carries, as its primary weapon, an LB-X Autocannon/20 with CASE-protected ammunition supported by two medium pulse lasers and a single small laser.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hunchback_HBK-5S.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally a refit line converted to full production, the -5S is a complete overhaul of the Hunchback design developed by Norse-Storm BattleMechs in 3058. The structure has been modified to use Endo Steel construction techniques, the engine has been upgraded to a Light Fusion Engine, and four Jump Jets were added for increased mobility. The 'Mech carries, as its primary weapon, an LB-X Autocannon/20 with CASE-protected ammunition supported by two medium pulse lasers and a single small laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -5S 最初是一条改装线，后转为全面量产，是诺斯-风暴战斗机甲公司于 3058 年开发的驼背设计全面翻新。结构已改用内骨骼建造技术，引擎升级为轻型聚变引擎，并加装四个跳跃推进器以提升机动性。机甲的主武器为一门 LB-X 自动炮/20，弹药由 C.A.S.E. 保护，辅以两门中型脉冲激光和一门小型激光。

Original: The Hunchback IIC is a ClanTech refit of the venerable Hunchback. Its meager armor, coupled with paltry ammunition and lack of long-range weapons, led Inner Sphere observers to conclude that this 'Mech was a last-ditch effort for failed warriors to die with glory. In truth, the assignment of a Hunchback IIC was essentially a death sentence. Warriors given this machine were not expected to survive their next battle.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hunchback_HBK-IIC-2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hunchback IIC is a ClanTech refit of the venerable Hunchback. Its meager armor, coupled with paltry ammunition and lack of long-range weapons, led Inner Sphere observers to conclude that this 'Mech was a last-ditch effort for failed warriors to die with glory. In truth, the assignment of a Hunchback IIC was essentially a death sentence. Warriors given this machine were not expected to survive their next battle.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 驼背 IIC 是古老的驼背的氏族科技改装版。它可怜的装甲，加上稀少的弹药和缺乏远程武器，让内天体观察家断定这款机甲是失败战士求取荣耀战死的最后一搏。事实上，被分配驼背 IIC 基本等于死刑。获得此机的战士不被指望能活过下一场战斗。

Original: The Hunchback IIC is a ClanTech refit of the venerable Hunchback. Its meager armor, coupled with paltry ammunition and lack of long-range weapons, led Inner Sphere observers to conclude that this 'Mech was a last-ditch effort for failed warriors to die with glory. In truth, the assignment of a Hunchback IIC was essentially a death sentence. Warriors given this machine were not expected to survive their next battle.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hunchback_HBK-IIC.Details
