Original: Useful at all ranges, the first alternate configuration uses an LRM-10 and an LB-X Autocannon/2 at long range. A pair of Large Pulse Lasers are accurate at all ranges, though they necessitated the addition of two double heat sinks.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_huntsman_HMN-A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Useful at all ranges, the first alternate configuration uses an LRM-10 and an LB-X Autocannon/2 at long range. A pair of Large Pulse Lasers are accurate at all ranges, though they necessitated the addition of two double heat sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 首个备用配置在各类距离上都有用：远程使用一具 LRM-10 和一门 LB-X 自动炮/2。两门大型脉冲激光在各距离都精准，但为此必须加装两台双倍散热器。

Original: The Huntsman B uses an ER PPC at long range. Close in, it can call upon an LB-X Autocannon/10 and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers. Two Machine Guns can make short work of unarmored infantry.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_huntsman_HMN-B.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Huntsman B uses an ER PPC at long range. Close in, it can call upon an LB-X Autocannon/10 and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers. Two Machine Guns can make short work of unarmored infantry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎人 B 在远距离使用一门 ER PPC。近距离可依靠一门 LB-X 自动炮/10 和两门中型脉冲激光。两挺机枪能轻松对付无装甲步兵。

Original: This long-range support variant uses an LRM-20, LRM-15, and an Ultra Autocannon/5 for most of its work. An ER Medium Laser, ER Small Laser, and Streak SRM-4 handle units that get in close. A Flamer provides defense against infantry and combat vehicles.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_huntsman_HMN-C.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This long-range support variant uses an LRM-20, LRM-15, and an Ultra Autocannon/5 for most of its work. An ER Medium Laser, ER Small Laser, and Streak SRM-4 handle units that get in close. A Flamer provides defense against infantry and combat vehicles.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此远程支援变体主要使用一具 LRM-20、一具 LRM-15 和一门超速自动炮/5。一门 ER 中型激光、一门 ER 小型激光和一具连续 SRM-4 负责对付逼近的单位。一具火焰喷射器提供对步兵与战斗车辆的防御。

Original: The primary configuration of the Huntsman sports a myriad of weapons. An Ultra Autocannon/2 and Artemis IV-linked LRM-10 provide long-range capability, while four ER Medium Lasers and a Streak SRM-6 make it a vicious close range 'Mech. A pair of Anti-Personnel Pods and a Flamer protect it from conventional infantry, and an Anti-Missile System provides it with some defense against incoming missiles. An Active Probe finds hidden units, and a TAG spotting laser can designate targets for homing artillery strikes.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_huntsman_HMN-PRIME.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary configuration of the Huntsman sports a myriad of weapons. An Ultra Autocannon/2 and Artemis IV-linked LRM-10 provide long-range capability, while four ER Medium Lasers and a Streak SRM-6 make it a vicious close range 'Mech. A pair of Anti-Personnel Pods and a Flamer protect it from conventional infantry, and an Anti-Missile System provides it with some defense against incoming missiles. An Active Probe finds hidden units, and a TAG spotting laser can designate targets for homing artillery strikes.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎人的主配置武器种类繁多。一门超速自动炮/2 和 Artemis IV 联接的 LRM-10 提供远程能力，而四门 ER 中型激光和一具连续 SRM-6 使它成为凶悍的近战机甲。一对反人员荚舱和一具火焰喷射器保护它免受常规步兵攻击，反导系统则为它提供对来袭导弹的防御。主动探测器可发现隐藏单位，TAG 指示激光能为制导炮击标记目标。

Original: The primary weapon that the Huron Warrior carries is a Grizzard Gauss Rifle (Modified 210 Version) that is capable of stripping off a ton of armor with each shot at extremely long ranges. The Gauss Rifle is backed up by a Martell ER Large Laser that provides good supplemental firepower at long ranges. Finally, it is armed with a Martell Medium Pulse Laser, which gives the Huron Warrior the ability to protect itself at short ranges.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_huronw_HUR-WO-R4L.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary weapon that the Huron Warrior carries is a Grizzard Gauss Rifle (Modified 210 Version) that is capable of stripping off a ton of armor with each shot at extremely long ranges. The Gauss Rifle is backed up by a Martell ER Large Laser that provides good supplemental firepower at long ranges. Finally, it is armed with a Martell Medium Pulse Laser, which gives the Huron Warrior the ability to protect itself at short ranges.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 休伦战士的主要武器是一门格里扎德高斯步枪（210 改进版），能在极远距离一枪削掉一吨装甲。高斯步枪辅以一门马特尔 ER 大型激光，在远距离提供良好的补充火力。最后它还装备一门马特尔中型脉冲激光，使休伦战士具备近距离自保能力。

Original: The Icarus II was the first homegrown BattleMech design to be mass-produced by the Free Worlds League. It was originally designed as a speedy striker to compliment the Mackie and combat vehicles with a similar speed profile.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_icarusii_ICR-1S.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Icarus II was the first homegrown BattleMech design to be mass-produced by the Free Worlds League. It was originally designed as a speedy striker to compliment the Mackie and combat vehicles with a similar speed profile.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 伊卡洛斯 II 是自由世界联盟首个量产的自主战斗机甲设计。它最初被设计为一款高速突击机甲，以配合麦基和速度相近的战斗车辆。

Original: The A configuration carries a single LB-X Autocannon/2 for its excellent long range sniping capabilities. This is backed up by two ER Medium Lasers for close combat capabilities and a single Anti-Missile System for added defense against missile weapons.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_iceferret_IFR-A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The A configuration carries a single LB-X Autocannon/2 for its excellent long range sniping capabilities. This is backed up by two ER Medium Lasers for close combat capabilities and a single Anti-Missile System for added defense against missile weapons.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: A 配置携带一门 LB-X 自动炮/2，具备出色的远程狙击能力。它辅以两门 ER 中型激光提供近战能力，以及一套反导系统增加对导弹武器的防御。

Original: The Ice Ferret B has an ER Large Laser as its only long-range weapon. For close combat, the B configuration carries an SRM-4 and an SRM-6 launcher as well as a highly accurate Small Pulse Laser.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_iceferret_IFR-B.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Ice Ferret B has an ER Large Laser as its only long-range weapon. For close combat, the B configuration carries an SRM-4 and an SRM-6 launcher as well as a highly accurate Small Pulse Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 冰貂 B 只有一门 ER 大型激光作为远程武器。近战方面，B 配置携带一具 SRM-4 和一具 SRM-6 发射器，以及一门极为精准的小型脉冲激光。

Original: A fire support configuration of the Ice Ferret, the C configuration has a trio of LRM-5 launchers, each linked to an Artemis IV fire control system for increased missile accuracy. For close range defense, the 'Mech has a single ER Small Laser.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_iceferret_IFR-C.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A fire support configuration of the Ice Ferret, the C configuration has a trio of LRM-5 launchers, each linked to an Artemis IV fire control system for increased missile accuracy. For close range defense, the 'Mech has a single ER Small Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 冰貂 C 是冰貂的火力支援配置，装备三具 LRM-5 发射器，每具联接一套 Artemis IV 火控系统以提升导弹精度。近程防御方面，机甲有一门 ER 小型激光。

Original: In its primary configuration, the Ice Ferret is capable of acting in a variety of roles. The Ice Ferret carries an Active Probe allowing the 'Mech to detect hidden enemy units. For close combat, the Ice Ferret prime has a Streak SRM-2 launcher and an ER Small Laser. For long range engagements, the 'Mech is armed with a single ER PPC, giving it excellent long range hitting power for its size.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_iceferret_IFR-PRIME.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In its primary configuration, the Ice Ferret is capable of acting in a variety of roles. The Ice Ferret carries an Active Probe allowing the 'Mech to detect hidden enemy units. For close combat, the Ice Ferret prime has a Streak SRM-2 launcher and an ER Small Laser. For long range engagements, the 'Mech is armed with a single ER PPC, giving it excellent long range hitting power for its size.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主配置中，冰貂能胜任多种角色。它携带主动探测器，可侦测隐藏的敌方单位。近战方面，冰貂主型号有一具连续 SRM-2 发射器和一门 ER 小型激光。远程交战时，机甲装备一门 ER PPC，就其尺寸而言拥有出色的远程打击力。

Original: A second line mech designed for settling clan duels, the laser armed Incubus has found considerable success with Clan Hell's Horses'49th Battlemech Cluster as a protomech hunter.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_incubus_1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A second line mech designed for settling clan duels, the laser armed Incubus has found considerable success with Clan Hell's Horses'49th Battlemech Cluster as a protomech hunter.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一款为氏族决斗而设计的二线机甲，以激光武装的梦魔在鬼马氏族第 49 战斗机甲集群中作为原型机甲猎手取得了相当大的成功。

Original: The Initiate started production after the Word of Blake retook Terra. This medium 'Mech has been produced in record numbers by the Word of Blake with no shortage of pilots. It is built on a Geometric 1000 Endo Steel chassis to save weight and is powered by a LTV 160 fusion engine that gives it a top speed of 64.8 km/h. For protection from enemy fire, the Initiate carries eight and a half tons of armor that allows the 'Mech to stand up to fire from most other 'Mechs of the same weight class or lower, and enjoys increased durability because of its CASE system that protects against ammunition explosions. Overall, the Initiate is a reliable trooper 'Mech that is capable of filling a variety of roles on the modern battlefield.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_initiate_INI-02.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Initiate started production after the Word of Blake retook Terra. This medium 'Mech has been produced in record numbers by the Word of Blake with no shortage of pilots. It is built on a Geometric 1000 Endo Steel chassis to save weight and is powered by a LTV 160 fusion engine that gives it a top speed of 64.8 km/h. For protection from enemy fire, the Initiate carries eight and a half tons of armor that allows the 'Mech to stand up to fire from most other 'Mechs of the same weight class or lower, and enjoys increased durability because of its CASE system that protects against ammunition explosions. Overall, the Initiate is a reliable trooper 'Mech that is capable of filling a variety of roles on the modern battlefield.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 启蒙者在布雷克之言重夺泰拉后开始生产。这款中型机甲被布雷克之言以创纪录的数量生产，飞行员从不短缺。它基于"几何 1000"内骨骼底盘建造以减重，由 LTV 160 聚变引擎驱动，最高速度 64.8 公里/小时。为抵御敌方火力，启蒙者携带八吨半装甲，使机甲能承受同重量级或更低级别大多数机甲的射击，并因其 C.A.S.E. 系统防护弹药爆炸而拥有更高耐久度。总体而言，启蒙者是一台可靠的通用机甲，能在现代战场上胜任多种角色。

Original: The JagerMech A model attempts to provide an indirect-fire support platform that can dish out damage without ever being seen. It has lower overall focused damage capability, but it usually mounts decent armor.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_jagermech_JM6-A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The JagerMech A model attempts to provide an indirect-fire support platform that can dish out damage without ever being seen. It has lower overall focused damage capability, but it usually mounts decent armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎手机甲 A 型试图提供一款能在大发雷霆却始终不被看见的间接火力支援平台。它的整体集中伤害能力较低，但通常装备可观的装甲。

Original: A recent variant to the JagerMech, the JM6-B removes most of the ammunition dependencies of the original model by swapping out the AutoCannons for Lasers.  To make up for the loss in range, a pair of LRM-15 launchers have been added.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_jagermech_JM6-B.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A recent variant to the JagerMech, the JM6-B removes most of the ammunition dependencies of the original model by swapping out the AutoCannons for Lasers.  To make up for the loss in range, a pair of LRM-15 launchers have been added.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为猎手机甲的新近变体，JM6-B 把自动炮换成激光，从而消除了原型号大部分的弹药依赖。为弥补射程损失，加装了一对 LRM-15 发射器。

Original: The JagerMech S model is highly specialized at long-range Autocannon fire support. It doesn't have much in the way of protection or closer-range weapons, though, so keep it distant and out of harm's way.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_jagermech_JM6-S.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The JagerMech S model is highly specialized at long-range Autocannon fire support. It doesn't have much in the way of protection or closer-range weapons, though, so keep it distant and out of harm's way.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎手机甲 S 型号高度专精于远程自动炮火力支援。它的防护与近程武器都不多，所以让它保持距离、远离危险。

Original: The JagerMech X model mounts unusually thick Armor alongside 2 LBX5
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_jagermech_JM6-X.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The JagerMech X model mounts unusually thick Armor alongside 2 LBX5
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎手机甲 X 型装备异常厚重的装甲以及 2 门 LBX5

Original: The Jenner R was downgraded to accommodate a lack of replacement parts, carrying 2 SRM6, 2 Rocket Launchers and 2 Medium laser.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_jenner_JR1-R.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Jenner R was downgraded to accommodate a lack of replacement parts, carrying 2 SRM6, 2 Rocket Launchers and 2 Medium laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 詹纳 R 因缺乏替换部件而降级，携带 2 具 SRM6、2 具火箭发射器和 2 门中型激光。

Original: The original Jenner model mounted a Large Laser with a pair of Medium Lasers in a torso mounted turret.  While it was a solid fast moving 'Mech, its Argra 27C Medium Lasers suffered from a targetting defect.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_jenner_JR7-A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Jenner model mounted a Large Laser with a pair of Medium Lasers in a torso mounted turret.  While it was a solid fast moving 'Mech, its Argra 27C Medium Lasers suffered from a targetting defect.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 原版詹纳型号在躯干炮塔中装有一门大型激光和一对中型激光。虽然它是一台扎实的高速机甲，其"阿尔格拉 27C"中型激光却存在瞄准缺陷。

Original: The JR7-C was a basic upgrade of the JR7-K, removing one of the Medium Lasers and replacing it with a C3 Slave Unit. Combined with its speed this made the Jenner an ideal spotter for a C3 company.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_jenner_JR7-C.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The JR7-C was a basic upgrade of the JR7-K, removing one of the Medium Lasers and replacing it with a C3 Slave Unit. Combined with its speed this made the Jenner an ideal spotter for a C3 company.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: JR7-C 是 JR7-K 的基础升级，移除其中一门中型激光，换成一台 C3 从属单元。结合其速度，这使詹纳成为 C3 连的理想目标指示者。

Original: Jenner Ds run hot, and they run fast but can quickly bound into combat to deliver a knockout punch, even against heavier units. Their capability with speed and weaponry tends to come at the expense of lower armor capacity, though.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_jenner_JR7-D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Jenner Ds run hot, and they run fast but can quickly bound into combat to deliver a knockout punch, even against heavier units. Their capability with speed and weaponry tends to come at the expense of lower armor capacity, though.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 詹纳 D 散热偏热、跑得很快，能迅速跃入战斗打出致命一击，即使对更重的单位也是如此。不过它在速度与武器上的本事，往往是以较低装甲容量为代价的。

Original: The Jenner F drops the SRM in favor of increasing armor across the entire 'Mech, producing a more durable striker.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_jenner_JR7-F.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Jenner F drops the SRM in favor of increasing armor across the entire 'Mech, producing a more durable striker.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 詹纳 F 舍弃 SRM，转而增强整台机甲的装甲，造就了一款更耐久的突击手。

Original: The Jenner was first fielded in September 2784, the same year the Exodus fleet that would eventually become the Clans left the Inner Sphere in November. How exactly they acquired this design in that short timeframe is not known, but what is known is that the Clan version fields Clan weaponry.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_jenner_JR7-IIC-3.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Jenner was first fielded in September 2784, the same year the Exodus fleet that would eventually become the Clans left the Inner Sphere in November. How exactly they acquired this design in that short timeframe is not known, but what is known is that the Clan version fields Clan weaponry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 詹纳首次投入战场是在 2784 年 9 月，同年 11 月，最终演变为氏族的出埃及舰队离开了内天体。他们如何在如此短的时间内获得该设计不得而知，但已知氏族版本装备的是氏族武器。

Original: The Jenner was first fielded in September 2784, the same year the Exodus fleet that would eventually become the Clans left the Inner Sphere in November. How exactly they acquired this design in that short timeframe is not known, but what is known is that the Clan version fields Clan weaponry.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_jenner_JR7-IIC.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Jenner was first fielded in September 2784, the same year the Exodus fleet that would eventually become the Clans left the Inner Sphere in November. How exactly they acquired this design in that short timeframe is not known, but what is known is that the Clan version fields Clan weaponry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 詹纳首次投入战场是在 2784 年 9 月，同年 11 月，最终演变为氏族的出埃及舰队离开了内天体。他们如何在如此短的时间内获得该设计不得而知，但已知氏族版本装备的是氏族武器。

Original: The JR7-K adds a higher degree of survivability to the Jenner by upgrading the armor to Ferro-Fibrous, while removing a half ton of the armor. This provides virtually the same armor protection while allowing space for CASE to protect the SRM-4 ammunition.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_jenner_JR7-K.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The JR7-K adds a higher degree of survivability to the Jenner by upgrading the armor to Ferro-Fibrous, while removing a half ton of the armor. This provides virtually the same armor protection while allowing space for CASE to protect the SRM-4 ammunition.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: JR7-K 通过把装甲升级为铁纤维并削减半吨装甲，为詹纳提升了生存性。这提供了几乎相同的装甲防护，同时腾出空间加装 C.A.S.E. 以保护 SRM-4 弹药。

Original: A lumbering mountain of armor and weaponry, Solaris Arms' massive assault 'Mech definitely lives up to the name of Juggernaut in the Solaris Games. While not a flashy design, Solaris Arms kept up steady production of the design since the early 3050s. Sixteen and half tons of Valiant Chainmail armor protect a GM 270 Fusion Engine, propelling the 'Mech at fairly standard assault 'Mech speed of 54 kph.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_juggernaut_JG-R9T1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A lumbering mountain of armor and weaponry, Solaris Arms' massive assault 'Mech definitely lives up to the name of Juggernaut in the Solaris Games. While not a flashy design, Solaris Arms kept up steady production of the design since the early 3050s. Sixteen and half tons of Valiant Chainmail armor protect a GM 270 Fusion Engine, propelling the 'Mech at fairly standard assault 'Mech speed of 54 kph.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一座笨重的装甲与武器之山，索拉里斯兵工厂的巨型突击机甲在索拉里斯竞技场上绝对配得上"主宰者"之名。虽然设计并不炫目，索拉里斯兵工厂自 3050 年代初以来一直稳定生产该设计。十六吨半的"勇武锁子甲"装甲保护着一台 GM 270 聚变引擎，推动机甲以相当标准的突击机甲速度——54 公里/小时——行进。

Original: The Juggernaut's main armament is a trio of Large X-Pulse Lasers, one in each arm with one in its center torso, backed up by three Sutel Precision Line Medium X-Pulse Lasers divided between each arm and the head. Due to the 'Mech's lack of hand actuators, at knife-fighting range the Juggernaut is protected by a staggering twelve Machine Guns fed from two tons of reloads.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_juggernaut_JG-R9T2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Juggernaut's main armament is a trio of Large X-Pulse Lasers, one in each arm with one in its center torso, backed up by three Sutel Precision Line Medium X-Pulse Lasers divided between each arm and the head. Due to the 'Mech's lack of hand actuators, at knife-fighting range the Juggernaut is protected by a staggering twelve Machine Guns fed from two tons of reloads.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重装的主要武装是三门大型 X 脉冲激光，每臂各一，中央躯干一门，辅以三门苏特尔精准线中型 X 脉冲激光，分列每臂与头部。由于机甲没有手部驱动器，在贴身距离上重装靠十二挺机枪（由两吨再装填供弹）提供惊人的防护。

Original: Developed by Diplan mechyards as an easy to repair, scout and ambusher. This mech can deliver a nasty punch, before having to withdraw.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_kabuto_KBO-7A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed by Diplan mechyards as an easy to repair, scout and ambusher. This mech can deliver a nasty punch, before having to withdraw.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由迪普兰机甲船坞开发，作为一款易于修理的侦察与伏击机甲。这台机甲能打出凶狠一击，然后不得不撤离。

Original: An upgrade of the base model. This mech is sold only to the DCMS and fills the ranks of a number of elite units.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_kabuto_KBO-7A1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade of the base model. This mech is sold only to the DCMS and fills the ranks of a number of elite units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 基础型号的升级版。此机甲仅售予 DCMS，充实了若干精锐单位的编制。

Original: The Kanazuchi, Japanese for 'hammer', is a Draconis Combine battle armor design, one of the heaviest to come from that realm.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_Kanazuchi.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Kanazuchi, Japanese for 'hammer', is a Draconis Combine battle armor design, one of the heaviest to come from that realm.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 金锤（日语"锤子"）是德拉科尼斯联合体的战斗装甲设计，是该势力出品中最重的一种。

Original: The King Crab KGC-0 is a badly maintained primitive version of one of the most heavily armed and armored 'Mechs ever constructed. While carrying lesser weaponry is its arsenal still able to deliver a crushing Blow.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_kingcrab_KGC-0.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The King Crab KGC-0 is a badly maintained primitive version of one of the most heavily armed and armored 'Mechs ever constructed. While carrying lesser weaponry is its arsenal still able to deliver a crushing Blow.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 帝王蟹 KGC-0 是维护不良的原始版本，属史上武装与装甲最厚重的机甲之一。虽然武器较弱，其火力库仍能造成毁灭性打击。

Original: One of the most heavily armed and armored 'Mechs ever constructed, the King Crab 0000 is capable of massive burst damage. A pair of heavy, close-range Autocannons form its primary weaponry, backed up by ranged weaponry to fire as it closes distance.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_kingcrab_KGC-0000.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the most heavily armed and armored 'Mechs ever constructed, the King Crab 0000 is capable of massive burst damage. A pair of heavy, close-range Autocannons form its primary weaponry, backed up by ranged weaponry to fire as it closes distance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 帝王蟹 0000 是史上武装与装甲最厚重的机甲之一，能造成巨大的爆发伤害。一对重型近程自动炮构成其主要武器，辅以远程武器在接近过程中开火。

Original: One of the so-called Clanbuster variants developed in 3052 during the lead-up to the Battle of Tukayyid, ComStar's techs replaced the twin autocannons with two M-7 Gauss Rifles and four tons of ammo in the arms, trading a minor reduction in destructive capacity for greatly increased range. While retaining the LRM launcher the large laser was upgraded to a Tronel XIII Large Pulse Laser and two Hovertec Streak SRM-2s, split between the side torsos with a single ton of reloads each, were added. These changes were accomplished by using an extralight engine in place of the standard model.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_kingcrab_KGC-0001.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the so-called Clanbuster variants developed in 3052 during the lead-up to the Battle of Tukayyid, ComStar's techs replaced the twin autocannons with two M-7 Gauss Rifles and four tons of ammo in the arms, trading a minor reduction in destructive capacity for greatly increased range. While retaining the LRM launcher the large laser was upgraded to a Tronel XIII Large Pulse Laser and two Hovertec Streak SRM-2s, split between the side torsos with a single ton of reloads each, were added. These changes were accomplished by using an extralight engine in place of the standard model.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是 3052 年图卡伊德战役前夕开发的所谓"破氏族"变体之一。康星技师将双联自动炮换成两门 M-7 高斯步枪，臂部携带四吨弹药，以略微降低的破坏力换取大幅提升的射程。保留 LRM 发射器的同时，大型激光升级为特罗内尔 XIII 大型脉冲激光，并加装两具霍弗泰克连续 SRM-2，分列两侧躯干、各配一吨再装填。这些改动通过以超轻型引擎取代标准引擎实现。

Original: One of the most heavily armed and armored 'Mechs ever constructed, the King Crab 0002 variant mounts twin UAC10 with MRM's.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_kingcrab_KGC-0002.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the most heavily armed and armored 'Mechs ever constructed, the King Crab 0002 variant mounts twin UAC10 with MRM's.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 帝王蟹 0002 变体是史上武装与装甲最厚重的机甲之一，装备双 UAC10 与 MRM。

Original: The King Crab-000b, the Star League's Royal variant, is every bit as powerful as its downgraded cousin, the -0000. Still armed with twin AC/20s, the -000b's double heat sinks and doubled ammo keeps the massive cannons firing far longer and more frequently making the -000b a true terror on the battlefield.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_kingcrab_KGC-000b.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The King Crab-000b, the Star League's Royal variant, is every bit as powerful as its downgraded cousin, the -0000. Still armed with twin AC/20s, the -000b's double heat sinks and doubled ammo keeps the massive cannons firing far longer and more frequently making the -000b a true terror on the battlefield.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 帝王蟹-000b 是星盟的皇家变体，威力丝毫不逊于其降级版表亲-0000。它仍装备双 AC/20，其双倍散热器与双倍弹药让这对巨炮能更持久、更频繁地开火，使-000b 成为战场上真正的恐怖。

Original: This version of the King Crab was created by the Star League to be a command 'Mech and introduced alongside the original 000 model in 2743. Conceived in secret between Cosara and the Terran Hegemony, it was an attempt to produce a deadly command 'Mech by mounting a pair of newly-developed Hellstar Magna PPCs in either side torso backed by bya pair of SRM-6's. A pair of newly developed LBX/10's replaced the standard autocannon. The 010 model was more than capable of taking down an Atlas, but the entire line left with Kerensky during the Exodus and even knowledge of the design's existence became lost during the Succession Wars.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_kingcrab_KGC-010.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This version of the King Crab was created by the Star League to be a command 'Mech and introduced alongside the original 000 model in 2743. Conceived in secret between Cosara and the Terran Hegemony, it was an attempt to produce a deadly command 'Mech by mounting a pair of newly-developed Hellstar Magna PPCs in either side torso backed by bya pair of SRM-6's. A pair of newly developed LBX/10's replaced the standard autocannon. The 010 model was more than capable of taking down an Atlas, but the entire line left with Kerensky during the Exodus and even knowledge of the design's existence became lost during the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此版帝王蟹由星盟打造为指挥机甲，与原始 000 型于 2743 年一同推出。它由科萨拉与地球霸权秘密构想，试图通过在两肋各装一对新研制的"地狱星"大型 PPC 并辅以两具 SRM-6，打造一款致命的指挥机甲。一对新研制的 LBX/10 取代了标准自动炮。010 型完全有能力击杀一台阿特拉斯，但整条生产线随克伦斯基一同出走，连该设计存在的知识也在继承战争中失传。

Original: The Kintaro 18 is… a beast of a machine. It's fast for its size, mounts heavy armor, and can literally shred most other 'Mechs with its almost ridiculous amount of close-range weaponry. But, it runs hotter than Hell's saunas.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_kintaro_KTO-18.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Kintaro 18 is… a beast of a machine. It's fast for its size, mounts heavy armor, and can literally shred most other 'Mechs with its almost ridiculous amount of close-range weaponry. But, it runs hotter than Hell's saunas.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 金太郎 18 是……一台猛兽般的机器。就体型而言它很快，装备厚重装甲，凭其近乎荒谬的近程武器数量，几乎能把大多数其他机甲撕成碎片。不过，它比地狱的桑拿房还热。

Original: The Kintaro 18K is a beast of a machine. Still running hot does this Kurita refit carry a light PPC and Deadfire enhanced launcher for every engagement range.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_kintaro_KTO-18K.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Kintaro 18K is a beast of a machine. Still running hot does this Kurita refit carry a light PPC and Deadfire enhanced launcher for every engagement range.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 金太郎 18K 是一台猛兽般的机器。这款库瑞塔改装型依然散热偏热，为每个交战距离都配备了一门轻型 PPC 和死火增强发射器。

Original: This Marik refit of the Kintaro was built in cooperation with Holly as a testbed for Streak and NARC missiles.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_kintaro_KTO-18S.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Marik refit of the Kintaro was built in cooperation with Holly as a testbed for Streak and NARC missiles.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款马里克对金太郎的改装是与冬青公司合作建造的，用作连续导弹与 NARC 导弹的试验台。

Original: The Kintaro 19 is a beast of a machine. It's fast for its size, mounts heavy armor and can literally shred most other Mechs with its almost ridiculous amount of Narc supported close-range weaponry. However, it runs hotter than Hell's saunas.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_kintaro_KTO-19.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Kintaro 19 is a beast of a machine. It's fast for its size, mounts heavy armor and can literally shred most other Mechs with its almost ridiculous amount of Narc supported close-range weaponry. However, it runs hotter than Hell's saunas.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 金太郎 19 是一台猛兽般的机器。就体型而言它很快，装备厚重装甲，凭其近乎荒谬的、由 NARC 支援的近程武器数量，几乎能把大多数其他机甲撕成碎片。然而，它比地狱的桑拿房还热。

Original: The KTO-19b was an upgrade utilized by the Royal Brigades of the SLDF. It used an XL Engine and Double Heat Sinks to free up space to upgrade the KTO-19's LRM-5 launcher to a larger LRM-15.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_kintaro_KTO-19b.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The KTO-19b was an upgrade utilized by the Royal Brigades of the SLDF. It used an XL Engine and Double Heat Sinks to free up space to upgrade the KTO-19's LRM-5 launcher to a larger LRM-15.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: KTO-19b 是星盟防卫军皇家旅使用的升级型。它使用 XL 引擎和双倍散热器腾出空间，把 KTO-19 的 LRM-5 发射器升级为更大的 LRM-15。

Original: The KTO-20, used to good effect in the War of 3039, was the slightly downgraded version of the KTO-19 given to the Draconis Combine by ComStar as part of Operation Rosebud. The KTO-20 was nearly identical to its Star League era cousin, the only real difference being the loss of the Narc Missile beacon in exchange for a Magna Mk III Large Laser. It was equipped with double heat sinks.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_kintaro_KTO-20.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The KTO-20, used to good effect in the War of 3039, was the slightly downgraded version of the KTO-19 given to the Draconis Combine by ComStar as part of Operation Rosebud. The KTO-20 was nearly identical to its Star League era cousin, the only real difference being the loss of the Narc Missile beacon in exchange for a Magna Mk III Large Laser. It was equipped with double heat sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: KTO-20 在 3039 年战争中发挥了良好作用，是康星作为"玫瑰花蕾"行动一部分交给德拉科尼斯联合体的 KTO-19 的轻度降级版。KTO-20 与其星盟时代的表亲几乎相同，唯一真正的差别是失去了 NARC 导弹信标，换成一门玛格纳 Mk III 大型激光。它装备了双倍散热器。

Original: Developed by both ComStar and the Word of Blake, the KTO-21 was the first 'Mech to utilize both the new Improved Narc Missile Beacon (iNarc for short) and the improved C3 computer system. In order to utilize these new systems, the KTO-21 was refitted with an Endo Steel chassis and carried half a ton less armor than the KTO-19. Retaining only the two SRM launchers, the LRM launcher was dropped and the standard medium lasers were upgraded to more advanced ER Medium Lasers, enhanced by a switch to Double Heat Sinks.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_kintaro_KTO-21.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed by both ComStar and the Word of Blake, the KTO-21 was the first 'Mech to utilize both the new Improved Narc Missile Beacon (iNarc for short) and the improved C3 computer system. In order to utilize these new systems, the KTO-21 was refitted with an Endo Steel chassis and carried half a ton less armor than the KTO-19. Retaining only the two SRM launchers, the LRM launcher was dropped and the standard medium lasers were upgraded to more advanced ER Medium Lasers, enhanced by a switch to Double Heat Sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: KTO-21 由康星与布雷克之言共同开发，是首款同时使用新型改进型 NARC 导弹信标（简称 iNarc）和改进型 C3 计算机系统的机甲。为使用这些新系统，KTO-21 改装了内骨骼底盘，装甲比 KTO-19 少半吨。它只保留两具 SRM 发射器，去掉了 LRM 发射器，标准中型激光升级为更先进的 ER 中型激光，并改用双倍散热器加以强化。

Original: A variant of the Combine's KTO-20, the KTO-C was one of the test bed 'Mechs for the C3 Slave Unit, one of the Medium Lasers being removed in order to free up the necessary weight.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_kintaro_KTO-C.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A variant of the Combine's KTO-20, the KTO-C was one of the test bed 'Mechs for the C3 Slave Unit, one of the Medium Lasers being removed in order to free up the necessary weight.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: KTO-C 是联合体 KTO-20 的变体，是 C3 从属单元的试验台机甲之一，它移除一门中型激光以腾出所需重量。
氏族科技升级的金太郎。

Original: An upgrade to the KTO-C, the KTO-K removed the Large Laser and LRM launcher to upgrade the short-range missiles to Streak SRM-6s. The lasers were upgraded to ER Medium Lasers and a third was added. The most significant difference was the addition of Jump jets to allow the unit to leap up to 150 meters.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_kintaro_KTO-K.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade to the KTO-C, the KTO-K removed the Large Laser and LRM launcher to upgrade the short-range missiles to Streak SRM-6s. The lasers were upgraded to ER Medium Lasers and a third was added. The most significant difference was the addition of Jump jets to allow the unit to leap up to 150 meters.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: KTO-K 是 KTO-C 的升级版，移除大型激光和 LRM 发射器，把短程火箭升级为连续 SRM-6。激光升级为 ER 中型激光，并加装第三门。最显著的区别是加装跳跃推进器，使单位能跃至 150 米。

Original: The A configuration of the Kit Fox uses a Gauss Rifle as its primary long-range weapon. Two ER Medium Lasers provide medium and short-range firepower.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_kitfox_A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The A configuration of the Kit Fox uses a Gauss Rifle as its primary long-range weapon. Two ER Medium Lasers provide medium and short-range firepower.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 小狐 A 配置以一门高斯步枪为主要远程武器。两门 ER 中型激光提供中近程火力。

Original: The B configuration of the Kit Fox boasts a rapid-fire Ultra Autocannon-10 as its primary weapon, startling considering the 'Mech's tonnage. An ER Medium Laser, ER Small Laser, and an SRM-6 rack allow the Kit Fox B to finish off anything that manages to close ranges.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_kitfox_B.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The B configuration of the Kit Fox boasts a rapid-fire Ultra Autocannon-10 as its primary weapon, startling considering the 'Mech's tonnage. An ER Medium Laser, ER Small Laser, and an SRM-6 rack allow the Kit Fox B to finish off anything that manages to close ranges.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 小狐 B 配置以一门速射超速自动炮-10 为主武器，就机甲的吨位而言令人吃惊。一门 ER 中型激光、一门 ER 小型激光和一具 SRM-6 挂架使小狐 B 能干掉任何设法接近的目标。

Original: The Kit Fox D is configured for indirect fire support, mounting dual LRM-15 racks as well as a LRM-5. A Narc Missile Beacon is also carried, which may be exploited by the Kit Fox D itself, as the targeting systems of Clan LRMs lack a minimum range; this literally allows the Kit Fox D to run up to an enemy and mark them for increased accuracy, and then fall back, firing the entire time.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_kitfox_D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Kit Fox D is configured for indirect fire support, mounting dual LRM-15 racks as well as a LRM-5. A Narc Missile Beacon is also carried, which may be exploited by the Kit Fox D itself, as the targeting systems of Clan LRMs lack a minimum range; this literally allows the Kit Fox D to run up to an enemy and mark them for increased accuracy, and then fall back, firing the entire time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 小狐 D 配置为间接火力支援，装备双联 LRM-15 挂架以及一具 LRM-5。它还携带一具 NARC 导弹信标，且此信标可被小狐 D 自己利用——因为氏族 LRM 的瞄准系统没有最小射程，这实际上让小狐 D 能冲到敌人跟前为其标记以提升精度，然后一面后撤一面持续开火。

Original: In its primary configuration, the Kit Fox mounts an ER Large Laser and Small Pulse Laser on the left arm as its primary source of firepower. These are supplemented by an LB 5-X Autocannon for tactical flexibility and a Streak SRM-4 rack for close range combat.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_kitfox_PRIME.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In its primary configuration, the Kit Fox mounts an ER Large Laser and Small Pulse Laser on the left arm as its primary source of firepower. These are supplemented by an LB 5-X Autocannon for tactical flexibility and a Streak SRM-4 rack for close range combat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主配置中，小狐左臂装备一门 ER 大型激光和一门小型脉冲激光作为主要火力。它们由一门 LB 5-X 自动炮（提供战术灵活性）和一具连续 SRM-4 挂架（用于近战）作补充。

Original: The Kit Fox S is a Clan Snow Raven variant based for space combat. The primary weapon is a Large Pulse Laser, while a Medium Pulse Laser and a Small Pulse Laser complement this, with a Streak SRM-4 for additional firepower.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_kitfox_S.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Kit Fox S is a Clan Snow Raven variant based for space combat. The primary weapon is a Large Pulse Laser, while a Medium Pulse Laser and a Small Pulse Laser complement this, with a Streak SRM-4 for additional firepower.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 小狐 S 是雪鸦氏族的太空战变体。主武器为一门大型脉冲激光，辅以一门中型脉冲激光和一门小型脉冲激光，另有一具连续 SRM-4 提供额外火力。

Original: A fast moving assault ’Mech, the Kodiak was originally designed by Clan Ghost Bear as a second-line mech and represents the epitome of Ghost Bear thinking: mostly defensive but capable of surprising speed and a devastating attack when launched.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_kodiak_1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A fast moving assault ’Mech, the Kodiak was originally designed by Clan Ghost Bear as a second-line mech and represents the epitome of Ghost Bear thinking: mostly defensive but capable of surprising speed and a devastating attack when launched.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 科迪亚克是一款高速突击机甲，最初由鬼熊氏族设计为二线机甲，体现了鬼熊思维的精髓：偏重防御，但在发动时能展现出惊人的速度和毁灭性的攻击。

Original: A fast moving assault ’Mech, the Kodiak was originally designed by Clan Ghost Bear as a second-line mech and represents the epitome of Ghost Bear thinking: mostly defensive but capable of surprising speed and a devastating attack when launched.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_kodiak_5.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A fast moving assault ’Mech, the Kodiak was originally designed by Clan Ghost Bear as a second-line mech and represents the epitome of Ghost Bear thinking: mostly defensive but capable of surprising speed and a devastating attack when launched.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 科迪亚克是一款高速突击机甲，最初由鬼熊氏族设计为二线机甲，体现了鬼熊思维的精髓：偏重防御，但在发动时能展现出惊人的速度和毁灭性的攻击。

Original: The Komodo was designed in 3053 to hunt and kill Clan Elemental Battle Armor. The 'Mech is built to be able to catch up to and destroy them with exceptional speed and maneuverability. The 'Mech is powered by a VOX 225 XL Engine that propels the 'Mech to a maximum speed of 86.4 kph. The Komodo can jump up to one hundred and fifty meters allowing it to traverse just about any terrain with ease, and is armored with seven and a half tons of armor. The 'Mech is also equipped with a Matabushi Guardian ECM Suite to defend against any enemy electronic warfare systems and also a Forward-1 TAG allowing the Komodo to designate a target for an Arrow IV artillery strike.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_komodo_KIM-2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Komodo was designed in 3053 to hunt and kill Clan Elemental Battle Armor. The 'Mech is built to be able to catch up to and destroy them with exceptional speed and maneuverability. The 'Mech is powered by a VOX 225 XL Engine that propels the 'Mech to a maximum speed of 86.4 kph. The Komodo can jump up to one hundred and fifty meters allowing it to traverse just about any terrain with ease, and is armored with seven and a half tons of armor. The 'Mech is also equipped with a Matabushi Guardian ECM Suite to defend against any enemy electronic warfare systems and also a Forward-1 TAG allowing the Komodo to designate a target for an Arrow IV artillery strike.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 科莫多于 3053 年设计，专为猎杀氏族元素战斗装甲。机甲能以卓越的速度与机动性追上并消灭它们。它由 VOX 225 XL 引擎驱动，最高速度 86.4 公里/小时。科莫多可跳跃至一百五十米，轻松跨越几乎任何地形，并有七吨半装甲。它还配备马塔布希守护者 ECM 套件以防御敌方电子战系统，以及 Forward-1 TAG 使科莫多能为箭矢 IV 炮击标记目标。

The 'Mech is powered by a VOX 225 XL Engine that propels the 'Mech to a maximum speed of 86.4 kph. Original: Configured similarly to the Timber Wolf Prime, the Linebacker A carries, as its primary long-range weapons, a pair of ER Large Lasers that are backed up by an LRM-5 launcher and LRM-15 launcher, both of which allow the Linebacker to bombard its target at long range. For close combat, the 'Mech carries two ER Medium Lasers.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_linebacker_LBK-A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Configured similarly to the Timber Wolf Prime, the Linebacker A carries, as its primary long-range weapons, a pair of ER Large Lasers that are backed up by an LRM-5 launcher and LRM-15 launcher, both of which allow the Linebacker to bombard its target at long range. For close combat, the 'Mech carries two ER Medium Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 中后卫 A 配置与木材狼主型号相似，其主要远程武器为一对 ER 大型激光，辅以一具 LRM-5 和一具 LRM-15 发射器，使中后卫能在远距离轰击目标。近战方面，机甲携带两门 ER 中型激光。

Original: The Linebacker B is a sniper configuration. The 'Mech carries a powerful Gauss Rifle for fearsome long range hitting power. For close combat, the 'Mech has three ER Medium Lasers and a single ER Small Laser.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_linebacker_LBK-B.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Linebacker B is a sniper configuration. The 'Mech carries a powerful Gauss Rifle for fearsome long range hitting power. For close combat, the 'Mech has three ER Medium Lasers and a single ER Small Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 中后卫 B 是狙击配置。机甲携带一门强劲的高斯步枪，具备可怕的远程打击力。近战方面，它有三门 ER 中型激光和一门 ER 小型激光。

Original: The Linebacker D is a committed close-combat configuration with four highly accurate Streak SRM-6 launchers providing an overwhelming close range missile barrage. The launchers are backed up by two ER Medium Lasers and a rear-mounted ER Small Laser, making this configuration a ferocious short-range brawler - until its three ammunition bins run dry.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_linebacker_LBK-D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Linebacker D is a committed close-combat configuration with four highly accurate Streak SRM-6 launchers providing an overwhelming close range missile barrage. The launchers are backed up by two ER Medium Lasers and a rear-mounted ER Small Laser, making this configuration a ferocious short-range brawler - until its three ammunition bins run dry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 中后卫 D 是一款彻底的近战配置，四具极为精准的连续 SRM-6 发射器提供压倒性的近程导弹弹幕。发射器辅以两门 ER 中型激光和一门后向 ER 小型激光，使此配置成为凶悍的近距离缠斗者——直到三个弹药箱打空为止。

Original: In its primary configuration the Linebacker is configured for long range combat, with two powerful ER PPCs for its primary firepower, as they can reach a target at long range and are each capable of vaporizing almost a full ton of standard armor. These are backed up by an LRM-5 launcher for long range missile bombardment. For close combat, the Linebacker Prime carries a light arsenal of a highly accurate Streak SRM-4 launcher and a rear-mounted ER Small Laser.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_linebacker_LBK-PRIME.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In its primary configuration the Linebacker is configured for long range combat, with two powerful ER PPCs for its primary firepower, as they can reach a target at long range and are each capable of vaporizing almost a full ton of standard armor. These are backed up by an LRM-5 launcher for long range missile bombardment. For close combat, the Linebacker Prime carries a light arsenal of a highly accurate Streak SRM-4 launcher and a rear-mounted ER Small Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主配置中，中后卫为远程战斗而设，以两门强力 ER PPC 为主火力，它们能在远距离触及目标，各自几乎能蒸发整整一吨标准装甲。这两门主炮辅以一具 LRM-5 发射器用于远程导弹轰炸。近战方面，中后卫主型号携带一套轻型武器：一具极为精准的连续 SRM-4 发射器和一门后向 ER 小型激光。

Original: The Lineholder was the first BattleMech design to come from Kressly Warworks. The Lineholder is designed around a set of Common Sense Rules for 'Mech design. This approach has produced a 'Mech with a good ground speed and respectable amount of armor and firepower. The 'Mech has a top speed of 86.4 km/h, allowing it to keep up with all but the fastest light and medium 'Mechs. The Lineholder also carries ten tons of armor protection and has fourteen heat sinks. Its mix of off-the-shelf weapons and equipment makes the Lineholder a reliable 'Mech that is easy to repair and is dependable in battle. However, the ultimate selling point for the Lineholder, especially to its target audience of small units and minor nobles, is value and price. In the first year of sales, the Lineholder was historically successful compared with other 55-ton BattleMechs. For minor factions able to afford brand new BattleMechs, the Lineholder has become the garrison machine of choice.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_lineholder_KW1-LH2.Details

In the first year of sales, the Lineholder was historically successful compared with other 55-ton BattleMechs. For minor factions able to afford brand new BattleMechs, the Lineholder has become the garrison machine of choice.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战线守护者是克雷斯利兵工厂出品的第一款战斗机甲设计。它围绕一套"机甲设计常识规则"构建。这一思路造就了一台地面速度良好、装甲与火力都相当可观的机甲。它最高速度 86.4 公里/小时，除最快的轻中型机甲外都能跟上。战线守护者还携带十吨装甲防护并有十四台散热器。它采用的现货武器与装备组合使其成为易于修理、作战可靠的机甲。然而其终极卖点——尤其对小型单位与末等贵族这类目标客户——是性价比。在销售第一年，战线守护者的业绩与其他 55 吨战斗机甲相比堪称历史性成功。对买得起全新战斗机甲的小势力而言，它已成为驻防机型的首选。
