Original: Since it was the chosen BattleMech of the Great Father, the venerable Orion has always held a special place in the mystique of the Clans. Out of respect for General Kerensky's legacy, all the Clans maintained the design for several decades even as the development of newer and more advanced technologies increasingly left it less effective on the battlefield. Not a radical reworking of the design, as some Clan upgrades are, the Orion IIC replaces much of the innards and weapons of the original, while preserving its mass and aesthetics. This IIC upgrade utilizes an Endo Steel chassis and twelve tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, while also making use of twelve double heat sinks, freeing up weight for heavier weapons loadout. This variant switches the Gauss Rifle to an Ultra Autocannon/5.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_orion_ON1-IIC-A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Since it was the chosen BattleMech of the Great Father, the venerable Orion has always held a special place in the mystique of the Clans. Out of respect for General Kerensky's legacy, all the Clans maintained the design for several decades even as the development of newer and more advanced technologies increasingly left it less effective on the battlefield. Not a radical reworking of the design, as some Clan upgrades are, the Orion IIC replaces much of the innards and weapons of the original, while preserving its mass and aesthetics. This IIC upgrade utilizes an Endo Steel chassis and twelve tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, while also making use of twelve double heat sinks, freeing up weight for heavier weapons loadout. This variant switches the Gauss Rifle to an Ultra Autocannon/5.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由于它是"伟大之父"选用的战斗机甲，古老的猎户座在氏族的神秘传统中始终占有特殊地位。出于对克伦斯基将军遗产的尊重，所有氏族都维持该设计数十年，即便更新更先进技术的发展日益令它在战场上失去效力。猎户座 IIC 并非像某些氏族升级那样彻底重做，而是更换了原版的大部分内部结构与武器，同时保留其质量与外观。此次 IIC 升级采用内骨骼底盘和十二吨铁纤维装甲，并使用十二台双倍散热器，腾出重量以搭载更重的武器。此变体将高斯步枪换成超速自动炮/5。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由于它是"伟大之父"选用的战斗机甲，古老的猎户座在氏族的神秘传统中始终占有特殊地位。出于对克伦斯基将军遗产的尊重，所有氏族都维持该设计数十年，即便更新更先进技术的发展日益令它在战场上失去效力。猎户座 IIC 并非像某些氏族升级那样彻底重做，而是更换了原版的大部分内部结构与武器，同时保留其质量与外观。此次 IIC 升级采用内骨骼底盘和十二吨铁纤维装甲，并使用十二台双倍散热器，腾出重量以搭载更重的武器。此变体将高斯步枪换成超速自动炮/10，并将 LRM-20 挂架降级为 LRM-15。

Original: Since it was the chosen BattleMech of the Great Father, the venerable Orion has always held a special place in the mystique of the Clans. Out of respect for General Kerensky's legacy, all the Clans maintained the design for several decades even as the development of newer and more advanced technologies increasingly left it less effective on the battlefield. Not a radical reworking of the design, as some Clan upgrades are, the Orion IIC replaces much of the innards and weapons of the original, while preserving its mass and aesthetics. This IIC upgrade utilizes an Endo Steel chassis and twelve tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, while also making use of twelve double heat sinks, freeing up weight for heavier weapons loadout.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_orion_ON1-IIC.Details

Original: The Orion K was the first true heavy 'Mech. As a multirole brawler, the Orion can engage enemies at a variety of ranges, and with plenty of armor, it can survive combined fire for quite some time. Slow, yes—but powerful.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_orion_ON1-K.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Orion K was the first true heavy 'Mech. As a multirole brawler, the Orion can engage enemies at a variety of ranges, and with plenty of armor, it can survive combined fire for quite some time. Slow, yes—but powerful.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎户座 K 是首款真正的重型机甲。作为多用途缠斗者，猎户座能在多种距离上交战，凭借充裕装甲，它能在集中火力下存活相当长时间。慢，是的——但强大。

Original: The M variant is an upgrade using Star League technology first fielded in 3049. Replacing the standard engine with a Hermes 300 XL Engine and shaving off a half-ton of armor allows the 'Mech to retain the same speed while mounting a number of upgrades.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_orion_ON1-M.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The M variant is an upgrade using Star League technology first fielded in 3049. Replacing the standard engine with a Hermes 300 XL Engine and shaving off a half-ton of armor allows the 'Mech to retain the same speed while mounting a number of upgrades.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: M 变体是 3049 年首次投入战场的星盟科技升级版。以赫尔墨斯 300 XL 引擎取代标准引擎，并削减半吨装甲，使机甲在保持相同速度的同时搭载多项升级。

Original: Command Console refit built in 2913 - Standard refits usually installed the Command Console on a ON1-V, requiring the removal of one ton of SRM, LRM, and AC ammunition. The loss of ammunition reduces its capability to maintain fire for long, but a Commander will typically not be located at the head of a formation.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_orion_ON1-V-DC.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Command Console refit built in 2913 - Standard refits usually installed the Command Console on a ON1-V, requiring the removal of one ton of SRM, LRM, and AC ammunition. The loss of ammunition reduces its capability to maintain fire for long, but a Commander will typically not be located at the head of a formation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2913 年建造的指挥控制台改装型——标准改装通常在 ON1-V 上安装指挥控制台，需要移除一吨 SRM、LRM 和 AC 弹药。弹药的损失降低了它长时间持续开火的能力，但指挥官通常不会处在队列最前方。

Original: The Orion V trades some of the armor the K model is known for to mount additional weaponry. This increases its overall damage output, but many pilots consider the loss of armor to be risky.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_orion_ON1-V.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Orion V trades some of the armor the K model is known for to mount additional weaponry. This increases its overall damage output, but many pilots consider the loss of armor to be risky.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎户座 V 以 K 型闻名的部分装甲为代价搭载额外武器。这提升了总体伤害输出，但许多飞行员认为失去装甲颇为冒险。

Original: Instead of sacrificing armor, the Orion VA trades out some of it's long range punch by removing the LRM-15.  This allows it to not only maintain the stock armor, but also add 6 Heat Sinks for better heat management.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_orion_ON1-VA.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Instead of sacrificing armor, the Orion VA trades out some of it's long range punch by removing the LRM-15.  This allows it to not only maintain the stock armor, but also add 6 Heat Sinks for better heat management.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎户座 VA 不以装甲为代价，而是通过移除 LRM-15 换掉部分远程打击力。这使它不仅能维持原装装甲，还能加装 6 台散热器以改善散热管理。

Original: The Ostroc carries as its primary weapons two Fuersturm-C Large Lasers in the left and right torsos. These give the Ostroc good medium to long range damage capabilities. The Ostrocs secondary weapons are two Fuersturm-b Medium Lasers also mounted in the side torsos and a Totschlagen SRM-4 launcher in the right torso for close-range combat, with one ton of reloads carried in the center torso. While the Ostroc's laser-heavy weapons payload allows it to operate well as a guerrilla fighter since it has limited dependency on supply lines, its short arms are a handicap in close combat, and the shocks of hand-to-hand fighting can easily damage the Fuersturm systems.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_ostroc_OSR-2C.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Ostroc carries as its primary weapons two Fuersturm-C Large Lasers in the left and right torsos. These give the Ostroc good medium to long range damage capabilities. While the Ostroc's laser-heavy weapons payload allows it to operate well as a guerrilla fighter since it has limited dependency on supply lines, its short arms are a handicap in close combat, and the shocks of hand-to-hand fighting can easily damage the Fuersturm systems.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 奥斯特罗克以左右躯干的两门"元首-C"大型激光为主武器。这赋予奥斯特罗克良好的中远程伤害能力。奥斯特罗克的次要武器是同样装在两侧躯干的两门"元首-b"中型激光，以及右躯干一具"重击"SRM-4 发射器用于近程战斗，中央躯干携带一吨再装填。虽然奥斯特罗克偏重激光的武器载荷使它对补给线依赖有限、能很好地充当游击战士，但其短小的手臂在近战中是个缺陷，肉搏的冲击很容易损坏"元首"系统。

Original: This upgrade of the 2C was used by the SLDF Royals starting in 2729. The large lasers are upgraded to ER Large Lasers, and the SRM-4 is replaced with a pair of Streak SRM-2s. Fourteen double heat sinks keep this 'Mech cool, while Ferro-Fibrous armor gives it additional protection.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_ostroc_OSR-2CB.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This upgrade of the 2C was used by the SLDF Royals starting in 2729. The large lasers are upgraded to ER Large Lasers, and the SRM-4 is replaced with a pair of Streak SRM-2s. Fourteen double heat sinks keep this 'Mech cool, while Ferro-Fibrous armor gives it additional protection.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此 2C 的升级版自 2729 年起供星盟防卫军皇家部队使用。大型激光升级为 ER 大型激光，SRM-4 换成两具连续 SRM-2。十四台双倍散热器使机甲保持凉爽，铁纤维装甲则提供额外防护。

Original: An experimental model produced by Kong Interstellar for the Free Worlds League in 2793, the 2M variant of the Ostroc focuses on the 'Mech's maneuverability. Five jump jets, two in each leg and one in the rear torso, have been added to the design, giving it a maximum jumping distance of one hundred and fifty meters. In order to make this change, the medium lasers and the SRM-4 launcher were removed. Relatively few of these were built between the League's annexation of Connaught and the factory's destruction.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_ostroc_OSR-2M.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An experimental model produced by Kong Interstellar for the Free Worlds League in 2793, the 2M variant of the Ostroc focuses on the 'Mech's maneuverability. Five jump jets, two in each leg and one in the rear torso, have been added to the design, giving it a maximum jumping distance of one hundred and fifty meters. In order to make this change, the medium lasers and the SRM-4 launcher were removed. Relatively few of these were built between the League's annexation of Connaught and the factory's destruction.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2M 变体是康格星际于 2793 年为自由世界联盟生产的实验型号，聚焦于机甲的机动性。设计中加入五个跳跃推进器（每腿两个、后躯干一个），使最大跳跃距离达一百五十米。为做此改动，中型激光和 SRM-4 发射器被移除。在联盟吞并康诺特到工厂被毁之间，这样的机甲建造得相当少。

Original: The 3C variant looks to improve the long-range direct firepower of the Ostroc. Introduced in 2876, the two medium lasers and the SRM-4 have been removed in order to add a third large laser mounted in the right torso.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_ostroc_OSR-3C.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3C variant looks to improve the long-range direct firepower of the Ostroc. Introduced in 2876, the two medium lasers and the SRM-4 have been removed in order to add a third large laser mounted in the right torso.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3C 变体旨在提升奥斯特洛克的远程直射火力。它于 2876 年推出，移除两门中型激光和 SRM-4，以便在右躯干加装第三门大型激光。

Original: The Ostscout was designed as a pure recon BattleMech by Ostmann Industries. To that end, it was built entirely around gathering data and getting out of trouble, tasks for which it is exceptional. The Ostscout is quick enough to escape most traps, and very few other designs can match it in terms of speed and maneuverability. However its ability to run and leap out of danger came at the expense of offensive capability. In fact were it not for aggressive lobbying on the part of its test pilots the final production model would have been completely weaponless. As it is, the Ostcout would be hard-pressed to win a fight against all but the lightest 'Mechs. A poor combatant, the 'Mech excels at operating deep behind enemy lines, gathering as much information as possible about the terrain and the disposition of enemy forces. Besides the Great Houses, ComStar also utilized the Ostscout, and in the aftermath of the Clan Invasion and ComStar Schism began developing a new Ostscout variant for their Com Guards. This new model would maintain the same maneuverability and intelligence-gathering capabilities of the original while improving its offensive and defensive capabilities. Debuting with success in 3064, within the next three years nearly half of all Com Guard Ostscouts had been upgraded to the new variant; however it was soon discovered that both the Lyran Alliance and Word of Blake were fielding their own updated Ostscouts identical to ComStar's. The intelligence leak would be confirmed and traced back to Dag Kesselring, former Precentor of the 66th Division, who passed on information about the program to both the Lyrans and Blakists.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_ostscout_OTT-7J.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Ostscout was designed as a pure recon BattleMech by Ostmann Industries. To that end, it was built entirely around gathering data and getting out of trouble, tasks for which it is exceptional. The Ostscout is quick enough to escape most traps, and very few other designs can match it in terms of speed and maneuverability. However its ability to run and leap out of danger came at the expense of offensive capability. In fact were it not for aggressive lobbying on the part of its test pilots the final production model would have been completely weaponless. As it is, the Ostcout would be hard-pressed to win a fight against all but the lightest 'Mechs. A poor combatant, the 'Mech excels at operating deep behind enemy lines, gathering as much information as possible about the terrain and the disposition of enemy forces. Besides the Great Houses, ComStar also utilized the Ostscout, and in the aftermath of the Clan Invasion and ComStar Schism began developing a new Ostscout variant for their Com Guards. This new model would maintain the same maneuverability and intelligence-gathering capabilities of the original while improving its offensive and defensive capabilities. Debuting with success in 3064, within the next three years nearly half of all Com Guard Ostscouts had been upgraded to the new variant; however it was soon discovered that both the Lyran Alliance and Word of Blake were fielding their own updated Ostscouts identical to ComStar's. The intelligence leak would be confirmed and traced back to Dag Kesselring, former Precentor of the 66th Division, who passed on information about the program to both the Lyrans and Blakists.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 奥斯特侦察由奥斯特曼工业设计为纯侦察战斗机甲。为此它完全围绕收集数据与脱离险境而构建，而它在这两项任务上表现卓越。奥斯特侦察速度快到足以逃出大多数陷阱，几乎没有其他设计能在速度与机动性上与之匹敌。然而它跑得快、跳得远的能力是以攻击力为代价换来的。事实上，若不是测试飞行员积极游说，最终量产型本会完全没有武器。即便如此，奥斯特侦察除了对抗最轻的机甲外，很难赢下任何战斗。作为战斗者它很差，但在敌后深处行动、尽可能收集地形与敌军部署情报方面却极为出色。除各大议院外，康星也使用奥斯特侦察，在氏族入侵与康星分裂之后，他们开始为其康卫开发新的奥斯特侦察变体。新机型将保持原版同样的机动性与情报收集能力，同时提升攻防能力。该型于 3064 年成功亮相，此后三年内近半数康卫奥斯特侦察都升级到了新型号；然而很快发现莱兰联盟与布雷克之言都在装备与康星型号完全相同的自家更新版奥斯特侦察。泄密最终被确认并可追溯到达格·凯塞尔林——第 66 师的前任主祭——他将该计划的信息同时传给了莱兰人与布雷克派。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 奥斯特侦察由奥斯特曼工业设计为纯侦察战斗机甲。为此它完全围绕收集数据与脱离险境而构建，而它在这两项任务上表现卓越。奥斯特侦察速度快到足以逃出大多数陷阱，几乎没有其他设计能在速度与机动性上与之匹敌。然而它跑得快、跳得远的能力是以攻击力为代价换来的。事实上，若不是测试飞行员积极游说，最终量产型本会完全没有武器。即便如此，奥斯特侦察除了对抗最轻的机甲外，很难赢下任何战斗。作为战斗者它很差，但在敌后深处行动、尽可能收集地形与敌军部署情报方面却极为出色。除各大议院外，康星也使用奥斯特侦察，在氏族入侵与康星分裂之后，他们开始为其康卫开发新的奥斯特侦察变体。新机型将保持原版同样的机动性与情报收集能力，同时提升攻防能力。该型于 3064 年成功亮相，此后三年内近半数康卫奥斯特侦察都升级到了新型号；然而很快发现莱兰联盟与布雷克之言都在装备与康星型号完全相同的自家更新版奥斯特侦察。泄密最终被确认并可追溯到达格·凯塞尔林——第 66 师的前任主祭——他将该计划的信息同时传给了莱兰人与布雷克派。

Original: Nine tons of armoring is considered decent for a heavy 'Mech, while its fast cruising speed of 54 km/h is thanks to a nineteen-ton Vlar 300 fusion engine. Besides speed though it's the 'Mech's highly-sensitive TRSS.2L3 targeting-tracking system, able to detect enemies over several kilometers in even the most difficult terrain, which makes it a good command platform for scouting missions. Sixteen heat sinks also help manage the heat output of its all-energy weapons payload.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_ostsol_OTL-4D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Nine tons of armoring is considered decent for a heavy 'Mech, while its fast cruising speed of 54 km/h is thanks to a nineteen-ton Vlar 300 fusion engine. Besides speed though it's the 'Mech's highly-sensitive TRSS.2L3 targeting-tracking system, able to detect enemies over several kilometers in even the most difficult terrain, which makes it a good command platform for scouting missions. Sixteen heat sinks also help manage the heat output of its all-energy weapons payload.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对重型机甲而言九吨装甲称得上不错，而 54 公里/小时的快速巡航速度要归功于一台十九吨的 Vlar 300 聚变引擎。不过除速度之外，真正亮点是机甲高度灵敏的 TRSS.2L3 瞄准追踪系统——即便在最困难的地形中也能探测数公里外的敌人，这使它成为侦察任务的优良指挥平台。十六台散热器也有助于管理其全能量武器载荷的热量输出。

Original: The 4F Ostsol introduced in 2871 was the only common variant of the 'Mech pre-Clan Invasion, completely removing the laser weapons and replacing them with two Dominion-V PPCs in the side torsos. The 'Mech is seen as, in some ways at least, a poor man's Marauder or Warhammer, and the PPC array can quickly overload the sixteen heat sinks. Though, on its own merits, the variant is a good long-range direct fire support 'Mech which uses its top speed of 86.4 kph to dictate combat ranges against most heavier 'Mechs.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_ostsol_OTL-4F.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 4F Ostsol introduced in 2871 was the only common variant of the 'Mech pre-Clan Invasion, completely removing the laser weapons and replacing them with two Dominion-V PPCs in the side torsos. The 'Mech is seen as, in some ways at least, a poor man's Marauder or Warhammer, and the PPC array can quickly overload the sixteen heat sinks. Though, on its own merits, the variant is a good long-range direct fire support 'Mech which uses its top speed of 86.4 kph to dictate combat ranges against most heavier 'Mechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 4F 奥斯特索尔于 2871 年推出，是氏族入侵前该机甲唯一常见的变体，它完全移除激光武器，在两侧躯干换成两门"自治领-V"PPC。该机甲在某种程度上被视为穷人版的掠夺者或战锤，而 PPC 阵列会迅速让十六台散热器过载。不过就自身而言，该变体是一款优秀的远程直射支援机甲，能利用 86.4 公里/小时的最高速度对抗大多数更重的机甲来决定交战距离。

Original: The 5M variant of the Ostsol is an upgrade of the design using Star League technology and is built for close-range combat with production starting in 3050. The original engine, heat sinks, and weapons have been stripped from the chassis and replaced with a Hermes 300 XL engine and sixteen double heat sinks. Taking the place of its standard weapons, the 5M Ostsol carries two Tronel XIII Large Pulse Lasers and four Tronel XII Medium Pulse Lasers, two of which remain rear-mounted to discourage attacks against the 'Mech's weak rear armor. Finally, for added protection against missile attacks, the 5M carries a Lindblad Shotgun Anti-Missile System in its right torso with one ton of ammo in the left.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_ostsol_OTL-5M.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5M variant of the Ostsol is an upgrade of the design using Star League technology and is built for close-range combat with production starting in 3050. The original engine, heat sinks, and weapons have been stripped from the chassis and replaced with a Hermes 300 XL engine and sixteen double heat sinks. Taking the place of its standard weapons, the 5M Ostsol carries two Tronel XIII Large Pulse Lasers and four Tronel XII Medium Pulse Lasers, two of which remain rear-mounted to discourage attacks against the 'Mech's weak rear armor. Finally, for added protection against missile attacks, the 5M carries a Lindblad Shotgun Anti-Missile System in its right torso with one ton of ammo in the left.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 奥斯特索尔 5M 变体是使用星盟技术对该设计的升级，专为近程战斗而造，自 3050 年起生产。原有引擎、散热器和武器已从底盘上拆除，换成赫尔墨斯 300 XL 引擎和十六台双倍散热器。5M 奥斯特索尔以两门"特罗内尔 XIII"大型脉冲激光和四门"特罗内尔 XII"中型脉冲激光取代标准武器，其中两门仍为后向安装，以遏制对机甲薄弱后方装甲的攻击。最后，为加强对导弹攻击的防护，5M 在右躯干装一套林德布拉德霰弹反导系统，左躯干配一吨弹药。

Original: An updated version of the primitive Ostwar developed in 2620, this variant carries 12 tons of standard BattleMech armor and a modern cockpit. The chassis has been upgraded to use Endo Steel, while an XL Engine increases the Ostwar's ground speed to 84 kmh. Eighteen double heat sinks dissipate the heat from three ER Large Lasers and twin SRM-6 launchers.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_ostwar_OWR-2MB.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An updated version of the primitive Ostwar developed in 2620, this variant carries 12 tons of standard BattleMech armor and a modern cockpit. The chassis has been upgraded to use Endo Steel, while an XL Engine increases the Ostwar's ground speed to 84 kmh. Eighteen double heat sinks dissipate the heat from three ER Large Lasers and twin SRM-6 launchers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此变体是 2620 年开发的原始奥斯特战争的更新版，携带 12 吨标准战斗机甲装甲和现代驾驶舱。底盘升级为内骨骼，XL 引擎把奥斯特战争的地面速度提升至 84 公里/小时。十八台双倍散热器散发三门 ER 大型激光和双联 SRM-6 发射器的热量。

Original: The Owens is intended to be an OmniMech upgrade of the Jenner BattleMech. The intended role for the Owens is as a cavalry 'Mech that can move along the enemy lines and designate targets for bombardment with Arrow IV artillery attacks. The Owens is a strong spotting unit as well as a point 'Mech for C3 lances with its permanently mounted TAG laser designator, Beagle Probe and C3 Slave unit.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_owens_OW-1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Owens is intended to be an OmniMech upgrade of the Jenner BattleMech. The intended role for the Owens is as a cavalry 'Mech that can move along the enemy lines and designate targets for bombardment with Arrow IV artillery attacks. The Owens is a strong spotting unit as well as a point 'Mech for C3 lances with its permanently mounted TAG laser designator, Beagle Probe and C3 Slave unit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 欧文斯旨在作为詹纳战斗机甲的全能机甲升级型。其定位是骑兵机甲，可沿敌方战线机动并为我方箭矢 IV 炮击标记目标。凭借固定安装的 TAG 激光指示器、比格犬探测器与 C3 从属单元，欧文斯既是优秀的侦察单位，也是 C3 小队的先锋机甲。

Original: The 10K Panther is a high tech upgrade of the 9R model introduced by Wakazashi Enterprises. The chassis has been rebuilt using Endo Steel construction techniques and the saved weight used to add an Artemis IV fire control system to the missile launcher, as well as upgrading the PPC to a Lord's Light 2 ER PPC. Since its introduction the 10K has gone on to replace the 9R as the most common model employed by the DCMS.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_panther_PNT-10K.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 10K Panther is a high tech upgrade of the 9R model introduced by Wakazashi Enterprises. The chassis has been rebuilt using Endo Steel construction techniques and the saved weight used to add an Artemis IV fire control system to the missile launcher, as well as upgrading the PPC to a Lord's Light 2 ER PPC. Since its introduction the 10K has gone on to replace the 9R as the most common model employed by the DCMS.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 10K 黑豹是若林重工推出的 9R 型号高科技升级版。底盘以日式建筑技术重建，节省的重量用于为导弹发射器加装 Artemis IV 火控系统，并把 PPC 升级为"主之光 2"ER PPC。自推出以来，10K 已取代 9R 成为 DCMS 最常用的型号。

Original: The 10KA Panther is a field refit of the Panther 10K. It removes the ER PPC and replaces it with a standard PPC to alleviate some heat problems.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_panther_PNT-10KA.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 10KA Panther is a field refit of the Panther 10K. It removes the ER PPC and replaces it with a standard PPC to alleviate some heat problems.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 10KA 黑豹是黑豹 10K 的野战改装。它移除 ER PPC，换成标准 PPC 以缓解一些热量问题。

Original: The Panther 5T is a Taurian refit, replacing the PPC and SRM with a low-tech Heavy Rifle and Flamer. Born from extreme shortages of replacement parts, this is a cheap alternative favoured by mercenaries and hired security.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_panther_PNT-5T.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Panther 5T is a Taurian refit, replacing the PPC and SRM with a low-tech Heavy Rifle and Flamer. Born from extreme shortages of replacement parts, this is a cheap alternative favoured by mercenaries and hired security.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑豹 5T 是陶里安改装型，将 PPC 和 SRM 换成低技术重型步枪与火焰喷射器。它因替换零件极度短缺而生，是佣兵与雇佣保安青睐的廉价替代品。

Original: An early version of the Panther that is occasionally seen in the Periphery, it is armed with the ancient Tronel Large Laser in place of the PPC.  This laser suffers from faulty heat exchangers and generates more heat than a standard Large Laser.  Most of these have long since been retrofitted.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_panther_PNT-8Z.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An early version of the Panther that is occasionally seen in the Periphery, it is armed with the ancient Tronel Large Laser in place of the PPC.  This laser suffers from faulty heat exchangers and generates more heat than a standard Large Laser.  Most of these have long since been retrofitted.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是黑豹的早期版本，偶尔在外围区可见，它以古老的"特罗内尔"大型激光取代 PPC。这门激光受热交换器故障困扰，比标准大型激光产生更多热量。其中大多数早已被改装。

Original: Known for their highly mobile nature, the Draconis Combine's Amphigean Light Assault Group upgrade the engines by removing the Jump Jets.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_panther_PNT-9ALAG.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Known for their highly mobile nature, the Draconis Combine's Amphigean Light Assault Group upgrade the engines by removing the Jump Jets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 德拉科尼斯联合体的安菲吉亚轻型突击集群以高度机动著称，它们通过移除跳跃推进器来升级引擎。

Original: Panther 9Rs are solid all-around 'Mechs, if a bit on the slow side. They make up for it with Jump Jets, considerable armor, and a hefty punch from their trademark PPC. They've even been used in physical slugging matches to good effect.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_panther_PNT-9R.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Panther 9Rs are solid all-around 'Mechs, if a bit on the slow side. They make up for it with Jump Jets, considerable armor, and a hefty punch from their trademark PPC. They've even been used in physical slugging matches to good effect.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑豹 9R 是扎实的全能机甲，只是稍偏慢。它靠跳跃推进器、可观的装甲和标志性 PPC 的沉重打击来弥补。它们甚至被用于近身肉搏，效果不俗。

Original: The PNT-C is a modification of the -10K model and simply removes the Artemis IV for a C3 slave.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_panther_PNT-C.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The PNT-C is a modification of the -10K model and simply removes the Artemis IV for a C3 slave.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: PNT-C 是-10K 型号的改装，仅移除 Artemis IV，换成一台 C3 从属单元。

Original: The PNT-CA is a simple weapon swap. A cooler firing standard PPC is used in place of the PNT-C's ER PPC.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_panther_PNT-CA.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The PNT-CA is a simple weapon swap. A cooler firing standard PPC is used in place of the PNT-C's ER PPC.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: PNT-CA 是一次简单的武器更换。它以一门散热更低的标准 PPC 取代 PNT-C 的 ER PPC。

Original: The Perseus is the product of a program begun by the League Central Coordination and Command to create an OmniMech completely indigenous to the Free Worlds League from concept to production. The Perseus shares much with the venerable Orion, a staple of Free Worlds League Military, both broadly resembling the older design visually and using a number of the same components. This similarity prompted more than a few FWLM technicians to nickname the new design the Omni-Orion and the deployment of Perseus has largely been to front-line units that fielded large concentrations of its progenitor, replacing older Orions on a one-for-one basis. Built on a lightweight Endo Steel chassis, the Perseus is powered by a Hermes 300 XL engine helping save even more weight and giving the 'Mech a top speed of 64.8 km/h. The advanced structure and engine save a great deal of weight for weapons and equipment. The Perseus is protected by fourteen tons of Valiant Lamellor armor, giving it around average armor protection for a 'Mech of its size. It also has twelve double heat sinks that are fixed on the chassis.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_perseus_P1-A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Perseus is the product of a program begun by the League Central Coordination and Command to create an OmniMech completely indigenous to the Free Worlds League from concept to production. The Perseus shares much with the venerable Orion, a staple of Free Worlds League Military, both broadly resembling the older design visually and using a number of the same components. This similarity prompted more than a few FWLM technicians to nickname the new design the Omni-Orion and the deployment of Perseus has largely been to front-line units that fielded large concentrations of its progenitor, replacing older Orions on a one-for-one basis. Built on a lightweight Endo Steel chassis, the Perseus is powered by a Hermes 300 XL engine helping save even more weight and giving the 'Mech a top speed of 64.8 km/h. The advanced structure and engine save a great deal of weight for weapons and equipment. The Perseus is protected by fourteen tons of Valiant Lamellor armor, giving it around average armor protection for a 'Mech of its size. It also has twelve double heat sinks that are fixed on the chassis.

Original: Developed for the Star League Defense Force Royal Divisions in 2692, this variant of the Phoenix Hawk LAM used four Medium Lasers and a single ER Large Laser as its main firepower. Twelve double heat sinks kept the heat curve low, but the limited fuel, armor, and maneuverability made the Phoenix Hawk LAM easy prey for AeroSpace Fighters of the same weight. It could maneuver fast enough to evade heavier foes however
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_phoenixhawklam_PXH-HK1.Details

It could maneuver fast enough to evade heavier foes however
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此型凤凰鹰 LAM 于 2692 年为星盟防卫军皇家师开发，以四门中型激光和一门 ER 大型激光为主要火力。十二台双倍散热器将热量曲线维持在低位，但有限的燃料、装甲与机动性使凤凰鹰 LAM 成为同重量航空战斗机的易捕猎物。不过它的机动速度足以避开更重的敌人

Original: This version was created before the introduction of the PHX-HK2, in 2695. It removed the ER Large Laser, a Medium Laser, and two heat sinks, replacing them with an experimental Snub-Nose PPC, Beagle Active Probe, and an additional half ton of armor.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_phoenixhawklam_PXH-HK1R.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This version was created before the introduction of the PHX-HK2, in 2695. It removed the ER Large Laser, a Medium Laser, and two heat sinks, replacing them with an experimental Snub-Nose PPC, Beagle Active Probe, and an additional half ton of armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此版本在 PHX-HK2 推出之前（2695 年）就被制造。它移除了一门 ER 大型激光、一门中型激光和两台散热器，换成一门实验型短鼻 PPC、比格犬主动探测器和额外半吨装甲。

Original: The Phoenix Hawk LAM was the largest Land-Air 'Mech produced during the Star League. Allied Aerospace reworked their designs for conversion equipment and the size of the LAM, learning from their mistake with the Shadow Hawk LAM and the success of the Stinger LAM. The resulting LAM was the largest LAM ever constructed capable of remaining in AirMech mode. Unfortunately, large Land-Air 'Mech conversion technology was not fully researched before the fall of the Star League, and the Phoenix Hawk LAM frequently met its end due to the occasional glitch. The end of the Star League and destruction of the Allied Aerospace facilities at the beginning of the First Succession War prevented further development and refinement.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_phoenixhawklam_PXH-HK2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Phoenix Hawk LAM was the largest Land-Air 'Mech produced during the Star League. Allied Aerospace reworked their designs for conversion equipment and the size of the LAM, learning from their mistake with the Shadow Hawk LAM and the success of the Stinger LAM. The resulting LAM was the largest LAM ever constructed capable of remaining in AirMech mode. Unfortunately, large Land-Air 'Mech conversion technology was not fully researched before the fall of the Star League, and the Phoenix Hawk LAM frequently met its end due to the occasional glitch. The end of the Star League and destruction of the Allied Aerospace facilities at the beginning of the First Succession War prevented further development and refinement.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凤凰鹰 LAM 是星盟时期生产的最大陆空机甲。联合航空重做了其变身设备与 LAM 尺寸的设计，吸取了影鹰 LAM 的教训与毒刺 LAM 的成功经验。成品是有史以来最大的、能在机甲空中模式维持飞行的 LAM。遗憾的是，大型陆空机甲变身技术在星盟覆灭前未获充分研究，凤凰鹰 LAM 常因偶发故障而殒命。星盟的终结与第一次继承战争初期联合航空设施的毁灭，阻断了进一步的开发与改良。

Original: House Marik produced a variant of the Phoenix Hawk LAM which replaces the Large Laser and Machine Guns with a Holly LRM-10.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_phoenixhawklam_PXH-HK2M.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: House Marik produced a variant of the Phoenix Hawk LAM which replaces the Large Laser and Machine Guns with a Holly LRM-10.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 马里克家族生产了一款凤凰鹰 LAM 变体，将大型激光和机枪换成冬青 LRM-10。

Original: First introduced by the Terran Hegemony in 2568, the Phoenix Hawk is one of the most well known BattleMechs in the Inner Sphere. The 'Mech began life when Orguss Industries realized that it could reinforce the Stinger chassis to create a larger version, one with the same speed and maneuverability as the Stinger but with superior armor, firepower and electronics. Though not without its own drawbacks, the Phoenix Hawk quickly became the standard by which all other reconnaissance 'Mechs were measured.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_phoenixhawk_PXH-1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: First introduced by the Terran Hegemony in 2568, the Phoenix Hawk is one of the most well known BattleMechs in the Inner Sphere. The 'Mech began life when Orguss Industries realized that it could reinforce the Stinger chassis to create a larger version, one with the same speed and maneuverability as the Stinger but with superior armor, firepower and electronics. Though not without its own drawbacks, the Phoenix Hawk quickly became the standard by which all other reconnaissance 'Mechs were measured.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凤凰鹰由地球霸权于 2568 年首次推出，是内天体最知名的战斗机甲之一。这台机甲的诞生始于奥古斯工业意识到它可以强化毒刺底盘造出更大版本——一个与毒刺速度与机动性相同，但拥有更优装甲、火力与电子设备的型号。尽管并非毫无缺点，凤凰鹰很快成为衡量所有其他侦察机甲的标准。

Original: The 1D variant of the Phoenix Hawk is commonly used by the forces of House Davion, though it is slowly being phased out by the upgraded 3D. Contrasted with the base PXH-1, it removes the machine guns and replaces them with two additional heat sinks. While removing a small amount of the 'Mech's short-range firepower, the additional heat sinks make the 1D's heat load more manageable.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_phoenixhawk_PXH-1D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 1D variant of the Phoenix Hawk is commonly used by the forces of House Davion, though it is slowly being phased out by the upgraded 3D. Contrasted with the base PXH-1, it removes the machine guns and replaces them with two additional heat sinks. While removing a small amount of the 'Mech's short-range firepower, the additional heat sinks make the 1D's heat load more manageable.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凤凰鹰 1D 变体常为达维昂家族部队使用，不过正被升级版 3D 逐步淘汰。与基础 PXH-1 相比，它移除机枪并换上两台额外散热器。这虽然削减了机甲少量近程火力，额外散热器却让 1D 的热负荷更易管理。

Original: After the destruction of their main production line in 2928, Solaris 7 based Blue Shot Weapons looked for other means of income. They took the idea behind the STR-3G Stinger variant and created a similar variant of the Phoenix Hawk by adding a second Large Laser in the left arm. To free up the necessary weight the PXH-1GS removes the Medium Lasers and Machine Guns and sacrifices some speed & maneuverability, but also adds 3 Heat Sinks and two Small Lasers. Both the primary lasers are mounted in gunpods giving the variant its "Gunslinger" nickname.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_phoenixhawk_PXH-1GS.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: After the destruction of their main production line in 2928, Solaris 7 based Blue Shot Weapons looked for other means of income. They took the idea behind the STR-3G Stinger variant and created a similar variant of the Phoenix Hawk by adding a second Large Laser in the left arm. To free up the necessary weight the PXH-1GS removes the Medium Lasers and Machine Guns and sacrifices some speed & maneuverability, but also adds 3 Heat Sinks and two Small Lasers. Both the primary lasers are mounted in gunpods giving the variant its "Gunslinger" nickname.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在 2928 年主生产线被毁后，驻扎索拉里斯 7 的蓝射武器公司寻找其他收入来源。他们借鉴 STR-3G 毒刺变体的思路，通过在左臂加装第二门大型激光，为凤凰鹰打造了类似变体。为腾出所需重量，PXH-1GS 移除中型激光和机枪，并牺牲部分速度与机动性，但也增加 3 台散热器和两门小型激光。两门主激光都装在枪袋中，为该变体赢得了"枪手"的绰号。

Original: The 1K variant is particularly favored by House Kurita, though when it was introduced in 2603 it represented a departure from the traditional thinking of the Phoenix Hawk: By removing all jump jets from the 'Mech, room is freed up to install additional heat sinks and more armor. The machine guns and ammunition have also been removed from the design and replaced with a single Small Laser carried in the center torso.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_phoenixhawk_PXH-1K.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 1K variant is particularly favored by House Kurita, though when it was introduced in 2603 it represented a departure from the traditional thinking of the Phoenix Hawk: By removing all jump jets from the 'Mech, room is freed up to install additional heat sinks and more armor. The machine guns and ammunition have also been removed from the design and replaced with a single Small Laser carried in the center torso.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 1K 变体尤其受库瑞塔家族青睐，不过它在 2603 年推出时代表了与凤凰鹰传统思路的背离：通过移除机甲上全部跳跃推进器，腾出空间安装额外散热器和更多装甲。机枪与弹药也一并从设计中移除，换成装在中央躯干的一门小型激光。

Original: Based on the PXH-1, this electronic warfare variant introduced in 2599 drops the machine guns and ammunition in favor of a Guardian ECM Suite and another half-ton of armor.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_phoenixhawk_PXH-2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Based on the PXH-1, this electronic warfare variant introduced in 2599 drops the machine guns and ammunition in favor of a Guardian ECM Suite and another half-ton of armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款电子战变体基于 PXH-1，于 2599 年推出，它舍弃机枪与弹药，改配一套守护者 ECM 套件和另外半吨装甲。

Original: The Phoenix Hawk 2L was one of the first new mechs to be produced under the Long Road initiative. A compete overhaul designed to be compatible with the myriad PXH-1 variants found throughout the Periphery, the redesign takes advantage of a new ER Large Laser. The weapons increased heat is balanced by the inclusion of 2 extra heat sinks; with an Endo steel chassis providing the necessary free wieght. Retaining the medium lasers and the Guardian ECM suite, the 2L is a cheap upgrade for anyone fielding a PXH-1 design. Available for export throughout the Periphery, the only constraint to production is the lack of a production facility for the PXH chassis, though Alliance Mech Works has plans to build a dedicated PHX line should the design prove popular. Until then the current output is limited to in-situ conversions of existing mechs and the restoration of battlefield salvage.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_phoenixhawk_PXH-2L.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Phoenix Hawk 2L was one of the first new mechs to be produced under the Long Road initiative. A compete overhaul designed to be compatible with the myriad PXH-1 variants found throughout the Periphery, the redesign takes advantage of a new ER Large Laser. The weapons increased heat is balanced by the inclusion of 2 extra heat sinks; with an Endo steel chassis providing the necessary free wieght. Retaining the medium lasers and the Guardian ECM suite, the 2L is a cheap upgrade for anyone fielding a PXH-1 design. Available for export throughout the Periphery, the only constraint to production is the lack of a production facility for the PXH chassis, though Alliance Mech Works has plans to build a dedicated PHX line should the design prove popular. Until then the current output is limited to in-situ conversions of existing mechs and the restoration of battlefield salvage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凤凰鹰 2L 是"长路"倡议下最先生产的新机甲之一。作为一次与外围区各地无数 PXH-1 变体兼容的彻底翻新，该重新设计利用了新的 ER 大型激光。武器增加的热量由额外 2 台散热器平衡；内骨骼底盘提供了所需的空闲重量。2L 保留中型激光和守护者 ECM 套件，对任何装备 PXH-1 设计的人来说都是廉价的升级。它可向外围区各地出口，唯一的生产制约是缺乏 PXH 底盘的生产设施，不过联盟机甲厂计划在该设计受欢迎时建造一条专用的 PHX 生产线。在此之前，当前产量仅限于对现有机甲的就地改装和战场残骸的修复。

Original: Like all PXH-3 models, the 3D is an upgraded Phoenix Hawk using rediscovered technology. By upgrading Davion's favorite 1D variant with an Endo-Steel chassis and XL engine, Davion scouts can cram quite a lot of firepower into their scout 'Mechs. To sustain the extra laser firepower the design replaces all single heat sinks with doubles, further improving upon the cooling upgrades from its parent variant. Whilst it lacks the Ferro-Fibrous armor of its Kuritan counterpart, the design does make room for an AMS system, allowing it to dive behind cover without having to worry about indirect fire.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_phoenixhawk_PXH-3D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Like all PXH-3 models, the 3D is an upgraded Phoenix Hawk using rediscovered technology. By upgrading Davion's favorite 1D variant with an Endo-Steel chassis and XL engine, Davion scouts can cram quite a lot of firepower into their scout 'Mechs. To sustain the extra laser firepower the design replaces all single heat sinks with doubles, further improving upon the cooling upgrades from its parent variant. Whilst it lacks the Ferro-Fibrous armor of its Kuritan counterpart, the design does make room for an AMS system, allowing it to dive behind cover without having to worry about indirect fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 与所有 PXH-3 型号一样，3D 是使用重新发现技术的凤凰鹰升级版。通过给达维昂最爱的 1D 变体升级内骨骼底盘和 XL 引擎，达维昂侦察兵能在侦察机甲中塞进相当多的火力。为支撑额外的激光火力，该设计把所有单散热器换成双倍散热器，在母变体的散热升级基础上更进一步。虽然缺少其库瑞塔对应型的铁纤维装甲，该设计却腾出空间装了一套 AMS 系统，使它能躲到掩体后而不必担心间接火力。

Original: The 3K Phoenix Hawk is another upgrade of the design that uses rediscovered technologies. Inspired by the 1K variant, the 3K uses an XL engine to upgrade the firepower to Medium Pulse and ER Large Lasers as well as reintroducing House Kurita to jump jets. Taking the 1K's additional heat sinks and upgrading those to doubles alongisde an Ferro-Fibrous armor upgrade means that the 'Mech can stay in the fight for longer, though it remains a scout at heart. It is notably the only PXH-3 variant that does not include AMS.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_phoenixhawk_PXH-3K.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3K Phoenix Hawk is another upgrade of the design that uses rediscovered technologies. Inspired by the 1K variant, the 3K uses an XL engine to upgrade the firepower to Medium Pulse and ER Large Lasers as well as reintroducing House Kurita to jump jets. Taking the 1K's additional heat sinks and upgrading those to doubles alongisde an Ferro-Fibrous armor upgrade means that the 'Mech can stay in the fight for longer, though it remains a scout at heart. It is notably the only PXH-3 variant that does not include AMS.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3K 凤凰鹰是该设计又一次使用重新发现技术的升级。受 1K 变体启发，3K 用 XL 引擎把火力升级为中型脉冲激光和 ER 大型激光，也把跳跃推进器重新带回库瑞塔家族。它继承 1K 的额外散热器并升级为双倍，同时升级铁纤维装甲，意味着机甲能在战斗中坚持更久——尽管它本质上仍是侦察机甲。值得注意的是，它是唯一不含 AMS 的 PXH-3 变体。

Original: The 3M variant of the Phoenix Hawk was introduced in 3048 alongside everyone else's attempt to upgrade the 'Mech with LosTech, built by Earthwerks Incorporated from their Keystone factory. Endo-Steel, double heat sinks and an XL engine allow the design to carry ER Large Lasers and Medium Pulse Lasers. The 'Mech retains a machinegun from the original design, whilst the other is replaced with an Anti Missile System. This gives it slightly more firepower then its Kuritan and Davion brethren, at the cost of fewer heat sinks and slightly worse armor.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_phoenixhawk_PXH-3M.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3M variant of the Phoenix Hawk was introduced in 3048 alongside everyone else's attempt to upgrade the 'Mech with LosTech, built by Earthwerks Incorporated from their Keystone factory. Endo-Steel, double heat sinks and an XL engine allow the design to carry ER Large Lasers and Medium Pulse Lasers. The 'Mech retains a machinegun from the original design, whilst the other is replaced with an Anti Missile System. This gives it slightly more firepower then its Kuritan and Davion brethren, at the cost of fewer heat sinks and slightly worse armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凤凰鹰 3M 变体于 3048 年推出，与各方用失传技术升级该机甲的尝试同期，由地球工厂公司在其基斯通工厂生产。内骨骼、双倍散热器和 XL 引擎使该设计得以携带 ER 大型激光与中型脉冲激光。机甲保留原设计的一挺机枪，另一挺换成反导系统。这使它的火力略强于库瑞塔与达维昂的同门，代价是散热器更少、装甲略差。

Original: The 3S model of this 'Mech, first deployed in 3042, is another upgrade using rediscovered technology that attempts to make the Phoenix Hawk even more effective for reconnaissance. The engine is upgraded to an ExtraLight version and double heat sinks improve heat management. The armor has both been strengthened and replaced with the lighter Ferro Fibrous armor. A large pulse laser adds extra firepower, though it still retains the two medium lasers and machine guns of the original. Additionally an anti-missile system is mounted on the right arm, with CASE protection for its ammo. Its primary difference from other variants is the addition of a MASC system, which allows the 'Mech to reach higher speeds in short bursts.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_phoenixhawk_PXH-3S.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3S model of this 'Mech, first deployed in 3042, is another upgrade using rediscovered technology that attempts to make the Phoenix Hawk even more effective for reconnaissance. The engine is upgraded to an ExtraLight version and double heat sinks improve heat management. The armor has both been strengthened and replaced with the lighter Ferro Fibrous armor. A large pulse laser adds extra firepower, though it still retains the two medium lasers and machine guns of the original. Additionally an anti-missile system is mounted on the right arm, with CASE protection for its ammo. Its primary difference from other variants is the addition of a MASC system, which allows the 'Mech to reach higher speeds in short bursts.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该机甲的 3S 型号于 3042 年首次部署，是又一次利用重新发现技术的升级，力图让凤凰鹰在侦察上更有效。引擎升级为超轻型版本，双倍散热器改善散热管理。装甲既被强化，也换成了更轻的铁纤维装甲。一门大型脉冲激光增加额外火力，同时仍保留原版的两门中型激光和机枪。此外右臂还安装一套反导系统，其弹药有 C.A.S.E. 保护。它与其他变体的主要区别在于加装了 MASC 系统，使机甲能在短促爆发中达到更高速度。

Original: The PXH-1b, or Phoenix Hawk 'Special' is a Star League model that manages to be far scarier then even the PHX-3 variants that were introduced not so long ago. Beyond the Endo-Steel chassis and ExtraLight engine that is now more commonly found across the Inner Sphere, the 1b sports a Guardian ECM system and IFF jammer. Its large laser has been upgraded to an ER variant, but on top of its original weaponry the SLDF somehow managed to get an ER PPC in there as well.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_phoenix_hawk_PXH-1b.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The PXH-1b, or Phoenix Hawk 'Special' is a Star League model that manages to be far scarier then even the PHX-3 variants that were introduced not so long ago. Beyond the Endo-Steel chassis and ExtraLight engine that is now more commonly found across the Inner Sphere, the 1b sports a Guardian ECM system and IFF jammer. Its large laser has been upgraded to an ER variant, but on top of its original weaponry the SLDF somehow managed to get an ER PPC in there as well.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: PXH-1b，即凤凰鹰"特种"，是一款星盟型号，比不久前推出的 PHX-3 变体还要可怕得多。除内骨骼底盘和如今在内天体更常见的超轻型引擎之外，1b 还装有守护者 ECM 系统和 IFF 干扰器。它的大型激光已升级为 ER 版本，而在原有武器之上，星盟防卫军不知怎的还设法塞进了一门 ER PPC。

Original: The Phoenix Hawk Special! This upgraded model of the scout 'Mech represents the peak of Star League technology, still being tested when the Exodus happened. Contrasted to the already spectacular 1b, this variant uses an experimental snub nose PPC to bring the weight down for additional armour, making it the most heavily armoured variant of the Phoenix Hawk that I know of. Just like the 1b, it carries a full ECM suite.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_phoenix_hawk_PXH-1c.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Phoenix Hawk Special! This upgraded model of the scout 'Mech represents the peak of Star League technology, still being tested when the Exodus happened. Contrasted to the already spectacular 1b, this variant uses an experimental snub nose PPC to bring the weight down for additional armour, making it the most heavily armoured variant of the Phoenix Hawk that I know of. Just like the 1b, it carries a full ECM suite.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凤凰鹰"特种"！这款侦察机甲的升级型号代表星盟技术的巅峰，在出埃及发生时仍在测试中。与已经出色的 1b 相比，此变体使用一门实验性短管 PPC 以降低重量换取额外装甲，使其成为我所知装甲最厚重的凤凰鹰变体。与 1b 一样，它携带全套 ECM 套件。

Original: The Piranha was developed by Clan Diamond Shark to combat conventional infantry and light vehicles. The sheer speed that the BattleMech is capable of has also made it something of a scout, though it lacks sophisticated electronic equipment. The Piranha is protected mostly by its speed.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_Piranha.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Piranha was developed by Clan Diamond Shark to combat conventional infantry and light vehicles. The sheer speed that the BattleMech is capable of has also made it something of a scout, though it lacks sophisticated electronic equipment. The Piranha is protected mostly by its speed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 食人鱼由钻石鲨氏族开发，用于对抗常规步兵和轻型车辆。这台战斗机甲所能达到的纯粹速度也使它多少充当侦察兵，尽管它缺乏精密电子设备。食人鱼主要靠速度自保。

Original: The Piranha's main threat is its twelve Series XII Rotary Machine Guns. These are a serious threat to any foe on such a speedy 'Mech, especially if a Star of Piranhas operate in a pack, and such a large array allows the 'Mech to chew through an opponent's rear armor almost instantly. They are most deadly, however, to unarmored infantry, capable of wiping out an entire company in seconds. For work against hardened targets, the Piranha mounts a pair of Mk. 3 ER Medium Lasers and a single Series 1 ER Small Laser. Since the design only uses ten single heat sinks, the MechWarrior must still manage heat levels. The ammunition dependency of the Machine Guns ensure that Piranhas must stay close to supply lines, so most have been relegated to solahma or garrison roles.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_piranha_PIR-1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Piranha's main threat is its twelve Series XII Rotary Machine Guns. These are a serious threat to any foe on such a speedy 'Mech, especially if a Star of Piranhas operate in a pack, and such a large array allows the 'Mech to chew through an opponent's rear armor almost instantly. They are most deadly, however, to unarmored infantry, capable of wiping out an entire company in seconds. For work against hardened targets, the Piranha mounts a pair of Mk. 3 ER Medium Lasers and a single Series 1 ER Small Laser. Since the design only uses ten single heat sinks, the MechWarrior must still manage heat levels. The ammunition dependency of the Machine Guns ensure that Piranhas must stay close to supply lines, so most have been relegated to solahma or garrison roles.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 食人鱼的主要威胁是它的十二挺 XII 系列旋转机枪。在一台如此快速的机甲上，这对任何敌人都是严重威胁，尤其当一个"星"的食人鱼成群作战时；如此庞大的阵列让机甲几乎瞬间啃穿对手的背部装甲。不过它们对无装甲步兵最为致命，能在数秒内歼灭一整连。对付硬化目标时，食人鱼装有双联 Mk. 3 ER 中型激光和一门 1 系列 ER 小型激光。由于该设计仅使用十台单散热器，机甲战士仍须管理热量水平。机枪对弹药的依赖使食人鱼必须靠近补给线，因此大多数被降级到索拉马或驻防任务。

Original: Quickdraw 4Gs are among the fastest and most maneuverable of heavy 'Mechs, with decent weaponry. They suffer from problematic heat buildup when using all their features at once, so some caution is needed.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_quickdraw_QKD-4G.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Quickdraw 4Gs are among the fastest and most maneuverable of heavy 'Mechs, with decent weaponry. They suffer from problematic heat buildup when using all their features at once, so some caution is needed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 快枪手 4G 是重型机甲中最快、最机动的一类，武器也相当不错。同时使用全部功能时会出现棘手的过热问题，因此需要一些谨慎。

Original: Quickdraw 4Hs are among the fastest and most maneuverable of heavy 'Mechs, with decent weaponry. They suffer from problematic heat buildup when using all their features at once, so some caution is needed.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_quickdraw_QKD-4H.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Quickdraw 4Hs are among the fastest and most maneuverable of heavy 'Mechs, with decent weaponry. They suffer from problematic heat buildup when using all their features at once, so some caution is needed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 快枪手 4H 是重型机甲中最快、最机动的一类，武器也相当不错。同时使用全部功能时会出现棘手的过热问题，因此需要一些谨慎。

Original: The Quickdraw 5A was designed to give the 'Mech more endurance than the stock 4G. By removing the LRM-10, two additional Medium Lasers and four additional Heat Sinks could be mounted. Unfortunately, the 5A still runs too hot for most pilots.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_quickdraw_QKD-5A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Quickdraw 5A was designed to give the 'Mech more endurance than the stock 4G. By removing the LRM-10, two additional Medium Lasers and four additional Heat Sinks could be mounted. Unfortunately, the 5A still runs too hot for most pilots.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 快手 5A 的设计目标是为机甲提供比标准 4G 更强的续航力。通过移除 LRM-10，可以加装两门额外中型激光和四台额外散热器。遗憾的是，5A 对大多数飞行员而言仍然过热。

Original: The 5K Quickdraw is an upgraded variant using Star League technology produced by Luthien Armor Works in 3049. Carrying the same weaponry as the 5A model, its use of seventeen double heat sinks solves the problem of excessive waste heat. It also uses Ferro-Fibrous armor, giving the 5K superior armor protection to the 5A model, with no added weight.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_quickdraw_QKD-5K.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5K Quickdraw is an upgraded variant using Star League technology produced by Luthien Armor Works in 3049. Carrying the same weaponry as the 5A model, its use of seventeen double heat sinks solves the problem of excessive waste heat. It also uses Ferro-Fibrous armor, giving the 5K superior armor protection to the 5A model, with no added weight.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5K 快枪手是卢西恩装甲工厂于 3049 年使用星盟科技生产的升级变体。它携带与 5A 型号相同的武器，但使用十七台双倍散热器解决了废热过多的问题。它还使用铁纤维装甲，使 5K 在不增加重量的情况下拥有优于 5A 的装甲防护。

Original: The Rakshasa was designed by engineers at the New Avalon Institute of Science in an attempt to copy the Mad Cat . The finished product, while not as powerful as the OmniMech it emulates, is a powerful 'Mech with an undeserved bad reputation. The Rakshasa is powered by a GM 375 XL engine and built on a GM Marauder Special MD Endo Steel chassis to save weight and allow the 'Mech to carry as similar a weapons payload as possible to the Mad Cat.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_rakshasa_MDG-1A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Rakshasa was designed by engineers at the New Avalon Institute of Science in an attempt to copy the Mad Cat . The finished product, while not as powerful as the OmniMech it emulates, is a powerful 'Mech with an undeserved bad reputation. The Rakshasa is powered by a GM 375 XL engine and built on a GM Marauder Special MD Endo Steel chassis to save weight and allow the 'Mech to carry as similar a weapons payload as possible to the Mad Cat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 罗刹由新阿瓦隆科学院的工程师设计，试图复制疯猫。成品虽然不如它所模仿的全能机甲强大，却是一台强悍的机甲，背负着不该有的坏名声。罗刹由一台 GM 375 XL 引擎驱动，基于"GM 掠夺者特种 MD"内骨骼底盘建造，以减轻重量并使机甲能携带尽可能接近疯猫的武器载荷。

Original: The Raptor began as a proof of concept design by Luthien Armor Works that turned into a respected recon and fast strike OmniMech. The Raptor is built on an Alshain Type KR140 Endo Steel chassis and uses a weight-saving Omni 175 XL Engine, which gives the Raptor a top speed of 118.8 kph.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_raptor_RTX1-O.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Raptor began as a proof of concept design by Luthien Armor Works that turned into a respected recon and fast strike OmniMech. The Raptor is built on an Alshain Type KR140 Endo Steel chassis and uses a weight-saving Omni 175 XL Engine, which gives the Raptor a top speed of 118.8 kph.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猛禽最初是卢西恩装甲工厂的概念验证设计，后来成为广受尊重的侦察与快速打击全能机甲。它建立在 Alshain KR140 型内骨骼底盘上，使用节省重量的 Omni 175 XL 引擎，最高速度达 118.8 公里/小时。

Original: The Raptor A is intended for extended operations from supply lines. The Raptor A carries as its primary weapons two Large Lasers and for close range combat the A configuration carries three Small Lasers.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_raptor_RTX1-OA.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Raptor A is intended for extended operations from supply lines. The Raptor A carries as its primary weapons two Large Lasers and for close range combat the A configuration carries three Small Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猛禽 A 意在远离补给线执行长期任务。它以两门大型激光为主武器，近战方面 A 配置携带三门小型激光。

Original: The B configuration carries three SRM-6 launchers and a Small Laser. This configuration is intended for close combat and works well in a vehicle-hunting role as well as in mop up operations.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_raptor_RTX1-OB.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The B configuration carries three SRM-6 launchers and a Small Laser. This configuration is intended for close combat and works well in a vehicle-hunting role as well as in mop up operations.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: B 配置携带三具 SRM-6 发射器和一门小型激光。此配置为近战设计，在反车辆任务和清剿行动中都表现出色。

Original: Configured for medium to close range combat, the C configuration of the Raptor is built to swoop in on a target and overwhelm an enemy with fire from its six Medium Lasers and two Small Pulse Lasers and adds two more double heat sinks. For missile defense the Raptor C carries an Anti-Missile System.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_raptor_RTX1-OC.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Configured for medium to close range combat, the C configuration of the Raptor is built to swoop in on a target and overwhelm an enemy with fire from its six Medium Lasers and two Small Pulse Lasers and adds two more double heat sinks. For missile defense the Raptor C carries an Anti-Missile System.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猛禽 C 配置为中近距离战斗而设，旨在扑向目标，用六门中型激光和两门小型脉冲激光压制敌人，并加装两台额外双倍散热器。导弹防御方面，猛禽 C 携带一套反导系统。

Original: Loaded with advanced electronic equipment, the D configuration carries a TAG laser designator, a Beagle Active Probe, and a C3 Slave unit. The Raptor D is armed with a short-range arsenal of three Streak SRM-2 launchers and two Small Lasers. To deter infantry attacks, the D configuration has two Machine Guns. The combination of a Beagle Active Probe with TAG and a C3 slave make the Raptor D an excellent point 'Mech for light C3 lances, since it is able to share targeting information with allied units and also find hidden units and designate them for highly accurate artillery fire.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_raptor_RTX1-OD.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Loaded with advanced electronic equipment, the D configuration carries a TAG laser designator, a Beagle Active Probe, and a C3 Slave unit. The Raptor D is armed with a short-range arsenal of three Streak SRM-2 launchers and two Small Lasers. To deter infantry attacks, the D configuration has two Machine Guns. The combination of a Beagle Active Probe with TAG and a C3 slave make the Raptor D an excellent point 'Mech for light C3 lances, since it is able to share targeting information with allied units and also find hidden units and designate them for highly accurate artillery fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: D 配置装载先进电子设备，携带 TAG 激光指示器、比格犬主动探测器和一台 C3 从属单元。猛禽 D 以三具连续 SRM-2 发射器和两门小型激光构成近程武器库。为威慑步兵攻击，D 配置有两挺机枪。比格犬主动探测器加 TAG 与 C3 从属单元的组合，使猛禽 D 成为轻型 C3 小队的优秀先锋机甲，因为它能与友军共享瞄准信息，也能发现隐藏单位并为高精度炮火标记它们。

Original: A medium range missile barrage 'Mech, the E configuration carries three MRM-10 launchers with a single Small Laser as a backup weapon.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_raptor_RTX1-OE.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A medium range missile barrage 'Mech, the E configuration carries three MRM-10 launchers with a single Small Laser as a backup weapon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: E 配置是一款中程导弹弹幕机甲，携带三具 MRM-10 发射器，以一门小型激光作为备用武器。

Original: Similar to the C configuration, the F configuration of the Raptor carries five ER Medium Lasers and adds three additional double heat sinks. The Raptor F has added maneuverability with the addition of seven jump jets, allowing it to jump up to two hundred and ten meters.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_raptor_RTX1-OF.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Similar to the C configuration, the F configuration of the Raptor carries five ER Medium Lasers and adds three additional double heat sinks. The Raptor F has added maneuverability with the addition of seven jump jets, allowing it to jump up to two hundred and ten meters.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 与 C 配置相似，猛禽 F 配置携带五门 ER 中型激光，并加装三台额外双倍散热器。猛禽 F 通过加装七个跳跃推进器提升机动性，可跳跃至二百一十米。

Original: A field upgrade developed in the midst of Operation Bulldog, this configuration utilized captured Clan Smoke Jaguar weapons to help bolster the SLDF forces in later waves. This configuration mounts an array of Clan-tech Extended Range Lasers, with an ER Large and medium in each arm and a ER Small Laser beside a C3 Slave unit in the center torso.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_raptor_RTX1-OR.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A field upgrade developed in the midst of Operation Bulldog, this configuration utilized captured Clan Smoke Jaguar weapons to help bolster the SLDF forces in later waves. This configuration mounts an array of Clan-tech Extended Range Lasers, with an ER Large and medium in each arm and a ER Small Laser beside a C3 Slave unit in the center torso.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此配置是"斗牛犬"行动期间开发的野战升级，利用缴获的烟虎氏族武器帮助增强后期波次的星盟防卫军部队。此配置装备一系列氏族科技增程激光：每臂一门 ER 大型和一门 ER 中型，中央躯干一门 ER 小型激光与一台 C3 从属单元并列。

Original: The Rifleman II was an upgrade fielded by the SLDF Royals in 2720, adding twenty tons to its overall mass. The Rifleman II used an Endo Steel structure and an XL Engine, and carried a pair of LB-X Autocannon/10s and Large Pulse Lasers, one in each arm, as well as a pair of Medium Lasers, a Beagle Active Probe, and fourteen Double Heat Sinks.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_riflemanII_RFL-3N-2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Rifleman II was an upgrade fielded by the SLDF Royals in 2720, adding twenty tons to its overall mass. The Rifleman II used an Endo Steel structure and an XL Engine, and carried a pair of LB-X Autocannon/10s and Large Pulse Lasers, one in each arm, as well as a pair of Medium Lasers, a Beagle Active Probe, and fourteen Double Heat Sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 步枪手 II 是星盟防卫军皇家部队于 2720 年装备的升级型，整体质量增加二十吨。步枪手 II 采用内骨骼结构和 XL 引擎，每臂各携带一门 LB-X 自动炮/10 和一门大型脉冲激光，另有两门中型激光、一具比格犬主动探测器和十四台双倍散热器。

Original: The second of two variants designed by Hanse Davion and debuting in 3026, the 3C removes the large lasers and autocannon/5s in order to mount a pair of Autocannon/10s in their place and add an extra ton of armor. Two tons of ammunition for the larger autocannons were carried in the right torso.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_rifleman_RFL-3C.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The second of two variants designed by Hanse Davion and debuting in 3026, the 3C removes the large lasers and autocannon/5s in order to mount a pair of Autocannon/10s in their place and add an extra ton of armor. Two tons of ammunition for the larger autocannons were carried in the right torso.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 汉斯·达维昂设计的两款变体中的第二款，于 3026 年首次亮相，3C 移除大型激光和自动炮/5，换上两门自动炮/10，并增加一吨装甲。两吨较大自动炮的弹药携带在右躯干。

Original: A Clan-tech retrofit of the standard Rifleman, the Rifleman C was used by Clan Jade Falcon second-line garrison forces during the invasion. This field modification removed all Inner Sphere weaponry, without altering any structural components of the original RFL-3N, and instead carried two Clan-tech Large Pulse Lasers and LB 5-X ACs split between the arms.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_rifleman_RFL-3N_C_.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan-tech retrofit of the standard Rifleman, the Rifleman C was used by Clan Jade Falcon second-line garrison forces during the invasion. This field modification removed all Inner Sphere weaponry, without altering any structural components of the original RFL-3N, and instead carried two Clan-tech Large Pulse Lasers and LB 5-X ACs split between the arms.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 步枪手 C 是标准步枪手的氏族技术改装版，在入侵期间由翡翠隼氏族的二线驻军部队使用。这次野战改装移除了全部内天体武器，但未改动原版 RFL-3N 的任何结构部件，改为在双肩分置两门氏族技术大型脉冲激光和 LB 5-X 自动炮。

Original: Designed as a medium fire-support platform, the Rifleman was plagued with a variety of problems since its debut and was ill-suited as a front-line combatant.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_rifleman_RFL-3N.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed as a medium fire-support platform, the Rifleman was plagued with a variety of problems since its debut and was ill-suited as a front-line combatant.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 步枪手被设计为中型火力支援平台，自问世以来便受各种问题困扰，并不适合担任前线战斗单位。

Original: The 4D was one of two variants designed by Hanse Davion; it was intended to compete with the heavier Warhammer. It replaced the autocannon/5s with PPCs and removed the medium lasers, using the freed-up weight to mount an five extra heat sinks. In spite of the extra heat sinks, this model suffered from significant overheat problems.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_rifleman_RFL-4D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 4D was one of two variants designed by Hanse Davion; it was intended to compete with the heavier Warhammer. It replaced the autocannon/5s with PPCs and removed the medium lasers, using the freed-up weight to mount an five extra heat sinks. In spite of the extra heat sinks, this model suffered from significant overheat problems.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 4D 是汉斯·达维昂设计的两款变体之一，意在对抗更重的战锤。它把自动炮/5 换成 PPC 并移除中型激光，用腾出的重量加装五台额外散热器。尽管增加了散热器，该型号仍受严重过热问题困扰。

Original: This variant removes all of the weapons and equipment, and replaces them with four Ultra Autocannon/2s and six tons of ammunition. The weight saved, plus a half ton from armor, is used to upgrade the engine to allow the 'Mech a top speed of 64 km/h. MechWarriors must be exceptionally wary of the large, vulnerable ammo bins.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_rifleman_RFL-IIC-2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant removes all of the weapons and equipment, and replaces them with four Ultra Autocannon/2s and six tons of ammunition. The weight saved, plus a half ton from armor, is used to upgrade the engine to allow the 'Mech a top speed of 64 km/h. MechWarriors must be exceptionally wary of the large, vulnerable ammo bins.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此变体移除全部武器与装备，换成四门超速自动炮/2 和六吨弹药。节省的重量加上半吨装甲用于升级引擎，使机甲最高速度达 64 公里/小时。机甲战士必须格外警惕那些庞大而脆弱的弹药箱。

Original: A modern Clan take on the classic Succession Wars era RFL-3N Rifleman, the A variant carries a Large Pulse Laser and Ultra Autocannon/5 in each arm, supported by an ER Medium Laser in each side torso. Built around a 260-rated XL Engine, Endo Steel frame, and ten tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, the A is fitted with sixteen Double Heat Sinks and four tons of UAC ammo.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_rifleman_RFL-IIC-A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A modern Clan take on the classic Succession Wars era RFL-3N Rifleman, the A variant carries a Large Pulse Laser and Ultra Autocannon/5 in each arm, supported by an ER Medium Laser in each side torso. Built around a 260-rated XL Engine, Endo Steel frame, and ten tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, the A is fitted with sixteen Double Heat Sinks and four tons of UAC ammo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是氏族对经典继承战争时代 RFL-3N 步枪手的现代演绎。A 变体在每臂装备一门大型脉冲激光和一门超速自动炮/5，两侧躯干各由一门 ER 中型激光支援。它以 260 级 XL 引擎、内骨骼框架和十吨铁纤维装甲为基础，配十六台双倍散热器和四吨 UAC 弹药。

Original: Simple, straightforward, and accurate; the Rifleman IIC is armed with four Large Pulse Lasers. This allows it to pick apart enemies from a respectable range, as well as easily target incoming aircraft. A single ER Small Laser is installed, seemingly as an afterthought. Nineteen double heat sinks keep heat mostly in check, though volley fire should be used.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_rifleman_RFL-IIC.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Simple, straightforward, and accurate; the Rifleman IIC is armed with four Large Pulse Lasers. This allows it to pick apart enemies from a respectable range, as well as easily target incoming aircraft. A single ER Small Laser is installed, seemingly as an afterthought. Nineteen double heat sinks keep heat mostly in check, though volley fire should be used.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 简单、直接而精准；步枪手 IIC 装备四门大型脉冲激光，使其能在相当远的距离拆解敌人，也能轻松瞄准来袭飞行器。一门 ER 小型激光像是事后想起才装上的。十九台双倍散热器基本能压制热量，不过仍应使用齐射。

Original: A militarized BattleMech version of Achernar's Loader King IndustrialMech, the Roughneck is a low-cost heavy 'Mech intended for price conscious buyers such as planetary militias and down-on-their-luck mercenary units. Featuring a mixed if short ranged weapons loadout, the Roughneck's primary weapons are an AC/10 and SRM-4 in its torsos, supported by a trio of Machine Guns and a head-mounted Small Laser. While tying it to supply lines, two tons of SRM and autocannon rounds provide adequate field endurance, only a ton and a half of rounds supporting three machine guns run dry quickly.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_roughneck_RGH-1A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A militarized BattleMech version of Achernar's Loader King IndustrialMech, the Roughneck is a low-cost heavy 'Mech intended for price conscious buyers such as planetary militias and down-on-their-luck mercenary units. Featuring a mixed if short ranged weapons loadout, the Roughneck's primary weapons are an AC/10 and SRM-4 in its torsos, supported by a trio of Machine Guns and a head-mounted Small Laser. While tying it to supply lines, two tons of SRM and autocannon rounds provide adequate field endurance, only a ton and a half of rounds supporting three machine guns run dry quickly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 粗汉是阿克尔纳装载之王工业机甲的军用战斗机甲版本，是一款低成本重型机甲，面向精打细算的买家，如行星民兵和落魄的佣兵部队。它的武器配置杂糅而偏近程，主武器是躯干上的 AC/10 和 SRM-4，辅以三挺机枪和头部一门小型激光。虽然这让它依赖补给线，但两吨 SRM 与自动炮弹药提供了足够的野战续航，仅有一吨半弹药支撑三挺机枪，很快就打光。

Original: A militarized BattleMech version of Achernar's Loader King IndustrialMech, the Roughneck is a low-cost heavy 'Mech intended for price conscious buyers such as planetary militias and down-on-their-luck mercenary units. The Roughneck-1B swaps the AC/10 of the -1A for an AC/5 and upgrades the missiles to a pair of SRM 6 racks. The Small Laser and two of the Machine Guns are retained.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_roughneck_RGH-1B.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A militarized BattleMech version of Achernar's Loader King IndustrialMech, the Roughneck is a low-cost heavy 'Mech intended for price conscious buyers such as planetary militias and down-on-their-luck mercenary units. The Roughneck-1B swaps the AC/10 of the -1A for an AC/5 and upgrades the missiles to a pair of SRM 6 racks. The Small Laser and two of the Machine Guns are retained.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 粗汉是阿克尔纳装载之王工业机甲的军用战斗机甲版本，是一款低成本重型机甲，面向精打细算的买家，如行星民兵和落魄的佣兵部队。粗汉-1B 把-1A 的 AC/10 换成 AC/5，并把导弹升级为两具 SRM 6 挂架。小型激光和其中两挺机枪得以保留。

Original: A militarized BattleMech version of Achernar's Loader King IndustrialMech, the Roughneck is a low-cost heavy 'Mech intended for price conscious buyers such as planetary militias and down-on-their-luck mercenary units. The Roughneck-1C leans hard on its missiles for firepower, carrying a pair of SRM 6s and a pair of Machine Guns for close range power, with long range firepower provided by a LRM 10 and an AC/5.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_roughneck_RGH-1C.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A militarized BattleMech version of Achernar's Loader King IndustrialMech, the Roughneck is a low-cost heavy 'Mech intended for price conscious buyers such as planetary militias and down-on-their-luck mercenary units. The Roughneck-1C leans hard on its missiles for firepower, carrying a pair of SRM 6s and a pair of Machine Guns for close range power, with long range firepower provided by a LRM 10 and an AC/5.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 粗汉是阿克尔纳装载之王工业机甲的军用战斗机甲版本，是一款低成本重型机甲，面向精打细算的买家，如行星民兵和落魄的佣兵部队。粗汉-1C 的火力重度依赖导弹，携带两具 SRM 6 和两挺机枪负责近程，远程火力则由一具 LRM 10 和一门 AC/5 提供。

Original: A militarized BattleMech version of Achernar's Loader King IndustrialMech, the Roughneck is a low-cost heavy 'Mech intended for price conscious buyers such as planetary militias and down-on-their-luck mercenary units. The Roughneck-3A is an advanced technology version of the Roughneck that makes heavy use of Double Heat Sinks to power an all-energy loadout of 2 PPCs, 4 Medium Lasers, and a solitary Small Laser. 18 Double Heat Sinks keep the mech nice and cool.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_roughneck_RGH-3A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A militarized BattleMech version of Achernar's Loader King IndustrialMech, the Roughneck is a low-cost heavy 'Mech intended for price conscious buyers such as planetary militias and down-on-their-luck mercenary units. The Roughneck-3A is an advanced technology version of the Roughneck that makes heavy use of Double Heat Sinks to power an all-energy loadout of 2 PPCs, 4 Medium Lasers, and a solitary Small Laser. 18 Double Heat Sinks keep the mech nice and cool.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 粗汉是阿克尔纳装载之王工业机甲的军用战斗机甲版本，是一款低成本重型机甲，面向精打细算的买家，如行星民兵和落魄的佣兵部队。粗汉-3A 是粗汉的先进技术版本，大量使用双倍散热器来驱动一套全能量配置：2 门 PPC、4 门中型激光和一门单独的小型激光。18 台双倍散热器让机甲保持凉爽。

Original: The 'Mech was also part of Khan Koga's attempts to revitalize the fading Clan that invented the OmniMech.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_savage_coyote_PRIME.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 'Mech was also part of Khan Koga's attempts to revitalize the fading Clan that invented the OmniMech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台机甲也是可汗科加重振发明全能机甲却日渐衰落的氏族的努力之一。

Original: The Sentry was developed under pressure from the Draconis and Capellan marches for a more advanced 'Mech to defend the borders of the Federated Suns. The 'Mech is built on a light weight Dorwinion hyperactive 3 Endo Steel chassis. This chassis saves weight, allowing the 'Mech to carry heavier weapons and equipment. The Sentry is powered by a Nissan 200 fusion engine that gives it a top speed of 86.4 km/h that is augmented by five HildCo Model 12 jump jets that make it possible for the Sentry to jump up to one hundred and fifty meters. To compensate for its less than average mobility, the Sentry has an impressive eight and a half tons of Starshield A armor that has been fitted with CASE to protect the 'Mech from an ammunition explosion.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_sentry_SNT-04.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Sentry was developed under pressure from the Draconis and Capellan marches for a more advanced 'Mech to defend the borders of the Federated Suns. The 'Mech is built on a light weight Dorwinion hyperactive 3 Endo Steel chassis. This chassis saves weight, allowing the 'Mech to carry heavier weapons and equipment. The Sentry is powered by a Nissan 200 fusion engine that gives it a top speed of 86.4 km/h that is augmented by five HildCo Model 12 jump jets that make it possible for the Sentry to jump up to one hundred and fifty meters. To compensate for its less than average mobility, the Sentry has an impressive eight and a half tons of Starshield A armor that has been fitted with CASE to protect the 'Mech from an ammunition explosion.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 哨兵是在德拉科尼斯与卡佩兰边疆区压力下开发的，旨在为保卫联邦太阳系边境提供一款更先进的机甲。机甲基于轻量化的"多温尼恩亢奋 3"内骨骼底盘建造。这一底盘节省重量，使机甲能携带更重的武器和装备。哨兵由一台日产 200 聚变引擎驱动，最高速度 86.4 公里/小时，并由五个希尔德科 12 型跳跃推进器增强，使哨兵能跳起至一百五十米。为弥补其低于平均的机动性，哨兵拥有令人印象深刻的八吨半"星盾 A"装甲，并加装 C.A.S.E. 以保护机甲免受弹药爆炸。

Original: At the beginning of this century, the leaders of Clan Nova Cat commissioned a new medium Mech that could compete with and outperform the Fenris. The Shadow Cat was the result.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_shadowcat_A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: At the beginning of this century, the leaders of Clan Nova Cat commissioned a new medium Mech that could compete with and outperform the Fenris. The Shadow Cat was the result.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 本世纪初，氏族诺瓦猫的领袖委托研制一款能与芬里斯竞争并超越它的新型中型机甲。影猫由此诞生。

Original: The original and considerably flawed prototypes were completed in 2680. Based on the Shadow Hawk SHD-2H, the 'Mech carried a Class 2 Autocannon in place of the Class 5. The SHD-X1 carried only 6.5 tons of armor for protection. Only one chassis survived multiple crashes caused by its faulty schematics. It had a top ground speed of 86.4 km/h like its progenitor, the SHD-2H, and used ten single heat sinks.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_shadowhawklam_SHD-X1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original and considerably flawed prototypes were completed in 2680. Based on the Shadow Hawk SHD-2H, the 'Mech carried a Class 2 Autocannon in place of the Class 5. The SHD-X1 carried only 6.5 tons of armor for protection. Only one chassis survived multiple crashes caused by its faulty schematics. It had a top ground speed of 86.4 km/h like its progenitor, the SHD-2H, and used ten single heat sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初且缺陷颇多的原型机于 2680 年完成。以影鹰 SHD-2H 为基础，该机甲以一门 2 级自动炮取代 5 级。SHD-X1 仅有 6.5 吨装甲用于防护。因其图纸错误导致多次坠机，仅有一台机体幸存。它的最高地面速度与前辈 SHD-2H 相同，为 86.4 公里/小时，并使用十台单散热器。

Original: Allied Aerospace won the SLDF's contract to produce a series of Land-Air mechs with a design based on the venerable Shadow HawkBattleMech. Allied gave their new Land-Air 'Mech the ability to convert directly into an Aerospace Fighter. While construction was completed in 2680, thanks to the chassis' numerous flaws, lackluster performance and a number of ill-fated and publicly witnessed test-flights disasters during SLDF reviews in 2682, Allied Aerospace was forced to go back to the drawing board. The more refined X2 variant faced considerable scrutiny by SLDF evaluators in 2684, successfully meeting the SLDF's requirements but still rejected thanks to its high fuel consumption and the bad press generated by the earlier X1. Twenty SHD-X2 were built for trials with potential customers, but failed to attract any interest. Ultimately Allied scrapped the Shadow Hawk LAM program in favor of what became the considerably more successful Phoenix Hawk LAM.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_shadowhawklam_SHD-X2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Allied Aerospace won the SLDF's contract to produce a series of Land-Air mechs with a design based on the venerable Shadow HawkBattleMech. Allied gave their new Land-Air 'Mech the ability to convert directly into an Aerospace Fighter. While construction was completed in 2680, thanks to the chassis' numerous flaws, lackluster performance and a number of ill-fated and publicly witnessed test-flights disasters during SLDF reviews in 2682, Allied Aerospace was forced to go back to the drawing board. The more refined X2 variant faced considerable scrutiny by SLDF evaluators in 2684, successfully meeting the SLDF's requirements but still rejected thanks to its high fuel consumption and the bad press generated by the earlier X1. Twenty SHD-X2 were built for trials with potential customers, but failed to attract any interest. Ultimately Allied scrapped the Shadow Hawk LAM program in favor of what became the considerably more successful Phoenix Hawk LAM.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 联合航空赢得星盟防卫军生产一系列陆空机甲的合同，设计以古老的影鹰战斗机甲为基础。联合航空让新型陆空机甲能直接变身为航空战斗机。虽然制造于 2680 年完成，但由于底盘缺陷众多、性能不佳，加上 2682 年星盟防卫军评审期间一系列不幸且公开可见的试飞灾难，联合航空被迫重头再来。更精细的 X2 变体于 2684 年接受了星盟评审员的严格审查，虽然成功满足星盟要求，却仍因高燃料消耗和早期 X1 造成的负面报道而被否决。二十台 SHD-X2 被造出来供潜在客户试用，却未能引起任何兴趣。最终联合航空放弃了影鹰 LAM 项目，转而投向后来相当成功的凤凰鹰 LAM。

Original: BRING THE LOG TO DISCORD SO WE CAN FIX THIS APPEARING OR GET REKTED AGAIN!
