Original: First introduced in 2467, this first generation of the Shadow Hawk employs early BattleMech technology in its weaponry, equipment and its armor. This design was first produced by Lang Industries on Caph, where it was designed as part of the Hegemony's efforts to keep ahead of the Inner Sphere's newly stolen BattleMech technology.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_shadowhawk_SHD-1R.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: First introduced in 2467, this first generation of the Shadow Hawk employs early BattleMech technology in its weaponry, equipment and its armor. This design was first produced by Lang Industries on Caph, where it was designed as part of the Hegemony's efforts to keep ahead of the Inner Sphere's newly stolen BattleMech technology.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 影鹰的第一代于 2467 年首次推出，其武器、装备与装甲都采用早期战斗机甲技术。该设计最初由卡夫星上的朗工业制造，是霸权为保持领先于内天体新近窃取战斗机甲技术的努力的一部分。

Original: The Shadow Hawk 2D is an interesting model. Its default payload sacrifices a lot of armor to mount a bit more firepower, though some argue the tradeoff isn't worth it. Its Alpha Strikes are better, though, so… I guess you can be the judge.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_shadowhawk_SHD-2D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Shadow Hawk 2D is an interesting model. Its default payload sacrifices a lot of armor to mount a bit more firepower, though some argue the tradeoff isn't worth it. Its Alpha Strikes are better, though, so… I guess you can be the judge.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 影鹰 2D 是个有趣的型号。它的默认配置牺牲大量装甲以搭载略多火力，尽管有人认为这笔交易不划算。不过它的全力齐射确实更好，所以…我想你可以自行判断。

Original: The Shadow Hawk 2H is the perfect example of a 'jack-of-all-trades.' It supports weaponry for all ranges, has respectable speed and jump capability, and mounts decent armor. This comes at the cost of excelling at nothing in particular.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_shadowhawk_SHD-2H.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Shadow Hawk 2H is the perfect example of a 'jack-of-all-trades.' It supports weaponry for all ranges, has respectable speed and jump capability, and mounts decent armor. This comes at the cost of excelling at nothing in particular.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 暗影鹰 2H 是"样样通吃"的完美范例。它具备适用于所有射程的武器，速度与跳跃能力可观，装甲也相当不错。代价是它在任何方面都不特别出众。

Original: The Shadow Hawk 2Hb was designed for the Star League's Royal regiments, which changed the mission profile to favor close range engagements exclusively. The -2Hb has little at range but is deadly dangerous up close thanks to its heavy weapons load.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_shadowhawk_SHD-2Hb.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Shadow Hawk 2Hb was designed for the Star League's Royal regiments, which changed the mission profile to favor close range engagements exclusively. The -2Hb has little at range but is deadly dangerous up close thanks to its heavy weapons load.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 影鹰 2Hb 为星盟皇家团设计，任务定位改为专门偏好近距离交战。-2Hb 在远距离几乎无能为力，但凭借重型武器装载，近身时极为凶险。

Original: The Shadow Hawk 2I variant comes with a UAC/10 coupled with a nasty Inferno Launcher, but in doing so sacrifices its jump capabilities.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_shadowhawk_SHD-2I.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Shadow Hawk 2I variant comes with a UAC/10 coupled with a nasty Inferno Launcher, but in doing so sacrifices its jump capabilities.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 影鹰 2I 变体配备一门 UAC/10 和一具凶恶的燃烧弹发射器，但为此牺牲了跳跃能力。

Original: The Shadow Hawk 2K removes all the armaments of the original, aside from its LRM-5, and replaces them with a single PPC.  Five additional Heat Sinks are also added to help with the excess heat.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_shadowhawk_SHD-2K.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Shadow Hawk 2K removes all the armaments of the original, aside from its LRM-5, and replaces them with a single PPC.  Five additional Heat Sinks are also added to help with the excess heat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 影鹰 2K 移除原版除 LRM-5 之外的全部武器，换成单门 PPC，并加装五台额外散热器以应对多余热量。

Original: The Shadow Hawk 2Ki was conceived during the First Succession War by the Draconis Combine in 2803. As the enraged Federated Suns pushed the Kuritan troops back, the Draconis Combine dramatically overhauled the chassis by replacing almost all of its original armaments, most notably swapping in an upgraded PPC in place of an Autocannon.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_shadowhawk_SHD-2Ki.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Shadow Hawk 2Ki was conceived during the First Succession War by the Draconis Combine in 2803. As the enraged Federated Suns pushed the Kuritan troops back, the Draconis Combine dramatically overhauled the chassis by replacing almost all of its original armaments, most notably swapping in an upgraded PPC in place of an Autocannon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 影鹰 2Ki 由德拉科尼斯联合体于 2803 年第一次继承战争期间构想。当愤怒的联邦太阳系将库瑞塔部队击退时，联合体大幅改造底盘，替换了几乎所有原始武器，最显著的是用一门升级版 PPC 换下自动炮。

Original: The 5M Shadow Hawk is the first complete overhaul and upgrade of the design, unveiled in 3048 by Earthwerks for the Free Worlds League. The chassis has been upgraded to an Earthwerks SHD II Endo Steel frame, an additional ton of armor was added, two additional jump jets were fitted for a total jumping distance of 150 meters, the engine replaced with an extralight version of the Hermes 275, and the weapons load has undergone an almost complete renovation. The original autocannon has been updated to an Imperator Ultra Autocannon/5, the LRM launcher to a Doombud LRM-20, and the head-mounted SRM launcher to a Hovertec Streak SRM-2. The amount of ammunition carried and the left-arm medium laser are maintained, and while the number of heat sinks was reduced to ten these were upgrade to double-strength models.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_shadowhawk_SHD-5M.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5M Shadow Hawk is the first complete overhaul and upgrade of the design, unveiled in 3048 by Earthwerks for the Free Worlds League. The chassis has been upgraded to an Earthwerks SHD II Endo Steel frame, an additional ton of armor was added, two additional jump jets were fitted for a total jumping distance of 150 meters, the engine replaced with an extralight version of the Hermes 275, and the weapons load has undergone an almost complete renovation. The original autocannon has been updated to an Imperator Ultra Autocannon/5, the LRM launcher to a Doombud LRM-20, and the head-mounted SRM launcher to a Hovertec Streak SRM-2. The amount of ammunition carried and the left-arm medium laser are maintained, and while the number of heat sinks was reduced to ten these were upgrade to double-strength models.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5M 影鹰是该设计的首次彻底翻修与升级，由地球工厂于 3048 年为自由世界联盟推出。底盘升级为地球工厂 SHD II 内骨骼框架，增加一吨装甲，加装两个跳跃推进器使总跳跃距离达 150 米，引擎换成赫尔墨斯 275 的超轻型版本，武器配置几乎全面翻新。原始自动炮升级为帝皇超速自动炮/5，LRM 发射器换为末日芽 LRM-20，头部 SRM 发射器换为霍弗泰克连续 SRM-2。弹药携带量与左臂中型激光保持不变，散热器数量虽减至十台但升级为双倍强度型号。

Original: Created by Maverick Industries, the 5MI is a redesign of House Marik’s 5M model. Designed to compete with the Griffin 1DS and other new designs, the 5MI was Mavericks attempt to win over the recalcitrant FedCom military. Focusing on improving survivability and battlefield endurance, the 5MI used new technology like DHS and an Artemis IV FSC to give it an edge. Unfortunately the design was deemed too expensive to produce and as a result the military declined to purchase any of the initial production run. Such poor performance led to the second manufacturing run being cancelled and resources diverted to more promising lines. The surviving models were sold off to various mercenary groups, though the Maverick Industries scion would use one during her time in the 10th Lyran Guards; netting the company the occasional conversion or custom order from fellow members of the regiment.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_shadowhawk_SHD-5MI.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Created by Maverick Industries, the 5MI is a redesign of House Marik’s 5M model. Designed to compete with the Griffin 1DS and other new designs, the 5MI was Mavericks attempt to win over the recalcitrant FedCom military. Focusing on improving survivability and battlefield endurance, the 5MI used new technology like DHS and an Artemis IV FSC to give it an edge. Unfortunately the design was deemed too expensive to produce and as a result the military declined to purchase any of the initial production run. Such poor performance led to the second manufacturing run being cancelled and resources diverted to more promising lines. The surviving models were sold off to various mercenary groups, though the Maverick Industries scion would use one during her time in the 10th Lyran Guards; netting the company the occasional conversion or custom order from fellow members of the regiment.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5MI 由马弗里克工业打造，是马里克家族 5M 型号的重新设计。为与狮鹫 1DS 及其他新设计竞争，5MI 是马弗里克试图赢得顽固的联邦联邦军方青睐的尝试。它聚焦于提升生存性与战场续航力，采用双倍散热器和 Artemis IV 火控系统等新技术以取得优势。遗憾的是该设计被认为生产成本过高，军方因此拒绝购买首批量产的任何一台。如此糟糕的表现导致第二批生产被取消，资源转向更有前景的产品线。幸存的型号被卖给各佣兵团体，不过马弗里克工业的继承人曾在第十莱兰卫队服役期间使用过一台；这为公司偶尔从该团同僚那里赢得改装或定制订单。

Original: The 5S is a variant of the 5M used by the Special Forces. It replaces all standard weapons with one Large Laser, one medium pulse laser and four medium lasers. In addition, it carries a Beagle Active Probe and an ECM Suite.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_shadowhawk_SHD-5S.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5S is a variant of the 5M used by the Special Forces. It replaces all standard weapons with one Large Laser, one medium pulse laser and four medium lasers. In addition, it carries a Beagle Active Probe and an ECM Suite.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5S 是特种部队使用的 5M 变体。它将所有标准武器换成一门大型激光、一门中型脉冲激光和四门中型激光。此外还携带比格犬主动探测器和一套 ECM 套件。

Original: A Clan Tech Shadowhawk. The first version of the Shadow Hawk IIC that Inner Sphere forces encountered is meant for close-range fighting, and appears to be designed with urban warfare in mind.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_shadowhawk_SHD-IIC-1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan Tech Shadowhawk. The first version of the Shadow Hawk IIC that Inner Sphere forces encountered is meant for close-range fighting, and appears to be designed with urban warfare in mind.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 氏族科技影鹰。内天体部队遭遇的第一版影鹰 IIC 是为近战而设，看起来在设计时考虑了城市战。

Original: A Clan Tech Shadowhawk. This variant is designed for long-range, direct-fire support.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_shadowhawk_SHD-IIC-2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan Tech Shadowhawk. This variant is designed for long-range, direct-fire support.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 氏族科技影鹰。此变体为远程直射支援而设计。

Original: A Clan Tech Shadowhawk. A newer variant that dates to the late 3050s, the IIC 3's main gun is a Heavy Large Laser.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_shadowhawk_SHD-IIC-3.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan Tech Shadowhawk. A newer variant that dates to the late 3050s, the IIC 3's main gun is a Heavy Large Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 氏族科技影鹰。较新的变体，可追溯至 3050 年代末，IIC 3 的主炮是一门重型大型激光。

Original: A Clan Tech Shadowhawk. First fielded in 3060, the IIC 4 was resulted in a 'Mech that is visually very different from the design it is considered a variant of.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_shadowhawk_SHD-IIC-4.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan Tech Shadowhawk. First fielded in 3060, the IIC 4 was resulted in a 'Mech that is visually very different from the design it is considered a variant of.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 氏族科技影鹰。于 3060 年首次投入战场，IIC 4 造就了一台在外观上与其所归属的设计大相径庭的机甲。

Original: The Shootist first saw service in 2621 as a heavily armored, electronic warfare-capable command 'Mech for SLDF Royal BattleMech Regiments. However, the Shootist's upgraded electronic suites proved no match for the cutting edge of electronic warfare of its own time. When the BattleMaster eclipsed the Shootist in its intended role as a command vehicle merely ten years after its introduction, the SLDF changed the Shootist's mission parameters. The Shootist's balanced mix of weapons and speed, and its heavy armor allowed it a new role: juggernaut for close-combat heavy lances, and later, a bodyguard unit for command lances. This role never proved favorable to the longevity of the Shootist; since the Succession Wars, this BattleMech is rarely seen outside of the ComGuards, Word of Blake Militia, and ancient Clan Brian Caches.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_shootist_ST-8A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Shootist first saw service in 2621 as a heavily armored, electronic warfare-capable command 'Mech for SLDF Royal BattleMech Regiments. However, the Shootist's upgraded electronic suites proved no match for the cutting edge of electronic warfare of its own time. When the BattleMaster eclipsed the Shootist in its intended role as a command vehicle merely ten years after its introduction, the SLDF changed the Shootist's mission parameters. The Shootist's balanced mix of weapons and speed, and its heavy armor allowed it a new role: juggernaut for close-combat heavy lances, and later, a bodyguard unit for command lances. This role never proved favorable to the longevity of the Shootist; since the Succession Wars, this BattleMech is rarely seen outside of the ComGuards, Word of Blake Militia, and ancient Clan Brian Caches.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 射击手于 2621 年首次服役，作为星盟防卫军皇家战斗机甲团的重视装甲、具备电子战能力的指挥机甲。然而射击手升级后的电子套件被证明敌不过同代最前沿的电子战。当战将在射击手推出仅十年后就在其预定的指挥车辆角色上超越它时，星盟防卫军改变了射击手的任务参数。射击手均衡的武器与速度搭配以及厚重装甲让它获得了新角色：近战重型小队的主宰者，后来又成为指挥小队的护卫单位。这一角色从未有利于射击手的长久存续；自继承战争以来，这台战斗机甲在康卫、布雷克之言民兵和古老的氏族布莱恩仓库之外已很少见到。

Original: Apparently based on the Timber Wolf, the Sidewinder OmniMech was developed by Clan Cloud Cobra in preparation for the Clan Invasion of the Inner Sphere. When it turned out that the Cloud Cobras would likely not be among the invader clans they became increasingly desperate and eventually fielded a Sidewinder against Clan Jade Falcon in a trial on Babylon that they lost. The Jade Falcons salvaged the heavily damaged 'Mech and all available information is based on their investigation of the design.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_sidewinder_SW-PRIME.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Apparently based on the Timber Wolf, the Sidewinder OmniMech was developed by Clan Cloud Cobra in preparation for the Clan Invasion of the Inner Sphere. When it turned out that the Cloud Cobras would likely not be among the invader clans they became increasingly desperate and eventually fielded a Sidewinder against Clan Jade Falcon in a trial on Babylon that they lost. The Jade Falcons salvaged the heavily damaged 'Mech and all available information is based on their investigation of the design.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 响尾蛇全能机甲显然以森林狼为基础，由云眼镜蛇氏族为准备氏族入侵内天体而开发。当发现云眼镜蛇很可能不在入侵氏族之列时，他们日益绝望，最终在巴比伦的一场试炼中派出响尾蛇对抗翡翠猎鹰氏族，但败北。翡翠猎鹰回收了严重受损的机甲，所有已知信息都基于他们对该设计的调查。

Original: Meant mostly as a high-speed fire support unit, the minimally-armored Sling was meant to remain out of the way of enemy fire, saturating the target area with its fifteen long-range missile tubes.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_sling_SL-1G.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Meant mostly as a high-speed fire support unit, the minimally-armored Sling was meant to remain out of the way of enemy fire, saturating the target area with its fifteen long-range missile tubes.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 投石索主要作为高速火力支援单位，装甲极少，意在远离敌方火力，用十五根远程导弹发射管饱和覆盖目标区域。

Original: Meant as a more traditional skirmish unit, the SL-1H replaced all three missile launchers with a pair of standard medium lasers and a single medium pulse laser.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_sling_SL-1H.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Meant as a more traditional skirmish unit, the SL-1H replaced all three missile launchers with a pair of standard medium lasers and a single medium pulse laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: SL-1H 意在成为更传统的散兵单位，它以一对标准中型激光和一门中型脉冲激光取代了全部三具导弹发射器。

Original: The Snake is a 'Mech that was built under the aegis of an Elemental hunter. With the power of hindsight though the Snake is clearly designed to hunt Inner Sphere Battle Armor suits. The 'Mech is built using a Vox 225 XL Engine to move at a top speed of 86.4 kph. The Snake also has a jumping capability of one hundred and fifty meters making it capable of outmaneuvering any battle armor suit and also keeping it on par with most medium 'Mechs. The Snake is also armored with seven tons of armor and uses double heat sinks to cool the 'Mech's excess heat.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_snake_SNK-1V.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Snake is a 'Mech that was built under the aegis of an Elemental hunter. With the power of hindsight though the Snake is clearly designed to hunt Inner Sphere Battle Armor suits. The 'Mech is built using a Vox 225 XL Engine to move at a top speed of 86.4 kph. The Snake also has a jumping capability of one hundred and fifty meters making it capable of outmaneuvering any battle armor suit and also keeping it on par with most medium 'Mechs. The Snake is also armored with seven tons of armor and uses double heat sinks to cool the 'Mech's excess heat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蛇是一台在"元素猎手"名义下建造的机甲。不过事后看来，蛇显然是为猎杀内天体战斗装甲服而设计的。机甲采用 VOX 225 XL 引擎，最高速度 86.4 公里/小时。蛇还具备一百五十米的跳跃能力，使其能胜过任何战斗装甲服，也能与大多数中型机甲并驾齐驱。蛇还披挂七吨装甲，并使用双倍散热器散发机甲的多余热量。

Original: The Spector was originally designed by Norse-Storm BattleMechs to be a lighter version of the Exterminator BattleMech, made to hunt down light command 'Mechs. The first Spector rolled off the assembly line on 6 June, 2639, and following extensive testing the SLDF ordered 600. The Star League's enthusiasm for the Spector is due to the BattleMechs stealth capabilities, a Chameleon Light Polarization Shield
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_spector_SPR-4F.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Spector was originally designed by Norse-Storm BattleMechs to be a lighter version of the Exterminator BattleMech, made to hunt down light command 'Mechs. The first Spector rolled off the assembly line on 6 June, 2639, and following extensive testing the SLDF ordered 600. The Star League's enthusiasm for the Spector is due to the BattleMechs stealth capabilities, a Chameleon Light Polarization Shield
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 幽灵最初由北欧风暴战斗机甲设计，作为灭绝者的轻型版本，用于猎杀轻型指挥机甲。首台幽灵于 2639 年 6 月 6 日下线，经大量测试后星盟防卫军订购了 600 台。星盟对幽灵的热情源于其隐形能力——变色龙光偏振护盾

Original: The 5D Spider is geared towards anti-infantry work, removing one of the medium lasers and replacing it with a Flamer in the right arm.  However, the combination of its speed with the Flamer can deliver an unpleasant surprise.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_spider_SDR-5D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5D Spider is geared towards anti-infantry work, removing one of the medium lasers and replacing it with a Flamer in the right arm.  However, the combination of its speed with the Flamer can deliver an unpleasant surprise.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5D 蜘蛛偏重反步兵工作，移除一门中型激光，在右臂换成火焰喷射器。不过它的速度与火焰喷射器的组合能带来不愉快的惊喜。

Original: An anti-infantry variant, the 5K mounts Machine Guns in each arm along with a single Medium Laser in its center torso.  In order to make room for the added weapons, a pair of JumpJets are removed, hampering some of the Spider's vaunted mobility.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_spider_SDR-5K.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An anti-infantry variant, the 5K mounts Machine Guns in each arm along with a single Medium Laser in its center torso.  In order to make room for the added weapons, a pair of JumpJets are removed, hampering some of the Spider's vaunted mobility.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5K 是反步兵变体，每臂安装机枪，中央躯干一门中型激光。为给新增武器腾出空间，移除了两个跳跃推进器，削弱了蜘蛛引以为傲的部分机动性。

Original: The Spider 5V is hands down the most maneuverable 'Mech you can field… but it's made of paper. It's an excellent scout, though, and can even jump into the rear arc of most enemies for surprise back shots.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_spider_SDR-5V.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Spider 5V is hands down the most maneuverable 'Mech you can field… but it's made of paper. It's an excellent scout, though, and can even jump into the rear arc of most enemies for surprise back shots.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蜘蛛 5V 毫无疑问是你能派上场的最灵活机动的机甲……但它纸糊一般。不过它是出色的侦察机甲，甚至能跳到大多数敌人的后方射界，来一记出其不意的背射。

Original: The 7M was Nimakachi's upgrade of the venerable Spider with recovered Star League technology. Released in 3051 it uses a Crucis-II Delux Endo Steel chassis and three tons of Kallon FWL Special Ferro-Fibrous armor, freeing up weight to replace the two medium lasers with two Tronel XII medium pulse lasers. Many of the components were also replaced with proprietary technology, including Rawlings 75 jump jets, an Omicron 4002 Networking Channel, and a TRSS Eagle Eye targeting system. One thing they could not do however was include an ejection system for the pilot.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_spider_SDR-7M.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 7M was Nimakachi's upgrade of the venerable Spider with recovered Star League technology. Released in 3051 it uses a Crucis-II Delux Endo Steel chassis and three tons of Kallon FWL Special Ferro-Fibrous armor, freeing up weight to replace the two medium lasers with two Tronel XII medium pulse lasers. Many of the components were also replaced with proprietary technology, including Rawlings 75 jump jets, an Omicron 4002 Networking Channel, and a TRSS Eagle Eye targeting system. One thing they could not do however was include an ejection system for the pilot.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 7M 是尼玛卡奇用回收的星盟科技对古老蜘蛛的升级。它于 3051 年发布，使用十字-II 豪华内骨骼底盘和三吨卡隆 FWL 特制铁纤维装甲，腾出重量把两门中型激光换成两门特罗内尔 XII 中型脉冲激光。许多部件也换成自有技术，包括罗林斯 75 跳跃推进器、奥米克戎 4002 网络通道和 TRSS 鹰眼瞄准系统。然而有一件事他们做不到：为飞行员加装弹射系统。

Original: The 8M is a simple upgrade of the 7M developed by the FWLM in 3060, replacing the single heat sinks with double strength versions. Otherwise, both variants are completely identical.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_spider_SDR-8M.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 8M is a simple upgrade of the 7M developed by the FWLM in 3060, replacing the single heat sinks with double strength versions. Otherwise, both variants are completely identical.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 8M 是 FWLM 于 3060 年开发的 7M 简单升级版，把单散热器换成双倍强度型号。除此之外，两个变体完全相同。

Original: This Draconis Combine variant, introduced in 3054 and based on the 7M, swaps out one of the pulse lasers for a standard medium and a C3 Slave Unit.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_spider_SDR-C.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Draconis Combine variant, introduced in 3054 and based on the 7M, swaps out one of the pulse lasers for a standard medium and a C3 Slave Unit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款德拉科尼斯联合体变体于 3054 年推出，以 7M 为基础，将其中的一门脉冲激光换成标准中型激光和一台 C3 从属单元。

Original: The Spider I1 is a cheap refit from the Frontier Worlds that comes with a Plasma Cutter and Fluid Gun, along with marginally improved armour.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_spider_SDR-I1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Spider I1 is a cheap refit from the Frontier Worlds that comes with a Plasma Cutter and Fluid Gun, along with marginally improved armour.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蜘蛛 I1 是边疆世界出品的廉价改装型，配备等离子切割器和流体枪，装甲也略有改善。

Original: The Stalker 3F mounts a ridiculous amount of weaponry—even for an assault 'Mech. It is also notable for its incredibly poor heat management, which is the cost it pays for such amazing damage output. Powerful, but to be used wisely.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_stalker_STK-3F.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Stalker 3F mounts a ridiculous amount of weaponry—even for an assault 'Mech. It is also notable for its incredibly poor heat management, which is the cost it pays for such amazing damage output. Powerful, but to be used wisely.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 潜行者 3F 装备的武器数量即便对突击机甲而言也荒唐得多。它还以极其糟糕的散热管理著称，这是它为如此惊人的伤害输出付出的代价。强大，但需明智使用。

Original: Created for the Star League's Royal regiments, the Stalker-3Fb is much like its lesser kin: a walking death machine. It carries a similar payload but makes use of lostech double heat sinks to cool down much more effectively, letting it fire continuously much longer than a normal Stalker-3F.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_stalker_STK-3Fb.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Created for the Star League's Royal regiments, the Stalker-3Fb is much like its lesser kin: a walking death machine. It carries a similar payload but makes use of lostech double heat sinks to cool down much more effectively, letting it fire continuously much longer than a normal Stalker-3F.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 潜行者-3Fb 为星盟皇家团打造，与其较弱的同类一样：一台行走的死亡机器。它携带相似的有效载荷，但使用失传技术双倍散热器更高效地降温，使其能比普通潜行者-3F 持续开火久得多。

Original: The Stalker 3H was intended as a seige 'Mech.  Replacing the twin LRM-10s and Large Lasers for paired LRM-20s, the STK-3H is a powerful fire support 'Mech.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_stalker_STK-3H.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Stalker 3H was intended as a seige 'Mech.  Replacing the twin LRM-10s and Large Lasers for paired LRM-20s, the STK-3H is a powerful fire support 'Mech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 潜行者 3H 本意是作为攻城机甲。STK-3H 以成对的 LRM-20 取代双联 LRM-10 和大型激光，是一款强大的火力支援机甲。

Original: By removing one of the LRM launchers and adding more Heat Sinks, the Stalker 4N can dish out more damage per round without as much fear of baking the pilot alive.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_stalker_STK-4N.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: By removing one of the LRM launchers and adding more Heat Sinks, the Stalker 4N can dish out more damage per round without as much fear of baking the pilot alive.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 通过移除一具 LRM 发射器并增加更多散热器，潜行者 4N 每回合能造成更多伤害，而不必太担心把飞行员活活烤熟。

Original: Due to ongoing structual weakness issues with the aging Stalker chassis, it was necessary to reduce the load by 10 tons by removing a LRM launcher effectively reclassifying this variant as a Heavy 'Mech.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_stalker_STK-4P.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Due to ongoing structual weakness issues with the aging Stalker chassis, it was necessary to reduce the load by 10 tons by removing a LRM launcher effectively reclassifying this variant as a Heavy 'Mech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由于老化的潜行者底盘持续存在结构强度问题，有必要移除一具 LRM 发射器以减载 10 吨，这实际上把该变体重新归类为重型机甲。

Original: The Stealth is a heavy scout 'Mech that is in use by the Federated Suns and the Lyran Alliance. The 'Mech has a GM 315 XL Engine that allows the Stealth to move at speeds of 118.8 kph and the MASC system on board can push the 'Mech to 151.2 kph in short bursts. This amazing mobility is augmented by jump jets which the Stealth can use to jump up to two hundred and ten meters. The Stealth is also outfitted with a Cyclops-Beagle Sensory Active Probe that the Stealth can use to find hidden enemy units.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_stealth_STH-1D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Stealth is a heavy scout 'Mech that is in use by the Federated Suns and the Lyran Alliance. The 'Mech has a GM 315 XL Engine that allows the Stealth to move at speeds of 118.8 kph and the MASC system on board can push the 'Mech to 151.2 kph in short bursts. This amazing mobility is augmented by jump jets which the Stealth can use to jump up to two hundred and ten meters. The Stealth is also outfitted with a Cyclops-Beagle Sensory Active Probe that the Stealth can use to find hidden enemy units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐形是联邦太阳系与莱兰联盟使用的重型侦察机甲。它采用 GM 315 XL 引擎，速度可达 118.8 公里/小时，机上的 MASC 系统可在短促爆发中推至 151.2 公里/小时。这一惊人机动性由跳跃推进器进一步增强，隐形可跳跃至二百一十米。它还配备了独眼巨人-比格犬主动探测器，可用于寻找隐藏的敌方单位。

Original: The Stiletto was engineered in a similar vein as the Black Hawk-KU or the Rakshasa, using examples of Fire Falcon OmniMechs salvaged from the battlefield immediately following the Battle of Coventry. The Stiletto has an identical speed profile as the Fire Falcon with a VOX 280 Light Engine giving it a top speed of 129.6 km/h.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_stiletto_STO-4A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Stiletto was engineered in a similar vein as the Black Hawk-KU or the Rakshasa, using examples of Fire Falcon OmniMechs salvaged from the battlefield immediately following the Battle of Coventry. The Stiletto has an identical speed profile as the Fire Falcon with a VOX 280 Light Engine giving it a top speed of 129.6 km/h.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 短剑的设计思路与黑鹰-KU 或罗刹相似，采用了在考文垂战役后立即从战场回收的火隼全能机甲样本。短剑的速度曲线与火隼相同，VOX 280 轻型引擎赋予它 129.6 公里/小时的最高速度。

Original: The original Stinger LAM used by the Star League Defense Force Royal Divisions, this version carried a Medium Pulse Laser and replaced the Machine Guns with Small Pulse Lasers. Double heat sinks kept the temperature manageable. It was also more heavily armored than its forerunner, carrying five tons of protection.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_stingerlam_STG-A1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Stinger LAM used by the Star League Defense Force Royal Divisions, this version carried a Medium Pulse Laser and replaced the Machine Guns with Small Pulse Lasers. Double heat sinks kept the temperature manageable. It was also more heavily armored than its forerunner, carrying five tons of protection.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是星盟防卫军皇家师使用的原始毒刺 LAM，此版本携带一门中型脉冲激光，并以轻型脉冲激光取代机枪。双倍散热器使温度可控。它的装甲也较前型更厚，携带五吨防护。

Original: In 2680, the Star League requested designers to develop 'Mechs which could fly as well as function as standard 'Mechs. The first Land-Air 'Mech off the drawing board, the Shadow Hawk LAM, proved so fatally flawed, the concept was almost shelved. However, LexaTech Industries reworked the conversion equipment and unveiled the first viable LAM, the Stinger LAM in 2688, based on the old Stinger design. LexaTech's reworking of the concept proved so successful, the Land-Air 'Mech became highly sought after, especially for space combat operations. In fact, the Stinger LAM first saw combat destroying a nuclear weapons facility in the Oort Cloud orbiting Sol, Terra's star. Found in the Draconis Combine, this variant uses two pairs of Martell Small Lasers on the arms instead of a single Medium Laser.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_stingerlam_STG-A10.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In 2680, the Star League requested designers to develop 'Mechs which could fly as well as function as standard 'Mechs. The first Land-Air 'Mech off the drawing board, the Shadow Hawk LAM, proved so fatally flawed, the concept was almost shelved. However, LexaTech Industries reworked the conversion equipment and unveiled the first viable LAM, the Stinger LAM in 2688, based on the old Stinger design. LexaTech's reworking of the concept proved so successful, the Land-Air 'Mech became highly sought after, especially for space combat operations. In fact, the Stinger LAM first saw combat destroying a nuclear weapons facility in the Oort Cloud orbiting Sol, Terra's star. Found in the Draconis Combine, this variant uses two pairs of Martell Small Lasers on the arms instead of a single Medium Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2680 年，星盟要求设计师开发既能飞行又能作为标准机甲运作的机甲。首款走下绘图板的陆空机甲——影鹰 LAM——被证明缺陷致命，该概念几乎被搁置。然而莱克萨科技工业重做了变身设备，于 2688 年推出首款可用的 LAM——毒刺 LAM，以老式毒刺设计为基础。莱克萨对概念的改造极为成功，陆空机甲变得极受追捧，尤其是在太空作战中。事实上，毒刺 LAM 首次参战就是摧毁太阳系恒星泰拉轨道上奥尔特云中的一处核武器设施。此变体见于德拉科尼斯联合体，臂部使用两对马特尔小型激光取代单门中型激光。

Original: In 2680, the Star League requested designers to develop 'Mechs which could fly as well as function as standard 'Mechs. The first Land-Air 'Mech off the drawing board, the Shadow Hawk LAM, proved so fatally flawed, the concept was almost shelved. However, LexaTech Industries reworked the conversion equipment and unveiled the first viable LAM, the Stinger LAM in 2688, based on the old Stinger design. In fact, the Stinger LAM first saw combat destroying a nuclear weapons facility in the Oort Cloud orbiting Sol, Terra's star. The standard production model uses three Magna Medium Lasers mounted on the head and arms.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_stingerlam_STG-A5.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In 2680, the Star League requested designers to develop 'Mechs which could fly as well as function as standard 'Mechs. The first Land-Air 'Mech off the drawing board, the Shadow Hawk LAM, proved so fatally flawed, the concept was almost shelved. The standard production model uses three Magna Medium Lasers mounted on the head and arms.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2680 年，星盟要求设计师开发既能飞行又能作为标准机甲运作的机甲。首款走下绘图板的陆空机甲——影鹰 LAM——被证明缺陷致命，该概念几乎被搁置。然而莱克萨科技工业重做了变身设备，于 2688 年推出首款可用的 LAM——毒刺 LAM，以老式毒刺设计为基础。莱克萨对概念的改造极为成功，陆空机甲变得极受追捧，尤其是在太空作战中。事实上，毒刺 LAM 首次参战就是摧毁太阳系恒星泰拉轨道上奥尔特云中的一处核武器设施。标准量产型使用三门玛格纳中型激光，分装于头部与双臂。

Original: The 3G Stinger was the only mainstream variant of the Stinger to achieve any sort of popularity prior to the Clan Invasion. First debuting in 2581, it traded the two machine guns for a second medium laser mounted on the left arm. While this variant increased the Stinger's lethality against other 'Mechs, it also made heat management a little more complicated for less experienced MechWarriors.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_stinger_STG-3G.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3G Stinger was the only mainstream variant of the Stinger to achieve any sort of popularity prior to the Clan Invasion. First debuting in 2581, it traded the two machine guns for a second medium laser mounted on the left arm. While this variant increased the Stinger's lethality against other 'Mechs, it also made heat management a little more complicated for less experienced MechWarriors.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3G 毒刺是氏族入侵前唯一获得某种程度普及的毒刺主流变体。它于 2581 年首次亮相，以装在左臂的第二门中型激光取代两挺机枪。虽然此变体提升了毒刺对其他机甲的杀伤力，但也让经验较少的机甲战士在散热管理上更麻烦一些。

Original: The SLDF improved upon the stock Stinger with the addition of many new technologies unavailable when the 'Mech was first designed. Designed as a fast, jump-capable reconnaissance platform, the Stinger has served capably in that role for well over half a millennium, a testament to the utility of the original design.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_stinger_STG-3Gb.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The SLDF improved upon the stock Stinger with the addition of many new technologies unavailable when the 'Mech was first designed. Designed as a fast, jump-capable reconnaissance platform, the Stinger has served capably in that role for well over half a millennium, a testament to the utility of the original design.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 星盟防卫军以多项在机甲最初设计时尚不可得的新技术改良了标准毒刺。作为一款快速、具备跳跃能力的侦察平台，毒刺在这一角色上已称职服役超过半个千年，印证了原始设计的实用性。

Original: Best to keep these units at range for flanking and spotting.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_stinger_STG-3R.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Best to keep these units at range for flanking and spotting.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最好让这些单位保持距离进行侧翼与侦察。

Original: This upgraded version of the Stinger produced by Earthwerks Incorporated on Keystone and Calloway VI took advantage of several technologies that were rediscovered, thanks in part to the Helm Memory Core. The chassis was upgraded to an Earthwerks STG II Endo Steel model, allowing it to carry an additional half-ton of armor. The 'Mech retained the Omicron medium laser but swapped the machine guns for a Lindblad Shotgun Anti-Missile System on its right arm and a Flame Tech Flamer on its left. One ton of AMS ammo was carried in the right torso, while the Datacom 26 and Dynatec 990 electronic systems remain unchanged.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_stinger_STG-5M.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This upgraded version of the Stinger produced by Earthwerks Incorporated on Keystone and Calloway VI took advantage of several technologies that were rediscovered, thanks in part to the Helm Memory Core. The chassis was upgraded to an Earthwerks STG II Endo Steel model, allowing it to carry an additional half-ton of armor. The 'Mech retained the Omicron medium laser but swapped the machine guns for a Lindblad Shotgun Anti-Missile System on its right arm and a Flame Tech Flamer on its left. One ton of AMS ammo was carried in the right torso, while the Datacom 26 and Dynatec 990 electronic systems remain unchanged.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款毒刺升级版由地球工厂公司在基斯通与卡洛威 VI 生产，得益于多项重新发现的技术，其中部分要归功于赫尔姆记忆核心。底盘升级为地球工厂 STG II 内骨骼型号，使其能多携带半吨装甲。机甲保留奥米克戎中型激光，但把机枪换成右臂的林德布拉德霰弹反导系统和左臂的火焰科技火焰喷射器。右躯干携带一吨 AMS 弹药，而 Datacom 26 与 Dynatec 990 电子系统保持不变。

Original: The design featured Large Pulse Lasers in each arm, twin Gauss Rifles mounted behind flip-open circular firing ports on each side torso, and an almost superfluous Small Pulse Laser located above the cockpit. The Stone Rhino also sported an interesting feature; each arm contained a retractable, shock-absorbing cowl covering the weapon barrels. This allowed MechWarriors to use the arms as battering rams without damaging the weaponry.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_stonerhino_STR-1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The design featured Large Pulse Lasers in each arm, twin Gauss Rifles mounted behind flip-open circular firing ports on each side torso, and an almost superfluous Small Pulse Laser located above the cockpit. The Stone Rhino also sported an interesting feature; each arm contained a retractable, shock-absorbing cowl covering the weapon barrels. This allowed MechWarriors to use the arms as battering rams without damaging the weaponry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该设计在每臂装备大型脉冲激光，两侧躯干各在翻开式圆形射击口后安装两门高斯步枪，驾驶舱上方还有一门近乎多余的轻型脉冲激光。石犀牛还有一个有趣特征：每臂都包含一个可伸缩的减震罩盖住炮管，使机甲战士能把手臂当攻城锤使用而不损坏武器。

Original: In order to plug holes in their touman, Clan Goliath Scorpion scientists revisited the Behemoth. Like Clan Smoke Jaguar before them, they upgraded and improved upon the design. This version used an Extra-light Engine to mount a pair of Thunderstroke Series 2b Gauss Rifles along the top of the 'Mech. Each arm carried a Series 4D-2 Heavy Large Laser, a Series 22a Heavy Medium Laser, and a General Systems Heavy Small Laser. It retained the shock-absorbing cowls of the original. Another pair of Heavy Mediums protected the rear of the 'Mech. A head-mounted Shield-3 Anti-Missile System defended against missiles, while an Anti-Personnel Pod in each leg discouraged unarmored infantry. This design had jump jets, nineteen tons of armor, and a meager sixteen double heat sinks.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_stonerhino_STR-2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In order to plug holes in their touman, Clan Goliath Scorpion scientists revisited the Behemoth. Like Clan Smoke Jaguar before them, they upgraded and improved upon the design. This version used an Extra-light Engine to mount a pair of Thunderstroke Series 2b Gauss Rifles along the top of the 'Mech. Each arm carried a Series 4D-2 Heavy Large Laser, a Series 22a Heavy Medium Laser, and a General Systems Heavy Small Laser. It retained the shock-absorbing cowls of the original. Another pair of Heavy Mediums protected the rear of the 'Mech. A head-mounted Shield-3 Anti-Missile System defended against missiles, while an Anti-Personnel Pod in each leg discouraged unarmored infantry. This design had jump jets, nineteen tons of armor, and a meager sixteen double heat sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 为填补图曼的缺口，歌利亚蝎氏族科学家重新审视了巨兽。如烟虎氏族先前所做，他们升级改进了该设计。此版本使用超轻型引擎，在机甲顶部安装两门雷霆系列 2b 高斯步枪。每臂携带一门 4D-2 系列重型大型激光、一门 22a 系列重型中型激光和一门通用系统重型小型激光。它保留了原版的减震罩盖。另外两门重型中型激光保护机甲后方。头部安装的盾-3 反导系统防御导弹，每条腿上的反人员荚舱则用于威慑无装甲步兵。该设计配有跳跃推进器、十九吨装甲和仅十六台双倍散热器。

Original: A variable range variant, the Stone Rhino 4 uses an XL Engine to provide weight savings for four LRM 10s to lay down impressive long range fire. Backing these up are a pair of Ultra AC-10s for mid-range engagements. From there, four ER Medium Lasers provide a solid short range punch. Lastly, four Machine Guns provide anti-infantry support. These combine to make a solid and well rounded configuration.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_stonerhino_STR-4.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A variable range variant, the Stone Rhino 4 uses an XL Engine to provide weight savings for four LRM 10s to lay down impressive long range fire. Backing these up are a pair of Ultra AC-10s for mid-range engagements. From there, four ER Medium Lasers provide a solid short range punch. Lastly, four Machine Guns provide anti-infantry support. These combine to make a solid and well rounded configuration.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 石犀牛 4 是一款全能射程变体，它使用 XL 引擎节省重量以搭载四具 LRM 10，倾泻可观远程火力。中距离交战由两门超速 AC-10 支援，四门 ER 中型激光提供扎实的近距离打击，最后四挺机枪提供反步兵支援。这些组合成一套扎实而均衡的配置。

Original: A design based off of early specifications for Amaris's Folly, the Stone Rhino 5 uses a 400XL engine to reach speeds up up to 64.8kph. It is armed with four LB-5X Autocannons mounted in the torsos backed up by six ER Medium Lasers in the arms.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_stonerhino_STR-5.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A design based off of early specifications for Amaris's Folly, the Stone Rhino 5 uses a 400XL engine to reach speeds up up to 64.8kph. It is armed with four LB-5X Autocannons mounted in the torsos backed up by six ER Medium Lasers in the arms.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 石犀牛 5 基于"阿马里斯之愚"的早期规格设计，使用 400XL 引擎达到最高 64.8 公里/小时的速度。它在躯干安装四门 LB-5X 自动炮，并以臂部六门 ER 中型激光作为补充。

Original: A close combat design based on the Stone Rhino 5, the Stone Rhino 6 is armed with a simple yet effective loadout of 14 Medium Pulse Lasers. These are backed up by a single ER Small Laser.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_stonerhino_STR-6.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A close combat design based on the Stone Rhino 5, the Stone Rhino 6 is armed with a simple yet effective loadout of 14 Medium Pulse Lasers. These are backed up by a single ER Small Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 石犀牛 6 是基于石犀牛 5 的近战设计，装备简单却有效的 14 门中型脉冲激光，并由一门 ER 小型激光支援。
氏族重新设计的"阿马里斯之愚"。

Original: The Stormcrow A is configured mainly for close combat.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_stormcrow_A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Stormcrow A is configured mainly for close combat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 风暴鸦 A 主要配置为近战。

Original: The Stormcrow B is another close combat configuration.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_stormcrow_B.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Stormcrow B is another close combat configuration.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 风暴鸦 B 是另一种近战配置。

Original: The Stormcrow C is armed with some of the most accurate weapons available to the clans.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_stormcrow_C.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Stormcrow C is armed with some of the most accurate weapons available to the clans.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 暴风鸦 C 装备了氏族所能获得的一些最精准的武器。

Original: A long range support configuration, the Stormcrow D has, as its primary weapons, a pair of LRM-20 launchers. These are backed up by two SRM-2 launchers for close combat.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_stormcrow_D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A long range support configuration, the Stormcrow D has, as its primary weapons, a pair of LRM-20 launchers. These are backed up by two SRM-2 launchers for close combat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 暴风鸦 D 是远程支援配置，以一对 LRM-20 发射器为主武器。它们由两具 SRM-2 发射器支援用于近战。

Original: Capable of engaging an enemy at any range, the Stormcrow E's primary weapons are a pair of ATM-9 launchers. These are capable of firing short, medium, and long range munitions. The launchers are backed up, for added close range firepower, by four ER Small Lasers and two ER Medium Lasers.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_stormcrow_E.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Capable of engaging an enemy at any range, the Stormcrow E's primary weapons are a pair of ATM-9 launchers. These are capable of firing short, medium, and long range munitions. The launchers are backed up, for added close range firepower, by four ER Small Lasers and two ER Medium Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 暴风鸦 E 能在任何距离上交战，主武器为一对 ATM-9 发射器。它们能发射短程、中程和远程弹药。为增强近程火力，这些发射器由四门 ER 小型激光和两门 ER 中型激光支援。

Original: A heavy laser-toting version of the primary configuration, the H has, as its main weapons, two Heavy Large Lasers. These are backed up by three ER Medium Lasers.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_stormcrow_H.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A heavy laser-toting version of the primary configuration, the H has, as its main weapons, two Heavy Large Lasers. These are backed up by three ER Medium Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: H 是主配置的重型激光版本，以两门重型大型激光为主武器。它们由三门 ER 中型激光支援。

Original: A pair of LRM-15 launchers provide long range firepower while each arm carries an ER Large Laser and ER Medium Laser. To ferret out hidden enemy forces, the Stormcrow I configuration mounts an Active Probe in the head.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_stormcrow_I.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A pair of LRM-15 launchers provide long range firepower while each arm carries an ER Large Laser and ER Medium Laser. To ferret out hidden enemy forces, the Stormcrow I configuration mounts an Active Probe in the head.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 两具 LRM-15 发射器提供远程火力，每臂则携带一门 ER 大型激光和一门 ER 中型激光。为搜出隐藏的敌军，暴风鸦 I 配置在头部安装一具主动探测器。

Original: A pair of LRM-15 launchers provide long range firepower while each arm carries an ER Large Laser and ER Medium Laser.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_stormcrow_L.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A pair of LRM-15 launchers provide long range firepower while each arm carries an ER Large Laser and ER Medium Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 两具 LRM-15 发射器提供远程火力，同时每臂各携带一门 ER 大型激光和一门 ER 中型激光。

Original: A sleek, mobile, and versatile design, the Lacerator comes equiped with 2 Clan AC5's with 2 medium lasers as backup. An AMS is installed for defense.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_stormcrow_LACERATOR.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A sleek, mobile, and versatile design, the Lacerator comes equiped with 2 Clan AC5's with 2 medium lasers as backup. An AMS is installed for defense.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一款流线型、机动且多用途的设计，撕裂者装备 2 门氏族 AC5，配 2 门中型激光作备用。为防御还装有一套 AMS。

Original: A sleek, mobile, and versatile design, the Clan Stormcrow was long suspected to be one of the first OmniMechs produced by the Clans.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_stormcrow_PRIME.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A sleek, mobile, and versatile design, the Clan Stormcrow was long suspected to be one of the first OmniMechs produced by the Clans.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一款流线型、机动且多用途的设计，氏族风暴鸦长期被认为是最早由氏族生产的全能机甲之一。

Original: The Strider OmniMech is based on the older Cicada BattleMech. The Strider is built on an Alshain Type KR240 Endo Steel chassis to help save on weight. Built with the rugged GM 240 fusion engine, the Strider has a top speed of 97.2 km/h. Outfitted with CASE, built around the durable GM 240, and protected with seven and a half tons of armor, the Strider is a durable 'Mech for its weight class; capable of suffering considerable damage before being disabled or destroyed.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_strider_SR1-O.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Strider OmniMech is based on the older Cicada BattleMech. The Strider is built on an Alshain Type KR240 Endo Steel chassis to help save on weight. Built with the rugged GM 240 fusion engine, the Strider has a top speed of 97.2 km/h. Outfitted with CASE, built around the durable GM 240, and protected with seven and a half tons of armor, the Strider is a durable 'Mech for its weight class; capable of suffering considerable damage before being disabled or destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 疾行者全能机甲以较老的蝉战斗机甲为基础。它采用 Alshain KR240 型内骨骼底盘以减轻重量。配备坚固的 GM 240 聚变引擎，疾行者最高速度达 97.2 公里/小时。它装有 C.A.S.E.、以耐用的 GM 240 为核心，并有七吨半装甲防护，在同重量级中属耐久型机甲；在瘫痪或被摧毁前能承受相当可观的损伤。

Original: For long range combat, the Summoner A has a powerful Gauss Rifle which is supported by a Large Pulse Laser for intermediate ranges and an SRM-6 launcher for close combat.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_summoner_A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: For long range combat, the Summoner A has a powerful Gauss Rifle which is supported by a Large Pulse Laser for intermediate ranges and an SRM-6 launcher for close combat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 远程战斗中，召唤者 A 有一门强劲的高斯步枪，配一门大型脉冲激光负责中距离，以及一具 SRM-6 发射器负责近战。

Original: A missile bombardment configuration, the B configuration carries a pair of LRM-20 launchers for long range engagements. For close combat, the Summoner B has two SRM-4 launchers. A Narc Missile Beacon allows the Summoner to designate targets for missile fire from other friendly units. The Summoner B has further protection through the use of an Anti-Missile System which gives it increased protection from missile attacks.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_summoner_B.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A missile bombardment configuration, the B configuration carries a pair of LRM-20 launchers for long range engagements. For close combat, the Summoner B has two SRM-4 launchers. A Narc Missile Beacon allows the Summoner to designate targets for missile fire from other friendly units. The Summoner B has further protection through the use of an Anti-Missile System which gives it increased protection from missile attacks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 召唤者 B 是一款导弹轰炸配置，携带两具 LRM-20 发射器用于远程交战。近战方面，它有两具 SRM-4 发射器。一具 NARC 导弹信标让召唤者能为其他友军单位的导弹火力标记目标。召唤者 B 还通过一套反导系统获得进一步保护，提升对导弹攻击的防御。

Original: A close range brawler, the Summoner C is armed with a single ER Large Laser for long range sniping at enemy targets but truly comes into its own at close range. The 'Mech relies on a powerful Ultra Autocannon/20 for quick kill capabilities at close ranges. This is backed up by a highly accurate Streak SRM-6 launcher to seek out weak points in an enemy's armor and an ER Small Laser.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_summoner_C.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A close range brawler, the Summoner C is armed with a single ER Large Laser for long range sniping at enemy targets but truly comes into its own at close range. The 'Mech relies on a powerful Ultra Autocannon/20 for quick kill capabilities at close ranges. This is backed up by a highly accurate Streak SRM-6 launcher to seek out weak points in an enemy's armor and an ER Small Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 召唤者 C 是一款近战近战型，装备一门 ER 大型激光用于对敌方目标的远程狙击，但真正发挥威力是在近距离。机甲依靠一门强劲的超速自动炮/20 在近距离快速击杀。它辅以一具极为精准的连续 SRM-6 发射器以寻找敌方装甲弱点，以及一门 ER 小型激光。

Original: In its primary configuration the Summoner has a basic yet effective arsenal. The primary direct fire weapon is an ER PPC backed up by an LB 10-X Autocannon that can fire both standard and cluster ammunition. For fire support and bombardment, the Summoner has an LRM-15 launcher.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_summoner_PRIME.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In its primary configuration the Summoner has a basic yet effective arsenal. The primary direct fire weapon is an ER PPC backed up by an LB 10-X Autocannon that can fire both standard and cluster ammunition. For fire support and bombardment, the Summoner has an LRM-15 launcher.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 召唤者的主配置拥有基础却有效的武器库。主要直射武器是一门 ER PPC，辅以一门 LB 10-X 自动炮，可发射标准弹与集束弹。火力支援与炮击方面，召唤者有一具 LRM-15 发射器。

Original: A short-ranged brawler, the Sun Spider D carries a mammoth Ultra AC/20 in each arm, with just a pair of Heavy Machine Guns in the right torso as supporting weapons. Lacking in ranged weapons, an ECM Suite is fitted in the left torso to try and assist in closing with its foes so it can make full use of the four tons of Ultra ammunition and single ton HMG bin.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_sunspider_SNS-F.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A short-ranged brawler, the Sun Spider D carries a mammoth Ultra AC/20 in each arm, with just a pair of Heavy Machine Guns in the right torso as supporting weapons. Lacking in ranged weapons, an ECM Suite is fitted in the left torso to try and assist in closing with its foes so it can make full use of the four tons of Ultra ammunition and single ton HMG bin.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 太阳蜘蛛 D 是一款近战近战型，每臂携带一门巨型超速 AC/20，右躯干仅以两挺重机枪作为支援武器。由于缺乏远程武器，左躯干装有 ECM 套件以协助接近敌人，从而充分利用四吨超速弹药与一吨重机枪弹药。

Original: Almost a direct counter-point to the Prime, the A Config mounts twin Ultra AC/2s in each side torso, supported by an ER Large Laser in each arm if the two tons of Ultra reloads run dry. The config is rounded out by an extra Double Heat Sink.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_sunspider_SNS_A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Almost a direct counter-point to the Prime, the A Config mounts twin Ultra AC/2s in each side torso, supported by an ER Large Laser in each arm if the two tons of Ultra reloads run dry. The config is rounded out by an extra Double Heat Sink.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: A 配置几乎与主型号针锋相对，两侧躯干各装双联超速 AC/2，若两吨超速弹药耗尽，则每臂一门 ER 大型激光可顶上。配置以一台额外双倍散热器收尾。

Original: A mixed-range combatant, the Sun Spider B is built around a right-torso mounted Gauss Rifle, supported by a left-torso ER Large Laser and matched Streak SRM-6 and ER Medium Lasers in each arm. An Anti-Missile System and a Light Active Probe in the left torso prevent the B from being caught unaware, carrying two tons of Gauss and Streak reloads along with a single ton of AMS ammo and an extra double heat sink.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_sunspider_SNS_B.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A mixed-range combatant, the Sun Spider B is built around a right-torso mounted Gauss Rifle, supported by a left-torso ER Large Laser and matched Streak SRM-6 and ER Medium Lasers in each arm. An Anti-Missile System and a Light Active Probe in the left torso prevent the B from being caught unaware, carrying two tons of Gauss and Streak reloads along with a single ton of AMS ammo and an extra double heat sink.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 太阳蜘蛛 B 是一款混合射程战斗型，以右躯干的高斯步枪为核心，左躯干的 ER 大型激光以及每臂配对的连续 SRM-6 和 ER 中型激光为支援。左躯干的反导系统与轻型主动探测器使 B 不会被打个措手不及，它携带两吨高斯与连续导弹再装填、一吨 AMS 弹药和一台额外双倍散热器。

Original: The C configuration is a classic LRM Missile Boat, fitted with a pair of LRM-15s in each arm and supported by an LRM-20 in each side torso. Carrying six tons of LRM missiles, an extra double heat sink strives to try and keep the Sun Spider firing.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_sunspider_SNS_C.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The C configuration is a classic LRM Missile Boat, fitted with a pair of LRM-15s in each arm and supported by an LRM-20 in each side torso. Carrying six tons of LRM missiles, an extra double heat sink strives to try and keep the Sun Spider firing.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: C 配置是经典的 LRM 导弹平台，每臂装两具 LRM-15，每侧躯干各一具 LRM-20 支援。携带六吨 LRM 导弹，一台额外双倍散热器努力让太阳蜘蛛保持开火。

Original: A short-ranged brawler, the Sun Spider D carries a mammoth Ultra AC/20 in each arm, with just a pair of Heavy Machine Guns in the right torso as supporting weapons. Lacking in ranged weapons, an ECM Suite is fitted in the left torso to try and assist in closing with its foes so it can make full use of the four tons of Ultra ammunition and single ton HMG bin.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_sunspider_SNS_D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A short-ranged brawler, the Sun Spider D carries a mammoth Ultra AC/20 in each arm, with just a pair of Heavy Machine Guns in the right torso as supporting weapons. Lacking in ranged weapons, an ECM Suite is fitted in the left torso to try and assist in closing with its foes so it can make full use of the four tons of Ultra ammunition and single ton HMG bin.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 太阳蜘蛛 D 是一款近战近战型，每臂携带一门巨型超速 AC/20，右躯干仅以两挺重机枪作为支援武器。由于缺乏远程武器，左躯干装有 ECM 套件以协助接近敌人，从而充分利用四吨超速弹药与一吨重机枪弹药。

Original: The Sun Spider Prime is built for short-range combat and carries a pair of Streak SRM-6 launchers in each arm, supported at range by Ultra AC/10 and an ER Large Laser in the right and left torsos, respectively. Two tons of Ultra Autocannon reloads and three tons of Streak SRM missiles are more than adequate for Clan Trials.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_sunspider_SNS_PRIME.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Sun Spider Prime is built for short-range combat and carries a pair of Streak SRM-6 launchers in each arm, supported at range by Ultra AC/10 and an ER Large Laser in the right and left torsos, respectively. Two tons of Ultra Autocannon reloads and three tons of Streak SRM missiles are more than adequate for Clan Trials.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 太阳蜘蛛主型号为近战而设，每臂携带两具连续 SRM-6 发射器，远程则由右躯干的超速 AC/10 和左躯干的 ER 大型激光支援。两吨超速自动炮再装填与三吨连续 SRM 导弹对氏族试炼而言绰绰有余。

Original: Apparently based on the Supernova-2, the Supernova-A retains only a single ER Large Laser in each arm, mounting an Artemis IV FCS-equipped LRM-20 and Streak SRM-6 launcher in each torso. With a targeting computer linked to the large lasers, three tons of LRM missiles and four tons of Streak reloads give the A variant good endurance. Keeping the classic jump jets and boosting armor over primary variant, an Endo Steel frame and fitting only seventeen double heat sinks are used to free up the extra weight required for the missile launchers.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_supernova_SNV-A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Apparently based on the Supernova-2, the Supernova-A retains only a single ER Large Laser in each arm, mounting an Artemis IV FCS-equipped LRM-20 and Streak SRM-6 launcher in each torso. With a targeting computer linked to the large lasers, three tons of LRM missiles and four tons of Streak reloads give the A variant good endurance. Keeping the classic jump jets and boosting armor over primary variant, an Endo Steel frame and fitting only seventeen double heat sinks are used to free up the extra weight required for the missile launchers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 超新星-A 显然以超新星-2 为基础，每臂只保留一门 ER 大型激光，每个躯干装备一具配 Artemis IV 火控系统的 LRM-20 和连续 SRM-6 发射器。大型激光联动的瞄准计算机、三吨 LRM 导弹和四吨连续导弹再装填赋予 A 变体良好的续航。保留经典的跳跃推进器并在主变体基础上加强装甲，使用内骨骼框架并只装十七台双倍散热器，以腾出导弹发射器所需的额外重量。

Original: Somewhat of an anomaly, unlike its brothers the Supernova-C mounts its primary weapons in its torsos and secondary weapons in its arms; twin Large Pulse Lasers in each side torso supported by a ER Medium and Medium Pulse Laser in each arm. Built on the framework of the Supernova-2, the C mounts twenty-two double heat sinks.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_supernova_SNV-C.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Somewhat of an anomaly, unlike its brothers the Supernova-C mounts its primary weapons in its torsos and secondary weapons in its arms; twin Large Pulse Lasers in each side torso supported by a ER Medium and Medium Pulse Laser in each arm. Built on the framework of the Supernova-2, the C mounts twenty-two double heat sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 超新星-C 有些反常，与其兄弟们不同，它把主武器装在躯干、次要武器装在臂部：每侧躯干各两门大型脉冲激光，每臂则由一门 ER 中型激光和一门中型脉冲激光支援。C 型基于超新星-2 的框架建造，装备二十二台双倍散热器。

Original: While an exceptionally early design, the Talos by Vandenberg MilTech was a financial success and a long-standing general mech for the Taurian Defense Forces from its production in the 2530's well into the Succession Wars. An Autocannon/10, two LRM-5s, and an SRM-6 give the Talos weapons effective at multiple range bands while its 8.5 tons of armor give it some longevity on the battlefield.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_talos_TLS-1B.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: While an exceptionally early design, the Talos by Vandenberg MilTech was a financial success and a long-standing general mech for the Taurian Defense Forces from its production in the 2530's well into the Succession Wars. An Autocannon/10, two LRM-5s, and an SRM-6 give the Talos weapons effective at multiple range bands while its 8.5 tons of armor give it some longevity on the battlefield.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 虽然设计极早，但范登堡军工的塔洛斯取得了商业成功，自 2530 年代投产直到继承战争，一直是陶里安防卫军长期使用的通用机甲。一门自动炮/10、两具 LRM-5 和一具 SRM-6 使塔洛斯的武器在多个射程段都有效，而其 8.5 吨装甲赋予它在战场上一定的持久力。

Original: A relic of an earlier age, it’s a minor miracle this antique is still functional. Occasionally found through the frontier, surviving Taloses are a strange mix of new and old technology, bodged together by generations of different mectechs. Rarely seen and even more rarely fielded in battle, very few of these 500 year old designs still grace the modern battlefield, but those that do are treated with the respect and reverence, due to a centuries old design. The 1P is the ‘‘modern’’ adaption of the older 1B design and has proliferated in recent years, leading some to speculate that a cache of Talos or Talos parts has been found. Armed with a variety of local tech and a knock-off ecm suite, the 1P is a versatile design outfitted as a mid range brawler.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_talos_TLS-1P.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A relic of an earlier age, it’s a minor miracle this antique is still functional. Occasionally found through the frontier, surviving Taloses are a strange mix of new and old technology, bodged together by generations of different mectechs. Rarely seen and even more rarely fielded in battle, very few of these 500 year old designs still grace the modern battlefield, but those that do are treated with the respect and reverence, due to a centuries old design. The 1P is the ‘‘modern’’ adaption of the older 1B design and has proliferated in recent years, leading some to speculate that a cache of Talos or Talos parts has been found. Armed with a variety of local tech and a knock-off ecm suite, the 1P is a versatile design outfitted as a mid range brawler.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为更早时代的遗物，这台古董还能运转已是小小奇迹。偶尔能在边疆见到，幸存的塔洛斯是新旧技术奇异的混合体，由一代代不同的机甲技师拼凑而成。它们很少见，更罕见于战场，这些五百年前的设计几乎已不再现身现代战场，但少数仍在服役者因这数世纪之久的设计而备受敬重。1P 是较老 1B 设计的"现代"改型，近年数量激增，让一些人猜测有人发现了塔洛斯或其部件的储藏库。1P 装备多种本地技术与一套仿制 ECM 套件，是一款多用途设计，定位为中距离缠斗者。

Original: With the reintroduction of Helm Core LosTech, the Taurian Defense Force found themselves lagging behind their neighbours. Just as they did during the Age of War, the Taurians turned to the home grown Talos. With a reputation as an easy to maintain and easy to manufacture mech, the design was just what the TDF needed. Lacking the resources to turn the newly redesigned Talos into a viable production model, the Taurians enlisted the aid of their neighbours, in exchange for joining the ongoing Trinity Alliance negotiations. Aided by the expertise of Capellan engineers and financial investment from the Magistracy of Canopus, Vandenburg started limited manufacturing of the Talos; at their New Vandenburg plant: in late 3059. The formal signing of the Trinity Alliance, in 3062; awarded production licenses to both Majesty Metals and Detroit Consolidated Mech Works. Both companies swiftly opened their own lines, producing multiple variants of the Talos for their own use and for export further afield.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_talos_TLS-4A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: With the reintroduction of Helm Core LosTech, the Taurian Defense Force found themselves lagging behind their neighbours. Just as they did during the Age of War, the Taurians turned to the home grown Talos. With a reputation as an easy to maintain and easy to manufacture mech, the design was just what the TDF needed. Lacking the resources to turn the newly redesigned Talos into a viable production model, the Taurians enlisted the aid of their neighbours, in exchange for joining the ongoing Trinity Alliance negotiations. Aided by the expertise of Capellan engineers and financial investment from the Magistracy of Canopus, Vandenburg started limited manufacturing of the Talos; at their New Vandenburg plant: in late 3059. The formal signing of the Trinity Alliance, in 3062; awarded production licenses to both Majesty Metals and Detroit Consolidated Mech Works. Both companies swiftly opened their own lines, producing multiple variants of the Talos for their own use and for export further afield.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 随着赫尔姆核心失传技术的重新引入，陶里安防卫军发现自己在邻国面前落后了。正如战锤时代那样，陶里安人转向了本土的塔洛斯。凭借易于维护、易于制造的名声，这一设计正是 TDF 所需。由于缺乏资源把重新设计的塔洛斯变成可行的量产型号，陶里安人向邻国求助，以换取加入正在进行的"三一联盟"谈判。在卡佩兰工程师的专业知识与卡诺普斯法域的财政投资帮助下，范登堡于 3059 年底在其新范登堡工厂开始限量制造塔洛斯。3062 年"三一联盟"正式签署，把生产许可授予 Majesty Metals 与 Detroit Consolidated Mech Works。两家公司迅速开设了自己的生产线，为自身使用并向外更远处出口而生产多种塔洛斯变体。

Original: Intended to emulate the Thor OmniMech used by the Clans, the Thanatos is an incredibly sturdy and hard-hitting design. Copying both the looks and the capabilities of the Clan Thor, the Thanatos is a fast all-range design, though it skimps on armor a bit for a mech its size. Carrying an ER Large Laser for long range and a brace of advanced medium lasers and a MRM-20 for medium to close range, the Thanatos has a weapon for any situation. Combined with a fast 86.4 km/h top speed and five jump jets, the Thanatos can often catch what it cannot out-range.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_thanatos_TNS-4S.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Intended to emulate the Thor OmniMech used by the Clans, the Thanatos is an incredibly sturdy and hard-hitting design. Copying both the looks and the capabilities of the Clan Thor, the Thanatos is a fast all-range design, though it skimps on armor a bit for a mech its size. Carrying an ER Large Laser for long range and a brace of advanced medium lasers and a MRM-20 for medium to close range, the Thanatos has a weapon for any situation. Combined with a fast 86.4 km/h top speed and five jump jets, the Thanatos can often catch what it cannot out-range.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 塔纳托斯旨在模仿氏族使用的雷神全能机甲，是一款极其坚固、打击力极强的设计。它同时复制了氏族雷神的外观与能力，是一款快速的全射程机甲，尽管就其尺寸而言装甲略显单薄。远程携带一门 ER 大型激光，中近程则有一批先进中型激光和一具 MRM-20，塔纳托斯拥有应对任何情况的武器。加上 86.4 公里/小时的快速最高速度和五个跳跃推进器，塔纳托斯常常能追上它无法在射程上压制的对手。

Original: This was the original Thunderbolt design produced in 2491 by Earthwerks Limited, built with Primitive Technology, until the introduction of the modern TDR-5S in 2505.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_thunderbolt_TDR-1C.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This was the original Thunderbolt design produced in 2491 by Earthwerks Limited, built with Primitive Technology, until the introduction of the modern TDR-5S in 2505.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是地球工厂有限公司于 2491 年生产的原始雷霆设计，采用原始技术建造，直到 2505 年现代 TDR-5S 问世为止。

Original: The so-called "Lost Thunderbolt", the 5L was a downgraded version of the Royal 5Sb Thunderbolt developed by Earthwerks Tikonov in 2823. Built on a more basic standard chassis, the now LosTech ER PPC was swapped for a Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Laser but most of the 5Sb's systems were preserved with only the loss of one double heat sink and the head-mounted Small Laser. Production of the design only lasted a mere twenty-seven years before further technology decline resulted in the 5LS.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_thunderbolt_TDR-5L.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The so-called "Lost Thunderbolt", the 5L was a downgraded version of the Royal 5Sb Thunderbolt developed by Earthwerks Tikonov in 2823. Built on a more basic standard chassis, the now LosTech ER PPC was swapped for a Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Laser but most of the 5Sb's systems were preserved with only the loss of one double heat sink and the head-mounted Small Laser. Production of the design only lasted a mere twenty-seven years before further technology decline resulted in the 5LS.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5L 即所谓的"失落雷霆"，是地球工厂提科诺夫于 2823 年为皇家 5Sb 雷霆开发的降级版。它建立在更基础的标准底盘上，如今已成失落科技的 ER PPC 被换成多元光学"日光束"ER 大型激光，但 5Sb 的大部分系统得以保留，仅损失一台双倍散热器和头部小型激光。该设计仅生产了短短二十七年，技术进一步衰退便催生了 5LS。

Original: Developed in 2850 as the Second Succession War saw more and more technologies disappear, the 5LS was a downgraded field refit and a factory model of the now impossible to build 5L. While the ER Large Laser and Starfish Small Pulse Lasers were retained, the standard LRM-15 and Bical SRM-2 rack were noticeably less accurate than the 5L's more advanced launchers, but nothing compared to the replacement of the 5L's double heat sinks with fifteen standard models and the heat management issues that resulted. Production of even the "primitive" 5LS would end during the Third Succession War.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_thunderbolt_TDR-5LS.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed in 2850 as the Second Succession War saw more and more technologies disappear, the 5LS was a downgraded field refit and a factory model of the now impossible to build 5L. While the ER Large Laser and Starfish Small Pulse Lasers were retained, the standard LRM-15 and Bical SRM-2 rack were noticeably less accurate than the 5L's more advanced launchers, but nothing compared to the replacement of the 5L's double heat sinks with fifteen standard models and the heat management issues that resulted. Production of even the "primitive" 5LS would end during the Third Succession War.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5LS 于 2850 年开发，当时第二次继承战争让越来越多的技术消失，它是对如今已无法建造的 5L 的降级野战改装与工厂型号。虽然保留了 ER 大型激光和"海星"小型脉冲激光，标准 LRM-15 和比卡尔 SRM-2 挂架的精度明显不如 5L 更先进的发射器，但这与把 5L 的双倍散热器换成十五台标准型号、以及由此产生的散热问题相比，根本不算什么。即便是"原始"的 5LS 也在第三次继承战争期间停产。

Original: The Thunderbolt 5S is well-armed and heavily armored for its size. It's often deployed as a frontline 'Mech where the fighting is heavy, and it needs to give as good as it gets.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_thunderbolt_TDR-5S.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Thunderbolt 5S is well-armed and heavily armored for its size. It's often deployed as a frontline 'Mech where the fighting is heavy, and it needs to give as good as it gets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雷霆 5S 就其尺寸而言武装精良、装甲厚重。它常被部署在战斗最激烈的前线，而它也必须能承受多少就还击多少。

Original: This SLDF Royal variant of the Thunderbolt was introduced in 2753 and uses Star League technology. An Endo Steel chassis provides more space for an updated weapon mix.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_thunderbolt_TDR-5Sb.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This SLDF Royal variant of the Thunderbolt was introduced in 2753 and uses Star League technology. An Endo Steel chassis provides more space for an updated weapon mix.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款星盟防卫军皇家版雷霆于 2753 年推出，使用星盟技术。内骨骼底盘为更新后的武器搭配提供了更多空间。

Original: Thunderbolt SE models lose a little of their firepower in exchange for mounting Jump Jets. The greater mobility is intended to allow for more precision attacking maneuvers, though it all depends on the battlefield terrain.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_thunderbolt_TDR-5SE.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Thunderbolt SE models lose a little of their firepower in exchange for mounting Jump Jets. The greater mobility is intended to allow for more precision attacking maneuvers, though it all depends on the battlefield terrain.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雷霆 SE 型号牺牲些许火力以加装跳跃推进器。更高的机动性意在实现更精准的攻击机动，不过这一切都取决于战场地形。

Original: Known for its superb heat management, the Thunderbolt 5SS hits hard at long range with its PPC and then closes to disable or destroy its target with close-range weaponry.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_thunderbolt_TDR-5SS.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Known for its superb heat management, the Thunderbolt 5SS hits hard at long range with its PPC and then closes to disable or destroy its target with close-range weaponry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雷霆 5SS 以出色的散热管理著称，先用 PPC 在远距离重击，然后逼近以近程武器瘫痪或摧毁目标。

Original: Build from derelict Thunderbolt chassis abandoned during Amaris Revolt carries this mech a cheap AC10 alongside 2 MRM10.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_thunderbolt_TDR-F4X.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Build from derelict Thunderbolt chassis abandoned during Amaris Revolt carries this mech a cheap AC10 alongside 2 MRM10.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台机甲由阿马里斯叛乱期间被遗弃的雷霆底盘重建而成，携带一门廉价 AC10 和 2 具 MRM10。

Original: The Timber Wolf is a fast, heavy OmniMech. A signature design of the Clans' military might, it was arguably the first Clan OmniMech encountered by Inner Sphere forces on The Rock by Phelan Kell. Vaguely resembling a cross-over between the MAD (Marauder) and CAT (Catapult) series, the Timber Wolf was tagged with the Inner Sphere reporting name Mad Cat on first contact.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_timberwolf_TW-A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Timber Wolf is a fast, heavy OmniMech. A signature design of the Clans' military might, it was arguably the first Clan OmniMech encountered by Inner Sphere forces on The Rock by Phelan Kell. Vaguely resembling a cross-over between the MAD (Marauder) and CAT (Catapult) series, the Timber Wolf was tagged with the Inner Sphere reporting name Mad Cat on first contact.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 森林狼是一款高速重型全能机甲。作为氏族军事力量的标志性设计，它可以说是内天体部队在"岩石"星上由菲兰·凯尔首次遭遇的氏族全能机甲。因其隐约呈现出 MAD（掠夺者）与 CAT（投石机）系列的杂交特征，森林狼在首次接触时被内天体冠以"疯猫"的报告代号。
