Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是狼犬的最初型号，自 3028 年生产至 WLF-2 变体问世。赫尔姆记忆核心之前的 WLF-1 主武器是标准"塞坦塔"大型激光，打击距离短于后来的型号，其十台标准散热器散发废热的能力也不如 WLF-2 使用的较新型双倍散热器。

Original: A common field refit employed by some MechWarriors, this model simply removes the rear mounted medium laser and adds an extra heat sink.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_wolfhound_WLF-1A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A common field refit employed by some MechWarriors, this model simply removes the rear mounted medium laser and adds an extra heat sink.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一些机甲战士常用的野战改装，此型号只是移除后向中型激光并加装一台额外散热器。

Original: As a 'laser boat' the Wolfhound's very basic weapons array frees it from supply lines and allows for superior endurance during extended campaigns. The primary long-range weapon is a Cyclops XII ER Large Laser mounted in the right arm, which allows the Wolfhound to strike at ranges of nearly 600 meters.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_wolfhound_WLF-1X.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As a 'laser boat' the Wolfhound's very basic weapons array frees it from supply lines and allows for superior endurance during extended campaigns. The primary long-range weapon is a Cyclops XII ER Large Laser mounted in the right arm, which allows the Wolfhound to strike at ranges of nearly 600 meters.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一台"激光平台"，狼犬极为基础的武器阵列使它摆脱了补给线的束缚，在长期战役中拥有卓越的续航能力。主要远程武器是右臂的"独眼巨人 XII"ER 大型激光，使狼犬能在近 600 米的距离上发起攻击。

Original: Introduced in 3052 the WLF-2 Variant upgrades the 10 heat sinks to double strength and the Large laser is upgraded also to ER version.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_wolfhound_WLF-2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced in 3052 the WLF-2 Variant upgrades the 10 heat sinks to double strength and the Large laser is upgraded also to ER version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: WLF-2 变体于 3052 年推出，把 10 台散热器升级为双倍强度，大型激光也升级为 ER 版本。

Original: A Solaris refit of the Wolfhound, trading the energy weapons for a Massive LBX/10, Stealth Gear and a large Claw.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_wolfhound_WLF-7S.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Solaris refit of the Wolfhound, trading the energy weapons for a Massive LBX/10, Stealth Gear and a large Claw.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是太阳系 VII 的猎狼犬改装版，用能量武器换得一具巨型 LBX/10、隐形装备和一只大型爪。

Original: Infamously nicknamed the ''Varnay-1R'' the original primitive Wolverine was introduced in 2471.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_wolverine_WVR-1R.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Infamously nicknamed the ''Varnay-1R'' the original primitive Wolverine was introduced in 2471.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 原始的原始型狼獾于 2471 年推出，被戏称为"瓦尔内-1R"而臭名昭著。

Original: Wolverine 6K models don't usually include Jump Jets in order to mount more Energy weaponry, Heat Sinks, and armor.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_wolverine_WVR-6K.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Wolverine 6K models don't usually include Jump Jets in order to mount more Energy weaponry, Heat Sinks, and armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狼獾 6K 型号通常不装跳跃推进器，以便搭载更多能量武器、散热器和装甲。

Original: The 6M boasts an increase in firepower and endurance as a raider by dropping the AC5 and replacing it with a Large Laser.  This also allowed for the addition of another Medium Laser and extra Heat Sinks.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_wolverine_WVR-6M.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 6M boasts an increase in firepower and endurance as a raider by dropping the AC5 and replacing it with a Large Laser.  This also allowed for the addition of another Medium Laser and extra Heat Sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 6M 通过舍弃 AC5 换成一门大型激光，作为劫掠者提升了火力与续航力。这也使得可以再加装一门中型激光和额外散热器。

Original: Wolverine 6Rs are fairly flexible in terms of weaponry ranges, tending somewhat more toward closer engagements. This is supported by their jump capability and pretty decent heat management.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_wolverine_WVR-6R.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Wolverine 6Rs are fairly flexible in terms of weaponry ranges, tending somewhat more toward closer engagements. This is supported by their jump capability and pretty decent heat management.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狼獾 6R 在武器射程上相当灵活，偏向近距交战一些。其跳跃能力和相当不错的散热管理对此形成支撑。

Original: A Taurian variant, the WVR-6T design was created to capitalize on the less expensive ballistic weapons that were readily available within the Concordat to reduce their reliance on Star League member states. The 6T was also meant to act as anti-pirate garrison 'Mech, utilizing its long range AC/5 and LRM-5 combo to engage raiders at range.  While the swap out of the Medium Laser for a Small Laser and the addition of two Machine Guns allow this Wolverine variant to better engage with the light vehicles and infantry common to raiding forces.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_wolverine_WVR-6T.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Taurian variant, the WVR-6T design was created to capitalize on the less expensive ballistic weapons that were readily available within the Concordat to reduce their reliance on Star League member states. The 6T was also meant to act as anti-pirate garrison 'Mech, utilizing its long range AC/5 and LRM-5 combo to engage raiders at range.  While the swap out of the Medium Laser for a Small Laser and the addition of two Machine Guns allow this Wolverine variant to better engage with the light vehicles and infantry common to raiding forces.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为陶里安变体，WVR-6T 的设计意图是利用协约国内易于获得的较廉价实弹武器，以减少对星盟成员国的依赖。6T 也意在充当反海盗驻防机甲，利用其远程 AC/5 与 LRM-5 组合在远距离迎击劫掠者。而把中型激光换成小型激光并加装两挺机枪，则让这款狼獾变体能更好地对付劫掠部队常见的轻型车辆与步兵。

Original: The 7D variant of the Wolverine is a major upgrade to the design introduced in 3050 by the Federated Suns' new Nanking factory. The standard engine on the 'Mech was replaced with a Nissan 275 XLversion and the armor has been upgraded to Kallon Unity Weave Ferro-Fibrous material with an extra half-ton added. To increase the Wolverine's speed, MASC has been added, allowing it to move up to 108 km/h in bursts. Finally, the weapons payload has been upgraded as well. The autocannon has been upgraded to a General Motors Nova-5 Ultra Autocannon/5 and the medium laser is now a Sutel Precision Line Medium Pulse Laser. The design retains its jumping capability, as well as the SRM-6, although CASE now protects the SRM reloads
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_wolverine_WVR-7D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 7D variant of the Wolverine is a major upgrade to the design introduced in 3050 by the Federated Suns' new Nanking factory. The standard engine on the 'Mech was replaced with a Nissan 275 XLversion and the armor has been upgraded to Kallon Unity Weave Ferro-Fibrous material with an extra half-ton added. To increase the Wolverine's speed, MASC has been added, allowing it to move up to 108 km/h in bursts. Finally, the weapons payload has been upgraded as well. The autocannon has been upgraded to a General Motors Nova-5 Ultra Autocannon/5 and the medium laser is now a Sutel Precision Line Medium Pulse Laser. The design retains its jumping capability, as well as the SRM-6, although CASE now protects the SRM reloads
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狼獾 7D 变体是该设计的重大升级，由联邦太阳系的新南京工厂于 3050 年推出。机甲的标准引擎换成日产 275 XL 版本，装甲升级为卡隆统一编织铁纤维材料并额外增加半吨。为提升狼獾速度，加装了 MASC，使其能在爆发中移动至 108 公里/小时。最后武器配置也得到升级：自动炮升级为通用汽车新星-5 超速自动炮/5，中型激光换为苏特尔精准线中型脉冲激光。设计保留跳跃能力与 SRM-6，不过 SRM 再装填现由 C.A.S.E. 保护

Original: The Star League changed so much from the WVR-6R that they called this the Wolverine II. It carries a similar weapon load but enhanced by the Star League's superior technology, making this a far deadlier machine.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_wolverine_WVR-7H.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Star League changed so much from the WVR-6R that they called this the Wolverine II. It carries a similar weapon load but enhanced by the Star League's superior technology, making this a far deadlier machine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 星盟对 WVR-6R 的改动如此之大，以至于他们把它称为狼獾 II。它携带相似武器载荷，但在星盟优越技术的强化下，成为一台致命得多的机器。

Original: Another major upgrade of the Wolverine, this one for the Combine and first rolling off Marduk's production lines, the 7K model is also built with an XL Engine for power with the saved weight used to increase and upgrade its arsenal.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_wolverine_WVR-7K.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another major upgrade of the Wolverine, this one for the Combine and first rolling off Marduk's production lines, the 7K model is also built with an XL Engine for power with the saved weight used to increase and upgrade its arsenal.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是狼獾的又一次重大升级，此次为联合体打造，首批从马尔杜克生产线下线。7K 型号同样采用 XL 引擎提供动力，节省的重量用于扩充与升级其武器库。

Original: The 7M variant of the Wolverine has aspects of both the 7D and the 7K versions but is much closer to the original model. Introduced by FWDI in 3050 the 'Mech uses an XL engine, which is augmented with MASC, so as to push the machine up to 108 km/h in bursts. The 7M has twelve double heat sinks and, for a weapons package, it carries two Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Lasers in the right arm and two Magna 400P medium pulse lasers in the head mount while retaining the SRM-6 for close range work.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_wolverine_WVR-7M.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 7M variant of the Wolverine has aspects of both the 7D and the 7K versions but is much closer to the original model. Introduced by FWDI in 3050 the 'Mech uses an XL engine, which is augmented with MASC, so as to push the machine up to 108 km/h in bursts. The 7M has twelve double heat sinks and, for a weapons package, it carries two Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Lasers in the right arm and two Magna 400P medium pulse lasers in the head mount while retaining the SRM-6 for close range work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狼獾 7M 变体兼具 7D 与 7K 版本的特征，但更接近原始型号。该机甲由 FWDI 于 3050 年推出，使用 XL 引擎并配 MASC，可在爆发中把机器推至 108 公里/小时。7M 有十二台双倍散热器，武器方面右臂装两门多元光学"日光束"ER 大型激光，头部安装两门玛格纳 400P 中型脉冲激光，同时保留 SRM-6 用于近战。

Original: This BattleMech was solely designed to spite Clanners' distaste for everything Wolverine.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_wolverine_WVR-C.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This BattleMech was solely designed to spite Clanners' distaste for everything Wolverine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款战斗机甲的设计目的只有一个：专门气一气氏族对狼獾一切事物的厌恶。

Original: The Wraith marked Curtiss Militech's entry into BattleMech production. When the design was announced, many felt that the design would be little more than a walking water cooler. What the critics got was a shock. The Wraith is a 'Mech that, when properly employed, can wreak havoc on an enemy with its astounding speed and maneuverability. It is built around a massive LTV 385 XL Engine that allows it to reach speeds of just under 119 kph. The Wraith has a simple, yet effective, pulse weapons payload. Pulse laser weaponry allows the Mech to negate most of the side effects on accuracy that are introduced by the Wraith's heavy use of jump jets, making it incredibly accurate and powerful for such a lightly armed Mech.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_wraith_TR-1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Wraith marked Curtiss Militech's entry into BattleMech production. When the design was announced, many felt that the design would be little more than a walking water cooler. What the critics got was a shock. The Wraith is a 'Mech that, when properly employed, can wreak havoc on an enemy with its astounding speed and maneuverability. It is built around a massive LTV 385 XL Engine that allows it to reach speeds of just under 119 kph. The Wraith has a simple, yet effective, pulse weapons payload. Pulse laser weaponry allows the Mech to negate most of the side effects on accuracy that are introduced by the Wraith's heavy use of jump jets, making it incredibly accurate and powerful for such a lightly armed Mech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 幽灵标志着柯蒂斯军工进军战斗机甲生产。该设计公布时，许多人以为它不过是台会走路的水冷器。批评者得到的却是震惊。若运用得当，幽灵能凭借惊人的速度与机动性在敌阵中肆虐。它以庞大的 LTV 385 XL 引擎为核心，速度可达略低于 119 公里/小时。幽灵配有简单却有效的脉冲武器配置。脉冲激光武器能让机甲抵消跳跃推进器大量使用所带来的大部分精度副作用，使这款轻武装机甲变得异常精准而强大。

Original: The Wraith marked Curtiss Militech's entry into BattleMech production. When the design was announced, many felt that the design would be little more than a walking water cooler. Original: The Zeus 5S is an original model Zeus, carrying a similar loadout to the normal -6S but making good use of Star League technology to increase both its hitting power and its heat management, making the -5S a terrifying mech on the battlefield.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_zeus_ZEU-5S.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Zeus 5S is an original model Zeus, carrying a similar loadout to the normal -6S but making good use of Star League technology to increase both its hitting power and its heat management, making the -5S a terrifying mech on the battlefield.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 宙斯 5S 是原版宙斯型号，携带与普通-6S 相似的有效载荷，但善用星盟技术同时提升打击力与散热管理，使-5S 成为战场上一台可怕的机甲。

Original: The Zeus 5T is an original model Zeus and makes use of Star League technology to make a much more deadly mech. Just as fast as the -6S, the -5T switches the autocannon for a devastating array of energy weapons which combined with the -5T's double heat sinks is a brutal combination.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_zeus_ZEU-5T.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Zeus 5T is an original model Zeus and makes use of Star League technology to make a much more deadly mech. Just as fast as the -6S, the -5T switches the autocannon for a devastating array of energy weapons which combined with the -5T's double heat sinks is a brutal combination.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 宙斯 5T 是原始型号宙斯，利用星盟科技打造成致命得多的机甲。速度与-6S 相同，-5T 把自动炮换成一整套毁灭性的能量武器，配合-5T 的双倍散热器，是极为凶悍的组合。

Original: The Zeus 6S-DC moves faster than many other assault 'Mechs and mounts decent long-range weaponry. Its armor is very good, but it can get stuck in a tight spot if forced into closer-range fights.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_zeus_ZEU-6S-DC.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Zeus 6S-DC moves faster than many other assault 'Mechs and mounts decent long-range weaponry. Its armor is very good, but it can get stuck in a tight spot if forced into closer-range fights.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 宙斯 6S-DC 比许多其他突击机甲都快，并装备不错的远程武器。它的装甲非常好，但若被迫近身作战，可能会陷入困境。

Original: A relatively new development, the Zeus 6TS removes the Autocannon and replaces it with a PPC.  To help mitigate the additional heat, 2 Heat Sinks were also added.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_zeus_ZEU-6T.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A relatively new development, the Zeus 6TS removes the Autocannon and replaces it with a PPC.  To help mitigate the additional heat, 2 Heat Sinks were also added.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 宙斯 6TS 是相对较新的发展，它移除自动炮，换成一门 PPC。为帮助缓解额外热量，还加装了 2 台散热器。

Original: An experiment in logistical support, the Zeus 6Y retains the AC5, but downgrades the LRM15 to a LRM10.  This allowed for the Large Laser to be 'upgraded' to a Binary Laser Cannon.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_zeus_ZEU-6Y.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An experiment in logistical support, the Zeus 6Y retains the AC5, but downgrades the LRM15 to a LRM10.  This allowed for the Large Laser to be 'upgraded' to a Binary Laser Cannon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为后勤支援的一次实验，宙斯 6Y 保留 AC5，但把 LRM15 降级为 LRM10。这使得大型激光得以"升级"为一门双联激光炮。

Original: The Zeus IS moves faster than many other assault 'Mech, but mounts mostly low tech, cheap industrial weapons. Still, it's well armoured, and a common sight among the more broke and disgraced units in the Periphery.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_zeus_ZEU-IS.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Zeus IS moves faster than many other assault 'Mech, but mounts mostly low tech, cheap industrial weapons. Still, it's well armoured, and a common sight among the more broke and disgraced units in the Periphery.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 宙斯 IS 比许多其他突击机甲都快，但主要装备低技术、廉价的工业武器。不过它装甲良好，在外围区较穷困落魄的部队中很常见。

Original: This version of the Emperor was a model introduced in the Age of War. It carried an Autocannon/5 in each arm instead of the LB10-Xs that were used in later versions. It also carried sixteen single heat sinks.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_emperor_EMP-5A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This version of the Emperor was a model introduced in the Age of War. It carried an Autocannon/5 in each arm instead of the LB10-Xs that were used in later versions. It also carried sixteen single heat sinks.

Original: The Emperor is one of the earliest assault BattleMechs, dating back to 2502. The Emperor also bears the distinction of being the first 90+ ton BattleMech to mount jump jets (the famed Highlander began production in 2592). In 2612, StarCorps introduced an upgraded Emperor, EMP-6A designed for and distributed exclusively to Star League Defense Forces Royal Units. The Emperor was produced continuously until Marik forces destroyed StarCorps Industries facility with nuclear arms on Son Hoa during the Second Succession War. Production of the Emperor resumed in 3057 alongside the legendary Highlander.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_emperor_EMP-6A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Emperor is one of the earliest assault BattleMechs, dating back to 2502. The Emperor also bears the distinction of being the first 90+ ton BattleMech to mount jump jets (the famed Highlander began production in 2592). In 2612, StarCorps introduced an upgraded Emperor, EMP-6A designed for and distributed exclusively to Star League Defense Forces Royal Units. The Emperor was produced continuously until Marik forces destroyed StarCorps Industries facility with nuclear arms on Son Hoa during the Second Succession War. Production of the Emperor resumed in 3057 alongside the legendary Highlander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 皇帝是最早的突击战斗机甲之一，可追溯至 2502 年。它还享有另一项殊荣：首款装备跳跃推进器的 90 吨以上战斗机甲（著名的高地人于 2592 年开始生产）。2612 年，星团公司推出升级版皇帝 EMP-6A，专为星盟防卫军皇家部队设计并独家供应。皇帝一直持续生产，直到第二次继承战争中马里克部队用核武器摧毁了星团公司在子华星的工厂。皇帝的生产于 3057 年与传奇的高地人一同恢复。

Original: Utilizing locally produced components such as the Kali Yama Big Bore autocannon and Hellion-V medium lasers, the Kali Yama-produced 5M Hunchback is a simple upgrade of the original 4G model that first saw production in 3046. The most notable changes saw the heat sinks upgraded to double-strength models, while the small laser was upgraded to a Sunglow Prism-Optic Small Pulse Laser, and CASE was added to protect against ammunition explosions. The extra weight required to add the newer systems forced Kali Yama to reduced ammunition storage to a single ton of reloads, making it unpopular with MechWarriors and spawning the unofficial HBK-5N variant.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_hunchback_HBK-5M.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Utilizing locally produced components such as the Kali Yama Big Bore autocannon and Hellion-V medium lasers, the Kali Yama-produced 5M Hunchback is a simple upgrade of the original 4G model that first saw production in 3046. The most notable changes saw the heat sinks upgraded to double-strength models, while the small laser was upgraded to a Sunglow Prism-Optic Small Pulse Laser, and CASE was added to protect against ammunition explosions. The extra weight required to add the newer systems forced Kali Yama to reduced ammunition storage to a single ton of reloads, making it unpopular with MechWarriors and spawning the unofficial HBK-5N variant.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5M 驼背由卡利亚马生产，使用本地制造的部件如卡利亚马大口径自动炮和海利昂-V 中型激光，是原 4G 型号的简单升级，于 3046 年首次投产。最显著的变化是散热器升级为双倍强度型号，小型激光升级为"日辉"棱镜光学小型脉冲激光，并加装 C.A.S.E. 以防弹药爆炸。加装新系统所需的额外重量迫使卡利亚马把弹药储存减至一吨再装填，这让机甲战士颇为不满，也催生了非官方的 HBK-5N 变体。

The most notable changes saw the heat sinks upgraded to double-strength models, while the small laser was upgraded to a Sunglow Prism-Optic Small Pulse Laser, and CASE was added to protect against ammunition explosions. The extra weight required to add the newer systems forced Kali Yama to reduced ammunition storage to a single ton of reloads, making it unpopular with MechWarriors and spawning the unofficial HBK-5N variant.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5M 驼背由卡利亚马生产，使用本地制造的部件如卡利亚马大口径自动炮和海利昂-V 中型激光，是原 4G 型号的简单升级，于 3046 年首次投产。最显著的变化是散热器升级为双倍强度型号，小型激光升级为"日辉"棱镜光学小型脉冲激光，并加装 C.A.S.E. 以防弹药爆炸。加装新系统所需的额外重量迫使卡利亚马把弹药储存减至一吨再装填，这让机甲战士颇为不满，也催生了非官方的 HBK-5N 变体。

Original: The Emperor is one of the earliest assault BattleMechs, dating back to 2502. The Emperor also bears the distinction of being the first 90+ ton BattleMech to mount jump jets (the famed Highlander began production in 2592). In 2612, StarCorps introduced an upgraded Emperor, EMP-6A designed for and distributed exclusively to Star League Defense Forces Royal Units. The Emperor was produced continuously until Marik forces destroyed StarCorps Industries facility with nuclear arms on Son Hoa during the Second Succession War. Production of the Emperor resumed in 3057 alongside the legendary Highlander.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_emperor_EMP-6A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 皇帝是最早的突击战斗机甲之一，可追溯至 2502 年。它还享有另一项殊荣：首款装备跳跃推进器的 90 吨以上战斗机甲（著名的高地人于 2592 年开始生产）。2612 年，星团公司推出升级版皇帝 EMP-6A，专为星盟防卫军皇家部队设计并独家供应。皇帝一直持续生产，直到第二次继承战争中马里克部队用核武器摧毁了星团公司在子华星的工厂。皇帝的生产于 3057 年与传奇的高地人一同恢复。

Original: The Dragon II is a Heavy BattleMech built by LAW for the armed forces of the Draconis Combine during the post-Jihad era. Built as a successor to the aging Dragon, the 'Mech was designed with Advanced Technology to allow it to handle threats of the new era. The design was phased in as a replacement to the older Dragons, which were nearing the end of their service lives.
Name: Artillery_Units.chassisdef_dragon_DRG-11K.Details

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 龙 II 是 LAW 为德拉科尼斯联合体武装力量在后圣战时代建造的重型战斗机甲。作为老化的龙的继任者，该机甲以先进技术设计，以应对新时代的威胁。它被逐步引入，以替换寿命将至的老旧龙。

The 'Mech was proven ineffective on multiple occasions and, following the destruction of the production facilities in 2775, the design was lost during the Succession Wars. The HEP-2H dates to 2488.
Name: Artillery_Units.chassisdef_helepolis_HEP-2H.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: First unleashed by the Terran Hegemony in 2460, the Helepolis is a ponderous BattleMech designed to deliver artillery fire. The 'Mech was proven ineffective on multiple occasions and, following the destruction of the production facilities in 2775, the design was lost during the Succession Wars. The HEP-2H dates to 2488.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 攻城塔于 2460 年由地球霸权首次推出，是一款笨重的战斗机甲，用于投送炮火。它多次被证明效果不佳，2775 年生产设施被毁后，该设计在继承战争中失传。HEP-2H 可追溯至 2488 年。

Original: Designed by the Explorer Corps to provide heavy fire support in environments unsuited to a normal tank or support unit, the 4E is a field refit that mounts a Thumper Artillery piece in place of the standard AC/20. Removing a mostly superfluous s heat sink, frees up the weight for the 4E retain it’s secondary weaponry should it be engaged by head hunter units. By 3010, the Explorer Corps had entered into a long term contract with Kali Yama Weapons to produce limited numbers of this design under licence. The design spread to other interested parties, after the Corps relaxed their licensing arrangements, following the Scarlet Fist debacle; in which the a lone Corps pilot – Larissa ‘‘Raza’’ Brooks – managed to successfully evaded the pirate band responsible for the destruction of her lance, before stalking them back to their base and levelling it with repeated Thumper volleys in the middle of the night.
Name: Artillery_Units.chassisdef_hunchback_HBK-4E.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed by the Explorer Corps to provide heavy fire support in environments unsuited to a normal tank or support unit, the 4E is a field refit that mounts a Thumper Artillery piece in place of the standard AC/20. Removing a mostly superfluous s heat sink, frees up the weight for the 4E retain it’s secondary weaponry should it be engaged by head hunter units. By 3010, the Explorer Corps had entered into a long term contract with Kali Yama Weapons to produce limited numbers of this design under licence. The design spread to other interested parties, after the Corps relaxed their licensing arrangements, following the Scarlet Fist debacle; in which the a lone Corps pilot – Larissa ‘‘Raza’’ Brooks – managed to successfully evaded the pirate band responsible for the destruction of her lance, before stalking them back to their base and levelling it with repeated Thumper volleys in the middle of the night.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由探险队设计，用于在不适于常规坦克或支援单位的环境提供重型火力支援。4E 是战地改装型，以一门重锤火炮取代标准 AC/20。拆掉一只基本多余的散热器腾出重量，使 4E 在被猎杀单位接战时仍保留次要武器。到 3010 年，探险队已与卡利亚马武器公司签订长期合同，授权限量生产该设计。在"赤拳"事件后，探险队放宽了授权安排，此设计遂扩散至其他有意方；在那次事件中，探险队唯一幸存的飞行员——拉里萨·"拉扎"·布鲁克斯——成功避开了摧毁她小队的海盗团，随后追踪他们回到基地，并在深夜以反复的重锤齐射将基地夷平。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由探险队设计，用于在不适于常规坦克或支援单位的环境提供重型火力支援。4E 是战地改装型，以一门重锤火炮取代标准 AC/20。拆掉一只基本多余的散热器腾出重量，使 4E 在被猎杀单位接战时仍保留次要武器。到 3010 年，探险队已与卡利亚马武器公司签订长期合同，授权限量生产该设计。在"赤拳"事件后，探险队放宽了授权安排，此设计遂扩散至其他有意方；在那次事件中，探险队唯一幸存的飞行员——拉里萨·"拉扎"·布鲁克斯——成功避开了摧毁她小队的海盗团，随后追踪他们回到基地，并在深夜以反复的重锤齐射将基地夷平。

Original: Developed during the Clan Invasion, the 5A takes advantage of the newly reintroduced Arrow IV and an Artemis IV FCS. Intended to operate in support of a lance or as part of a dedicated battery, the 5A carries a mix of homing missiles and utility ammo; enabling it to bombard targets that have been tagged by supporting forces or deploying FASCAM and other speciality ammo as and when needed. Guardian ECM confuses and blinds enemy sensors, vastly reducing the chances of accurate counter battery fire, whilst the use of CASE protects against catastrophic ammunition explosions. Sold to any interested buyer as part of Kali Yama’s contribution to the war effort, the design has been seen all across the Inner Sphere and is increasingly found in the Periphery, where reliable and cheap Artillery assets are in high demand.
Name: Artillery_Units.chassisdef_hunchback_HBK-5A.Details

Original: Debuting in 3063, the 5E is a Word of Blake designed upgrade to the older 4E design. Intended for deployment with Protectorate Militia units and Free Worlds League formations, the Blakists sought to rebuild the design with newer technology and correct some of the flaws apparent in the older design. Installing a new Light Fusion Engine and Endo Steel enabled the designers to swap the Thumper for the much larger and more powerful Sniper Artillery Canon. Defensively the design mounts CASE to protect against the ammunition explosions that plagued the older 4E model. A swap to ER Lasers and DHS round out the design, giving it increased range and striking power. Popular with Hunchback pilots and Artillery units, the design is slated for continuous production; with Kali Yama having to expand their Hunchback line to keep up with demand.
Name: Artillery_Units.chassisdef_hunchback_HBK-5E.Details

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5E 于 3063 年亮相，是布雷克之言为较老的 4E 设计所作的升级。为在保护国民兵单位与自由世界联盟编队中部署，布雷克派谋求用更新的技术重建该设计，并纠正旧设计中明显的缺陷。安装新的轻型聚变引擎与内骨骼，使设计师得以把重锤换成大得多、威力也强得多的狙击炮。防御方面，该设计装设 C.A.S.E. 以防困扰旧 4E 型号的弹药爆炸。激光换成 ER 型号并配 DHS，为设计收尾，赋予其更远的射程与更强的打击力。它受驼背飞行员与炮兵单位欢迎，被排入持续生产；卡利亚马不得不扩建其驼背生产线以满足需求。

Original: Built during the Amaris civil war, the Mackie 9Hb was a stopgap attempt to solve the SLDF's sudden dearth of advanced assault mechs. By taking Mackie 9H's from the remaining Hegemony stockpiles and upgrading them with surplus parts, the SLDF hoped to create a multi role assault mech for rear echelon and support duties; potentially freeing up better equipped machines that could be used on the frontlines. Equipped with 2 Thumper Artillery pieces and a cockpit command console, the 9Hb functions as both a command mech and an Artillery support platform. Though this design functions well as a support unit, it performs poorly in direct combat. Particularly devastating is the lack of CASE around the ammo magazines, a consequence of the rushed design process.
Name: Artillery_Units.chassisdef_mackie_MSK-9Hb.Details

Equipped with 2 Thumper Artillery pieces and a cockpit command console, the 9Hb functions as both a command mech and an Artillery support platform. Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 麦基 9Hb 在阿马里斯内战期间建造，是为解决星盟防卫军先进突击机甲突然短缺的权宜之计。通过从霸权剩余库存中取用麦基 9H 并以剩余部件升级，星盟防卫军希望打造一款用于后方梯队与支援任务的多用途突击机甲，从而腾出装备更精良的机器用于前线。9Hb 装备两门重锤火炮与一个驾驶舱指挥台，兼具指挥机甲与火炮支援平台的功能。虽然作为支援单位表现出色，但在直接战斗中表现糟糕。尤其致命的是弹药匣周围缺乏 C.A.S.E.，这是设计过程仓促的后果。

Original: A clan buster refit developed with Comstar’s mothballed 9Hb’s, the 9Hc was an attempt to fix the failings of it’s predecessor design in a cheap and easy to maintain upgrade package. Identifying the lack of CASE and adequate secondary weapons as the key weaknesses, the Comguard designers disregarded the other weakness – the designs slow ground speed – as being of lesser importance. The designers selected an Endo Steel skeleton as the preferred option, rejecting other more expensive solutions. CASE was installed for both ammo magazines and the designers upgraded the medium lasers to ER versions; installing an extra 3 in the process with double heat sinks incorporated to balance out the heat spike. The 5 completed prototypes served with distinction on Tukayyid, though the design never reached production status; with only 2 other conversions finished before the Word of Blake seized Terra and the remaining stocks of 9Hb’s. .
Name: Artillery_Units.chassisdef_mackie_MSK-9Hc.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A clan buster refit developed with Comstar’s mothballed 9Hb’s, the 9Hc was an attempt to fix the failings of it’s predecessor design in a cheap and easy to maintain upgrade package. Identifying the lack of CASE and adequate secondary weapons as the key weaknesses, the Comguard designers disregarded the other weakness – the designs slow ground speed – as being of lesser importance. The designers selected an Endo Steel skeleton as the preferred option, rejecting other more expensive solutions. CASE was installed for both ammo magazines and the designers upgraded the medium lasers to ER versions; installing an extra 3 in the process with double heat sinks incorporated to balance out the heat spike. The 5 completed prototypes served with distinction on Tukayyid, though the design never reached production status; with only 2 other conversions finished before the Word of Blake seized Terra and the remaining stocks of 9Hb’s. .
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 9Hc 是利用康星封存的 9Hb 开发的"破氏族"改装型，旨在以廉价易维护的升级包修正前型设计的缺陷。康卫设计师认定缺乏 C.A.S.E. 与足够的次要武器是关键弱点，而将设计的另一缺陷——地面速度缓慢——视为次要。设计师选择内骨骼骨架为首选方案，否决了其他更昂贵的解决途径。两个弹匣都安装了 C.A.S.E.，并将中型激光升级为 ER 版本；过程中还额外加装 3 门，并配以双倍散热器以平衡热量尖峰。5 台完成的原型机在图卡伊德表现出色，尽管该设计从未进入量产；在布雷克之言夺取地球及其剩余的 9Hb 库存前，仅又完成了 2 台改装。.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This fast assault 'Mech mounts a meager nine tons of armor, but tactical doctrine keeps it far from the front lines. The Naga is often derided because it rarely allows for the glory that comes from an individual kill.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款快速突击机甲只装九吨装甲，但战术条令让它远离前线。娜迦常被嘲笑，因为它很少带来个人击杀所能获得的荣耀。

Original: This Naga Replaces the ARROW IV Launchers with LRMS.
Name: Artillery_Units.chassisdef_naga_NGA-Z.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Naga Replaces the ARROW IV Launchers with LRMS.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此娜迦用 LRM 替换了箭矢 IV 发射器。

Original: Well I guess the society decided they could make an artillery mech an LRM boat.
Name: Artillery_Units.chassisdef_naga_NGA-Z.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Well I guess the society decided they could make an artillery mech an LRM boat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好吧，我猜 society 决定把一台火炮机甲改造成 LRM 平台。

Original: The O-Bakemono weighs in at eighty tons and has a top speed of 64.8 km/h, which is considered a good ground speed for an assault 'Mech..
Name: Artillery_Units.chassisdef_OBakemono_OBK-M10.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The O-Bakemono weighs in at eighty tons and has a top speed of 64.8 km/h, which is considered a good ground speed for an assault 'Mech..
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: O-Bakemono 重达八十吨，最高速度 64.8 公里/小时，对突击机甲而言这是不错的地面速度。
重型火力支援 & 防御者

Original: The primary weapons on the O-Bakemono are a pair of Shigunga Arrow IV Systems. The Arrow IVs have an effective range of up to three kilometers, allowing the O-Bakemono to stay at extreme ranges and rain missiles onto the battlefield while friendly units spot for it.

Original: The Owens is intended to be an OmniMech upgrade of the Jenner BattleMech. The intended role for the Owens is as a cavalry 'Mech that can move along the enemy lines and designate targets for bombardment with Arrow IV artillery attacks. The Owens is a strong spotting unit as well as a point 'Mech for C3 lances with its permanently mounted TAG laser designator, Beagle Probe and C3 Slave unit.
Name: Artillery_Units.chassisdef_owens_OW-1_Arty.Details

The intended role for the Owens is as a cavalry 'Mech that can move along the enemy lines and designate targets for bombardment with Arrow IV artillery attacks. The Owens is a strong spotting unit as well as a point 'Mech for C3 lances with its permanently mounted TAG laser designator, Beagle Probe and C3 Slave unit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 欧文斯旨在作为詹纳战斗机甲的全能机甲升级型。其定位是骑兵机甲，可沿敌方战线机动并为我方箭矢 IV 炮击标记目标。凭借固定安装的 TAG 激光指示器、比格犬探测器与 C3 从属单元，欧文斯既是优秀的侦察单位，也是 C3 小队的先锋机甲。

Original: With the reintroduction of Helm Core LosTech, the Taurian Defense Force found themselves lagging behind their neighbours. Just as they did during the Age of War, the Taurians turned to the home grown Talos. With a reputation as an easy to maintain and easy to manufacture mech, the design was just what the TDF needed. Lacking the resources to turn the newly redesigned Talos into a viable production model, the Taurians enlisted the aid of their neighbours, in exchange for joining the ongoing Trinity Alliance negotiations. Aided by the expertise of Capellan engineers and financial investment from the Magistracy of Canopus, Vandenburg started limited manufacturing of the Talos; at their New Vandenburg plant: in late 3059. The formal signing of the Trinity Alliance, in 3062; awarded production licenses to both Majesty Metals and Detroit Consolidated Mech Works. Both companies swiftly opened their own lines, producing multiple variants of the Talos for their own use and for export further afield.
Name: Artillery_Units.chassisdef_talos_TLS-5A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: With the reintroduction of Helm Core LosTech, the Taurian Defense Force found themselves lagging behind their neighbours. Just as they did during the Age of War, the Taurians turned to the home grown Talos. With a reputation as an easy to maintain and easy to manufacture mech, the design was just what the TDF needed. Lacking the resources to turn the newly redesigned Talos into a viable production model, the Taurians enlisted the aid of their neighbours, in exchange for joining the ongoing Trinity Alliance negotiations. Aided by the expertise of Capellan engineers and financial investment from the Magistracy of Canopus, Vandenburg started limited manufacturing of the Talos; at their New Vandenburg plant: in late 3059. The formal signing of the Trinity Alliance, in 3062; awarded production licenses to both Majesty Metals and Detroit Consolidated Mech Works. Both companies swiftly opened their own lines, producing multiple variants of the Talos for their own use and for export further afield.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 随着赫尔姆核心失落科技的重现，陶里安防卫军发现自己落后于邻国。正如战争时代一样，陶里安人转向了本土成长的塔洛斯。这款机甲以易于维护和易于制造著称，正是陶里安防卫军所需。由于缺乏资源将新设计的塔洛斯转为可行的量产型号，陶里安人以加入正在进行的"三位一体同盟"谈判为交换，寻求邻国援助。在卡佩兰工程师的专业知识与卡诺普斯女权国的资金投入协助下，范登堡于 3059 年末在其新范登堡工厂开始了塔洛斯的限量生产。3062 年三位一体同盟正式签署，授予陛下金属公司与底特律联合机工厂生产许可。两家公司迅速开设了自己的生产线，为自用与远销生产了塔洛斯的多种变体。

Original: Boss, I don't know how this got past the design review board but this thing has two Thumper Artillery pieces and nothing else. If anything gets in close, there isn't much it can do. However, those cannons will pulverize most things that are unfortunate enough to be spotted.
Name: Artillery_Units.chassisdef_talos_TLS-5A.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Boss, I don't know how this got past the design review board but this thing has two Thumper Artillery pieces and nothing else. If anything gets in close, there isn't much it can do. However, those cannons will pulverize most things that are unfortunate enough to be spotted.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 老大，我不知道这东西是怎么通过设计评审的，但这玩意儿装了两门重锤火炮，别的什么都没有。一旦有什么东西贴近，它几乎无能为力。不过，那两门炮会把大多数不幸被发现的目标碾成粉末。

Original: Produced by Maverick Industries after Operations Serpent and Bulldog, the TsarBomba is an attempt to improve the flexibility and survivability of artillery units. Noting the loss of many Arrow IV equipped units and the slaughter of their crews during Clan breakthroughs, the Maverick Industries design teams looked for ways to improve the situation. With a license to produce the Hollander BZK-F3 already secured, it was decided to produce an upgraded model that utilised an XL Engine to mount the Arrow IV launcher. Modern artillery tactics called for the deployment of anti air and anti mech units to protect the precious assets, so Maverick only mounted a Small Pulse Laser on the mech, augmented by a TAG; so that the Hollander could handle infantry infiltrators and spot for either it’s own launcher or the rest of it’s lancemates. The designs speed was judged sufficient for it to evade other threats that might threaten the mech, especially with it’s armour unable to stand up to much punishment.
Name: Artillery_Units.chassisdef_tsarbomba_BZK-T2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Produced by Maverick Industries after Operations Serpent and Bulldog, the TsarBomba is an attempt to improve the flexibility and survivability of artillery units. Noting the loss of many Arrow IV equipped units and the slaughter of their crews during Clan breakthroughs, the Maverick Industries design teams looked for ways to improve the situation. With a license to produce the Hollander BZK-F3 already secured, it was decided to produce an upgraded model that utilised an XL Engine to mount the Arrow IV launcher. Modern artillery tactics called for the deployment of anti air and anti mech units to protect the precious assets, so Maverick only mounted a Small Pulse Laser on the mech, augmented by a TAG; so that the Hollander could handle infantry infiltrators and spot for either it’s own launcher or the rest of it’s lancemates. The designs speed was judged sufficient for it to evade other threats that might threaten the mech, especially with it’s armour unable to stand up to much punishment.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 沙皇炸弹由马弗里克工业在"蛇"与"斗牛犬"行动后生产，旨在提升炮兵单位的灵活性与生存性。注意到许多装备箭矢 IV 的单位损失、其乘员在氏族突破中被屠杀，马弗里克工业的设计团队寻找改善之道。凭借已获得的荷兰人 BZK-F3 生产许可，他们决定生产一款使用 XL 引擎以搭载箭矢 IV 发射器的升级型号。现代炮兵战术要求部署防空与反机甲单位保护这些宝贵资产，因此马弗里克只在机甲上装了一门小型脉冲激光并配 TAG；使荷兰人能对付步兵渗透者，并为自己或其他队友的发射器侦察。该设计的速度被认为足以避开其他可能威胁它的目标，尤其考虑到它的装甲经不起太多打击。

Original: This variant of the UrbanMech replaces the standard weaponry with an Arrow IV missile launcher and ER Medium Laser. It requires an Endo Steel chassis and Small Cockpit to provide room, and the UrbanMech can only carry ten rounds for the Arrow system. Despite these limitations, it is still a decent fire support unit.
Name: Artillery_Units.chassisdef_urbanmech_UM-AIV.Details

Original: Designed by the Capellans in the Succession Wars, the UM-R100 was deemed a failure due to mechanical issues with its large Thumper artillery cannon. However, after the introduction of the Helm Memory Core and Star League technologies, the Confederation revisted the -R100 and created this, the -R100X. Using Endo-Steel and Ferro-Fibrous as well as CASE, the -R100X brings tube artillery to the battlefield in a cheap and affordable package. Other than its Thumper cannon, the -R100X has only a pitiful ER Small Laser for defense.
Name: Artillery_Units.chassisdef_urbanmech_UM-R100X.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed by the Capellans in the Succession Wars, the UM-R100 was deemed a failure due to mechanical issues with its large Thumper artillery cannon. However, after the introduction of the Helm Memory Core and Star League technologies, the Confederation revisted the -R100 and created this, the -R100X. Using Endo-Steel and Ferro-Fibrous as well as CASE, the -R100X brings tube artillery to the battlefield in a cheap and affordable package. Other than its Thumper cannon, the -R100X has only a pitiful ER Small Laser for defense.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: UM-R100 由卡佩兰人在继承战争中设计，因其大型重锤火炮的机械问题而被判定为失败。然而在赫尔姆记忆核心与星盟技术问世后，邦联重新审视-R100 并打造出这款-R100X。使用内骨骼、铁纤维以及 C.A.S.E.，-R100X 以廉价实惠的方案把管式火炮带上战场。除了重锤炮，-R100X 只有一门可怜巴巴的 ER 小型激光用于防御。

Original: After his son was killed in the Taurian Concordat invasion of the Federated Suns, Benedict St. James had his VTR-9K refitted with experimental weapons and equipment to allow him to take his revenge. Replacing the standard weapons with a Long Tom Cannon and two Medium X-Pulse Lasers, St. James' Victor can inflict massive amounts of damage on his prey. The 'Mech's jump jets had to be removed to make way for the weapons load, and technicians equipped it with a patchwork of Ferro-Fibrous and Standard Armor as another weight saving measure. A Supercharger mounted on the engine provides the Victor with unexpected bursts of speed.
Name: Artillery_Units.chassisdef_victor_VTR-9K2.Details

Original: The Archer 8L is a prototype chassis designed to provide fire support with 2 Arrow IV Launchers loaded with Incendiary Missiles and the newly developed Guardian ECM and Stealth Armor.

Original: The C3 variant takes the 'Mech's long range fire support to a new level by removing both of the LRM-15 launchers and replacing them with an Arrow IV artillery system, allowing the Catapult to stay a safe distance from the battlefield.

Original: The Dragon II is a Heavy BattleMech built by LAW for the armed forces of the Draconis Combine during the post-Jihad era. Built as a successor to the aging Dragon, the 'Mech was designed with Advanced Technology to allow it to handle threats of the new era. The design was phased in as a replacement to the older Dragons, which were nearing the end of their service lives.
Name: Artillery_Units.mechdef_dragon_DRG-11K.Details

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 龙 II 是 LAW 为德拉科尼斯联合体武装力量在后圣战时代建造的重型战斗机甲。作为老化的龙的继任者，该机甲以先进技术设计，以应对新时代的威胁。它被逐步引入，以替换寿命将至的老旧龙。

Original: First unleashed by the Terran Hegemony in 2460, the Helepolis is a ponderous BattleMech designed to deliver artillery fire. The 'Mech was proven ineffective on multiple occasions and, following the destruction of the production facilities in 2775, the design was lost during the Succession Wars. The HEP-2H dates to 2488.
Name: Artillery_Units.mechdef_helepolis_HEP-2H.Details

The 'Mech was proven ineffective on multiple occasions and, following the destruction of the production facilities in 2775, the design was lost during the Succession Wars. The HEP-2H dates to 2488.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 攻城塔于 2460 年由地球霸权首次推出，是一款笨重的战斗机甲，用于投送炮火。它多次被证明效果不佳，2775 年生产设施被毁后，该设计在继承战争中失传。HEP-2H 可追溯至 2488 年。

Original: Designed by the Explorer Corps to provide heavy fire support in environments unsuited to a normal tank or support unit, the 4E is a field refit that mounts a Thumper Artillery piece in place of the standard AC/20. Removing a mostly superfluous s heat sink, frees up the weight for the 4E retain it’s secondary weaponry should it be engaged by head hunter units. By 3010, the Explorer Corps had entered into a long term contract with Kali Yama Weapons to produce limited numbers of this design under licence. The design spread to other interested parties, after the Corps relaxed their licensing arrangements, following the Scarlet Fist debacle; in which the a lone Corps pilot – Larissa ‘‘Raza’’ Brooks – managed to successfully evaded the pirate band responsible for the destruction of her lance, before stalking them back to their base and levelling it with repeated Thumper volleys in the middle of the night.
Name: Artillery_Units.mechdef_hunchback_HBK-4E.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed by the Explorer Corps to provide heavy fire support in environments unsuited to a normal tank or support unit, the 4E is a field refit that mounts a Thumper Artillery piece in place of the standard AC/20. Removing a mostly superfluous s heat sink, frees up the weight for the 4E retain it’s secondary weaponry should it be engaged by head hunter units. By 3010, the Explorer Corps had entered into a long term contract with Kali Yama Weapons to produce limited numbers of this design under licence. The design spread to other interested parties, after the Corps relaxed their licensing arrangements, following the Scarlet Fist debacle; in which the a lone Corps pilot – Larissa ‘‘Raza’’ Brooks – managed to successfully evaded the pirate band responsible for the destruction of her lance, before stalking them back to their base and levelling it with repeated Thumper volleys in the middle of the night.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由探险队设计，用于在不适于常规坦克或支援单位的环境提供重型火力支援。4E 是战地改装型，以一门重锤火炮取代标准 AC/20。拆掉一只基本多余的散热器腾出重量，使 4E 在被猎杀单位接战时仍保留次要武器。到 3010 年，探险队已与卡利亚马武器公司签订长期合同，授权限量生产该设计。在"赤拳"事件后，探险队放宽了授权安排，此设计遂扩散至其他有意方；在那次事件中，探险队唯一幸存的飞行员——拉里萨·"拉扎"·布鲁克斯——成功避开了摧毁她小队的海盗团，随后追踪他们回到基地，并在深夜以反复的重锤齐射将基地夷平。

Original: Developed during the Clan Invasion, the 5A takes advantage of the newly reintroduced Arrow IV and an Artemis IV FCS. Intended to operate in support of a lance or as part of a dedicated battery, the 5A carries a mix of homing missiles and utility ammo; enabling it to bombard targets that have been tagged by supporting forces or deploying FASCAM and other speciality ammo as and when needed. Guardian ECM confuses and blinds enemy sensors, vastly reducing the chances of accurate counter battery fire, whilst the use of CASE protects against catastrophic ammunition explosions. Sold to any interested buyer as part of Kali Yama’s contribution to the war effort, the design has been seen all across the Inner Sphere and is increasingly found in the Periphery, where reliable and cheap Artillery assets are in high demand.
Name: Artillery_Units.mechdef_hunchback_HBK-5A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed during the Clan Invasion, the 5A takes advantage of the newly reintroduced Arrow IV and an Artemis IV FCS. Intended to operate in support of a lance or as part of a dedicated battery, the 5A carries a mix of homing missiles and utility ammo; enabling it to bombard targets that have been tagged by supporting forces or deploying FASCAM and other speciality ammo as and when needed. Guardian ECM confuses and blinds enemy sensors, vastly reducing the chances of accurate counter battery fire, whilst the use of CASE protects against catastrophic ammunition explosions. Sold to any interested buyer as part of Kali Yama’s contribution to the war effort, the design has been seen all across the Inner Sphere and is increasingly found in the Periphery, where reliable and cheap Artillery assets are in high demand.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5A 在氏族入侵期间开发，利用了新近重新引入的箭矢 IV 与 Artemis IV 火控系统。它旨在支援一个小队或作为专用炮组的一员，混合携带寻的导弹与多用途弹药；既能轰击被友军标记的目标，也能按需布撒 FASCAM 等特种弹药。守护者 ECM 扰乱并致盲敌方传感器，大幅降低其精准反炮击的可能，而 C.A.S.E. 的使用则防止灾难性的弹药爆炸。作为卡利亚马对战争努力的贡献，该设计向任何有意买家出售，已遍布内天体，并越来越多地出现在对可靠廉价火炮资产需求旺盛的外围区。

Original: Debuting in 3063, the 5E is a Word of Blake designed upgrade to the older 4E design. Intended for deployment with Protectorate Militia units and Free Worlds League formations, the Blakists sought to rebuild the design with newer technology and correct some of the flaws apparent in the older design. Installing a new Light Fusion Engine and Endo Steel enabled the designers to swap the Thumper for the much larger and more powerful Sniper Artillery Canon. Defensively the design mounts CASE to protect against the ammunition explosions that plagued the older 4E model. A swap to ER Lasers and DHS round out the design, giving it increased range and striking power. Popular with Hunchback pilots and Artillery units, the design is slated for continuous production; with Kali Yama having to expand their Hunchback line to keep up with demand.
Name: Artillery_Units.mechdef_hunchback_HBK-5E.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Debuting in 3063, the 5E is a Word of Blake designed upgrade to the older 4E design. Intended for deployment with Protectorate Militia units and Free Worlds League formations, the Blakists sought to rebuild the design with newer technology and correct some of the flaws apparent in the older design. Installing a new Light Fusion Engine and Endo Steel enabled the designers to swap the Thumper for the much larger and more powerful Sniper Artillery Canon. Defensively the design mounts CASE to protect against the ammunition explosions that plagued the older 4E model. A swap to ER Lasers and DHS round out the design, giving it increased range and striking power. Popular with Hunchback pilots and Artillery units, the design is slated for continuous production; with Kali Yama having to expand their Hunchback line to keep up with demand.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5E 于 3063 年亮相，是布雷克之言为较老的 4E 设计所作的升级。为在保护国民兵单位与自由世界联盟编队中部署，布雷克派谋求用更新的技术重建该设计，并纠正旧设计中明显的缺陷。安装新的轻型聚变引擎与内骨骼，使设计师得以把重锤换成大得多、威力也强得多的狙击炮。防御方面，该设计装设 C.A.S.E. 以防困扰旧 4E 型号的弹药爆炸。激光换成 ER 型号并配 DHS，为设计收尾，赋予其更远的射程与更强的打击力。它受驼背飞行员与炮兵单位欢迎，被排入持续生产；卡利亚马不得不扩建其驼背生产线以满足需求。

Original: Built during the Amaris civil war, the Mackie 9Hb was a stopgap attempt to solve the SLDF's sudden dearth of advanced assault mechs. By taking Mackie 9H's from the remaining Hegemony stockpiles and upgrading them with surplus parts, the SLDF hoped to create a multi role assault mech for rear echelon and support duties; potentially freeing up better equipped machines that could be used on the frontlines. Equipped with 2 Thumper Artillery pieces and a cockpit command console, the 9Hb functions as both a command mech and an Artillery support platform. Though this design functions well as a support unit, it performs poorly in direct combat. Particularly devastating is the lack of CASE around the ammo magazines, a consequence of the rushed design process.
Name: Artillery_Units.mechdef_mackie_MSK-9Hb.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Built during the Amaris civil war, the Mackie 9Hb was a stopgap attempt to solve the SLDF's sudden dearth of advanced assault mechs. By taking Mackie 9H's from the remaining Hegemony stockpiles and upgrading them with surplus parts, the SLDF hoped to create a multi role assault mech for rear echelon and support duties; potentially freeing up better equipped machines that could be used on the frontlines. Equipped with 2 Thumper Artillery pieces and a cockpit command console, the 9Hb functions as both a command mech and an Artillery support platform. Though this design functions well as a support unit, it performs poorly in direct combat. Particularly devastating is the lack of CASE around the ammo magazines, a consequence of the rushed design process.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 麦基 9Hb 在阿马里斯内战期间建造，是为解决星盟防卫军先进突击机甲突然短缺的权宜之计。通过从霸权剩余库存中取用麦基 9H 并以剩余部件升级，星盟防卫军希望打造一款用于后方梯队与支援任务的多用途突击机甲，从而腾出装备更精良的机器用于前线。9Hb 装备两门重锤火炮与一个驾驶舱指挥台，兼具指挥机甲与火炮支援平台的功能。虽然作为支援单位表现出色，但在直接战斗中表现糟糕。尤其致命的是弹药匣周围缺乏 C.A.S.E.，这是设计过程仓促的后果。

Original: A clan buster refit developed with Comstar’s mothballed 9Hb’s, the 9Hc was an attempt to fix the failings of it’s predecessor design in a cheap and easy to maintain upgrade package. Identifying the lack of CASE and adequate secondary weapons as the key weaknesses, the Comguard designers disregarded the other weakness – the designs slow ground speed – as being of lesser importance. The designers selected an Endo Steel skeleton as the preferred option, rejecting other more expensive solutions. CASE was installed for both ammo magazines and the designers upgraded the medium lasers to ER versions; installing an extra 3 in the process with double heat sinks incorporated to balance out the heat spike. The 5 completed prototypes served with distinction on Tukayyid, though the design never reached production status; with only 2 other conversions finished before the Word of Blake seized Terra and the remaining stocks of 9Hb’s. .
Name: Artillery_Units.mechdef_mackie_MSK-9Hc.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A clan buster refit developed with Comstar’s mothballed 9Hb’s, the 9Hc was an attempt to fix the failings of it’s predecessor design in a cheap and easy to maintain upgrade package. Identifying the lack of CASE and adequate secondary weapons as the key weaknesses, the Comguard designers disregarded the other weakness – the designs slow ground speed – as being of lesser importance. The designers selected an Endo Steel skeleton as the preferred option, rejecting other more expensive solutions. CASE was installed for both ammo magazines and the designers upgraded the medium lasers to ER versions; installing an extra 3 in the process with double heat sinks incorporated to balance out the heat spike. The 5 completed prototypes served with distinction on Tukayyid, though the design never reached production status; with only 2 other conversions finished before the Word of Blake seized Terra and the remaining stocks of 9Hb’s. .
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 9Hc 是利用康星封存的 9Hb 开发的"破氏族"改装型，旨在以廉价易维护的升级包修正前型设计的缺陷。康卫设计师认定缺乏 C.A.S.E. 与足够的次要武器是关键弱点，而将设计的另一缺陷——地面速度缓慢——视为次要。设计师选择内骨骼骨架为首选方案，否决了其他更昂贵的解决途径。两个弹匣都安装了 C.A.S.E.，并将中型激光升级为 ER 版本；过程中还额外加装 3 门，并配以双倍散热器以平衡热量尖峰。5 台完成的原型机在图卡伊德表现出色，尽管该设计从未进入量产；在布雷克之言夺取地球及其剩余的 9Hb 库存前，仅又完成了 2 台改装。.

Original: The Naga is a fire-support successor to the first-generation Woodsman OmniMech, but is an oddity in many ways. Most of what could be pod space for the design is actually taken up by a pair of fixed Arrow IV Artillery Systems.

Name: Artillery_Units.mechdef_OBakemono_OBK-M10.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The O-Bakemono weighs in at eighty tons and has a top speed of 64.8 km/h, which is considered a good ground speed for an assault 'Mech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 大妖怪重八十吨，最高速度 64.8 公里/小时，对突击机甲而言算是不错的地面速度。

Original: The M11 downgrades the O-Bakemono's engine to a standard 240 Pitban, reducing its top speed to 54 km/h. The artillery pieces, along with their expensive ammunition, are removed and replaced with a pair of cheap MRM 40s
Name: Artillery_Units.mechdef_OBakemono_OBK-M11.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The M11 downgrades the O-Bakemono's engine to a standard 240 Pitban, reducing its top speed to 54 km/h. The artillery pieces, along with their expensive ammunition, are removed and replaced with a pair of cheap MRM 40s
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: M11 把 O-Bakemono 的引擎降级为标准皮特班 240，把最高速度降至 54 公里/小时。火炮及其昂贵弹药被移除，换成一对廉价的 MRM 40

Original: The M12 is a rarer variant due to the difficulty involved in the modifications to the 'Mech's loadout. The variant on the M11 removes two heat sinks and two tons of ammo to replace the C3 unit with a C3 Computer.
Name: Artillery_Units.mechdef_OBakemono_OBK-M12.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The M12 is a rarer variant due to the difficulty involved in the modifications to the 'Mech's loadout. The variant on the M11 removes two heat sinks and two tons of ammo to replace the C3 unit with a C3 Computer.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: M12 由于改装机甲载荷难度较大而较为罕见。这一基于 M11 的变体移除两台散热器和两吨弹药，把 C3 单元换成一台 C3 计算机。

Original: The Owens is intended to be an OmniMech upgrade of the Jenner BattleMech. The intended role for the Owens is as a cavalry 'Mech that can move along the enemy lines and designate targets for bombardment with Arrow IV artillery attacks. The Owens is a strong spotting unit as well as a point 'Mech for C3 lances with its permanently mounted TAG laser designator, Beagle Probe and C3 Slave unit.
Name: Artillery_Units.mechdef_owens_OW-1_Arty.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Owens is intended to be an OmniMech upgrade of the Jenner BattleMech. The intended role for the Owens is as a cavalry 'Mech that can move along the enemy lines and designate targets for bombardment with Arrow IV artillery attacks. The Owens is a strong spotting unit as well as a point 'Mech for C3 lances with its permanently mounted TAG laser designator, Beagle Probe and C3 Slave unit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 欧文斯旨在作为詹纳战斗机甲的全能机甲升级型。其定位是骑兵机甲，可沿敌方战线机动并为我方箭矢 IV 炮击标记目标。凭借固定安装的 TAG 激光指示器、比格犬探测器与 C3 从属单元，欧文斯既是优秀的侦察单位，也是 C3 小队的先锋机甲。

Original: With the reintroduction of Helm Core LosTech, the Taurian Defense Force found themselves lagging behind their neighbours. Just as they did during the Age of War, the Taurians turned to the home grown Talos. With a reputation as an easy to maintain and easy to manufacture mech, the design was just what the TDF needed. Lacking the resources to turn the newly redesigned Talos into a viable production model, the Taurians enlisted the aid of their neighbours, in exchange for joining the ongoing Trinity Alliance negotiations. Aided by the expertise of Capellan engineers and financial investment from the Magistracy of Canopus, Vandenburg started limited manufacturing of the Talos; at their New Vandenburg plant: in late 3059. The formal signing of the Trinity Alliance, in 3062; awarded production licenses to both Majesty Metals and Detroit Consolidated Mech Works. Both companies swiftly opened their own lines, producing multiple variants of the Talos for their own use and for export further afield.
Name: Artillery_Units.mechdef_talos_TLS-5A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: With the reintroduction of Helm Core LosTech, the Taurian Defense Force found themselves lagging behind their neighbours. Just as they did during the Age of War, the Taurians turned to the home grown Talos. With a reputation as an easy to maintain and easy to manufacture mech, the design was just what the TDF needed. Lacking the resources to turn the newly redesigned Talos into a viable production model, the Taurians enlisted the aid of their neighbours, in exchange for joining the ongoing Trinity Alliance negotiations. Aided by the expertise of Capellan engineers and financial investment from the Magistracy of Canopus, Vandenburg started limited manufacturing of the Talos; at their New Vandenburg plant: in late 3059. The formal signing of the Trinity Alliance, in 3062; awarded production licenses to both Majesty Metals and Detroit Consolidated Mech Works. Both companies swiftly opened their own lines, producing multiple variants of the Talos for their own use and for export further afield.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 随着赫尔姆核心失落科技的重现，陶里安防卫军发现自己落后于邻国。正如战争时代一样，陶里安人转向了本土成长的塔洛斯。这款机甲以易于维护和易于制造著称，正是陶里安防卫军所需。由于缺乏资源将新设计的塔洛斯转为可行的量产型号，陶里安人以加入正在进行的"三位一体同盟"谈判为交换，寻求邻国援助。在卡佩兰工程师的专业知识与卡诺普斯女权国的资金投入协助下，范登堡于 3059 年末在其新范登堡工厂开始了塔洛斯的限量生产。3062 年三位一体同盟正式签署，授予陛下金属公司与底特律联合机工厂生产许可。两家公司迅速开设了自己的生产线，为自用与远销生产了塔洛斯的多种变体。

Original: Produced by Maverick Industries after Operations Serpent and Bulldog, the TsarBomba is an attempt to improve the flexibility and survivability of artillery units. Noting the loss of many Arrow IV equipped units and the slaughter of their crews during Clan breakthroughs, the Maverick Industries design teams looked for ways to improve the situation. With a license to produce the Hollander BZK-F3 already secured, it was decided to produce an upgraded model that utilised an XL Engine to mount the Arrow IV launcher. Modern artillery tactics called for the deployment of anti air and anti mech units to protect the precious assets, so Maverick only mounted a Small Pulse Laser on the mech, augmented by a TAG; so that the Hollander could handle infantry infiltrators and spot for either it’s own launcher or the rest of it’s lancemates. The designs speed was judged sufficient for it to evade other threats that might threaten the mech, especially with it’s armour unable to stand up to much punishment.
Name: Artillery_Units.mechdef_tsarbomba_BZK-T2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Produced by Maverick Industries after Operations Serpent and Bulldog, the TsarBomba is an attempt to improve the flexibility and survivability of artillery units. Noting the loss of many Arrow IV equipped units and the slaughter of their crews during Clan breakthroughs, the Maverick Industries design teams looked for ways to improve the situation. With a license to produce the Hollander BZK-F3 already secured, it was decided to produce an upgraded model that utilised an XL Engine to mount the Arrow IV launcher. Modern artillery tactics called for the deployment of anti air and anti mech units to protect the precious assets, so Maverick only mounted a Small Pulse Laser on the mech, augmented by a TAG; so that the Hollander could handle infantry infiltrators and spot for either it’s own launcher or the rest of it’s lancemates. The designs speed was judged sufficient for it to evade other threats that might threaten the mech, especially with it’s armour unable to stand up to much punishment.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 沙皇炸弹由马弗里克工业在"蛇"与"斗牛犬"行动后生产，旨在提升炮兵单位的灵活性与生存性。注意到许多装备箭矢 IV 的单位损失、其乘员在氏族突破中被屠杀，马弗里克工业的设计团队寻找改善之道。凭借已获得的荷兰人 BZK-F3 生产许可，他们决定生产一款使用 XL 引擎以搭载箭矢 IV 发射器的升级型号。现代炮兵战术要求部署防空与反机甲单位保护这些宝贵资产，因此马弗里克只在机甲上装了一门小型脉冲激光并配 TAG；使荷兰人能对付步兵渗透者，并为自己或其他队友的发射器侦察。该设计的速度被认为足以避开其他可能威胁它的目标，尤其考虑到它的装甲经不起太多打击。
箭矢 IV 城市机甲

Original: This variant of the UrbanMech replaces the standard weaponry with an Arrow IV missile launcher and ER Medium Laser. It requires an Endo Steel chassis and Small Cockpit to provide room, and the UrbanMech can only carry ten rounds for the Arrow system. Despite these limitations, it is still a decent fire support unit.
Name: Artillery_Units.mechdef_urbanmech_UM-AIV.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant of the UrbanMech replaces the standard weaponry with an Arrow IV missile launcher and ER Medium Laser. It requires an Endo Steel chassis and Small Cockpit to provide room, and the UrbanMech can only carry ten rounds for the Arrow system. Despite these limitations, it is still a decent fire support unit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款都市机甲变体以箭矢 IV 导弹发射器和 ER 中型激光取代标准武器。它需要内骨骼底盘和小型驾驶舱来腾出空间，且都市机甲只能携带十发箭矢系统弹药。尽管有这些限制，它仍是不错的火力支援单位。

Original: Designed by the Capellans in the Succession Wars, the UM-R100 was deemed a failure due to mechanical issues with its large Thumper artillery cannon. However, after the introduction of the Helm Memory Core and Star League technologies, the Confederation revisted the -R100 and created this, the -R100X. Using Endo-Steel and Ferro-Fibrous as well as CASE, the -R100X brings tube artillery to the battlefield in a cheap and affordable package. Other than its Thumper cannon, the -R100X has only a pitiful ER Small Laser for defense.
Name: Artillery_Units.mechdef_urbanmech_UM-R100X.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed by the Capellans in the Succession Wars, the UM-R100 was deemed a failure due to mechanical issues with its large Thumper artillery cannon. However, after the introduction of the Helm Memory Core and Star League technologies, the Confederation revisted the -R100 and created this, the -R100X. Using Endo-Steel and Ferro-Fibrous as well as CASE, the -R100X brings tube artillery to the battlefield in a cheap and affordable package. Other than its Thumper cannon, the -R100X has only a pitiful ER Small Laser for defense.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: UM-R100 由卡佩兰人在继承战争中设计，因其大型重锤火炮的机械问题而被判定为失败。然而在赫尔姆记忆核心与星盟技术问世后，邦联重新审视-R100 并打造出这款-R100X。使用内骨骼、铁纤维以及 C.A.S.E.，-R100X 以廉价实惠的方案把管式火炮带上战场。除了重锤炮，-R100X 只有一门可怜巴巴的 ER 小型激光用于防御。

Original: After his son was killed in the Taurian Concordat invasion of the Federated Suns, Benedict St. James had his VTR-9K refitted with experimental weapons and equipment to allow him to take his revenge. Replacing the standard weapons with a Long Tom Cannon and two Medium X-Pulse Lasers, St. James' Victor can inflict massive amounts of damage on his prey. The 'Mech's jump jets had to be removed to make way for the weapons load, and technicians equipped it with a patchwork of Ferro-Fibrous and Standard Armor as another weight saving measure. A Supercharger mounted on the engine provides the Victor with unexpected bursts of speed.
Name: Artillery_Units.mechdef_victor_VTR-9K2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: After his son was killed in the Taurian Concordat invasion of the Federated Suns, Benedict St. James had his VTR-9K refitted with experimental weapons and equipment to allow him to take his revenge. Replacing the standard weapons with a Long Tom Cannon and two Medium X-Pulse Lasers, St. James' Victor can inflict massive amounts of damage on his prey. The 'Mech's jump jets had to be removed to make way for the weapons load, and technicians equipped it with a patchwork of Ferro-Fibrous and Standard Armor as another weight saving measure. A Supercharger mounted on the engine provides the Victor with unexpected bursts of speed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在陶里安协约入侵联邦太阳系时儿子被杀后，本尼迪克特·圣詹姆斯将自己的 VTR-9K 改装上实验性武器与装备以复仇。他把标准武器换成一门长汤姆炮和两门中型 X 脉冲激光，使圣詹姆斯的胜利者能对猎物造成巨量伤害。为给武器腾出空间，机甲的跳跃推进器不得不拆除，技师还为其配上铁纤维与标准装甲的拼装方案作为另一项减重措施。引擎上加装的增压器为胜利者提供了出其不意的速度爆发。

Original: The earliest version used standard heat sinks and its Primitive Engine could only manage 30 km/h. This proved to be a challenge as the early Helepolis needed to completely stop to fire the Sniper artillery and then start moving again before counter-battery fire could destroy the unit. Twenty and a half tons of Primitive Armor protected the Helepolis from enemy fire. The weight and bulk of the primitive systems prevented the designers from installing the long range missiles used on later models.
Name: Artillery_Units.chassisdef_helepolis_HEP-1H.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The earliest version used standard heat sinks and its Primitive Engine could only manage 30 km/h. This proved to be a challenge as the early Helepolis needed to completely stop to fire the Sniper artillery and then start moving again before counter-battery fire could destroy the unit. Twenty and a half tons of Primitive Armor protected the Helepolis from enemy fire. The weight and bulk of the primitive systems prevented the designers from installing the long range missiles used on later models.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最早版本使用标准散热器，其原始引擎仅能维持 30 公里/小时。这构成了挑战：早期攻城塔必须完全停下才能发射狙击炮，然后在对炮反击摧毁它之前再次启动。二十吨半的原始装甲保护攻城塔免受敌方火力。原始系统的重量与体积使设计师无法安装后期型号使用的远程导弹。

Original: The Helepolis is built around an Armstrong Industries Sniper Artillery Piece. The accurate, long-range fire makes it effective against static defenses. The 'Mech does carry some backup weapons to augment its screening forces. It can defend itself with a Coventry Starfire LRM-10 and Nova Large Laser. If an enemy gets close, the MechWarrior can call upon a Thunderstroke SRM-6 and a Starflash Medium Laser. This 2625 model upgrades the Large Laser to an ER Large Laser.
Name: Artillery_Units.chassisdef_helepolis_HEP-3H.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Helepolis is built around an Armstrong Industries Sniper Artillery Piece. The accurate, long-range fire makes it effective against static defenses. The 'Mech does carry some backup weapons to augment its screening forces. It can defend itself with a Coventry Starfire LRM-10 and Nova Large Laser. If an enemy gets close, the MechWarrior can call upon a Thunderstroke SRM-6 and a Starflash Medium Laser. This 2625 model upgrades the Large Laser to an ER Large Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 攻城塔以阿姆斯特朗工业的狙击炮为核心。精准的远程火力使其对固定防御极为有效。该机甲确实携带一些备用武器以增强其掩护部队。它可用一门考文垂"星火"LRM-10 和一门新星大型激光自卫。若敌人逼近，机甲战士还能依靠一门雷霆 SRM-6 和一门星光中型激光。此 2625 型号将大型激光升级为 ER 大型激光。

Original: This variant was introduced much more recently by Vining Engineering and Salvage Team. VEST rebuilt a factory on Solaris VII after the Word of Blake had left that world. There, they began to produce an upgraded version of the Helepolis. This upgrade of the 3H is built on an Endo Steel frame. It is powered by a 300-rated Light Fusion Engine that gives it a top speed of 64 km/h, though this necessitated splitting the missile launcher into two LRM-5s.
Name: Artillery_Units.chassisdef_helepolis_HEP-4H.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant was introduced much more recently by Vining Engineering and Salvage Team. VEST rebuilt a factory on Solaris VII after the Word of Blake had left that world. There, they began to produce an upgraded version of the Helepolis. This upgrade of the 3H is built on an Endo Steel frame. It is powered by a 300-rated Light Fusion Engine that gives it a top speed of 64 km/h, though this necessitated splitting the missile launcher into two LRM-5s.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此变体由维宁工程与打捞队新近推出。布雷克之言离开太阳系 VII 后，VEST 重建了那里的一座工厂，并开始生产升级版攻城塔。此 3H 升级版建立在内骨骼框架上，由 300 级轻型聚变引擎驱动，最高速度 64 公里/小时，但为此不得不把导弹发射器拆为两具 LRM-5。

Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_arctic_cheetah_ACH-A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A sleek, mobile, and versatile design, the Clan Arctic Cheetah was long suspected to be one of the first OmniMechs produced by the Clans.

Original: The Arctic Fox is a light OmniMech reverse engineered by the Kell Hounds from the Clan Uller OmniMech with assistance in the final stages from Clan Wolf-in-Exile. The resulting OmniMech is a powerful light 'Mech that has a top speed of 97.2 km/h that is provided by a GM 180 XL engine, shaving off valuable weight from the Arctic Fox's base chassis while also making the 'Mech vulnerable to becoming a combat kill through the loss of one of its side torsos. The Arctic Fox has ten double heat sinks which are generally enough to handle the 'Mech's heat load, with the ability to add more if needed. To protect itself from enemy fire, the Arctic Fox has six tons of Royal-7 armor.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_arctic_fox_af1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Arctic Fox is a light OmniMech reverse engineered by the Kell Hounds from the Clan Uller OmniMech with assistance in the final stages from Clan Wolf-in-Exile. The resulting OmniMech is a powerful light 'Mech that has a top speed of 97.2 km/h that is provided by a GM 180 XL engine, shaving off valuable weight from the Arctic Fox's base chassis while also making the 'Mech vulnerable to becoming a combat kill through the loss of one of its side torsos. The Arctic Fox has ten double heat sinks which are generally enough to handle the 'Mech's heat load, with the ability to add more if needed. To protect itself from enemy fire, the Arctic Fox has six tons of Royal-7 armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 极地狐是凯尔猎犬依据氏族乌勒尔全能机甲逆向工程而来的轻型全能机甲，最终阶段得到流亡狼氏族的协助。成品是一款强劲的轻型机甲，由 GM 180 XL 引擎提供 97.2 公里/小时的最高速度，既为极地狐的基础底盘省下宝贵重量，也使它因失去任一侧面躯干而容易被击毁。它装有十台双倍散热器，通常足以应对其热负荷，必要时还可加装。为抵御敌方火力，极地狐拥有六吨 Royal-7 装甲。

Original: The primary configuration of the Arctic Fox is intended to wear an enemy's armor down at long ranges and then close for the kill. To do this, the Arctic Fox carries an ER PPC that can hit a target at up to six hundred and ninety meters. For close combat, two Medium Lasers provide the primary hitting power while two SRM-4 launchers seek out weak points in an enemy's armor.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_arctic_fox_af1.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary configuration of the Arctic Fox is intended to wear an enemy's armor down at long ranges and then close for the kill. To do this, the Arctic Fox carries an ER PPC that can hit a target at up to six hundred and ninety meters. For close combat, two Medium Lasers provide the primary hitting power while two SRM-4 launchers seek out weak points in an enemy's armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 北极狐主配置意在远距离磨掉敌人装甲，然后逼近收尾。为此，北极狐携带一门 ER PPC，能在六百九十米外命中目标。近战方面，两门中型激光构成主要打击力，而两具 SRM-4 发射器搜寻敌人装甲上的弱点。

Original: A Combine modification of the K model introduced in 3050, the C model carried a C3 Slave unit into combat. This was achieved by removing one of the Medium Pulse Lasers from the K model. The extra free ton was used to add another heat sink to the design.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_atlas_AS7-C.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Combine modification of the K model introduced in 3050, the C model carried a C3 Slave unit into combat. This was achieved by removing one of the Medium Pulse Lasers from the K model. The extra free ton was used to add another heat sink to the design.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: C 型是 3050 年推出的 K 型的联合体改装，它把一台 C3 从属单元带入战斗。这通过从 K 型移除一门中型脉冲激光实现。多出的一吨用于为设计增加一台散热器。

Original: Another 'Mech design that the Combine inherited when they took Independence Weaponries on Quentin in the War of 3039, the Atlas C was one of the first designs thought of when Combine Engineers began incorporating C3 units into BattleMechs. Since the Atlas has such a large arsenal of weapons, the removal of one medium pulse lasers was of small consequence. Added in its place was a C3 slave and another heat sink to help the design dissipate the huge amounts of heat it already produces.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_atlas_AS7-C.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another 'Mech design that the Combine inherited when they took Independence Weaponries on Quentin in the War of 3039, the Atlas C was one of the first designs thought of when Combine Engineers began incorporating C3 units into BattleMechs. Since the Atlas has such a large arsenal of weapons, the removal of one medium pulse lasers was of small consequence. Added in its place was a C3 slave and another heat sink to help the design dissipate the huge amounts of heat it already produces.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为联合体在 3039 年战争中接管昆汀上的独立兵器公司时继承的另一款机甲设计，阿特拉斯 C 是联合体工程师开始把 C3 单元整合进战斗机甲时最先想到的设计之一。由于阿特拉斯武器库庞大，移除一门中型脉冲激光影响很小。代替它加装的是一台 C3 从属单元和一台额外散热器，以帮助该设计散发它本来就会产生的大量热量。

Original: Another modification of the K model of the Atlas introduced in 3050, the CM Atlas was designed to carry a C3 Master Computer into battle. In order to do this one of the ER Large Lasers was removed and in its place a C3 Master computer was installed, allowing it to coordinate a C3 lance.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_atlas_AS7-CM.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another modification of the K model of the Atlas introduced in 3050, the CM Atlas was designed to carry a C3 Master Computer into battle. In order to do this one of the ER Large Lasers was removed and in its place a C3 Master computer was installed, allowing it to coordinate a C3 lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: CM 阿特拉斯是 3050 年推出的阿特拉斯 K 型的又一改装，旨在把 C3 主控计算机带入战斗。为此移除了一门 ER 大型激光，在原位安装 C3 主控计算机，使其能协调一个 C3 小队。

Lighter Clan components allowed the Atlas C to carry 3 tons of autocannon ammunition.

Original: A very basic FedCom upgrade of the standard Atlas introduced in 3050, the S model removed five heat sinks from the design, upgrading the rest to Double Heat Sinks. The weight savings are used to add two rear firing Coventry T4H Streak SRM-2 launchers, giving the Atlas increased protection in its rear arc of fire. After the civil war production of this model ceased, although garrison forces in both sundered states continued to use them, with AFFS units using Precision Ammunition for the autocannon and LAAF units making use of specialized LRM munitions captured from the Free Worlds League.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_atlas_AS7-S.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A very basic FedCom upgrade of the standard Atlas introduced in 3050, the S model removed five heat sinks from the design, upgrading the rest to Double Heat Sinks. The weight savings are used to add two rear firing Coventry T4H Streak SRM-2 launchers, giving the Atlas increased protection in its rear arc of fire. After the civil war production of this model ceased, although garrison forces in both sundered states continued to use them, with AFFS units using Precision Ammunition for the autocannon and LAAF units making use of specialized LRM munitions captured from the Free Worlds League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: S 型是 3050 年推出的标准阿特拉斯联邦联邦版基础升级，从设计中移除五台散热器，其余升级为双倍散热器。节省的重量用于加装两具后向考文垂 T4H 连续 SRM-2 发射器，增强阿特拉斯后方射界的防护。内战之后此型号停产，但两个分裂国家的驻防部队仍在使用，AFFS 单位为自动炮使用精确弹药，LAAF 单位则使用从自由世界联盟缴获的特种 LRM 弹药。

Original: The S2 Atlas was a major upgrade of the design by the Lyran Alliance coming out of the Hesperus II facility in 3061. The 'Mech was built with a Light Fusion Engine and carried an Artemis IV Fire Control System enhanced LRM-15 launcher and two ER large lasers as its primary long range weapons. For close combat, the 'Mech was armed with a Heavy Gauss Rifle. The S2 mounted a Guardian ECM Suite in place of the AMS to protect against enemy electronic warfare equipment.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_atlas_AS7-S2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The S2 Atlas was a major upgrade of the design by the Lyran Alliance coming out of the Hesperus II facility in 3061. The 'Mech was built with a Light Fusion Engine and carried an Artemis IV Fire Control System enhanced LRM-15 launcher and two ER large lasers as its primary long range weapons. For close combat, the 'Mech was armed with a Heavy Gauss Rifle. The S2 mounted a Guardian ECM Suite in place of the AMS to protect against enemy electronic warfare equipment.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: S2 阿特拉斯是莱兰联盟于 3061 年从赫斯佩鲁斯 II 工厂推出的重大升级。机甲采用轻型聚变引擎建造，携带一具 Artemis IV 火控系统增强的 LRM-15 发射器，以及两门 ER 大型激光作为主要远程武器。近战方面，机甲装备一门重型高斯步枪。S2 以守护者 ECM 套件取代 AMS，用于抵御敌方电子战装备。

Original: First fielded in 2765, the Atlas II was designed by the Hegemony Research and Development Department, Weapons Division of the original Star League to maintain the technological edge over the other Great Houses. It was exclusively for the SLDF's Royal Regiments. In 2785, when General Aleksandr Kerensky put out his call for loyal forces to join him in his Exodus, every Atlas II pilot responded and left with him. The Atlas II is armed with an array of weaponry, including an LB-X Autocannon/10, a pair of ER Large Lasers, and a 20-tube Long Range Missile Launcher for long range attacks. For close range combat, the 'Mech is equipped with a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers and a Holly Six Pack. In addition, the 'Mech has been given CASEfor both sides of the torso in order to keep an ammunition cook-off from consuming the 'Mech.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_atlas_ii_AS7-D-H.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: First fielded in 2765, the Atlas II was designed by the Hegemony Research and Development Department, Weapons Division of the original Star League to maintain the technological edge over the other Great Houses. It was exclusively for the SLDF's Royal Regiments. In 2785, when General Aleksandr Kerensky put out his call for loyal forces to join him in his Exodus, every Atlas II pilot responded and left with him. The Atlas II is armed with an array of weaponry, including an LB-X Autocannon/10, a pair of ER Large Lasers, and a 20-tube Long Range Missile Launcher for long range attacks. For close range combat, the 'Mech is equipped with a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers and a Holly Six Pack. In addition, the 'Mech has been given CASEfor both sides of the torso in order to keep an ammunition cook-off from consuming the 'Mech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿特拉斯 II 于 2765 年首次投入战场，由原星盟的霸权研发部武器司设计，以维持对各大议院的技术优势。它专供星盟防卫军皇家团使用。2785 年亚历山大·克伦斯基将军号召忠诚部队随他出埃及时，每一位阿特拉斯 II 飞行员都响应并随他离开。阿特拉斯 II 装备一系列武器，包括一门 LB-X 自动炮/10、两门 ER 大型激光和一具 20 管远程导弹发射器用于远程攻击。近距离战斗则配备两门中型脉冲激光和一具冬青六联装。此外，机甲两侧躯干都装有 C.A.S.E.，以防弹药殉爆吞噬整机。
