Original: A basic upgrade to the original 8Q introduced in 3057, the heat sinks are upgraded to double heat sinks and are reduced to nineteen. The saved weight is used to add a fourth PPC to the 'Mech as well as a Guardian ECM Suite. Although there was some criticism for using basic PPCs and not upgrading to ER models, the 9Q proved itself during Operation Guerrero to be quite devastating.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_awesome_AWS-9Q.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A basic upgrade to the original 8Q introduced in 3057, the heat sinks are upgraded to double heat sinks and are reduced to nineteen. The saved weight is used to add a fourth PPC to the 'Mech as well as a Guardian ECM Suite. Although there was some criticism for using basic PPCs and not upgrading to ER models, the 9Q proved itself during Operation Guerrero to be quite devastating.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 9Q 是 3057 年推出的对原版 8Q 的基础升级，散热器升级为双倍并减少至十九台。节省的重量用于为机甲加装第四门 PPC 以及一套守护者 ECM 套件。尽管有人批评它使用基础 PPC 而未升级为 ER 型号，9Q 在"格雷罗"行动中证明自己相当具毁灭性。
重型狙击手 & 防御者

Original: This variant of the Awesome is designed for units that cannot afford the newer, and more costly, variants or for older machines that, due to past damage, cannot be upgraded with the newer weapon systems and construction materials. The 9Q has a higher damage curve than previous models due to the inclusion of a fourth particle projectile cannon. Included into the design is also a Guardian ECM suite, making the design difficult to target with many of the newer weapon systems available to date. While the Awesome of past days were feared, this newest refit of the Awesome will strike fear into any warrior that crosses its path.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_awesome_AWS-9Q.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant of the Awesome is designed for units that cannot afford the newer, and more costly, variants or for older machines that, due to past damage, cannot be upgraded with the newer weapon systems and construction materials. The 9Q has a higher damage curve than previous models due to the inclusion of a fourth particle projectile cannon. Included into the design is also a Guardian ECM suite, making the design difficult to target with many of the newer weapon systems available to date. While the Awesome of past days were feared, this newest refit of the Awesome will strike fear into any warrior that crosses its path.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 神奇的这一变体是为那些买不起更新、更昂贵变体的单位，或因过往损伤无法用新武器系统与建造材料升级的老旧机器设计的。由于加入第四门粒子投射炮，9Q 的伤害曲线高于前型号。设计中还加入了守护者 ECM 套件，使该设计难以被迄今可用的许多较新武器系统锁定。过去的神奇令人畏惧，而神奇这一最新改装将让任何与它相遇的战士心生恐惧。

Original: The Bane is a BattleMech that is based upon a Star League prototype that was never put into production. Tagged the Kraken by Inner Sphere forces who opposed it, the Bane was first built in 2827. It was originally a significant part of many Clan toumans, but was gradually relegated to second-line status following the introduction of the OmniMech. As such, it is still critical to many defensive units.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_bane_prime.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Bane is a BattleMech that is based upon a Star League prototype that was never put into production. Tagged the Kraken by Inner Sphere forces who opposed it, the Bane was first built in 2827. It was originally a significant part of many Clan toumans, but was gradually relegated to second-line status following the introduction of the OmniMech. As such, it is still critical to many defensive units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 灾祸是一款以星盟从未投产的原型为基础的战斗机甲。它被对抗它的内天体部队冠以"海怪"之名，于 2827 年首次建造。它原本是许多氏族图曼的重要组成部分，但随着全能机甲的引入逐渐退居二线。即便如此，它对许多防御单位仍至关重要。

Original: An upgrade of the 3S variant using Star League technology, the 5S replaces the engine with an XL Engine and uses double heat sinks to save weight, restoring its top speed to 64.8 km/h. The 'Mech is armed for long range combat with a Poland Main Model A Gauss Rifle and two Defiance 1001 ER PPCs. For close ranges, the 'Mech has a TharHes Maxi SRM-6, four Defiance B3M Medium Lasers, and two Defiance B3S Small Lasers, and is also equipped with an Angst Clear Channel 3 comsys.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_banshee_BNC-5S.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade of the 3S variant using Star League technology, the 5S replaces the engine with an XL Engine and uses double heat sinks to save weight, restoring its top speed to 64.8 km/h. For close ranges, the 'Mech has a TharHes Maxi SRM-6, four Defiance B3M Medium Lasers, and two Defiance B3S Small Lasers, and is also equipped with an Angst Clear Channel 3 comsys.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5S 是使用星盟科技的 3S 变体升级版，将引擎换成 XL 引擎并用双倍散热器节省重量，把最高速度恢复到 64.8 公里/小时。机甲为远程战斗装备一门波兰 A 型主炮高斯步枪和两门迪法恩斯 1001 ER PPC。近程则有一具塔尔赫斯 Maxi SRM-6、四门迪法恩斯 B3M 中型激光和两门迪法恩斯 B3S 小型激光，还配备安格斯特清频 3 通信系统。

Original: The 1Gb was an upgraded BattleMaster that was used by the Terran Hegemony-based SLDF Royal units. Introduced in 2760 it was built on an Endo Steel chassis and used double heat sinks. It only retained the forward-facing medium lasers to which was added a pair of ER PPCs, one in each arm, and a Large Pulse Laser in the center torso.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_battlemaster_BLR-1GB.Details

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 1Gb 是升级版战斗大师，供以地球霸权为基地的星盟防卫军皇家部队使用。它于 2760 年推出，建立在内骨骼底盘上并使用双倍散热器。它仅保留了前向中型激光，并加装两门 ER PPC（每臂一门）和中央躯干一门大型脉冲激光。

Original: The 3M was a basic upgrade of the BattleMaster utilizing Star League technology. Introduced by Earthwerks Incorporated for the Free Worlds League in 3049, the 'Mech replaces the standard heat sinks with double heat sinks, upgrades its primary weapon to a Fusigon Longtooth ER PPC and removes one of the machine guns to add CASE to the design to protect itself in the event of an ammunition explosion.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_battlemaster_BLR-3M.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3M was a basic upgrade of the BattleMaster utilizing Star League technology. Introduced by Earthwerks Incorporated for the Free Worlds League in 3049, the 'Mech replaces the standard heat sinks with double heat sinks, upgrades its primary weapon to a Fusigon Longtooth ER PPC and removes one of the machine guns to add CASE to the design to protect itself in the event of an ammunition explosion.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3M 是利用星盟技术对战将的基础升级。它由地球工厂公司于 3049 年为自由世界联盟推出，把标准散热器换成双倍散热器，主武器升级为"富西贡长牙"ER PPC，并移除一挺机枪以给设计加装 C.A.S.E.，在弹药爆炸时保护自身。
重型缠斗者 & 近程突击

Original: This is the Free Worlds League official version of the Battlemaster from  Earthwerks factory on Keystone, the BLR-3M. It features Cellular Ammunition Storage Equipment to guard against an internal explosion, and double heat sinks, allowing it to dissipate great amounts of heat in a short time. The only change in weaponry is mounting the Fusigon Longtooth Extended-Range Particle Projection Cannon instead of the older Donal model and dropping one of the two machine guns.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_battlemaster_BLR-3M.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is the Free Worlds League official version of the Battlemaster from  Earthwerks factory on Keystone, the BLR-3M. It features Cellular Ammunition Storage Equipment to guard against an internal explosion, and double heat sinks, allowing it to dissipate great amounts of heat in a short time. The only change in weaponry is mounting the Fusigon Longtooth Extended-Range Particle Projection Cannon instead of the older Donal model and dropping one of the two machine guns.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是自由世界联盟官方版本的战将，出自基斯通上的地球工厂，即 BLR-3M。它采用蜂窝式弹药储存设备以防内部爆炸，并使用双倍散热器，使它能在短时间内散发大量热量。武器上唯一的变化是装用"富西贡长牙"增程粒子投射炮取代较老的"多纳尔"型号，并去掉两挺机枪中的一挺。

Original: The Battle Hawk was originally designed and built at a time when Defiance Industries felt threatened by the large amount of equipment being produced by, and imported from, the Free Worlds League. It was built to prove that Defiance Industries was still an industry leader in BattleMechs. This came from a 'Mech that, while slow for its weight class, is a force to be reckoned with on the modern battlefield. The Battle Hawk has a top speed of 86.4 kph, which puts it on par with 'Mechs fifteen to twenty tons heavier than itself, but it also carries a powerful arsenal for its size. Its five and a half tons of armor give it good protection for a light 'Mech. Additionally, to make the Battle Hawk more maneuverable on the battlefield, it can jump up to one hundred and fifty meters.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_battle_hawk_BH-K305.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Battle Hawk was originally designed and built at a time when Defiance Industries felt threatened by the large amount of equipment being produced by, and imported from, the Free Worlds League. It was built to prove that Defiance Industries was still an industry leader in BattleMechs. This came from a 'Mech that, while slow for its weight class, is a force to be reckoned with on the modern battlefield. The Battle Hawk has a top speed of 86.4 kph, which puts it on par with 'Mechs fifteen to twenty tons heavier than itself, but it also carries a powerful arsenal for its size. Its five and a half tons of armor give it good protection for a light 'Mech. Additionally, to make the Battle Hawk more maneuverable on the battlefield, it can jump up to one hundred and fifty meters.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战斗鹰设计与建造之时，迪法恩斯工业正感到被自由世界联盟生产与进口的大量装备所威胁。它的诞生是为了证明迪法恩斯工业仍是战斗机甲行业的领导者。成果是一款虽在同重量级中偏慢、但在现代战场上不容小觑的机甲。战斗鹰最高速度 86.4 公里/小时，与其重十五到二十吨的机甲持平，同时也为此尺寸携带了强大的武器库。五吨半装甲为轻型机甲提供了良好防护。此外，为提升战场机动性，战斗鹰可跳跃至一百五十米。

Original: The Battle Hawk is armed with a powerful short-range arsenal. The primary weaponry is a trio of Defiance P5M Medium Pulse Lasers, which provides the Battle Hawk with a blistering short-range laser arsenal. The 'Mech is also armed with a Hovertec Streak SRM-2 which allows the 'Mech to attempt to seek out weak points in an enemy's armor. The 'Mech is also armed with a McArthur Anti-Missile System which provides the Battle Hawk with a degree of protection from missile attacks.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_battle_hawk_BH-K305.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Battle Hawk is armed with a powerful short-range arsenal. The primary weaponry is a trio of Defiance P5M Medium Pulse Lasers, which provides the Battle Hawk with a blistering short-range laser arsenal. The 'Mech is also armed with a Hovertec Streak SRM-2 which allows the 'Mech to attempt to seek out weak points in an enemy's armor. The 'Mech is also armed with a McArthur Anti-Missile System which provides the Battle Hawk with a degree of protection from missile attacks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战鹰装备强大的近程武器库。主武器为三门迪法恩斯 P5M 中型脉冲激光，为战鹰提供炽烈的近程激光武器库。机甲还装备一具"气垫"连续 SRM-2，使机甲能尝试搜寻敌方装甲上的弱点。机甲另装有一套麦克阿瑟反导系统，为战鹰提供一定程度的导弹攻击防护。

Original: The Black Hawk-KU is an Inner Sphere version of the Clan Black Hawk OmniMech. In order to make it possible to copy the Black Hawk, the Black Hawk-KU is built ten tons heavier than its Clan counterpart. The Black Hawk-KU is built on a sixty ton chassis and is powered by a Vlar 300 XL Engine which propels it to a top speed of 86.4 kph.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_black_hawk-ku_BHKU-O.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Black Hawk-KU is an Inner Sphere version of the Clan Black Hawk OmniMech. In order to make it possible to copy the Black Hawk, the Black Hawk-KU is built ten tons heavier than its Clan counterpart. The Black Hawk-KU is built on a sixty ton chassis and is powered by a Vlar 300 XL Engine which propels it to a top speed of 86.4 kph.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑鹰-KU 是氏族黑鹰全能机甲的内天体版本。为使复制黑鹰成为可能，黑鹰-KU 比其氏族对应型重了十吨。它采用六十吨底盘，由 Vlar 300 XL 引擎驱动，最高速度 86.4 公里/小时。

Original: The Black Lanner A is configured for electronic warfare and scouting. It uses an Active Probe to find hidden units, an ECM Suite to counteract enemy electronics, and a TAG spotting laser to designate targets for homing artillery. Offensively, it can call upon an ER PPC and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers.

It uses an Active Probe to find hidden units, an ECM Suite to counteract enemy electronics, and a TAG spotting laser to designate targets for homing artillery. Offensively, it can call upon an ER PPC and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑猎隼 A 为电子战与侦察而配置。它使用主动探测器寻找隐藏单位、ECM 套件对抗敌方电子设备、TAG 侦察激光为寻的炮弹标记目标。攻击方面，它能依靠一门 ER PPC 和两门中型脉冲激光。

Original: This close-range brawler mounts pairs of Medium Pulse Lasers, SRM-6s, ER Small Lasers, Flamers, and four Machine Guns. This configuration is devastating to conventional infantry and a serious threat to combat vehicles. An Active Probe ensures that it is rarely surprised.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_black_lanner_BKL-D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This close-range brawler mounts pairs of Medium Pulse Lasers, SRM-6s, ER Small Lasers, Flamers, and four Machine Guns. This configuration is devastating to conventional infantry and a serious threat to combat vehicles. An Active Probe ensures that it is rarely surprised.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款近战近战型装备成对的中型脉冲激光、SRM-6、ER 小型激光、火焰喷射器和四挺机枪。此配置对常规步兵极具毁灭性，对战斗车辆也是严重威胁。主动探测器确保它很少被突袭。

Original: The primary configuration of the Black Lanner is effective at all ranges. At long range, it can make use of an ER Large Laser and LRM-10. Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_black_lanner_BKL-Prime.Details

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑猎隼的主配置在各类距离上都很有效。远距离可用一门 ER 大型激光和一具 LRM-10。接近后，它可用两门 ER 中型激光和一具 SRM-6 攻击，后者能利用对手装甲上的破口。ECM 套件保护它免受多种电子手段干扰。

Original: The Black Python is similar in many ways to the Warhammer and Marauder BattleMechs. Though it is faster than those heavies, it has a similar weapons load-out with comparable damage, albeit with much more accurate damage potential. In order to achieve this, this expensive second-line 'Mech avails itself of all weight saving technologies that were at the disposal of the Clans, including an XL Engine, Endo Steel frame, and eleven tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_black_python_BP-2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Black Python is similar in many ways to the Warhammer and Marauder BattleMechs. Though it is faster than those heavies, it has a similar weapons load-out with comparable damage, albeit with much more accurate damage potential. In order to achieve this, this expensive second-line 'Mech avails itself of all weight saving technologies that were at the disposal of the Clans, including an XL Engine, Endo Steel frame, and eleven tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑蟒在许多方面与战锤和掠夺者战斗机甲相似。虽然比这两款重型机甲更快，但它的武器配置与伤害相当，只是伤害潜力更为精准。为实现这一点，这款昂贵的二线机甲使用了氏族可用的一切减重技术，包括 XL 引擎、内骨骼框架和十一吨铁纤维装甲。

Original: When the say Inferno, no one realized they were referring to the temperature inside the cockpit.  I suggest removing some of the lasers and adding a heat sink or two.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_blazing_inferno_COM-2D-BI.YangsThoughts

Original: We call the Cataphract a "FrankenMech" because it's got a little bit of everything stitched together on it. The 0X model was a limited prototype that contained hardwired Electronics Warfare Equipment but never received full Line production.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_cataphract_CTF-0X.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We call the Cataphract a "FrankenMech" because it's got a little bit of everything stitched together on it. The 0X model was a limited prototype that contained hardwired Electronics Warfare Equipment but never received full Line production.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们把铠装骑兵称为"科学怪机"，因为它身上东拼西凑了各种东西。0X 型号是有限的原型，内嵌硬连线的电子战设备，但从未进入全面量产。

Original: We call the Cataphract a "FrankenMech" because it's got a little bit of everything stitched together on it. The 1X model works well at medium-long to closer range, with good armor and weaponry.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_cataphract_CTF-0X.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We call the Cataphract a "FrankenMech" because it's got a little bit of everything stitched together on it. The 1X model works well at medium-long to closer range, with good armor and weaponry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们称铁甲舰为"拼装机甲"，因为它把五花八门的东西缝在了一起。1X 型号在中远到较近距离都表现出色，装甲与武器俱佳。

Original: The longest ranged weapon carried by the CTF-3D Cataphract is a General Motors Nova-5 Ultra AC-5 in its right arm, boasting a rate of fire twice that of a standard autocannon. This is backed up by a Mydron Excel LB-X Autocannon/10 in its right torso, capable of firing both solid and cluster rounds. It is a more popular weapon than the Ultra AC-5, especially for use in an anti-conventional and anti-aircraft role without the possibility of jamming. Finally, the 'Mech has four Intek Medium Lasers for close range defense, one in each arm firing forward and two in its torso covering the rear. With only two tons of ammo for the LB-X 10 and one ton for the Ultra, if it runs dry the Cataphract must fall back to be reloaded before continuing the fight. Eleven tons of armor combined with CASE allowed the Cataphract to easily absorb damage. Sixteen heat sinks keep it cool while four HildCo Model 12 jump jets gave it a jumping distance of one hundred and twenty meters. Room for these improvements was made by using a GM 280 XL Engine.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_cataphract_CTF-3D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The longest ranged weapon carried by the CTF-3D Cataphract is a General Motors Nova-5 Ultra AC-5 in its right arm, boasting a rate of fire twice that of a standard autocannon. This is backed up by a Mydron Excel LB-X Autocannon/10 in its right torso, capable of firing both solid and cluster rounds. It is a more popular weapon than the Ultra AC-5, especially for use in an anti-conventional and anti-aircraft role without the possibility of jamming. Finally, the 'Mech has four Intek Medium Lasers for close range defense, one in each arm firing forward and two in its torso covering the rear. With only two tons of ammo for the LB-X 10 and one ton for the Ultra, if it runs dry the Cataphract must fall back to be reloaded before continuing the fight. Eleven tons of armor combined with CASE allowed the Cataphract to easily absorb damage. Sixteen heat sinks keep it cool while four HildCo Model 12 jump jets gave it a jumping distance of one hundred and twenty meters. Room for these improvements was made by using a GM 280 XL Engine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: CTF-3D 铠装骑兵携带的最远射程武器是右臂的一门通用汽车"新星-5"超速 AC-5，射速是标准自动炮的两倍。它由右躯干一门迈德龙 Excel LB-X 自动炮/10 支援，可发射实心弹与集束弹。它比超速 AC-5 更受欢迎，尤其用于反常规与防空任务且不会卡壳。最后，机甲有四门英泰克中型激光用于近程防御，每臂一门向前，躯干两门覆盖后方。LB-X 10 只有两吨弹药、超速炮一吨，一旦打空，铠装骑兵必须后撤装填才能继续作战。十一吨装甲结合 C.A.S.E. 使铠装骑兵能轻易吸收伤害。十六台散热器使其保持低温，四个希尔德科 12 型跳跃推进器赋予它一百二十米的跳跃距离。这些改进所需的空间来自一台 GM 280 XL 引擎。

Original: Produced by the Capellans based on stolen Davion designs, the 3L is an upgraded version of the Cataphract that follows more in line with the prototype 1X model. It is propelled by an XL Engine with MASC instead of jump jets allowing it to reach speeds of 86.4 km/h in short bursts. While it is also armed with an LB-X Autocannon/10 as its primary weapon this is instead matched with a Ceres Arms Warrior ER PPC for powerful striking capabilities at long range. Other differences include the use of four Medium Pulse Lasers and double heat sinks in place of the standard models. This design was produced by the Confederation at Grand Base following the ascension of Chancellor Romano Liao.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_cataphract_CTF-3L.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Produced by the Capellans based on stolen Davion designs, the 3L is an upgraded version of the Cataphract that follows more in line with the prototype 1X model. It is propelled by an XL Engine with MASC instead of jump jets allowing it to reach speeds of 86.4 km/h in short bursts. While it is also armed with an LB-X Autocannon/10 as its primary weapon this is instead matched with a Ceres Arms Warrior ER PPC for powerful striking capabilities at long range. Other differences include the use of four Medium Pulse Lasers and double heat sinks in place of the standard models. This design was produced by the Confederation at Grand Base following the ascension of Chancellor Romano Liao.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3L 由卡佩兰人基于窃取的达维昂设计生产，是铁甲舰的升级版，更贴近原型 1X 型号。它由配 MASC 的 XL 引擎驱动而非跳跃推进器，可在短促爆发中达到 86.4 公里/小时。虽然主武器同为 LB-X 自动炮/10，但它改配一门谷神星军械"战士"ER PPC，具备强大的远程打击能力。其他差异包括使用四门中型脉冲激光和双倍散热器取代标准型号。此设计在罗曼诺·廖大臣登位后由邦联在格兰德基地生产。

Original: The C3 variant takes the 'Mech's long range fire support to a new level by removing both of the LRM-15 launchers and replacing them with an Arrow IV artillery system, allowing the Catapult to stay a safe distance from the battlefield.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_catapult_CPLT-C3.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The C3 variant takes the 'Mech's long range fire support to a new level by removing both of the LRM-15 launchers and replacing them with an Arrow IV artillery system, allowing the Catapult to stay a safe distance from the battlefield.

Original: An upgrade of the C4 model. The standard fusion engine is replaced with an extralight engine. With the extra freed tonnage, a large laser and Beagle Active Probe can be mounted. The two Small Lasers are replaced with a single pulse version. The heat sinks are upgraded to double strength models.

Original: An upgrade of the C3 model, this variant first appeared during the St. Ives Conflict. It retains the Arrow IV artillery system, but its chassis has been upgraded to Endo Steel and its heat sinks to improved versions. This allows the C5 to increase its armor coverage to twelve and a half tons, upgrade its lasers to ER Medium Lasers, and quadruple the amount of ammo carried with protection provided by CASE.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_catapult_CPLT-C5.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade of the C3 model, this variant first appeared during the St. Ives Conflict. This allows the C5 to increase its armor coverage to twelve and a half tons, upgrade its lasers to ER Medium Lasers, and quadruple the amount of ammo carried with protection provided by CASE.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此变体是 C3 型号的升级版，首次出现在圣艾夫斯冲突期间。它保留箭矢 IV 火炮系统，但底盘升级为内骨骼，散热器升级为改进型。这使 C5 能把装甲覆盖增至十二吨半，将激光升级为 ER 中型激光，并把弹药携带量翻两番，同时以 C.A.S.E. 提供保护。

Original: The CattleMaster was created at the turn of the thirty-first century as an IndustrialMech to handle large herd animals. The concept for the Rancher 'Mech dates back to the twenty-fourth century. The 'Mech is noted for its durability and flexible Internal Combustion Engine.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_cattlemaster_CTL-3R3.Details

The concept for the Rancher 'Mech dates back to the twenty-fourth century. The 'Mech is noted for its durability and flexible Internal Combustion Engine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 牧牛人于三十一世纪之交被制造为工业机甲，用于处置大型畜群。这类"牧场主"机甲的概念可追溯至二十四世纪。此机甲以其耐用性和灵活的内燃引擎著称。

Original: A heavier 55-ton version of the venerable Centurion, the CN10-B was built in 3057 and uses an Endo Steel chassis to save weight on the design while retaining the CN9-A's original ground speed through the use of a 220-rated standard fusion engine. Much like the CN9-D, the 10-B carries an LB-X Autocannon/10 as its primary weapon with an LRM-10 launcher with an Artemis IV fire control system, but these are backed up by a medium laser and a medium pulse laser.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_centurion_CN10-B.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A heavier 55-ton version of the venerable Centurion, the CN10-B was built in 3057 and uses an Endo Steel chassis to save weight on the design while retaining the CN9-A's original ground speed through the use of a 220-rated standard fusion engine. Much like the CN9-D, the 10-B carries an LB-X Autocannon/10 as its primary weapon with an LRM-10 launcher with an Artemis IV fire control system, but these are backed up by a medium laser and a medium pulse laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: CN10-B 是经典百夫长的 55 吨加重版本，于 3057 年建造，使用内骨骼底盘为设计减重，同时通过 220 额定标准聚变引擎保留 CN9-A 原有的地面速度。与 CN9-D 十分相似，10-B 以一门 LB-X 自动炮/10 为主武器，配一具带 Artemis IV 火控系统的 LRM-10 发射器，另有中型激光和中型脉冲激光作为后备。

Original: This radical modification looks to turn the Charger into a traditional assault 'Mech by reducing the 'Mechs speed to 54 km/h, which allows the use of a smaller engine (incidentally, the commonplace Pitban 240 reactor). The 'Mech is armored with fifteen and a half tons of armor and is armed with four Large Lasers, one in each arm and side torso, and a Medium Laser in its head; twenty-eight heat sinks kept the 'Mech cool.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_challenger_CGR-SB.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This radical modification looks to turn the Charger into a traditional assault 'Mech by reducing the 'Mechs speed to 54 km/h, which allows the use of a smaller engine (incidentally, the commonplace Pitban 240 reactor). The 'Mech is armored with fifteen and a half tons of armor and is armed with four Large Lasers, one in each arm and side torso, and a Medium Laser in its head; twenty-eight heat sinks kept the 'Mech cool.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这项激进的改装试图把冲锋者变成传统的突击机甲：将机甲速度降至 54 公里/小时，从而得以使用更小的引擎（顺带一提，是常见的皮特班 240 反应堆）。机甲披挂十五吨半装甲，武装为四门大型激光（每臂与每侧躯干各一）以及头部一门中型激光；二十八台散热器使机甲保持凉爽。

Original: Called Challenger by its designers, the -SB modification is not remarkable because it is not particularly difficult to apply.  Using a common and well-know reactor in the refit and essentially only upgrading the existing lasers to heavier versions, in turn requiring the Targeting-Tracking System to be tampered with.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_challenger_CGR-SB.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Called Challenger by its designers, the -SB modification is not remarkable because it is not particularly difficult to apply.  Using a common and well-know reactor in the refit and essentially only upgrading the existing lasers to heavier versions, in turn requiring the Targeting-Tracking System to be tampered with.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -SB 改装被设计者称为"挑战者"，它并不起眼，因为实施起来并不特别困难。改装中使用了常见且知名的反应堆，本质上只是把现有激光升级为更重的版本，相应地需要对瞄准追踪系统进行调整。

Original: Draconis Combine's 3K was an upgrade of the 1A9 that used an uprated XL engine to raise the Charger's top speed back to 86.4 km/h. The head-mounted small laser was removed, the medium lasers were swapped out for Medium Pulse Lasers, and the LRM-20 launcher was mated with an Artemis IV fire control system to improve accuracy. The addition of a fifth jump jet mounted in the rear torso gave the 'Mech a jumping distance of up to one hundred and fifty meters. This variant was confirmed to have been deployed on An Ting in the War of 3039 and may have been what Davion forces initially dubbed the Charger II; however, descriptions of the Charger II suggest that it was more likely a LRM-equipped variant of the Hatamoto-Chi (presumably the -Kaze).
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_charger_CGR-3K.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Draconis Combine's 3K was an upgrade of the 1A9 that used an uprated XL engine to raise the Charger's top speed back to 86.4 km/h. The head-mounted small laser was removed, the medium lasers were swapped out for Medium Pulse Lasers, and the LRM-20 launcher was mated with an Artemis IV fire control system to improve accuracy. The addition of a fifth jump jet mounted in the rear torso gave the 'Mech a jumping distance of up to one hundred and fifty meters. This variant was confirmed to have been deployed on An Ting in the War of 3039 and may have been what Davion forces initially dubbed the Charger II; however, descriptions of the Charger II suggest that it was more likely a LRM-equipped variant of the Hatamoto-Chi (presumably the -Kaze).
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 联合体的 3K 是 1A9 的升级版，使用升级的 XL 引擎把冲锋者最高速度重新提升至 86.4 公里/小时。头部小型激光被移除，中型激光换成中型脉冲激光，LRM-20 发射器配以 Artemis IV 火控系统以提升精度。在后躯干加装的第五个跳跃推进器使机甲跳跃距离达一百五十米。该变体被证实曾在 3039 年战争中部署于安廷，也许正是达维昂部队最初称为冲锋者 II 的机型；不过对冲锋者 II 的描述表明，它更可能是旗本-血的 LRM 装备变体（推测是-风）。

Original: An upgrade of the 3K, the Charger C was modified to carry a C3 Slave unit that allowed it to share targeting data with other 'Mechs in its unit. In order to add the slave unit, a medium pulse laser had to be removed from the design. The left over mass went towards extra ammunition for the LRM launcher.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_charger_CGR-C.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade of the 3K, the Charger C was modified to carry a C3 Slave unit that allowed it to share targeting data with other 'Mechs in its unit. In order to add the slave unit, a medium pulse laser had to be removed from the design. The left over mass went towards extra ammunition for the LRM launcher.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为 3K 的升级，冲锋者 C 经改装携带一台 C3 从属单元，使其能与本单位的其他机甲共享瞄准数据。为加装从属单元，必须从设计中移除一门中型脉冲激光。剩下的质量用于为 LRM 发射器增加额外弹药。

Original: A succession wars attempt at turning the Cicada into a fire support platform, the 3D is widely considered as failure. Armed with 2 lrm-5's and 2 medium lasers, it relies on a 280 rated engine to fit the heavier arsenal. Despite possessing more firepower and armour than other Cicada models, it's lack of speed and raw fire proved a major draw back and only a few survived through succession wars.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_cicada_CDA-3D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A succession wars attempt at turning the Cicada into a fire support platform, the 3D is widely considered as failure. Armed with 2 lrm-5's and 2 medium lasers, it relies on a 280 rated engine to fit the heavier arsenal. Despite possessing more firepower and armour than other Cicada models, it's lack of speed and raw fire proved a major draw back and only a few survived through succession wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是继承战争时期把蝉改造为火力支援平台的尝试，3D 被普遍认为是失败之作。它装备 2 具 lrm-5 和 2 门中型激光，依靠一台 280 额定引擎来容纳更重的武器库。尽管拥有比其他蝉型号更多的火力与装甲，它缺乏速度与原始打击力成为主要缺点，只有少数在继承战争中幸存。

Original: A somewhat unusual design, this fire support mech is popular among the more advanced periphery states and with many mercenary commands. Refitting a standard 2A with an XL Engine, Gibson Federated stripped the weapons and replaced them with a pair of LRM-15’s and 3 tons of ammunition. Conceived as a relatively cheap support mech, with the speed to keep up with lighter scout elements and enough ammunition to last most engagements, it has maintained steady sales since it’s introduction and convinced Gibson to refit one of their older 2A production lines; to produce this variant. Deployed by everyone from the FWL to the Outworlds Alliance, this mech has been spreading across the IS and is a common sight among defensive garrisons. Critics of the design note it’s lack of armour and CASE whilst proponents praise it’s low cost and tactical flexibility.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_cicada_CDA-3D.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A somewhat unusual design, this fire support mech is popular among the more advanced periphery states and with many mercenary commands. Deployed by everyone from the FWL to the Outworlds Alliance, this mech has been spreading across the IS and is a common sight among defensive garrisons. Critics of the design note it’s lack of armour and CASE whilst proponents praise it’s low cost and tactical flexibility.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一款略显另类的设计，这款火力支援机甲在较先进的外围区国家和许多佣兵部队中颇受欢迎。吉布森联邦将一个标准 2A 换上 XL 引擎，拆除武器代之以两具 LRM-15 和三吨弹药。它被构想为一款相对廉价的支援机甲，速度足以跟上轻型侦察部队，弹药也足以支撑大多数交战，自推出以来销量稳定，并说服吉布森改装了他们一条较老的 2A 生产线以生产此变体。从自由世界联盟到外域联盟都在部署，这款机甲已遍布内天体，在防御驻军中十分常见。批评者指出它缺乏装甲与 C.A.S.E.，支持者则称赞其低成本与战术灵活性。

Original: When General Aleksandr Kerensky led most of the Star League Defense Force into exile in 2784, they brought prototypes of the Clint BattleMech with them. After the annihilation of Clan Wolverine, Clan Snow Raven revisited these prototypes and was able to begin mass-production of the 'Mech in 2830 and introduced 2842. They ensured that it kept up with advances in Clan technology, eventually becoming the design that is now known as the Clint IIC. This speedy medium 'Mech is armed with a Type KOV LB-10X Autocannon and a pair of Series 2d ER Medium Lasers. This makes the Clint IIC an effective light 'Mech killer. It is capable of ranging far beyond supply lines thanks to its four tons of ammunition, though it only uses ten standard heat sinks and seven tons of standard armor.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_clint_iic_CLNT-IIC-1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: When General Aleksandr Kerensky led most of the Star League Defense Force into exile in 2784, they brought prototypes of the Clint BattleMech with them. After the annihilation of Clan Wolverine, Clan Snow Raven revisited these prototypes and was able to begin mass-production of the 'Mech in 2830 and introduced 2842. They ensured that it kept up with advances in Clan technology, eventually becoming the design that is now known as the Clint IIC. This speedy medium 'Mech is armed with a Type KOV LB-10X Autocannon and a pair of Series 2d ER Medium Lasers. This makes the Clint IIC an effective light 'Mech killer. It is capable of ranging far beyond supply lines thanks to its four tons of ammunition, though it only uses ten standard heat sinks and seven tons of standard armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2784 年亚历山大·克伦斯基将军率领星盟防卫军大部流亡时，带上了克林特战斗机甲的原型机。在狼獾氏族被灭绝后，雪鸦氏族重新审视这些原型，于 2830 年得以开始量产并于 2842 年推出。他们确保其跟上氏族技术的进步，最终演变为如今被称为克林特 IIC 的设计。这款高速中型机甲装备一门 KOV 型 LB-10X 自动炮和两门 2d 系列 ER 中型激光，使其成为高效的轻型机甲杀手。凭借四吨弹药，它能远离补给线长期作战，不过它仅使用十台标准散热器和七吨标准装甲。
氏族狙击手与轻型近战

Original: During the Amaris Civil War, several Lyran MechWarriors joined the SLDF in defiance of their government's policy of neutrality. With this came the coup that the Star League Defense Force had attempted to pull off for decades: the acquisition of the Lyran Commando. Long considered one of the better scout 'Mechs in the Inner Sphere, at least one of these Commandos accompanied Kerensky into exile and several of them appeared in the forces assigned to Operation Klondike. As newer weapons and 'Mechs made their way into the Clan arsenal, these Commandos began to show their age, so Clan Goliath Scorpion began a program to upgrade theirs. Dubbed the Commando IIC, this upgrade used newer technologies to outperform its venerable cousin. With the proliferation of OmniMechs, most Commando IICs were relegated to second line status, though the Scorpions still continue to outfit some of their pirate hunters with these 'Mechs.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_commando_iic_COM-IIC.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: During the Amaris Civil War, several Lyran MechWarriors joined the SLDF in defiance of their government's policy of neutrality. With this came the coup that the Star League Defense Force had attempted to pull off for decades: the acquisition of the Lyran Commando. Long considered one of the better scout 'Mechs in the Inner Sphere, at least one of these Commandos accompanied Kerensky into exile and several of them appeared in the forces assigned to Operation Klondike. As newer weapons and 'Mechs made their way into the Clan arsenal, these Commandos began to show their age, so Clan Goliath Scorpion began a program to upgrade theirs. Dubbed the Commando IIC, this upgrade used newer technologies to outperform its venerable cousin. With the proliferation of OmniMechs, most Commando IICs were relegated to second line status, though the Scorpions still continue to outfit some of their pirate hunters with these 'Mechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿马里斯内战期间，数名莱兰机甲战士不顾政府中立政策加入星盟防卫军。随之而来的是星盟防卫军数十年来一直试图实现的目标：获得莱兰突击队。突击队长期被视为内天体最好的侦察机甲之一，至少有一台随克伦斯基流亡，数台出现在"克朗代克行动"的部队中。随着更新式武器与机甲进入氏族武库，这些突击队开始显露老态，于是歌利亚蝎氏族启动了升级计划。命名为突击队 IIC，该升级利用更新技术超越了它古老的表亲。随着全能机甲普及，大多数突击队 IIC 退居二线，但蝎氏族仍继续用它们装备部分猎杀海盗的部队。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿马里斯内战期间，数名莱兰机甲战士不顾政府中立政策加入星盟防卫军。随之而来的是星盟防卫军数十年来一直试图实现的目标：获得莱兰突击队。突击队长期被视为内天体最好的侦察机甲之一，至少有一台随克伦斯基流亡，数台出现在"克朗代克行动"的部队中。随着更新式武器与机甲进入氏族武库，这些突击队开始显露老态，于是歌利亚蝎氏族启动了升级计划。命名为突击队 IIC，该升级利用更新技术超越了它古老的表亲。随着全能机甲普及，大多数突击队 IIC 退居二线，但蝎氏族仍继续用它们装备部分猎杀海盗的部队。

Original: Considered to be a middleweight machine compared to the heavier Mackies and Ymirs already in circulation, the Crossbow was built to be a fast missile support unit. As was the case with the Coventry Defense Conglomerate, Arcturan Arms’ engineers initially failed to make their prototype Crossbow live up to expectations, but as the techniques for producing BattleMechs grew more refined, the Crossbow received an upgrade worthy of its original concept.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_crossbow_CRS-6B.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Considered to be a middleweight machine compared to the heavier Mackies and Ymirs already in circulation, the Crossbow was built to be a fast missile support unit. Original: The 3L variant of the Crusader takes concepts from both the 3D and the 3K models to save weight with a twist. Built for the Capellan Confederation starting in 2753, the 'Mech has removed the LRM-15 and SRM-6 launchers and replaced them with two LRM-10 launchers and two SRM-4 launchers. This frees up room for two additional heat sinks as well as the inclusion of four GM Jetstar jump jets, two each in either side torso, giving it a jumping distance of one hundred and twenty meters.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_crusader_CRD-3L.Details

This frees up room for two additional heat sinks as well as the inclusion of four GM Jetstar jump jets, two each in either side torso, giving it a jumping distance of one hundred and twenty meters.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 十字军 3L 变体借鉴 3D 与 3K 两种型号的思路来减重，并别出心裁。它自 2753 年起为卡佩兰邦联建造，移除了 LRM-15 和 SRM-6 发射器，换成两具 LRM-10 和两具 SRM-4 发射器。这腾出空间容纳两台额外散热器，并加装四个通用"喷气星"跳跃推进器（两侧躯干各两个），使其跳跃距离达一百二十米。

Original: The original version of the Dervish that was produced in 2520 was not up to the same standards as contemporary Terran Hegemony designs. The use of comparatively "primitive" parts resulted in a heavier cockpit, engine, and less efficient armor. Consequently, the 1S had a top speed of 64 km/h and could only jump ninety meters. While the missile launchers were the same as the 6M, it did not have that version's lasers. 1S variants continued to exist in militias, but were raided for parts during the Succession Wars. It was not intended for front line use, but for Militia units.  Though there were few, if any, remaining by the end of the 2990s, they once again began to be produced on low-tech worlds during the Jihad due to that conflict's disruption of supply lines.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_dervish_DV-1S.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original version of the Dervish that was produced in 2520 was not up to the same standards as contemporary Terran Hegemony designs. The use of comparatively "primitive" parts resulted in a heavier cockpit, engine, and less efficient armor. Consequently, the 1S had a top speed of 64 km/h and could only jump ninety meters. While the missile launchers were the same as the 6M, it did not have that version's lasers. 1S variants continued to exist in militias, but were raided for parts during the Succession Wars. It was not intended for front line use, but for Militia units.  Though there were few, if any, remaining by the end of the 2990s, they once again began to be produced on low-tech worlds during the Jihad due to that conflict's disruption of supply lines.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2520 年生产的原版苦行僧未达到当时地球霸权设计的同等标准。使用相对"原始"的部件导致驾驶舱与引擎更重、装甲效率更低。因此 1S 的最高速度为 64 公里/小时，且只能跳九十米。虽然导弹发射器与 6M 相同，但它没有该型号的激光。1S 变体继续存在于民兵部队中，但在继承战争期间被拆解取件。它并非为前线使用而设计，而是供民兵单位使用。尽管到 2990 年代末所剩无几，圣战期间由于供应链被打断，低技术世界再次开始生产它们。

It was not intended for front line use, but for Militia units.  Though there were few, if any, remaining by the end of the 2990s, they once again began to be produced on low-tech worlds during the Jihad due to that conflict's disruption of supply lines.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_dervish_DV-1S.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original version of the Dervish that was produced in 2520 was not up to the same standards as contemporary Terran Hegemony designs. The use of comparatively "primitive" parts resulted in a heavier cockpit, engine, and less efficient armor. Consequently, the 1S had a top speed of 64 km/h and could only jump ninety meters. While the missile launchers were the same as the 6M, it did not have that version's lasers. 1S variants continued to exist in militias, but were raided for parts during the Succession Wars. It was not intended for front line use, but for Militia units.  Though there were few, if any, remaining by the end of the 2990s, they once again began to be produced on low-tech worlds during the Jihad due to that conflict's disruption of supply lines.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2520 年生产的原版苦行僧未达到当时地球霸权设计的同等标准。使用相对"原始"的部件导致驾驶舱与引擎更重、装甲效率更低。因此 1S 的最高速度为 64 公里/小时，且只能跳九十米。虽然导弹发射器与 6M 相同，但它没有该型号的激光。1S 变体继续存在于民兵部队中，但在继承战争期间被拆解取件。它并非为前线使用而设计，而是供民兵单位使用。尽管到 2990 年代末所剩无几，圣战期间由于供应链被打断，低技术世界再次开始生产它们。

Original: The Dire Wolf is one of the OmniMechs that became feared throughout the Inner Sphere during the initial Clan Invasion and rightly so. The Dire Wolf weighs in at an impressive one hundred tons and has a relatively slow cruising speed of 54 km/h provided by a 300 XL engine. Its speed and armor protection matches that of an Atlas, but it has superior potential firepower with fifty and a half tons of free pod space for weapons and equipment. It is these traits which saw the 'Mech christened Daishi (pseudo-Japanese for 'Great Death') by the criminal underbelly of the Draconis Combine, a name that would be proven grimly accurate time and time again.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_dire_wolf_DW-A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Dire Wolf is one of the OmniMechs that became feared throughout the Inner Sphere during the initial Clan Invasion and rightly so. The Dire Wolf weighs in at an impressive one hundred tons and has a relatively slow cruising speed of 54 km/h provided by a 300 XL engine. Its speed and armor protection matches that of an Atlas, but it has superior potential firepower with fifty and a half tons of free pod space for weapons and equipment. It is these traits which saw the 'Mech christened Daishi (pseudo-Japanese for 'Great Death') by the criminal underbelly of the Draconis Combine, a name that would be proven grimly accurate time and time again.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 恐狼是氏族入侵初期令整个内天体闻之色变的全能机甲之一，实至名归。它重达惊人的一百吨，由 300 XL 引擎驱动，巡航速度相对缓慢，仅 54 公里/小时。它的速度与装甲防护与阿特拉斯相当，但凭借五十吨半的自由吊舱空间搭载武器与装备，拥有更强的火力潜力。正因如此，德拉科尼斯联合体的黑道将其命名为"大师"（伪日语"伟大的死亡"），而这名字一次又一次被证明冷酷地精准。

Original: A simple direct fire configuration of the Dire Wolf, the H configuration carries a pair of Gauss Rifles as its primary long range weaponry. These are backed up by two Heavy Large Lasers for medium to short ranges. Finally, for short range combat, the H configuration has a Medium Pulse Laser and a Flamer. All of this configuration's weapons are linked to a Targeting Computer, increasing their accuracy.

Original: The S configuration is intended for the close confines of urban and jungle warfare. The S configurations primary weapon is a massive LB-X Autocannon/20 which is capable of disabling most light and medium 'Mechs in a single blast. This is backed up by a single Large Pulse Laser to provide some long range firepower should the Dire Wolf S be caught in the open. Additional short range firepower is provided by five Medium Pulse Lasers and two Streak SRM-4 launchers. Two Anti-Personnel Pods and two Machine Guns provide exceptional anti infantry capabilities. The S configuration has added mobility with three jump jets allowing it to jump up to ninety meters.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_dire_wolf_DW-S.Details

Additional short range firepower is provided by five Medium Pulse Lasers and two Streak SRM-4 launchers. Two Anti-Personnel Pods and two Machine Guns provide exceptional anti infantry capabilities. Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: S 配置为城市与丛林战的狭窄环境而设。S 配置的主武器是一门巨型 LB-X 自动炮/20，能一击瘫痪大多数轻中型机甲。它辅以一门大型脉冲激光，若恐狼 S 身陷开阔地可提供一些远程火力。额外近程火力来自五门中型脉冲激光和两具连续 SRM-4 发射器。两个反人员荚舱和两挺机枪提供出色的反步兵能力。S 配置通过三个跳跃推进器提升机动性，可跳跃至九十米。

Original: This Wolf's Dragoons variant is effective at both long and short range. For long range, it uses a Gauss Rifle, an ER Large Laser, and an LRM-20. At close range, an Ultra Autocannon/20, ER Small Laser, and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers provide devastating firepower. Twenty double heat sinks allow the design to almost continually fire all of its weapons.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_dire_wolf_DW-W.Details

Original: This variant carries a Targeting Computer to guide the fire of a Large Pulse Laser, Heavy Medium Laser, twin ER Micro Lasers, an Ultra AC/10 and the solid shot of an LB 5-X autocannon. To provide missile support, the Daishi X carries an ATM 6 with a ton of each ammunition type, a head mounted Streak SRM-2, and an SRM-4 and LRM-15. The SRM-4 and LRM-15 are each equipped with an Artemis IV FCS.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_dire_wolf_DW-X.Details

Original: The 5N variant of the Dragon was used as a bridge between it and the Grand Dragon. Additionally, the rear facing Medium Laser has been removed from the 'Mech.

Original: The standard against which all battle armor is measured, the Elemental battle armor was first introduced in 2868 by Clan Wolf in a Trial of Possession against the Nova Cats. It was a marvel of Clan engineering that allowed a small group of operators to take down large 'Mechs and survive the encounter. While it is possible for a normal-sized human to use the battle armor, this design is tailored for the Clans' giant Elemental warriors and only they can bring out its fullest potential.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_elemental_toad.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The standard against which all battle armor is measured, the Elemental battle armor was first introduced in 2868 by Clan Wolf in a Trial of Possession against the Nova Cats. It was a marvel of Clan engineering that allowed a small group of operators to take down large 'Mechs and survive the encounter. While it is possible for a normal-sized human to use the battle armor, this design is tailored for the Clans' giant Elemental warriors and only they can bring out its fullest potential.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 元素战斗装甲是所有战斗装甲的衡量标准，由狼氏族于 2868 年在对抗诺瓦猫的占有试炼中首次推出。它是氏族工程的奇迹，能让一小队操作员击倒大型机甲并幸存下来。虽然普通体型的人也能使用这种战斗装甲，但该设计是为氏族巨人般的元素战士量身打造，唯有他们才能发挥其全部潜力。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 与主型号相比，行刑者 A 缩短了总体交战距离：它去掉高斯步枪，换成一大批大型脉冲激光，辅以四门 ER 中型激光。此变体是外面所有轻型机甲的噩梦。

Original: The Jack-of-all-trades variant. The Executioner B is set up to be effective in all ranges the battlefield can offer. With an ERPPC for extreme and long ranges and an absolutely devastating UAC/20 for closer range brackets, the B just executes its foes by brute force. Advanced targeting systems will make sure that there is nowhere to run...nowhere to hide.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_executioner_EXE-B.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Jack-of-all-trades variant. The Executioner B is set up to be effective in all ranges the battlefield can offer. Advanced targeting systems will make sure that there is nowhere to run...nowhere to hide.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 样样通吃的变体。行刑者 B 被设定为在战场能提供的所有射程上都有效。极端与远程有 ER PPC，较近射程则有绝对毁灭性的 UAC/20，B 以蛮力处决它的敌人。先进瞄准系统确保无处可逃……无处可藏。

But for everyone who believes to be able to sneak up on this monster: be warned it still fields the massive close range punch in form of an UAC/20.

Original: Fast, precise, deadly. The Executioner D(isco) makes use of its phenomenal agility to close in on its enemies...just to unleash a hell of fire on them in form of pulse lasers in all colors and sizes. LPL, MPL, SPL ... you name it, the EXE-D has it. Pilots be warned though, you better bring som chilled drinks as this one is running HOT!
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_executioner_EXE-D.Details

ERLLs and ATMs will grant massive firepower at long and medium ranges while a bunch of Heavy Medium and Heavy Small Lasers will grant close perimeter defense...or the bit of extra damage to finish an already damaged oponent.

Original: Fast and powerful, the Executioner, known as the Gladiator in the Inner Sphere, is an assault OmniMech developed by Clan Ghost Bear. As one of the fastest assault mechs available, the Executioner surprises its prey by being able to alter the engagement ranges way quicker than expected from a mech of this weight. The Executioner PRIME uses its speed to stay at distance to make full use of its long range weaponry.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_executioner_EXE-Prime.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fast and powerful, the Executioner, known as the Gladiator in the Inner Sphere, is an assault OmniMech developed by Clan Ghost Bear. As one of the fastest assault mechs available, the Executioner surprises its prey by being able to alter the engagement ranges way quicker than expected from a mech of this weight. The Executioner PRIME uses its speed to stay at distance to make full use of its long range weaponry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 行刑者快速而强大，在内天体被称为角斗士，是由鬼熊氏族开发的突击全能机甲。作为可用的最快突击机甲之一，行刑者能比人们对该重量机甲的预期更快地改变交战距离，从而突袭猎物。行刑者主型号利用其速度保持距离，以充分发挥远程武器的威力。

Original: The original Firebee used a single LRM-5 backed up by a trio of SRM-2s. The Primitive Engine provided a top speed of 85 km/h, more than enough to engage armored vehicles and infantry, and supporting heavier units. The lack of jump jets, combined with six and a half tons of Primitive Armor, forced pilots to pay attention to the terrain to insure they could move effectively.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_firebee_FRB-1E.Details

The lack of jump jets, combined with six and a half tons of Primitive Armor, forced pilots to pay attention to the terrain to insure they could move effectively.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 原版火蜂使用一具 LRM-5，辅以三具 SRM-2。原始引擎提供 85 公里/小时的最高速度，足以与装甲车辆和步兵交战，并支援较重的单位。缺少跳跃推进器，加上六吨半的原始装甲，迫使飞行员注意地形以确保有效机动。

Whether it is using Inferno rounds or not, something that its two tons of ammunition allows MechWarriors to utilize on a regular basis, the Firebee is a potent anti-vehicle platform.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2E 火蜂装备一门"星切"80 厘米大型激光，火力可观。近距离则四具毛伊弩炮 SRM-2 发射器可倾泻八枚导弹。无论是否使用燃烧弹——其两吨弹药让机甲战士能经常使用——火蜂都是威力强大的反车辆平台。

Original: Designed with the aim of upgrading the ageing Firebee with more advanced Star League technology, the 2Ep was still a prototype when the Succession Wars began. The only completed models of this design were lost with the destruction of the Exedor factory in the First Succession War. The design was briefly revived in the 3045, with a few surviving Firebee’s being converted as a showcase of home grown Capellan science and engineering. Armed with an ER Large Laser, dual Streak SRM-2's and augmented with the addition of a Beagle Probe, the 2Ep is a fast scout hunter and skirmisher.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_firebee_FRB-2Ep.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed with the aim of upgrading the ageing Firebee with more advanced Star League technology, the 2Ep was still a prototype when the Succession Wars began. The only completed models of this design were lost with the destruction of the Exedor factory in the First Succession War. The design was briefly revived in the 3045, with a few surviving Firebee’s being converted as a showcase of home grown Capellan science and engineering. Armed with an ER Large Laser, dual Streak SRM-2's and augmented with the addition of a Beagle Probe, the 2Ep is a fast scout hunter and skirmisher.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2Ep 旨在用更先进的星盟科技升级老化的火蜂，在继承战争爆发时仍是原型机。该设计仅有的成品随第一次继承战争中埃克塞多工厂的毁灭而遗失。该设计在 3045 年短暂复兴，几台幸存的火蜂被改装以展示卡佩兰本土科学与工程的水平。2Ep 装备一门 ER 大型激光、双联连续 SRM-2，并加装比格犬探测器，是一款快速的侦察猎手与游骑机甲。
狙击手 & 轻型缠斗者

Original: Ultimately overcoming a somewhat politically troubled birth, the OmniMech Firestarter has proven to be an highly effective and flexible design, with the Combine using it to replace other aging medium-weight workhorses such as the Phoenix Hawk
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_firestarter_FS9-O.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ultimately overcoming a somewhat politically troubled birth, the OmniMech Firestarter has proven to be an highly effective and flexible design, with the Combine using it to replace other aging medium-weight workhorses such as the Phoenix Hawk
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 全面型火焰使者最终克服了诞生时的政治波折，被证明是一款高效灵活的设计，联合体用它替代了凤凰鹰等老化的中量级主力机甲

Original: In its primary configuration the Firestarter is built to stay at long ranges when facing an enemy. The primary weapons are a pair of Large Lasers. The Large Lasers provide the 'Mech with respectable long-range firepower. To allow the 'Mech to create cover for itself and to clear woods, the Firestarter Prime carries two extra flamers on top of its fixed pair, bringing the total to four. Finally, to allow the 'Mech to search out hidden units, the Prime carries a Beagle Active Probe.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_firestarter_FS9-O.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In its primary configuration the Firestarter is built to stay at long ranges when facing an enemy. The primary weapons are a pair of Large Lasers. The Large Lasers provide the 'Mech with respectable long-range firepower. To allow the 'Mech to create cover for itself and to clear woods, the Firestarter Prime carries two extra flamers on top of its fixed pair, bringing the total to four. Finally, to allow the 'Mech to search out hidden units, the Prime carries a Beagle Active Probe.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主配置中，火焰使者被设计为面对敌人时保持远程。主武器为一对大型激光。这两门大型激光为机甲提供可观的远程火力。为让机甲能为自己制造掩护并清除林地，火焰使者主型号在固定的一对之外另装两具火焰喷射器，共四具。最后，为让机甲能搜寻隐藏单位，主型号携带一具比格犬主动探测器。

Original: Configured as a close combat and spotting 'Mech, the Firestarter B carries, as its primary weapon, a Large Pulse Laser, which is backed up by a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers and a Small Laser. The 'Mech also carries two Flamers to deter infantry attacks and also allow the 'Mech to start fires for cover. Original: The DGR-5K Grand Dragon introduced in 3050 incorporates a number of lostech improvements over the original DRG-1G.Mounted in its right arm is a Lord's Light 2 ER PPC. The ER PPC is backed up by a LRM-10 in the center torso, which gives the 'Mech an impressive and formidable long-range striking capability. The launcher is fed by a two-ton reload bin in the left torso protected by CASE. If an enemy 'Mech gets into close ranges, the Grand Dragon carries three Victory 23R Medium Lasers for defense, one in the left arm and two split between the rear-facing left and right torso. Protected by ten tons of armor, the Grand Dragon uses thirteen double heat sinks for excellent heat management and uses a 16.5 ton Hermes 360 XL engine to achieve a moderate cruising speed of 64 km/h.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_granddragon_DRG-5K.Details

Original: The 1DS variant of the Griffin, built by Defiance Industries, Kallon Industries and Norse BattleMech Works from their respective production lines starting in 3049, was intended to become the new standard model for the Federated Commonwealth. The engine was upgraded to Hermes 275 extralight engine, fourteen double heat sinks improved cooling and the weapons were stripped from the chassis. The 'Mech now carried a Doombud LRM-20 launcher over the right shoulder and a Thunderbolt-12 Large Pulse Laser in the right arm. It also employed CASE to protect the two tons of missile reloads stored in the left torso. The capture of Norse BattleMech on Marduk by the Draconis Combine meant this variant was also employed by the Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_griffin_GRF-1DS.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 1DS variant of the Griffin, built by Defiance Industries, Kallon Industries and Norse BattleMech Works from their respective production lines starting in 3049, was intended to become the new standard model for the Federated Commonwealth. The 'Mech now carried a Doombud LRM-20 launcher over the right shoulder and a Thunderbolt-12 Large Pulse Laser in the right arm. It also employed CASE to protect the two tons of missile reloads stored in the left torso. The capture of Norse BattleMech on Marduk by the Draconis Combine meant this variant was also employed by the Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狮鹫的 1DS 变体由迪法恩斯工业、卡隆工业和北欧战斗机甲厂自 3049 年起在各自生产线上制造，意在成为联邦联邦的新标准型号。引擎升级为赫尔墨斯 275 超轻型引擎，十四台双倍散热器改善散热，武器则从底盘上全部拆除。机甲右肩上方安装末日芽 LRM-20 发射器，右臂装备雷霆-12 大型脉冲激光。它还使用 C.A.S.E. 保护存于左躯干的两吨导弹再装填。北欧战斗机甲在马尔杜克被德拉科尼斯联合体夺取，意味着该变体也被德拉科尼斯联合体征募兵部队使用。

Original: The Grim Reaper was a 'Mech designed by ComStar to help replenish the heavy material losses suffered by the Com Guards during the Battle of Tukayyid, with the Word of Blake maintaining production after it captured Terra to help rebuild and expand the Word of Blake Militia. Thus the Grim Reaper is seen in moderate numbers in both secular and fanatical militaries. Designed to be a generic trooper 'Mech, the Grim Reaper carries a varied and non specialized weapons payload.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_grim_reaper_GRM-R-PR29.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Grim Reaper was a 'Mech designed by ComStar to help replenish the heavy material losses suffered by the Com Guards during the Battle of Tukayyid, with the Word of Blake maintaining production after it captured Terra to help rebuild and expand the Word of Blake Militia. Thus the Grim Reaper is seen in moderate numbers in both secular and fanatical militaries. Designed to be a generic trooper 'Mech, the Grim Reaper carries a varied and non specialized weapons payload.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 死神是康星设计的机甲，用于补充康卫在图卡伊德战役中遭受的严重物资损失，布雷克之言在夺取地球后维持生产，以协助重建和扩充布雷克之言民兵。因此死神在世俗与狂热两方的军队中都有中等数量的装备。作为一款通用士兵机甲，死神携带多样而非专精的武器配置。

Original: Developed in parallel with the standard Hammer 3M, the 3G is a cheap side grade designed for garrison and budget conscious buyers. The expensive Endo Steel is removed along with the Artemis IV system, dramatically decreasing the cost and relatability of the mech. Popular with many smaller mercenary units and on backwater garrisons every where through Marik space, the design is liked by Mektechs everywhere for the ease of maintenance and ready supply of replacement parts.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_hammer_HMR-3G.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed in parallel with the standard Hammer 3M, the 3G is a cheap side grade designed for garrison and budget conscious buyers. The expensive Endo Steel is removed along with the Artemis IV system, dramatically decreasing the cost and relatability of the mech. Popular with many smaller mercenary units and on backwater garrisons every where through Marik space, the design is liked by Mektechs everywhere for the ease of maintenance and ready supply of replacement parts.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3G 与标准战锤 3M 同期开发，是一款面向驻防与预算敏感买家的廉价副线产品。它去掉了昂贵的内部骨骼与 Artemis IV 系统，大幅降低成本并提升可维护性。它在许多较小佣兵部队和马里克空间各处偏远驻军中广受欢迎，也因易于维护、备件供应充足而受各地机甲技师的喜爱。

Original: The precursor to the 1H, the 0H was a flawed design that ran too hot and had insufficient armament or heat sinks for sustained combat. Armed with a Howitzer in place of the iconic Sniper piece, it lacks the range and stopping power of the later versions, whilst running significantly hotter due to the second large laser it mounted. Only a couple of test models were every introduced and the design was lost to the mists of history with the debut of the 1H and then the 2H, in 2480. Occasionally Helepolises in the periphery will be rebuilt along similar lines, the prized Sniper artillery pieces stripped off for other uses and local hardware retrofitted in its place.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_helepolis_HEP-0H.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The precursor to the 1H, the 0H was a flawed design that ran too hot and had insufficient armament or heat sinks for sustained combat. Armed with a Howitzer in place of the iconic Sniper piece, it lacks the range and stopping power of the later versions, whilst running significantly hotter due to the second large laser it mounted. Only a couple of test models were every introduced and the design was lost to the mists of history with the debut of the 1H and then the 2H, in 2480. Occasionally Helepolises in the periphery will be rebuilt along similar lines, the prized Sniper artillery pieces stripped off for other uses and local hardware retrofitted in its place.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为 1H 的前身，0H 是一个有缺陷的设计：过热严重，武器与散热器都不足以支撑持续战斗。它以一门榴弹炮取代标志性的狙击炮，既缺乏后期版本的射程与停止力，又因装有第二门大型激光而热得多。仅制造过几台测试型号，随着 2480 年 1H 与 2H 的问世，该设计湮没于历史迷雾中。外围区偶尔会按类似思路重建攻城塔，把珍贵的狙击炮拆下另作他用，改装本地硬件顶上。

Original: The earliest version used standard heat sinks and its Primitive Engine could only manage 30 km/h. This proved to be a challenge as the early Helepolis needed to completely stop to fire the Sniper artillery and then start moving again before counter-battery fire could destroy the unit. Twenty and a half tons of Primitive Armor protected the Helepolis from enemy fire. The weight and bulk of the primitive systems prevented the designers from installing the long range missiles used on later models.

Original: The Highlander is one of the most well-known Star League Defense Force assault 'Mechs, serving with distinction for almost two centuries since first entering service in 2592. Initially designed as a dedicated city and installation defender, the original model featured a variety of weaponry along with fifteen and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, but perhaps its most useful asset were the three Hildco jump jets giving it a jumping range of 90 meters. The heaviest 'Mech design to feature jump jets at the time, their original task was to allow the Highlander the ability to jump over inconvenient obstacles such as buildings and outpace other 'Mechs with a faster ground speed, but because of this increased mobility and its versatile weaponry the Highlander proved to be a capable fighter on any battlefield and within decades nearly every BattleMech regiment of the Regular and Royal Armies featured them. However it was during the design's initial trial runs that pilots began using these 'Mechs in what would infamously become known as the "Highlander Burial". Leaping into the air and landing directly on their enemy, a Highlander could literally drive a light 'Mech into the ground. So successful was this maneuver that the design team re-engineered the legs to withstand repeated death-from-above attacks and turned what had been a desperation move into an art form, giving Highlander pilots an additional psychological edge.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_highlander_HGN-732.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Highlander is one of the most well-known Star League Defense Force assault 'Mechs, serving with distinction for almost two centuries since first entering service in 2592. Initially designed as a dedicated city and installation defender, the original model featured a variety of weaponry along with fifteen and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, but perhaps its most useful asset were the three Hildco jump jets giving it a jumping range of 90 meters. The heaviest 'Mech design to feature jump jets at the time, their original task was to allow the Highlander the ability to jump over inconvenient obstacles such as buildings and outpace other 'Mechs with a faster ground speed, but because of this increased mobility and its versatile weaponry the Highlander proved to be a capable fighter on any battlefield and within decades nearly every BattleMech regiment of the Regular and Royal Armies featured them. However it was during the design's initial trial runs that pilots began using these 'Mechs in what would infamously become known as the "Highlander Burial". Leaping into the air and landing directly on their enemy, a Highlander could literally drive a light 'Mech into the ground. So successful was this maneuver that the design team re-engineered the legs to withstand repeated death-from-above attacks and turned what had been a desperation move into an art form, giving Highlander pilots an additional psychological edge.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 高地人是星盟防卫军最知名的突击机甲之一，自 2592 年首次服役以来已光荣服役近两个世纪。它最初被设计为专职的城市与设施防御者，原版型号装备多种武器与十五吨半铁纤维装甲，但也许最宝贵的资产是三个希尔德科跳跃推进器，赋予它 90 米的跳跃距离。作为当时配备跳跃推进器的最重机甲设计，它们最初的任务是让高地人能跃过建筑之类碍事的障碍，并追上地面速度更快的其他机甲；但由于这一增强的机动性和多用途武器，高地人在任何战场上都证明是能干的战士，数十年内常备军与皇家军几乎每个战斗机甲团都装备了它。然而在该设计的初期试跑中，飞行员开始以后来臭名昭著的"高地人葬礼"方式使用这些机甲。跃入空中并直接落在敌人头上，高地人能真把一台轻型机甲踩进地里。这一战术如此成功，设计团队重新设计了腿部以承受反复的"从天而降之死"，把原本的绝望之举变成了一门艺术，为高地人飞行员增添了额外的心理优势。

At long ranges, a Gauss Rifle and LRM 20 can effectively deter many more lightly armored opponents. If a mech does decide to close the distance, two Medium Lasers and a SRM 6 are waiting to meet them.

Original: One of the most popular Star League BattleMechs, many a Highlander accompanied General Aleksandr Kerensky into exile. Clan scientists were forced to rearrange the placement of some weapons within the 'Mech to allow it proper ammo feeds, but the design is largely unchanged. It carries the maximum amount of Ferro-Fibrous armor that can be crammed on the frame, fourteen and a half tons. As with the original, the IIC carries enough jump jets to move up to ninety meters at a time, allowing MechWarriors to execute the Highlander Burial.

First built in 3058 the 'Mech still carries a Gauss Rifle as its primary weapon, but is backed up by a single Medium Laser and a Streak SRM-2 launcher.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_hollander_ii_BZK-F5.Details

Original: The F7, debuting in 3061 is a modification of the F5 that takes advantage of the Hollander II's larger weapons payload to mount the Lyran Alliance's new Heavy Gauss Rifle, which is capable of causing a great deal of damage at short to medium ranges. Original: Designed by the Explorer Corps to provide heavy fire support in environments unsuited to a normal tank or support unit, the 4E is a field refit that mounts a Thumper Artillery piece in place of the standard AC/20. Removing a mostly superfluous s heat sink, frees up the weight for the 4E retain it’s secondary weaponry should it be engaged by head hunter units. By 3010, the Explorer Corps had entered into a long term contract with Kali Yama Weapons to produce limited numbers of this design under licence. The design spread to other interested parties, after the Corps relaxed their licensing arrangements, following the Scarlet Fist debacle; in which the a lone Corps pilot – Larissa ‘‘Raza’’ Brooks – managed to successfully evaded the pirate band responsible for the destruction of her lance, before stalking them back to their base and levelling it with repeated Thumper volleys in the middle of the night.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_hunchback_HBK-4E.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed by the Explorer Corps to provide heavy fire support in environments unsuited to a normal tank or support unit, the 4E is a field refit that mounts a Thumper Artillery piece in place of the standard AC/20. Removing a mostly superfluous s heat sink, frees up the weight for the 4E retain it’s secondary weaponry should it be engaged by head hunter units. By 3010, the Explorer Corps had entered into a long term contract with Kali Yama Weapons to produce limited numbers of this design under licence. The design spread to other interested parties, after the Corps relaxed their licensing arrangements, following the Scarlet Fist debacle; in which the a lone Corps pilot – Larissa ‘‘Raza’’ Brooks – managed to successfully evaded the pirate band responsible for the destruction of her lance, before stalking them back to their base and levelling it with repeated Thumper volleys in the middle of the night.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由探险队设计，用于在不适于常规坦克或支援单位的环境提供重型火力支援。4E 是战地改装型，以一门重锤火炮取代标准 AC/20。拆掉一只基本多余的散热器腾出重量，使 4E 在被猎杀单位接战时仍保留次要武器。到 3010 年，探险队已与卡利亚马武器公司签订长期合同，授权限量生产该设计。在"赤拳"事件后，探险队放宽了授权安排，此设计遂扩散至其他有意方；在那次事件中，探险队唯一幸存的飞行员——拉里萨·"拉扎"·布鲁克斯——成功避开了摧毁她小队的海盗团，随后追踪他们回到基地，并在深夜以反复的重锤齐射将基地夷平。

Original: During the War of 3039, the 9th Ghost regiment was engaged by the Screaming Eagles mercenary company during the Elidere IV campaign, when they decided to modify two of their Hunchbacks to carry prototype Gauss Rifles. Thus, the HBK-4GG was born, able to cause tremendous damage at ranges beyond anyone's expectations.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_hunchback_HBK-4G_gauss_prototype.Details

Original: Developed during the Clan Invasion, the 5A takes advantage of the newly reintroduced Arrow IV and an Artemis IV FCS. Intended to operate in support of a lance or as part of a dedicated battery, the 5A carries a mix of homing missiles and utility ammo; enabling it to bombard targets that have been tagged by supporting forces or deploying FASCAM and other speciality ammo as and when needed. Guardian ECM confuses and blinds enemy sensors, vastly reducing the chances of accurate counter battery fire, whilst the use of CASE protects against catastrophic ammunition explosions. Sold to any interested buyer as part of Kali Yama’s contribution to the war effort, the design has been seen all across the Inner Sphere and is increasingly found in the Periphery, where reliable and cheap Artillery assets are in high demand.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_hunchback_HBK-5A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed during the Clan Invasion, the 5A takes advantage of the newly reintroduced Arrow IV and an Artemis IV FCS. Intended to operate in support of a lance or as part of a dedicated battery, the 5A carries a mix of homing missiles and utility ammo; enabling it to bombard targets that have been tagged by supporting forces or deploying FASCAM and other speciality ammo as and when needed. Guardian ECM confuses and blinds enemy sensors, vastly reducing the chances of accurate counter battery fire, whilst the use of CASE protects against catastrophic ammunition explosions. Sold to any interested buyer as part of Kali Yama’s contribution to the war effort, the design has been seen all across the Inner Sphere and is increasingly found in the Periphery, where reliable and cheap Artillery assets are in high demand.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5A 在氏族入侵期间开发，利用了新近重新引入的箭矢 IV 与 Artemis IV 火控系统。它旨在支援一个小队或作为专用炮组的一员，混合携带寻的导弹与多用途弹药；既能轰击被友军标记的目标，也能按需布撒 FASCAM 等特种弹药。守护者 ECM 扰乱并致盲敌方传感器，大幅降低其精准反炮击的可能，而 C.A.S.E. 的使用则防止灾难性的弹药爆炸。作为卡利亚马对战争努力的贡献，该设计向任何有意买家出售，已遍布内天体，并越来越多地出现在对可靠廉价火炮资产需求旺盛的外围区。
箭矢 IV 火力平台

Original: Combining elements of the 4H and 4J 'Swaybacks', the HBK-4N uses an AC5 and two LRM-5s to give it range, while the four Medium Lasers give it punch up close.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_hunchback_HBK-5A.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Combining elements of the 4H and 4J 'Swaybacks', the HBK-4N uses an AC5 and two LRM-5s to give it range, while the four Medium Lasers give it punch up close.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: HBK-4N 融合了 4H 与 4J"驼背佬"的元素，用一门 AC5 和两具 LRM-5 提供射程，四门中型激光则负责近身打击。

Original: The Hunchback IIC is a ClanTech refit of the venerable Hunchback. Its meager armor, coupled with paltry ammunition and lack of long-range weapons, led Inner Sphere observers to conclude that this 'Mech was a last-ditch effort for failed warriors to die with glory. In truth, the assignment of a Hunchback IIC was essentially a death sentence. Warriors given this machine were not expected to survive their next battle.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_hunchback_iic_HBK-IIC-1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hunchback IIC is a ClanTech refit of the venerable Hunchback. Its meager armor, coupled with paltry ammunition and lack of long-range weapons, led Inner Sphere observers to conclude that this 'Mech was a last-ditch effort for failed warriors to die with glory. In truth, the assignment of a Hunchback IIC was essentially a death sentence. Warriors given this machine were not expected to survive their next battle.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 驼背 IIC 是古老的驼背的氏族科技改装版。它可怜的装甲，加上稀少的弹药和缺乏远程武器，让内天体观察家断定这款机甲是失败战士求取荣耀战死的最后一搏。事实上，被分配驼背 IIC 基本等于死刑。获得此机的战士不被指望能活过下一场战斗。

Original: The primary weapon that the Huron Warrior carries is a Grizzard Gauss Rifle (Modified 210 Version) that is capable of stripping off a ton of armor with each shot at extremely long ranges. The Gauss Rifle is backed up by a Martell ER Large Laser that provides good supplemental firepower at long ranges. Finally, it is armed with a Martell Medium Pulse Laser, which gives the Huron Warrior the ability to protect itself at short ranges.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_huron_warrior_HUR-WO-R4L.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary weapon that the Huron Warrior carries is a Grizzard Gauss Rifle (Modified 210 Version) that is capable of stripping off a ton of armor with each shot at extremely long ranges. The Gauss Rifle is backed up by a Martell ER Large Laser that provides good supplemental firepower at long ranges. Finally, it is armed with a Martell Medium Pulse Laser, which gives the Huron Warrior the ability to protect itself at short ranges.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 休伦战士的主要武器是一门格里扎德高斯步枪（210 改进版），能在极远距离一枪削掉一吨装甲。高斯步枪辅以一门马特尔 ER 大型激光，在远距离提供良好的补充火力。最后它还装备一门马特尔中型脉冲激光，使休伦战士具备近距离自保能力。

Finally, it is armed with a Martell Medium Pulse Laser, which gives the Huron Warrior the ability to protect itself at short ranges.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 休伦战士的主要武器是一门格里扎德高斯步枪（210 改进版），能在极远距离一枪削掉一吨装甲。高斯步枪辅以一门马特尔 ER 大型激光，在远距离提供良好的补充火力。最后它还装备一门马特尔中型脉冲激光，使休伦战士具备近距离自保能力。

Original: The Hussar has a single weapon on its chassis in a unique turreted mount on the center torso, an Extended Range Large Laser. While the use of a single weapon limits the defensive capabilities of the Hussar, the superior reach of the ER laser allows the 'Mech to engage enemies at a standoff range and its speed means the Hussar can dictate the range of the engagement, forcing enemies to fight on its terms. If enemies do get too close the Hussar can still engage in physical combat with kicks and punches but this is less than ideal. Ten double heat sinks are enough to keep the 'Mech cool in combat, but only one and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor makes the Hussar among the least-protected 'Mechs ever built.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_hussar_HSR-200-D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 轻骑兵在中央躯干上一个独特的炮塔式挂架上装有其唯一武器：一门增程大型激光。虽然只有一门武器限制了轻骑兵的防御能力，但 ER 激光的优越射程使机甲能在对峙距离上交战，而其速度意味着轻骑兵能决定交战距离，迫使敌人按它的条件作战。若敌人确实逼近，轻骑兵仍能以踢击和拳击进行肉搏，但这并不理想。十台双倍散热器足以让机甲在战斗中保持低温，但仅一吨半铁纤维装甲使轻骑兵成为史上防护最少的机甲之一。

This enables an upgrade of the 'Mech's electronics with a Beagle Active Probe and a Guardian ECM Suite in the side torsos. In addition, the armor coverage is increased to five and a half tons.

Original: The 300-D Hussar is a simple downgrade of the 200-D Hussar, gifted to the Draconis Combine by ComStar in 3035. The primary changes in the design are the replacement of the ER large laser with a standard Defiance B3L Large Laser, standard heat sinks in place of the double-strength models, and replacement of the Ferro-Fibrous armor with standard Riese Reliable armor at a negligible cost to the already weak armor protection.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_hussar_HSR-300-D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 300-D Hussar is a simple downgrade of the 200-D Hussar, gifted to the Draconis Combine by ComStar in 3035. Original: This Combine variant on the 300-D was introduced in 3038. It lowers the Hussar's top speed to 126 km/h by replacing the engine with a Pitban 240. The weight saved from the smaller power plant was used to add a Medium Laser to each arm and an extra ton of armor.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_hussar_HSR-350-D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Combine variant on the 300-D was introduced in 3038. It lowers the Hussar's top speed to 126 km/h by replacing the engine with a Pitban 240. The weight saved from the smaller power plant was used to add a Medium Laser to each arm and an extra ton of armor.

Original: One of the Clanbuster upgrades developed by ComStar in 3052, the 400-D is an extreme modification of the original Hussar. The ER large laser and the engine have both been stripped from the chassis to make room for a LB-X Autocannon/10 with one ton of ammo, an additional 1.5 tons of armor and a GM 240 XL Engine, reducing the Hussar's speed to 129.6 km/h. This variant of the Hussar, due to the cluster rounds that can be fired from the LB-X Autocannon, performs admirably in anti-vehicle screening forces.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_hussar_HSR-400-D.Details

Original: Built with lessons learned from the Battle of Tukkayid, the 450-D is armed with an LB-5X mounted in the Right Torso. 2 tons of ammo keep the main gun well supplied, whilst a pair of ER Medium Lasers offer provide some degree of deterrence against foes closing in. Rounding out the design is an extra ton of armour, allowing it to weather heavier damage than it's predecessor.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_hussar_HSR-450-D.Details

Original: The Icarus II was the first homegrown BattleMech design to be mass-produced by the Free Worlds League. It was originally designed as a speedy striker to compliment the Mackie and combat vehicles with a similar speed profile.

Original: Wow, boss. This is an old design. She may be old but she is solid and that AC10 has some serious punch.

Original: The original prototype Icarus was developed at the Happen Military Reservation on Xanthe III in 2466, and was first deployed on Alula Australis in 2469. Its premiere date in official documents is listed as 2470. The prototype used primitive equipment and lacked jump jets. It had a Large Laser to complement the Small Laser. Two SRM-2s and twin Machine Guns could prove devastating to conventional troops. Only six of these were ever produced and they are all long gone. The primitive engine drove it to a maximum of 64 km/h. Ten and a half tons of Primitive Armor provided protection.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_icarus_ii_ICR-1X.Details

Two SRM-2s and twin Machine Guns could prove devastating to conventional troops. Only six of these were ever produced and they are all long gone. The primitive engine drove it to a maximum of 64 km/h. Ten and a half tons of Primitive Armor provided protection.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 伊卡洛斯的原始原型于 2466 年在赞瑟 III 的哈彭军事保留地开发，2469 年在南十字星首次部署。官方文件中其首秀日期列为 2470 年。原型使用原始装备且没有跳跃推进器。它有一门大型激光配合小型激光。两具 SRM-2 和双联机枪对常规部队极具毁灭性。这样的机甲只造过六台，且早已消失。原始引擎驱动它最高只到 64 公里/小时。十吨半的原始装甲提供防护。

Original: The original Imp, introduced in 2793, carries an ER PPC and Medium Pulse Laser in the right and left torso. Supporting these weapons are 2 Medium Pulse Lasers mounted in the center torso and a Small Laser in the head. The left arm mounts another Medium Pulse Laser, while the right arm carries an Artemis IV enhanced LRM-20. The engine is a standard fusion model, and the missile ammunition is protected by CASE. This version was the original Imp design specified by Nicholas Kerensky and was intended for battlefield commanders.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_imp_IMP-1A.Details

Original: The Inner Sphere Standard was developed following the initial thrust of the Clan invasion, as Inner Sphere powers rushed to duplicate the battle armor technology the Clans fielded. Lacking any battlefield salvage on which to base their development though, engineers were forced to work off of ancient rumors of early power armor suits like the Nighthawk, more akin to armored Exoskeletons than the 'Toads' currently rampaging through known space, and these prototypes fared poorly during testing. It took salvage from the first victories over the Clans to truly kick-start the development of battle armor. The New Avalon Institute of Science was the first to reproduce in part the Clans' Elemental armor as the Inner Sphere Standard.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_inner_sphere_standard_IS-1.Details
