Original: One of the so-called Clanbuster variants developed in 3052 during the lead-up to the Battle of Tukayyid, ComStar's techs replaced the twin autocannons with two M-7 Gauss Rifles and four tons of ammo in the arms, trading a minor reduction in destructive capacity for greatly increased range. While retaining the LRM launcher the large laser was upgraded to a Tronel XIII Large Pulse Laser and two Hovertec Streak SRM-2s, split between the side torsos with a single ton of reloads each, were added. These changes were accomplished by using an extralight engine in place of the standard model.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_king_crab_KGC-001.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the so-called Clanbuster variants developed in 3052 during the lead-up to the Battle of Tukayyid, ComStar's techs replaced the twin autocannons with two M-7 Gauss Rifles and four tons of ammo in the arms, trading a minor reduction in destructive capacity for greatly increased range. While retaining the LRM launcher the large laser was upgraded to a Tronel XIII Large Pulse Laser and two Hovertec Streak SRM-2s, split between the side torsos with a single ton of reloads each, were added. These changes were accomplished by using an extralight engine in place of the standard model.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是 3052 年图卡伊德战役前夕开发的所谓"破氏族"变体之一。康星技师将双联自动炮换成两门 M-7 高斯步枪，臂部携带四吨弹药，以略微降低的破坏力换取大幅提升的射程。保留 LRM 发射器的同时，大型激光升级为特罗内尔 XIII 大型脉冲激光，并加装两具霍弗泰克连续 SRM-2，分列两侧躯干、各配一吨再装填。这些改动通过以超轻型引擎取代标准引擎实现。

Original: This version of the King Crab was created by the Star League to be a command 'Mech and introduced alongside the original 000 model in 2743. Conceived in secret between Cosara and the Terran Hegemony, it was an attempt to produce a deadly command 'Mech by mounting a pair of newly-developed Hellstar Magna PPCs in either side torso backed by bya pair of SRM-6's. A pair of newly developed LBX/10's replaced the standard autocannon. The 010 model was more than capable of taking down an Atlas, but the entire line left with Kerensky during the Exodus and even knowledge of the design's existence became lost during the Succession Wars.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_king_crab_KGC-010.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This version of the King Crab was created by the Star League to be a command 'Mech and introduced alongside the original 000 model in 2743. Conceived in secret between Cosara and the Terran Hegemony, it was an attempt to produce a deadly command 'Mech by mounting a pair of newly-developed Hellstar Magna PPCs in either side torso backed by bya pair of SRM-6's. A pair of newly developed LBX/10's replaced the standard autocannon. The 010 model was more than capable of taking down an Atlas, but the entire line left with Kerensky during the Exodus and even knowledge of the design's existence became lost during the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此版帝王蟹由星盟打造为指挥机甲，与原始 000 型于 2743 年一同推出。它由科萨拉与地球霸权秘密构想，试图通过在两肋各装一对新研制的"地狱星"大型 PPC 并辅以两具 SRM-6，打造一款致命的指挥机甲。一对新研制的 LBX/10 取代了标准自动炮。010 型完全有能力击杀一台阿特拉斯，但整条生产线随克伦斯基一同出走，连该设计存在的知识也在继承战争中失传。

Original: The Kit Fox D is configured for indirect fire support, mounting dual LRM-15 racks as well as a LRM-5. A Narc Missile Beacon is also carried, which may be exploited by the Kit Fox D itself, as the targeting systems of Clan LRMs lack a minimum range; this literally allows the Kit Fox D to run up to an enemy and mark them for increased accuracy, and then fall back, firing the entire time.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_kit_fox_KF-D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 小狐 D 配置为间接火力支援，装备双联 LRM-15 挂架以及一具 LRM-5。它还携带一具 NARC 导弹信标，且此信标可被小狐 D 自己利用——因为氏族 LRM 的瞄准系统没有最小射程，这实际上让小狐 D 能冲到敌人跟前为其标记以提升精度，然后一面后撤一面持续开火。

Original: The Loader King is one of the few IndustrialMechs still being manufactured in the Inner Sphere. This is due in large part to the fact that Achernar BattleMechs, the parent company of Achernar Heavy Industries, chose to maintain their IndustrialMech output rather than retool the lines for BattleMech production. Achernar BattleMechs already produces the Locust, Wasp, Phoenix Hawk and the Enforcer at their headquarters on New Avalon.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_loader_king_LDK-5C.Details

Achernar BattleMechs already produces the Locust, Wasp, Phoenix Hawk and the Enforcer at their headquarters on New Avalon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 装载之王是内天体仍在制造的少数工业机甲之一。这在很大程度上是因为阿克尔纳战斗机甲的母公司阿克尔纳重工选择维持其工业机甲产量，而非将生产线改装用于战斗机甲生产。阿克尔纳战斗机甲已在其新阿瓦隆总部生产蝗虫、黄蜂、凤凰鹰和执法者。

Original: I'm sure we can do something with this Commander, but we are pretty limited without completely gutting and rebuilding it as a whole new 'Mech.  First thing we'd have to do, is get rid of that I.C.E. and get a proper fusion engine in it.  Not sure this will be worth it.  Might not be bad for moving things around the bays though...
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_loader_king_LDK-5C.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm sure we can do something with this Commander, but we are pretty limited without completely gutting and rebuilding it as a whole new 'Mech. Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我相信我们能对它做点什么，指挥官，但如果不彻底掏空并作为全新机甲重建，我们的余地相当有限。首先我们得扔掉那台内燃机，换上正经的聚变引擎。不确定这值不值得。不过用来在机库里搬搬东西也许不错……

Original: One of the best known BattleMechs in the Inner Sphere for its low production and operation costs, the Locust is also well known in the Clans. In 2832, Clan Mongoose unleashed an upgraded version of the venerable 'Mech on the Clans, known as the Locust IIC. The speedy design complemented Mongoose tactics, enabling them to win many Trials.

Original: The primary configuration of the Lupus replaces the Archer and Bombardier 'Mechs. A pair of LRM-20 launchers with improved Artemis IV guidance systems allows the warrior to destroy a foe before they can reach close range. The Lupus Prime also carries a set of jump jets which allowed a smart warrior the opportunity to hold the range open, bombarding the enemy with heavy missile barrages. The only drawback is the limited ammunition supply: A mere three tons of ammunition allows for only a brief engagement. Should the enemy close with the Lupus all is not lost. The ER Medium Laser in each arm allow the Lupus to slice off armor, and the ECM Suite makes the Lupus Prime more difficult to target.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_lupus_LUPUS-Prime.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary configuration of the Lupus replaces the Archer and Bombardier 'Mechs. A pair of LRM-20 launchers with improved Artemis IV guidance systems allows the warrior to destroy a foe before they can reach close range. The Lupus Prime also carries a set of jump jets which allowed a smart warrior the opportunity to hold the range open, bombarding the enemy with heavy missile barrages. The only drawback is the limited ammunition supply: A mere three tons of ammunition allows for only a brief engagement. Should the enemy close with the Lupus all is not lost. The ER Medium Laser in each arm allow the Lupus to slice off armor, and the ECM Suite makes the Lupus Prime more difficult to target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狼人的主配置取代了弓箭手与轰炸机两款机甲。两具配改进型 Artemis IV 制导系统的 LRM-20 发射器，让战士能在敌人接近前将其摧毁。狼人主型号还携带一套跳跃推进器，让聪明的战士有机会保持距离，用重型导弹弹幕轰炸敌人。唯一缺点是弹药有限：仅三吨弹药只够短暂交战。若敌人逼近狼人，也并非无计可施。每臂的 ER 中型激光让狼人能削切装甲，而 ECM 套件使狼人主型号更难被锁定。

Original: Built during the Amaris civil war, the Mackie 9Hb was a stopgap attempt to solve the SLDF's sudden dearth of advanced assault mechs. By taking Mackie 9H's from the remaining Hegemony stockpiles and upgrading them with surplus parts, the SLDF hoped to create a multi role assault mech for rear echelon and support duties; potentially freeing up better equipped machines that could be used on the frontlines. Equipped with 2 Thumper Artillery pieces and a cockpit command console, the 9Hb functions as both a command mech and an Artillery support platform. Though this design functions well as a support unit, it performs poorly in direct combat. Particularly devastating is the lack of CASE around the ammo magazines, a consequence of the rushed design process.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_mackie_MSK-9Hb.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Built during the Amaris civil war, the Mackie 9Hb was a stopgap attempt to solve the SLDF's sudden dearth of advanced assault mechs. By taking Mackie 9H's from the remaining Hegemony stockpiles and upgrading them with surplus parts, the SLDF hoped to create a multi role assault mech for rear echelon and support duties; potentially freeing up better equipped machines that could be used on the frontlines. Equipped with 2 Thumper Artillery pieces and a cockpit command console, the 9Hb functions as both a command mech and an Artillery support platform. Though this design functions well as a support unit, it performs poorly in direct combat. Particularly devastating is the lack of CASE around the ammo magazines, a consequence of the rushed design process.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 麦基 9Hb 在阿马里斯内战期间建造，是为解决星盟防卫军先进突击机甲突然短缺的权宜之计。通过从霸权剩余库存中取用麦基 9H 并以剩余部件升级，星盟防卫军希望打造一款用于后方梯队与支援任务的多用途突击机甲，从而腾出装备更精良的机器用于前线。9Hb 装备两门重锤火炮与一个驾驶舱指挥台，兼具指挥机甲与火炮支援平台的功能。虽然作为支援单位表现出色，但在直接战斗中表现糟糕。尤其致命的是弹药匣周围缺乏 C.A.S.E.，这是设计过程仓促的后果。

Particularly devastating is the lack of CASE around the ammo magazines, a consequence of the rushed design process.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_mackie_MSK-9Hb.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Built during the Amaris civil war, the Mackie 9Hb was a stopgap attempt to solve the SLDF's sudden dearth of advanced assault mechs. By taking Mackie 9H's from the remaining Hegemony stockpiles and upgrading them with surplus parts, the SLDF hoped to create a multi role assault mech for rear echelon and support duties; potentially freeing up better equipped machines that could be used on the frontlines. Equipped with 2 Thumper Artillery pieces and a cockpit command console, the 9Hb functions as both a command mech and an Artillery support platform. Though this design functions well as a support unit, it performs poorly in direct combat. Particularly devastating is the lack of CASE around the ammo magazines, a consequence of the rushed design process.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 麦基 9Hb 在阿马里斯内战期间建造，是为解决星盟防卫军先进突击机甲突然短缺的权宜之计。通过从霸权剩余库存中取用麦基 9H 并以剩余部件升级，星盟防卫军希望打造一款用于后方梯队与支援任务的多用途突击机甲，从而腾出装备更精良的机器用于前线。9Hb 装备两门重锤火炮与一个驾驶舱指挥台，兼具指挥机甲与火炮支援平台的功能。虽然作为支援单位表现出色，但在直接战斗中表现糟糕。尤其致命的是弹药匣周围缺乏 C.A.S.E.，这是设计过程仓促的后果。

Original: A clan buster refit developed with Comstar’s mothballed 9Hb’s, the 9Hc was an attempt to fix the failings of it’s predecessor design in a cheap and easy to maintain upgrade package. Identifying the lack of CASE and adequate secondary weapons as the key weaknesses, the Comguard designers disregarded the other weakness – the designs slow ground speed – as being of lesser importance. The designers selected an Endo Steel skeleton as the preferred option, rejecting other more expensive solutions. CASE was installed for both ammo magazines and the designers upgraded the medium lasers to ER versions; installing an extra 3 in the process with double heat sinks incorporated to balance out the heat spike. The 5 completed prototypes served with distinction on Tukayyid, though the design never reached production status; with only 2 other conversions finished before the Word of Blake seized Terra and the remaining stocks of 9Hb’s. .
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_mackie_MSK-9Hc.Details

The designers selected an Endo Steel skeleton as the preferred option, rejecting other more expensive solutions. CASE was installed for both ammo magazines and the designers upgraded the medium lasers to ER versions; installing an extra 3 in the process with double heat sinks incorporated to balance out the heat spike. The 5 completed prototypes served with distinction on Tukayyid, though the design never reached production status; with only 2 other conversions finished before the Word of Blake seized Terra and the remaining stocks of 9Hb’s. .
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 9Hc 是利用康星封存的 9Hb 开发的"破氏族"改装型，旨在以廉价易维护的升级包修正前型设计的缺陷。康卫设计师认定缺乏 C.A.S.E. 与足够的次要武器是关键弱点，而将设计的另一缺陷——地面速度缓慢——视为次要。设计师选择内骨骼骨架为首选方案，否决了其他更昂贵的解决途径。两个弹匣都安装了 C.A.S.E.，并将中型激光升级为 ER 版本；过程中还额外加装 3 门，并配以双倍散热器以平衡热量尖峰。5 台完成的原型机在图卡伊德表现出色，尽管该设计从未进入量产；在布雷克之言夺取地球及其剩余的 9Hb 库存前，仅又完成了 2 台改装。.

Original: Built around the Extended Range Particle Projector Cannon, one of the most powerful weapons in the Clan arsenal, the Marauder IIC's weapon layout is typical of the standard Marauder, each pod-like forearm carrying an ER PPC paired with Medium Pulse Lasers. Where the Marauder IIC differs is with its torso weaponry, replacing the top-mounted autocannon and its vulnerable ammunition-feed linkage with another ER PPC, and adding a set of four ER Small Lasers. Twenty-one double heat sinks keep heat levels manageable, with an enterprising MechWarrior able to use volley fire to keep up a steady barrage of fire.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_marauder_iic_MAD-IIC-1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Built around the Extended Range Particle Projector Cannon, one of the most powerful weapons in the Clan arsenal, the Marauder IIC's weapon layout is typical of the standard Marauder, each pod-like forearm carrying an ER PPC paired with Medium Pulse Lasers. Where the Marauder IIC differs is with its torso weaponry, replacing the top-mounted autocannon and its vulnerable ammunition-feed linkage with another ER PPC, and adding a set of four ER Small Lasers. Twenty-one double heat sinks keep heat levels manageable, with an enterprising MechWarrior able to use volley fire to keep up a steady barrage of fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 掠夺者 IIC 以 ER 粒子投射炮——氏族武库中最强大的武器之一——为核心，其武器布局与标准掠夺者一致：每只吊舱式前臂各载一门 ER PPC 并配以中型脉冲激光。不同之处在于躯干武器：以另一门 ER PPC 取代顶部自动炮及其脆弱的供弹连接，并加装一组四门 ER 小型激光。二十一台双倍散热器将热量维持在可控水平，有进取心的机甲战士可用齐射维持稳定的火力倾泻。

Original: The Marauder II was first built in 3012 in an attempt to take the firepower of the Marauder and combine it with the reliability and ruggedness of an assault chassis. This was achieved by generally upgrading the entire 'Mech's chassis to allow it to carry a much heavier armor and weapons load. The 'Mech was then armored with nineteen tons of armor, giving it protection that rivals that of the Atlas. Finally, to make up for the reduced mobility of the Marauder II, the 'Mech was outfitted with jump jets that give it a jumping capability of up to ninety meters. Blackwell Heavy Industries produced the design exclusively for Wolf's Dragoons until the end of the Fourth Succession War, when Jaime Wolf allowed them to sell to others.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Marauder II was first built in 3012 in an attempt to take the firepower of the Marauder and combine it with the reliability and ruggedness of an assault chassis. This was achieved by generally upgrading the entire 'Mech's chassis to allow it to carry a much heavier armor and weapons load. The 'Mech was then armored with nineteen tons of armor, giving it protection that rivals that of the Atlas. Finally, to make up for the reduced mobility of the Marauder II, the 'Mech was outfitted with jump jets that give it a jumping capability of up to ninety meters. Blackwell Heavy Industries produced the design exclusively for Wolf's Dragoons until the end of the Fourth Succession War, when Jaime Wolf allowed them to sell to others.

Original: While the standard Marauder II, the MAD-5A, was built to spec for the Wolf's Dragoons to be a line combat unit and a traditional assault mech, the MAD-4HB is only one step removed from being a pirate design. Constructed by pirates after stealing a shipment of Marauder IIs meant for someone else, they removed the fancy equipment they couldn't maintain and filled in the holes with a frankly ungodly number of rockets, allowing the -4HB a punch that can instantly delete lesser mechs and even seriously damage mechs of its own caliber. After the rockets though, the -4HB has little firepower for an assault mech.

Original: Named for the door guards who serve to ward off evil spirits from a home, the Men Shen is the first OmniMech to come from the Capellan Confederation, it borrows heavily from the Raven BattleMech for its basic design concept. The 'Mech is built on a lightweight Endo Steel chassis and is powered by a vulnerable but light VOX 330 XL Engine that gives it a top speed of 97.2 km/h that is augmented by MASC system allowing the 'Mech to be pushed up to 129.6 km/h in short bursts. The Men Shen comes with eleven tons of armor, giving it a respectable amount of protection. The Men Shen carries on its base chassis a Beagle Active Probe allowing it to serve in a recon role regardless of its configuration. For weapons and equipment the Men Shen has seventeen tons of free pod space.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_men_shen_MS1-O.Details

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 门神之名取自守护家宅驱除邪灵的门卫，它是卡佩兰邦联的首款全能机甲，基本设计概念大量借鉴渡鸦战斗机甲。该机甲建立在轻量化内骨骼底盘上，由脆弱但轻便的 VOX 330 XL 引擎驱动，最高速度 97.2 公里/小时，并可由 MASC 系统在短促爆发中推至 129.6 公里/小时。门神配有十一吨装甲，防护相当可观。其基础底盘搭载比格犬主动探测器，使其无论何种配置都能胜任侦察任务。武器与装备方面，门神拥有十七吨自由吊舱空间。

Original: In its primary configuration the Men Shen is a powerful close combat 'Mech and is capable of providing indirect fire support to friendly units. For close-range combat, the primary configuration has four highly accurate Medium Pulse Lasers. To provide both direct and indirect long range fire support, the primary configuration of the Men Shen has an LRM-15 launcher with an Artemis IV fire control system for increased missile accuracy.

The Men Shen carries on its base chassis a Beagle Active Probe allowing it to serve in a recon role regardless of its configuration. For weapons and equipment the Men Shen has seventeen tons of free pod space.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 门神之名取自守护家宅驱除邪灵的门卫，它是卡佩兰邦联的首款全能机甲，基本设计概念大量借鉴渡鸦战斗机甲。该机甲建立在轻量化内骨骼底盘上，由脆弱但轻便的 VOX 330 XL 引擎驱动，最高速度 97.2 公里/小时，并可由 MASC 系统在短促爆发中推至 129.6 公里/小时。门神配有十一吨装甲，防护相当可观。其基础底盘搭载比格犬主动探测器，使其无论何种配置都能胜任侦察任务。武器与装备方面，门神拥有十七吨自由吊舱空间。

Original: The primary weapons on the O-Bakemono are a pair of Shigunga Arrow IV Systems. The Arrow IVs have an effective range of up to three kilometers, allowing the O-Bakemono to stay at extreme ranges and rain missiles onto the battlefield while friendly units spot for it.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_O-Bakemono_OBK-M10.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary weapons on the O-Bakemono are a pair of Shigunga Arrow IV Systems. The Arrow IVs have an effective range of up to three kilometers, allowing the O-Bakemono to stay at extreme ranges and rain missiles onto the battlefield while friendly units spot for it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: O-Bakemono 的主武器是一对"紫郡"箭矢 IV 系统。箭矢 IV 的有效射程可达三公里，使 O-Bakemono 能待在极远距离上向战场倾泻导弹，由友军单位为其指示目标。

Original: Since it was the chosen BattleMech of the Great Father, the venerable Orion has always held a special place in the mystique of the Clans. Out of respect for General Kerensky's legacy, all the Clans maintained the design for several decades even as the development of newer and more advanced technologies increasingly left it less effective on the battlefield. Not a radical reworking of the design, as some Clan upgrades are, the Orion IIC replaces much of the innards and weapons of the original, while preserving its mass and aesthetics. This IIC upgrade utilizes an Endo Steel chassis and twelve tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, while also making use of twelve double heat sinks, freeing up weight for heavier weapons loadout.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_orion_iic_ON1-IIC-1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Since it was the chosen BattleMech of the Great Father, the venerable Orion has always held a special place in the mystique of the Clans. Out of respect for General Kerensky's legacy, all the Clans maintained the design for several decades even as the development of newer and more advanced technologies increasingly left it less effective on the battlefield. Not a radical reworking of the design, as some Clan upgrades are, the Orion IIC replaces much of the innards and weapons of the original, while preserving its mass and aesthetics. This IIC upgrade utilizes an Endo Steel chassis and twelve tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, while also making use of twelve double heat sinks, freeing up weight for heavier weapons loadout.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由于它是"伟大之父"选用的战斗机甲，古老的猎户座在氏族的神秘传统中始终占有特殊地位。出于对克伦斯基将军遗产的尊重，所有氏族都维持该设计数十年，即便更新更先进技术的发展日益令它在战场上失去效力。猎户座 IIC 并非像某些氏族升级那样彻底重做，而是更换了原版的大部分内部结构与武器，同时保留其质量与外观。此次 IIC 升级采用内骨骼底盘和十二吨铁纤维装甲，并使用十二台双倍散热器，腾出重量以搭载更重的武器。

Original: Since it was the chosen BattleMech of the Great Father, the venerable Orion has always held a special place in the mystique of the Clans. Out of respect for General Kerensky's legacy, all the Clans maintained the design for several decades even as the development of newer and more advanced technologies increasingly left it less effective on the battlefield. Not a radical reworking of the design, as some Clan upgrades are, the Orion IIC replaces much of the innards and weapons of the original, while preserving its mass and aesthetics. This IIC upgrade utilizes an Endo Steel chassis and twelve tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, while also making use of twelve double heat sinks, freeing up weight for heavier weapons loadout. This variant switches the Gauss Rifle to an Ultra Autocannon/10 and downgrading the LRM-20 rack into an LRM-15.

Original: The original primitive Orion 'Mech as it was first commissioned lacked an LRM launcher and used an Autocannon/5 in place of the AC/10.  A massive 360 engine allowed the 'Mech to obtain a maximum speed of nearly 64.8 km/h, however there was not enough saved weight to mount additional weaponry besides two Medium Lasers, one in each arm. In addition it only mounted 14.5 tons of armor, and ultimately would be considered too lightly armed and armored with the prototype dismissed as a candidate for production.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_orion_ON1-C.Details

In addition it only mounted 14.5 tons of armor, and ultimately would be considered too lightly armed and armored with the prototype dismissed as a candidate for production.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 初版原始猎户座机甲在被首次定型时没有 LRM 发射器，并以一门自动炮/5 取代 AC/10。一台巨大的 360 引擎使机甲能达到近 64.8 公里/小时的最高速度，但节省的重量不足以在每臂各一门中型激光之外加装更多武器。此外它只披挂 14.5 吨装甲，最终被认为武装与装甲都过于薄弱，该原型被排除在量产候选之外。

Original: The Orion V trades some of the armor the K model is known for to mount additional weaponry. This increases its overall damage output, but many pilots consider the loss of armor to be risky.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_orion_ON1-C.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Orion V trades some of the armor the K model is known for to mount additional weaponry. This increases its overall damage output, but many pilots consider the loss of armor to be risky.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎户座 V 以 K 型闻名的部分装甲为代价搭载额外武器。这提升了总体伤害输出，但许多飞行员认为失去装甲颇为冒险。

Original: Built by General Mechanics, the ON1-H was the third known primitive prototype of the Orion 'Mech that was eventually accepted for mass production in 2456. While slower than the first iterations, with a top speed of only 54 km/h (the same as that of a Mackie or Banshee), due to the inclusion of a smaller 275-class engine, the additional weight saved allowed the designers to mount far more firepower. A newly developed Class-10 Prototype Autocannon was installed and two tons of ammo in place of the AC/5. This was backed up by two 5-tube Long-Range Missile launchers with one ton of reloads in the left torso for striking enemies at range and a short-range SRM-4 missile launcher and a ton of ammunition installed in the left arm for close-in defense. It was also heavily protected by 21 tons of armor. A minimal amount of heatsinks, however, could cause build-up of heat within crippling levels, but could be avoided by competent MechWarriors.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_orion_ON1-H.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Built by General Mechanics, the ON1-H was the third known primitive prototype of the Orion 'Mech that was eventually accepted for mass production in 2456. While slower than the first iterations, with a top speed of only 54 km/h (the same as that of a Mackie or Banshee), due to the inclusion of a smaller 275-class engine, the additional weight saved allowed the designers to mount far more firepower. A newly developed Class-10 Prototype Autocannon was installed and two tons of ammo in place of the AC/5. This was backed up by two 5-tube Long-Range Missile launchers with one ton of reloads in the left torso for striking enemies at range and a short-range SRM-4 missile launcher and a ton of ammunition installed in the left arm for close-in defense. It was also heavily protected by 21 tons of armor. A minimal amount of heatsinks, however, could cause build-up of heat within crippling levels, but could be avoided by competent MechWarriors.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: ON1-H 由通用机械制造，是猎户座机甲第三个已知的原始原型，最终于 2456 年被批准量产。虽然比最初几版更慢，最高速度仅 54 公里/小时（与麦基或女妖相当），因为采用了更小的 275 级引擎，但节省的额外重量让设计师能装上多得多的火力。它安装了新研制的 10 级原型自动炮和两吨弹药，取代 AC/5。远程打击方面辅以两具 5 管远程导弹发射器（左躯干一吨再装填），近身防御则有左臂的一具短程 SRM-4 导弹发射器和一吨弹药。它还有 21 吨装甲的重型防护。然而散热器数量极少，热量可能累积到致残水平，但能干的机甲战士可以避免这一点。

Original: Upgraded with Star League technology, the 2D variant of the Ostroc extends the 'Mechs maximum range by replacing the Large Lasers with two ER Large Lasers. The 2D retains the Medium Lasers and SRM-4 of the 2C model. To handle the heat burden it is also equipped with double heat sinks. Being a relatively rare design, the Ostroc had no official field refit kit but the 2D variant was a common upgrade in 3050 if the parts could be obtained.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_ostroc_OSR-2D.Details

Original: The 2M Ostwar was armed with a twenty-tube Doombud Long Range Missile launcher for its long range attacks. In close range, the 'Mech was armed with two four-tubed Shannon SH-40 Short-Range Missile launchers in each of its paddle shaped forearms. It also mounted two Martell Medium Lasers mounted on the left torso. The 'Mech carried three tons of ammunition for the LRM rack, while carrying a ton of SRM ammunition in its left arm.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_ostwar_OWR-2M.Details

Original: The Owens is intended to be an OmniMech upgrade of the Jenner BattleMech. The intended role for the Owens is as a cavalry 'Mech that can move along the enemy lines and designate targets for bombardment with Arrow IV artillery attacks. The Owens is a strong spotting unit as well as a point 'Mech for C3 lances with its permanently mounted TAG laser designator, Beagle Probe and C3 Slave unit.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_owens_OW-1Ar.Details

Original: The Pack Hunter is the first new design produced by Clan Wolf-in-Exile on Arc-Royal. It also represents a new partnership between Phelan's Wolves and the Kell Hounds, as the armor and communications gear are Kell Hound products, traded to the Wolves in exchange for Endo Steel. Reflecting their Khan's bias towards light, fast designs, Wolf scientists designed the Pack Hunter to be fast and have a sharp bite. Though its four tons of armor are light, the BattleMech is supposed to use its speed and maneuverability to stay out of trouble.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Pack Hunter is the first new design produced by Clan Wolf-in-Exile on Arc-Royal. It also represents a new partnership between Phelan's Wolves and the Kell Hounds, as the armor and communications gear are Kell Hound products, traded to the Wolves in exchange for Endo Steel. Reflecting their Khan's bias towards light, fast designs, Wolf scientists designed the Pack Hunter to be fast and have a sharp bite. Though its four tons of armor are light, the BattleMech is supposed to use its speed and maneuverability to stay out of trouble.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎群者是流亡狼氏族在弧-皇家星生产的第一款新设计。它也代表费兰的狼群与凯尔猎犬之间的新合作——装甲与通讯设备均为凯尔猎犬的产品，用来向狼群换取内骨骼。狼族科学家遵循其可汗对轻型快速设计的偏爱，把猎群者设计得又快又利齿。尽管四吨装甲偏薄，这台战斗机甲本应依靠速度与机动性避免陷入麻烦。

Original: The Perseus is the product of a program begun by the League Central Coordination and Command to create an OmniMech completely indigenous to the Free Worlds League from concept to production. The Perseus shares much with the venerable Orion, a staple of Free Worlds League Military, both broadly resembling the older design visually and using a number of the same components. This similarity prompted more than a few FWLM technicians to nickname the new design the Omni-Orion and the deployment of Perseus has largely been to front-line units that fielded large concentrations of its progenitor, replacing older Orions on a one-for-one basis. Built on a lightweight Endo Steel chassis, the Perseus is powered by a Hermes 300 XL engine helping save even more weight and giving the 'Mech a top speed of 64.8 km/h. The advanced structure and engine save a great deal of weight for weapons and equipment. The Perseus is protected by fourteen tons of Valiant Lamellor armor, giving it around average armor protection for a 'Mech of its size. It also has twelve double heat sinks that are fixed on the chassis.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_perseus_p1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 珀尔修斯是联盟中央协调与指挥部发起的一项计划的产物，旨在从概念到生产打造一款完全属于自由世界联盟的全能机甲。珀尔修斯与备受尊崇的猎户座共享诸多特征——后者是自由世界联盟军队的中坚，两者不仅外观上大体相似，还使用了若干相同部件。这种相似让不少联盟军技师将新设计戏称为"全能猎户座"，而珀尔修斯的部署也主要面向那些大量装备其前身的精锐部队，一对一替换老旧猎户座。珀尔修斯采用轻量化内骨骼底盘，由赫尔墨斯 300 XL 引擎驱动，进一步节省重量，最高速度 64.8 公里/小时。先进的结构与引擎为武器和装备腾出大量重量。它以十四吨英勇拉梅洛装甲防护，装甲水平约为此尺寸机甲的平均值。它还固定配备十二台双倍散热器。

Original: The primary configuration of the Perseus shares a great deal with the Orion. For long range direct and indirect fire support, the Perseus carries an LRM-20 with Artemis IV for increased missile accuracy. For long range direct fire, the Perseus carries a powerful Ultra Autocannon/10 that is capable of firing at twice the rate as a standard autocannon. The Perseus has a devastating short range arsenal with a highly accurate Medium Pulse Laser, four ER Medium Lasers , an ER Small Laser, and finally an SRM-4 launcher that is linked to an Artemis IV FCS. The primary configuration mounts two tons each of both Ultra Autocannon and LRM munitions as well as single ton of SRM reloads in CASE protected ammunition bays in both its side torsos.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_perseus_p1.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 英仙座主配置与猎户座有诸多共通之处。远程直接与间接火力支援方面，英仙座携带一具带 Artemis IV 以提升导弹精度的 LRM-20。远程直射火力方面，英仙座携带一门强力超速自动炮/10，射速可达标准自动炮的两倍。英仙座拥有毁灭性的近程武器库：一门极为精准的中型脉冲激光、四门 ER 中型激光、一门 ER 小型激光，最后一具联接 Artemis IV 火控系统的 SRM-4 发射器。主配置在两侧躯干受 C.A.S.E. 保护的弹药舱中各携带两吨超速自动炮弹药和两吨 LRM 弹药，以及一吨 SRM 再装填。

The D also has an ECM suite to protect itself from enemy electronic warfare systems and a Beagle Active Probe that allows it to find hidden units in close combat situation.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_perseus_p1d.YangsThoughts

For close ranges, the 'Mech has an SRM-6 launcher linked to an Artemis IV FCS, three ER Medium Lasers, and a ER Small Laser. The D also has an ECM suite to protect itself from enemy electronic warfare systems and a Beagle Active Probe that allows it to find hidden units in close combat situation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: D 配置专为近战而设，装有一具带 Artemis IV 火控系统以提升精度的 LRM-20 发射器，以及一门用于远程交战的 LB-X 自动炮/10。近程方面，机甲有一具联接 Artemis IV 火控系统的 SRM-6 发射器、三门 ER 中型激光和一门 ER 小型激光。D 还装有 ECM 套件以防御敌方电子战系统，以及一具比格犬主动探测器，使其能在近战中找出隐藏单位。

Original: Developed for the Star League Defense Force Royal Divisions in 2692, this variant of the Phoenix Hawk LAM used four Medium Lasers and a single ER Large Laser as its main firepower. Twelve double heat sinks kept the heat curve low, but the limited fuel, armor, and maneuverability made the Phoenix Hawk LAM easy prey for AeroSpace Fighters of the same weight. It could maneuver fast enough to evade heavier foes however

Original: The Phoenix Hawk LAM was the largest Land-Air 'Mech produced during the Star League. Allied Aerospace reworked their designs for conversion equipment and the size of the LAM, learning from their mistake with the Shadow Hawk LAM and the success of the Stinger LAM. The resulting LAM was the largest LAM ever constructed capable of remaining in AirMech mode. Unfortunately, large Land-Air 'Mech conversion technology was not fully researched before the fall of the Star League, and the Phoenix Hawk LAM frequently met its end due to the occasional glitch. The end of the Star League and destruction of the Allied Aerospace facilities at the beginning of the First Succession War prevented further development and refinement.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_phoenix_hawk_lam_PHX-HK2.Details

The resulting LAM was the largest LAM ever constructed capable of remaining in AirMech mode. Unfortunately, large Land-Air 'Mech conversion technology was not fully researched before the fall of the Star League, and the Phoenix Hawk LAM frequently met its end due to the occasional glitch. The end of the Star League and destruction of the Allied Aerospace facilities at the beginning of the First Succession War prevented further development and refinement.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凤凰鹰 LAM 是星盟时期生产的最大陆空机甲。联合航空重做了其变身设备与 LAM 尺寸的设计，吸取了影鹰 LAM 的教训与毒刺 LAM 的成功经验。成品是有史以来最大的、能在机甲空中模式维持飞行的 LAM。遗憾的是，大型陆空机甲变身技术在星盟覆灭前未获充分研究，凤凰鹰 LAM 常因偶发故障而殒命。星盟的终结与第一次继承战争初期联合航空设施的毁灭，阻断了进一步的开发与改良。

Original: The Piranha's main threat is its twelve Series XII Rotary Machine Guns. These are a serious threat to any foe on such a speedy 'Mech, especially if a Star of Piranhas operate in a pack, and such a large array allows the 'Mech to chew through an opponent's rear armor almost instantly. They are most deadly, however, to unarmored infantry, capable of wiping out an entire company in seconds. For work against hardened targets, the Piranha mounts a pair of Mk. 3 ER Medium Lasers and a single Series 1 ER Small Laser. Since the design only uses ten single heat sinks, the MechWarrior must still manage heat levels. The ammunition dependency of the Machine Guns ensure that Piranhas must stay close to supply lines, so most have been relegated to solahma or garrison roles.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_piranha_pra.Details

These are a serious threat to any foe on such a speedy 'Mech, especially if a Star of Piranhas operate in a pack, and such a large array allows the 'Mech to chew through an opponent's rear armor almost instantly. They are most deadly, however, to unarmored infantry, capable of wiping out an entire company in seconds. For work against hardened targets, the Piranha mounts a pair of Mk. 3 ER Medium Lasers and a single Series 1 ER Small Laser. Since the design only uses ten single heat sinks, the MechWarrior must still manage heat levels. The ammunition dependency of the Machine Guns ensure that Piranhas must stay close to supply lines, so most have been relegated to solahma or garrison roles.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 食人鱼的主要威胁是它的十二挺 XII 系列旋转机枪。在一台如此快速的机甲上，这对任何敌人都是严重威胁，尤其当一个"星"的食人鱼成群作战时；如此庞大的阵列让机甲几乎瞬间啃穿对手的背部装甲。不过它们对无装甲步兵最为致命，能在数秒内歼灭一整连。对付硬化目标时，食人鱼装有双联 Mk. 3 ER 中型激光和一门 1 系列 ER 小型激光。由于该设计仅使用十台单散热器，机甲战士仍须管理热量水平。机枪对弹药的依赖使食人鱼必须靠近补给线，因此大多数被降级到索拉马或驻防任务。

Original: The Pouncer was originally a test bed design that was upgraded to combat specifications on the orders of then-IlKhan Ulric Kerensky, as it was realized that a more mobile 'Mech was needed when combating Inner Sphere forces. The Pouncer is built on a lightweight DSAM Endo 4 Endo Steel chassis and is powered by a 240 XL engine which gives it a maximum speed of 97.2 km/h. The 'Mech's mobility is enhanced with five Grandthrust Mk. Four jump jets that allow it to jump up to one hundred and fifty meters. For protection from enemy fire, the Pouncer has a respectable six tons of Forging ZM15 Ferro-Fibrous armor. Overall, the Pouncer is an excellent OmniMech with fifteen and a half tons of pod space, allowing it to carry a wide variety of weapons payloads.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_pouncer_PCR-A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Pouncer was originally a test bed design that was upgraded to combat specifications on the orders of then-IlKhan Ulric Kerensky, as it was realized that a more mobile 'Mech was needed when combating Inner Sphere forces. The Pouncer is built on a lightweight DSAM Endo 4 Endo Steel chassis and is powered by a 240 XL engine which gives it a maximum speed of 97.2 km/h. The 'Mech's mobility is enhanced with five Grandthrust Mk. Four jump jets that allow it to jump up to one hundred and fifty meters. For protection from enemy fire, the Pouncer has a respectable six tons of Forging ZM15 Ferro-Fibrous armor. Overall, the Pouncer is an excellent OmniMech with fifteen and a half tons of pod space, allowing it to carry a wide variety of weapons payloads.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猛扑者原本是试验台设计，因意识到对抗内天体部队需要更机动的机甲，遂奉时任伊尔汗乌尔里克·克伦斯基之命升级至作战规格。它采用轻量化的 DSAM Endo 4 内骨骼底盘，由 240 XL 引擎驱动，最大速度 97.2 公里/小时。五个 Grandthrust Mk. Four 跳跃推进器使其机动性提升，可跳跃至一百五十米。为抵御敌方火力，猛扑者装备了可观的六吨 Forging ZM15 铁纤维装甲。总体而言，猛扑者是一款出色的全能机甲，拥有十五吨半的吊舱空间，可搭载多种武器配置。

Original: Technicron's replacement for the original 4G model, the 5M was introduced in 3049 as an answer to the original's heat problems by replacing the thirteen normal heat sinks with double-strength versions. It also improved the design's defenses by swapping out the regular armor with Kallon FWL Special Ferro-Fibrous and installing CASE for the LRM's ammunition. The space necessary for these upgrades was provided for by removing the SRM launcher for a one-shot Hovertec SRM-4 Launcher, a disposable missile launcher more commonly found on VTOLs, hovercraft and similar combat vehicles. The loss in sheer short-range firepower is more than made up for by the other upgrades to the design.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_quickdraw_QKD-5M.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Technicron's replacement for the original 4G model, the 5M was introduced in 3049 as an answer to the original's heat problems by replacing the thirteen normal heat sinks with double-strength versions. It also improved the design's defenses by swapping out the regular armor with Kallon FWL Special Ferro-Fibrous and installing CASE for the LRM's ammunition. The space necessary for these upgrades was provided for by removing the SRM launcher for a one-shot Hovertec SRM-4 Launcher, a disposable missile launcher more commonly found on VTOLs, hovercraft and similar combat vehicles. The loss in sheer short-range firepower is more than made up for by the other upgrades to the design.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5M 是泰克尼创为原 4G 型号打造的替代品，于 3049 年推出，以双倍强度散热器取代十三台普通散热器来回应原版的热量问题。它还通过把常规装甲换成卡隆 FWL 特制铁纤维、并为 LRM 弹药安装 C.A.S.E. 来改善设计的防御。这些升级所需的空间来自移除 SRM 发射器，换成单次发射的霍弗泰克 SRM-4 发射器——一种在垂直起降机、悬浮车及类似战斗车辆上更常见的可弃导弹发射器。近程火力上的损失，被其他升级远远补偿。

Original: Simple, straightforward, and accurate; the Rifleman IIC is armed with four Large Pulse Lasers. This allows it to pick apart enemies from a respectable range, as well as easily target incoming aircraft. A single ER Small Laser is installed, seemingly as an afterthought. Nineteen double heat sinks keep heat mostly in check, though volley fire should be used.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_rifleman_iic_RFL-IIC-1.Details

Original: Allied Aerospace won the SLDF's contract to produce a series of Land-Air mechs with a design based on the venerable Shadow HawkBattleMech. Allied gave their new Land-Air 'Mech the ability to convert directly into an Aerospace Fighter. While construction was completed in 2680, thanks to the chassis' numerous flaws, lackluster performance and a number of ill-fated and publicly witnessed test-flights disasters during SLDF reviews in 2682, Allied Aerospace was forced to go back to the drawing board. The more refined X2 variant faced considerable scrutiny by SLDF evaluators in 2684, successfully meeting the SLDF's requirements but still rejected thanks to its high fuel consumption and the bad press generated by the earlier X1. Twenty SHD-X2 were built for trials with potential customers, but failed to attract any interest. Ultimately Allied scrapped the Shadow Hawk LAM program in favor of what became the considerably more successful Phoenix Hawk LAM.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_shadow_hawk_lam_SHD-X2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Allied Aerospace won the SLDF's contract to produce a series of Land-Air mechs with a design based on the venerable Shadow HawkBattleMech. Allied gave their new Land-Air 'Mech the ability to convert directly into an Aerospace Fighter. While construction was completed in 2680, thanks to the chassis' numerous flaws, lackluster performance and a number of ill-fated and publicly witnessed test-flights disasters during SLDF reviews in 2682, Allied Aerospace was forced to go back to the drawing board. The more refined X2 variant faced considerable scrutiny by SLDF evaluators in 2684, successfully meeting the SLDF's requirements but still rejected thanks to its high fuel consumption and the bad press generated by the earlier X1. Twenty SHD-X2 were built for trials with potential customers, but failed to attract any interest. Ultimately Allied scrapped the Shadow Hawk LAM program in favor of what became the considerably more successful Phoenix Hawk LAM.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 联合航空赢得星盟防卫军生产一系列陆空机甲的合同，设计以古老的影鹰战斗机甲为基础。联合航空让新型陆空机甲能直接变身为航空战斗机。虽然制造于 2680 年完成，但由于底盘缺陷众多、性能不佳，加上 2682 年星盟防卫军评审期间一系列不幸且公开可见的试飞灾难，联合航空被迫重头再来。更精细的 X2 变体于 2684 年接受了星盟评审员的严格审查，虽然成功满足星盟要求，却仍因高燃料消耗和早期 X1 造成的负面报道而被否决。二十台 SHD-X2 被造出来供潜在客户试用，却未能引起任何兴趣。最终联合航空放弃了影鹰 LAM 项目，转而投向后来相当成功的凤凰鹰 LAM。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Allied Aerospace won the SLDF's contract to produce a series of Land-Air mechs with a design based on the venerable Shadow HawkBattleMech. Allied gave their new Land-Air 'Mech the ability to convert directly into an Aerospace Fighter. While construction was completed in 2680, thanks to the chassis' numerous flaws, lackluster performance and a number of ill-fated and publicly witnessed test-flights disasters during SLDF reviews in 2682, Allied Aerospace was forced to go back to the drawing board. The more refined X2 variant faced considerable scrutiny by SLDF evaluators in 2684, successfully meeting the SLDF's requirements but still rejected thanks to its high fuel consumption and the bad press generated by the earlier X1. Twenty SHD-X2 were built for trials with potential customers, but failed to attract any interest. Ultimately Allied scrapped the Shadow Hawk LAM program in favor of what became the considerably more successful Phoenix Hawk LAM.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 联合航空赢得星盟防卫军生产一系列陆空机甲的合同，设计以古老的影鹰战斗机甲为基础。联合航空让新型陆空机甲能直接变身为航空战斗机。虽然制造于 2680 年完成，但由于底盘缺陷众多、性能不佳，加上 2682 年星盟防卫军评审期间一系列不幸且公开可见的试飞灾难，联合航空被迫重头再来。更精细的 X2 变体于 2684 年接受了星盟评审员的严格审查，虽然成功满足星盟要求，却仍因高燃料消耗和早期 X1 造成的负面报道而被否决。二十台 SHD-X2 被造出来供潜在客户试用，却未能引起任何兴趣。最终联合航空放弃了影鹰 LAM 项目，转而投向后来相当成功的凤凰鹰 LAM。

Original: The 5M Shadow Hawk is the first complete overhaul and upgrade of the design, unveiled in 3048 by Earthwerks for the Free Worlds League. The chassis has been upgraded to an Earthwerks SHD II Endo Steel frame, an additional ton of armor was added, two additional jump jets were fitted for a total jumping distance of 150 meters, the engine replaced with an extralight version of the Hermes 275, and the weapons load has undergone an almost complete renovation. The original autocannon has been updated to an Imperator Ultra Autocannon/5, the LRM launcher to a Doombud LRM-20, and the head-mounted SRM launcher to a Hovertec Streak SRM-2. The amount of ammunition carried and the left-arm medium laser are maintained, and while the number of heat sinks was reduced to ten these were upgrade to double-strength models.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_shadow_hawk_SHD-5M.Details

The original autocannon has been updated to an Imperator Ultra Autocannon/5, the LRM launcher to a Doombud LRM-20, and the head-mounted SRM launcher to a Hovertec Streak SRM-2. The amount of ammunition carried and the left-arm medium laser are maintained, and while the number of heat sinks was reduced to ten these were upgrade to double-strength models.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5M 影鹰是该设计的首次彻底翻修与升级，由地球工厂于 3048 年为自由世界联盟推出。底盘升级为地球工厂 SHD II 内骨骼框架，增加一吨装甲，加装两个跳跃推进器使总跳跃距离达 150 米，引擎换成赫尔墨斯 275 的超轻型版本，武器配置几乎全面翻新。原始自动炮升级为帝皇超速自动炮/5，LRM 发射器换为末日芽 LRM-20，头部 SRM 发射器换为霍弗泰克连续 SRM-2。弹药携带量与左臂中型激光保持不变，散热器数量虽减至十台但升级为双倍强度型号。

Original: Created by Maverick Industries, the 5MI is a redesign of House Marik’s 5M model. Designed to compete with the Griffin 1DS and other new designs, the 5MI was Mavericks attempt to win over the recalcitrant FedCom military. Focusing on improving survivability and battlefield endurance, the 5MI used new technology like DHS and an Artemis IV FSC to give it an edge. Unfortunately the design was deemed to expensive too produce and as a result the military declined to purchase any of the initial production run. Such poor performance led to the second manufacturing run being cancelled and resources diverted to more promising lines. The surviving models were sold off to various mercenary groups, though the Maverick Industries scion would use one during her time in the 10th Lyran Guards; netting the company the occasional conversion or custom order from fellow members of the regiment.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_shadow_hawk_SHD-5MI.Details

Focusing on improving survivability and battlefield endurance, the 5MI used new technology like DHS and an Artemis IV FSC to give it an edge. Unfortunately the design was deemed to expensive too produce and as a result the military declined to purchase any of the initial production run. Such poor performance led to the second manufacturing run being cancelled and resources diverted to more promising lines. The surviving models were sold off to various mercenary groups, though the Maverick Industries scion would use one during her time in the 10th Lyran Guards; netting the company the occasional conversion or custom order from fellow members of the regiment.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5MI 由马弗里克工业打造，是马里克家族 5M 型号的重新设计。为与狮鹫 1DS 及其他新设计竞争，马弗里克试图借此赢得固执的联邦联邦军方青睐。5MI 聚焦于提升生存性与战场续航，采用 DHS 与 Artemis IV 火控系统等新技术以获得优势。遗憾的是该设计被认为生产成本过高，军方因此拒绝采购首批量产的任何一台。如此糟糕的表现导致第二轮生产被取消，资源被转投更有前途的生产线。幸存的型号被卖给各佣兵团，不过马弗里克工业的继承人在第 10 莱兰卫队服役期间使用过一台，为公司从团队袍泽那里赢得了零星的改装或定制订单。

Original: An upgrade originating from the Free Worlds League, the 5M variant of the Stalker was introduced in 3050 using moderate amounts of Star League technology. Most of the weaponry was retained but both large lasers were removed for a single Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Laser placed in the 'Mech's centerline and a Narc Missile Beacon in the left torso accompanied by two tons of reloads, allowing the Stalker to tag enemy units with homing beacon and direct friendly missile fire onto them. The seventeen double heat sinks of the 5M afford it far greater heat efficiency than the twenty single heat sinks of previous models, although it still could not handle firing all of its weaponry simultaneously, and an additional ton of armor was added for survivability. Other changes included the use of proprietary components such as an Irian E.A.R. communications system, Riese-456 armor and a Irian Chassis Class 30. Unfortunately the designers of the new 5M dismissed the inclusion of CASE, a factor which led directly to the deaths of several Stalkers during the Clan Invasion due to ammunition cook-offs caused by overheating and weapon penetrations.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_stalker_STK-5M.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade originating from the Free Worlds League, the 5M variant of the Stalker was introduced in 3050 using moderate amounts of Star League technology. Most of the weaponry was retained but both large lasers were removed for a single Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Laser placed in the 'Mech's centerline and a Narc Missile Beacon in the left torso accompanied by two tons of reloads, allowing the Stalker to tag enemy units with homing beacon and direct friendly missile fire onto them. The seventeen double heat sinks of the 5M afford it far greater heat efficiency than the twenty single heat sinks of previous models, although it still could not handle firing all of its weaponry simultaneously, and an additional ton of armor was added for survivability. Other changes included the use of proprietary components such as an Irian E.A.R. communications system, Riese-456 armor and a Irian Chassis Class 30. Unfortunately the designers of the new 5M dismissed the inclusion of CASE, a factor which led directly to the deaths of several Stalkers during the Clan Invasion due to ammunition cook-offs caused by overheating and weapon penetrations.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5M 变体源自自由世界联盟，是潜行者的升级版，于 3050 年推出，使用了适度数量的星盟技术。大部分武器得以保留，但两门大型激光被移除，换成一门装在机甲中线上的"多元光学阳光"ER 大型激光，以及左躯干一具 NARC 导弹信标配两吨再装填，使潜行者能为敌方单位打上自导信标并把友军导弹火力引导到它们身上。5M 的十七台双倍散热器赋予它远胜前型号二十台单散热器的散热效率，尽管它仍无法同时发射全部武器，另加了一吨装甲以提升生存性。其他改动包括采用专有组件，如"伊里安 E.A.R."通讯系统、里泽-456 装甲和伊里安 30 级底盘。遗憾的是，新 5M 的设计者放弃了 C.A.S.E.，这一因素直接导致氏族入侵期间数台潜行者因过热与武器穿透引发弹药殉爆而损毁。

Original: In 2680, the Star League requested designers to develop 'Mechs which could fly as well as function as standard 'Mechs. The first Land-Air 'Mech off the drawing board, the Shadow Hawk LAM, proved so fatally flawed, the concept was almost shelved. However, LexaTech Industries reworked the conversion equipment and unveiled the first viable LAM, the Stinger LAM in 2688, based on the old Stinger design. LexaTech's reworking of the concept proved so successful, the Land-Air 'Mech became highly sought after, especially for space combat operations. In fact, the Stinger LAM first saw combat destroying a nuclear weapons facility in the Oort Cloud orbiting Sol, Terra's star. Found in the Draconis Combine, this variant uses two pairs of Martell Small Lasers on the arms instead of a single Medium Laser.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_stinger_lam_STG-A10.Details

However, LexaTech Industries reworked the conversion equipment and unveiled the first viable LAM, the Stinger LAM in 2688, based on the old Stinger design. LexaTech's reworking of the concept proved so successful, the Land-Air 'Mech became highly sought after, especially for space combat operations. In fact, the Stinger LAM first saw combat destroying a nuclear weapons facility in the Oort Cloud orbiting Sol, Terra's star. Found in the Draconis Combine, this variant uses two pairs of Martell Small Lasers on the arms instead of a single Medium Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2680 年，星盟要求设计师开发既能飞行又能作为标准机甲运作的机甲。首款走下绘图板的陆空机甲——影鹰 LAM——被证明缺陷致命，该概念几乎被搁置。然而莱克萨科技工业重做了变身设备，于 2688 年推出首款可用的 LAM——毒刺 LAM，以老式毒刺设计为基础。莱克萨对概念的改造极为成功，陆空机甲变得极受追捧，尤其是在太空作战中。事实上，毒刺 LAM 首次参战就是摧毁太阳系恒星泰拉轨道上奥尔特云中的一处核武器设施。此变体见于德拉科尼斯联合体，臂部使用两对马特尔小型激光取代单门中型激光。

Original: The design featured Large Pulse Lasers in each arm, twin Gauss Rifles mounted behind flip-open circular firing ports on each side torso, and an almost superfluous Small Pulse Laser located above the cockpit. The Stone Rhino also sported an interesting feature; each arm contained a retractable, shock-absorbing cowl covering the weapon barrels. This allowed MechWarriors to use the arms as battering rams without damaging the weaponry.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_stone_rhino_STR-1.Details

Original: In order to plug holes in their touman, Clan Goliath Scorpion scientists revisited the Behemoth. Like Clan Smoke Jaguar before them, they upgraded and improved upon the design. This version used an Extra-light Engine to mount a pair of Thunderstroke Series 2b Gauss Rifles along the top of the 'Mech. Each arm carried a Series 4D-2 Heavy Large Laser, a Series 22a Heavy Medium Laser, and a General Systems Heavy Small Laser. It retained the shock-absorbing cowls of the original. Another pair of Heavy Mediums protected the rear of the 'Mech. A head-mounted Shield-3 Anti-Missile System defended against missiles, while an Anti-Personnel Pod in each leg discouraged unarmored infantry. This design had jump jets, nineteen tons of armor, and a meager sixteen double heat sinks.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_stone_rhino_STR-2.Details

Original: A variable range variant, the Stone Rhino 4 uses an XL Engine to provide weight savings for four LRM 10s to lay down impressive long range fire. Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 太阳蜘蛛 B 是一款混合射程战斗型，以右躯干的高斯步枪为核心，左躯干的 ER 大型激光以及每臂配对的连续 SRM-6 和 ER 中型激光为支援。左躯干的反导系统与轻型主动探测器使 B 不会被打个措手不及，它携带两吨高斯与连续导弹再装填、一吨 AMS 弹药和一台额外双倍散热器。

Original: The Inner Sphere Standard was developed following the initial thrust of the Clan invasion, as Inner Sphere powers rushed to duplicate the battle armor technology the Clans fielded. Lacking any battlefield salvage on which to base their development though, engineers were forced to work off of ancient rumors of early power armor suits like the Nighthawk, more akin to armored Exoskeletons than the 'Toads' currently rampaging through known space, and these prototypes fared poorly during testing. It took salvage from the first victories over the Clans to truly kick-start the development of battle armor. The New Avalon Institute of Science was the first to reproduce in part the Clans' Elemental armor as the Inner Sphere Standard.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_the_hive_IS-HIVE.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Inner Sphere Standard was developed following the initial thrust of the Clan invasion, as Inner Sphere powers rushed to duplicate the battle armor technology the Clans fielded. Lacking any battlefield salvage on which to base their development though, engineers were forced to work off of ancient rumors of early power armor suits like the Nighthawk, more akin to armored Exoskeletons than the 'Toads' currently rampaging through known space, and these prototypes fared poorly during testing. It took salvage from the first victories over the Clans to truly kick-start the development of battle armor. The New Avalon Institute of Science was the first to reproduce in part the Clans' Elemental armor as the Inner Sphere Standard.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 内天体标准型是在氏族入侵首轮攻势后开发的，当时内天体各势力竞相复制氏族装备的战斗装甲技术。然而由于缺乏战场缴获作为研发基础，工程师们只能依据"夜鹰"等早期动力装甲的古老传闻着手——它们与其说是当前肆虐已知空间的"蟾蜍"式装甲，更像是带装甲的外骨骼。这些原型在测试中表现糟糕。直到从对氏族的首次胜利中获得缴获品，战斗装甲的研发才真正起步。新阿瓦隆科学研究院率先部分复制了氏族的元素战士装甲，即内天体标准型。

Original: The Thorn carries a weapons array that is not usually seen on light 'Mechs: a Zeus-5 LRM launcher mounted in the right arm with one ton of reloads in the right torso, paired with two Hellion Spitfire Medium Lasers split between the head and left arm. Four and a half tons of armor provides the Thorn with good protection, especially when mated with CASE to contain any ammunition explosions.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_thorn_THE-N.Details

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 荆棘携带轻型机甲上不常见的武器阵列：右臂一具宙斯-5 LRM 发射器（右躯干一吨再装填），配以分列头部与左臂的两门海利昂"喷火"中型激光。四吨半装甲为荆棘提供良好防护，尤其配合 C.A.S.E. 遏制弹药爆炸时。

Original: Developed in 3051 on the orders of Precentor Martial Anastasius Focht to try and close the gap between the Clans and Com Guards, the factory refit THE-N1 received its baptism of fire during the Battle of Tukayyid. Having reached a similar conclusion that resulted in the THE-Nb, the CASE was dropped and the standard engine was swapped for an XL Engine to allow the standard weaponry to be stripped for an all energy weapon array: a right arm mounted Kinslaughter H-Class ER PPC and a head-mounted Intek Small Laser. This new weapons array, enhanced by double heat sinks, added a level of lethality never seen before on the Thorn.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_thorn_THE-N1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed in 3051 on the orders of Precentor Martial Anastasius Focht to try and close the gap between the Clans and Com Guards, the factory refit THE-N1 received its baptism of fire during the Battle of Tukayyid. Having reached a similar conclusion that resulted in the THE-Nb, the CASE was dropped and the standard engine was swapped for an XL Engine to allow the standard weaponry to be stripped for an all energy weapon array: a right arm mounted Kinslaughter H-Class ER PPC and a head-mounted Intek Small Laser. This new weapons array, enhanced by double heat sinks, added a level of lethality never seen before on the Thorn.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: THE-N1 于 3051 年根据战务长官阿纳斯塔修斯·福赫特的命令开发，试图缩小氏族与康卫之间的差距，这款工厂改装型在图卡伊德战役中接受了战火洗礼。它得出了与 THE-Nb 相似的结论，因此舍弃 C.A.S.E. 并把标准引擎换成 XL 引擎，以便剥离标准武器、改用全能量武器阵列：右臂一门"族杀 H 级"ER PPC 和头部一门英泰克小型激光。这一新武器阵列在双倍散热器的强化下，为荆棘带来了前所未有的杀伤力。

Original: A new production variant of the THE-N1 developed by the Word of Blake in 3071, the THE-N2 took its cues from both the THE-N and THE-T variants, swapping the ER-PPC with an MML 7 and the standard small laser for a Diverse Optics ER Small Laser. A two-ton CASE protected ammo bay allowed the THE-N2 to carry both LRM and SRM munitions to make best use of the Multi-Missile Launcher.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_thorn_THE-N2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A new production variant of the THE-N1 developed by the Word of Blake in 3071, the THE-N2 took its cues from both the THE-N and THE-T variants, swapping the ER-PPC with an MML 7 and the standard small laser for a Diverse Optics ER Small Laser. A two-ton CASE protected ammo bay allowed the THE-N2 to carry both LRM and SRM munitions to make best use of the Multi-Missile Launcher.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: THE-N2 是布雷克之言于 3071 年开发的 THE-N1 新量产变体，它同时借鉴了 THE-N 与 THE-T 变体，把 ER PPC 换成 MML 7，标准小型激光换成多元光学 ER 小型激光。一个两吨、有 C.A.S.E. 保护的弹药舱使 THE-N2 能同时携带 LRM 与 SRM 弹药，以最大化利用多用途导弹发射器。

Original: The advanced model employed by the Star League Defense Force Royal Divisions in 2743 changed the role of the 'Mech from a missile to an energy boat, replacing the LRM launcher with an ER Large Laser, retaining one medium laser and downgrading the other to a Small Laser. Dropping the no longer required CASE, the 'Mech also used a MASC system for temporary speed bursts and Double Heat Sinks to vent its increased waste heat output. The THE-Nb mounted an XL Engine to save the weight to mount this extra equipment, at the cost of reduced survivability.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_thorn_THE-Nb.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The advanced model employed by the Star League Defense Force Royal Divisions in 2743 changed the role of the 'Mech from a missile to an energy boat, replacing the LRM launcher with an ER Large Laser, retaining one medium laser and downgrading the other to a Small Laser. Dropping the no longer required CASE, the 'Mech also used a MASC system for temporary speed bursts and Double Heat Sinks to vent its increased waste heat output. The THE-Nb mounted an XL Engine to save the weight to mount this extra equipment, at the cost of reduced survivability.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款先进型号于 2743 年由星盟防卫军皇家师使用，它把机甲的角色从导弹平台改为能量平台，以一门 ER 大型激光取代 LRM 发射器，保留一门中型激光，另一门降级为小型激光。舍弃不再需要的 C.A.S.E.，机甲还使用 MASC 系统实现临时速度爆发，并以双倍散热器排出增加的废热。THE-Nb 装 XL 引擎以省出重量安装这些额外装备，代价是生存性降低。

Original: The advanced model employed by the Star League Defense Force Royal Divisions in 2743 changed the role of the 'Mech from a missile to an energy boat, replacing the LRM launcher with an ER Large Laser, retaining one medium laser and downgrading the other to a Small Laser. Dropping the no longer required CASE, the 'Mech also used a MASC system for temporary speed bursts and Double Heat Sinks to vent its increased waste heat output. The THE-Nb mounted an XL Engine to save the weight to mount this extra equipment, at the cost of reduced survivability.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_thorn_THE-Nb.YangsThoughts

Original: Supplied by ComStar to the Draconis Combine as part of Operation Rosebud in 3035, the THE-S was a downgraded factory refit of the THE-N. Stripping out the advanced Endo Steel chassis and CASE, the use of a heavier standard chassis forced a reduction in the Thorns armor protection by half a ton, most of which was removed from the head and rear torso. The communications system was also changed to a more primitive Olmstead 30, although the Omicron VII targeting-tracking system was similar in capabilities to the Orion 80 it replaced.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_thorn_THE-S.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Supplied by ComStar to the Draconis Combine as part of Operation Rosebud in 3035, the THE-S was a downgraded factory refit of the THE-N. Stripping out the advanced Endo Steel chassis and CASE, the use of a heavier standard chassis forced a reduction in the Thorns armor protection by half a ton, most of which was removed from the head and rear torso. The communications system was also changed to a more primitive Olmstead 30, although the Omicron VII targeting-tracking system was similar in capabilities to the Orion 80 it replaced.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: THE-S 由康星作为 3035 年"玫瑰花蕾"行动的一部分提供给德拉科尼斯联合体，是 THE-N 的降级工厂改装型。它拆除了先进的内骨骼底盘和 C.A.S.E.，改用较重的标准底盘，迫使荆棘的装甲防护减少半吨，其中大部分从头颅和后躯干扣除。通讯系统也换成更原始的奥姆斯特德 30，尽管奥米克戎 VII 瞄准追踪系统的性能与被它取代的猎户座 80 相近。

Original: The Timber Wolf is a fast, heavy OmniMech. A signature design of the Clans' military might, it was arguably the first Clan OmniMech encountered by Inner Sphere forces on The Rock by Phelan Kell. Vaguely resembling a cross-over between the MAD (Marauder) and CAT (Catapult) series, the Timber Wolf was tagged with the Inner Sphere reporting name Mad Cat on first contact.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_timber_wolf_TW-A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Timber Wolf is a fast, heavy OmniMech. A signature design of the Clans' military might, it was arguably the first Clan OmniMech encountered by Inner Sphere forces on The Rock by Phelan Kell. Vaguely resembling a cross-over between the MAD (Marauder) and CAT (Catapult) series, the Timber Wolf was tagged with the Inner Sphere reporting name Mad Cat on first contact.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 森林狼是一款高速重型全能机甲。作为氏族军事力量的标志性设计，它可以说是内天体部队在"岩石"星上由菲兰·凯尔首次遭遇的氏族全能机甲。因其隐约呈现出 MAD（掠夺者）与 CAT（投石机）系列的杂交特征，森林狼在首次接触时被内天体冠以"疯猫"的报告代号。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 森林狼是一款高速重型全能机甲。作为氏族军事力量的标志性设计，它可以说是内天体部队在"岩石"星上由菲兰·凯尔首次遭遇的氏族全能机甲。因其隐约呈现出 MAD（掠夺者）与 CAT（投石机）系列的杂交特征，森林狼在首次接触时被内天体冠以"疯猫"的报告代号。

Original: The Turkina is named after Turkina, the first Jade Falcon to be tamed, who inspired the leaders of Clan Jade Falcon in its early days.

Original: The UrbanMech IIC is a Clan IIC-style upgrade of the original UrbanMech. Around the same time as the development of the OmniMech during the Golden Century, Clan Coyote technicians reworked this venerable design. They studied battle data from as far back as the Amaris Civil War and used this research as the basis for their upgrades.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_urbanmech_iic_UM-IIC-1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The UrbanMech IIC is a Clan IIC-style upgrade of the original UrbanMech. Around the same time as the development of the OmniMech during the Golden Century, Clan Coyote technicians reworked this venerable design. They studied battle data from as far back as the Amaris Civil War and used this research as the basis for their upgrades.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 城市机甲 IIC 是原版城市机甲的氏族 IIC 式升级版。在黄金世纪全能机甲发展的同期，郊狼氏族技师重制了这款古老的设计。他们研究了可追溯至阿马里斯内战的作战数据，并以此为基础进行升级。

Original: Don't let the stubby 'Urbie' fool you, it may look like a walking trash can, but it can mount heavy armor and a grown-up-sized Autocannon. R63s aren't known for their speed, but they are very useful if you can draw the enemy into their firing range.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 别被矮胖的"都市"骗了，它也许看起来像个会走路的垃圾桶，却能装备厚重装甲和成人尺寸的自动炮。R63 不以速度著称，但如果你能把敌人引到它的射程内，它们就非常有用。

Original: The Valkyrie II project originated as an assignment for two NAIS student design teams to create a new heavy scout and skirmisher mech based on the Valkyrie VLK-QA. A rivalry between the two teams and outside pressures from Davion bureaucrats pushed both designs far beyond a replacement for the VLK-QA. Achernar BattleMechs was contracted to construct the Valkyrie II-1A which sports a Hermes 360XL Engine, six Jump Jets, an ER PPC, a LRM10, and over eleven tons of armor.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_valkyrie_ii_VLK-II-1A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Valkyrie II project originated as an assignment for two NAIS student design teams to create a new heavy scout and skirmisher mech based on the Valkyrie VLK-QA. A rivalry between the two teams and outside pressures from Davion bureaucrats pushed both designs far beyond a replacement for the VLK-QA. Achernar BattleMechs was contracted to construct the Valkyrie II-1A which sports a Hermes 360XL Engine, six Jump Jets, an ER PPC, a LRM10, and over eleven tons of armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 女武神 II 项目最初是给两个 NAIS 学员设计小组的作业：基于女武神 VLK-QA 打造一款新的重型侦察与散兵机甲。两队之间的竞争以及达维昂官僚的外来压力，把两个设计都推得远超 VLK-QA 的替代品。阿克尔纳战斗机甲公司获得合同建造女武神 II-1A，它配备一台赫尔墨斯 360XL 引擎、六个跳跃推进器、一门 ER PPC、一具 LRM10 以及超过十一吨装甲。

Original: I heard of this project; it was pretty bad, lot's of money changing hands and lot's of competing design requirements. It's a miracle these things ever made it to production. I will say this, the Valkyrie II is faster than the original despite being twice the weight while carrying a stronger weapons and armor compliment. It may not excel at anything in particular but it can work for most jobs it is tasked with.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_valkyrie_ii_VLK-II-1A.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I heard of this project; it was pretty bad, lot's of money changing hands and lot's of competing design requirements. It's a miracle these things ever made it to production. I will say this, the Valkyrie II is faster than the original despite being twice the weight while carrying a stronger weapons and armor compliment. It may not excel at anything in particular but it can work for most jobs it is tasked with.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我听说过这个项目；相当糟糕，大量资金易手，大量相互冲突的设计要求。这些东西能投产简直是奇迹。我得说，女武神 II 虽然重量是原版的两倍，却比原版更快，还携带更强的武器与装甲配置。它也许在任何方面都不突出，但能胜任交给它的大多数工作。

Original: The Vapor Eagle features an eclectic and close-ranged weapons load-out, mounting a Large Pulse Laser in its right arm, supported by a single Machine Gun, two Streak SRM-2s and three Medium Pulse Lasers split between its side torsos and rounded out by a trio of Machine Guns in a handgun shaped housing in the left arm. The addition of a Targeting Computer makes its firepower even more deadly as long as it can get its weapons into range. Eleven Double Heat Sinks, half a ton of machine gun ammunition and one Streak missiles are more than adequate for the average Clan trial.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_vapor_eagle_GWK-1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Vapor Eagle features an eclectic and close-ranged weapons load-out, mounting a Large Pulse Laser in its right arm, supported by a single Machine Gun, two Streak SRM-2s and three Medium Pulse Lasers split between its side torsos and rounded out by a trio of Machine Guns in a handgun shaped housing in the left arm. The addition of a Targeting Computer makes its firepower even more deadly as long as it can get its weapons into range. Eleven Double Heat Sinks, half a ton of machine gun ammunition and one Streak missiles are more than adequate for the average Clan trial.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蒸汽鹰拥有杂糅而偏近程的武器配置：右臂一门大型脉冲激光，辅以一挺机枪、两具连续 SRM-2 和三门中型脉冲激光分列两侧躯干，左臂手枪形护罩内还有三挺机枪收尾。加装瞄准计算机后，只要武器能进入射程，其火力更为致命。十一台双倍散热器、半吨机枪弹药和一吨连续导弹弹药，对一般的氏族试炼而言绰绰有余。

Original: This variant of the Vapor Eagle removes two of the Medium Pulse Lasers, both Streak Missile pods, and the Large Pulse Laser as well as one of the 'Mechs double heat sinks in exchange for an Ultra Autocannon/10. Mounted in an over the shoulder arrangement like the venerable Shadow Hawk, the weapon fires at twice the rate of a standard Autocannon/10 and carries enough ammunition to continuously fire at its maximum rate of fire for over a minute and a half.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_vapor_eagle_GWK-2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant of the Vapor Eagle removes two of the Medium Pulse Lasers, both Streak Missile pods, and the Large Pulse Laser as well as one of the 'Mechs double heat sinks in exchange for an Ultra Autocannon/10. Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此蒸汽鹰变体移除两门中型脉冲激光、两具连续导弹荚舱、大型脉冲激光以及一台双倍散热器，换成一门超速自动炮/10。该武器以如同古老的影鹰那样的过肩方式安装，射速是标准自动炮/10 的两倍，并携带足以以最高射速连续射击一分半钟以上的弹药。

Original: The Venom was built in direct response to losses suffered by the Draconis Combine and to boost sales for Nimakachi Fusion Products Limited. The 8C carries only standard jump jets and replaces 3 Pulse Lasers with a Snub Nose PPC.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_venom_SDR-9C.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Venom was built in direct response to losses suffered by the Draconis Combine and to boost sales for Nimakachi Fusion Products Limited. The 8C carries only standard jump jets and replaces 3 Pulse Lasers with a Snub Nose PPC.

Original: An upgrade using Star League technology, the 9K replaces the Autocannon/20 with a Gauss Rifle which can do serious damage at much greater ranges. The 'Mech also carries two Medium Pulse Lasers and a SRM-4 launcher for close combat. In order to make these changes possible, the 9K is built on an Endo Steel chassis. With the weight saved the 'Mech also carries an additional ton of armor.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_victor_VTR-9K.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade using Star League technology, the 9K replaces the Autocannon/20 with a Gauss Rifle which can do serious damage at much greater ranges. The 'Mech also carries two Medium Pulse Lasers and a SRM-4 launcher for close combat. In order to make these changes possible, the 9K is built on an Endo Steel chassis. With the weight saved the 'Mech also carries an additional ton of armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 9K 是使用星盟技术的升级，以一门高斯步枪取代自动炮/20，能在远得多的距离上造成严重伤害。机甲还携带两门中型脉冲激光和一具 SRM-4 发射器用于近战。为实现这些改动，9K 基于内骨骼底盘建造。凭借节省的重量，机甲还多携带一吨装甲。

Original: The VTR-9K incorporates several Lostech technologies, replacing the AC/20 with a Gauss Rifle, the Medium Lasers with Medium Pulse Lasers, and adding CASE, all on an Endo-Steel frame.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_victor_VTR-9K.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The VTR-9K incorporates several Lostech technologies, replacing the AC/20 with a Gauss Rifle, the Medium Lasers with Medium Pulse Lasers, and adding CASE, all on an Endo-Steel frame.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: VTR-9K 融入多项失传技术，以一门高斯步枪取代 AC/20，以中型脉冲激光取代中型激光，并加装 C.A.S.E.，全部基于内骨骼框架。

Original: After his son was killed in the Taurian Concordat invasion of the Federated Suns, Benedict St. James had his VTR-9K refitted with experimental weapons and equipment to allow him to take his revenge. Replacing the standard weapons with a Long Tom Cannon and two Medium X-Pulse Lasers, St. James' Victor can inflict massive amounts of damage on his prey. The 'Mech's jump jets had to be removed to make way for the weapons load, and technicians equipped it with a patchwork of Ferro-Fibrous and Standard Armor as another weight saving measure. A Supercharger mounted on the engine provides the Victor with unexpected bursts of speed.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_victor_VTR-9K2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: After his son was killed in the Taurian Concordat invasion of the Federated Suns, Benedict St. James had his VTR-9K refitted with experimental weapons and equipment to allow him to take his revenge. Replacing the standard weapons with a Long Tom Cannon and two Medium X-Pulse Lasers, St. James' Victor can inflict massive amounts of damage on his prey. The 'Mech's jump jets had to be removed to make way for the weapons load, and technicians equipped it with a patchwork of Ferro-Fibrous and Standard Armor as another weight saving measure. A Supercharger mounted on the engine provides the Victor with unexpected bursts of speed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在陶里安协约入侵联邦太阳系时儿子被杀后，本尼迪克特·圣詹姆斯将自己的 VTR-9K 改装上实验性武器与装备以复仇。他把标准武器换成一门长汤姆炮和两门中型 X 脉冲激光，使圣詹姆斯的胜利者能对猎物造成巨量伤害。为给武器腾出空间，机甲的跳跃推进器不得不拆除，技师还为其配上铁纤维与标准装甲的拼装方案作为另一项减重措施。引擎上加装的增压器为胜利者提供了出其不意的速度爆发。

Original: The 7M variant was introduced in 3047 by Ronin Inc. as the official upgraded variant of the Warhammer for the Free Worlds League. Built around a Magna 280 fusion engine, the 7M had a top speed of 64.5 km/h and carried eighteen double heat sinks to handle the waste heat generated by its two Fusigon Longtooth ER PPCs. Backing up these new weapons were two Martell medium lasers in the side torsos and a Shannon SH-60 SRM-6 launcher over the right shoulder. A LFN Lindblad machine gun was carried in the right torso, while the left mounted an LFN Lindblad Shotgun Anti-Missile System. One ton of machine gun rounds were carried in the center torso, while one ton each of missile reloads and AMS rounds were carried in the right.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_warhammer_WHM-7M.Details

Backing up these new weapons were two Martell medium lasers in the side torsos and a Shannon SH-60 SRM-6 launcher over the right shoulder. A LFN Lindblad machine gun was carried in the right torso, while the left mounted an LFN Lindblad Shotgun Anti-Missile System. One ton of machine gun rounds were carried in the center torso, while one ton each of missile reloads and AMS rounds were carried in the right.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 7M 变体由浪人公司于 3047 年推出，是自由世界联盟战锤的官方升级变体。它围绕玛格纳 280 聚变引擎建造，最高速度 64.5 公里/小时，携带十八台双倍散热器以处理两门"富西贡长牙"ER PPC 产生的废热。支援这些新武器的是两侧躯干的两门马特尔中型激光和右肩上方一具"香农 SH-60"SRM-6 发射器。右躯干携带一挺 LFN 林德布拉德机枪，左侧则装一套 LFN 林德布拉德霰弹反导系统。中央躯干携带一吨机枪弹，右侧则各携带一吨导弹再装填和一吨 AMS 弹药。

Original: The 7S Warhammer was the official upgraded version built for the Federated Commonwealth by Olivettie Weaponry. Built out of their Sudeten factory starting in 3050, the 7S retained the small lasers of the original but updated the rest of the weaponry. Eighteen double heat sinks handled the additional waste heat and one ton of reloads for the Streak launchers was carried in the center torso.

Original: The Wraith marked Curtiss Militech's entry into BattleMech production. When the design was announced, many felt that the design would be little more than a walking water cooler. What the critics got was a shock. The Wraith is a 'Mech that, when properly employed, can wreak havoc on an enemy with its astounding speed and maneuverability. It is built around a massive LTV 385 XL Engine that allows it to reach speeds of just under 119 kph. The Wraith has a simple, yet effective, pulse weapons payload. Pulse laser weaponry allows the Mech to negate most of the side effects on accuracy that are introduced by the Wraith's heavy use of jump jets, making it incredibly accurate and powerful for such a lightly armed Mech. A simple modification of the Wraith, the TR2 simply replaces the Large Pulse Laser with an ER PPC, turning the 'Mech into a highly capable sniper.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_wraith_TR1-TR2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Wraith marked Curtiss Militech's entry into BattleMech production. When the design was announced, many felt that the design would be little more than a walking water cooler. What the critics got was a shock. The Wraith is a 'Mech that, when properly employed, can wreak havoc on an enemy with its astounding speed and maneuverability. It is built around a massive LTV 385 XL Engine that allows it to reach speeds of just under 119 kph. The Wraith has a simple, yet effective, pulse weapons payload. Pulse laser weaponry allows the Mech to negate most of the side effects on accuracy that are introduced by the Wraith's heavy use of jump jets, making it incredibly accurate and powerful for such a lightly armed Mech. A simple modification of the Wraith, the TR2 simply replaces the Large Pulse Laser with an ER PPC, turning the 'Mech into a highly capable sniper.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 幽灵标志着柯蒂斯军工进军战斗机甲生产。该设计公布时，许多人以为它不过是台会走路的水冷器。批评者得到的却是震惊。若运用得当，幽灵能凭借惊人的速度与机动性在敌阵中肆虐。它以庞大的 LTV 385 XL 引擎为核心，速度可达略低于 119 公里/小时。幽灵配有简单却有效的脉冲武器配置。脉冲激光武器能让机甲抵消跳跃推进器大量使用所带来的大部分精度副作用，使这款轻武装机甲变得异常精准而强大。作为幽灵的简单改型，TR2 仅将大型脉冲激光换成 ER PPC，把机甲变成极具能力的狙击手。

Original: The Yu Huang, named for the Jade Emperor that rules the Heavenly Court in the ancient Chinese pantheon, debuted with the promise from Sun-Tzu Liao that 'it shall sit in judgment over a battlefield, meting out justice to those who would transgress against us'. To live up to the promise of the Chancellor of the Capellan Confederation, the Yu Huang carries some of the most advanced technologies available at the time of its initial production. The Yu Huang is built on a Chariot Type II Endo Steel chassis and carries a Hermes 360 XL engine that gives the 'Mech a top speed of 64.8 km/h. The 'Mech is capable of jumping up to one hundred and twenty meters with its four Rodan 90 jump jets.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_yu_huang_Y-H10G.Details

The 'Mech is capable of jumping up to one hundred and twenty meters with its four Rodan 90 jump jets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玉皇以中国古代神话中主宰天庭的玉皇大帝命名，首次亮相时孙泰子承诺"它将坐镇战场之上，向那些侵犯我们的人施以正义"。为不负卡佩兰邦联大臣的承诺，玉皇在首次生产时携带了当时最先进的技术。它建立在战车型 II 内骨骼底盘上，搭载赫尔墨斯 360 XL 引擎，使机甲最高速度达 64.8 公里/小时。凭借四个罗丹 90 跳跃推进器，机甲可跳跃至一百二十米。

Original: The H10G variant is designed to directly engage an enemy at short ranges. The 10G removes all of the 'Mechs weapons. Instead, it carries a powerful Gauss Rifle for long range combat. This is supported by an ER Large Laser for additional long range firepower. For close combat, the 10G has six ER Medium Lasers and also carries a Guardian ECM Suite and a Beagle Active Probe to both protect the 'Mech from advanced enemy electronics systems and find hidden enemy units to prevent ambushes.
Name: Base_3061.chassisdef_yu_huang_Y-H10G.YangsThoughts

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The H10G variant is designed to directly engage an enemy at short ranges. The 10G removes all of the 'Mechs weapons. For close combat, the 10G has six ER Medium Lasers and also carries a Guardian ECM Suite and a Beagle Active Probe to both protect the 'Mech from advanced enemy electronics systems and find hidden enemy units to prevent ambushes.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: H10G 变体设计用于在近程直接与敌交战。10G 移除机甲全部武器，改为携带一门强力高斯步枪用于远程战斗。它由一门 ER 大型激光支援以增加远程火力。近战方面，10G 有六门 ER 中型激光，还携带一套守护者 ECM 套件和一具比格犬主动探测器，既能保护机甲免受敌方先进电子系统干扰，也能找出隐藏的敌方单位以防伏击。

Original: This Clan upgraded Alacorn mounts four Gauss Rifles with five tons of ammo. Developed in 2587, the Alacorn attracted a reputation in the SLDF as an effective and dependable tank. Deployed throughout the Periphery, General Aleksandr Kerensky was reported to have taken hundreds of them during the Exodus. Although some of the earliest versions mount various autocannons the Alacorn became famous for it's array of gauss rifles. Their combination of heavy punch and long range makes the Alacorn a threat to any unit on the field. Tracked: Slow but able to cross most terrain. Fusion: Expensive engine that works in a Vacuum.
Name: Base_3061.vehicledef_ALACORN_IIC_1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Clan upgraded Alacorn mounts four Gauss Rifles with five tons of ammo. Developed in 2587, the Alacorn attracted a reputation in the SLDF as an effective and dependable tank. Deployed throughout the Periphery, General Aleksandr Kerensky was reported to have taken hundreds of them during the Exodus. Although some of the earliest versions mount various autocannons the Alacorn became famous for it's array of gauss rifles. Their combination of heavy punch and long range makes the Alacorn a threat to any unit on the field. Tracked: Slow but able to cross most terrain. Fusion: Expensive engine that works in a Vacuum.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款氏族升级版阿拉科恩装备四门高斯步枪和五吨弹药。阿拉科恩于 2587 年开发，在星盟防卫军中赢得了高效可靠坦克的声誉。它被部署到整个外围区，据报亚历山大·克伦斯基将军在出埃及期间带走了数百辆。尽管最早的一些版本装的是各种自动炮，阿拉科恩是因它那批高斯步枪而成名的。重击与远程的结合使阿拉科恩成为战场上对任何单位的威胁。 履带式： 缓慢，但能穿越大多数地形。 聚变： 昂贵的引擎，可在真空中工作。
