Original: The Arctic Fox is a light OmniMech reverse engineered by the Kell Hounds from the Clan Uller OmniMech with assistance in the final stages from Clan Wolf-in-Exile. The resulting OmniMech is a powerful light 'Mech that has a top speed of 97.2 km/h that is provided by a GM 180 XL engine, shaving off valuable weight from the Arctic Fox's base chassis while also making the 'Mech vulnerable to becoming a combat kill through the loss of one of its side torsos. The Arctic Fox has ten double heat sinks which are generally enough to handle the 'Mech's heat load, with the ability to add more if needed. To protect itself from enemy fire, the Arctic Fox has six tons of Royal-7 armor.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_arctic_fox_af1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Arctic Fox is a light OmniMech reverse engineered by the Kell Hounds from the Clan Uller OmniMech with assistance in the final stages from Clan Wolf-in-Exile. The resulting OmniMech is a powerful light 'Mech that has a top speed of 97.2 km/h that is provided by a GM 180 XL engine, shaving off valuable weight from the Arctic Fox's base chassis while also making the 'Mech vulnerable to becoming a combat kill through the loss of one of its side torsos. The Arctic Fox has ten double heat sinks which are generally enough to handle the 'Mech's heat load, with the ability to add more if needed. To protect itself from enemy fire, the Arctic Fox has six tons of Royal-7 armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 极地狐是凯尔猎犬依据氏族乌勒尔全能机甲逆向工程而来的轻型全能机甲，最终阶段得到流亡狼氏族的协助。成品是一款强劲的轻型机甲，由 GM 180 XL 引擎提供 97.2 公里/小时的最高速度，既为极地狐的基础底盘省下宝贵重量，也使它因失去任一侧面躯干而容易被击毁。它装有十台双倍散热器，通常足以应对其热负荷，必要时还可加装。为抵御敌方火力，极地狐拥有六吨 Royal-7 装甲。

Original: A Combine modification of the K model introduced in 3050, the C model carried a C3 Slave unit into combat. This was achieved by removing one of the Medium Pulse Lasers from the K model. The extra free ton was used to add another heat sink to the design.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_atlas_AS7-C.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Combine modification of the K model introduced in 3050, the C model carried a C3 Slave unit into combat. This was achieved by removing one of the Medium Pulse Lasers from the K model. The extra free ton was used to add another heat sink to the design.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: C 型是 3050 年推出的 K 型的联合体改装，它把一台 C3 从属单元带入战斗。这通过从 K 型移除一门中型脉冲激光实现。多出的一吨用于为设计增加一台散热器。

Original: Another modification of the K model of the Atlas introduced in 3050, the CM Atlas was designed to carry a C3 Master Computer into battle. In order to do this one of the ER Large Lasers was removed and in its place a C3 Master computer was installed, allowing it to coordinate a C3 lance.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_atlas_AS7-CM.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another modification of the K model of the Atlas introduced in 3050, the CM Atlas was designed to carry a C3 Master Computer into battle. In order to do this one of the ER Large Lasers was removed and in its place a C3 Master computer was installed, allowing it to coordinate a C3 lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: CM 阿特拉斯是 3050 年推出的阿特拉斯 K 型的又一改装，旨在把 C3 主控计算机带入战斗。为此移除了一门 ER 大型激光，在原位安装 C3 主控计算机，使其能协调一个 C3 小队。

Original: A Clan-tech retrofit of the AS7-D Atlas, the Atlas C replaced the older autocannon and missile launchers with a Clan standard Ultra AC/20, Swarm LRM compatible LRM-20, and Streak SRM-6 launchers; but the Inner Sphere Medium Lasers remained unchanged. Lighter Clan components allowed the Atlas C to carry 3 tons of autocannon ammunition.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_atlas_AS7-D_C_.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan-tech retrofit of the AS7-D Atlas, the Atlas C replaced the older autocannon and missile launchers with a Clan standard Ultra AC/20, Swarm LRM compatible LRM-20, and Streak SRM-6 launchers; but the Inner Sphere Medium Lasers remained unchanged. Lighter Clan components allowed the Atlas C to carry 3 tons of autocannon ammunition.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿特拉斯 C 是 AS7-D 阿特拉斯的氏族技术改装型，它把较旧的自动炮和导弹发射器换成氏族标准超速 AC/20、兼容蜂群 LRM 的 LRM-20 和连续 SRM-6 发射器；但内天体中型激光保持不变。更轻的氏族组件使阿特拉斯 C 能携带 3 吨自动炮弹药。

Original: The AS7-K-DC is a command version of the AS7-K. To be able to fit a command console, a ton of LRM ammo and one medium pulse laser was removed.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_atlas_AS7-K-DC.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The AS7-K-DC is a command version of the AS7-K. To be able to fit a command console, a ton of LRM ammo and one medium pulse laser was removed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: AS7-K-DC 是 AS7-K 的指挥版本。为容纳一台指挥控制台，移除了一吨 LRM 弹药和一门中型脉冲激光。

Original: A very basic FedCom upgrade of the standard Atlas introduced in 3050, the S model removed five heat sinks from the design, upgrading the rest to Double Heat Sinks. The weight savings are used to add two rear firing Coventry T4H Streak SRM-2 launchers, giving the Atlas increased protection in its rear arc of fire. After the civil war production of this model ceased, although garrison forces in both sundered states continued to use them, with AFFS units using Precision Ammunition for the autocannon and LAAF units making use of specialized LRM munitions captured from the Free Worlds League.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_atlas_AS7-S.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A very basic FedCom upgrade of the standard Atlas introduced in 3050, the S model removed five heat sinks from the design, upgrading the rest to Double Heat Sinks. The weight savings are used to add two rear firing Coventry T4H Streak SRM-2 launchers, giving the Atlas increased protection in its rear arc of fire. After the civil war production of this model ceased, although garrison forces in both sundered states continued to use them, with AFFS units using Precision Ammunition for the autocannon and LAAF units making use of specialized LRM munitions captured from the Free Worlds League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: S 型是 3050 年推出的标准阿特拉斯联邦联邦版基础升级，从设计中移除五台散热器，其余升级为双倍散热器。节省的重量用于加装两具后向考文垂 T4H 连续 SRM-2 发射器，增强阿特拉斯后方射界的防护。内战之后此型号停产，但两个分裂国家的驻防部队仍在使用，AFFS 单位为自动炮使用精确弹药，LAAF 单位则使用从自由世界联盟缴获的特种 LRM 弹药。

Original: The S2 Atlas was a major upgrade of the design by the Lyran Alliance coming out of the Hesperus II facility in 3061. The 'Mech was built with a Light Fusion Engine and carried an Artemis IV Fire Control System enhanced LRM-15 launcher and two ER large lasers as its primary long range weapons. For close combat, the 'Mech was armed with a Heavy Gauss Rifle. The S2 mounted a Guardian ECM Suite in place of the AMS to protect against enemy electronic warfare equipment.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_atlas_AS7-S2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The S2 Atlas was a major upgrade of the design by the Lyran Alliance coming out of the Hesperus II facility in 3061. The 'Mech was built with a Light Fusion Engine and carried an Artemis IV Fire Control System enhanced LRM-15 launcher and two ER large lasers as its primary long range weapons. For close combat, the 'Mech was armed with a Heavy Gauss Rifle. The S2 mounted a Guardian ECM Suite in place of the AMS to protect against enemy electronic warfare equipment.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: S2 阿特拉斯是莱兰联盟于 3061 年从赫斯佩鲁斯 II 工厂推出的重大升级。机甲采用轻型聚变引擎建造，携带一具 Artemis IV 火控系统增强的 LRM-15 发射器，以及两门 ER 大型激光作为主要远程武器。近战方面，机甲装备一门重型高斯步枪。S2 以守护者 ECM 套件取代 AMS，用于抵御敌方电子战装备。

Original: First fielded in 2765, the Atlas II was designed by the Hegemony Research and Development Department, Weapons Division of the original Star League to maintain the technological edge over the other Great Houses. It was exclusively for the SLDF's Royal Regiments. In 2785, when General Aleksandr Kerensky put out his call for loyal forces to join him in his Exodus, every Atlas II pilot responded and left with him. The Atlas II is armed with an array of weaponry, including an LB-X Autocannon/10, a pair of ER Large Lasers, and a 20-tube Long Range Missile Launcher for long range attacks. For close range combat, the 'Mech is equipped with a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers and a Holly Six Pack. In addition, the 'Mech has been given CASEfor both sides of the torso in order to keep an ammunition cook-off from consuming the 'Mech.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_atlas_ii_AS7-D-H.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: First fielded in 2765, the Atlas II was designed by the Hegemony Research and Development Department, Weapons Division of the original Star League to maintain the technological edge over the other Great Houses. It was exclusively for the SLDF's Royal Regiments. In 2785, when General Aleksandr Kerensky put out his call for loyal forces to join him in his Exodus, every Atlas II pilot responded and left with him. The Atlas II is armed with an array of weaponry, including an LB-X Autocannon/10, a pair of ER Large Lasers, and a 20-tube Long Range Missile Launcher for long range attacks. For close range combat, the 'Mech is equipped with a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers and a Holly Six Pack. In addition, the 'Mech has been given CASEfor both sides of the torso in order to keep an ammunition cook-off from consuming the 'Mech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿特拉斯 II 于 2765 年首次投入战场，由原星盟的霸权研发部武器司设计，以维持对各大议院的技术优势。它专供星盟防卫军皇家团使用。2785 年亚历山大·克伦斯基将军号召忠诚部队随他出埃及时，每一位阿特拉斯 II 飞行员都响应并随他离开。阿特拉斯 II 装备一系列武器，包括一门 LB-X 自动炮/10、两门 ER 大型激光和一具 20 管远程导弹发射器用于远程攻击。近距离战斗则配备两门中型脉冲激光和一具冬青六联装。此外，机甲两侧躯干都装有 C.A.S.E.，以防弹药殉爆吞噬整机。

Original: This variant of the Atlas II exchanges both ER Large Lasers and its LB 10-X for a Kinslaughter ER PPC and a Gauss Rifle while removing only one double heat sink
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_atlas_ii_AS7-D-H2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant of the Atlas II exchanges both ER Large Lasers and its LB 10-X for a Kinslaughter ER PPC and a Gauss Rifle while removing only one double heat sink
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此阿特拉斯 II 变体将两门 ER 大型激光和 LB 10-X 换成一门"屠亲"ER PPC 和一门高斯步枪，仅移除一台双倍散热器

Original: A basic upgrade to the original 8Q introduced in 3057, the heat sinks are upgraded to double heat sinks and are reduced to nineteen. The saved weight is used to add a fourth PPC to the 'Mech as well as a Guardian ECM Suite. Although there was some criticism for using basic PPCs and not upgrading to ER models, the 9Q proved itself during Operation Guerrero to be quite devastating.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_awesome_AWS-9Q.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A basic upgrade to the original 8Q introduced in 3057, the heat sinks are upgraded to double heat sinks and are reduced to nineteen. The saved weight is used to add a fourth PPC to the 'Mech as well as a Guardian ECM Suite. Although there was some criticism for using basic PPCs and not upgrading to ER models, the 9Q proved itself during Operation Guerrero to be quite devastating.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 9Q 是 3057 年推出的对原版 8Q 的基础升级，散热器升级为双倍并减少至十九台。节省的重量用于为机甲加装第四门 PPC 以及一套守护者 ECM 套件。尽管有人批评它使用基础 PPC 而未升级为 ER 型号，9Q 在"格雷罗"行动中证明自己相当具毁灭性。

Original: The Bane is a BattleMech that is based upon a Star League prototype that was never put into production. Tagged the Kraken by Inner Sphere forces who opposed it, the Bane was first built in 2827. It was originally a significant part of many Clan toumans, but was gradually relegated to second-line status following the introduction of the OmniMech. As such, it is still critical to many defensive units.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_bane_prime.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Bane is a BattleMech that is based upon a Star League prototype that was never put into production. Tagged the Kraken by Inner Sphere forces who opposed it, the Bane was first built in 2827. It was originally a significant part of many Clan toumans, but was gradually relegated to second-line status following the introduction of the OmniMech. As such, it is still critical to many defensive units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 灾祸是一款以星盟从未投产的原型为基础的战斗机甲。它被对抗它的内天体部队冠以"海怪"之名，于 2827 年首次建造。它原本是许多氏族图曼的重要组成部分，但随着全能机甲的引入逐渐退居二线。即便如此，它对许多防御单位仍至关重要。

Original: An upgrade of the 3S variant using Star League technology, the 5S replaces the engine with an XL Engine and uses double heat sinks to save weight, restoring its top speed to 64.8 km/h. The 'Mech is armed for long range combat with a Poland Main Model A Gauss Rifle and two Defiance 1001 ER PPCs. For close ranges, the 'Mech has a TharHes Maxi SRM-6, four Defiance B3M Medium Lasers, and two Defiance B3S Small Lasers, and is also equipped with an Angst Clear Channel 3 comsys.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_banshee_BNC-5S.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade of the 3S variant using Star League technology, the 5S replaces the engine with an XL Engine and uses double heat sinks to save weight, restoring its top speed to 64.8 km/h. The 'Mech is armed for long range combat with a Poland Main Model A Gauss Rifle and two Defiance 1001 ER PPCs. For close ranges, the 'Mech has a TharHes Maxi SRM-6, four Defiance B3M Medium Lasers, and two Defiance B3S Small Lasers, and is also equipped with an Angst Clear Channel 3 comsys.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5S 是使用星盟科技的 3S 变体升级版，将引擎换成 XL 引擎并用双倍散热器节省重量，把最高速度恢复到 64.8 公里/小时。机甲为远程战斗装备一门波兰 A 型主炮高斯步枪和两门迪法恩斯 1001 ER PPC。近程则有一具塔尔赫斯 Maxi SRM-6、四门迪法恩斯 B3M 中型激光和两门迪法恩斯 B3S 小型激光，还配备安格斯特清频 3 通信系统。

Original: The 1Gb was an upgraded BattleMaster that was used by the Terran Hegemony-based SLDF Royal units. Introduced in 2760 it was built on an Endo Steel chassis and used double heat sinks. It only retained the forward-facing medium lasers to which was added a pair of ER PPCs, one in each arm, and a Large Pulse Laser in the center torso.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_battlemaster_BLR-1GB.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 1Gb was an upgraded BattleMaster that was used by the Terran Hegemony-based SLDF Royal units. Introduced in 2760 it was built on an Endo Steel chassis and used double heat sinks. It only retained the forward-facing medium lasers to which was added a pair of ER PPCs, one in each arm, and a Large Pulse Laser in the center torso.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 1Gb 是升级版战斗大师，供以地球霸权为基地的星盟防卫军皇家部队使用。它于 2760 年推出，建立在内骨骼底盘上并使用双倍散热器。它仅保留了前向中型激光，并加装两门 ER PPC（每臂一门）和中央躯干一门大型脉冲激光。

Original: A variant of the 1Gb introduced in 2763, this model dropped three heat sinks to incorporate a Command Console.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_battlemaster_BLR-1Gbc.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A variant of the 1Gb introduced in 2763, this model dropped three heat sinks to incorporate a Command Console.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此 1Gb 变体于 2763 年推出，它减少了三台散热器以装设一个指挥台。

Original: A much less radical upgrade of the 1G, the 1Gc upgraded the heat sinks to double strength models and removed the machine guns to make room for a command console.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_battlemaster_BLR-1Gc.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A much less radical upgrade of the 1G, the 1Gc upgraded the heat sinks to double strength models and removed the machine guns to make room for a command console.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 1Gc 是对 1G 温和得多的升级，它把散热器升级为双倍强度型号，并移除机枪以腾出空间安装指挥控制台。

Original: A command variant of the BLR-3M that removes two medium lasers and one double heat sink to fit a Cockpit Command Console.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_battlemaster_BLR-3M-DC.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A command variant of the BLR-3M that removes two medium lasers and one double heat sink to fit a Cockpit Command Console.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: BLR-3M 的指挥变体，移除两门中型激光和一台双倍散热器以安装驾驶舱指挥控制台。

Original: The 3M was a basic upgrade of the BattleMaster utilizing Star League technology. Introduced by Earthwerks Incorporated for the Free Worlds League in 3049, the 'Mech replaces the standard heat sinks with double heat sinks, upgrades its primary weapon to a Fusigon Longtooth ER PPC and removes one of the machine guns to add CASE to the design to protect itself in the event of an ammunition explosion.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_battlemaster_BLR-3M.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3M was a basic upgrade of the BattleMaster utilizing Star League technology. Introduced by Earthwerks Incorporated for the Free Worlds League in 3049, the 'Mech replaces the standard heat sinks with double heat sinks, upgrades its primary weapon to a Fusigon Longtooth ER PPC and removes one of the machine guns to add CASE to the design to protect itself in the event of an ammunition explosion.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3M 是利用星盟技术对战将的基础升级。它由地球工厂公司于 3049 年为自由世界联盟推出，把标准散热器换成双倍散热器，主武器升级为"富西贡长牙"ER PPC，并移除一挺机枪以给设计加装 C.A.S.E.，在弹药爆炸时保护自身。

Original: The Battle Hawk was originally designed and built at a time when Defiance Industries felt threatened by the large amount of equipment being produced by, and imported from, the Free Worlds League. It was built to prove that Defiance Industries was still an industry leader in BattleMechs. This came from a 'Mech that, while slow for its weight class, is a force to be reckoned with on the modern battlefield. The Battle Hawk has a top speed of 86.4 kph, which puts it on par with 'Mechs fifteen to twenty tons heavier than itself, but it also carries a powerful arsenal for its size. Its five and a half tons of armor give it good protection for a light 'Mech. Additionally, to make the Battle Hawk more maneuverable on the battlefield, it can jump up to one hundred and fifty meters.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_battle_hawk_BH-K305.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Battle Hawk was originally designed and built at a time when Defiance Industries felt threatened by the large amount of equipment being produced by, and imported from, the Free Worlds League. It was built to prove that Defiance Industries was still an industry leader in BattleMechs. This came from a 'Mech that, while slow for its weight class, is a force to be reckoned with on the modern battlefield. The Battle Hawk has a top speed of 86.4 kph, which puts it on par with 'Mechs fifteen to twenty tons heavier than itself, but it also carries a powerful arsenal for its size. Its five and a half tons of armor give it good protection for a light 'Mech. Additionally, to make the Battle Hawk more maneuverable on the battlefield, it can jump up to one hundred and fifty meters.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战斗鹰设计与建造之时，迪法恩斯工业正感到被自由世界联盟生产与进口的大量装备所威胁。它的诞生是为了证明迪法恩斯工业仍是战斗机甲行业的领导者。成果是一款虽在同重量级中偏慢、但在现代战场上不容小觑的机甲。战斗鹰最高速度 86.4 公里/小时，与其重十五到二十吨的机甲持平，同时也为此尺寸携带了强大的武器库。五吨半装甲为轻型机甲提供了良好防护。此外，为提升战场机动性，战斗鹰可跳跃至一百五十米。

Original: Unqiue among Wolfs Dragoon's, this is apparantly a downgraded Stone Rhino equipped with locally made Inner Sphere technology. The sole known example was lost at the battle of Misery and the Dragoon's have been unusually reticent about the mech or it's origins, refusing to confirm where the mech came from or whether they posses anymore.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_behemoth_BM-1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Unqiue among Wolfs Dragoon's, this is apparantly a downgraded Stone Rhino equipped with locally made Inner Sphere technology. The sole known example was lost at the battle of Misery and the Dragoon's have been unusually reticent about the mech or it's origins, refusing to confirm where the mech came from or whether they posses anymore.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这在狼之龙骑兵中独一无二，显然是一台装备了本地制造内天体技术的降级石犀牛。已知唯一一台在米瑟里战役中损失，而龙骑兵对这台机甲或其来历异常默默，拒绝确认它的来源或他们是否还拥有更多。

Original: The CattleMaster was created at the turn of the thirty-first century as an IndustrialMech to handle large herd animals. Being fed up by local Troublemakers and Pirates trying to steal his livestock, one farmer went and upgraded his Cattlemaster.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_bessie_CTL-X.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The CattleMaster was created at the turn of the thirty-first century as an IndustrialMech to handle large herd animals. Being fed up by local Troublemakers and Pirates trying to steal his livestock, one farmer went and upgraded his Cattlemaster.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 牧牛人于三十一世纪之交被制造为工业机甲，用于处置大型畜群。由于受够了当地捣蛋鬼和海盗试图偷窃他的牲畜，一位农场主升级了自己的牧牛人。

Original: The Black Hawk-KU is an Inner Sphere version of the Clan Black Hawk OmniMech. In order to make it possible to copy the Black Hawk, the Black Hawk-KU is built ten tons heavier than its Clan counterpart. The Black Hawk-KU is built on a sixty ton chassis and is powered by a Vlar 300 XL Engine which propels it to a top speed of 86.4 kph.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_black_hawk-ku_BHKU-O.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Black Hawk-KU is an Inner Sphere version of the Clan Black Hawk OmniMech. In order to make it possible to copy the Black Hawk, the Black Hawk-KU is built ten tons heavier than its Clan counterpart. The Black Hawk-KU is built on a sixty ton chassis and is powered by a Vlar 300 XL Engine which propels it to a top speed of 86.4 kph.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑鹰-KU 是氏族黑鹰全能机甲的内天体版本。为使复制黑鹰成为可能，黑鹰-KU 比其氏族对应型重了十吨。它采用六十吨底盘，由 Vlar 300 XL 引擎驱动，最高速度 86.4 公里/小时。

In order to make it possible to copy the Black Hawk, the Black Hawk-KU is built ten tons heavier than its Clan counterpart. Original: A Free Worlds League variant, the BL-7-KNT-L replaces the rarer PPC with a 3rd Large Laser and 2 additional Heat Sinks.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_black_knight_BL-7-KNT-L.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Free Worlds League variant, the BL-7-KNT-L replaces the rarer PPC with a 3rd Large Laser and 2 additional Heat Sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是自由世界联盟的变体，BL-7-KNT-L 将较稀有的 PPC 换成第三门大型激光和 2 台额外散热器。

Original: The Black Knight 7-KNT is a dedicated Energy weapon platform. It can shell out hellish damage with its beams and shrug off a lot of damage… just gotta make sure to keep its heat in check.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_black_knight_BL-7-KNT.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Black Knight 7-KNT is a dedicated Energy weapon platform. It can shell out hellish damage with its beams and shrug off a lot of damage… just gotta make sure to keep its heat in check.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑骑士 7-KNT 是专职能量武器平台。它能以光束倾泻地狱般的伤害，并轻易承受大量打击……只要确保把热量控制住。

Original: The Black Knight 7B is a refit made for and sold to Mercenary Commanders deeply in favour with the Federated Commonwealth, sporting advanced technologies and Prototype X-Pulse Laser.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_black_knight_BL-7b-KNT.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Black Knight 7B is a refit made for and sold to Mercenary Commanders deeply in favour with the Federated Commonwealth, sporting advanced technologies and Prototype X-Pulse Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑骑士 7B 是为深得联邦联邦青睐的佣兵指挥官制造并出售的改装型，配备先进技术和原型 X 脉冲激光。

Original: The Black Knight 9-KNT is essentially a LosTech upgrade to the 6 variant, replacing most of its standard lasers with pulse versions, and the standard PPC with an ER version. This variant also carries double heat sinks to manage the extra heat generated by these weapons.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_black_knight_BL-9-KNT.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Black Knight 9-KNT is essentially a LosTech upgrade to the 6 variant, replacing most of its standard lasers with pulse versions, and the standard PPC with an ER version. This variant also carries double heat sinks to manage the extra heat generated by these weapons.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑骑士 9-KNT 实质上是 6 型的失落科技升级版，将其大部分标准激光换成脉冲版本，标准 PPC 换成 ER 版本。该变体还配备双倍散热器以应对这些武器产生的额外热量。

Original: The Black Lanner A is configured for electronic warfare and scouting. It uses an Active Probe to find hidden units, an ECM Suite to counteract enemy electronics, and a TAG spotting laser to designate targets for homing artillery. Offensively, it can call upon an ER PPC and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_black_lanner_BKL-A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Black Lanner A is configured for electronic warfare and scouting. It uses an Active Probe to find hidden units, an ECM Suite to counteract enemy electronics, and a TAG spotting laser to designate targets for homing artillery. Offensively, it can call upon an ER PPC and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑猎隼 A 为电子战与侦察而配置。它使用主动探测器寻找隐藏单位、ECM 套件对抗敌方电子设备、TAG 侦察激光为寻的炮弹标记目标。攻击方面，它能依靠一门 ER PPC 和两门中型脉冲激光。

Original: The C is a close-support variant that mounts six ER Medium Lasers and a Streak SRM-6. It also uses three additional double heat sinks to help combat heat levels.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_black_lanner_BKL-C.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The C is a close-support variant that mounts six ER Medium Lasers and a Streak SRM-6. It also uses three additional double heat sinks to help combat heat levels.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: C 型是近距支援变体，装备六门 ER 中型激光和一具连续 SRM-6。它还使用三台额外双倍散热器以帮助控制热量水平。

Original: This close-range brawler mounts pairs of Medium Pulse Lasers, SRM-6s, ER Small Lasers, Flamers, and four Machine Guns. This configuration is devastating to conventional infantry and a serious threat to combat vehicles. An Active Probe ensures that it is rarely surprised.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_black_lanner_BKL-D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This close-range brawler mounts pairs of Medium Pulse Lasers, SRM-6s, ER Small Lasers, Flamers, and four Machine Guns. This configuration is devastating to conventional infantry and a serious threat to combat vehicles. An Active Probe ensures that it is rarely surprised.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款近战近战型装备成对的中型脉冲激光、SRM-6、ER 小型激光、火焰喷射器和四挺机枪。此配置对常规步兵极具毁灭性，对战斗车辆也是严重威胁。主动探测器确保它很少被突袭。

Original: The primary configuration of the Black Lanner is effective at all ranges. At long range, it can make use of an ER Large Laser and LRM-10. When it closes in, it can attack with a pair of ER Medium Lasers and an SRM-6 that can exploit holes in its opponent's armor. An ECM Suite protects it from many forms of electronics.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_black_lanner_BKL-Prime.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary configuration of the Black Lanner is effective at all ranges. At long range, it can make use of an ER Large Laser and LRM-10. When it closes in, it can attack with a pair of ER Medium Lasers and an SRM-6 that can exploit holes in its opponent's armor. An ECM Suite protects it from many forms of electronics.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑猎隼的主配置在各类距离上都很有效。远距离可用一门 ER 大型激光和一具 LRM-10。接近后，它可用两门 ER 中型激光和一具 SRM-6 攻击，后者能利用对手装甲上的破口。ECM 套件保护它免受多种电子手段干扰。

Original: The Black Python is similar in many ways to the Warhammer and Marauder BattleMechs. Though it is faster than those heavies, it has a similar weapons load-out with comparable damage, albeit with much more accurate damage potential. In order to achieve this, this expensive second-line 'Mech avails itself of all weight saving technologies that were at the disposal of the Clans, including an XL Engine, Endo Steel frame, and eleven tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_black_python_BP-2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Black Python is similar in many ways to the Warhammer and Marauder BattleMechs. Though it is faster than those heavies, it has a similar weapons load-out with comparable damage, albeit with much more accurate damage potential. In order to achieve this, this expensive second-line 'Mech avails itself of all weight saving technologies that were at the disposal of the Clans, including an XL Engine, Endo Steel frame, and eleven tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑蟒在许多方面与战锤和掠夺者战斗机甲相似。虽然比这两款重型机甲更快，但它的武器配置与伤害相当，只是伤害潜力更为精准。为实现这一点，这款昂贵的二线机甲使用了氏族可用的一切减重技术，包括 XL 引擎、内骨骼框架和十一吨铁纤维装甲。

Original: Dubbed the 'Blazing Inferno', this variant of the 2D chassis removes all the missiles and instead adds three more Medium Lasers and six Small Lasers, along with an extra ton of armor.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_blazing_inferno_COM-2D-BI.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Dubbed the 'Blazing Inferno', this variant of the 2D chassis removes all the missiles and instead adds three more Medium Lasers and six Small Lasers, along with an extra ton of armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此变体绰号"炽烈地狱"，基于 2D 底盘，移除全部导弹，改为加装三门中型激光和六门小型激光，以及额外一吨装甲。

Original: Though bearing a remarkable outward resemblance to the Timberwolf, this BattleMech is a new and powerful creation. Carrying thirteen tons of ferro-fibrous armor, the Mad Cat MK II is an incredibly resilient design. A pair of arm mounted Gaussrifles supported by torso mounted LRM racks give it complete command over the battlefield.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_blood_asp_BAS-A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Though bearing a remarkable outward resemblance to the Timberwolf, this BattleMech is a new and powerful creation. Carrying thirteen tons of ferro-fibrous armor, the Mad Cat MK II is an incredibly resilient design. A pair of arm mounted Gaussrifles supported by torso mounted LRM racks give it complete command over the battlefield.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 虽然外观与森林狼极为相似，这款战斗机甲却是全新而强大的创造。疯猫 MK II 携带十三吨铁纤维装甲，是极为坚固的设计。臂载的双高斯步枪配以躯干搭载的 LRM 挂架，使其能完全掌控战场。

Original: We call the Cataphract a "FrankenMech" because it's got a little bit of everything stitched together on it. The 1X model works well at medium-long to closer range, with good armor and weaponry.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_cataphract_CTF-0X.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We call the Cataphract a "FrankenMech" because it's got a little bit of everything stitched together on it. The 1X model works well at medium-long to closer range, with good armor and weaponry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们称铁甲舰为"拼装机甲"，因为它把五花八门的东西缝在了一起。1X 型号在中远到较近距离都表现出色，装甲与武器俱佳。

Original: The longest ranged weapon carried by the CTF-3D Cataphract is a General Motors Nova-5 Ultra AC-5 in its right arm, boasting a rate of fire twice that of a standard autocannon. This is backed up by a Mydron Excel LB-X Autocannon/10 in its right torso, capable of firing both solid and cluster rounds. It is a more popular weapon than the Ultra AC-5, especially for use in an anti-conventional and anti-aircraft role without the possibility of jamming. Finally, the 'Mech has four Intek Medium Lasers for close range defense, one in each arm firing forward and two in its torso covering the rear. With only two tons of ammo for the LB-X 10 and one ton for the Ultra, if it runs dry the Cataphract must fall back to be reloaded before continuing the fight. Eleven tons of armor combined with CASE allowed the Cataphract to easily absorb damage. Sixteen heat sinks keep it cool while four HildCo Model 12 jump jets gave it a jumping distance of one hundred and twenty meters. Room for these improvements was made by using a GM 280 XL Engine.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_cataphract_CTF-3D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The longest ranged weapon carried by the CTF-3D Cataphract is a General Motors Nova-5 Ultra AC-5 in its right arm, boasting a rate of fire twice that of a standard autocannon. This is backed up by a Mydron Excel LB-X Autocannon/10 in its right torso, capable of firing both solid and cluster rounds. It is a more popular weapon than the Ultra AC-5, especially for use in an anti-conventional and anti-aircraft role without the possibility of jamming. Finally, the 'Mech has four Intek Medium Lasers for close range defense, one in each arm firing forward and two in its torso covering the rear. With only two tons of ammo for the LB-X 10 and one ton for the Ultra, if it runs dry the Cataphract must fall back to be reloaded before continuing the fight. Eleven tons of armor combined with CASE allowed the Cataphract to easily absorb damage. Sixteen heat sinks keep it cool while four HildCo Model 12 jump jets gave it a jumping distance of one hundred and twenty meters. Room for these improvements was made by using a GM 280 XL Engine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: CTF-3D 铠装骑兵携带的最远射程武器是右臂的一门通用汽车"新星-5"超速 AC-5，射速是标准自动炮的两倍。它由右躯干一门迈德龙 Excel LB-X 自动炮/10 支援，可发射实心弹与集束弹。它比超速 AC-5 更受欢迎，尤其用于反常规与防空任务且不会卡壳。最后，机甲有四门英泰克中型激光用于近程防御，每臂一门向前，躯干两门覆盖后方。LB-X 10 只有两吨弹药、超速炮一吨，一旦打空，铠装骑兵必须后撤装填才能继续作战。十一吨装甲结合 C.A.S.E. 使铠装骑兵能轻易吸收伤害。十六台散热器使其保持低温，四个希尔德科 12 型跳跃推进器赋予它一百二十米的跳跃距离。这些改进所需的空间来自一台 GM 280 XL 引擎。

Original: Produced by the Capellans based on stolen Davion designs, the 3L is an upgraded version of the Cataphract that follows more in line with the prototype 1X model. It is propelled by an XL Engine with MASC instead of jump jets allowing it to reach speeds of 86.4 km/h in short bursts. While it is also armed with an LB-X Autocannon/10 as its primary weapon this is instead matched with a Ceres Arms Warrior ER PPC for powerful striking capabilities at long range. Other differences include the use of four Medium Pulse Lasers and double heat sinks in place of the standard models. This design was produced by the Confederation at Grand Base following the ascension of Chancellor Romano Liao.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_cataphract_CTF-3L.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Produced by the Capellans based on stolen Davion designs, the 3L is an upgraded version of the Cataphract that follows more in line with the prototype 1X model. It is propelled by an XL Engine with MASC instead of jump jets allowing it to reach speeds of 86.4 km/h in short bursts. While it is also armed with an LB-X Autocannon/10 as its primary weapon this is instead matched with a Ceres Arms Warrior ER PPC for powerful striking capabilities at long range. Other differences include the use of four Medium Pulse Lasers and double heat sinks in place of the standard models. This design was produced by the Confederation at Grand Base following the ascension of Chancellor Romano Liao.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3L 由卡佩兰人基于窃取的达维昂设计生产，是铁甲舰的升级版，更贴近原型 1X 型号。它由配 MASC 的 XL 引擎驱动而非跳跃推进器，可在短促爆发中达到 86.4 公里/小时。虽然主武器同为 LB-X 自动炮/10，但它改配一门谷神星军械"战士"ER PPC，具备强大的远程打击能力。其他差异包括使用四门中型脉冲激光和双倍散热器取代标准型号。此设计在罗曼诺·廖大臣登位后由邦联在格兰德基地生产。

Original: The C3 variant takes the 'Mech's long range fire support to a new level by removing both of the LRM-15 launchers and replacing them with an Arrow IV artillery system, allowing the Catapult to stay a safe distance from the battlefield.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_catapult_CPLT-C3.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The C3 variant takes the 'Mech's long range fire support to a new level by removing both of the LRM-15 launchers and replacing them with an Arrow IV artillery system, allowing the Catapult to stay a safe distance from the battlefield.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此 C3 变体将机甲远程火力支援提升到新层次：拆掉两具 LRM-15 发射器，换成一套箭矢 IV 火炮系统，使投石机得以与战场保持安全距离。

Original: An upgrade of the C4 model. The standard fusion engine is replaced with an extralight engine. With the extra freed tonnage, a large laser and Beagle Active Probe can be mounted. The two Small Lasers are replaced with a single pulse version. The heat sinks are upgraded to double strength models.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_catapult_CPLT-C4C.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade of the C4 model. The standard fusion engine is replaced with an extralight engine. With the extra freed tonnage, a large laser and Beagle Active Probe can be mounted. The two Small Lasers are replaced with a single pulse version. The heat sinks are upgraded to double strength models.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: C4 型号的升级。标准聚变引擎换成超轻型引擎。凭借腾出的额外吨位，可安装一门大型激光和一具比格犬主动探测器。两门小型激光换成一门脉冲版本。散热器升级为双倍强度型号。

Original: An upgrade of the C3 model, this variant first appeared during the St. Ives Conflict. It retains the Arrow IV artillery system, but its chassis has been upgraded to Endo Steel and its heat sinks to improved versions. This allows the C5 to increase its armor coverage to twelve and a half tons, upgrade its lasers to ER Medium Lasers, and quadruple the amount of ammo carried with protection provided by CASE.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_catapult_CPLT-C5.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade of the C3 model, this variant first appeared during the St. Ives Conflict. It retains the Arrow IV artillery system, but its chassis has been upgraded to Endo Steel and its heat sinks to improved versions. This allows the C5 to increase its armor coverage to twelve and a half tons, upgrade its lasers to ER Medium Lasers, and quadruple the amount of ammo carried with protection provided by CASE.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此变体是 C3 型号的升级版，首次出现在圣艾夫斯冲突期间。它保留箭矢 IV 火炮系统，但底盘升级为内骨骼，散热器升级为改进型。这使 C5 能把装甲覆盖增至十二吨半，将激光升级为 ER 中型激光，并把弹药携带量翻两番，同时以 C.A.S.E. 提供保护。

Original: The CattleMaster was created at the turn of the thirty-first century as an IndustrialMech to handle large herd animals. The concept for the Rancher 'Mech dates back to the twenty-fourth century. The 'Mech is noted for its durability and flexible Internal Combustion Engine.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_cattlemaster_CTL-3R3.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The CattleMaster was created at the turn of the thirty-first century as an IndustrialMech to handle large herd animals. The concept for the Rancher 'Mech dates back to the twenty-fourth century. The 'Mech is noted for its durability and flexible Internal Combustion Engine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 牧牛人于三十一世纪之交被制造为工业机甲，用于处置大型畜群。这类"牧场主"机甲的概念可追溯至二十四世纪。此机甲以其耐用性和灵活的内燃引擎著称。

Original: A heavier 55-ton version of the venerable Centurion, the CN10-B was built in 3057 and uses an Endo Steel chassis to save weight on the design while retaining the CN9-A's original ground speed through the use of a 220-rated standard fusion engine. Much like the CN9-D, the 10-B carries an LB-X Autocannon/10 as its primary weapon with an LRM-10 launcher with an Artemis IV fire control system, but these are backed up by a medium laser and a medium pulse laser.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_centurion_CN10-B.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A heavier 55-ton version of the venerable Centurion, the CN10-B was built in 3057 and uses an Endo Steel chassis to save weight on the design while retaining the CN9-A's original ground speed through the use of a 220-rated standard fusion engine. Much like the CN9-D, the 10-B carries an LB-X Autocannon/10 as its primary weapon with an LRM-10 launcher with an Artemis IV fire control system, but these are backed up by a medium laser and a medium pulse laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: CN10-B 是经典百夫长的 55 吨加重版本，于 3057 年建造，使用内骨骼底盘为设计减重，同时通过 220 额定标准聚变引擎保留 CN9-A 原有的地面速度。与 CN9-D 十分相似，10-B 以一门 LB-X 自动炮/10 为主武器，配一具带 Artemis IV 火控系统的 LRM-10 发射器，另有中型激光和中型脉冲激光作为后备。

Original: This radical modification looks to turn the Charger into a traditional assault 'Mech by reducing the 'Mechs speed to 54 km/h, which allows the use of a smaller engine (incidentally, the commonplace Pitban 240 reactor). The 'Mech is armored with fifteen and a half tons of armor and is armed with four Large Lasers, one in each arm and side torso, and a Medium Laser in its head; twenty-eight heat sinks kept the 'Mech cool.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_challenger_CGR-SB.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This radical modification looks to turn the Charger into a traditional assault 'Mech by reducing the 'Mechs speed to 54 km/h, which allows the use of a smaller engine (incidentally, the commonplace Pitban 240 reactor). The 'Mech is armored with fifteen and a half tons of armor and is armed with four Large Lasers, one in each arm and side torso, and a Medium Laser in its head; twenty-eight heat sinks kept the 'Mech cool.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这项激进的改装试图把冲锋者变成传统的突击机甲：将机甲速度降至 54 公里/小时，从而得以使用更小的引擎（顺带一提，是常见的皮特班 240 反应堆）。机甲披挂十五吨半装甲，武装为四门大型激光（每臂与每侧躯干各一）以及头部一门中型激光；二十八台散热器使机甲保持凉爽。

Original: Draconis Combine's 3K was an upgrade of the 1A9 that used an uprated XL engine to raise the Charger's top speed back to 86.4 km/h. The head-mounted small laser was removed, the medium lasers were swapped out for Medium Pulse Lasers, and the LRM-20 launcher was mated with an Artemis IV fire control system to improve accuracy. The addition of a fifth jump jet mounted in the rear torso gave the 'Mech a jumping distance of up to one hundred and fifty meters. This variant was confirmed to have been deployed on An Ting in the War of 3039 and may have been what Davion forces initially dubbed the Charger II; however, descriptions of the Charger II suggest that it was more likely a LRM-equipped variant of the Hatamoto-Chi (presumably the -Kaze).
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_charger_CGR-3K.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Draconis Combine's 3K was an upgrade of the 1A9 that used an uprated XL engine to raise the Charger's top speed back to 86.4 km/h. The head-mounted small laser was removed, the medium lasers were swapped out for Medium Pulse Lasers, and the LRM-20 launcher was mated with an Artemis IV fire control system to improve accuracy. The addition of a fifth jump jet mounted in the rear torso gave the 'Mech a jumping distance of up to one hundred and fifty meters. This variant was confirmed to have been deployed on An Ting in the War of 3039 and may have been what Davion forces initially dubbed the Charger II; however, descriptions of the Charger II suggest that it was more likely a LRM-equipped variant of the Hatamoto-Chi (presumably the -Kaze).
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 联合体的 3K 是 1A9 的升级版，使用升级的 XL 引擎把冲锋者最高速度重新提升至 86.4 公里/小时。头部小型激光被移除，中型激光换成中型脉冲激光，LRM-20 发射器配以 Artemis IV 火控系统以提升精度。在后躯干加装的第五个跳跃推进器使机甲跳跃距离达一百五十米。该变体被证实曾在 3039 年战争中部署于安廷，也许正是达维昂部队最初称为冲锋者 II 的机型；不过对冲锋者 II 的描述表明，它更可能是旗本-血的 LRM 装备变体（推测是-风）。

Original: An upgrade of the 3K, the Charger C was modified to carry a C3 Slave unit that allowed it to share targeting data with other 'Mechs in its unit. In order to add the slave unit, a medium pulse laser had to be removed from the design. The left over mass went towards extra ammunition for the LRM launcher.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_charger_CGR-C.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade of the 3K, the Charger C was modified to carry a C3 Slave unit that allowed it to share targeting data with other 'Mechs in its unit. In order to add the slave unit, a medium pulse laser had to be removed from the design. The left over mass went towards extra ammunition for the LRM launcher.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为 3K 的升级，冲锋者 C 经改装携带一台 C3 从属单元，使其能与本单位的其他机甲共享瞄准数据。为加装从属单元，必须从设计中移除一门中型脉冲激光。剩下的质量用于为 LRM 发射器增加额外弹药。

Original: A succession wars attempt at turning the Cicada into a fire support platform, the 3D is widely considered as failure. Armed with 2 lrm-5's and 2 medium lasers, it relies on a 280 rated engine to fit the heavier arsenal. Despite possessing more firepower and armour than other Cicada models, it's lack of speed and raw fire proved a major draw back and only a few survived through succession wars.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_cicada_CDA-3D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A succession wars attempt at turning the Cicada into a fire support platform, the 3D is widely considered as failure. Armed with 2 lrm-5's and 2 medium lasers, it relies on a 280 rated engine to fit the heavier arsenal. Despite possessing more firepower and armour than other Cicada models, it's lack of speed and raw fire proved a major draw back and only a few survived through succession wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是继承战争时期把蝉改造为火力支援平台的尝试，3D 被普遍认为是失败之作。它装备 2 具 lrm-5 和 2 门中型激光，依靠一台 280 额定引擎来容纳更重的武器库。尽管拥有比其他蝉型号更多的火力与装甲，它缺乏速度与原始打击力成为主要缺点，只有少数在继承战争中幸存。

Original: When General Aleksandr Kerensky led most of the Star League Defense Force into exile in 2784, they brought prototypes of the Clint BattleMech with them. After the annihilation of Clan Wolverine, Clan Snow Raven revisited these prototypes and was able to begin mass-production of the 'Mech in 2830 and introduced 2842. They ensured that it kept up with advances in Clan technology, eventually becoming the design that is now known as the Clint IIC. This speedy medium 'Mech is armed with a Type KOV LB-10X Autocannon and a pair of Series 2d ER Medium Lasers. This makes the Clint IIC an effective light 'Mech killer. It is capable of ranging far beyond supply lines thanks to its four tons of ammunition, though it only uses ten standard heat sinks and seven tons of standard armor.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_clint_iic_CLNT-IIC-1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: When General Aleksandr Kerensky led most of the Star League Defense Force into exile in 2784, they brought prototypes of the Clint BattleMech with them. After the annihilation of Clan Wolverine, Clan Snow Raven revisited these prototypes and was able to begin mass-production of the 'Mech in 2830 and introduced 2842. They ensured that it kept up with advances in Clan technology, eventually becoming the design that is now known as the Clint IIC. This speedy medium 'Mech is armed with a Type KOV LB-10X Autocannon and a pair of Series 2d ER Medium Lasers. This makes the Clint IIC an effective light 'Mech killer. It is capable of ranging far beyond supply lines thanks to its four tons of ammunition, though it only uses ten standard heat sinks and seven tons of standard armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2784 年亚历山大·克伦斯基将军率领星盟防卫军大部流亡时，带上了克林特战斗机甲的原型机。在狼獾氏族被灭绝后，雪鸦氏族重新审视这些原型，于 2830 年得以开始量产并于 2842 年推出。他们确保其跟上氏族技术的进步，最终演变为如今被称为克林特 IIC 的设计。这款高速中型机甲装备一门 KOV 型 LB-10X 自动炮和两门 2d 系列 ER 中型激光，使其成为高效的轻型机甲杀手。凭借四吨弹药，它能远离补给线长期作战，不过它仅使用十台标准散热器和七吨标准装甲。

Original: During the Amaris Civil War, several Lyran MechWarriors joined the SLDF in defiance of their government's policy of neutrality. With this came the coup that the Star League Defense Force had attempted to pull off for decades: the acquisition of the Lyran Commando. Long considered one of the better scout 'Mechs in the Inner Sphere, at least one of these Commandos accompanied Kerensky into exile and several of them appeared in the forces assigned to Operation Klondike. As newer weapons and 'Mechs made their way into the Clan arsenal, these Commandos began to show their age, so Clan Goliath Scorpion began a program to upgrade theirs. Dubbed the Commando IIC, this upgrade used newer technologies to outperform its venerable cousin. With the proliferation of OmniMechs, most Commando IICs were relegated to second line status, though the Scorpions still continue to outfit some of their pirate hunters with these 'Mechs.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_commando_iic_COM-IIC.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: During the Amaris Civil War, several Lyran MechWarriors joined the SLDF in defiance of their government's policy of neutrality. With this came the coup that the Star League Defense Force had attempted to pull off for decades: the acquisition of the Lyran Commando. Long considered one of the better scout 'Mechs in the Inner Sphere, at least one of these Commandos accompanied Kerensky into exile and several of them appeared in the forces assigned to Operation Klondike. As newer weapons and 'Mechs made their way into the Clan arsenal, these Commandos began to show their age, so Clan Goliath Scorpion began a program to upgrade theirs. Dubbed the Commando IIC, this upgrade used newer technologies to outperform its venerable cousin. With the proliferation of OmniMechs, most Commando IICs were relegated to second line status, though the Scorpions still continue to outfit some of their pirate hunters with these 'Mechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿马里斯内战期间，数名莱兰机甲战士不顾政府中立政策加入星盟防卫军。随之而来的是星盟防卫军数十年来一直试图实现的目标：获得莱兰突击队。突击队长期被视为内天体最好的侦察机甲之一，至少有一台随克伦斯基流亡，数台出现在"克朗代克行动"的部队中。随着更新式武器与机甲进入氏族武库，这些突击队开始显露老态，于是歌利亚蝎氏族启动了升级计划。命名为突击队 IIC，该升级利用更新技术超越了它古老的表亲。随着全能机甲普及，大多数突击队 IIC 退居二线，但蝎氏族仍继续用它们装备部分猎杀海盗的部队。

Original: A sleek, mobile, and versatile design, the Clan hellhound was long suspected to be one of the first OmniMechs produced by the Clans.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_conjurer_HND-1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A sleek, mobile, and versatile design, the Clan hellhound was long suspected to be one of the first OmniMechs produced by the Clans.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一款流线型、机动且多用途的设计，氏族地狱犬长期被认为是最早由氏族生产的全能机甲之一。

Original: Considered to be a middleweight machine compared to the heavier Mackies and Ymirs already in circulation, the Crossbow was built to be a fast missile support unit. As was the case with the Coventry Defense Conglomerate, Arcturan Arms’ engineers initially failed to make their prototype Crossbow live up to expectations, but as the techniques for producing BattleMechs grew more refined, the Crossbow received an upgrade worthy of its original concept.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_crossbow_CRS-6B.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Considered to be a middleweight machine compared to the heavier Mackies and Ymirs already in circulation, the Crossbow was built to be a fast missile support unit. As was the case with the Coventry Defense Conglomerate, Arcturan Arms’ engineers initially failed to make their prototype Crossbow live up to expectations, but as the techniques for producing BattleMechs grew more refined, the Crossbow received an upgrade worthy of its original concept.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 与当时已在使用的更重型的麦基和伊米尔相比，弩弓被视为中量级机体，被造成快速导弹支援单位。与考文垂防务集团的情况类似，大熊座军械的工程师最初未能让原型弩弓达到预期，但随着战斗机甲生产技术日趋精良，弩弓获得了与其原始构想相称的升级。

Original: Developed during the Golden Century by Clan Steel Viper as an early second-generation OmniMech, the Crossbow is a relatively cheap OmniMech. The Crossbow was Clan Steel Viper's first attempt to crash-start their OmniMech manufacturing capability, and was initiated in part by a small cadre of captured Clan Snow Raven scientist caste.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_crossbow_CRS-A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed during the Golden Century by Clan Steel Viper as an early second-generation OmniMech, the Crossbow is a relatively cheap OmniMech. The Crossbow was Clan Steel Viper's first attempt to crash-start their OmniMech manufacturing capability, and was initiated in part by a small cadre of captured Clan Snow Raven scientist caste.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 弩弓是钢蛇氏族在黄金世纪开发的早期第二代全能机甲，造价相对低廉。它是钢蛇氏族首次尝试速成其全能机甲制造能力，部分工作由一小批被俘的雪鸦氏族科学家种姓发起。

Original: A variant of the Crusader concentrating on lessening its heat burden, the 3K was introduced by the Draconis Combine in 2765. It downsized the LRM launchers to LRM-10 models and removed the machine guns to make room for an additional six heat sinks.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_crusader_CRD-3K.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A variant of the Crusader concentrating on lessening its heat burden, the 3K was introduced by the Draconis Combine in 2765. It downsized the LRM launchers to LRM-10 models and removed the machine guns to make room for an additional six heat sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为专注减轻热负担的十字军变体，3K 由德拉科尼斯联合体于 2765 年推出。它把 LRM 发射器缩小为 LRM-10 型号，并移除机枪，以腾出空间安装另外六台散热器。

Original: The 3L variant of the Crusader takes concepts from both the 3D and the 3K models to save weight with a twist. Built for the Capellan Confederation starting in 2753, the 'Mech has removed the LRM-15 and SRM-6 launchers and replaced them with two LRM-10 launchers and two SRM-4 launchers. This frees up room for two additional heat sinks as well as the inclusion of four GM Jetstar jump jets, two each in either side torso, giving it a jumping distance of one hundred and twenty meters.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_crusader_CRD-3L.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3L variant of the Crusader takes concepts from both the 3D and the 3K models to save weight with a twist. Built for the Capellan Confederation starting in 2753, the 'Mech has removed the LRM-15 and SRM-6 launchers and replaced them with two LRM-10 launchers and two SRM-4 launchers. This frees up room for two additional heat sinks as well as the inclusion of four GM Jetstar jump jets, two each in either side torso, giving it a jumping distance of one hundred and twenty meters.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 十字军 3L 变体借鉴 3D 与 3K 两种型号的思路来减重，并别出心裁。它自 2753 年起为卡佩兰邦联建造，移除了 LRM-15 和 SRM-6 发射器，换成两具 LRM-10 和两具 SRM-4 发射器。这腾出空间容纳两台额外散热器，并加装四个通用"喷气星"跳跃推进器（两侧躯干各两个），使其跳跃距离达一百二十米。

Original: A field modification kit based on the 3K variant and introduced for Kuritan forces in 3049, the 4K removes two heat sinks and replaces the two medium lasers of the 3K with Magna 400P medium pulse models.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_crusader_CRD-4K.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A field modification kit based on the 3K variant and introduced for Kuritan forces in 3049, the 4K removes two heat sinks and replaces the two medium lasers of the 3K with Magna 400P medium pulse models.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 4K 是基于 3K 变体的野战改装套件，于 3049 年引入库瑞塔部队，它移除两台散热器，并把 3K 的两门中型激光换成玛格纳 400P 中型脉冲型号。

Original: The original version of the Dervish that was produced in 2520 was not up to the same standards as contemporary Terran Hegemony designs. The use of comparatively "primitive" parts resulted in a heavier cockpit, engine, and less efficient armor. Consequently, the 1S had a top speed of 64 km/h and could only jump ninety meters. While the missile launchers were the same as the 6M, it did not have that version's lasers. 1S variants continued to exist in militias, but were raided for parts during the Succession Wars. It was not intended for front line use, but for Militia units.  Though there were few, if any, remaining by the end of the 2990s, they once again began to be produced on low-tech worlds during the Jihad due to that conflict's disruption of supply lines.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_dervish_DV-1S.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original version of the Dervish that was produced in 2520 was not up to the same standards as contemporary Terran Hegemony designs. The use of comparatively "primitive" parts resulted in a heavier cockpit, engine, and less efficient armor. Consequently, the 1S had a top speed of 64 km/h and could only jump ninety meters. While the missile launchers were the same as the 6M, it did not have that version's lasers. 1S variants continued to exist in militias, but were raided for parts during the Succession Wars. It was not intended for front line use, but for Militia units.  Though there were few, if any, remaining by the end of the 2990s, they once again began to be produced on low-tech worlds during the Jihad due to that conflict's disruption of supply lines.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2520 年生产的原版苦行僧未达到当时地球霸权设计的同等标准。使用相对"原始"的部件导致驾驶舱与引擎更重、装甲效率更低。因此 1S 的最高速度为 64 公里/小时，且只能跳九十米。虽然导弹发射器与 6M 相同，但它没有该型号的激光。1S 变体继续存在于民兵部队中，但在继承战争期间被拆解取件。它并非为前线使用而设计，而是供民兵单位使用。尽管到 2990 年代末所剩无几，圣战期间由于供应链被打断，低技术世界再次开始生产它们。

Original: The Dervish IIC, a 55-ton Clan refit of the Star-League-era Dervish, was first seen in 3058 along the Smoke Jaguar front bordering the Draconis Combine. It has similar movement and jump capabilities to the original Dervish, but carries significantly more firepower.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_dervish_iic_DV-IIC.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Dervish IIC, a 55-ton Clan refit of the Star-League-era Dervish, was first seen in 3058 along the Smoke Jaguar front bordering the Draconis Combine. It has similar movement and jump capabilities to the original Dervish, but carries significantly more firepower.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 苦行僧 IIC 是星盟时代苦行僧的 55 吨氏族改装版，于 3058 年首次出现在烟虎氏族与德拉科尼斯联合体接壤的前线。它的移动与跳跃能力与原版苦行僧相似，但火力显著更强。

Original: The Dire Wolf is one of the OmniMechs that became feared throughout the Inner Sphere during the initial Clan Invasion and rightly so. The Dire Wolf weighs in at an impressive one hundred tons and has a relatively slow cruising speed of 54 km/h provided by a 300 XL engine. Its speed and armor protection matches that of an Atlas, but it has superior potential firepower with fifty and a half tons of free pod space for weapons and equipment. It is these traits which saw the 'Mech christened Daishi (pseudo-Japanese for 'Great Death') by the criminal underbelly of the Draconis Combine, a name that would be proven grimly accurate time and time again.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_dire_wolf_DW-A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Dire Wolf is one of the OmniMechs that became feared throughout the Inner Sphere during the initial Clan Invasion and rightly so. The Dire Wolf weighs in at an impressive one hundred tons and has a relatively slow cruising speed of 54 km/h provided by a 300 XL engine. Its speed and armor protection matches that of an Atlas, but it has superior potential firepower with fifty and a half tons of free pod space for weapons and equipment. It is these traits which saw the 'Mech christened Daishi (pseudo-Japanese for 'Great Death') by the criminal underbelly of the Draconis Combine, a name that would be proven grimly accurate time and time again.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 恐狼是氏族入侵初期令整个内天体闻之色变的全能机甲之一，实至名归。它重达惊人的一百吨，由 300 XL 引擎驱动，巡航速度相对缓慢，仅 54 公里/小时。它的速度与装甲防护与阿特拉斯相当，但凭借五十吨半的自由吊舱空间搭载武器与装备，拥有更强的火力潜力。正因如此，德拉科尼斯联合体的黑道将其命名为"大师"（伪日语"伟大的死亡"），而这名字一次又一次被证明冷酷地精准。

Original: A simple direct fire configuration of the Dire Wolf, the H configuration carries a pair of Gauss Rifles as its primary long range weaponry. These are backed up by two Heavy Large Lasers for medium to short ranges. Finally, for short range combat, the H configuration has a Medium Pulse Laser and a Flamer. All of this configuration's weapons are linked to a Targeting Computer, increasing their accuracy.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_dire_wolf_DW-H.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A simple direct fire configuration of the Dire Wolf, the H configuration carries a pair of Gauss Rifles as its primary long range weaponry. These are backed up by two Heavy Large Lasers for medium to short ranges. Finally, for short range combat, the H configuration has a Medium Pulse Laser and a Flamer. All of this configuration's weapons are linked to a Targeting Computer, increasing their accuracy.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 恐狼 H 配置是一款简单的直射配置，携带两门高斯步枪作为主要远程武器。它们由两门重型大型激光支援中近距离。最后，近战方面 H 配置有一门中型脉冲激光和一具火焰喷射器。此配置的所有武器都联动一台瞄准计算机，以提升精度。

Original: The S configuration is intended for the close confines of urban and jungle warfare. The S configurations primary weapon is a massive LB-X Autocannon/20 which is capable of disabling most light and medium 'Mechs in a single blast. This is backed up by a single Large Pulse Laser to provide some long range firepower should the Dire Wolf S be caught in the open. Additional short range firepower is provided by five Medium Pulse Lasers and two Streak SRM-4 launchers. Two Anti-Personnel Pods and two Machine Guns provide exceptional anti infantry capabilities. The S configuration has added mobility with three jump jets allowing it to jump up to ninety meters.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_dire_wolf_DW-S.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The S configuration is intended for the close confines of urban and jungle warfare. The S configurations primary weapon is a massive LB-X Autocannon/20 which is capable of disabling most light and medium 'Mechs in a single blast. This is backed up by a single Large Pulse Laser to provide some long range firepower should the Dire Wolf S be caught in the open. Additional short range firepower is provided by five Medium Pulse Lasers and two Streak SRM-4 launchers. Two Anti-Personnel Pods and two Machine Guns provide exceptional anti infantry capabilities. The S configuration has added mobility with three jump jets allowing it to jump up to ninety meters.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: S 配置为城市与丛林战的狭窄环境而设。S 配置的主武器是一门巨型 LB-X 自动炮/20，能一击瘫痪大多数轻中型机甲。它辅以一门大型脉冲激光，若恐狼 S 身陷开阔地可提供一些远程火力。额外近程火力来自五门中型脉冲激光和两具连续 SRM-4 发射器。两个反人员荚舱和两挺机枪提供出色的反步兵能力。S 配置通过三个跳跃推进器提升机动性，可跳跃至九十米。

Original: This Wolf's Dragoons variant is effective at both long and short range. For long range, it uses a Gauss Rifle, an ER Large Laser, and an LRM-20. At close range, an Ultra Autocannon/20, ER Small Laser, and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers provide devastating firepower. Twenty double heat sinks allow the design to almost continually fire all of its weapons.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_dire_wolf_DW-W.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Wolf's Dragoons variant is effective at both long and short range. For long range, it uses a Gauss Rifle, an ER Large Laser, and an LRM-20. At close range, an Ultra Autocannon/20, ER Small Laser, and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers provide devastating firepower. Twenty double heat sinks allow the design to almost continually fire all of its weapons.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款狼之龙骑兵变体在远程与近程都很有效。远程使用一门高斯步枪、一门 ER 大型激光和一具 LRM-20。近程则由一门超速自动炮/20、一门 ER 小型激光和一对中型脉冲激光提供毁灭性火力。二十台双倍散热器使该设计几乎能持续发射全部武器。

Original: This variant carries a Targeting Computer to guide the fire of a Large Pulse Laser, Heavy Medium Laser, twin ER Micro Lasers, an Ultra AC/10 and the solid shot of an LB 5-X autocannon. To provide missile support, the Daishi X carries an ATM 6 with a ton of each ammunition type, a head mounted Streak SRM-2, and an SRM-4 and LRM-15. The SRM-4 and LRM-15 are each equipped with an Artemis IV FCS.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_dire_wolf_DW-X.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant carries a Targeting Computer to guide the fire of a Large Pulse Laser, Heavy Medium Laser, twin ER Micro Lasers, an Ultra AC/10 and the solid shot of an LB 5-X autocannon. To provide missile support, the Daishi X carries an ATM 6 with a ton of each ammunition type, a head mounted Streak SRM-2, and an SRM-4 and LRM-15. The SRM-4 and LRM-15 are each equipped with an Artemis IV FCS.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此变体携带一台瞄准计算机，用于引导一门大型脉冲激光、一门重型中型激光、两门 ER 微型激光、一门超速 AC/10 以及一门 LB 5-X 自动炮的实心弹。为提供导弹支援，大石 X 携带一具 ATM 6（每种弹药各一吨）、一门头部安装的连续 SRM-2，以及一具 SRM-4 和一具 LRM-15。SRM-4 与 LRM-15 均配备 Artemis IV 火控系统。

Original: The 5N variant of the Dragon was used as a bridge between it and the Grand Dragon. This field upgrade, which utilizes formerly lost technology, upgrades its normal autocannon to an Ultra Autocannon/5, which is capable of firing at twice the rate of a standard model. Additionally, the rear facing Medium Laser has been removed from the 'Mech.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_dragon_DRG-5N.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5N variant of the Dragon was used as a bridge between it and the Grand Dragon. This field upgrade, which utilizes formerly lost technology, upgrades its normal autocannon to an Ultra Autocannon/5, which is capable of firing at twice the rate of a standard model. Additionally, the rear facing Medium Laser has been removed from the 'Mech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 龙的 5N 变体是它与大龙之间的过渡型号。这项野战升级利用了曾经失传的技术，将普通自动炮升级为超速自动炮/5，射速可达标准型号的两倍。此外，机上的后向中型激光被移除。

Original: Once fielded in great numbers by the Smoke Jaguars, the Ebon Jaguar has proliferated to many of Kerensky's Clans, though some, like the Wolves, Jade Falcons and Coyotes, continue to field Hellbringers instead.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_ebon_jaguar_EBJ-B.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Once fielded in great numbers by the Smoke Jaguars, the Ebon Jaguar has proliferated to many of Kerensky's Clans, though some, like the Wolves, Jade Falcons and Coyotes, continue to field Hellbringers instead.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑玉美洲豹曾由烟虎氏族大量装备，如今已扩散至克伦斯基的众多氏族，不过狼、翡翠猎鹰与郊狼等氏族仍继续装备地狱使者。

Original: The standard against which all battle armor is measured, the Elemental battle armor was first introduced in 2868 by Clan Wolf in a Trial of Possession against the Nova Cats. It was a marvel of Clan engineering that allowed a small group of operators to take down large 'Mechs and survive the encounter. While it is possible for a normal-sized human to use the battle armor, this design is tailored for the Clans' giant Elemental warriors and only they can bring out its fullest potential.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_elemental_toad.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The standard against which all battle armor is measured, the Elemental battle armor was first introduced in 2868 by Clan Wolf in a Trial of Possession against the Nova Cats. It was a marvel of Clan engineering that allowed a small group of operators to take down large 'Mechs and survive the encounter. While it is possible for a normal-sized human to use the battle armor, this design is tailored for the Clans' giant Elemental warriors and only they can bring out its fullest potential.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 元素战斗装甲是所有战斗装甲的衡量标准，由狼氏族于 2868 年在对抗诺瓦猫的占有试炼中首次推出。它是氏族工程的奇迹，能让一小队操作员击倒大型机甲并幸存下来。虽然普通体型的人也能使用这种战斗装甲，但该设计是为氏族巨人般的元素战士量身打造，唯有他们才能发挥其全部潜力。

Original: The Emperor is one of the earliest assault BattleMechs, dating back to 2502. The Emperor also bears the distinction of being the first 90+ ton BattleMech to mount jump jets (the famed Highlander began production in 2592).
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_emperor_EMP-1A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Emperor is one of the earliest assault BattleMechs, dating back to 2502. The Emperor also bears the distinction of being the first 90+ ton BattleMech to mount jump jets (the famed Highlander began production in 2592).
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 皇帝是最早的突击战斗机甲之一，可追溯至 2502 年。它还享有另一项殊荣：首款装备跳跃推进器的 90 吨以上战斗机甲（著名的高地人于 2592 年开始生产）。

Original: Developed by Cappellan Engineers just before the Clan Invasion, this Emperor is a retrofit of the standard 5A. Armed with the newly introduced Arrow IV launcher and a pair of large lasers, the 5B is built to provide fire support at long range.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_emperor_EMP-5B.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed by Cappellan Engineers just before the Clan Invasion, this Emperor is a retrofit of the standard 5A. Armed with the newly introduced Arrow IV launcher and a pair of large lasers, the 5B is built to provide fire support at long range.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款皇帝由卡佩兰工程师在氏族入侵前夕开发，是标准 5A 的改装型。它装备新推出的箭矢 IV 发射器和两门大型激光，5B 旨在提供远程火力支援。

Original: The Executioner A reduces the overall engagement ranges compared to its PRIME variant by dropping the Gauss Rifle and replacing it with a massive collection of Large Pulse Lasers, backed up by four ERML's. This variant is the nightmare for every light mech out there.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_executioner_EXE-A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Executioner A reduces the overall engagement ranges compared to its PRIME variant by dropping the Gauss Rifle and replacing it with a massive collection of Large Pulse Lasers, backed up by four ERML's. This variant is the nightmare for every light mech out there.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 与主型号相比，行刑者 A 缩短了总体交战距离：它去掉高斯步枪，换成一大批大型脉冲激光，辅以四门 ER 中型激光。此变体是外面所有轻型机甲的噩梦。

Original: The Jack-of-all-trades variant. The Executioner B is set up to be effective in all ranges the battlefield can offer. With an ERPPC for extreme and long ranges and an absolutely devastating UAC/20 for closer range brackets, the B just executes its foes by brute force. Advanced targeting systems will make sure that there is nowhere to run...nowhere to hide.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_executioner_EXE-B.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Jack-of-all-trades variant. The Executioner B is set up to be effective in all ranges the battlefield can offer. With an ERPPC for extreme and long ranges and an absolutely devastating UAC/20 for closer range brackets, the B just executes its foes by brute force. Advanced targeting systems will make sure that there is nowhere to run...nowhere to hide.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 样样通吃的变体。行刑者 B 被设定为在战场能提供的所有射程上都有效。极端与远程有 ER PPC，较近射程则有绝对毁灭性的 UAC/20，B 以蛮力处决它的敌人。先进瞄准系统确保无处可逃……无处可藏。

Original: Sometimes you just need to lob some missiles at them. The Executioner C trades direct hit firepower of its sister variants for a set of Artemis IV guided Long Range Missiles. But for everyone who believes to be able to sneak up on this monster: be warned it still fields the massive close range punch in form of an UAC/20.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_executioner_EXE-C.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sometimes you just need to lob some missiles at them. The Executioner C trades direct hit firepower of its sister variants for a set of Artemis IV guided Long Range Missiles. But for everyone who believes to be able to sneak up on this monster: be warned it still fields the massive close range punch in form of an UAC/20.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 有时你就是需要朝他们甩几发导弹。行刑者 C 以一套 Artemis IV 制导远程导弹取代其姊妹变体的直击火力。但要提醒所有以为能偷偷接近这头怪物的人：它仍然以 UAC/20 的形式保留着庞大的近距离打击力。

Original: Fast, precise, deadly. The Executioner D(isco) makes use of its phenomenal agility to close in on its enemies...just to unleash a hell of fire on them in form of pulse lasers in all colors and sizes. LPL, MPL, SPL ... you name it, the EXE-D has it. Pilots be warned though, you better bring som chilled drinks as this one is running HOT!
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_executioner_EXE-D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fast, precise, deadly. The Executioner D(isco) makes use of its phenomenal agility to close in on its enemies...just to unleash a hell of fire on them in form of pulse lasers in all colors and sizes. LPL, MPL, SPL ... you name it, the EXE-D has it. Pilots be warned though, you better bring som chilled drinks as this one is running HOT!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 快速、精准、致命。行刑者 D(isco) 利用其惊人的灵活性逼近敌人…只为用各种颜色与尺寸的脉冲激光向它们倾泻地狱之火。LPL、MPL、SPL…你能想到的，EXE-D 都有。不过要提醒飞行员：最好带上些冰镇饮料，因为这家伙跑起来很热！

Original: In a logical step up from other, earlier variants the Executioner E sticks with the idea of being effective and deadly at all ranges. ERLLs and ATMs will grant massive firepower at long and medium ranges while a bunch of Heavy Medium and Heavy Small Lasers will grant close perimeter defense...or the bit of extra damage to finish an already damaged oponent.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_executioner_EXE-E.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In a logical step up from other, earlier variants the Executioner E sticks with the idea of being effective and deadly at all ranges. ERLLs and ATMs will grant massive firepower at long and medium ranges while a bunch of Heavy Medium and Heavy Small Lasers will grant close perimeter defense...or the bit of extra damage to finish an already damaged oponent.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 行刑者 E 是对其他早期变体的合理升级，坚持在所有距离上都有效而致命。ER 大型激光和 ATM 将在远距离与中距离提供巨量火力，而一批重型中型激光和重型小型激光将提供近距离环形防御…或者用于给已受损对手补上那一点额外伤害。

Original: Fast and powerful, the Executioner, known as the Gladiator in the Inner Sphere, is an assault OmniMech developed by Clan Ghost Bear. As one of the fastest assault mechs available, the Executioner surprises its prey by being able to alter the engagement ranges way quicker than expected from a mech of this weight. The Executioner PRIME uses its speed to stay at distance to make full use of its long range weaponry.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_executioner_EXE-Prime.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fast and powerful, the Executioner, known as the Gladiator in the Inner Sphere, is an assault OmniMech developed by Clan Ghost Bear. As one of the fastest assault mechs available, the Executioner surprises its prey by being able to alter the engagement ranges way quicker than expected from a mech of this weight. The Executioner PRIME uses its speed to stay at distance to make full use of its long range weaponry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 行刑者快速而强大，在内天体被称为角斗士，是由鬼熊氏族开发的突击全能机甲。作为可用的最快突击机甲之一，行刑者能比人们对该重量机甲的预期更快地改变交战距离，从而突袭猎物。行刑者主型号利用其速度保持距离，以充分发挥远程武器的威力。

Original: The original Firebee used a single LRM-5 backed up by a trio of SRM-2s. The Primitive Engine provided a top speed of 85 km/h, more than enough to engage armored vehicles and infantry, and supporting heavier units. The lack of jump jets, combined with six and a half tons of Primitive Armor, forced pilots to pay attention to the terrain to insure they could move effectively.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_firebee_FRB-1E.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Firebee used a single LRM-5 backed up by a trio of SRM-2s. The Primitive Engine provided a top speed of 85 km/h, more than enough to engage armored vehicles and infantry, and supporting heavier units. The lack of jump jets, combined with six and a half tons of Primitive Armor, forced pilots to pay attention to the terrain to insure they could move effectively.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 原版火蜂使用一具 LRM-5，辅以三具 SRM-2。原始引擎提供 85 公里/小时的最高速度，足以与装甲车辆和步兵交战，并支援较重的单位。缺少跳跃推进器，加上六吨半的原始装甲，迫使飞行员注意地形以确保有效机动。

Original: The 2E Firebee mounts a Star Cutter 80cm Large Laser, giving it respectable firepower. Up close, four Maui Crossbow SRM-2 launcher can unleash eight missiles. Whether it is using Inferno rounds or not, something that its two tons of ammunition allows MechWarriors to utilize on a regular basis, the Firebee is a potent anti-vehicle platform.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_firebee_FRB-2E.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 2E Firebee mounts a Star Cutter 80cm Large Laser, giving it respectable firepower. Up close, four Maui Crossbow SRM-2 launcher can unleash eight missiles. Whether it is using Inferno rounds or not, something that its two tons of ammunition allows MechWarriors to utilize on a regular basis, the Firebee is a potent anti-vehicle platform.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2E 火蜂装备一门"星切"80 厘米大型激光，火力可观。近距离则四具毛伊弩炮 SRM-2 发射器可倾泻八枚导弹。无论是否使用燃烧弹——其两吨弹药让机甲战士能经常使用——火蜂都是威力强大的反车辆平台。

Original: Designed with the aim of upgrading the ageing Firebee with more advanced Star League technology, the 2Ep was still a prototype when the Succession Wars began. The only completed models of this design were lost with the destruction of the Exedor factory in the First Succession War. The design was briefly revived in the 3045, with a few surviving Firebee’s being converted as a showcase of home grown Capellan science and engineering. Armed with an ER Large Laser, dual Streak SRM-2's and augmented with the addition of a Beagle Probe, the 2Ep is a fast scout hunter and skirmisher.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_firebee_FRB-2Ep.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed with the aim of upgrading the ageing Firebee with more advanced Star League technology, the 2Ep was still a prototype when the Succession Wars began. The only completed models of this design were lost with the destruction of the Exedor factory in the First Succession War. The design was briefly revived in the 3045, with a few surviving Firebee’s being converted as a showcase of home grown Capellan science and engineering. Armed with an ER Large Laser, dual Streak SRM-2's and augmented with the addition of a Beagle Probe, the 2Ep is a fast scout hunter and skirmisher.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2Ep 旨在用更先进的星盟科技升级老化的火蜂，在继承战争爆发时仍是原型机。该设计仅有的成品随第一次继承战争中埃克塞多工厂的毁灭而遗失。该设计在 3045 年短暂复兴，几台幸存的火蜂被改装以展示卡佩兰本土科学与工程的水平。2Ep 装备一门 ER 大型激光、双联连续 SRM-2，并加装比格犬探测器，是一款快速的侦察猎手与游骑机甲。

Original: Ultimately overcoming a somewhat politically troubled birth, the OmniMech Firestarter has proven to be an highly effective and flexible design, with the Combine using it to replace other aging medium-weight workhorses such as the Phoenix Hawk
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_firestarter_FS9-O.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ultimately overcoming a somewhat politically troubled birth, the OmniMech Firestarter has proven to be an highly effective and flexible design, with the Combine using it to replace other aging medium-weight workhorses such as the Phoenix Hawk
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 全面型火焰使者最终克服了诞生时的政治波折，被证明是一款高效灵活的设计，联合体用它替代了凤凰鹰等老化的中量级主力机甲
