Original: The Firestarter is a dangerous 'Mech for its tonnage—carefully timed attacks with its Flamers can shut down any 'Mech and leave it open to punishment from your other forces.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_firestarter_FS9-PM.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Firestarter is a dangerous 'Mech for its tonnage—carefully timed attacks with its Flamers can shut down any 'Mech and leave it open to punishment from your other forces.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 火焰使者就其吨位而言是危险的机甲——以火焰喷射器精心把握时机的攻击能让任何机甲停机，使其暴露在你其他部队的打击之下。

Original: In 3055 the Taurian Concordat's Vandenburg Mechanized Industries produced limited runs of this factory refit of the Commando COM-2D using stealth and sensor packages imported from the Cappelan Confederation. While the result was an effective scout, with respectable ambush capabilities, the expense compared to the base model, and the difficulties of multinational production, kept it from widespread adoption.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_freeman_COM-2DS.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In 3055 the Taurian Concordat's Vandenburg Mechanized Industries produced limited runs of this factory refit of the Commando COM-2D using stealth and sensor packages imported from the Cappelan Confederation. While the result was an effective scout, with respectable ambush capabilities, the expense compared to the base model, and the difficulties of multinational production, kept it from widespread adoption.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3055 年，陶里安协约的范登堡机械化工业公司限量生产了这款突击队 COM-2D 的工厂改装型，使用从卡佩兰邦联进口的隐形与传感器组件。成果是一款有效的侦察机甲，具备可观的伏击能力，但与基础型号相比的高昂成本以及跨国生产的困难，使其未能被广泛采用。

Original: The D configuration of the Gargoyle is armed with two ER Large Lasers for long range combat. These are backed up for short range engagements with three highly accurate Medium Pulse Lasers and an ER Small Laser. The 'Mech is frighteningly accurate due to its advanced Targeting Computer, which increases the accuracy of all the weapons in this configuration.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_gargoyle_GAR-D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The D configuration of the Gargoyle is armed with two ER Large Lasers for long range combat. These are backed up for short range engagements with three highly accurate Medium Pulse Lasers and an ER Small Laser. The 'Mech is frighteningly accurate due to its advanced Targeting Computer, which increases the accuracy of all the weapons in this configuration.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 石像鬼 D 配置装备两门 ER 大型激光用于远程战斗。近程则由三门极为精准的中型脉冲激光和一门 ER 小型激光支援。由于配备先进瞄准计算机，该机甲精准得令人恐惧——它会提升此配置下所有武器的精度。

Original: Configured to take advantage of new Heavy Laser technology, the H configuration is a capable 'Mech at any range. For long range jousting with an enemy, the 'Mech has an LRM-10 launcher. This is backed up by an Ultra Autocannon/10 and a new Heavy Large Laser for intermediate ranges. Finally, for added punch at close range, the 'Mech has two ER Medium Lasers.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_gargoyle_GAR-H.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Configured to take advantage of new Heavy Laser technology, the H configuration is a capable 'Mech at any range. For long range jousting with an enemy, the 'Mech has an LRM-10 launcher. This is backed up by an Ultra Autocannon/10 and a new Heavy Large Laser for intermediate ranges. Finally, for added punch at close range, the 'Mech has two ER Medium Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: H 配置旨在利用新型重型激光技术，在任何距离上都能胜任。与敌人远程周旋时，它有一具 LRM-10 发射器。它由中距离的一门超速自动炮/10 和一门新型重型大型激光支援。最后，为增强近距离打击，机甲配有两门 ER 中型激光。

Original: At its core this is still a typical Periphery FrankenMech, but it received a lot of care from 'Her' owner, named after a infamous Terran Pirate Queen, does this specific design sport a Thumper Artillery Piece and munitions from the Barrymore Munitions manufacturers, granting superior Tactical Flexibility.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_grace_COR-S7.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: At its core this is still a typical Periphery FrankenMech, but it received a lot of care from 'Her' owner, named after a infamous Terran Pirate Queen, does this specific design sport a Thumper Artillery Piece and munitions from the Barrymore Munitions manufacturers, granting superior Tactical Flexibility.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 本质上它仍是典型的外围区拼装机甲，但它得到了"她"的主人——以一位臭名昭著的泰拉海盗女王命名——的精心照料。这款特定设计装备一门重锤火炮与巴里摩尔弹药公司的弹药，赋予其卓越的战术灵活性。

Original: The DGR-5K Grand Dragon introduced in 3050 incorporates a number of lostech improvements over the original DRG-1G.Mounted in its right arm is a Lord's Light 2 ER PPC. The ER PPC is backed up by a LRM-10 in the center torso, which gives the 'Mech an impressive and formidable long-range striking capability. The launcher is fed by a two-ton reload bin in the left torso protected by CASE. If an enemy 'Mech gets into close ranges, the Grand Dragon carries three Victory 23R Medium Lasers for defense, one in the left arm and two split between the rear-facing left and right torso. Protected by ten tons of armor, the Grand Dragon uses thirteen double heat sinks for excellent heat management and uses a 16.5 ton Hermes 360 XL engine to achieve a moderate cruising speed of 64 km/h.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_granddragon_DRG-5K.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The DGR-5K Grand Dragon introduced in 3050 incorporates a number of lostech improvements over the original DRG-1G.Mounted in its right arm is a Lord's Light 2 ER PPC. The ER PPC is backed up by a LRM-10 in the center torso, which gives the 'Mech an impressive and formidable long-range striking capability. The launcher is fed by a two-ton reload bin in the left torso protected by CASE. If an enemy 'Mech gets into close ranges, the Grand Dragon carries three Victory 23R Medium Lasers for defense, one in the left arm and two split between the rear-facing left and right torso. Protected by ten tons of armor, the Grand Dragon uses thirteen double heat sinks for excellent heat management and uses a 16.5 ton Hermes 360 XL engine to achieve a moderate cruising speed of 64 km/h.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3050 年推出的 DGR-5K 大龙在原版 DRG-1G 基础上融入了多项失传技术改进。右臂装一门"主之光 2"ER PPC。这门 ER PPC 由中央躯干一具 LRM-10 支援，为机甲带来惊人而强劲的远程打击能力。发射器由左躯干一个受 C.A.S.E. 保护的两吨弹药箱供弹。若敌方机甲逼近，大龙携带三门"胜利 23R"中型激光用于防御，一门在左臂，两门分置于后向左、右躯干。由十吨装甲保护，大龙使用十三台双倍散热器实现出色的散热管理，并采用一台 16.5 吨的赫尔墨斯 360 XL 引擎达到 64 公里/小时的中等巡航速度。

Original: Modified specifically to carry a C3 slave unit into combat, the C is a modification of the DRG-5K introduced in 3050. The 'Mech carries a C3 slave in the place of its rear-facing medium laser. While this does reduce the Grand Dragons short range firepower somewhat, it also makes the machine far more accurate when working in a C3 lance.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_granddragon_DRG-C.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Modified specifically to carry a C3 slave unit into combat, the C is a modification of the DRG-5K introduced in 3050. The 'Mech carries a C3 slave in the place of its rear-facing medium laser. While this does reduce the Grand Dragons short range firepower somewhat, it also makes the machine far more accurate when working in a C3 lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: C 型专为把 C3 从属单元带入战斗而改装，是 3050 年推出的 DRG-5K 的改装版。机甲用后向中型激光的位置安装一台 C3 从属单元。这虽在一定程度上降低了大龙的近程火力，却使它在 C3 小队中作战时精准得多。

Original: The Grand Dragon 3K is a beefy machine that can take a serious beating and carries heavier weaponry than its smaller cousin. Equipped with a heavy-duty gyro, a PPC and Gauss rifle, this variant is a formidable heavy weapons platform.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_grand_dragon_DRG-3K.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Grand Dragon 3K is a beefy machine that can take a serious beating and carries heavier weaponry than its smaller cousin. Equipped with a heavy-duty gyro, a PPC and Gauss rifle, this variant is a formidable heavy weapons platform.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 大龙 3K 是一台强壮的机器，能承受严重打击，并携带比其小型表亲更重的武器。它配备重型陀螺仪、一门 PPC 和一门高斯步枪，是令人敬畏的重型武器平台。

Original: The 1DS variant of the Griffin, built by Defiance Industries, Kallon Industries and Norse BattleMech Works from their respective production lines starting in 3049, was intended to become the new standard model for the Federated Commonwealth. The engine was upgraded to Hermes 275 extralight engine, fourteen double heat sinks improved cooling and the weapons were stripped from the chassis. The 'Mech now carried a Doombud LRM-20 launcher over the right shoulder and a Thunderbolt-12 Large Pulse Laser in the right arm. It also employed CASE to protect the two tons of missile reloads stored in the left torso. The capture of Norse BattleMech on Marduk by the Draconis Combine meant this variant was also employed by the Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_griffin_GRF-1DS.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 1DS variant of the Griffin, built by Defiance Industries, Kallon Industries and Norse BattleMech Works from their respective production lines starting in 3049, was intended to become the new standard model for the Federated Commonwealth. The engine was upgraded to Hermes 275 extralight engine, fourteen double heat sinks improved cooling and the weapons were stripped from the chassis. The 'Mech now carried a Doombud LRM-20 launcher over the right shoulder and a Thunderbolt-12 Large Pulse Laser in the right arm. It also employed CASE to protect the two tons of missile reloads stored in the left torso. The capture of Norse BattleMech on Marduk by the Draconis Combine meant this variant was also employed by the Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狮鹫的 1DS 变体由迪法恩斯工业、卡隆工业和北欧战斗机甲厂自 3049 年起在各自生产线上制造，意在成为联邦联邦的新标准型号。引擎升级为赫尔墨斯 275 超轻型引擎，十四台双倍散热器改善散热，武器则从底盘上全部拆除。机甲右肩上方安装末日芽 LRM-20 发射器，右臂装备雷霆-12 大型脉冲激光。它还使用 C.A.S.E. 保护存于左躯干的两吨导弹再装填。北欧战斗机甲在马尔杜克被德拉科尼斯联合体夺取，意味着该变体也被德拉科尼斯联合体征募兵部队使用。
装备氏族科技升级的狮鹫。

Original: The Grim Reaper was a 'Mech designed by ComStar to help replenish the heavy material losses suffered by the Com Guards during the Battle of Tukayyid, with the Word of Blake maintaining production after it captured Terra to help rebuild and expand the Word of Blake Militia. Thus the Grim Reaper is seen in moderate numbers in both secular and fanatical militaries. Designed to be a generic trooper 'Mech, the Grim Reaper carries a varied and non specialized weapons payload.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_grim_reaper_GRM-R-PR29.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Grim Reaper was a 'Mech designed by ComStar to help replenish the heavy material losses suffered by the Com Guards during the Battle of Tukayyid, with the Word of Blake maintaining production after it captured Terra to help rebuild and expand the Word of Blake Militia. Thus the Grim Reaper is seen in moderate numbers in both secular and fanatical militaries. Designed to be a generic trooper 'Mech, the Grim Reaper carries a varied and non specialized weapons payload.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 死神是康星设计的机甲，用于补充康卫在图卡伊德战役中遭受的严重物资损失，布雷克之言在夺取地球后维持生产，以协助重建和扩充布雷克之言民兵。因此死神在世俗与狂热两方的军队中都有中等数量的装备。作为一款通用士兵机甲，死神携带多样而非专精的武器配置。

Original: The Grizzly is a BattleMech that was developed by Clan Ghost Bear scientists in the 30th century. Unfortunately, the design excels at no one thing, so it never carved a niche in the Clan's touman.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_grizzly_GRZ-1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Grizzly is a BattleMech that was developed by Clan Ghost Bear scientists in the 30th century. Unfortunately, the design excels at no one thing, so it never carved a niche in the Clan's touman.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 灰熊是鬼熊氏族科学家在三十世纪开发的战斗机甲。遗憾的是，该设计在任何方面都不出众，因此从未在氏族的图曼中占据一席之地。

Original: Developed in parallel with the standard Hammer 3M, the 3G is a cheap side grade designed for garrison and budget conscious buyers. The expensive Endo Steel is removed along with the Artemis IV system, dramatically decreasing the cost and relatability of the mech. Popular with many smaller mercenary units and on backwater garrisons every where through Marik space, the design is liked by Mektechs everywhere for the ease of maintenance and ready supply of replacement parts.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hammer_HMR-3G.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed in parallel with the standard Hammer 3M, the 3G is a cheap side grade designed for garrison and budget conscious buyers. The expensive Endo Steel is removed along with the Artemis IV system, dramatically decreasing the cost and relatability of the mech. Popular with many smaller mercenary units and on backwater garrisons every where through Marik space, the design is liked by Mektechs everywhere for the ease of maintenance and ready supply of replacement parts.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3G 与标准战锤 3M 同期开发，是一款面向驻防与预算敏感买家的廉价副线产品。它去掉了昂贵的内部骨骼与 Artemis IV 系统，大幅降低成本并提升可维护性。它在许多较小佣兵部队和马里克空间各处偏远驻军中广受欢迎，也因易于维护、备件供应充足而受各地机甲技师的喜爱。

Original: The original version produced during 3039. Though lacking the LosTech of the HTM-27, the single production run of the original field-test Hatamoto-Chi completed on the verge of the War of 3039 came as a total shock to the attacking Lyran and Davion Forces. Since it was built on a standard chassis, the 26T had less armor, one less heat sink, and single ton of SRM ammunition in a standard ammo bin.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hatamoto-chi_HTM-26T.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original version produced during 3039. Though lacking the LosTech of the HTM-27, the single production run of the original field-test Hatamoto-Chi completed on the verge of the War of 3039 came as a total shock to the attacking Lyran and Davion Forces. Since it was built on a standard chassis, the 26T had less armor, one less heat sink, and single ton of SRM ammunition in a standard ammo bin.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初版本于 3039 年生产。尽管缺少 HTM-27 的失落科技，原版野战测试型旗本-血的唯一一次量产恰在 3039 年战争前夕完成，令进攻的莱兰与达维昂部队大为震惊。由于建立在标准底盘上，26T 装甲较少、少一台散热器，SRM 弹药也仅有一吨存于标准弹药箱中。

Original: Constructed with an Earthwerks VOL Endo Steel chassis, fitted with CASE protected ammo bins and clad in fifteen and a half tons of Mitchell Argon armor, the Hatamoto-Chi shared the features which made its parent design a nearly indestructible zombie 'Mech. The main area that Combine was unable to replicate the Thug was the older design's advanced Double Heat Sinks, eighteen standard Heat Sinks giving the Hatamoto-Chi a high heat curve in heavy combat.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hatamoto-chi_HTM-27T.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Constructed with an Earthwerks VOL Endo Steel chassis, fitted with CASE protected ammo bins and clad in fifteen and a half tons of Mitchell Argon armor, the Hatamoto-Chi shared the features which made its parent design a nearly indestructible zombie 'Mech. The main area that Combine was unable to replicate the Thug was the older design's advanced Double Heat Sinks, eighteen standard Heat Sinks giving the Hatamoto-Chi a high heat curve in heavy combat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 旗本-血采用地球工厂 VOL 内骨骼底盘建造，装有 C.A.S.E. 保护的弹药箱，披挂十五吨半米切尔氢装甲，共享了使其母设计成为近乎不可摧毁的"僵尸"机甲的特征。联合体唯一无法复制"暴徒"的地方是那款老设计的先进双倍散热器，十八台标准散热器使旗本-血在激烈战斗中热量曲线偏高。

Original: The 27V, known within the Combine as the Hatamoto-Kaze, is a variant focused on long range combat. The 'Mech removes both of the SRM-6 launchers and replaces them with a pair of LRM-5 launchers, giving the Hatamoto-Kaze the ability to stay back from the battlefield and provide indirect fire.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hatamoto-chi_HTM-27V.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 27V, known within the Combine as the Hatamoto-Kaze, is a variant focused on long range combat. The 'Mech removes both of the SRM-6 launchers and replaces them with a pair of LRM-5 launchers, giving the Hatamoto-Kaze the ability to stay back from the battlefield and provide indirect fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 27V 在联合体内部被称为旗本-风，是一款专注远程战斗的变体。它移除两具 SRM-6 发射器，换成两具 LRM-5，使旗本-风能远离战场提供间接火力。

Original: The 27W, also known as the Hatamoto-Ku, removes both of the SRM-6 launchers and replaces them with an Autocannon5. The 'Mech has a powerful direct fire capability.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hatamoto-chi_HTM-27W.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 27W, also known as the Hatamoto-Ku, removes both of the SRM-6 launchers and replaces them with an Autocannon5. The 'Mech has a powerful direct fire capability.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 27W 又称旗本-空，移除两具 SRM-6 发射器，换成一门自动炮5。该机甲具备强大的直射火力。

Original: The precursor to the 1H, the 0H was a flawed design that ran too hot and had insufficient armament or heat sinks for sustained combat. Armed with a Howitzer in place of the iconic Sniper piece, it lacks the range and stopping power of the later versions, whilst running significantly hotter due to the second large laser it mounted. Only a couple of test models were every introduced and the design was lost to the mists of history with the debut of the 1H and then the 2H, in 2480. Occasionally Helepolises in the periphery will be rebuilt along similar lines, the prized Sniper artillery pieces stripped off for other uses and local hardware retrofitted in its place.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_helepolis_HEP-0H.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The precursor to the 1H, the 0H was a flawed design that ran too hot and had insufficient armament or heat sinks for sustained combat. Armed with a Howitzer in place of the iconic Sniper piece, it lacks the range and stopping power of the later versions, whilst running significantly hotter due to the second large laser it mounted. Only a couple of test models were every introduced and the design was lost to the mists of history with the debut of the 1H and then the 2H, in 2480. Occasionally Helepolises in the periphery will be rebuilt along similar lines, the prized Sniper artillery pieces stripped off for other uses and local hardware retrofitted in its place.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为 1H 的前身，0H 是一个有缺陷的设计：过热严重，武器与散热器都不足以支撑持续战斗。它以一门榴弹炮取代标志性的狙击炮，既缺乏后期版本的射程与停止力，又因装有第二门大型激光而热得多。仅制造过几台测试型号，随着 2480 年 1H 与 2H 的问世，该设计湮没于历史迷雾中。外围区偶尔会按类似思路重建攻城塔，把珍贵的狙击炮拆下另作他用，改装本地硬件顶上。

Original: The earliest version used standard heat sinks and its Primitive Engine could only manage 30 km/h. This proved to be a challenge as the early Helepolis needed to completely stop to fire the Sniper artillery and then start moving again before counter-battery fire could destroy the unit. Twenty and a half tons of Primitive Armor protected the Helepolis from enemy fire. The weight and bulk of the primitive systems prevented the designers from installing the long range missiles used on later models.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_helepolis_HEP-1H.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The earliest version used standard heat sinks and its Primitive Engine could only manage 30 km/h. This proved to be a challenge as the early Helepolis needed to completely stop to fire the Sniper artillery and then start moving again before counter-battery fire could destroy the unit. Twenty and a half tons of Primitive Armor protected the Helepolis from enemy fire. The weight and bulk of the primitive systems prevented the designers from installing the long range missiles used on later models.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最早版本使用标准散热器，其原始引擎仅能维持 30 公里/小时。这构成了挑战：早期攻城塔必须完全停下才能发射狙击炮，然后在对炮反击摧毁它之前再次启动。二十吨半的原始装甲保护攻城塔免受敌方火力。原始系统的重量与体积使设计师无法安装后期型号使用的远程导弹。

Original: First unleashed by the Terran Hegemony in 2460, the Helepolis is a ponderous BattleMech designed to deliver artillery fire. The 'Mech was proven ineffective on multiple occasions and, following the destruction of the production facilities in 2775, the design was lost during the Succession Wars. The HEP-2H dates to 2488.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_helepolis_HEP-2H.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: First unleashed by the Terran Hegemony in 2460, the Helepolis is a ponderous BattleMech designed to deliver artillery fire. The 'Mech was proven ineffective on multiple occasions and, following the destruction of the production facilities in 2775, the design was lost during the Succession Wars. The HEP-2H dates to 2488.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 攻城塔于 2460 年由地球霸权首次推出，是一款笨重的战斗机甲，用于投送炮火。它多次被证明效果不佳，2775 年生产设施被毁后，该设计在继承战争中失传。HEP-2H 可追溯至 2488 年。

Original: The Helepolis is built around an Armstrong Industries Sniper Artillery Piece. The accurate, long-range fire makes it effective against static defenses. The 'Mech does carry some backup weapons to augment its screening forces. It can defend itself with a Coventry Starfire LRM-10 and Nova Large Laser. If an enemy gets close, the MechWarrior can call upon a Thunderstroke SRM-6 and a Starflash Medium Laser. This 2625 model upgrades the Large Laser to an ER Large Laser.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_helepolis_HEP-3H.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Helepolis is built around an Armstrong Industries Sniper Artillery Piece. The accurate, long-range fire makes it effective against static defenses. The 'Mech does carry some backup weapons to augment its screening forces. It can defend itself with a Coventry Starfire LRM-10 and Nova Large Laser. If an enemy gets close, the MechWarrior can call upon a Thunderstroke SRM-6 and a Starflash Medium Laser. This 2625 model upgrades the Large Laser to an ER Large Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 攻城塔以阿姆斯特朗工业的狙击炮为核心。精准的远程火力使其对固定防御极为有效。该机甲确实携带一些备用武器以增强其掩护部队。它可用一门考文垂"星火"LRM-10 和一门新星大型激光自卫。若敌人逼近，机甲战士还能依靠一门雷霆 SRM-6 和一门星光中型激光。此 2625 型号将大型激光升级为 ER 大型激光。

Original: The Hellbringer A bears similarities in design and appearance to the classic Warhammer. The primary weapons are indeed a pair of ER PPCs.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hellbringer_HBR-A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hellbringer A bears similarities in design and appearance to the classic Warhammer. The primary weapons are indeed a pair of ER PPCs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 地狱使者 A 在设计上与经典战锤相似，外观也近似。主武器确实是两门 ER PPC。

Original: With a high damage profile at long and short range, the Hellbringer B does not utilize energy weapons as much, and so has few issues with heat buildup.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hellbringer_HBR-B.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: With a high damage profile at long and short range, the Hellbringer B does not utilize energy weapons as much, and so has few issues with heat buildup.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凭借远程与近程的高伤害曲线，地狱使者 B 不太使用能量武器，因此在积热上问题不大。

Original: The Hellbringer C is a Mech that appears to be a Jack of all trades. It does not accel at any one role but can apply damage at any range.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hellbringer_HBR-C.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hellbringer C is a Mech that appears to be a Jack of all trades. It does not accel at any one role but can apply damage at any range.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 地狱使者 C 是一台看似样样通吃的机甲。它在任何单一角色上都不出众，却能在任何距离上施加伤害。

Original: This variant carries a pair of LB 10-X's, one in each arm, supported by an ER Medium Laser. Another pair of ER Medium Lasers and a single SRM-6 launcher round out the weapons.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hellbringer_HBR-F.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant carries a pair of LB 10-X's, one in each arm, supported by an ER Medium Laser. Another pair of ER Medium Lasers and a single SRM-6 launcher round out the weapons.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此变体携带两门 LB 10-X，每臂一门，由一门 ER 中型激光支援。另有一对 ER 中型激光和一具 SRM-6 发射器补全武器配置。

Original: The Hellbringer GP is a laser heavy version of the mech. Designed for sustained duration combat, this mech can always go the distance.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hellbringer_HBR-GP.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hellbringer GP is a laser heavy version of the mech. Designed for sustained duration combat, this mech can always go the distance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 地狱使者 GP 是该机甲的重激光版本。它为持久战而设计，总能坚持到底。

Original: The Hellbringer H bears similarities in design and appearance to the classic Warhammer. The primary weapons are indeed a pair of ER PPCs.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hellbringer_HBR-H.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hellbringer H bears similarities in design and appearance to the classic Warhammer. The primary weapons are indeed a pair of ER PPCs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 地狱使者 H 在设计上与经典战锤相似，外观也近似。主武器确实是两门 ER PPC。

Original: The Hellbringer Prime bears similarities in design and appearance to the classic Warhammer. The primary weapons are indeed a pair of ER PPCs.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hellbringer_HBR-Prime.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hellbringer Prime bears similarities in design and appearance to the classic Warhammer. The primary weapons are indeed a pair of ER PPCs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 地狱使者主型号在设计上与经典战锤相似，外观也近似。主武器确实是两门 ER PPC。

Original: The Highlander is one of the most well-known Star League Defense Force assault 'Mechs, serving with distinction for almost two centuries since first entering service in 2592. Initially designed as a dedicated city and installation defender, the original model featured a variety of weaponry along with fifteen and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, but perhaps its most useful asset were the three Hildco jump jets giving it a jumping range of 90 meters. The heaviest 'Mech design to feature jump jets at the time, their original task was to allow the Highlander the ability to jump over inconvenient obstacles such as buildings and outpace other 'Mechs with a faster ground speed, but because of this increased mobility and its versatile weaponry the Highlander proved to be a capable fighter on any battlefield and within decades nearly every BattleMech regiment of the Regular and Royal Armies featured them. However it was during the design's initial trial runs that pilots began using these 'Mechs in what would infamously become known as the "Highlander Burial". Leaping into the air and landing directly on their enemy, a Highlander could literally drive a light 'Mech into the ground. So successful was this maneuver that the design team re-engineered the legs to withstand repeated death-from-above attacks and turned what had been a desperation move into an art form, giving Highlander pilots an additional psychological edge.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_highlander_HGN-732.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Highlander is one of the most well-known Star League Defense Force assault 'Mechs, serving with distinction for almost two centuries since first entering service in 2592. Initially designed as a dedicated city and installation defender, the original model featured a variety of weaponry along with fifteen and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, but perhaps its most useful asset were the three Hildco jump jets giving it a jumping range of 90 meters. The heaviest 'Mech design to feature jump jets at the time, their original task was to allow the Highlander the ability to jump over inconvenient obstacles such as buildings and outpace other 'Mechs with a faster ground speed, but because of this increased mobility and its versatile weaponry the Highlander proved to be a capable fighter on any battlefield and within decades nearly every BattleMech regiment of the Regular and Royal Armies featured them. However it was during the design's initial trial runs that pilots began using these 'Mechs in what would infamously become known as the "Highlander Burial". Leaping into the air and landing directly on their enemy, a Highlander could literally drive a light 'Mech into the ground. So successful was this maneuver that the design team re-engineered the legs to withstand repeated death-from-above attacks and turned what had been a desperation move into an art form, giving Highlander pilots an additional psychological edge.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 高地人是星盟防卫军最知名的突击机甲之一，自 2592 年首次服役以来已光荣服役近两个世纪。它最初被设计为专职的城市与设施防御者，原版型号装备多种武器与十五吨半铁纤维装甲，但也许最宝贵的资产是三个希尔德科跳跃推进器，赋予它 90 米的跳跃距离。作为当时配备跳跃推进器的最重机甲设计，它们最初的任务是让高地人能跃过建筑之类碍事的障碍，并追上地面速度更快的其他机甲；但由于这一增强的机动性和多用途武器，高地人在任何战场上都证明是能干的战士，数十年内常备军与皇家军几乎每个战斗机甲团都装备了它。然而在该设计的初期试跑中，飞行员开始以后来臭名昭著的"高地人葬礼"方式使用这些机甲。跃入空中并直接落在敌人头上，高地人能真把一台轻型机甲踩进地里。这一战术如此成功，设计团队重新设计了腿部以承受反复的"从天而降之死"，把原本的绝望之举变成了一门艺术，为高地人飞行员增添了额外的心理优势。

Original: One of the most popular Star League BattleMechs, many a Highlander accompanied General Aleksandr Kerensky into exile. Some were mothballed, but many found their way into the toumans of the Clans. As technology advanced, the weapons systems were upgraded until the design known as the Highlander IIC finally emerged. With the use of newer, lighter weapons, the damage potential of the Highlander has roughly doubled. The IIC also contains enough ammunition that it rarely needs to conserve any during Trials. Clan scientists were forced to rearrange the placement of some weapons within the 'Mech to allow it proper ammo feeds, but the design is largely unchanged. It carries the maximum amount of Ferro-Fibrous armor that can be crammed on the frame, fourteen and a half tons. As with the original, the IIC carries enough jump jets to move up to ninety meters at a time, allowing MechWarriors to execute the Highlander Burial.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_highlander_iic_HGN-IIC-1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the most popular Star League BattleMechs, many a Highlander accompanied General Aleksandr Kerensky into exile. Some were mothballed, but many found their way into the toumans of the Clans. As technology advanced, the weapons systems were upgraded until the design known as the Highlander IIC finally emerged. With the use of newer, lighter weapons, the damage potential of the Highlander has roughly doubled. The IIC also contains enough ammunition that it rarely needs to conserve any during Trials. Clan scientists were forced to rearrange the placement of some weapons within the 'Mech to allow it proper ammo feeds, but the design is largely unchanged. It carries the maximum amount of Ferro-Fibrous armor that can be crammed on the frame, fourteen and a half tons. As with the original, the IIC carries enough jump jets to move up to ninety meters at a time, allowing MechWarriors to execute the Highlander Burial.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 高地人是星盟最受欢迎的战斗机甲之一，许多随亚历山大·克伦斯基将军流亡。有些被封存，但许多进入了氏族的图曼。随着技术进步，武器系统不断升级，最终诞生了被称为高地人 IIC 的设计。凭借更新更轻的武器，高地人的伤害潜力几乎翻倍。IIC 还携带充足弹药，在试炼中几乎无需节省。氏族科学家被迫重新安排机内部分武器的位置以使其供弹顺畅，但设计大体未变。它携带了框架所能容纳的最大量铁纤维装甲——十四吨半。与原版一样，IIC 携带足以一次移动九十米的跳跃推进器，使机甲战士能施展"高地人埋葬"。

Original: One of the most popular Star League BattleMechs, many a Highlander accompanied General Aleksandr Kerensky into exile. Some were mothballed, but many found their way into the toumans of the Clans. As technology advanced, the weapons systems were upgraded until the design known as the Highlander IIC finally emerged. With the use of newer, lighter weapons, the damage potential of the Highlander has roughly doubled. The IIC also contains enough ammunition that it rarely needs to conserve any during Trials. Clan scientists were forced to rearrange the placement of some weapons within the 'Mech to allow it proper ammo feeds, but the design is largely unchanged. It carries the maximum amount of Ferro-Fibrous armor that can be crammed on the frame, fourteen and a half tons. As with the original, the IIC carries enough jump jets to move up to ninety meters at a time, allowing MechWarriors to execute the Highlander Burial. This version introduced 3077 carries a HAG/20 with 4 tons of ammunition for long battlefield endurance and ECM Suite instead of the standard Gauss Rifle.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_highlander_iic_HGN-IIC-A.Details

Original: The F5 variant, called the Hollander II, is a variant of the Hollander that looks to alleviate the 'Mech's problems by building it on a chassis ten tons heavier than the original, pushing it into the medium weight class. First built in 3058 the 'Mech still carries a Gauss Rifle as its primary weapon, but is backed up by a single Medium Laser and a Streak SRM-2 launcher.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hollander_ii_BZK-F5.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The F5 variant, called the Hollander II, is a variant of the Hollander that looks to alleviate the 'Mech's problems by building it on a chassis ten tons heavier than the original, pushing it into the medium weight class. First built in 3058 the 'Mech still carries a Gauss Rifle as its primary weapon, but is backed up by a single Medium Laser and a Streak SRM-2 launcher.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 名为荷兰人 II 的 F5 变体是荷兰人的改型，试图通过把底盘加重十吨、跨入中量级来解决机甲的问题。它于 3058 年首次建造，仍以高斯步枪为主武器，但辅以一门中型激光和一具连续 SRM-2 发射器。

Original: The F7, debuting in 3061 is a modification of the F5 that takes advantage of the Hollander II's larger weapons payload to mount the Lyran Alliance's new Heavy Gauss Rifle, which is capable of causing a great deal of damage at short to medium ranges. While improving upon the firepower of the variant, the removal of backup weaponry to fit these massive weapon leaves it with the same problems as the original Hollander.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hollander_ii_BZK-F7.Details

While improving upon the firepower of the variant, the removal of backup weaponry to fit these massive weapon leaves it with the same problems as the original Hollander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: F7 于 3061 年亮相，是 F5 的改型，利用荷兰人 II 更大的武器负载能力搭载莱兰联盟新型重型高斯步枪，能在中近距离造成大量伤害。虽然火力优于前型，但为容纳这些巨型武器而移除备用武器，使它仍带有原版荷兰人的同样问题。

Original: Designed by the Explorer Corps to provide heavy fire support in environments unsuited to a normal tank or support unit, the 4E is a field refit that mounts a Thumper Artillery piece in place of the standard AC/20. Removing a mostly superfluous s heat sink, frees up the weight for the 4E retain it’s secondary weaponry should it be engaged by head hunter units. By 3010, the Explorer Corps had entered into a long term contract with Kali Yama Weapons to produce limited numbers of this design under licence. The design spread to other interested parties, after the Corps relaxed their licensing arrangements, following the Scarlet Fist debacle; in which the a lone Corps pilot – Larissa ‘‘Raza’’ Brooks – managed to successfully evaded the pirate band responsible for the destruction of her lance, before stalking them back to their base and levelling it with repeated Thumper volleys in the middle of the night.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hunchback_HBK-4E.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed by the Explorer Corps to provide heavy fire support in environments unsuited to a normal tank or support unit, the 4E is a field refit that mounts a Thumper Artillery piece in place of the standard AC/20. Removing a mostly superfluous s heat sink, frees up the weight for the 4E retain it’s secondary weaponry should it be engaged by head hunter units. By 3010, the Explorer Corps had entered into a long term contract with Kali Yama Weapons to produce limited numbers of this design under licence. The design spread to other interested parties, after the Corps relaxed their licensing arrangements, following the Scarlet Fist debacle; in which the a lone Corps pilot – Larissa ‘‘Raza’’ Brooks – managed to successfully evaded the pirate band responsible for the destruction of her lance, before stalking them back to their base and levelling it with repeated Thumper volleys in the middle of the night.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由探险队设计，用于在不适于常规坦克或支援单位的环境提供重型火力支援。4E 是战地改装型，以一门重锤火炮取代标准 AC/20。拆掉一只基本多余的散热器腾出重量，使 4E 在被猎杀单位接战时仍保留次要武器。到 3010 年，探险队已与卡利亚马武器公司签订长期合同，授权限量生产该设计。在"赤拳"事件后，探险队放宽了授权安排，此设计遂扩散至其他有意方；在那次事件中，探险队唯一幸存的飞行员——拉里萨·"拉扎"·布鲁克斯——成功避开了摧毁她小队的海盗团，随后追踪他们回到基地，并在深夜以反复的重锤齐射将基地夷平。

Original: During the War of 3039, the 9th Ghost regiment was engaged by the Screaming Eagles mercenary company during the Elidere IV campaign, when they decided to modify two of their Hunchbacks to carry prototype Gauss Rifles. Thus, the HBK-4GG was born, able to cause tremendous damage at ranges beyond anyone's expectations.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hunchback_HBK-4G_gauss_prototype.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: During the War of 3039, the 9th Ghost regiment was engaged by the Screaming Eagles mercenary company during the Elidere IV campaign, when they decided to modify two of their Hunchbacks to carry prototype Gauss Rifles. Thus, the HBK-4GG was born, able to cause tremendous damage at ranges beyond anyone's expectations.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3039 年战争中，第 9 幽灵团在埃利代尔 IV 战役期间与"尖叫之鹰"佣兵团交战，当时他们决定改装两台驼背以搭载原型高斯步枪。HBK-4GG 由此诞生，能在超出所有人预期的距离上造成巨大伤害。

Original: Developed during the Clan Invasion, the 5A takes advantage of the newly reintroduced Arrow IV and an Artemis IV FCS. Intended to operate in support of a lance or as part of a dedicated battery, the 5A carries a mix of homing missiles and utility ammo; enabling it to bombard targets that have been tagged by supporting forces or deploying FASCAM and other speciality ammo as and when needed. Guardian ECM confuses and blinds enemy sensors, vastly reducing the chances of accurate counter battery fire, whilst the use of CASE protects against catastrophic ammunition explosions. Sold to any interested buyer as part of Kali Yama’s contribution to the war effort, the design has been seen all across the Inner Sphere and is increasingly found in the Periphery, where reliable and cheap Artillery assets are in high demand.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hunchback_HBK-5A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed during the Clan Invasion, the 5A takes advantage of the newly reintroduced Arrow IV and an Artemis IV FCS. Guardian ECM confuses and blinds enemy sensors, vastly reducing the chances of accurate counter battery fire, whilst the use of CASE protects against catastrophic ammunition explosions. Sold to any interested buyer as part of Kali Yama’s contribution to the war effort, the design has been seen all across the Inner Sphere and is increasingly found in the Periphery, where reliable and cheap Artillery assets are in high demand.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5A 在氏族入侵期间开发，利用了新近重新引入的箭矢 IV 与 Artemis IV 火控系统。它旨在支援一个小队或作为专用炮组的一员，混合携带寻的导弹与多用途弹药；既能轰击被友军标记的目标，也能按需布撒 FASCAM 等特种弹药。守护者 ECM 扰乱并致盲敌方传感器，大幅降低其精准反炮击的可能，而 C.A.S.E. 的使用则防止灾难性的弹药爆炸。作为卡利亚马对战争努力的贡献，该设计向任何有意买家出售，已遍布内天体，并越来越多地出现在对可靠廉价火炮资产需求旺盛的外围区。

Original: The Hunchback IIC is a ClanTech refit of the venerable Hunchback. Its meager armor, coupled with paltry ammunition and lack of long-range weapons, led Inner Sphere observers to conclude that this 'Mech was a last-ditch effort for failed warriors to die with glory. In truth, the assignment of a Hunchback IIC was essentially a death sentence. Warriors given this machine were not expected to survive their next battle.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hunchback_iic_HBK-IIC-1.Details

Original: The CattleMaster was created at the turn of the thirty-first century as an IndustrialMech to handle large herd animals. The concept for the Rancher 'Mech dates back to the twenty-fourth century. The 'Mech is noted for its durability and flexible Internal Combustion Engine.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hunter_CTL-3R2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The CattleMaster was created at the turn of the thirty-first century as an IndustrialMech to handle large herd animals. The concept for the Rancher 'Mech dates back to the twenty-fourth century. The 'Mech is noted for its durability and flexible Internal Combustion Engine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 牧牛人于三十一世纪之交被制造为工业机甲，用于处置大型畜群。这类"牧场主"机甲的概念可追溯至二十四世纪。此机甲以其耐用性和灵活的内燃引擎著称。

Original: The primary weapon that the Huron Warrior carries is a Grizzard Gauss Rifle (Modified 210 Version) that is capable of stripping off a ton of armor with each shot at extremely long ranges. The Gauss Rifle is backed up by a Martell ER Large Laser that provides good supplemental firepower at long ranges. Finally, it is armed with a Martell Medium Pulse Laser, which gives the Huron Warrior the ability to protect itself at short ranges.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_huron_warrior_HUR-WO-R4L.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary weapon that the Huron Warrior carries is a Grizzard Gauss Rifle (Modified 210 Version) that is capable of stripping off a ton of armor with each shot at extremely long ranges. The Gauss Rifle is backed up by a Martell ER Large Laser that provides good supplemental firepower at long ranges. Finally, it is armed with a Martell Medium Pulse Laser, which gives the Huron Warrior the ability to protect itself at short ranges.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 休伦战士的主要武器是一门格里扎德高斯步枪（210 改进版），能在极远距离一枪削掉一吨装甲。高斯步枪辅以一门马特尔 ER 大型激光，在远距离提供良好的补充火力。最后它还装备一门马特尔中型脉冲激光，使休伦战士具备近距离自保能力。

Original: The Hussar has a single weapon on its chassis in a unique turreted mount on the center torso, an Extended Range Large Laser. While the use of a single weapon limits the defensive capabilities of the Hussar, the superior reach of the ER laser allows the 'Mech to engage enemies at a standoff range and its speed means the Hussar can dictate the range of the engagement, forcing enemies to fight on its terms. If enemies do get too close the Hussar can still engage in physical combat with kicks and punches but this is less than ideal. Ten double heat sinks are enough to keep the 'Mech cool in combat, but only one and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor makes the Hussar among the least-protected 'Mechs ever built.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hussar_HSR-200-D.Details

If enemies do get too close the Hussar can still engage in physical combat with kicks and punches but this is less than ideal. Ten double heat sinks are enough to keep the 'Mech cool in combat, but only one and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor makes the Hussar among the least-protected 'Mechs ever built.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 轻骑兵在中央躯干上一个独特的炮塔式挂架上装有其唯一武器：一门增程大型激光。虽然只有一门武器限制了轻骑兵的防御能力，但 ER 激光的优越射程使机甲能在对峙距离上交战，而其速度意味着轻骑兵能决定交战距离，迫使敌人按它的条件作战。若敌人确实逼近，轻骑兵仍能以踢击和拳击进行肉搏，但这并不理想。十台双倍散热器足以让机甲在战斗中保持低温，但仅一吨半铁纤维装甲使轻骑兵成为史上防护最少的机甲之一。

Original: An upgrade of the 200 introduced in 2735 and used exclusively by SLDF Royal units, the 200Db is powered by an XL Engine. This enables an upgrade of the 'Mech's electronics with a Beagle Active Probe and a Guardian ECM Suite in the side torsos. In addition, the armor coverage is increased to five and a half tons.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hussar_HSR-200-Db.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade of the 200 introduced in 2735 and used exclusively by SLDF Royal units, the 200Db is powered by an XL Engine. This enables an upgrade of the 'Mech's electronics with a Beagle Active Probe and a Guardian ECM Suite in the side torsos. In addition, the armor coverage is increased to five and a half tons.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 200Db 是 200 型的升级版，于 2735 年推出，专供星盟防卫军皇家部队使用，由 XL 引擎驱动。这使其得以在两侧躯干加装比格犬主动探测器和守护者 ECM 套件来升级电子设备。此外装甲覆盖增至五吨半。

Original: The 300-D Hussar is a simple downgrade of the 200-D Hussar, gifted to the Draconis Combine by ComStar in 3035. The primary changes in the design are the replacement of the ER large laser with a standard Defiance B3L Large Laser, standard heat sinks in place of the double-strength models, and replacement of the Ferro-Fibrous armor with standard Riese Reliable armor at a negligible cost to the already weak armor protection.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hussar_HSR-300-D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 300-D Hussar is a simple downgrade of the 200-D Hussar, gifted to the Draconis Combine by ComStar in 3035. The primary changes in the design are the replacement of the ER large laser with a standard Defiance B3L Large Laser, standard heat sinks in place of the double-strength models, and replacement of the Ferro-Fibrous armor with standard Riese Reliable armor at a negligible cost to the already weak armor protection.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 300-D 骠骑兵是 200-D 骠骑兵的简单降级版，由康星于 3035 年赠予德拉科尼斯联合体。设计的主要变化是将 ER 大型激光换成标准的迪法恩斯 B3L 大型激光，双倍强度散热器换为标准型号，铁纤维装甲换成标准里瑟可靠装甲，对本就脆弱的防护影响微乎其微。

Original: This Combine variant on the 300-D was introduced in 3038. It lowers the Hussar's top speed to 126 km/h by replacing the engine with a Pitban 240. The weight saved from the smaller power plant was used to add a Medium Laser to each arm and an extra ton of armor.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hussar_HSR-350-D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Combine variant on the 300-D was introduced in 3038. It lowers the Hussar's top speed to 126 km/h by replacing the engine with a Pitban 240. The weight saved from the smaller power plant was used to add a Medium Laser to each arm and an extra ton of armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款联合体版本的 300-D 于 3038 年推出。它用皮特班 240 替换引擎，把轻骑兵的最高速度降至 126 公里/小时。较小动力装置节省的重量用于为每臂加装一门中型激光和一吨额外装甲。

Original: One of the Clanbuster upgrades developed by ComStar in 3052, the 400-D is an extreme modification of the original Hussar. The ER large laser and the engine have both been stripped from the chassis to make room for a LB-X Autocannon/10 with one ton of ammo, an additional 1.5 tons of armor and a GM 240 XL Engine, reducing the Hussar's speed to 129.6 km/h. This variant of the Hussar, due to the cluster rounds that can be fired from the LB-X Autocannon, performs admirably in anti-vehicle screening forces.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hussar_HSR-400-D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the Clanbuster upgrades developed by ComStar in 3052, the 400-D is an extreme modification of the original Hussar. The ER large laser and the engine have both been stripped from the chassis to make room for a LB-X Autocannon/10 with one ton of ammo, an additional 1.5 tons of armor and a GM 240 XL Engine, reducing the Hussar's speed to 129.6 km/h. This variant of the Hussar, due to the cluster rounds that can be fired from the LB-X Autocannon, performs admirably in anti-vehicle screening forces.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 400-D 是康星 3052 年开发的"破氏族"升级之一，是对原版骠骑兵的极端改装。ER 大型激光与引擎都被从底盘上剥离，以腾出空间装载一门 LB-X 自动炮/10（配一吨弹药）、额外 1.5 吨装甲和一台 GM 240 XL 引擎，把骠骑兵的速度降至 129.6 公里/小时。由于 LB-X 自动炮可发射集束弹，此骠骑兵变体在反车辆掩护部队中表现出色。

Original: Built with lessons learned from the Battle of Tukkayid, the 450-D is armed with an LB-5X mounted in the Right Torso. 2 tons of ammo keep the main gun well supplied, whilst a pair of ER Medium Lasers offer provide some degree of deterrence against foes closing in. Rounding out the design is an extra ton of armour, allowing it to weather heavier damage than it's predecessor.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hussar_HSR-450-D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Built with lessons learned from the Battle of Tukkayid, the 450-D is armed with an LB-5X mounted in the Right Torso. 2 tons of ammo keep the main gun well supplied, whilst a pair of ER Medium Lasers offer provide some degree of deterrence against foes closing in. Rounding out the design is an extra ton of armour, allowing it to weather heavier damage than it's predecessor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 450-D 汲取图卡伊德战役的教训建造，右躯干装有一门 LB-5X。两吨弹药让主炮补给充足，两门 ER 中型激光则对逼近的敌人提供一定威慑。设计以额外一吨装甲收尾，使其比前型能承受更重的打击。

Original: The 500-D Hussar, built by Bonn Mekarmorwerks and introduced in 3060, is armed with an ER PPC. The targeting system has been mated to an Improved C3 Computer, making it deadly accurate at long range when working closely with other units.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_hussar_HSR-500-D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 500-D Hussar, built by Bonn Mekarmorwerks and introduced in 3060, is armed with an ER PPC. The targeting system has been mated to an Improved C3 Computer, making it deadly accurate at long range when working closely with other units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 500-D 骠骑兵由波恩机甲兵工厂制造，3060 年推出，装备一门 ER PPC。其瞄准系统与改进型 C3 计算机联动，与其他单位密切协同时可在远距离实现致命精准。

Original: The Icarus II was the first homegrown BattleMech design to be mass-produced by the Free Worlds League. It was originally designed as a speedy striker to compliment the Mackie and combat vehicles with a similar speed profile.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_icarus_ii_ICR-1S.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Icarus II was the first homegrown BattleMech design to be mass-produced by the Free Worlds League. It was originally designed as a speedy striker to compliment the Mackie and combat vehicles with a similar speed profile.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 伊卡洛斯 II 是自由世界联盟首个量产的自主战斗机甲设计。它最初被设计为一款高速突击机甲，以配合麦基和速度相近的战斗车辆。

Original: The original prototype Icarus was developed at the Happen Military Reservation on Xanthe III in 2466, and was first deployed on Alula Australis in 2469. Its premiere date in official documents is listed as 2470. The prototype used primitive equipment and lacked jump jets. It had a Large Laser to complement the Small Laser. Two SRM-2s and twin Machine Guns could prove devastating to conventional troops. Only six of these were ever produced and they are all long gone. The primitive engine drove it to a maximum of 64 km/h. Ten and a half tons of Primitive Armor provided protection.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_icarus_ii_ICR-1X.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original prototype Icarus was developed at the Happen Military Reservation on Xanthe III in 2466, and was first deployed on Alula Australis in 2469. Its premiere date in official documents is listed as 2470. The prototype used primitive equipment and lacked jump jets. It had a Large Laser to complement the Small Laser. Two SRM-2s and twin Machine Guns could prove devastating to conventional troops. Only six of these were ever produced and they are all long gone. The primitive engine drove it to a maximum of 64 km/h. Ten and a half tons of Primitive Armor provided protection.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 伊卡洛斯的原始原型于 2466 年在赞瑟 III 的哈彭军事保留地开发，2469 年在南十字星首次部署。官方文件中其首秀日期列为 2470 年。原型使用原始装备且没有跳跃推进器。它有一门大型激光配合小型激光。两具 SRM-2 和双联机枪对常规部队极具毁灭性。这样的机甲只造过六台，且早已消失。原始引擎驱动它最高只到 64 公里/小时。十吨半的原始装甲提供防护。

Original: The A configuration carries a single LB-X Autocannon/2 for its excellent long range sniping capabilities. This is backed up by two ER Medium Lasers for close combat capabilities and a single Anti-Missile System for added defense against missile weapons.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_ice_ferret_IFR-A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The A configuration carries a single LB-X Autocannon/2 for its excellent long range sniping capabilities. This is backed up by two ER Medium Lasers for close combat capabilities and a single Anti-Missile System for added defense against missile weapons.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: A 配置携带一门 LB-X 自动炮/2，具备出色的远程狙击能力。它辅以两门 ER 中型激光提供近战能力，以及一套反导系统增加对导弹武器的防御。

Original: The Ice Ferret B has an ER Large Laser as its only long-range weapon. For close combat, the B configuration carries an SRM-4 and an SRM-6 launcher as well as a highly accurate Small Pulse Laser.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_ice_ferret_IFR-B.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Ice Ferret B has an ER Large Laser as its only long-range weapon. For close combat, the B configuration carries an SRM-4 and an SRM-6 launcher as well as a highly accurate Small Pulse Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 冰貂 B 只有一门 ER 大型激光作为远程武器。近战方面，B 配置携带一具 SRM-4 和一具 SRM-6 发射器，以及一门极为精准的小型脉冲激光。

Original: A fire support configuration of the Ice Ferret, the C configuration has a trio of LRM-5 launchers, each linked to an Artemis IV fire control system for increased missile accuracy. For close range defense, the 'Mech has a single ER Small Laser.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_ice_ferret_IFR-C.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A fire support configuration of the Ice Ferret, the C configuration has a trio of LRM-5 launchers, each linked to an Artemis IV fire control system for increased missile accuracy. For close range defense, the 'Mech has a single ER Small Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 冰貂 C 是冰貂的火力支援配置，装备三具 LRM-5 发射器，每具联接一套 Artemis IV 火控系统以提升导弹精度。近程防御方面，机甲有一门 ER 小型激光。

Original: In its primary configuration, the Ice Ferret is capable of acting in a variety of roles. The Ice Ferret carries an Active Probe allowing the 'Mech to detect hidden enemy units. For close combat, the Ice Ferret prime has a Streak SRM-2 launcher and an ER Small Laser. For long range engagements, the 'Mech is armed with a single ER PPC, giving it excellent long range hitting power for its size.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_ice_ferret_IFR-Prime.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In its primary configuration, the Ice Ferret is capable of acting in a variety of roles. The Ice Ferret carries an Active Probe allowing the 'Mech to detect hidden enemy units. For close combat, the Ice Ferret prime has a Streak SRM-2 launcher and an ER Small Laser. For long range engagements, the 'Mech is armed with a single ER PPC, giving it excellent long range hitting power for its size.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主配置中，冰貂能胜任多种角色。它携带主动探测器，可侦测隐藏的敌方单位。近战方面，冰貂主型号有一具连续 SRM-2 发射器和一门 ER 小型激光。远程交战时，机甲装备一门 ER PPC，就其尺寸而言拥有出色的远程打击力。

Original: The original Imp, introduced in 2793, carries an ER PPC and Medium Pulse Laser in the right and left torso. Supporting these weapons are 2 Medium Pulse Lasers mounted in the center torso and a Small Laser in the head. The left arm mounts another Medium Pulse Laser, while the right arm carries an Artemis IV enhanced LRM-20. The engine is a standard fusion model, and the missile ammunition is protected by CASE. This version was the original Imp design specified by Nicholas Kerensky and was intended for battlefield commanders.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_imp_IMP-1A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Imp, introduced in 2793, carries an ER PPC and Medium Pulse Laser in the right and left torso. Supporting these weapons are 2 Medium Pulse Lasers mounted in the center torso and a Small Laser in the head. The left arm mounts another Medium Pulse Laser, while the right arm carries an Artemis IV enhanced LRM-20. The engine is a standard fusion model, and the missile ammunition is protected by CASE. This version was the original Imp design specified by Nicholas Kerensky and was intended for battlefield commanders.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 原版 Imp 于 2793 年推出，右躯干装一门 ER PPC，左躯干一门中型脉冲激光。支援这些武器的是中央躯干两门中型脉冲激光和头部一门小型激光。左臂另装一门中型脉冲激光，右臂则携带一具 Artemis IV 增强的 LRM-20。引擎为标准聚变型号，导弹弹药由 C.A.S.E. 保护。此版本是尼古拉斯·克伦斯基指定的原始 Imp 设计，供战场指挥官使用。

Original: Similar to the Imp 1A variant, this model trades the Medium Pulse Lasers for Medium Lasers. It also trades the head mounted Small Laser for a Medium Pulse Laser. It keeps the ER PPCs and LRM-20 and Artemis IV system. The biggest change is the addition of a Guardian ECM suite in the 'Mech's right torso.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_imp_IMP-1B.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Similar to the Imp 1A variant, this model trades the Medium Pulse Lasers for Medium Lasers. It also trades the head mounted Small Laser for a Medium Pulse Laser. It keeps the ER PPCs and LRM-20 and Artemis IV system. The biggest change is the addition of a Guardian ECM suite in the 'Mech's right torso.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 与 Imp 1A 变体相似，此型号把中型脉冲激光换成中型激光。它还把头部小型激光换成中型脉冲激光。它保留 ER PPC、LRM-20 和 Artemis IV 系统。最大的变化是在机甲右躯干加装了守护者 ECM 套件。

Original: Another early version based on the Imp 1B, this variant mounts a Gauss Rifle in the right arm. The Imp 1C uses the head mounted Small Laser of the Imp 1A in place of the Medium Pulse Laser. The Guardian ECM suite is still in the right torso. One heat sink is removed, giving the Imp 1C a total of seventeen double heat sinks.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_imp_IMP-1C.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another early version based on the Imp 1B, this variant mounts a Gauss Rifle in the right arm. The Imp 1C uses the head mounted Small Laser of the Imp 1A in place of the Medium Pulse Laser. The Guardian ECM suite is still in the right torso. One heat sink is removed, giving the Imp 1C a total of seventeen double heat sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是基于 Imp 1B 的另一早期版本，此变体在右臂装一门高斯步枪。Imp 1C 用 Imp 1A 的头部小型激光取代中型脉冲激光。守护者 ECM 套件仍在右躯干。移除一台散热器，使 Imp 1C 共有十七台双倍散热器。

Original: An early variant of the Imp and the first version to be seen by the Inner Sphere, the 2E model uses all non-Star League technology. The 'Mech is armed with a pair of PPCs and an LRM-15 launcher for long range combat. For close combat, the 'Mech carries five Medium Lasers.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_imp_IMP-2E.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An early variant of the Imp and the first version to be seen by the Inner Sphere, the 2E model uses all non-Star League technology. The 'Mech is armed with a pair of PPCs and an LRM-15 launcher for long range combat. For close combat, the 'Mech carries five Medium Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Imp 的早期变体 2E 型号是内天体首见的版本，全部采用非星盟技术。它对远程战斗装备两门 PPC 和一具 LRM-15 发射器，近战则携带五门中型激光。

Original: An upgrade to the 2E model, the 3E carries, a pair of Magna Firestar ER PPCs and a Mitchell Systems LRM-15 as it's primary weapons. For closer range combat, the 'Mech relies on a Thunderbolt-12 Large Pulse Laser, backed up by two Magna 400P Medium Pulse Lasers and two Martell Model 5 Medium Lasers.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_imp_IMP-3E.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade to the 2E model, the 3E carries, a pair of Magna Firestar ER PPCs and a Mitchell Systems LRM-15 as it's primary weapons. For closer range combat, the 'Mech relies on a Thunderbolt-12 Large Pulse Laser, backed up by two Magna 400P Medium Pulse Lasers and two Martell Model 5 Medium Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3E 是 2E 型号的升级版，主武器为两门玛格纳"火之星"ER PPC 和一具米切尔系统 LRM-15。近距离战斗则依靠一门雷霆-12 大型脉冲激光，辅以两门玛格纳 400P 中型脉冲激光和两门马特尔 5 型中型激光。

Original: A massive upgrade of the Imp, the 4E model carries two ER PPCs for long range direct fire, as well as an LRM-20 launcher with an Artemis IV Fire Control System. The 'Mech carries three ER Medium Lasers for intermediate range combat. The 'Mech also carries two Medium Pulse Lasers and two ER Small Lasers for close combat. Much like the original Clan models, the 21 heat sinks are double-strength and the engine is a standard model.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_imp_IMP-4E.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A massive upgrade of the Imp, the 4E model carries two ER PPCs for long range direct fire, as well as an LRM-20 launcher with an Artemis IV Fire Control System. The 'Mech carries three ER Medium Lasers for intermediate range combat. The 'Mech also carries two Medium Pulse Lasers and two ER Small Lasers for close combat. Much like the original Clan models, the 21 heat sinks are double-strength and the engine is a standard model.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 4E 型号是 Imp 的大幅升级版，携带两门 ER PPC 用于远程直射，以及一具配 Artemis IV 火控系统的 LRM-20 发射器。机甲携带三门 ER 中型激光负责中距离战斗，还有两门中型脉冲激光和两门 ER 小型激光负责近战。与原始氏族型号很像，它的 21 台散热器是双倍强度，引擎则是标准型号。

Original: This upgrade of the Imp is built exclusively for Wolf's Dragoons using only Clan technology. The 'Mech is armed with two ER PPCs and an LRM-20 launcher with an Artemis IV Fire Control System for long range combat. For close ranges, the 'Mech carries five Medium Pulse Lasers. The Imp C is also armored with nineteen tons of armor.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_imp_IMP-C.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This upgrade of the Imp is built exclusively for Wolf's Dragoons using only Clan technology. The 'Mech is armed with two ER PPCs and an LRM-20 launcher with an Artemis IV Fire Control System for long range combat. For close ranges, the 'Mech carries five Medium Pulse Lasers. The Imp C is also armored with nineteen tons of armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款 Imp 升级版专为狼之龙骑兵建造，仅使用氏族技术。机甲装备两门 ER PPC 和一具带 Artemis IV 火控系统的 LRM-20 发射器用于远程战斗。近程方面，机甲携带五门中型脉冲激光。Imp C 还披挂十九吨装甲。

Original: A second line mech designed for settling clan duels, the laser armed Incubus has found considerable success with Clan Hell's Horses'49th Battlemech Cluster as a protomech hunter.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_incubus_vixen-1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A second line mech designed for settling clan duels, the laser armed Incubus has found considerable success with Clan Hell's Horses'49th Battlemech Cluster as a protomech hunter.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一款为氏族决斗而设计的二线机甲，以激光武装的梦魔在鬼马氏族第 49 战斗机甲集群中作为原型机甲猎手取得了相当大的成功。

Original: The Inner Sphere Standard was developed following the initial thrust of the Clan invasion, as Inner Sphere powers rushed to duplicate the battle armor technology the Clans fielded. Lacking any battlefield salvage on which to base their development though, engineers were forced to work off of ancient rumors of early power armor suits like the Nighthawk, more akin to armored Exoskeletons than the 'Toads' currently rampaging through known space, and these prototypes fared poorly during testing. It took salvage from the first victories over the Clans to truly kick-start the development of battle armor. The New Avalon Institute of Science was the first to reproduce in part the Clans' Elemental armor as the Inner Sphere Standard.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_inner_sphere_standard_IS-1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Inner Sphere Standard was developed following the initial thrust of the Clan invasion, as Inner Sphere powers rushed to duplicate the battle armor technology the Clans fielded. Lacking any battlefield salvage on which to base their development though, engineers were forced to work off of ancient rumors of early power armor suits like the Nighthawk, more akin to armored Exoskeletons than the 'Toads' currently rampaging through known space, and these prototypes fared poorly during testing. It took salvage from the first victories over the Clans to truly kick-start the development of battle armor. The New Avalon Institute of Science was the first to reproduce in part the Clans' Elemental armor as the Inner Sphere Standard.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 内天体标准型是在氏族入侵首轮攻势后开发的，当时内天体各势力竞相复制氏族装备的战斗装甲技术。然而由于缺乏战场缴获作为研发基础，工程师们只能依据"夜鹰"等早期动力装甲的古老传闻着手——它们与其说是当前肆虐已知空间的"蟾蜍"式装甲，更像是带装甲的外骨骼。这些原型在测试中表现糟糕。直到从对氏族的首次胜利中获得缴获品，战斗装甲的研发才真正起步。新阿瓦隆科学研究院率先部分复制了氏族的元素战士装甲，即内天体标准型。

Original: The Inner Sphere Standard was developed following the initial thrust of the Clan invasion, as Inner Sphere powers rushed to duplicate the battle armor technology the Clans fielded. Lacking any battlefield salvage on which to base their development though, engineers were forced to work off of ancient rumors of early power armor suits like the Nighthawk, more akin to armored Exoskeletons than the 'Toads' currently rampaging through known space, and these prototypes fared poorly during testing. It took salvage from the first victories over the Clans to truly kick-start the development of battle armor. The New Avalon Institute of Science was the first to reproduce in part the Clans' Elemental armor as the Inner Sphere Standard.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_inner_sphere_standard_IS-INF.Details

Original: The Jenner was first fielded in September 2784, the same year the Exodus fleet that would eventually become the Clans left the Inner Sphere in November. How exactly they acquired this design in that short timeframe is not known, but what is known is that the Clan version fields Clan weaponry.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_jenner_iic_JR7-IIC-1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Jenner was first fielded in September 2784, the same year the Exodus fleet that would eventually become the Clans left the Inner Sphere in November. How exactly they acquired this design in that short timeframe is not known, but what is known is that the Clan version fields Clan weaponry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 詹纳于 2784 年 9 月首次投入战场，同年的 11 月，最终成为氏族的出埃及舰队离开了内天体。他们究竟如何在如此短的时间内获得这一设计尚不清楚，但已知的是氏族版本装备的是氏族武器。

Original: This support variant replaces the short-range missile launchers with an ER Large Laser and an LRM-5. A Small Pulse Laser provides defense against conventional infantry and other units that stray too close. Its jumping capacity is increased to 270 meters.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_jenner_iic_JR7-IIC-2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This support variant replaces the short-range missile launchers with an ER Large Laser and an LRM-5. A Small Pulse Laser provides defense against conventional infantry and other units that stray too close. Its jumping capacity is increased to 270 meters.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此支援变体将短程火箭发射器换成一门 ER 大型激光和一具 LRM-5。一门小型脉冲激光提供对常规步兵和靠得太近的其他单位的防御。其跳跃能力提升至 270 米。

Name: Base_3061.mechdef_jenner_iic_JR7-IIC-3.Details
