Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 氏族科技影鹰。此变体为远程直射支援而设计。

Original: A Clan Tech Shadowhawk. A newer variant that dates to the late 3050s, the IIC 3's main gun is a Heavy Large Laser.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_shadow_hawk_iic_SHD-IIC-3.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan Tech Shadowhawk. A newer variant that dates to the late 3050s, the IIC 3's main gun is a Heavy Large Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 氏族科技影鹰。较新的变体，可追溯至 3050 年代末，IIC 3 的主炮是一门重型大型激光。

Original: A Clan Tech Shadowhawk. First fielded in 3060, the IIC 4 was resulted in a 'Mech that is visually very different from the design it is considered a variant of.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_shadow_hawk_iic_SHD-IIC-4.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan Tech Shadowhawk. First fielded in 3060, the IIC 4 was resulted in a 'Mech that is visually very different from the design it is considered a variant of.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 氏族科技影鹰。于 3060 年首次投入战场，IIC 4 造就了一台在外观上与其所归属的设计大相径庭的机甲。

Original: The original and considerably flawed prototypes were completed in 2680. Based on the Shadow Hawk SHD-2H, the 'Mech carried a Class 2 Autocannon in place of the Class 5. The SHD-X1 carried only 6.5 tons of armor for protection. Only one chassis survived multiple crashes caused by its faulty schematics. It had a top ground speed of 86.4 km/h like its progenitor, the SHD-2H, and used ten single heat sinks.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_shadow_hawk_lam_SHD-X1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original and considerably flawed prototypes were completed in 2680. Based on the Shadow Hawk SHD-2H, the 'Mech carried a Class 2 Autocannon in place of the Class 5. The SHD-X1 carried only 6.5 tons of armor for protection. Only one chassis survived multiple crashes caused by its faulty schematics. It had a top ground speed of 86.4 km/h like its progenitor, the SHD-2H, and used ten single heat sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初且缺陷颇多的原型机于 2680 年完成。以影鹰 SHD-2H 为基础，该机甲以一门 2 级自动炮取代 5 级。SHD-X1 仅有 6.5 吨装甲用于防护。因其图纸错误导致多次坠机，仅有一台机体幸存。它的最高地面速度与前辈 SHD-2H 相同，为 86.4 公里/小时，并使用十台单散热器。

Original: Allied Aerospace won the SLDF's contract to produce a series of Land-Air mechs with a design based on the venerable Shadow HawkBattleMech. Allied gave their new Land-Air 'Mech the ability to convert directly into an Aerospace Fighter. While construction was completed in 2680, thanks to the chassis' numerous flaws, lackluster performance and a number of ill-fated and publicly witnessed test-flights disasters during SLDF reviews in 2682, Allied Aerospace was forced to go back to the drawing board. The more refined X2 variant faced considerable scrutiny by SLDF evaluators in 2684, successfully meeting the SLDF's requirements but still rejected thanks to its high fuel consumption and the bad press generated by the earlier X1. Twenty SHD-X2 were built for trials with potential customers, but failed to attract any interest. Ultimately Allied scrapped the Shadow Hawk LAM program in favor of what became the considerably more successful Phoenix Hawk LAM.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_shadow_hawk_lam_SHD-X2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Allied Aerospace won the SLDF's contract to produce a series of Land-Air mechs with a design based on the venerable Shadow HawkBattleMech. Allied gave their new Land-Air 'Mech the ability to convert directly into an Aerospace Fighter. While construction was completed in 2680, thanks to the chassis' numerous flaws, lackluster performance and a number of ill-fated and publicly witnessed test-flights disasters during SLDF reviews in 2682, Allied Aerospace was forced to go back to the drawing board. The more refined X2 variant faced considerable scrutiny by SLDF evaluators in 2684, successfully meeting the SLDF's requirements but still rejected thanks to its high fuel consumption and the bad press generated by the earlier X1. Twenty SHD-X2 were built for trials with potential customers, but failed to attract any interest. Ultimately Allied scrapped the Shadow Hawk LAM program in favor of what became the considerably more successful Phoenix Hawk LAM.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 联合航空赢得星盟防卫军生产一系列陆空机甲的合同，设计以古老的影鹰战斗机甲为基础。联合航空让新型陆空机甲能直接变身为航空战斗机。虽然制造于 2680 年完成，但由于底盘缺陷众多、性能不佳，加上 2682 年星盟防卫军评审期间一系列不幸且公开可见的试飞灾难，联合航空被迫重头再来。更精细的 X2 变体于 2684 年接受了星盟评审员的严格审查，虽然成功满足星盟要求，却仍因高燃料消耗和早期 X1 造成的负面报道而被否决。二十台 SHD-X2 被造出来供潜在客户试用，却未能引起任何兴趣。最终联合航空放弃了影鹰 LAM 项目，转而投向后来相当成功的凤凰鹰 LAM。

Original: First introduced in 2467, this first generation of the Shadow Hawk employs early BattleMech technology in its weaponry, equipment and its armor. This design was first produced by Lang Industries on Caph, where it was designed as part of the Hegemony's efforts to keep ahead of the Inner Sphere's newly stolen BattleMech technology.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_shadow_hawk_SHD-1R.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: First introduced in 2467, this first generation of the Shadow Hawk employs early BattleMech technology in its weaponry, equipment and its armor. This design was first produced by Lang Industries on Caph, where it was designed as part of the Hegemony's efforts to keep ahead of the Inner Sphere's newly stolen BattleMech technology.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 影鹰的第一代于 2467 年首次推出，其武器、装备与装甲都采用早期战斗机甲技术。该设计最初由卡夫星上的朗工业制造，是霸权为保持领先于内天体新近窃取战斗机甲技术的努力的一部分。

Original: The Shadow Hawk 2Hb was designed for the Star League's Royal regiments, which changed the mission profile to favor close range engagements exclusively. The -2Hb has little at range but is deadly dangerous up close thanks to its heavy weapons load.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_shadow_hawk_SHD-2Hb.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Shadow Hawk 2Hb was designed for the Star League's Royal regiments, which changed the mission profile to favor close range engagements exclusively. The -2Hb has little at range but is deadly dangerous up close thanks to its heavy weapons load.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 影鹰 2Hb 为星盟皇家团设计，任务定位改为专门偏好近距离交战。-2Hb 在远距离几乎无能为力，但凭借重型武器装载，近身时极为凶险。

Original: The Shadow Hawk 2I variant comes with a UAC/10 coupled with a nasty Inferno Launcher, but in doing so sacrifices its jump capabilities.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_shadow_hawk_SHD-2I.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Shadow Hawk 2I variant comes with a UAC/10 coupled with a nasty Inferno Launcher, but in doing so sacrifices its jump capabilities.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 影鹰 2I 变体配备一门 UAC/10 和一具凶恶的燃烧弹发射器，但为此牺牲了跳跃能力。

Original: The Shadow Hawk 2K removes all the armaments of the original, aside from its LRM-5, and replaces them with a single PPC.  Five additional Heat Sinks are also added to help with the excess heat.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_shadow_hawk_SHD-2K.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Shadow Hawk 2K removes all the armaments of the original, aside from its LRM-5, and replaces them with a single PPC.  Five additional Heat Sinks are also added to help with the excess heat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 影鹰 2K 移除原版除 LRM-5 之外的全部武器，换成单门 PPC，并加装五台额外散热器以应对多余热量。

Original: The Shadow Hawk 2Ki was conceived during the First Succession War by the Draconis Combine in 2803. As the enraged Federated Suns pushed the Kuritan troops back, the Draconis Combine dramatically overhauled the chassis by replacing almost all of its original armaments, most notably swapping in an upgraded PPC in place of an Autocannon.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_shadow_hawk_SHD-2Ki.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Shadow Hawk 2Ki was conceived during the First Succession War by the Draconis Combine in 2803. As the enraged Federated Suns pushed the Kuritan troops back, the Draconis Combine dramatically overhauled the chassis by replacing almost all of its original armaments, most notably swapping in an upgraded PPC in place of an Autocannon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 影鹰 2Ki 由德拉科尼斯联合体于 2803 年第一次继承战争期间构想。当愤怒的联邦太阳系将库瑞塔部队击退时，联合体大幅改造底盘，替换了几乎所有原始武器，最显著的是用一门升级版 PPC 换下自动炮。

Original: The 5M Shadow Hawk is the first complete overhaul and upgrade of the design, unveiled in 3048 by Earthwerks for the Free Worlds League. The chassis has been upgraded to an Earthwerks SHD II Endo Steel frame, an additional ton of armor was added, two additional jump jets were fitted for a total jumping distance of 150 meters, the engine replaced with an extralight version of the Hermes 275, and the weapons load has undergone an almost complete renovation. The original autocannon has been updated to an Imperator Ultra Autocannon/5, the LRM launcher to a Doombud LRM-20, and the head-mounted SRM launcher to a Hovertec Streak SRM-2. The amount of ammunition carried and the left-arm medium laser are maintained, and while the number of heat sinks was reduced to ten these were upgrade to double-strength models.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_shadow_hawk_SHD-5M.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5M Shadow Hawk is the first complete overhaul and upgrade of the design, unveiled in 3048 by Earthwerks for the Free Worlds League. The chassis has been upgraded to an Earthwerks SHD II Endo Steel frame, an additional ton of armor was added, two additional jump jets were fitted for a total jumping distance of 150 meters, the engine replaced with an extralight version of the Hermes 275, and the weapons load has undergone an almost complete renovation. The original autocannon has been updated to an Imperator Ultra Autocannon/5, the LRM launcher to a Doombud LRM-20, and the head-mounted SRM launcher to a Hovertec Streak SRM-2. The amount of ammunition carried and the left-arm medium laser are maintained, and while the number of heat sinks was reduced to ten these were upgrade to double-strength models.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5M 影鹰是该设计的首次彻底翻修与升级，由地球工厂于 3048 年为自由世界联盟推出。底盘升级为地球工厂 SHD II 内骨骼框架，增加一吨装甲，加装两个跳跃推进器使总跳跃距离达 150 米，引擎换成赫尔墨斯 275 的超轻型版本，武器配置几乎全面翻新。原始自动炮升级为帝皇超速自动炮/5，LRM 发射器换为末日芽 LRM-20，头部 SRM 发射器换为霍弗泰克连续 SRM-2。弹药携带量与左臂中型激光保持不变，散热器数量虽减至十台但升级为双倍强度型号。

Original: Created by Maverick Industries, the 5MI is a redesign of House Marik’s 5M model. Designed to compete with the Griffin 1DS and other new designs, the 5MI was Mavericks attempt to win over the recalcitrant FedCom military. Focusing on improving survivability and battlefield endurance, the 5MI used new technology like DHS and an Artemis IV FSC to give it an edge. Unfortunately the design was deemed too expensive to produce and as a result the military declined to purchase any of the initial production run. Such poor performance led to the second manufacturing run being cancelled and resources diverted to more promising lines. The surviving models were sold off to various mercenary groups, though the Maverick Industries scion would use one during her time in the 10th Lyran Guards; netting the company the occasional conversion or custom order from fellow members of the regiment.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_shadow_hawk_SHD-5MI.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Created by Maverick Industries, the 5MI is a redesign of House Marik’s 5M model. Designed to compete with the Griffin 1DS and other new designs, the 5MI was Mavericks attempt to win over the recalcitrant FedCom military. Focusing on improving survivability and battlefield endurance, the 5MI used new technology like DHS and an Artemis IV FSC to give it an edge. Unfortunately the design was deemed too expensive to produce and as a result the military declined to purchase any of the initial production run. Such poor performance led to the second manufacturing run being cancelled and resources diverted to more promising lines. The surviving models were sold off to various mercenary groups, though the Maverick Industries scion would use one during her time in the 10th Lyran Guards; netting the company the occasional conversion or custom order from fellow members of the regiment.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5MI 由马弗里克工业打造，是马里克家族 5M 型号的重新设计。为与狮鹫 1DS 及其他新设计竞争，5MI 是马弗里克试图赢得顽固的联邦联邦军方青睐的尝试。它聚焦于提升生存性与战场续航力，采用双倍散热器和 Artemis IV 火控系统等新技术以取得优势。遗憾的是该设计被认为生产成本过高，军方因此拒绝购买首批量产的任何一台。如此糟糕的表现导致第二批生产被取消，资源转向更有前景的产品线。幸存的型号被卖给各佣兵团体，不过马弗里克工业的继承人曾在第十莱兰卫队服役期间使用过一台；这为公司偶尔从该团同僚那里赢得改装或定制订单。

Original: The 5S is a variant of the 5M used by the Special Forces. It replaces all standard weapons with one Large Laser, one medium pulse laser and four medium lasers. In addition, it carries a Beagle Active Probe and an ECM Suite.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_shadow_hawk_SHD-5S.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5S is a variant of the 5M used by the Special Forces. It replaces all standard weapons with one Large Laser, one medium pulse laser and four medium lasers. In addition, it carries a Beagle Active Probe and an ECM Suite.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5S 是特种部队使用的 5M 变体。它将所有标准武器换成一门大型激光、一门中型脉冲激光和四门中型激光。此外还携带比格犬主动探测器和一套 ECM 套件。

Original: Reintroduced in 3053, the Spector mounts a Magna 245 XL engine in combination with an XL Engine and an  Endo Steel chassis. It carries seven and a half tons of armor along with seven jump jets. The Spector carries a Nightwind Large Laser as its primary weapon,  backed up by a pair of Defiance B3M Medium Lasers and a single Defiance B4S Small Laser for close combat. Defensively the Spector carries a Norse Guardian ECM Suite that allows it to defend itself against advanced enemy targeting and range finding equipment.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_spector_SPR-5F.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Reintroduced in 3053, the Spector mounts a Magna 245 XL engine in combination with an XL Engine and an  Endo Steel chassis. It carries seven and a half tons of armor along with seven jump jets. The Spector carries a Nightwind Large Laser as its primary weapon,  backed up by a pair of Defiance B3M Medium Lasers and a single Defiance B4S Small Laser for close combat. Defensively the Spector carries a Norse Guardian ECM Suite that allows it to defend itself against advanced enemy targeting and range finding equipment.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 幽灵于 3053 年重新推出，采用玛格纳 245 XL 引擎，结合 XL 引擎与内骨骼底盘。它携带七吨半装甲和七个跳跃推进器。幽灵以一门风夜大型激光为主武器，辅以两门迪法恩斯 B3M 中型激光和一门迪法恩斯 B4S 小型激光用于近战。防御方面，幽灵携带北欧守护者 ECM 套件，可防御敌方先进的瞄准与测距设备。

Original: An upgrade originating from the Free Worlds League, the 5M variant of the Stalker was introduced in 3050 using moderate amounts of Star League technology. Most of the weaponry was retained but both large lasers were removed for a single Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Laser placed in the 'Mech's centerline and a Narc Missile Beacon in the left torso accompanied by two tons of reloads, allowing the Stalker to tag enemy units with homing beacon and direct friendly missile fire onto them. The seventeen double heat sinks of the 5M afford it far greater heat efficiency than the twenty single heat sinks of previous models, although it still could not handle firing all of its weaponry simultaneously, and an additional ton of armor was added for survivability. Other changes included the use of proprietary components such as an Irian E.A.R. communications system, Riese-456 armor and a Irian Chassis Class 30. Unfortunately the designers of the new 5M dismissed the inclusion of CASE, a factor which led directly to the deaths of several Stalkers during the Clan Invasion due to ammunition cook-offs caused by overheating and weapon penetrations.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_stalker_STK-5M.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade originating from the Free Worlds League, the 5M variant of the Stalker was introduced in 3050 using moderate amounts of Star League technology. Most of the weaponry was retained but both large lasers were removed for a single Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Laser placed in the 'Mech's centerline and a Narc Missile Beacon in the left torso accompanied by two tons of reloads, allowing the Stalker to tag enemy units with homing beacon and direct friendly missile fire onto them. The seventeen double heat sinks of the 5M afford it far greater heat efficiency than the twenty single heat sinks of previous models, although it still could not handle firing all of its weaponry simultaneously, and an additional ton of armor was added for survivability. Other changes included the use of proprietary components such as an Irian E.A.R. communications system, Riese-456 armor and a Irian Chassis Class 30. Unfortunately the designers of the new 5M dismissed the inclusion of CASE, a factor which led directly to the deaths of several Stalkers during the Clan Invasion due to ammunition cook-offs caused by overheating and weapon penetrations.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5M 变体源自自由世界联盟，是潜行者的升级版，于 3050 年推出，使用了适度数量的星盟技术。大部分武器得以保留，但两门大型激光被移除，换成一门装在机甲中线上的"多元光学阳光"ER 大型激光，以及左躯干一具 NARC 导弹信标配两吨再装填，使潜行者能为敌方单位打上自导信标并把友军导弹火力引导到它们身上。5M 的十七台双倍散热器赋予它远胜前型号二十台单散热器的散热效率，尽管它仍无法同时发射全部武器，另加了一吨装甲以提升生存性。其他改动包括采用专有组件，如"伊里安 E.A.R."通讯系统、里泽-456 装甲和伊里安 30 级底盘。遗憾的是，新 5M 的设计者放弃了 C.A.S.E.，这一因素直接导致氏族入侵期间数台潜行者因过热与武器穿透引发弹药殉爆而损毁。

Original: The original Stinger LAM used by the Star League Defense Force Royal Divisions, this version carried a Medium Pulse Laser and replaced the Machine Guns with Small Pulse Lasers. Double heat sinks kept the temperature manageable. It was also more heavily armored than its forerunner, carrying five tons of protection.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_stinger_lam_STG-A1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Stinger LAM used by the Star League Defense Force Royal Divisions, this version carried a Medium Pulse Laser and replaced the Machine Guns with Small Pulse Lasers. Double heat sinks kept the temperature manageable. It was also more heavily armored than its forerunner, carrying five tons of protection.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是星盟防卫军皇家师使用的原始毒刺 LAM，此版本携带一门中型脉冲激光，并以轻型脉冲激光取代机枪。双倍散热器使温度可控。它的装甲也较前型更厚，携带五吨防护。

Original: In 2680, the Star League requested designers to develop 'Mechs which could fly as well as function as standard 'Mechs. The first Land-Air 'Mech off the drawing board, the Shadow Hawk LAM, proved so fatally flawed, the concept was almost shelved. However, LexaTech Industries reworked the conversion equipment and unveiled the first viable LAM, the Stinger LAM in 2688, based on the old Stinger design. LexaTech's reworking of the concept proved so successful, the Land-Air 'Mech became highly sought after, especially for space combat operations. In fact, the Stinger LAM first saw combat destroying a nuclear weapons facility in the Oort Cloud orbiting Sol, Terra's star. Found in the Draconis Combine, this variant uses two pairs of Martell Small Lasers on the arms instead of a single Medium Laser.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_stinger_lam_STG-A10.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In 2680, the Star League requested designers to develop 'Mechs which could fly as well as function as standard 'Mechs. The first Land-Air 'Mech off the drawing board, the Shadow Hawk LAM, proved so fatally flawed, the concept was almost shelved. However, LexaTech Industries reworked the conversion equipment and unveiled the first viable LAM, the Stinger LAM in 2688, based on the old Stinger design. LexaTech's reworking of the concept proved so successful, the Land-Air 'Mech became highly sought after, especially for space combat operations. In fact, the Stinger LAM first saw combat destroying a nuclear weapons facility in the Oort Cloud orbiting Sol, Terra's star. Found in the Draconis Combine, this variant uses two pairs of Martell Small Lasers on the arms instead of a single Medium Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2680 年，星盟要求设计师开发既能飞行又能作为标准机甲运作的机甲。首款走下绘图板的陆空机甲——影鹰 LAM——被证明缺陷致命，该概念几乎被搁置。然而莱克萨科技工业重做了变身设备，于 2688 年推出首款可用的 LAM——毒刺 LAM，以老式毒刺设计为基础。莱克萨对概念的改造极为成功，陆空机甲变得极受追捧，尤其是在太空作战中。事实上，毒刺 LAM 首次参战就是摧毁太阳系恒星泰拉轨道上奥尔特云中的一处核武器设施。此变体见于德拉科尼斯联合体，臂部使用两对马特尔小型激光取代单门中型激光。

Original: In 2680, the Star League requested designers to develop 'Mechs which could fly as well as function as standard 'Mechs. The first Land-Air 'Mech off the drawing board, the Shadow Hawk LAM, proved so fatally flawed, the concept was almost shelved. However, LexaTech Industries reworked the conversion equipment and unveiled the first viable LAM, the Stinger LAM in 2688, based on the old Stinger design. LexaTech's reworking of the concept proved so successful, the Land-Air 'Mech became highly sought after, especially for space combat operations. In fact, the Stinger LAM first saw combat destroying a nuclear weapons facility in the Oort Cloud orbiting Sol, Terra's star. The standard production model uses three Magna Medium Lasers mounted on the head and arms.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_stinger_lam_STG-A5.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In 2680, the Star League requested designers to develop 'Mechs which could fly as well as function as standard 'Mechs. The first Land-Air 'Mech off the drawing board, the Shadow Hawk LAM, proved so fatally flawed, the concept was almost shelved. However, LexaTech Industries reworked the conversion equipment and unveiled the first viable LAM, the Stinger LAM in 2688, based on the old Stinger design. LexaTech's reworking of the concept proved so successful, the Land-Air 'Mech became highly sought after, especially for space combat operations. In fact, the Stinger LAM first saw combat destroying a nuclear weapons facility in the Oort Cloud orbiting Sol, Terra's star. The standard production model uses three Magna Medium Lasers mounted on the head and arms.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2680 年，星盟要求设计师开发既能飞行又能作为标准机甲运作的机甲。首款走下绘图板的陆空机甲——影鹰 LAM——被证明缺陷致命，该概念几乎被搁置。然而莱克萨科技工业重做了变身设备，于 2688 年推出首款可用的 LAM——毒刺 LAM，以老式毒刺设计为基础。莱克萨对概念的改造极为成功，陆空机甲变得极受追捧，尤其是在太空作战中。事实上，毒刺 LAM 首次参战就是摧毁太阳系恒星泰拉轨道上奥尔特云中的一处核武器设施。标准量产型使用三门玛格纳中型激光，分装于头部与双臂。

Original: The design featured Large Pulse Lasers in each arm, twin Gauss Rifles mounted behind flip-open circular firing ports on each side torso, and an almost superfluous Small Pulse Laser located above the cockpit. The Stone Rhino also sported an interesting feature; each arm contained a retractable, shock-absorbing cowl covering the weapon barrels. This allowed MechWarriors to use the arms as battering rams without damaging the weaponry.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_stone_rhino_STR-1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The design featured Large Pulse Lasers in each arm, twin Gauss Rifles mounted behind flip-open circular firing ports on each side torso, and an almost superfluous Small Pulse Laser located above the cockpit. The Stone Rhino also sported an interesting feature; each arm contained a retractable, shock-absorbing cowl covering the weapon barrels. This allowed MechWarriors to use the arms as battering rams without damaging the weaponry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该设计在每臂装备大型脉冲激光，两侧躯干各在翻开式圆形射击口后安装两门高斯步枪，驾驶舱上方还有一门近乎多余的轻型脉冲激光。石犀牛还有一个有趣特征：每臂都包含一个可伸缩的减震罩盖住炮管，使机甲战士能把手臂当攻城锤使用而不损坏武器。

Original: In order to plug holes in their touman, Clan Goliath Scorpion scientists revisited the Behemoth. Like Clan Smoke Jaguar before them, they upgraded and improved upon the design. This version used an Extra-light Engine to mount a pair of Thunderstroke Series 2b Gauss Rifles along the top of the 'Mech. Each arm carried a Series 4D-2 Heavy Large Laser, a Series 22a Heavy Medium Laser, and a General Systems Heavy Small Laser. It retained the shock-absorbing cowls of the original. Another pair of Heavy Mediums protected the rear of the 'Mech. A head-mounted Shield-3 Anti-Missile System defended against missiles, while an Anti-Personnel Pod in each leg discouraged unarmored infantry. This design had jump jets, nineteen tons of armor, and a meager sixteen double heat sinks.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_stone_rhino_STR-2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In order to plug holes in their touman, Clan Goliath Scorpion scientists revisited the Behemoth. Like Clan Smoke Jaguar before them, they upgraded and improved upon the design. This version used an Extra-light Engine to mount a pair of Thunderstroke Series 2b Gauss Rifles along the top of the 'Mech. Each arm carried a Series 4D-2 Heavy Large Laser, a Series 22a Heavy Medium Laser, and a General Systems Heavy Small Laser. It retained the shock-absorbing cowls of the original. Another pair of Heavy Mediums protected the rear of the 'Mech. A head-mounted Shield-3 Anti-Missile System defended against missiles, while an Anti-Personnel Pod in each leg discouraged unarmored infantry. This design had jump jets, nineteen tons of armor, and a meager sixteen double heat sinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 为填补图曼的缺口，歌利亚蝎氏族科学家重新审视了巨兽。如烟虎氏族先前所做，他们升级改进了该设计。此版本使用超轻型引擎，在机甲顶部安装两门雷霆系列 2b 高斯步枪。每臂携带一门 4D-2 系列重型大型激光、一门 22a 系列重型中型激光和一门通用系统重型小型激光。它保留了原版的减震罩盖。另外两门重型中型激光保护机甲后方。头部安装的盾-3 反导系统防御导弹，每条腿上的反人员荚舱则用于威慑无装甲步兵。该设计配有跳跃推进器、十九吨装甲和仅十六台双倍散热器。

Original: A variable range variant, the Stone Rhino 4 uses an XL Engine to provide weight savings for four LRM 10s to lay down impressive long range fire. Backing these up are a pair of Ultra AC-10s for mid-range engagements. From there, four ER Medium Lasers provide a solid short range punch. Lastly, four Machine Guns provide anti-infantry support. These combine to make a solid and well rounded configuration.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_stone_rhino_STR-4.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A variable range variant, the Stone Rhino 4 uses an XL Engine to provide weight savings for four LRM 10s to lay down impressive long range fire. Backing these up are a pair of Ultra AC-10s for mid-range engagements. From there, four ER Medium Lasers provide a solid short range punch. Lastly, four Machine Guns provide anti-infantry support. These combine to make a solid and well rounded configuration.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 石犀牛 4 是一款全能射程变体，它使用 XL 引擎节省重量以搭载四具 LRM 10，倾泻可观远程火力。中距离交战由两门超速 AC-10 支援，四门 ER 中型激光提供扎实的近距离打击，最后四挺机枪提供反步兵支援。这些组合成一套扎实而均衡的配置。

Original: A design based off of early specifications for Amaris's Folly, the Stone Rhino 5 uses a 400XL engine to reach speeds up up to 64.8kph. It is armed with four LB-5X Autocannons mounted in the torsos backed up by six ER Medium Lasers in the arms.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_stone_rhino_STR-5.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A design based off of early specifications for Amaris's Folly, the Stone Rhino 5 uses a 400XL engine to reach speeds up up to 64.8kph. It is armed with four LB-5X Autocannons mounted in the torsos backed up by six ER Medium Lasers in the arms.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 石犀牛 5 基于"阿马里斯之愚"的早期规格设计，使用 400XL 引擎达到最高 64.8 公里/小时的速度。它在躯干安装四门 LB-5X 自动炮，并以臂部六门 ER 中型激光作为补充。

Original: A close combat design based on the Stone Rhino 5, the Stone Rhino 6 is armed with a simple yet effective loadout of 14 Medium Pulse Lasers. These are backed up by a single ER Small Laser.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_stone_rhino_STR-6.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A close combat design based on the Stone Rhino 5, the Stone Rhino 6 is armed with a simple yet effective loadout of 14 Medium Pulse Lasers. These are backed up by a single ER Small Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 石犀牛 6 是基于石犀牛 5 的近战设计，装备简单却有效的 14 门中型脉冲激光，并由一门 ER 小型激光支援。
氏族重新设计的"阿马里斯之愚"。

Original: The Stormcrow A is configured mainly for close combat.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_stormcrow_SCR-A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Stormcrow A is configured mainly for close combat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 风暴鸦 A 主要配置为近战。

Original: The Stormcrow B is another close combat configuration.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_stormcrow_SCR-B.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Stormcrow B is another close combat configuration.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 风暴鸦 B 是另一种近战配置。

Original: The Stormcrow C is armed with some of the most accurate weapons available to the clans.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_stormcrow_SCR-C.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Stormcrow C is armed with some of the most accurate weapons available to the clans.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 暴风鸦 C 装备了氏族所能获得的一些最精准的武器。

Original: A long range support configuration, the Stormcrow D has, as its primary weapons, a pair of LRM-20 launchers. These are backed up by two SRM-2 launchers for close combat.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_stormcrow_SCR-D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A long range support configuration, the Stormcrow D has, as its primary weapons, a pair of LRM-20 launchers. These are backed up by two SRM-2 launchers for close combat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 风暴鸦 D 是一款远程支援配置，主武器为两具 LRM-20 发射器。它们由两具 SRM-2 发射器支援用于近战。

Original: Capable of engaging an enemy at any range, the Stormcrow E's primary weapons are a pair of ATM-9 launchers. These are capable of firing short, medium, and long range munitions. The launchers are backed up, for added close range firepower, by four ER Small Lasers and two ER Medium Lasers.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_stormcrow_SCR-E.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Capable of engaging an enemy at any range, the Stormcrow E's primary weapons are a pair of ATM-9 launchers. These are capable of firing short, medium, and long range munitions. The launchers are backed up, for added close range firepower, by four ER Small Lasers and two ER Medium Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 暴风鸦 E 能在任何距离上交战，主武器为一对 ATM-9 发射器。它们能发射短程、中程和远程弹药。为增强近程火力，这些发射器由四门 ER 小型激光和两门 ER 中型激光支援。

Original: A heavy laser-toting version of the primary configuration, the H has, as its main weapons, two Heavy Large Lasers. These are backed up by three ER Medium Lasers.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_stormcrow_SCR-H.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A heavy laser-toting version of the primary configuration, the H has, as its main weapons, two Heavy Large Lasers. These are backed up by three ER Medium Lasers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: H 是主配置的重型激光版本，以两门重型大型激光为主武器。它们由三门 ER 中型激光支援。

Original: A pair of LRM-15 launchers provide long range firepower while each arm carries an ER Large Laser and ER Medium Laser. To ferret out hidden enemy forces, the Stormcrow I configuration mounts an Active Probe in the head.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_stormcrow_SCR-I.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A pair of LRM-15 launchers provide long range firepower while each arm carries an ER Large Laser and ER Medium Laser. To ferret out hidden enemy forces, the Stormcrow I configuration mounts an Active Probe in the head.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 两具 LRM-15 发射器提供远程火力，每臂则携带一门 ER 大型激光和一门 ER 中型激光。为搜出隐藏的敌军，暴风鸦 I 配置在头部安装一具主动探测器。

Original: A pair of LRM-15 launchers provide long range firepower while each arm carries an ER Large Laser and ER Medium Laser.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_stormcrow_SCR-L.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A pair of LRM-15 launchers provide long range firepower while each arm carries an ER Large Laser and ER Medium Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 两具 LRM-15 发射器提供远程火力，每臂则携带一门 ER 大型激光和一门 ER 中型激光。

Original: A sleek, mobile, and versatile design, the Clan Stormcrow was long suspected to be one of the first OmniMechs produced by the Clans.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_stormcrow_SCR-Prime.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A sleek, mobile, and versatile design, the Clan Stormcrow was long suspected to be one of the first OmniMechs produced by the Clans.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一款流线型、机动且多用途的设计，氏族风暴鸦长期被认为是最早由氏族生产的全能机甲之一。

Original: For long range combat, the Summoner A has a powerful Gauss Rifle which is supported by a Large Pulse Laser for intermediate ranges and an SRM-6 launcher for close combat.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_summoner_SMN-A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: For long range combat, the Summoner A has a powerful Gauss Rifle which is supported by a Large Pulse Laser for intermediate ranges and an SRM-6 launcher for close combat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 远程战斗中，召唤者 A 有一门强劲的高斯步枪，配一门大型脉冲激光负责中距离，以及一具 SRM-6 发射器负责近战。

Original: A missile bombardment configuration, the B configuration carries a pair of LRM-20 launchers for long range engagements. For close combat, the Summoner B has two SRM-4 launchers. A Narc Missile Beacon allows the Summoner to designate targets for missile fire from other friendly units. The Summoner B has further protection through the use of an Anti-Missile System which gives it increased protection from missile attacks.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_summoner_SMN-B.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A missile bombardment configuration, the B configuration carries a pair of LRM-20 launchers for long range engagements. For close combat, the Summoner B has two SRM-4 launchers. A Narc Missile Beacon allows the Summoner to designate targets for missile fire from other friendly units. The Summoner B has further protection through the use of an Anti-Missile System which gives it increased protection from missile attacks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 召唤者 B 是一款导弹轰炸配置，携带两具 LRM-20 发射器用于远程交战。近战方面，它有两具 SRM-4 发射器。一具 NARC 导弹信标让召唤者能为其他友军单位的导弹火力标记目标。召唤者 B 还通过一套反导系统获得进一步保护，提升对导弹攻击的防御。

Original: A close range brawler, the Summoner C is armed with a single ER Large Laser for long range sniping at enemy targets but truly comes into its own at close range. The 'Mech relies on a powerful Ultra Autocannon/20 for quick kill capabilities at close ranges. This is backed up by a highly accurate Streak SRM-6 launcher to seek out weak points in an enemy's armor and an ER Small Laser.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_summoner_SMN-C.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A close range brawler, the Summoner C is armed with a single ER Large Laser for long range sniping at enemy targets but truly comes into its own at close range. The 'Mech relies on a powerful Ultra Autocannon/20 for quick kill capabilities at close ranges. This is backed up by a highly accurate Streak SRM-6 launcher to seek out weak points in an enemy's armor and an ER Small Laser.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 召唤者 C 是一款近战近战型，装备一门 ER 大型激光用于对敌方目标的远程狙击，但真正发挥威力是在近距离。机甲依靠一门强劲的超速自动炮/20 在近距离快速击杀。它辅以一具极为精准的连续 SRM-6 发射器以寻找敌方装甲弱点，以及一门 ER 小型激光。

Original: In its primary configuration the Summoner has a basic yet effective arsenal. The primary direct fire weapon is an ER PPC backed up by an LB 10-X Autocannon that can fire both standard and cluster ammunition. For fire support and bombardment, the Summoner has an LRM-15 launcher.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_summoner_SMN-Prime.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In its primary configuration the Summoner has a basic yet effective arsenal. The primary direct fire weapon is an ER PPC backed up by an LB 10-X Autocannon that can fire both standard and cluster ammunition. For fire support and bombardment, the Summoner has an LRM-15 launcher.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主配置中，召唤者拥有基础却有效的武器库。主要直射武器是一门 ER PPC，辅以一门 LB 10-X 自动炮，后者可发射标准弹与集束弹。用于火力支援与轰炸，召唤者有一具 LRM-15 发射器。

Original: Almost a direct counter-point to the Prime, the A Config mounts twin Ultra AC/2s in each side torso, supported by an ER Large Laser in each arm if the two tons of Ultra reloads run dry. The config is rounded out by an extra Double Heat Sink.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_sun_spider_SNS-A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Almost a direct counter-point to the Prime, the A Config mounts twin Ultra AC/2s in each side torso, supported by an ER Large Laser in each arm if the two tons of Ultra reloads run dry. The config is rounded out by an extra Double Heat Sink.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: A 配置几乎与主型号针锋相对，每侧躯干装双联超速 AC/2，若两吨超速弹药耗尽，则由每臂一门 ER 大型激光支援。该配置另有一台额外双倍散热器补全。

Original: A mixed-range combatant, the Sun Spider B is built around a right-torso mounted Gauss Rifle, supported by a left-torso ER Large Laser and matched Streak SRM-6 and ER Medium Lasers in each arm. An Anti-Missile System and a Light Active Probe in the left torso prevent the B from being caught unaware, carrying two tons of Gauss and Streak reloads along with a single ton of AMS ammo and an extra double heat sink.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_sun_spider_SNS-B.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A mixed-range combatant, the Sun Spider B is built around a right-torso mounted Gauss Rifle, supported by a left-torso ER Large Laser and matched Streak SRM-6 and ER Medium Lasers in each arm. An Anti-Missile System and a Light Active Probe in the left torso prevent the B from being caught unaware, carrying two tons of Gauss and Streak reloads along with a single ton of AMS ammo and an extra double heat sink.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 太阳蜘蛛 B 是一款混合射程战斗型，以右躯干的高斯步枪为核心，左躯干的 ER 大型激光以及每臂配对的连续 SRM-6 和 ER 中型激光为支援。左躯干的反导系统与轻型主动探测器使 B 不会被打个措手不及，它携带两吨高斯与连续导弹再装填、一吨 AMS 弹药和一台额外双倍散热器。

Original: The C configuration is a classic LRM Missile Boat, fitted with a pair of LRM-15s in each arm and supported by an LRM-20 in each side torso. Carrying six tons of LRM missiles, an extra double heat sink strives to try and keep the Sun Spider firing.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_sun_spider_SNS-C.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The C configuration is a classic LRM Missile Boat, fitted with a pair of LRM-15s in each arm and supported by an LRM-20 in each side torso. Carrying six tons of LRM missiles, an extra double heat sink strives to try and keep the Sun Spider firing.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: C 配置是经典的 LRM 导弹平台，每臂装备两具 LRM-15，两侧躯干各以一具 LRM-20 支援。它携带六吨 LRM 导弹，一台额外双倍散热器尽力维持太阳蜘蛛的火力。

Original: A short-ranged brawler, the Sun Spider D carries a mammoth Ultra AC/20 in each arm, with just a pair of Heavy Machine Guns in the right torso as supporting weapons. Lacking in ranged weapons, an ECM Suite is fitted in the left torso to try and assist in closing with its foes so it can make full use of the four tons of Ultra ammunition and single ton HMG bin.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_sun_spider_SNS-D.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A short-ranged brawler, the Sun Spider D carries a mammoth Ultra AC/20 in each arm, with just a pair of Heavy Machine Guns in the right torso as supporting weapons. Lacking in ranged weapons, an ECM Suite is fitted in the left torso to try and assist in closing with its foes so it can make full use of the four tons of Ultra ammunition and single ton HMG bin.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 太阳蜘蛛 D 是一款近战近战型，每臂携带一门巨型超速 AC/20，右躯干仅以两挺重机枪作为支援武器。由于缺乏远程武器，左躯干装有 ECM 套件以协助接近敌人，从而充分利用四吨超速弹药与一吨重机枪弹药。

Original: The Sun Spider F configuration mounts an ERPPC in each arm and an LBX10 Autocannon in the right torso. A single AP Gauss rifle and anti-Battlearmor pod help deal with enemy infantry. A pair of anti-missile systems and an ECM suite enhance defense.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_sun_spider_SNS-F.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Sun Spider F configuration mounts an ERPPC in each arm and an LBX10 Autocannon in the right torso. A single AP Gauss rifle and anti-Battlearmor pod help deal with enemy infantry. A pair of anti-missile systems and an ECM suite enhance defense.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 太阳蜘蛛 F 配置在每臂装一门 ER PPC，右躯干一门 LBX10 自动炮。一门单装 AP 高斯步枪和反战斗装甲荚舱帮助对付敌方步兵。两套反导系统和一套 ECM 套件增强防御。

Original: The Sun Spider Prime is built for short-range combat and carries a pair of Streak SRM-6 launchers in each arm, supported at range by Ultra AC/10 and an ER Large Laser in the right and left torsos, respectively. Two tons of Ultra Autocannon reloads and three tons of Streak SRM missiles are more than adequate for Clan Trials.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_sun_spider_SNS-Prime.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Sun Spider Prime is built for short-range combat and carries a pair of Streak SRM-6 launchers in each arm, supported at range by Ultra AC/10 and an ER Large Laser in the right and left torsos, respectively. Two tons of Ultra Autocannon reloads and three tons of Streak SRM missiles are more than adequate for Clan Trials.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 太阳蜘蛛主型号为近战而设，每臂携带两具连续 SRM-6 发射器，远程则由右躯干的超速 AC/10 和左躯干的 ER 大型激光支援。两吨超速自动炮再装填与三吨连续 SRM 导弹对氏族试炼而言绰绰有余。

Original: The Inner Sphere Standard was developed following the initial thrust of the Clan invasion, as Inner Sphere powers rushed to duplicate the battle armor technology the Clans fielded. Lacking any battlefield salvage on which to base their development though, engineers were forced to work off of ancient rumors of early power armor suits like the Nighthawk, more akin to armored Exoskeletons than the 'Toads' currently rampaging through known space, and these prototypes fared poorly during testing. It took salvage from the first victories over the Clans to truly kick-start the development of battle armor. The New Avalon Institute of Science was the first to reproduce in part the Clans' Elemental armor as the Inner Sphere Standard.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_the_hive_IS-HIVE.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Inner Sphere Standard was developed following the initial thrust of the Clan invasion, as Inner Sphere powers rushed to duplicate the battle armor technology the Clans fielded. Lacking any battlefield salvage on which to base their development though, engineers were forced to work off of ancient rumors of early power armor suits like the Nighthawk, more akin to armored Exoskeletons than the 'Toads' currently rampaging through known space, and these prototypes fared poorly during testing. It took salvage from the first victories over the Clans to truly kick-start the development of battle armor. The New Avalon Institute of Science was the first to reproduce in part the Clans' Elemental armor as the Inner Sphere Standard.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 内天体标准型是在氏族入侵首轮攻势后开发的，当时内天体各势力竞相复制氏族装备的战斗装甲技术。然而由于缺乏战场缴获作为研发基础，工程师们只能依据"夜鹰"等早期动力装甲的古老传闻着手——它们与其说是当前肆虐已知空间的"蟾蜍"式装甲，更像是带装甲的外骨骼。这些原型在测试中表现糟糕。直到从对氏族的首次胜利中获得缴获品，战斗装甲的研发才真正起步。新阿瓦隆科学研究院率先部分复制了氏族的元素战士装甲，即内天体标准型。

Original: The Thorn carries a weapons array that is not usually seen on light 'Mechs: a Zeus-5 LRM launcher mounted in the right arm with one ton of reloads in the right torso, paired with two Hellion Spitfire Medium Lasers split between the head and left arm. Four and a half tons of armor provides the Thorn with good protection, especially when mated with CASE to contain any ammunition explosions.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_thorn_THE-N.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Thorn carries a weapons array that is not usually seen on light 'Mechs: a Zeus-5 LRM launcher mounted in the right arm with one ton of reloads in the right torso, paired with two Hellion Spitfire Medium Lasers split between the head and left arm. Four and a half tons of armor provides the Thorn with good protection, especially when mated with CASE to contain any ammunition explosions.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 荆棘携带轻型机甲上不常见的武器阵列：右臂一具宙斯-5 LRM 发射器（右躯干一吨再装填），配以分列头部与左臂的两门海利昂"喷火"中型激光。四吨半装甲为荆棘提供良好防护，尤其配合 C.A.S.E. 遏制弹药爆炸时。

Original: Developed in 3051 on the orders of Precentor Martial Anastasius Focht to try and close the gap between the Clans and Com Guards, the factory refit THE-N1 received its baptism of fire during the Battle of Tukayyid. Having reached a similar conclusion that resulted in the THE-Nb, the CASE was dropped and the standard engine was swapped for an XL Engine to allow the standard weaponry to be stripped for an all energy weapon array: a right arm mounted Kinslaughter H-Class ER PPC and a head-mounted Intek Small Laser. This new weapons array, enhanced by double heat sinks, added a level of lethality never seen before on the Thorn.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_thorn_THE-N1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed in 3051 on the orders of Precentor Martial Anastasius Focht to try and close the gap between the Clans and Com Guards, the factory refit THE-N1 received its baptism of fire during the Battle of Tukayyid. Having reached a similar conclusion that resulted in the THE-Nb, the CASE was dropped and the standard engine was swapped for an XL Engine to allow the standard weaponry to be stripped for an all energy weapon array: a right arm mounted Kinslaughter H-Class ER PPC and a head-mounted Intek Small Laser. This new weapons array, enhanced by double heat sinks, added a level of lethality never seen before on the Thorn.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: THE-N1 于 3051 年根据战务长官阿纳斯塔修斯·福赫特的命令开发，试图缩小氏族与康卫之间的差距，这款工厂改装型在图卡伊德战役中接受了战火洗礼。它得出了与 THE-Nb 相似的结论，因此舍弃 C.A.S.E. 并把标准引擎换成 XL 引擎，以便剥离标准武器、改用全能量武器阵列：右臂一门"族杀 H 级"ER PPC 和头部一门英泰克小型激光。这一新武器阵列在双倍散热器的强化下，为荆棘带来了前所未有的杀伤力。

Original: A new production variant of the THE-N1 developed by the Word of Blake in 3071, the THE-N2 took its cues from both the THE-N and THE-T variants, swapping the ER-PPC with an MML 7 and the standard small laser for a Diverse Optics ER Small Laser. A two-ton CASE protected ammo bay allowed the THE-N2 to carry both LRM and SRM munitions to make best use of the Multi-Missile Launcher.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_thorn_THE-N2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A new production variant of the THE-N1 developed by the Word of Blake in 3071, the THE-N2 took its cues from both the THE-N and THE-T variants, swapping the ER-PPC with an MML 7 and the standard small laser for a Diverse Optics ER Small Laser. A two-ton CASE protected ammo bay allowed the THE-N2 to carry both LRM and SRM munitions to make best use of the Multi-Missile Launcher.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: THE-N2 是布雷克之言于 3071 年开发的 THE-N1 新量产变体，它同时借鉴了 THE-N 与 THE-T 变体，把 ER PPC 换成 MML 7，标准小型激光换成多元光学 ER 小型激光。一个两吨、有 C.A.S.E. 保护的弹药舱使 THE-N2 能同时携带 LRM 与 SRM 弹药，以最大化利用多用途导弹发射器。

Original: The advanced model employed by the Star League Defense Force Royal Divisions in 2743 changed the role of the 'Mech from a missile to an energy boat, replacing the LRM launcher with an ER Large Laser, retaining one medium laser and downgrading the other to a Small Laser. Dropping the no longer required CASE, the 'Mech also used a MASC system for temporary speed bursts and Double Heat Sinks to vent its increased waste heat output. The THE-Nb mounted an XL Engine to save the weight to mount this extra equipment, at the cost of reduced survivability.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_thorn_THE-Nb.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The advanced model employed by the Star League Defense Force Royal Divisions in 2743 changed the role of the 'Mech from a missile to an energy boat, replacing the LRM launcher with an ER Large Laser, retaining one medium laser and downgrading the other to a Small Laser. Dropping the no longer required CASE, the 'Mech also used a MASC system for temporary speed bursts and Double Heat Sinks to vent its increased waste heat output. The THE-Nb mounted an XL Engine to save the weight to mount this extra equipment, at the cost of reduced survivability.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款先进型号于 2743 年由星盟防卫军皇家师使用，它把机甲的角色从导弹平台改为能量平台，以一门 ER 大型激光取代 LRM 发射器，保留一门中型激光，另一门降级为小型激光。舍弃不再需要的 C.A.S.E.，机甲还使用 MASC 系统实现临时速度爆发，并以双倍散热器排出增加的废热。THE-Nb 装 XL 引擎以省出重量安装这些额外装备，代价是生存性降低。

Original: Supplied by ComStar to the Draconis Combine as part of Operation Rosebud in 3035, the THE-S was a downgraded factory refit of the THE-N. Stripping out the advanced Endo Steel chassis and CASE, the use of a heavier standard chassis forced a reduction in the Thorns armor protection by half a ton, most of which was removed from the head and rear torso. The communications system was also changed to a more primitive Olmstead 30, although the Omicron VII targeting-tracking system was similar in capabilities to the Orion 80 it replaced.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_thorn_THE-S.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Supplied by ComStar to the Draconis Combine as part of Operation Rosebud in 3035, the THE-S was a downgraded factory refit of the THE-N. Stripping out the advanced Endo Steel chassis and CASE, the use of a heavier standard chassis forced a reduction in the Thorns armor protection by half a ton, most of which was removed from the head and rear torso. The communications system was also changed to a more primitive Olmstead 30, although the Omicron VII targeting-tracking system was similar in capabilities to the Orion 80 it replaced.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: THE-S 由康星作为 3035 年"玫瑰花蕾"行动的一部分提供给德拉科尼斯联合体，是 THE-N 的降级工厂改装型。它拆除了先进的内骨骼底盘和 C.A.S.E.，改用较重的标准底盘，迫使荆棘的装甲防护减少半吨，其中大部分从头颅和后躯干扣除。通讯系统也换成更原始的奥姆斯特德 30，尽管奥米克戎 VII 瞄准追踪系统的性能与被它取代的猎户座 80 相近。

Original: Developed in 3038 by the Draconis Combine in an attempt to upgrade the 'Mech's short range firepower prior to the War of 3039, the THE-T is a field refit of the downgraded THE-S that swaps out the LRM launcher for an SRM-4.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_thorn_THE-T.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed in 3038 by the Draconis Combine in an attempt to upgrade the 'Mech's short range firepower prior to the War of 3039, the THE-T is a field refit of the downgraded THE-S that swaps out the LRM launcher for an SRM-4.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: THE-T 由德拉科尼斯联合体于 3038 年开发，试图在 3039 年战争前升级机甲的近程火力，它是对降级版 THE-S 的野战改装，把 LRM 发射器换成 SRM-4。

Original: The Timber Wolf is a fast, heavy OmniMech. A signature design of the Clans' military might, it was arguably the first Clan OmniMech encountered by Inner Sphere forces on The Rock by Phelan Kell. Vaguely resembling a cross-over between the MAD (Marauder) and CAT (Catapult) series, the Timber Wolf was tagged with the Inner Sphere reporting name Mad Cat on first contact.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_timber_wolf_TW-A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Timber Wolf is a fast, heavy OmniMech. A signature design of the Clans' military might, it was arguably the first Clan OmniMech encountered by Inner Sphere forces on The Rock by Phelan Kell. Vaguely resembling a cross-over between the MAD (Marauder) and CAT (Catapult) series, the Timber Wolf was tagged with the Inner Sphere reporting name Mad Cat on first contact.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 森林狼是一款高速重型全能机甲。作为氏族军事力量的标志性设计，它可以说是内天体部队在"岩石"星上由菲兰·凯尔首次遭遇的氏族全能机甲。因其隐约呈现出 MAD（掠夺者）与 CAT（投石机）系列的杂交特征，森林狼在首次接触时被内天体冠以"疯猫"的报告代号。

Original: The Turkina is named after Turkina, the first Jade Falcon to be tamed, who inspired the leaders of Clan Jade Falcon in its early days.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_turkina_TKR-A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Turkina is named after Turkina, the first Jade Falcon to be tamed, who inspired the leaders of Clan Jade Falcon in its early days.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 图尔基娜以图尔基娜命名——第一只被驯服的翡翠猎鹰，它在翡翠猎鹰氏族早期激励了其领袖。

Original: The UrbanMech IIC is a Clan IIC-style upgrade of the original UrbanMech. Around the same time as the development of the OmniMech during the Golden Century, Clan Coyote technicians reworked this venerable design. They studied battle data from as far back as the Amaris Civil War and used this research as the basis for their upgrades.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_urbanmech_iic_UM-IIC-1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The UrbanMech IIC is a Clan IIC-style upgrade of the original UrbanMech. Around the same time as the development of the OmniMech during the Golden Century, Clan Coyote technicians reworked this venerable design. They studied battle data from as far back as the Amaris Civil War and used this research as the basis for their upgrades.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 城市机甲 IIC 是原版城市机甲的氏族 IIC 式升级版。在黄金世纪全能机甲发展的同期，郊狼氏族技师重制了这款古老的设计。他们研究了可追溯至阿马里斯内战的作战数据，并以此为基础进行升级。

Original: Don't let the stubby 'Urbie' fool you—it may look like a walking trash can, but it can mount heavy armor and a grown-up-sized Autocannon. R63s aren't known for their speed, but they are very useful if you can draw the enemy into their firing range.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_urbanmech_UM-R63.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Don't let the stubby 'Urbie' fool you—it may look like a walking trash can, but it can mount heavy armor and a grown-up-sized Autocannon. R63s aren't known for their speed, but they are very useful if you can draw the enemy into their firing range.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 别被矮胖的"都市"骗了——它也许看起来像个会走路的垃圾桶，却能装备厚重装甲和成人尺寸的自动炮。R63 不以速度著称，但如果你能把敌人引到它的射程内，它们就非常有用。

Original: The Valkyrie II project originated as an assignment for two NAIS student design teams to create a new heavy scout and skirmisher mech based on the Valkyrie VLK-QA. A rivalry between the two teams and outside pressures from Davion bureaucrats pushed both designs far beyond a replacement for the VLK-QA. Achernar BattleMechs was contracted to construct the Valkyrie II-1A which sports a Hermes 360XL Engine, six Jump Jets, an ER PPC, a LRM10, and over eleven tons of armor.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_valkyrie_ii_VLK-II-1A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Valkyrie II project originated as an assignment for two NAIS student design teams to create a new heavy scout and skirmisher mech based on the Valkyrie VLK-QA. A rivalry between the two teams and outside pressures from Davion bureaucrats pushed both designs far beyond a replacement for the VLK-QA. Achernar BattleMechs was contracted to construct the Valkyrie II-1A which sports a Hermes 360XL Engine, six Jump Jets, an ER PPC, a LRM10, and over eleven tons of armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 女武神 II 项目最初是给两个 NAIS 学员设计小组的作业：基于女武神 VLK-QA 打造一款新的重型侦察与散兵机甲。两队之间的竞争以及达维昂官僚的外来压力，把两个设计都推得远超 VLK-QA 的替代品。阿克尔纳战斗机甲公司获得合同建造女武神 II-1A，它配备一台赫尔墨斯 360XL 引擎、六个跳跃推进器、一门 ER PPC、一具 LRM10 以及超过十一吨装甲。

Original: The Vapor Eagle features an eclectic and close-ranged weapons load-out, mounting a Large Pulse Laser in its right arm, supported by a single Machine Gun, two Streak SRM-2s and three Medium Pulse Lasers split between its side torsos and rounded out by a trio of Machine Guns in a handgun shaped housing in the left arm. The addition of a Targeting Computer makes its firepower even more deadly as long as it can get its weapons into range. Eleven Double Heat Sinks, half a ton of machine gun ammunition and one Streak missiles are more than adequate for the average Clan trial.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_vapor_eagle_GWK-1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Vapor Eagle features an eclectic and close-ranged weapons load-out, mounting a Large Pulse Laser in its right arm, supported by a single Machine Gun, two Streak SRM-2s and three Medium Pulse Lasers split between its side torsos and rounded out by a trio of Machine Guns in a handgun shaped housing in the left arm. The addition of a Targeting Computer makes its firepower even more deadly as long as it can get its weapons into range. Eleven Double Heat Sinks, half a ton of machine gun ammunition and one Streak missiles are more than adequate for the average Clan trial.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蒸汽鹰拥有杂糅而偏近程的武器配置：右臂一门大型脉冲激光，辅以一挺机枪、两具连续 SRM-2 和三门中型脉冲激光分列两侧躯干，左臂手枪形护罩内还有三挺机枪收尾。加装瞄准计算机后，只要武器能进入射程，其火力更为致命。十一台双倍散热器、半吨机枪弹药和一吨连续导弹弹药，对一般的氏族试炼而言绰绰有余。

Original: This variant of the Vapor Eagle removes two of the Medium Pulse Lasers, both Streak Missile pods, and the Large Pulse Laser as well as one of the 'Mechs double heat sinks in exchange for an Ultra Autocannon/10. Mounted in an over the shoulder arrangement like the venerable Shadow Hawk, the weapon fires at twice the rate of a standard Autocannon/10 and carries enough ammunition to continuously fire at its maximum rate of fire for over a minute and a half.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_vapor_eagle_GWK-2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant of the Vapor Eagle removes two of the Medium Pulse Lasers, both Streak Missile pods, and the Large Pulse Laser as well as one of the 'Mechs double heat sinks in exchange for an Ultra Autocannon/10. Mounted in an over the shoulder arrangement like the venerable Shadow Hawk, the weapon fires at twice the rate of a standard Autocannon/10 and carries enough ammunition to continuously fire at its maximum rate of fire for over a minute and a half.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此蒸汽鹰变体移除两门中型脉冲激光、两具连续导弹荚舱、大型脉冲激光以及一台双倍散热器，换成一门超速自动炮/10。该武器以如同古老的影鹰那样的过肩方式安装，射速是标准自动炮/10 的两倍，并携带足以以最高射速连续射击一分半钟以上的弹药。

Original: The Venom was built in direct response to losses suffered by the Draconis Combine and to boost sales for Nimakachi Fusion Products Limited. The 8C carries only standard jump jets and replaces 3 Pulse Lasers with a Snub Nose PPC.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_venom_SDR-9C.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Venom was built in direct response to losses suffered by the Draconis Combine and to boost sales for Nimakachi Fusion Products Limited. The 8C carries only standard jump jets and replaces 3 Pulse Lasers with a Snub Nose PPC.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 毒液是为直接回应德拉科尼斯联合体的损失并提振尼玛卡奇聚变产品公司的销量而制造。8C 仅携带标准跳跃推进器，并将 3 门脉冲激光换成短鼻 PPC。

Original: The Venom was built in direct response to losses suffered by the Draconis Combine and to boost sales for Nimakachi Fusion Products Limited. This earlier Model trades Jump Capability for a Capacitator boosted Heavy PPC.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_venom_SDR-9E.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Venom was built in direct response to losses suffered by the Draconis Combine and to boost sales for Nimakachi Fusion Products Limited. This earlier Model trades Jump Capability for a Capacitator boosted Heavy PPC.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 毒液是为直接回应德拉科尼斯联合体的损失并提振尼玛卡奇聚变产品公司的销量而制造。此早期型号以跳跃能力换取一门电容增强的重型 PPC。

Original: An upgrade using Star League technology, the 9K replaces the Autocannon/20 with a Gauss Rifle which can do serious damage at much greater ranges. The 'Mech also carries two Medium Pulse Lasers and a SRM-4 launcher for close combat. In order to make these changes possible, the 9K is built on an Endo Steel chassis. With the weight saved the 'Mech also carries an additional ton of armor.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_victor_VTR-9K.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade using Star League technology, the 9K replaces the Autocannon/20 with a Gauss Rifle which can do serious damage at much greater ranges. The 'Mech also carries two Medium Pulse Lasers and a SRM-4 launcher for close combat. In order to make these changes possible, the 9K is built on an Endo Steel chassis. With the weight saved the 'Mech also carries an additional ton of armor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 9K 是使用星盟技术的升级，以一门高斯步枪取代自动炮/20，能在远得多的距离上造成严重伤害。机甲还携带两门中型脉冲激光和一具 SRM-4 发射器用于近战。为实现这些改动，9K 基于内骨骼底盘建造。凭借节省的重量，机甲还多携带一吨装甲。

Original: After his son was killed in the Taurian Concordat invasion of the Federated Suns, Benedict St. James had his VTR-9K refitted with experimental weapons and equipment to allow him to take his revenge. Replacing the standard weapons with a Long Tom Cannon and two Medium X-Pulse Lasers, St. James' Victor can inflict massive amounts of damage on his prey. The 'Mech's jump jets had to be removed to make way for the weapons load, and technicians equipped it with a patchwork of Ferro-Fibrous and Standard Armor as another weight saving measure. A Supercharger mounted on the engine provides the Victor with unexpected bursts of speed.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_victor_VTR-9K2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: After his son was killed in the Taurian Concordat invasion of the Federated Suns, Benedict St. James had his VTR-9K refitted with experimental weapons and equipment to allow him to take his revenge. Replacing the standard weapons with a Long Tom Cannon and two Medium X-Pulse Lasers, St. James' Victor can inflict massive amounts of damage on his prey. The 'Mech's jump jets had to be removed to make way for the weapons load, and technicians equipped it with a patchwork of Ferro-Fibrous and Standard Armor as another weight saving measure. A Supercharger mounted on the engine provides the Victor with unexpected bursts of speed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在陶里安协约入侵联邦太阳系时儿子被杀后，本尼迪克特·圣詹姆斯将自己的 VTR-9K 改装上实验性武器与装备以复仇。他把标准武器换成一门长汤姆炮和两门中型 X 脉冲激光，使圣詹姆斯的胜利者能对猎物造成巨量伤害。为给武器腾出空间，机甲的跳跃推进器不得不拆除，技师还为其配上铁纤维与标准装甲的拼装方案作为另一项减重措施。引擎上加装的增压器为胜利者提供了出其不意的速度爆发。

Original: Utilizing a heavier mix of shorter ranged weapons among many of the configurations, the Viper saw success when paired with other light platforms.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_viper_VPR-A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Utilizing a heavier mix of shorter ranged weapons among many of the configurations, the Viper saw success when paired with other light platforms.

Original: The original Warhammer was designed as an assault BattleMech. However, it had been superseded by later and heavier 'Mech designs, though it remained a powerful weapons platform. The Clans wisely maintained and built on this solid frame a real assault 'Mech, the Warhammer IIC.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_warhammer_iic_WMR-IIC-1.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Warhammer was designed as an assault BattleMech. However, it had been superseded by later and heavier 'Mech designs, though it remained a powerful weapons platform. The Clans wisely maintained and built on this solid frame a real assault 'Mech, the Warhammer IIC.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初的战锤被设计为突击战斗机甲。尽管后来被更重的机甲设计取代，它仍是一个强大的武器平台。氏族明智地在这一坚固框架上维护并建造出真正的突击机甲——战锤 IIC。

Original: The original Warhammer was designed as an assault BattleMech. However, it had been superseded by later and heavier 'Mech designs, though it remained a powerful weapons platform. The Clans wisely maintained and built on this solid frame a real assault 'Mech, the Warhammer IIC. This variant turns the Warhammer IIC into a fire support 'Mech. Clan scientists replaced the Medium Pulse Lasers with a pair of LRM-15s and four tons of ammunition.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_warhammer_iic_WMR-IIC-2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Warhammer was designed as an assault BattleMech. However, it had been superseded by later and heavier 'Mech designs, though it remained a powerful weapons platform. The Clans wisely maintained and built on this solid frame a real assault 'Mech, the Warhammer IIC. This variant turns the Warhammer IIC into a fire support 'Mech. Clan scientists replaced the Medium Pulse Lasers with a pair of LRM-15s and four tons of ammunition.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初的战锤被设计为突击战斗机甲。尽管后来被更重的机甲设计取代，它仍是一个强大的武器平台。氏族明智地在这一坚固框架上维护并建造出真正的突击机甲——战锤 IIC。此变体将战锤 IIC 改造为火力支援机甲。氏族科学家将中型脉冲激光换成两具 LRM-15 和四吨弹药。

Original: The original Warhammer was designed as an assault BattleMech. However, it had been superseded by later and heavier 'Mech designs, though it remained a powerful weapons platform. The Clans wisely maintained and built on this solid frame a real assault 'Mech, the Warhammer IIC. Designed by Clan Diamond Shark, this variant replaces the PPCs and missile launcher of the original design with a pair of arm-mounted Heavy Large Lasers, two additional heat sinks, and a half ton of armor. An advanced Targeting Computer was also added to help ensure that the hard-to-use heavy lasers hit.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_warhammer_iic_WMR-IIC-3.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Warhammer was designed as an assault BattleMech. However, it had been superseded by later and heavier 'Mech designs, though it remained a powerful weapons platform. The Clans wisely maintained and built on this solid frame a real assault 'Mech, the Warhammer IIC. Designed by Clan Diamond Shark, this variant replaces the PPCs and missile launcher of the original design with a pair of arm-mounted Heavy Large Lasers, two additional heat sinks, and a half ton of armor. An advanced Targeting Computer was also added to help ensure that the hard-to-use heavy lasers hit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初的战锤被设计为突击战斗机甲。尽管后来被更重的机甲设计取代，它仍是一个强大的武器平台。氏族明智地在这一坚固框架上维护并建造出真正的突击机甲——战锤 IIC。此变体由钻石鲨氏族设计，将原设计中的 PPC 与导弹发射器换成一对臂载重型大型激光、两台额外散热器和半吨装甲。还加装了先进瞄准计算机以确保难以驾驭的重型激光能够命中。

Original: This House Kurita variant, introduced in 3054, was built on an Endo Steel skeleton. It carried ER PPCs, two medium lasers, and two small pulse lasers. The SRM-6 was replaced by a pair of Streak SRM-2 launchers, while a TAG system allowed the 7K to spot for friendly artillery units.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_warhammer_WHM-7K.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This House Kurita variant, introduced in 3054, was built on an Endo Steel skeleton. It carried ER PPCs, two medium lasers, and two small pulse lasers. The SRM-6 was replaced by a pair of Streak SRM-2 launchers, while a TAG system allowed the 7K to spot for friendly artillery units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款库瑞塔家族变体于 3054 年推出，建立在内骨骼骨架上。它携带 ER PPC、两门中型激光和两门小型脉冲激光。SRM-6 换成两具连续 SRM-2 发射器，TAG 系统则使 7K 能为友军炮兵单位侦察。

Original: The 7M variant was introduced in 3047 by Ronin Inc. as the official upgraded variant of the Warhammer for the Free Worlds League. Built around a Magna 280 fusion engine, the 7M had a top speed of 64.5 km/h and carried eighteen double heat sinks to handle the waste heat generated by its two Fusigon Longtooth ER PPCs. Backing up these new weapons were two Martell medium lasers in the side torsos and a Shannon SH-60 SRM-6 launcher over the right shoulder. A LFN Lindblad machine gun was carried in the right torso, while the left mounted an LFN Lindblad Shotgun Anti-Missile System. One ton of machine gun rounds were carried in the center torso, while one ton each of missile reloads and AMS rounds were carried in the right.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_warhammer_WHM-7M.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 7M variant was introduced in 3047 by Ronin Inc. as the official upgraded variant of the Warhammer for the Free Worlds League. Built around a Magna 280 fusion engine, the 7M had a top speed of 64.5 km/h and carried eighteen double heat sinks to handle the waste heat generated by its two Fusigon Longtooth ER PPCs. Backing up these new weapons were two Martell medium lasers in the side torsos and a Shannon SH-60 SRM-6 launcher over the right shoulder. A LFN Lindblad machine gun was carried in the right torso, while the left mounted an LFN Lindblad Shotgun Anti-Missile System. One ton of machine gun rounds were carried in the center torso, while one ton each of missile reloads and AMS rounds were carried in the right.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 7M 变体由浪人公司于 3047 年推出，是自由世界联盟战锤的官方升级变体。它围绕玛格纳 280 聚变引擎建造，最高速度 64.5 公里/小时，携带十八台双倍散热器以处理两门"富西贡长牙"ER PPC 产生的废热。支援这些新武器的是两侧躯干的两门马特尔中型激光和右肩上方一具"香农 SH-60"SRM-6 发射器。右躯干携带一挺 LFN 林德布拉德机枪，左侧则装一套 LFN 林德布拉德霰弹反导系统。中央躯干携带一吨机枪弹，右侧则各携带一吨导弹再装填和一吨 AMS 弹药。

Original: The 7S Warhammer was the official upgraded version built for the Federated Commonwealth by Olivettie Weaponry. Built out of their Sudeten factory starting in 3050, the 7S retained the small lasers of the original but updated the rest of the weaponry. It carried two arm-mounted ER PPCs, two Defiance P5M medium pulse lasers in the side torsos, and two Coventry T4H Streak SRM-2 launchers in place of the SRM-6 launcher. Eighteen double heat sinks handled the additional waste heat and one ton of reloads for the Streak launchers was carried in the center torso.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_warhammer_WHM-7S.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 7S Warhammer was the official upgraded version built for the Federated Commonwealth by Olivettie Weaponry. Built out of their Sudeten factory starting in 3050, the 7S retained the small lasers of the original but updated the rest of the weaponry. It carried two arm-mounted ER PPCs, two Defiance P5M medium pulse lasers in the side torsos, and two Coventry T4H Streak SRM-2 launchers in place of the SRM-6 launcher. Eighteen double heat sinks handled the additional waste heat and one ton of reloads for the Streak launchers was carried in the center torso.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 7S 战锤是奥利维蒂兵器为联邦联邦建造的官方升级版。自 3050 年起在其苏德滕工厂生产，7S 保留了原版的小型激光，但更新了其余武器。它携带两门臂载 ER PPC、两侧躯干各两门迪法恩斯 P5M 中型脉冲激光，以及两具考文垂 T4H 连续 SRM-2 发射器取代 SRM-6。十八台双倍散热器处理额外废热，中央躯干携带一吨连续发射器再装填。

Carrying thirteen tons of ferro-fibrous armor, the Mad Cat MK II is an incredibly resilient design. A pair of arm mounted Gaussrifles supported by torso mounted LRM racks give it complete command over the battlefield.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_warhawk_WHK-Prime.Details

Carrying thirteen tons of ferro-fibrous armor, the Mad Cat MK II is an incredibly resilient design. A pair of arm mounted Gaussrifles supported by torso mounted LRM racks give it complete command over the battlefield.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 虽然外观与森林狼极为相似，这款战斗机甲却是全新而强大的创造。疯猫 MK II 携带十三吨铁纤维装甲，是极为坚固的设计。臂载的双高斯步枪配以躯干搭载的 LRM 挂架，使其能完全掌控战场。

Original: This version of the Wasp LAM replaces the bomb bay with an LRM-10 launcher and an extra jump jet. This variant was later used as the inspiration for the Valkyrie.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_wasp_lam_WSP-100A.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This version of the Wasp LAM replaces the bomb bay with an LRM-10 launcher and an extra jump jet. This variant was later used as the inspiration for the Valkyrie.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此版黄蜂 LAM 将炸弹舱换成一具 LRM-10 发射器和一个额外跳跃推进器。该变体后来成为瓦尔基里的灵感来源。

Original: This variant was designed for the SLDF's "Blackhearts" teams. Based on the standard WSP-100, it replaced the medium laser and bomb bay with an extra jump jet, Medium Pulse Laser, Streak SRM-2, and Guardian ECM Suite. The armor protection was also increased slightly.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_wasp_lam_WSP-100b.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant was designed for the SLDF's "Blackhearts" teams. Based on the standard WSP-100, it replaced the medium laser and bomb bay with an extra jump jet, Medium Pulse Laser, Streak SRM-2, and Guardian ECM Suite. The armor protection was also increased slightly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此变体为星盟防卫军"黑心"小队设计。以标准 WSP-100 为基础，它将中型激光和炸弹舱换成一个额外跳跃推进器、一门中型脉冲激光、一具连续 SRM-2 和守护者 ECM 套件。装甲防护也略有增强。

Original: This variant, used by the SLDF, has a LTV 150 engine, slightly lower maximum ground speed (84km/h), a 120 meter jump capability, and replaces the SRM-2 with a rear-facing One-Shot version. In exchange the WSP-100 was equipped with a five ton bomb bay. This Bomb Bay allowed the WSP-100 to carry Arrow IVmissiles and conventional bombs without losing any speed.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_wasp_lam_WSP-100_lam_mk_i.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant, used by the SLDF, has a LTV 150 engine, slightly lower maximum ground speed (84km/h), a 120 meter jump capability, and replaces the SRM-2 with a rear-facing One-Shot version. In exchange the WSP-100 was equipped with a five ton bomb bay. This Bomb Bay allowed the WSP-100 to carry Arrow IVmissiles and conventional bombs without losing any speed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此变体由星盟防卫军使用，配备 LTV 150 引擎，最高地面速度略低（84 公里/小时），跳跃能力 120 米，并将 SRM-2 换成后向的单次发射版本。作为交换，WSP-100 配备了五吨炸弹舱。该炸弹舱使 WSP-100 能在不损失速度的情况下携带箭矢 IV 导弹和常规炸弹。

Original: The Wasp LAM is similar to the Stinger LAM, maintaining the same ground and air speed. The only real difference is in the armament - the Wasp LAM is armed with a Martell Medium Laser and a Holly SRM-2.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_wasp_lam_WSP-105.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Wasp LAM is similar to the Stinger LAM, maintaining the same ground and air speed. The only real difference is in the armament - the Wasp LAM is armed with a Martell Medium Laser and a Holly SRM-2.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黄蜂 LAM 与毒刺 LAM 相似，保持相同的地面与空中速度。唯一真正的区别在于武器：黄蜂 LAM 装备一门马特尔中型激光和一具冬青 SRM-2。

Original: This variant of the "standard" Wasp 105 replaced the SRM-2 and one heat sink with a single LRM-5.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_wasp_lam_WSP-105M.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant of the "standard" Wasp 105 replaced the SRM-2 and one heat sink with a single LRM-5.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此型"标准"黄蜂 105 将 SRM-2 和一台散热器换成单具 LRM-5。

Original: The Wraith marked Curtiss Militech's entry into BattleMech production. When the design was announced, many felt that the design would be little more than a walking water cooler. What the critics got was a shock. The Wraith is a 'Mech that, when properly employed, can wreak havoc on an enemy with its astounding speed and maneuverability. It is built around a massive LTV 385 XL Engine that allows it to reach speeds of just under 119 kph. The Wraith has a simple, yet effective, pulse weapons payload. Pulse laser weaponry allows the Mech to negate most of the side effects on accuracy that are introduced by the Wraith's heavy use of jump jets, making it incredibly accurate and powerful for such a lightly armed Mech. A simple modification of the Wraith, the TR2 simply replaces the Large Pulse Laser with an ER PPC, turning the 'Mech into a highly capable sniper.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_wraith_TR1-TR2.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Wraith marked Curtiss Militech's entry into BattleMech production. When the design was announced, many felt that the design would be little more than a walking water cooler. What the critics got was a shock. The Wraith is a 'Mech that, when properly employed, can wreak havoc on an enemy with its astounding speed and maneuverability. It is built around a massive LTV 385 XL Engine that allows it to reach speeds of just under 119 kph. The Wraith has a simple, yet effective, pulse weapons payload. Pulse laser weaponry allows the Mech to negate most of the side effects on accuracy that are introduced by the Wraith's heavy use of jump jets, making it incredibly accurate and powerful for such a lightly armed Mech. A simple modification of the Wraith, the TR2 simply replaces the Large Pulse Laser with an ER PPC, turning the 'Mech into a highly capable sniper.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 幽灵标志着柯蒂斯军工进军战斗机甲生产。该设计公布时，许多人以为它不过是台会走路的水冷器。批评者得到的却是震惊。若运用得当，幽灵能凭借惊人的速度与机动性在敌阵中肆虐。它以庞大的 LTV 385 XL 引擎为核心，速度可达略低于 119 公里/小时。幽灵配有简单却有效的脉冲武器配置。脉冲激光武器能让机甲抵消跳跃推进器大量使用所带来的大部分精度副作用，使这款轻武装机甲变得异常精准而强大。作为幽灵的简单改型，TR2 仅将大型脉冲激光换成 ER PPC，把机甲变成极具能力的狙击手。

Original: The Yu Huang, named for the Jade Emperor that rules the Heavenly Court in the ancient Chinese pantheon, debuted with the promise from Sun-Tzu Liao that 'it shall sit in judgment over a battlefield, meting out justice to those who would transgress against us'. To live up to the promise of the Chancellor of the Capellan Confederation, the Yu Huang carries some of the most advanced technologies available at the time of its initial production. The Yu Huang is built on a Chariot Type II Endo Steel chassis and carries a Hermes 360 XL engine that gives the 'Mech a top speed of 64.8 km/h. The 'Mech is capable of jumping up to one hundred and twenty meters with its four Rodan 90 jump jets.
Name: Base_3061.mechdef_yu_huang_Y-H10G.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Yu Huang, named for the Jade Emperor that rules the Heavenly Court in the ancient Chinese pantheon, debuted with the promise from Sun-Tzu Liao that 'it shall sit in judgment over a battlefield, meting out justice to those who would transgress against us'. To live up to the promise of the Chancellor of the Capellan Confederation, the Yu Huang carries some of the most advanced technologies available at the time of its initial production. The Yu Huang is built on a Chariot Type II Endo Steel chassis and carries a Hermes 360 XL engine that gives the 'Mech a top speed of 64.8 km/h. The 'Mech is capable of jumping up to one hundred and twenty meters with its four Rodan 90 jump jets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玉皇以中国古代神话中主宰天庭的玉皇大帝命名，首次亮相时孙泰子承诺"它将坐镇战场之上，向那些侵犯我们的人施以正义"。为不负卡佩兰邦联大臣的承诺，玉皇在首次生产时携带了当时最先进的技术。它建立在战车型 II 内骨骼底盘上，搭载赫尔墨斯 360 XL 引擎，使机甲最高速度达 64.8 公里/小时。凭借四个罗丹 90 跳跃推进器，机甲可跳跃至一百二十米。

Original: This rebadged Sleipnir replaces one of the standard medium lasers with a TAG to mark targets for allied strikes. APCs are not fighting vehicles, their main function is to transport infantry squads from one battle to another. However, many APC variants sacrifice troop capacity to mount significant weaponry.
Name: Base_3061.vehicledef_APC_Alsvin.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This rebadged Sleipnir replaces one of the standard medium lasers with a TAG to mark targets for allied strikes. APCs are not fighting vehicles, their main function is to transport infantry squads from one battle to another. However, many APC variants sacrifice troop capacity to mount significant weaponry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这款换牌的斯雷普尼尔以一门 TAG 取代一门标准中型激光，为友军打击标记目标。装甲运兵车不是战斗车辆，其主要功能是把步兵班从一个战场运到另一个战场。不过许多 APC 变体牺牲载员能力以安装相当的武器。

Original: The J-27 Ordnance Transport was the backbone of the Star League Defense Force and remains a common sight in Inner Sphere and Periphery armies. Consisting of a tracked cab and wheeled trailer unit driven by two crewmen, each J-27 can carry eleven tons of ammo in total.
Name: Base_3061.vehicledef_J-27.Details

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The J-27 Ordnance Transport was the backbone of the Star League Defense Force and remains a common sight in Inner Sphere and Periphery armies. Consisting of a tracked cab and wheeled trailer unit driven by two crewmen, each J-27 can carry eleven tons of ammo in total.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: J-27 弹药运输车曾是星盟防卫军的脊梁，至今仍常见于内天体与外围区的军队中。它由一辆履带式驾驶舱和一个轮式拖车组成，由两名乘员驾驶，每辆 J-27 总共可运载十一吨弹药。
